Description:
Join a team that delivers well-controlled compensation programs and processes across salary, incentive compensation, and market benchmarking. This role offers hands-on analytical work that translates complex compensation data into clear insights and recommendations. You will partner closely with Compensation colleagues, Human Resources Business Partners, and other stakeholders to deliver effective compensation solutions. You will contribute to reward initiatives while maintaining strong governance, documentation, and confidentiality.
Job summary
As a Compensation Associate, you will support the delivery of compensation programs and processes, providing analytical and advisory support across salary, incentive compensation, market benchmarking, compensation planning, and other reward initiatives. The role requires strong analytical capability, attention to detail, and the ability to translate complex compensation data into clear insights and recommendations. You will partner closely with Compensation colleagues, Human Resources Business Partners, and other stakeholders to deliver effective, well-controlled compensation solutions.
Job responsibilities
Support annual compensation planning, including salary and incentive compensation modelling, allocation analysis, planning guidance, reporting and post-planning analytics.
Help conduct market and internal compensation analysis, including benchmarking, range positioning, pay distribution and employee-level analysis to support compensation decisions.
Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, anomalies and potential compensation issues, translating findings into clear and actionable insights.
Support the development, review and maintenance of salary ranges and compensation structures, including market competitiveness and range-health analysis.
Provide compensation analysis and guidance to Human Resources Business Partners and other stakeholders, helping them understand compensation outcomes and apply established compensation frameworks.
Support job and employee-level compensation reviews, including new hires, promotions, salary adjustments and other compensation-related requests.
Prepare high-quality management information, dashboards and presentations, clearly communicating key findings and recommendations.
Partner across Human Resources and other functions to ensure compensation processes are executed accurately, consistently and within required timelines.
Maintain a strong controls and governance mindset, ensuring appropriate review, documentation, data quality and confidentiality of compensation information.
Identify opportunities to simplify and automate recurring analysis and processes using Microsoft Excel, approved artificial intelligence-enabled tools and other analytical capabilities.
Contribute to broader compensation initiatives and projects, including policy changes, regulatory requirements and process enhancements.
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
Relevant experience in Compensation, Human Resources analytics, Finance, Human Resources consulting or a related analytical discipline.
Strong quantitative and analytical skills with the ability to work confidently with large datasets.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, lookups, data manipulation and analysis.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify inconsistencies and ensure accuracy of compensation outputs.
Ability to interpret data and translate analysis into clear business insights and recommendations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex compensation concepts clearly.
Strong organization and prioritization skills, particularly when managing multiple deliverables during time-sensitive compensation cycles.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across Human Resources and broader stakeholder groups.
Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential employee and compensation information.
Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
Prior experience in Compensation or Total Rewards, ideally within a large, complex or global organization.
Experience with compensation benchmarking, salary structures, annual compensation planning or incentive compensation.
Working knowledge of compensation survey and market-pricing methodologies.
Experience with Human Resources and compensation systems and reporting tools.
Bachelor s degree or equivalent experience.

Description:
Job Description: Assistant Manager / Manager Global Taxation (CA, 0–5 Yrs)
Role Overview
We are looking for a Chartered Accountant (0–5 years experience) to join our team as Assistant Manager / Manager. You will manage end-to-end global tax compliance, provisioning, and reporting across the US, Canada, Australia, and India.
Key Responsibilities
• Manage multi-state US (SALT / Franchise Tax) and Canada (GST / HST /PST) Tax compliances and quarterly Australian BAS filings.
• Prepare monthly tax provision, tax reconciliations and review monthly Tax GLs, effective tax rate analysis,
current and deferred tax calculations and return-to-provision adjustments for all US, Canada, Australia subsidiaries.
• Prepare monthly / quarterly estimated tax workings and supporting schedules and documentation.
• Prepare and review annual US Federal and State return filings (Form 1120, Form 1120F), Canada and Australia Income Tax Returns and related schedules / compliances.
• Prepare transfer pricing workings and documentation and ensuring compliance with group TP policies and global TP regulations.
• Evaluate cross-border transactions, interpret DTAAs, assess PE risks, and determine consequent tax implications (such as withholding tax rates and foreign tax credits).
• Identify potential tax issues and assist in developing solutions or planning strategies.
• Overhaul and monitor state-level tax portals, resolve tax notices, tax audits and queries from IRS and various state tax departments, support statutory / internal audits. Maintain proper documentation and ensure accuracy and compliance in all tax filings.
• Identify and implement process improvements and technology tools to enhance efficiency in tax operations.
Work on tax software and internal trackers to ensure smooth workflow management.
• Conduct basic to intermediate tax research on legislative and regulatory developments in the US, Canada and Australia taxation. Develop technical skills by remaining up to date on trends, new developments and
tax authority decisions, and apply them to moderately complex situations.
Candidate Profile
• Qualification: Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) is mandatory (US CPA / EA is an added advantage).
• Experience: 0–5 years of post-qualification experience in corporate tax. Exposure to US / Global taxation is a major plus.
• Core Competencies: Intrinsic understanding of tax concepts and compliance landscapes, strong analytical skills, detail-oriented, and comfortable collaborating across international time zones with consultants and internal teams.

Interested can share CV on sneha.adidravidar@ikshealth.com

POSITION SUMMARY
Run sold room reports, verify room status, determine discrepant rooms, prioritize room cleaning, and update status of departing guest rooms. Strong communication and presentation skills.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across disciplines.
Curious, proactive, and comfortable learning complex domains.
Experience with usability testing and user research.
Familiarity with agile product development and close collaboration with engineering teams.

Job Summary
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that its your career and Its yours to build which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
The opportunity : Analyst-FS-Business Consulting Risk-CNS - RISK - FSRM - Mumbai
FS : Finance fuels our lives. Banking, Insurance and Wealth management, create the foundations for growth, prosperity and peace of mind. No other Industry touches so many people or shapes so many lives.
Amid sweeping regulatory change, todays financial services institutions are focusing on digital transformation, convergence and disruption from an array of nontraditional competitors all while meeting greater demands for trust and transparency.
To address this delicate balance of issues, our competent team of business strategists, technologists and industry leaders bring fresh thinking and sector knowledge across banking and capital markets, insurance, and wealth and asset management. The results are seamless collaboration, innovative problem solving, breakthrough performance gains and sustainable value creation.
We recruit, train and nurture a diverse set of people who dedicate their minds to building the future of financial services. Together, we explore new perspectives with innovative and entrepreneurial thinking to deliver exceptional client service and ensure that what we do today, counts for tomorrow.
CNS - RISK - FSRM :
EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls
Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.
Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.
Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence
Hands-on proficiency in Java and Spring Boot for building scalable, secure backend services. Working knowledge of Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) frameworks, including risk identification, assessment, and control processes. Applied experience with AI and machine learning techniques to support risk analytics and decision-making. Practical experience deploying and managing solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Ability to translate risk management requirements into well-architected technical solutions that integrate Java Spring Boot services, AI models, and GCP infrastructure.
Skills and attributes To qualify for the role you must have Qualification
Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science
Experience
Cloud Architecture (5+ years)
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Job Summary
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that its your career and Its yours to build which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
The opportunity : Analyst-TMT-TAX-TAX - Indirect Tax - Core - Mumbai
TMT: Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media & Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.
We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise-wide operational excellence. We help them protect their data, brand and reputation. We also enable the pursuit of M&A strategies that systematically create value, reduce risk and transform TMT companies into powerhouses that will lead the technology revolution of the future building a better working world for all.
TAX - Indirect Tax - Core :
Our globally coordinated tax professionals offer connected services across all tax disciplines to help the clients thrive in an era of rapid change. We combine our exceptional knowledge and experience with the people and technology platforms to equip clients in making better business decisions by bringing insights to the forefront. We help companies understand the tax policies and tax laws of governments around the world to plan and comply accordingly. Our teams leverage transformative technologies to deliver strategy and execution, from tax and regulatory obligations to operations and workforce management, to reduce risk and drive sustainable value.
We have competencies in Business Tax Services, Global Compliance and Reporting, Global Law, Indirect Tax, International Tax and Transaction Services.
Your key responsibilities
Demonstrated expertise in GST compliance, including return filing, reconciliations, and adherence to statutory timelines. Proficient in Microsoft Excel for data analysis, reconciliation, and preparation of tax computations and working papers. Solid understanding of indirect tax provisions to support GST litigation and assessment proceedings. Experience in supporting indirect tax audit assessments through accurate documentation and transaction-level analysis. Working knowledge of tax technology tools and ERP-based data extraction to streamline compliance and reporting processes.
Qualifications Qualification
Bcom
Mcom
Experience
1 to 4 years indirect tax experience
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Job Summary
The opportunity: Analyst-National-TAX-TAX - ITTS - Advisory - Mumbai
National comprises of sector agnostic teams working across industries for a well rounded experience.


Responsibilities
Demonstrated working knowledge of AI tools and their application to tax advisory and compliance workflows. Your key responsibilities Your main objective is to help the Transaction tax team deliver quality deliverables using tax knowledge gained from training and assistance from more experienced tax professionals. Contribute to the profitable growth by ensuring engagements are executed in an efficient manner.
Work responsibilities Conduct the engagement in a professional manner and in accordance with expectations; build productive working relationships with team
People responsibilities Exhibit positive attitude and demonstrate willingness to learn; Contribute and leverage knowledge from individuals, databases and other sources; Provide timely and high quality services and work products

Prepare deliverables capturing implications arrived on the basis of above research, in word, PowerPoint, excel or email form as required. Use and apply the right tax practice processes and tools to be as efficient as possible in your work. Be updated on latest developments and share articles on industry trends. Maintain and keep upto date records of internal documents / working papers. Assist in preparing training presentation on recent regulatory developments

Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously & Attention to detail
Positive attitude and responsible and ability to handle pressure
Willingness to travel Ideally youll also have
Strong communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
Comfortable interacting with senior executives
Strong leadership skills and supervisory responsibility.

To qualify for the role you must have
Bachelor of Commerce
Master of Commerce
Master of Business Administration


Experience
tax

Description:
Job Summary
The opportunity: Senior Consultant-CHS-TAX-TAX - ITTS - Transfer Pricing - Mumbai
CHS consists of Consumer Products and Healthcare sectors.
Consumer products largely entail, Retail and Agri business. Companies in this sector meet the demands of consumers all around the world, every day; providing everything from agricultural crops to food, clothes, durables and retail experiences. We help clients to capture new sources of profitable growth, rethinking how and where they bring value to consumers, today and into the future. Incumbents need to shift their focus from protecting what they have to creating what they need to become.
The Health Sciences & Wellness architecture brings together a worldwide network of professionals to build data-centric approaches to customer engagement and improved outcomes. To retain relevancy in todays digitally focused, data-infused ecosystem, all participants in the sector must rethink their business practices, including capital strategy, partnering and the creation of patient-centric operating models.
TAX - ITTS - Transfer Pricing
Our globally coordinated tax professionals offer connected services across all tax disciplines to help the clients thrive in an era of rapid change. We combine our exceptional knowledge and experience with the people and technology platforms to equip clients in making better business decisions by bringing insights to the forefront. We help companies understand the tax policies and tax laws of governments around the world to plan and comply accordingly. Our teams leverage transformative technologies to deliver strategy and execution, from tax and regulatory obligations to operations and workforce management, to reduce risk and drive sustainable value.
We have competencies in Business Tax Services, Global Compliance and Reporting, Global Law, Indirect Tax, International Tax and Transaction Services.
Your key responsibilities
The opportunity EY is looking for Senior Consultant in the Transfer Pricing Tax team with the main objective to help the core Tax teams deliver quality deliverables / solutions using general tax knowledge gained from training or education and assistance from more experienced tax professionals and contribute to the profitable growth by ensuring client engagements are executed in an efficient manner. Your key responsibilities
Preparing transfer pricing documentation reports
Develop specialized competence and begin to attract recognition within own service line as a technical resource for that specialization.
Identification of international transactions, computation of arms length price, selection of the most appropriate method, documentation and preparation of transfer pricing study reports.
Complete Transfer Pricing assignments which include benchmarking studies for various multinational clients.
Managing a team of Consultants and Interns who would be working on specific clients related to the industry.
Should have worked on large scale and complex Transfer Pricing projects for both Inbound and outbound companies
Assisting clients in transfer pricing/supply chain planning
Expands opportunities with existing clients, identifies and acts on referrals in relation to the Service Line
Conducting economic analysis/ comparability analysis. Should be well versed in using Indian and foreign databases
Preparing technical submissions for assessments & appellate level
Should be well versed with technical concepts of evolving Transfer Pricing law in India
Representing the client's case before the Tax Officer/ Appellate level
Should be well versed with OECD TP Guidelines and transfer pricing regulations of developed countries
Should be proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and PPT)
Qualifications
Chartered Accountant
2-4 years of core transfer pricing experience
Skills and attributes
Strong communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)
Strong leadership skills and supervisory responsibility.

Description:
Make your mark by partnering globally to strengthen third-party oversight, build resilient controls, and grow your operations career in a collaborative team.
As a Reference Data Analyst within Network Management Operations and Oversight, you support securities and cash network managers and global financial market infrastructure network managers with end-to-end operational oversight activities. You coordinate across internal partners and external third parties to obtain, validate, and distribute information that enables effective relationship oversight and day-to-day execution. You apply strong judgment, controls focus, and disciplined follow-through to maintain audit readiness and drive continuous improvement.
Job Responsibilities:
Monitor third-party due diligence workflows through closure, including questionnaire distribution, tracking, follow-ups, and status reporting
Support onboarding and offboarding activities for agent banks and financial market infrastructures, including closure of oversight-related actions
Perform negative media screening and credit risk rating support processes in line with established procedures
Prepare market development communications, periodic market information updates, and senior briefing materials for agent bank engagement
Maintain relationship inventory, party and reference data, and documentation records, including retention requirements and repository hygiene
Investigate process gaps, exceptions, and stakeholder queries, documenting root cause analysis and outcomes
Recommend efficiency enhancements that improve accuracy, reduce breaks, and strengthen controls and governance outcomes
Partner with data, analytics, and technology teams to support change delivery and user acceptance testing activities
Participate in ad hoc projects supporting network management and business stakeholders
Deliver control and governance reporting and support audit, compliance, and regulatory inquiries with well-organized evidence and reconciliations
Required qualifications, skills, and capabilities:
Hold a postgraduate qualification in finance
Demonstrate strong communication, interpersonal, and project management skills
Apply strong analytical skills with a controls and risk mindset, including sound judgment under pressure
Exercise ownership through disciplined execution and accountability for risk and control outcomes
Take initiative to proactively resolve issues and support responsible management practices
Manage deadlines with urgency and accuracy through effective planning, prioritization, scheduling, and monitoring
Negotiate solutions to challenges and issues in partnership with stakeholders
Build productive working relationships across functions and levels to achieve results
Work effectively across a global team and with external parties to coordinate information and documentation needs
Use Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word to produce accurate reporting and documentation
Exhibit strong data handling judgment, including confidentiality awareness, least-privilege mindset, and careful handling of third-party and internal information
Preferred qualifications, skills, and capabilities:
Bring experience partnering with global stakeholders across operations, compliance, risk, legal, and technology teams
Leverage experience supporting third-party due diligence and questionnaire administration activities
Apply developing experience using AI-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes
Demonstrate interest in applying new approaches and technologies to improve processes, including the use of artificial intelligence
Produce clear, well-structured governance materials and reference documentation for key stakeholders
Strengthen continuous improvement efforts by contributing ideas that enhance controls, reporting quality, and operational execution

Description:
Job Summary
The opportunity: Consultant-TMT-Business Consulting Risk-CNS - RISK - DIGITAL RISK - Mumbai.
TMT: Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media & Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.
We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise-wide operational excellence. We help them protect their data, brand and reputation. We also enable the pursuit of M&A strategies that systematically create value, reduce risk and transform TMT companies into powerhouses that will lead the technology revolution of the future building a better working world for all.
Your key responsibilitiesTechnical Excellence
CSV (Computer System Validation) ITRA The opportunity ITRA is one of the most important risks facing businesses today. Systems and processes are becoming increasingly interconnected and automated and many organizations are now reliant upon technology to drive business strategy and growth. Our clients are overwhelmingly turning to EY for help and guidance on how to protect their assets, minimize business disruption and improve security as they continue to exploit technology and the Internet of things. As part of the team, you will be working on CSV, which provides our internal customers with a Technology recharge (bill) which is timely, defensible, and meaningful service-oriented and based on true cost and volume drivers. It is being used by technology and business managers globally to view their individual areas technology spend. Vacancy for Roles The current vacancy is only for the roles of Associate Consultants/ Consultants/ Senior Consultants. The role will be finalized based on experience of the candidate. Your key responsibilities Perform assessments of computer systems and processes for Life Sciences clients (compliance with internal procedures, leading practices, and regulatory requirements) Create/ review CSV deliverables like user requirements, system specifications, Validation Plan, Qualification Plans, SOPs, IQ/OQ/PQ, Traceability matrix, Design Specs, and validation summary reports Provide guidance and oversight of validation activities for projects involving GxP relevant computer systems Work closely with project team members to incorporate appropriate elements of quality and compliance into the system lifecycle Review and approve computer system validation work products, assuring thoroughness of validation planning and making appropriate progress towards timely completion of validation deliverables Skills and attributes for success Experience in Quality and Compliance with hands-on computer system validation experience on Enterprise Applications (LIMS, ERPs, LMS, RPA, CTMS etc.) Experience in FDA regulated environment with good understanding of cGxP (cGMP, cGDP, cGAMP, cGLP) standards and Risk based validation. Experience with validation/ testing tools like HPALM, Azure DevOps (ADO) etc. will be an added advantage. Experience in training validation resources will be an added advantage.
Skills and attributesTo qualify for the role you must have
Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science
B Pharmacy
Bachelor of Computer Applications
Experience
CSV 2 to 13 years
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Prepare drink orders for guests according to specified recipes using measuring systems. Issue, open, and serve wine/champagne bottles. Set up and maintain cleanliness and condition of bar, bar unit, tables, and other tools. Prepare fresh garnishes for drinks. Stock ice, glassware, and paper supplies. Transport supplies to bar set-up area. Wash soiled glassware. Remove soiled wares from bar top and tables and place in designated area. Anticipate and communicate replenishment needs. Process all payment methods. Count bank at end of shift, complete designated cashier reports, resolve any discrepancies, drop off receipts, and secure bank. Secure liquors, beers, wines, coolers, cabinets, and storage areas. Complete closing duties.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests service needs, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATION
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Description:
Are you ready to make an impact in the world of digital payments Join our team where your analytical prowess and problem-solving skills will help shape the future. We offer a stimulating environment with opportunities for constant learning and expanded responsibilities.

As a Payment Lifecycle Analyst within Payments Operations, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth transfer of funds between various parties while enhancing our payment operations framework. You will leverage your knowledge of automation technologies and systems architecture to process payments across various products and parties. Your responsibilities include identifying and resolving issues, making decisions guided by established practices, and contributing to short-term operational goals. You will engage with stakeholders, manage projects, and spur continuous improvement initiatives, building strong working relationships with internal lines of business. Your ability to understand and apply cybersecurity controls, anti-fraud strategies, and data analysis techniques will be key to your success in this role.

Job responsibilities
Provide overall supervision / leadership to the staff during their shift operating window.
Develop an environment of continuous focus on quantifiable productivity and quality.
Regular reviews of procedures assuring new processes are documented.
Identify business knowledge gaps and ensure everyone has ownership of deliverables.
Assist the management team in risk assessment for process and recommend /implement controls.
Identify areas where efficiency can be gained within process.
Provide timely information to stakeholders and clients on pending requests and possible impacts to other processes
Respond to client services/internal queries in a timely fashion to ensure all queries are logged and resolved within the appropriate time frame
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
Experience in back-office operations of a reputed foreign bank or its payments processing arm/private sector bank/public sector bank as a supervisor.
(Prior experience and working knowledge of compliance /sanctions screening is required)
Strong Interpersonal skills to be able to communicate internally externally and at all levels.
Bachelor s degree
Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
Developing experience using AI-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes
Working knowledge of SWIFT and international payment conventions and practices is preferred

Description:
Bring your talents and passion to JPMorgan Chase, where you will work with a diverse range of real estate corporate clients (leveraged, financial sponsored, and investment grade), commercial real estate property and portfolio transactions, and real estate fund financings across Asia Pacific and Europe, Middle East and Africa. If you are eager to join the Credit Risk team and help the firm grow its business responsibly by anticipating new and emerging risks and applying your skills and judgement to solve real-world challenges that impact our company, customers, and communities, this opportunity is for you. In this role, you will play a crucial part in supporting credit recommendations, monitoring a portfolio of dynamic clients, and contributing to innovation and efficiency improvements. You will work closely with industry, coverage, and product teams to support business needs, conduct credit analysis, and create credit approval documents. We value motivated, inquisitive professionals who thrive in collaborative environments and are passionate about making an impact.
As a Wholesale Credit Risk Analyst within Wholesale Credit Risk, you will be based in Mumbai playing a crucial role in helping drive credit risk management for a diverse portfolio of clients. You will leverage your analytical skills and industry knowledge to support credit recommendations, monitor a portfolio of dynamic clients, and contribute to innovation and efficiency improvements. You will work closely with industry, coverage, and product teams to support business needs, conduct credit analysis, and create credit approval documents. You will communicate findings and recommendations effectively to stakeholders. You will maintain high standards of accuracy and compliance in all credit risk activities.
Job responsibilities
Conduct credit analysis and support deal teams in seeking approval for lending and trading-related transactions
Create written credit approval documents, including the spreading and presentation of historical financial statement information and related financial analysis
Develop a well-informed and forward-looking view of business, financial, and competitive risks for organizations and their sectors, and assess risk ratings
Take ownership of special projects and provide creative suggestions to enhance output
Help drive and support innovation and continuous efficiency improvements
Collaborate with coverage and product groups to support business needs
Communicate findings and recommendations effectively to stakeholders
Maintain high standards of accuracy and compliance in all credit risk activities
Support credit risk management for a diverse portfolio of real estate clients and transactions across Asia Pacific and Europe, Middle East and Africa
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
Master s Degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
At least 1 year of experience gained in a credit analysis role within comparable corporate, institutional and/or investment banking
Academic training in accounting principles, corporate finance, capital markets products, and macroeconomics
Strong analytical and financial assessment abilities
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with strong interpersonal skills
Exceptional work ethic and motivation to learn
Inquisitive personality with a passion for continuous improvement
Ability to work effectively in a team environment
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel, PowerPoint, and Word
Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
Familiarity or previous working experience with real estate clients or lending structures
Previous experience with discounted cash flow (DCF) modelling
Proven ability to drive process improvements
Experience working in multinational organizations
Relevant postgraduate qualifications (for example, Master of Business Administration (MBA), Masters of Finance, or Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)) would be highly regarded

As a Consultant you will help the team deliver and contribute to the profitable growth by ensuring client engagements are executed in an efficient manner.
Your key responsibilities
Conduct the engagement in a professional manner and in accordance with client expectations and as defined by the terms and conditions of the contract.
Preparation and filing of individual tax return, e-TDS return, drafting of submissions before tax authorities, representation before the tax authorities, advising on outbound/inbound structuring in connection with movement of employees, working knowledge of immigration and provident fund in connection with expatriates, etc

Exhibit positive attitude and demonstrate willingness to learn.
Work constructively with team to evaluate and improve personal and team performance.
Contribute and leverage knowledge from individuals, databases and other sources.

Good Communication skills (Written & Oral)
Proficient in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint
Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines
Strong Analytical/Numerical ability
Enthusiastic and Self Starter
Team Player
Ability to grasp details
Good time management skills

A certified CA
0-1 year of relevant experience
Ideally you will also have
Good interpersonal skills
Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative
Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)

Job Summary
EY is looking for Consultant. As a Consultant you will help the team deliver and contribute to the profitable growth by ensuring client engagements are executed in an efficient manner.
Your key responsibilities
Your client responsibilities: Conduct the engagement in a professional manner and in accordance with client expectations and as defined by the terms and conditions of the contract.
Preparation and filing of individual tax return, e-TDS return, drafting of submissions before tax authorities, representation before the tax authorities, advising on outbound/in inbound structuring in connection with movement of employees, working knowledge of immigration and provident fund in connection with expatriates, etc
Your people responsibilities: Exhibit positive attitude and demonstrate willingness to learn.
Work constructively with team to evaluate and improve personal and team performance.
Contribute and leverage knowledge from individuals, databases and other sources.
Provide timely and high-quality services and work products that exceed client expectations.
Operational Excellence / Day to day responsibilities: Participate in executing work within a group by assisting by delivering work effectively, and teaming with tax professionals to provide comprehensive tax solutions.
Ensure that the areas of work assigned are executed in accordance with the work programme and the firms methodologies and guidance, and professional standards.
Use electronic working papers, efficiently including various software applications and sources of knowledge in an appropriate manner to conduct research.
Acquire and demonstrate competence in technical knowledge, and compliance process by keeping up to date on trends, developments and technical authorities and apply them to moderately complex situations.
Analyze and convert data into a tax product (advisory/compliance) and ensure accuracy and timeliness of the product.
Where applicable thoroughly check documents and make available for tax inspections in an appropriate manner.
Demonstrate professionalism through a positive and cooperative attitude and by maintaining the confidential and proprietary nature of client relationships and related work products.
Contribute to the overall success of the team by developing a thorough understanding of our methodologies and tools to enhance service delivery; keeping team members informed of work status; actively seeking assignments when unassigned; proactively seeking opportunities to provide tax services; challenging traditional procedures used in the past; and attempting to find new approach.
Skills and attributes for success
Good Communication skills (Written & Oral)
Proficient in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint
Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines
Strong Analytical/Numerical ability
Enthusiastic and Self Starter
Team Player
Ability to grasp details
Good time management skills
To qualify for the role you must have
A certified CA
0-1 year of relevant experience
Ideally you'll also have
Good interpersonal skills
Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative
Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative way to provide services across multiple client departments while adhering to commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions.

Job Summary
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that its your career and Its yours to build which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
The opportunity : Consultant-FS-TAX-TAX - GCR - Global Compliance & Reporting - Mumbai
FS :
Finance fuels our lives. Banking, Insurance and Wealth management, create the foundations for growth, prosperity and peace of mind. No other Industry touches so many people or shapes so many lives.
Amid sweeping regulatory change, todays financial services institutions are focusing on digital transformation, convergence and disruption from an array of nontraditional competitors all while meeting greater demands for trust and transparency.
To address this delicate balance of issues, our competent team of business strategists, technologists and industry leaders bring fresh thinking and sector knowledge across banking and capital markets, insurance, and wealth and asset management. The results are seamless collaboration, innovative problem solving, breakthrough performance gains and sustainable value creation.
We recruit, train and nurture a diverse set of people who dedicate their minds to building the future of financial services. Together, we explore new perspectives with innovative and entrepreneurial thinking to deliver exceptional client service and ensure that what we do today, counts for tomorrow.
TAX - GCR - Global Compliance & Reporting :
Our globally coordinated tax professionals offer connected services across all tax disciplines to help the clients thrive in an era of rapid change. We combine our exceptional knowledge and experience with the people and technology platforms to equip clients in making better business decisions by bringing insights to the forefront. We help companies understand the tax policies and tax laws of governments around the world to plan and comply accordingly. Our teams leverage transformative technologies to deliver strategy and execution, from tax and regulatory obligations to operations and workforce management, to reduce risk and drive sustainable value.
We have competencies in Business Tax Services, Global Compliance and Reporting, Global Law, Indirect Tax, International Tax and Transaction Services.
Your key responsibilities
Demonstrated understanding of FATCA, CRS, and CARF reporting requirements and their application to financial institutions. Proficient in analyzing account holder documentation to determine FATCA, CRS, and CARF classification and reportability. Experienced in supporting the preparation and submission of FATCA, CRS, and CARF reports in line with applicable regulatory timelines and formats. Skilled in identifying due diligence gaps and applying compliance controls to remediate reporting and documentation issues. Strong analytical capability in interpreting evolving global tax transparency regulations and assessing their impact on client reporting processes.
Qualifications
Bachelor of Commerce
CA
MBA
Experience What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area This is a unique opportunity for you to work in our team to partner with the Business to provide a comprehensive view.
As Risk Management -Wholesale Credit Risk Associate your focuses will be on developing, implementing, and supporting quantitative financial risk management models for wholesale credit, including CCAR stress testing and CECL credit reserve requirements. The position requires strong programming and analytical skills, with emphasis on object-oriented languages (like Python, C++), numerical algorithms, large-scale data analysis, model forecasting, validation, testing, debugging, and performance optimization. Key skills include statistical modeling, Monte Carlo simulation, object-oriented design, SQL, Unix/shell scripting, Git, visualization tools, and experience with modern Agentic AI-assisted coding tools skills. The role also involves partnering with model developers and business stakeholders, managing deliverables, performing peer code reviews, and communicating implementation progress to senior management.
Job Responsibilities
Develop statistical quantitative financial risk management models
Design, Implement and Maintain JP Morgan s wholesale credit models - CCAR Stress Testing and CECL Credit Reserve regulatory requirements to assess portfolio health
Support model back testing and validation and implement high performance optimized computing solutions designs
Implement efficient numerical algorithms using Python libraries and build object-oriented programs for Risk Analytics and integrate new models into the Firmwide Forecasting Framework
Perform analysis and debugging for counter-intuitive observations in forecasts, Technical Documentation - Review, Implementation and Testing
Day-to-Day Analysis performed: Root Cause Analysis, Impact Analysis, Performance Analysis, Defaults Analysis, Sensitivity Analysis.
Perform peer code reviews to improve the efficiency and robustness of the forecasting framework
Partner with model developers and business during the implementation, testing and operationalization of the forecasting framework. Manage project deliverables, bug fixes and new feature roll-out for ongoing model development
Required Skills and Capabilities
Quantitative Object-Oriented Programming skills using C++, Python along with Experience with Visual Studio
Strong knowledge of tools and methods of exploratory data analysis like Pandas and NumPy which are efficient low-level C implementations
Familiarities with LLM and AI-based agent coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex etc.) will be a plus.
Knowledge of Statistical Modeling and Monte Carlo simulation, Unix and Shell Scripting
Knowledge of Version Control Systems like Git, Database systems and SQL, Visualization tools like Excel, Tableau and Matplotlib, issue bug tracking systems like JIRA and Data Structures and Program Design Techniques
Advanced Testing Skills - Unit Testing and Regression Testing
Preferred Experience
Experience supporting wholesale credit risk models related to CCAR Stress Testing and CECL Credit Reserve frameworks.
Exposure to modern Agentic AI-assisted coding tools and practices within software development and model implementation environments.

Job Summary
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it's your career and it's yours to build which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
The opportunity: Senior Consultant-FS-TAX-TAX - ITTS - Transfer Pricing - Mumbai
FS :
Finance fuels our lives. Banking, Insurance and Wealth management, create the foundations for growth, prosperity and peace of mind. No other Industry touches so many people or shapes so many lives.
Amid sweeping regulatory change, todays financial services institutions are focusing on digital transformation, convergence and disruption from an array of nontraditional competitors all while meeting greater demands for trust and transparency.
To address this delicate balance of issues, our competent team of business strategists, technologists and industry leaders bring fresh thinking and sector knowledge across banking and capital markets, insurance, and wealth and asset management. The results are seamless collaboration, innovative problem solving, breakthrough performance gains and sustainable value creation.
We recruit, train and nurture a diverse set of people who dedicate their minds to building the future of financial services. Together, we explore new perspectives with innovative and entrepreneurial thinking to deliver exceptional client service and ensure that what we do today, counts for tomorrow.
Responsibilities
Preparing transfer pricing documentation reports
Develop specialized competence and begin to attract recognition within own service line as a technical resource for that specialization.
Identification of international transactions, computation of arms length price, selection of the most appropriate method, documentation and preparation of transfer pricing study reports.
Complete Transfer Pricing assignments which include benchmarking studies for various multinational clients.
Managing a team of Consultants and Interns who would be working on specific clients related to the industry.
Should have worked on large scale and complex Transfer Pricing projects for both Inbound and outbound companies
Assisting clients in transfer pricing/supply chain planning
Expands opportunities with existing clients, identifies and acts on referrals in relation to the Service Line
Conducting economic analysis/ comparability analysis. Should be well versed in using Indian and foreign databases
Preparing technical submissions for assessments & appellate level
Should be well versed with technical concepts of evolving Transfer Pricing law in India
Representing the client's case before the Tax Officer/ Appellate level
Should be well versed with OECD TP Guidelines and transfer pricing regulations of developed countries
Should be proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and PPT)
A qualified Chartered Accountant
2-4 years of core transfer pricing experience
Strong communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)
Strong leadership skills and supervisory responsibility.
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
Qualifications
Chartered Accountant
2 to 3 years
Experience

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

POSITION SUMMARY
Complete closing duties, including storing all reusable goods, breaking down goods, cleaning all equipment and areas, returning equipment to proper locations, locking refrigerators, restocking items, turning off lights, locking doors, and completing daily cleaning checklist. Set up, stock, and maintain work areas. Inspect the cleanliness and presentation of all china, glass, and silver prior to use. Maintain cleanliness of work areas throughout the day, practicing clean-as-you-go procedures.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards. Speak with others using clear and professional language, and answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Process all guest check-ins, verifying guest identity, form of payment, assigning room, and activating/issuing room key. Set up accurate accounts for each guest according to their requirements. Enter Marriott Rewards information. Ensure rates match market codes, document exceptions. Secure payment prior to issuing room key, verify/adjust billing. Compile and review daily reports/logs/contingency lists. Complete cashier and closing reports. Supply guests with directions and property information. Accommodate guest requests, contacting appropriate staff if necessary. Follow up to ensure requests have been met. Process all payment types, vouchers, paid-outs, and charges. Balance and drop receipts. Count and secure bank at beginning and end of shift. Obtain manual authorizations and follow all Accounting procedures. Notify Loss Prevention/Security of any guest reports of theft.
Assist management in training, evaluating, counseling, motivating and coaching employees; serve as a role model and first point of contact of the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process. Develop/maintain positive working relationships; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to employee concerns. Follow company policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications; ensure personal appearance is clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge guests; anticipate and address guests service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Ensure adherence to quality standards. Enter and locate information using computers/POS systems. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
Inside Sales Executive
Department: Sales
Are you a motivated individual with a passion for real estate sales? Join our team at
Nobroker as an Inside Sales Executive and help revolutionize the way people buy and
sell properties !!!
Location
:
:
:
Kaikondrahalli, Bengaluru (Bangalore)
Full-time
Position Type
¢ Salary Range
Up to 4.5 LPA to 5.5 LPA (inclusive of variable components
& based on current relevant experience)
About Us
NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is Indias first Proptech
unicorn. Its a brokerage-free platform that directly connects property owners with tenants
and buyers, eliminating the need for middlemen. With over 1 crore customers and 5 lakh
new users each month, its reshaping the real estate market. The platform handles 55,000
transactions monthly, saving INR 1200 crore in brokerage fees each year. Headquartered
in Bengaluru, NoBroker operates in key cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Chennai, and
Hyderabad. Recently, it raised USD 210 million, bringing its valuation to over USD 1
billion.
Specific Responsibilities:
Prospect Identification: Identify and engage potential business opportunities.
Sales and Relationships: Build strong client relationships and effectively
communicate product value.
Problem Solving: Address client challenges with tailored solutions.
Lead Management: Handle outbound calls and follow-ups to nurture leads and
drive conversions.
Service Excellence: Maintain high service standards to ensure client satisfaction.
Revenue Generation: Focus on closing sales and meeting revenue goals.



Perks & Value Proposition:
Health insurance: Rs 1 lakh per year, fully paid by the company.
Free lunch and snacks: Provided to all employees.
Promotions: Employees are promoted every 6 months, with outstanding
performers eligible for promotions every quarter.
Rewards: Monthly recognition and rewards for top performers.
Career growth: Employees can become Assistant Managers in as little as 2
years.
Team-building activities: Regular team parties and an Annual Day outing for
all employees.
Educational & Skill-Set Qualifiers:
Education: Graduation or HSC qualified.
Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication, good interpersonal skills,
numerical and analytical ability, and strong decision-making skills.
Languages: English and Hindi mandatory; Kannada, Tamil, or Marathi preferred.
Technical skills: Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word).
Work schedule: Flexible for a day shift (9 hours between 8 AM - 10 PM), and
comfortable working 6 days a week, with a weekday off.
Why Nobroker?
At Nobroker, we believe in empowering our employees to reach their full potential. Join a
dynamic team of professionals who are passionate about changing the real estate landscape.
Take the next step in your career and apply today !!!

POSITION SUMMARY
Prepare ingredients for cooking, including portioning, chopping, and storing food. Wash and peel fresh fruits and vegetables. Weigh, measure, and mix ingredients. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklist. Prepare cold foods. Operate ovens, stoves, grills, microwaves, and fryers. Test foods to determine if they have been cooked sufficiently. Monitor food quality while preparing food. Set-up and break down work station. Serve food in proper portions onto proper receptacles. Wash and disinfect kitchen area, tables, tools, knives, and equipment. Check and ensure the correctness of the temperature of appliances and food.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATION
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
Job Summary:
Participates in the recruiting, screening, and interviewing processes to fill current or expected job vacancies. May communicate with applicants and candidates regarding consideration for employment and the specifics of the role.
Key Responsibilities:
Recruits, screens and interviews internal and external applicants to fill current or expected job vacancies in alignment with the organization s recruiting strategies and legislative requirements. Reviews and evaluates applicants background information in comparison to the job vacancy and facilitates the applicable reference checks, background checks and applicant testing processes. Communicates with candidates regarding their application status; may extend job offers and prepares the appropriate job offer paperwork processes. Informs candidates of jobs duties and responsibilities, compensation and benefits programs, work schedule and conditions, and career advancement opportunities. Ensures the organizations recruiting processes are carried out in accordance with applicable internal policies, procedures and government legislation. Communicates with external recruitment contacts to provide information regarding career opportunities. May travel to recruiting events. Arranges interviews and travel logistics for selected applicants; partners with line human resources to ensure interview and selection process progress smoothly. Collaborates with hiring managers and other key stakeholders in the recruiting process. Utilizes and maintains applicant tracking system including periodic reporting to stakeholders.
Strong Stakeholder Management
Weekly Business Travel
Competencies:
Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Balances stakeholders - Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Demonstrates self-awareness - Using a combination of feedback and reflection to gain productive insight into personal strengths and weaknesses.

Interpersonal savvy - Relating openly and comfortably with diverse groups of people.

Persuades - Using compelling arguments to gain the support and commitment of others.

Candidate Assessment and Selection - Defines qualification requirements and selection criteria for open positions using Cummins tools; employs objective selection processes that meet compliance requirements; assesses, evaluates and selects candidates against pre-determined job specifics and "Select for Cummins" competencies, and communicates openly with candidate and stakeholders to ensure timely hiring outcomes.

External Talent Sourcing - Identifies and applies appropriate candidate sourcing methodologies and tools to identify, attract and engage a diverse pool of talent in the external market.

Human Resources Business Process Execution - Manages the execution of Human Resources business processes, seeking efficiency, accuracy, positive business performance outcomes and operational agility; integrates activities across processes as needed; assures compliance with process and legal requirements; effectively balances process requirements and business leader needs.

Human Resources Consulting - Collaborates with partners to observe the environment and apply sound judgment informed by knowledge, skills, and experiences to diagnose, identify and optimize opportunities to provide holistic solutions, while balancing the needs of stakeholders, primarily employees, with those of the organization.

Data Analytics - Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
College, university, or equivalent degree in Human Resources, Business, or related field or equivalent experience required.

Experience:
Minimal level of relevant work experience required.

Description:
We are seeking an accomplished Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) Risk Leader to provide strategic HSE leadership across our Aftermarket Business in India.
This role will be based out of Pune, India.
As an HSE Leader, you will lead the execution of regional HSE and sustainability strategies, ensuring alignment with global objectives and driving continuous improvement across multiple sites and operations.
You will lead and develop a diverse regional HSE team, partnering with Regional Leadership , Site and Service leaders, and other key stakeholders to strengthen the organizations safety culture, improve environmental performance, manage operational risks, and ensure regulatory compliance.
Through strategic leadership, collaboration, and effective change management, you will influence stakeholders across multiple locations, drive standardization of HSE practices, and deliver measurable improvements in health, safety, environmental, and sustainability performance.
This role may require up to 25% domestic travel and 10% international travel.
1. Key Responsibilities
Regional HSE Strategy and Execution: Lead the implementation of regional Health, Safety, Environmental, and sustainability strategies, ensuring alignment with global priorities and business objectives while driving measurable performance improvements across sites.
HSE Governance and Compliance: Strengthen HSE governance, audit effectiveness, reporting standards, compliance processes, and risk management practices to ensure consistent application of policies, standards, and regulatory requirements.
Stakeholder Partnership: Collaborate with Regional Leadership , site leaders, business teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to implement HSE programs, tools, and initiatives that minimize operational risks and enhance business performance.
Safety Culture and Risk Management: Champion a proactive safety culture by promoting accountability, risk awareness, employee engagement, and the adoption of HSE best practices across regional operations.
Team Leadership and Development: Lead, coach, and develop regional HSE professionals and site teams, building technical capabilities, encouraging continuous learning, and fostering an environment of trust and psychological safety.
Incident Management and Investigation: Provide leadership in investigating significant incidents, identifying root causes, driving corrective and preventive actions, and ensuring lessons learned are effectively communicated and implemented across the region.
Continuous Improvement and Standardization: Identify, evaluate, and implement HSE best practices across sites to improve consistency, operational effectiveness, compliance, and overall HSE performance.
Global Collaboration and Sustainability: Represent the region in global HSE forums and initiatives, partnering with global teams to support policy development, process improvements, and the achievement of sustainability objectives.
Change Management: Lead HSE-related organizational and cultural change initiatives, supporting system integration, adoption of global standards, and continuous improvement across regional operations.
Regional Leadership Team Responsibilities
As a member of the Regional DBU and NRP Leadership Team, the HSE Leader serves as a strategic business partner, ensuring health, safety, environmental, and sustainability considerations are fully integrated into business strategy, operational excellence, and enterprise decision-making. This role provides executive leadership, governance, and independent oversight of regional HSE performance while supporting overall business objectives.
Key Leadership Responsibilities:
Partner with regional DBU and NRP leadership to integrate HSE risk management, sustainability, and compliance into business strategy, growth initiatives, and operational plans.
Provide expert guidance on HSE risks and opportunities, ensuring critical risks are identified, mitigated, and escalated appropriately.
Lead governance and oversight of HSE management systems, critical controls, Serious Injury and Fatality (SIF) prevention programs, environmental stewardship, and regulatory compliance.
Influence executive decisions related to acquisitions, capital investments, facility expansions, organizational changes, new technologies, and business continuity planning.
Champion a culture of safety, environmental responsibility, psychological safety, accountability, and continuous improvement across the region.
Monitor and communicate HSE performance, emerging risks, regulatory developments, and sustainability priorities to senior leadership.
Represent the region on HSE matters with regulators, customers, corporate leadership, external auditors, industry organizations, and community stakeholders.
Develop organizational capability by strengthening HSE leadership, succession planning, and operational competence across the business.
Ensure effective allocation of HSE resources and investments based on business risk and strategic priorities.
Serve as an independent advisor to executive leadership, balancing business objectives with the protection of people, the environment, company reputation, and long-term value creation.
Leadership Expectations:
Participate as a full Regional Leadership Team member with shared accountability for overall business performance.
Drive cross-functional alignment across Operations, HR, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Finance to achieve HSE and business objectives.
Provide strategic counsel to senior leadership on HSE risks, opportunities, resilience, and sustainable business performance.
2. Key Competencies
Strategic Leadership: Ability to translate global HSE strategies into actionable regional plans, aligning safety and sustainability priorities with business objectives.
People Leadership and Team Development: Demonstrated ability to lead diverse teams, coach and mentor professionals, build technical capabilities, and promote accountability and engagement.
Stakeholder Management and Influencing: Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate with stakeholders across multiple sites, functions, and geographies.
Business Acumen: Understanding of business and operational priorities, with the ability to balance HSE requirements, regulatory compliance, and business performance.
Change Leadership: Ability to lead cultural transformation, drive adoption of new processes and standards, and influence sustainable behavioural change.
Problem-Solving and Decision-Making: Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities to identify risks, address complex HSE challenges, and implement effective solutions.
Performance and Accountability: Results-oriented mindset with the ability to establish performance expectations, monitor outcomes, and drive measurable improvements.
Collaboration and Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills to build trust, influence diverse stakeholders, and effectively communicate HSE priorities and expectations.
3. Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Health and Safety, Engineering, Technical, Scientific, or a related discipline is required.
Professional certification in an HSE-related discipline is strongly preferred.
4. Skills and Technical Expertise
Strong knowledge of Health, Safety, and Environmental management systems, standards, and regulatory compliance requirements.
Expertise in HSE audits, inspections, risk assessments, compliance monitoring, and performance reporting.
Strong incident investigation, root cause analysis, and corrective and preventive action management capabilities.
Ability to develop, implement, and monitor regional HSE programs, policies, and improvement initiatives.
Knowledge of sustainability initiatives and environmental performance management.
Experience in standardizing HSE processes, implementing best practices, and driving operational excellence.
Strong communication, presentation, influencing, and stakeholder engagement skills.
Ability to interpret HSE performance data, identify improvement opportunities, and drive data-led decision-making.
Proficiency in managing organizational change, system integration, and continuous improvement initiatives.
