Skill required: Record To Report - Balance Sheet Account Reconciliations

Designation: Record to Report Ops Manager

Qualifications:Any Graduation

Years of Experience:13 to 18 years

About Accenture

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song- all powered by the world's largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com

What would you do?

You will be aligned with our Intelligent Finance Operations vertically and will lead Record to Report (R2R) service delivery, with primary responsibility for Balance Sheet Reconciliations, account substantiation and close governance.
You will be part of the team at Accenture s Jaipur Delivery Center (JPDC3), leading the assigned R2R portfolio and ensuring accurate, timely and controlled delivery across the month-end, quarter-end and year-end close cycles.
Balance Sheet Reconciliations include preparation, review and certification of account reconciliations; investigation and clearance of reconciling items; ageing analysis; account substantiation; risk assessment; and governance of open items across general ledger accounts.
You will establish reconciliation standards, review complex and high-risk accounts, challenge unsupported balances and ensure timely remediation of aged or unreconciled items in line with client policy and applicable accounting requirements.
You will lead operational excellence through standardization, automation, analytics and GenAI or Agentic AI use cases, including workflow improvement and enhanced controls through reconciliation and close-management platforms.
You will partner with client controllership, finance teams, auditors and Accenture leadership to manage accounting risks, support audits and deliver a predictable and well-controlled financial close.

What are we looking for?
Balance Sheet Reconciliations, account substantiation and close governance within Record to Report or General Accounting
Deep knowledge of reconciliation methodology, account certification, ageing analysis, reconciling-item management, journal entries and general ledger accounting
Ability to review complex and high-risk balance sheet accounts, assess the validity of supporting evidence and drive root-cause resolution of aged open items
Proven experience in leading large R2R operations in a shared service, BPO, GBS environment, including transitions, stabilization and critical close periods
Strong understanding of internal controls, SOX compliance, financial reporting risks, audit requirements and accounting policies under IFRS and or US GAAP
Hands-on knowledge of reconciliation and ERP platforms such as BlackLine, Trintech Cadency, SAP ECC, S-4HANA and Oracle; proficiency in Power BI and Advanced Excel
Track record of improving reconciliation quality and cycle time through standardization, automation, RPA, analytics and digital finance solutions; Lean, Six Sigma certification preferred
Strong client and senior-stakeholder management skills, with experience in governance forums, service reviews, risk discussions and executive-level escalations
Experience in managing managers and large teams, with responsibility for workforce planning, capability development, succession, performance, engagement and retention
Based in or willing to relocate to Jaipur and work from the JPDC3 office
Flexible to work in the time zone of the supported country and during critical close periods

Roles and Responsibilities:
In this role, you are required to identify, assess and resolve complex reconciliation, accounting, control and service-delivery issues across the assigned R2R portfolio
You will own the Balance Sheet Reconciliation framework, calendar, governance and quality standards, ensuring all in-scope accounts are prepared, reviewed and certified within agreed timelines
You will review high-risk and judgmental accounts, validate supporting documentation, monitor ageing and drive timely clearance of reconciling items and unsupported balances
You will lead month-end, quarter-end and year-end close readiness, including pre-close risk reviews, post-close analysis and escalation of material accounting or control issues
You will manage service delivery against SLAs, KPIs and control metrics, including reconciliation timeliness, first-time-right quality, open-item ageing and overdue-action closure
You will lead governance with client and Accenture stakeholders, communicate financial and operational risks, manage escalations and ensure closure of agreed actions
You will support internal and external audits by ensuring reconciliation evidence, control documentation and remediation plans are complete, accurate and readily available
You will oversee transitions, knowledge transfer, go-live and hypercare, ensuring reconciliation scope, ownership, policies, systems access and controls are clearly established
You will drive transformation through harmonized reconciliation templates, risk-based account segmentation, auto-certification, matching automation, analytics and workflow optimization
You will lead capacity planning, work allocation, quality management, capability building and performance management for managers, team leads and analysts
You will make decisions that affect the assigned service portfolio and influence areas outside your immediate responsibility, in line with business objectives and client commitments
Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts

Qualification
Any Graduation

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, or assisting guests with loading/unloading vehicles and transporting luggage to and from guest rooms and/or designated bell area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and 100 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Assist the Chief Steward in Managing the day to day heart of the house operations for kitchens, restaurants, room service, banqueting and lounges in attaining their established company standards of operation, sanitation, accident prevention. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Corporate Title: Analyst

Role Description
Our Fund administration team is working with some of the top names in the fund industry.
You ll be working in one of the teams responsible for managing the end to end processes related to securities and portfolio / fund valuation for client segments like Mutual Fund, Alternative Investment Fund, Portfolio Managers, etc.
Our fund administration team uses one of the best platforms available in the fund accounting space which is robust enough and at the same time offers flexibility to parameterize the system as per local needs and regulations.
Our team of experts will be there to coach and support your development to ensure you excel in this role. Enhance your career prospects through exposure to the diverse nature of funds like Money market, Equity, Arbitrage, Exchange traded, hybrid funds, etc handled and serviced by Fund administration division.

What we ll offer you
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you ll enjoy,
Best in class leave policy.
Gender neutral parental leaves
100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities
Computation and reconciliation of NAV, checking income accruals, NAV movement, etc
Reviewing Bank and Holding reconciliations and resolving breaks, if any
Processing and verification of all trades for the day processed in the system
Valuation / pricing of securities
Coordination with client for trades.
Coordinate with Registrars for Unit Capital files and checking and processing the same in the system
Monitoring the email instructions for trades and other instructions including Custody instructions.
Computation of Income equalisation and distributable surplus
Computation and Dissemination NAV to the Press, Registrar, etc.
Trial Balance Scrutiny
Audit co-ordination and finalization of accounts

Your skills and experience
3-4 years of experience
Knowledge of Mutual Fund Accounting and operations
Understanding of capital / Financial / derivative market
Understanding of various valuation tools and methodology
Good communication and presentation skill

Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

How we ll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career.
Coaching and support from experts in your team.
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.
Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.
We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

Description:
Job Title: Treasury Ops - Nostro Management Operations
Corporate Title: Associate
Location: Jaipur


Role Description
Deutsche Bank is committed to being the best financial services provider in the world, balancing passion with precision to deliver superior solutions for our clients. This is made possible by our people: agile minds, able to see beyond the obvious and act effectively in an ever-changing global business landscape. As you ll discover, our culture supports diverse perspectives, driven by a shared sense of purpose.
Margin Treasury Operations (MTO) comprises of two primary function Collateral Management Valuations (CMV and Treasury Operations. Collateral Management is a First Line of Defence function responsible for minimizing Deutsche Bank s counterparty credit risk on its collateralized derivatives portfolio CMV is responsible for the management of banks counterparty credit by issuing and processing margin calls on a daily basis. This function provides margin processing support for bilateral and cleared OTC derivatives, LD, Repo margin, CCP Margin, Portfolio reconciliations and Dispute Investigation and Valuation Client Services. Treasury Operations is responsible for funding all of bank s Nostro Accounts and ensuring optimal utilization of bank s funds across 8000+ agent bank accounts.
The Nostro Management team is responsible for the management of the unsecured funding of Deutsche Bank. The aim of the area is to ensure that the balances on the banks main Commercial, Securities and Equities Nostro accounts are kept to a minimum and therefore the costs from overdrafts and lost opportunity are low. The tasks are performed using the strategic Global Nostro Management System (GCMS).
What we ll offer you
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you ll enjoy,
Best in class leave policy.
Gender neutral parental leaves
100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above


Your key responsibilities
Preparation Monitoring of various MIS reports and thereafter perform Root Cause Analysis for long/short nostro balances.
Regular follow -ups and interaction with different funding owners/trader/operations managers and group treasury.
Management of CIB Nostro accounts on behalf of Global Market Finance.
Responsible for all activities performed within the Nostro management. Functions broadly cover Funding, Reconciliations and Interest Allocation.
Ensuring the accurate forecasting of cash positions, thus reducing the economic cost.
Perform analysis of funding requirements.
Perform trend analysis on balances and liquidity.
Production of data for the allocation of Nostro Interest to responsible business areas.
Manage specific portfolio with the overall objective of minimizing RTB costs.
Providing appropriate Management Information to Nostro Funding and Business Line managers.
Continually looking for opportunities to challenge, standardize and improve processes both within Nostro Funding Ops and the Business Lines that we work with.
Providing appropriate Management Information to Business Line managers.
Continually looking for opportunities to challenge, standardize and improve processes
Ensure adherence to all cut-off times and quality of processing as maintained in SLA.
Fails management.
Support Risk and Control initiatives and facilitate ongoing monitoring
Keep all operational guidelines updated and ensure adherence to standards, procedures and also identify plan to mitigate risks where-ever there is a control issue
Ability to interface/ partner with the onshore
Ensure regular review and update of documents form the Business Contingency Management Perspective


Your skills and experience
Degree educated in Finance, Commerce or related field, or have a minimum of 6 years of work experience in a Banking/Finance environment.
Multifunction Business/Product Knowledge
Banking and Securities Experience
At least 2 Years experience in a Nostro Management environment
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, strong Word and Excel skills required
Proficiency in automotive industry tools is beneficial.


Your personal skills and experience
Strong organisational skills; ability to identify and prioritise multiple tasks based on criticality, impact and franchise importance.
Exceptional communication skills - verbal, written and presentation.
Independent problem solver who demonstrates analytical thinking, accountability as well as execution capability.
Ability to independently coordinate and manage work requirements across multiple business areas and functions, think outside the box and connect with global stakeholders.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment. An outstanding team spirit and flexibility are key.
Must be able to work to tight deadlines
Responsible for preparing and maintaining a comprehensive training plan for every employee in the team
Ensure cross training is practiced to enable manage resourcing effectively
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.


How we ll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career.
Coaching and support from experts in your team.
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.

Job Title: L1 Transaction Monitoring, AML FCO APAC
Location: Jaipur, India
Corporate Title: AVP


Role Description
Transaction monitoring (TM) is an essential element of the Anti-Money Laundering (AML) policy within Deutsche Bank (DB). DB is required to monitor transactions and undertakes a risk based approach towards transaction monitoring to identify potentially unusual and suspicious transaction behavior in order to detect and prevent the misuse of its products and accounts for the purpose of money laundering or terrorist financing (ML/TF).
As an Associate in FCO APAC L1 TM you are a functional specialist/SME who will be responsible for reviewing transactions within APAC TM alerts to identify any ML/TF cautionary flags, evaluate the risk and dispense to close or escalate cases which requires further review by the next level. You are expected to display expertise in evolving AML typologies. You might call upon to deliver results in the areas of training, evaluating and setting process controls, QA gap analysis, KOD review adherence and audit point mitigation. You are an extra-miler with good written and oral communication skills focusing on results and an analytical bent of mind toward problem solving.


Your key responsibilities
Main Responsibility is to review alerts as per KODs and set high standards in individual KPI delivery on timelines, QA and productivity
Evaluate alert generation data as per product criteria regularly to check for anomalies
Escalate any data anomalies to stakeholders and work with related offices to assist in resolution
Evaluate/assist in evaluation of volume trends, procedures, QA feedback, audit finding and recommend/create action plan for training, procedural enhancements and/ audit gap mitigation
Evaluate, in line with specified process goals, alert handling workflow to explore process automation/Robotics benefits
Overseeing the team s production lifecycle, MI preparation, UAT testing and/or any associated process activity as tasked
Assists with internal, external audits and regulatory inspections.
Build leadership pipeline and cultivate high performance skill sets within team.


Your skills and experience
Work exposure in TM on different products, regions and well versed in AML regulations
Working experience in platforms like ACTIMIZE, FIRCOSOFT, MANTAS etc
Has had exposure in delivering AML process automation/Robotics projects
Self-driven, good interpersonal, communication and problem-solving skills
Educated to bachelor s degree level or equivalent qualification with at least 7+ years of relevant experience
ACAMS or similar industrial accreditation would be highly desirable
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Responsible for the daily shift operations of Housekeeping, Recreation/Health Club and, if applicable, Laundry. Directs and works with employees to ensure property guestrooms, public space and employee areas are clean and well maintained. Completes inspections and holds people accountable for corrective action. Position assists in ensuring guest and employee satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the housekeeping or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Housekeeping Operations
- Ensures guest room status is communicated to the Front Desk in a timely and efficient manner.
- Works effectively with the Engineering department on guestroom maintece needs.
- Supervises the property general cleaning schedule.
- Obtains list of rooms to be cleaned immediately and list of prospective check-outs or discharges to prepare work assignments.
- Inventories stock to ensure adequate supplies.
- Supervises daily Housekeeping shift operations and ensures compliance with all housekeeping policies, standards and procedures.
- Assists in the ordering of guestroom supplies, cleaning supplies and uniforms.
- Supports and supervises an effective inspection program for all guestrooms and public space.
- Communicates areas that need attention to staff and follows up to ensure understanding.
- Ensures all employees have proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.
Managing Departmental Costs
- Participates in the management of the department s controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Comprehends budgets, operating statements and payroll progress reports as needed to assist in the ficial management of department.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Conducting Human Resources Activities
- Participates as needed in the investigation of employee accidents.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs, and ficial objectives are met.
- Ensures employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
- Uses all available on the job training tools to train new room attendants and provide follow-up training as necessary.
- Participates in the employee performance appraisal process, providing feedback as needed.
- Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
- Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
- Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Job Title: Clearing and Settlement Analyst, NCT
Location: Jaipur, India

Role Description
The Assistant s role within Trade Services is responsible to acquire complete knowledge of Trade Services processes. Incumbent can be placed in any Trade Services Processes which are Settlement
Matching / Fails / Instructions / Registered Shares/Confirmation, Cancellations, Reconciliation, Transaction Reporting or Trade Investigation

What we ll offer you
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you ll enjoy
Best in class leave policy
Gender neutral parental leaves
100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities
Successfully meeting process SLAs/productivity/quality as per the process standards.
Get certified on all training levels of the process.
Meet SLA s requirements as per the agreed Service Specifications
Meet training targets to learn process for securities transfers, matching, fails handling confirmation of trades and non-trades, cancellations corrections of trades, registration deregistration of shares, cash stock reconciliation, transaction reporting and trade investigation
100% completion of the assigned work with required quality and appropriate productivity
Contact counterparts through mails/calls as per the process requirement for any clarifications.
Performing quality checks as and when required.
Understand the linkages between various Trades Services Processes
Strive for process improvements.
Responsiveness to feedback provided by Trainers/ Team Leaders
Maintaining a professional approach to work at all times, providing prompt and appropriate responses at all levels.
Actively participate in the team meetings and other initiatives taken by the company.
Following company rules and standard operating procedures.
Adhering to all Security Policies and Procedures as per business requirements
Maintaining MIS reports, analyse data by using various reporting/presenting tools.
Active demonstration of the company values in behaviour and attitude
Continually up-grading domain knowledge.
Exhibiting discipline on a personal level as well as a professional level.

Your skills and experience

Qualifications required to perform the role
Graduate / Post-Graduate
German language (Level 3 above for specific processes) mentioned beforehand

Skills work experience:
0-2 years of work experience
Good communication skills
Computer literate

Key Performance Indicators:
Meet and exceed timelines on productivity targets on a consistent basis.
Meet and exceed quality targets on a consistent basis
To ensure that the queries are raised within the stipulated TAT
Completeness and correctness of the MIS sheet should be strictly followed
Productivity - (must meet productivity targets set)

Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

How we ll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs


We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.
Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.
We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

Works together with the staff as a team to gain optimum production and exceed guest needs. Inspects grooming and attire of staff and rectifies any deficiencies. Completes opening and closing duties including setting up supplies and tools, cleaning all equipment and areas, including opening and locking doors, etc. Inspect kitchens, restaurants storage areas for organization and food safety, use of FIFO, and cleanliness. Complete scheduled inventories and stock and requisition necessary supplies. Monitor production, safety and food safety. Assist the Chief Steward in Managing the day to day heart of the house operations for kitchens, restaurants, room service, banqueting and lounges in attaining their established company standards of operation, sanitation, accident prevention. Works closely with the Chief Steward and assists the other food and beverage areas in attaining their goals and standards. Complete required paperwork and orders for maintenance repairs. Communicate handover to next shift.
Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees; and serve as a role model and first point of contact of the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards; and identify, recommend, develop, and implement new ways to increase organizational efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, and/or cost-savings. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Description:
About The Role  


Skill required: Record To Report - Balance Sheet Account Reconciliations


Designation: Record to Report Ops Analyst


Qualifications:BCom/MCom


Years of Experience:3 to 5 years


What would you do?
You will be aligned with our Finance Operations vertical and will be helping us in determining financial outcomes by collecting operational data/reports, whilst conducting analysis and reconciling transactions. Posting journal entries, preparing balance sheet reconciliations, reviewing entries and reconciliations, preparing cash forecasting statement, supporting month end closing, preparing reports and supports in audits. Involves balancing all balance sheet accounts against sub-ledger or other non-general ledger based source data to verify whether the balance sheet accounts are in balance with the source system feeding the general ledger. Differences which arise are addressed as reconciling items. The Record to Report team helps clients and organizations in their operational efficiency and balance sheet integrity, cuts time to close and safeguards compliance with regulatory requirements. The areas where this team s expertise lies is in Preparing and posting journal entries, preparing balance sheet reconciliations, supporting month end closing, preparing reports and supports in audits, perform variance analysis and provide comments for month over month movement in Trial Balance, perform reporting activities, perform intercompany related activities, FA and Lease related activities. The Account Reconciliation team focuses on general ledger accounting which contains a summary of sub-ledger accounts. The role requires a good understanding of P&L accounts, bookkeeping, journal entries, voucher entry, trial balance, and month-end reporting. The role may also need expertise around intercompany reconciliations, cut-off policies, transfer pricing policies, formal confirmation policy & procedure, dispute resolution policy & procedure, and general procedure.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Design and implement secure multi-account AWS environments using AWS Organizations, Control Tower/Landing Zone concepts and security guardrails.
Implement least-privilege access using AWS IAM, IAM Identity Center, IAM roles, policies, permission sets and SCPs.
Build and enforce secure AWS infrastructure using Terraform and/or CloudFormation.
Implement AWS network security across VPCs, Security Groups, NACLs, VPC Endpoints/PrivateLink and Transit Gateway.
Implement encryption and secrets-management controls using AWS KMS and Secrets Manager.
Configure and manage security monitoring using CloudTrail, AWS Config, GuardDuty, Security Hub and VPC Flow Logs.
Investigate cloud-security findings and drive remediation through closure.
Build security automation and remediation workflows using Python, AWS Lambda and EventBridge.
Secure CI/CD workflows using federation/OIDC and short-lived AWS credentials.
Support audit and compliance requirements through security documentation, remediation evidence and control validation.
Create operational runbooks, rollback procedures and security handover documentation.

Description:
Management Level: 05 - Associate Director Performance Marketing
Location : Hyderabad, Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore
Must have skills:
Performance Marketing Strategy, Digital Campaign Management, Paid Media (Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads), Marketing Analytics, Lead Generation, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), Marketing Automation, CRM Integration (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho), Budget Management, Funnel Optimization
Good to have skills:
P&L Management, Marketing Attribution, SEO/SEM, Account-Based Marketing (ABM), A/B Testing, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Data Visualization & Reporting
Experience :
15+ years of experience is required
Educational Qualification:
Master''s degree Preferred
Job Overview
The Associate Director - Performance Marketing will lead the performance marketing strategy and execution for programs, driving learner acquisition, enrollment growth, and marketing ROI across India.
This senior leadership role combines strategic planning, digital marketing expertise, data-driven decision-making, and team leadership to scale demand generation efforts.
The role requires building a high-performing marketing function, optimizing the learner acquisition funnel, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to maximize business impact.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and execute the national performance marketing strategy for programs, aligned with business objectives, enrollment goals, and revenue targets Own end-to-end digital acquisition efforts, including paid media, lead generation, campaign optimization, conversion tracking, and marketing performance management Drive qualified lead generation and maximize enrollment conversions through data-driven marketing initiatives Manage and optimize multi-channel campaigns across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, display networks, affiliates, and other digital platforms Lead, mentor, and guide a high-performing performance marketing team, including campaign managers, analysts, and agency partners Collaborate with Sales, Program, Product, and Content teams to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and learner engagement Analyze campaign performance, market trends, competitor activities, and learner behavior to continuously optimize acquisition strategies Ensure marketing excellence through robust analytics, attribution models, budget optimization, forecasting, and reporting for senior leadership Drive process improvements, marketing automation initiatives, standard operating procedures, and best practices within the performance marketing function Required Experience,
Skills, and Qualifications
Graduate with 15+ years of experience in performance marketing, digital marketing, or demand generation, with at least 5 years in leadership roles within higher education, EdTech, or B2C learning programs (MBA preferred)
Prior experience in the EdTech industry required Proven track record of scaling digital acquisition, optimizing marketing spend, and driving significant enrollment growth Strong expertise in paid media, marketing analytics, attribution, and conversion optimization
Experience managing large marketing budgets and delivering measurable ROI Familiarity with CRM platforms, marketing automation tools, web analytics platforms, and marketing technology ecosystems

Description:
Job Title: Seller Business Development Associate (BDA)
Company: NoBroker Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
Job Type: Full-time | Field Sales
Location: Bangalore, Chennai, Mumbai, Pune
Experience: Minimum 1 year / Smart Freshers
Industry: Real Estate
Job Summary
We are looking for energetic and customer-focused Business Development Associates (BDA) to join our field sales team. You will interact with property owners and customers, conduct property/site visits, explain NoBroker services, and help drive successful property transactions.
Qualified leads will be provided by the company.
Key Responsibilities
Meet property owners and customers for property sales, rentals, and leases.
Conduct property visits and accompany buyers during site visits.
Explain property details, pricing, and NoBroker services.
Coordinate property photoshoots and ensure accurate property information.
Negotiate with buyers and sellers to support deal closure.
Onboard property owners and promote premium services where applicable.
Visit commercial properties and collect owner details.
Update property details through the NoBroker App or Google Forms.
Maintain customer interactions and sales updates in CRM.
Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.
Eligibility
Diploma or Graduation is mandatory.
Smart Freshers or candidates with up to 2 years of field sales experience.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Comfortable with field sales and customer interaction.
Mandatory Requirements
Own bike and valid driving licence.
Smartphone.
Ability to communicate in at least one of these combinations:
English + Kannada
English + Telugu
English + Tamil
English + Hindi
English + Marathi
Key Skills
Field Sales | Business Development | Real Estate Sales | Lead Generation | Customer Relationship Management | Negotiation | Client Acquisition | Sales Closing | Site Visits | Communication | Target Achievement

Manage containerized applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and Amazon EKS/ECS.
Monitor system performance, availability, and security using tools such as CloudWatch, Prometheus.

Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Position: Associate/Senior Associate-IP and Corporate Law
Location: Pune, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Ahmedabad, Mumbai
PQE: 3 to 5 Years
Education: LLB (3 years or 5 years)/ LLM


Job Profile-:
Filing Prosecution of IP Applications and providing legal opinion on IP matters.
Preparing, maintaining and updating client IP portfolio
Handle client queries on IP Practices in India and draft legal opinions.
Prepare Notice of Opposition as well as Counter Statement Reply, Notices and Rejoinders.
Attending show cause hearings at Trademark Registry.
Managing and Maintaining IP filings, prosecution and renewals.
Drafting and reviewing contracts and legal documents for clients and advising them on legal matters; sending legal notices.
Statutory Compliances arising under company law, ROC compliances, Labor Law, FSSAI, legal metrology, Ecommerce, Cyber laws, health sanitary law and drugs cosmetics laws, etc.
Advising clients, drafting opinions and common law research.


SKILLS REQUIRED
Should possess excellent analytical, drafting skills and have solution driven approach.
Excellent communication skills both written and spoken.
Effective time management and organizational skills.
Ability to work independently without supervision.
Outstanding negotiation and communication skills, with sharp attention to detail.
Be an excellent team player with the ability to prioritize work.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment
AboutCompany:
S. S. Rana & Co. is a premier Indian IP and Corporate Law firm. With its head office offices in New Delhi and five other branch offices in India, it is one of the very few IP firms to be registered as an advocate on record with the Supreme Court, thus representing clients from the district courts right up to the Supreme Court, the countrys apex court.

Description:
Position: PLM Support Engineer
Experience: 3 to 8 Years
Location: Bangalore / Pune / Chennai / Hyderabad (or as applicable)
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled PLM Support Engineer with 3 to 8 years of experience in supporting and maintaining Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing L2/L3 production support for PLM platforms such as PLM Support ,Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam, ensuring stable operations, timely incident resolution, and continuous process improvement. The role involves troubleshooting workflows, CAD integrations, BOM management, release processes, and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality support.
Key Responsibilities
Production Support & Incident Management
Provide L2/L3 production support for PLM applications including Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam across production and non-production environments.
Act as the primary point of contact for business users for PLM operational, application, and workflow-related issues.
Manage incidents, service requests, problem tickets, and change requests within agreed SLA timelines.
Perform impact analysis and prioritize tickets based on business criticality.
PLM Functional Support
Support Engineering Change Management (ECM/ECR/ECO) processes and workflows.
Manage and troubleshoot complex BOM (Bill of Material) structures and product data issues.
Support product release processes, document lifecycle management, and workflow execution activities.
Assist users with process adherence, workflow execution, and system functionality.
CAD & Integration Support
Provide support for CAD integrations with Siemens NX, CATIA, and related engineering applications.
Troubleshoot CAD data loading, synchronization issues, and integration failures.
Investigate dataset validation failures, translator issues, and CAD file management problems.
Workflow & System Administration Support
Troubleshoot workflow integration issues, dispatcher failures, workflow processing delays, and PDF generation errors.
Support vault server management, job server monitoring, and scheduled background jobs.
Monitor workflow execution and system performance to ensure application availability and stability.
Analyze system bottlenecks impacting user performance and workflow processing.
Root Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring production incidents.
Implement corrective and preventive actions to reduce ticket volumes and improve system reliability.
Identify opportunities for automation and process improvements within PLM support operations.
Maintain knowledge articles, support documentation, and troubleshooting guides.
Reporting & Stakeholder Management
Generate and publish support metrics, incident reports, ticket trend analysis, and SLA compliance reports.
Provide regular status updates to management and key stakeholders.
Coordinate with development, infrastructure, database, and global support teams for issue resolution and deployments.
Participate in release validation, patch deployment, and post-deployment support activities.
Required Technical Skills
PLM Technologies
Strong experience in at least one or more PLM applications:
Teamcenter
Aras Innovator
SmarTeam
Functional Knowledge
Engineering Change Management (ECR/ECO/ECN)
Product Structure Management
BOM Management
Workflow Management
Release Management
Document Management
CAD Integration
Siemens NX
CATIA
CAD Data Management
Technical Skills
SQL Queries and Database Fundamentals
PLM Data Model Understanding
Workflow Configuration and Troubleshooting
Dispatcher Monitoring
PDF Generation Processes
Job Server and Vault Management
Application Log Analysis
Support Tools
ServiceNow / Jira / Remedy
Incident & Change Management Tools
Monitoring and Reporting Tools
Desired Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
3 to 8 years of experience in PLM application support.
Experience in global production support environments.
Knowledge of ITIL processes and best practices.
ITIL certification is preferred.
Required Soft Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work with global and cross-functional teams.
Customer-focused approach with strong ownership mindset.
Ability to work in rotational shifts and provide production support when required.
Strong documentation and reporting skills.
Preferred Skills
Teamcenter BMIDE knowledge.
Teamcenter Active Workspace exposure.
Aras administration/support experience.
Understanding of manufacturing and engineering business processes.
Exposure to deployment and release management activities.
Experience in performance tuning and application monitoring.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
1. Minimum 4+ years of experience implementing and managing IAM solutions.
2. Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience implementing and supporting the Saviynt Enterprise Identity Cloud (EIC) platform in enterprise environments.
3. Design, configure, and deploy Saviynt EIC solutions tailored to client-specific identity governance and compliance requirements.
4. Experience onboarding applications using Saviynt's out-of-the-box connectors, including Active Directory, LDAP, Azure AD, Workday, Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP, and Oracle DB.
5. Experience with REST APIs, SCIM, and JIT provisioning for real-time identity orchestration.
6. Hands-on scripting using Groovy, JavaScript, and SQL within Saviynt.
7. Knowledge of Saviynt's Risk-Based Access, Segregation of Duties (SoD) policies, and Compliance Campaigns.
8. Understanding of Saviynt's Delegation Framework, Workflow Engine, and Custom Attributes Mapping.
9. Experience integrating Saviynt with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow and cloud platforms including Azure, AWS, and GCP.
10. Saviynt Certified Professional (SCP) or Saviynt Certified Advanced Professional (SCAP) certification is highly desirable.
AboutCompany:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As an AES Salesforce Developer – Senior Associate- Operate, you will focus on connecting Salesforce with other systems, applications, or databases to enable seamless data flow and process automation. Within our Commercial & Service Excellence practice, you will design, develop, and implement integration solutions using various technologies and tools, such as Salesforce APIs, middleware platforms, and web services. This role involves analyzing client needs, implementing software solutions, and providing training and support to help clients optimize operational efficiency and achieve their strategic objectives.
As a Senior Associate, you will build meaningful client connections and learn how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions even when the path forward is unclear. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will leverage your skills to respond effectively to diverse perspectives and use a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems. This position offers an opportunity to develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving.

Description:
Data Warehouse Testing Engineer - Job Description

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
Keywords for Resume Screening
Data Warehouse Testing, ETL Testing, SQL, Data Validation, Data Reconciliation, Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, Ab Initio, Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Fact Tables, Dimension Tables, SCD, Data Migration Testing, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Redshift, BigQuery, Tableau, Power BI, JIRA, Agile.
Must-Have Skills
Data Warehouse Testing
ETL Testing
Advanced SQL
Source-to-Target Validation
Data Reconciliation
Data Warehousing Concepts (Star/Snowflake Schema, Facts & Dimensions)
Agile & JIRA Experience

Description:
We are looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Specialist to join our platinum team of entrepreneurial, enthusiastic, and caring people. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and delivering digital marketing programs to kickstart the sale of our products and drive the rapid expansion and growth in the market. You will identify new and exciting opportunities and establish brand awareness. If you are the person who can execute the ambitious goals at one-third resources than the normal, we would like to meet you. To succeed in this role, you must have a growth mindset and be a creative, self-starter, top-notch communicator, and passionate marketer.
Responsibilities
Comprehend categories, products, customers and business goals
Know the persona of customers and understand their needs
Research products and competitors to identify opportunities
Establish a digital marketing strategy across various engagement channels both online and offline and develop a marketing calendar
Identify syndication schedules for editorial calendars for blogs, content, and social media posts
Develop effective paid search strategies to gain market share
Plan, design, launch and optimize various PPC campaigns
Perform keyword research and audience targeting in support with management
Work with web developers and designers to manage integrations and tooling for PPC, social media, etc.
Monitor advertisement budgets and oversee search platform accounts
Track KPIs, analyze web traffic metrics, and provide recommendations and useful reports for management
Maintain partnerships with PPC ad platforms and vendors
Identify click frauds and eliminate it
Ensure the highest possible ROI on ad-spend
Perform ongoing keyword discovery, expansion, and optimization
Research and implement search engine optimization recommendations
Research and analyze competitor advertising links
Develop and implement link building strategy
Recommend changes to website architecture, content, linking, and other factors to improve SEO positions for target keywords
Build a social media strategy through the audience identification, competitive research, benchmarking and messaging including platform strategy
Setup, Review, and Optimize company pages on social media platforms
Establish metrics and goals on customer engagement and intimacy on social media to boost website traffic and gain revenue
Engage with the customer on behalf of the brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation
Collaborate with other stakeholders such as content developer (copywriter), graphics and media designer, and management for consistent brand messaging and best customer experience
Qualifications
Proven SEM experience with PPC campaign management across multiple web and social channels
In-depth experience with website analytics tools such as Google Analytics
Solid understanding of performance marketing, conversion, and online customer acquisition
Expertise in keyword research, data analysis and reporting
Knowledge of ranking factors and search engine algorithms
Up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in SEO and SEM
Strong business acumen and expert communicator
Experience with A/B and multivariate experiments
Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, XML, JavaScript, and web development and industry-leading commerce tools
Education Certifications
Bachelors/Masters in Marketing, Quantitative, Media or a related field
Google Adwords Certification
Google Analytics and other SEO training are welcome

Description:
We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Ecommerce Developer (Magento 2) to join our platinum team of entrepreneurial, enthusiastic, and caring people.
You will be responsible in developing, maintaining, securing, and optimizing our eCommerce platform based on Magento 2 on hyper scaler cloud environment including underlying components.
You will identify new and exciting functionalities and develop new modules.
If you are the person who can design and develop web / mobile platforms securely at an unbelievable pace, we would like to meet you.
To succeed in this role, you must have a growth mindset and be a self-starter, top-notch communicator and passionate hands-on programmer.
Responsibilities
Optimize existing Magento 2 installation
Provide regular and emergency support for break-fixes
Troubleshoot integration and performance issues
Design interfaces, themes, templates while following best practices and maintain world-class coding styles and standard
Anticipate the performance requirements and communicate with management on remediation plans to CTO/CIO
Develop new Magento modules and functionalities
Manage and upgrade Magento add-ons and conduct code reviews/scans
Establish DevOps pipelines, Release/Change management procedures, etc.
Develop testing scenarios including unit testing, integration testing and automate those
Work with UI/UX and graphic designers to implement front-end changes
Work with content writer to implement new contents
Implement additional components such as Elastic Search, Varnish, Redis, CDN, RabbitMQ, etc.
Manage SSL certificates, software accounts, keys, etc.
Rearchitect environment and provide vertical and horizontal scaling as demand grows
Fine-tune batch jobs (Crons) or Consumers
Migrate databases and data
Develop integrations for files, images, etc.
Manage stack components and upgrade them (Ubuntu, PHP, Percona, Nginx, Composer, Firewall, Redis, etc.)
Create plans for developing mobile experience, mobile apps or PWA front end environment
Maintain confidentiality about IP, methods, processes and data
Participate in conferences, webinars and provide presentations while socializing and partnering with startups
Install security patches and monitor web traffic
brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation
Collaborate with other stakeholders such as content developer (copywriter), graphics and media designer, and management for consistent brand messaging and best customer experience
Qualifications
Strong experience with Magento 2 development and debugging
Strong experience with high-performance technologies such as Nginx, Varnish, Redis, ElasticSearch
JavaScript and AJAX experience for Front-end
Extensive HTML5, LESS and CSS knowledge
Understanding of modern UI/UX trends
Experience or knowledge of React.js, Vue.js and Node.js
Experience with AWS components such as VPC, IAM, EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, WAF Cloud Formation
Linux or Ubuntu server operations working and know-hows
Experience in working with MySQL databases like MariaDB and Percona
Basic understanding of networking and ports
Experience with Google Tag Manager, SEO, Google Analytics, PPC, Facebook Pixels. A/B Testing
Strong attention to details about design styles to improve look and feel
Very good PHP knowledge and understating of various frameworks
Ability to work in a professional capacity and team environment is must
Ability to manage projects and work in strict deadlines
Education Certifications
Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field
Magento 2 Certification is required
Cloud Computing Certification (AWS/GCP/Azure) is a plus

Description:
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As an Experienced Associate in OneStream Implementation for Finance Solutions, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients optimize their financial performance and achieve their strategic goals. Within our Management Consulting practice, you will specialize in financial operations, focusing on enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of financial processes. Your work will involve assessing client needs, developing tailored financial solutions, and providing guidance on financial systems implementation and process automation.
As an Associate, you will contribute to client engagements while developing your skills and knowledge. You will be expected to adapt to diverse client challenges, take ownership of your work, and consistently deliver quality results. This role offers the chance to build meaningful client connections and grow your personal brand by deepening your technical knowledge and understanding of firm services.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be responsible for streamlining financial operations, enhancing controls, and reducing costs for clients. You will have the opportunity to learn and apply professional standards, uphold the firm's code of conduct, and develop commercial awareness. This position is ideal for those driven by curiosity and eager to contribute to a dynamic team environment.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client financial needs to develop tailored solutions that optimize performance
- Implementing financial systems and process automation to streamline operations and enhance controls
- Conducting financial statement analysis and preparation to support strategic decision-making
- Reviewing and managing financial reporting to validate accuracy and compliance
- Applying accounting practices and budgetary management to improve cost efficiency
- Collaborating with teams to provide guidance on financial strategy and internal controls
- Utilizing financial forecasting techniques to anticipate and address potential challenges
- Gathering and interpreting data to inform insights and recommendations for clients
- Building commercial awareness and understanding of business operations to drive value
- Adapting to diverse client environments and contributing to team success through reliable support
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 1 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Demonstrating proficiency in Accounting Practices and Financial Management
- Utilizing Financial Forecasting and Financial Strategy skills
- Excelling in Financial Reporting and Financial Statement Analysis
- Adapting to diverse client needs in Finance Operations
- Building commercial awareness in fast-paced environments
- Engaging in continuous learning and development
- Applying analytical skills to discern patterns and insights

Description:
Job Description
The Finance Solution team works closely with client and project teams in the US to help CFOs and their finance organizations identify, design and implement programs that transform their finance functions to meet todays demanding requirements while continuing to provide valuable insights to the business.
A career within the Finance Solutions team, will provide the opportunity to work alongside CEOs, CFOs and Controllers to optimize their Record to Report process. We work closely with clients to diagnose current-state finance operations, identify improvement opportunities, design future-state processes, and implement digital and process solutions to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and control in financial reporting.

Role & responsibilities
4-9 years Experience R2R Finance Strategy, Process Transformation,Blackline end to end Implementation.
1. Finance Strategy, Process Transformation & Optimization Workiva Implementation,Blackline Implementation.

Assist the finance function to define the finance vision, outline clear-set of value proposition, define sustainable cost reduction model, prepare a roadmap for finance transformation strategy, define and develop a finance target operating model.
Lead assessments and diagnostics of clients Controllership function / R2R processes, identifying pain points, inefficiencies, and control gaps.
Design future-state processes aligned with leading practices and automation opportunities.
Drive simplification, standardization, and centralization initiatives across global finance functions.
Performance / KPI Management - define an effective set of performance measures and KPIs which will focus the business on the delivery of strategy and business plans
2. Technology Enablement & Digital Finance
Lead implementation and optimization of Last mile tools (BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva, Alteryx, Power BI).
Collaborate with technology teams to define system requirements, support testing, and ensure smooth deployment.
Leverage analytics, RPA, and AI-based solutions to drive continuous improvement.
3. Financial Close & Reporting Excellence
Improve close cycle timelines, accuracy of financial statements, and reconciliation efficiency.
Implement best-in-class closing calendars, governance models, and reporting frameworks.
4. Stakeholder Management & Communication
Act as a trusted advisor to client CFOs, Controllers, and Shared Services leaders.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams (FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Procurement) to ensure end-to-end process alignment.
Prepare and deliver high-quality deliverables, presentations, and reports for leadership reviews.
5. People Development & Knowledge Sharing
Contribute to firm-wide knowledge creation, methodologies, and accelerators for finance transformation projects.
Mentor junior team members and support their development through on-the-job training and feedback.
Preferred candidate profile
An ideal candidate for the Finance Solutions practice of PwC Advisory Acceleration Center should be proficient in one or more of the below:
Advising global organizations on improving efficiency and effectiveness in Record to Report processes
Have a strong business acumen, with an ability to understand how business processes and decisions impact people and organization
Ability to conduct walkthroughs, workshops and meetings involving various business stakeholders
Strong understanding of Record to Report processes (GL, Intercompany, Fixed Assets, Reconciliations, Financial Close, Inventory Accounting and Reporting).
Exposure to automation and reporting tools like BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva.
Working knowledge of any digital tools and accelerators such as Alteryx, PowerBI, Tableau, Power Automate, Power Apps etc. would be an added advantage

Description:
Job DescriptionPosition Requirements:


Job Overview
In this role, you will work with PwC and client team members to design and deliver efficient Financial Close, Consolidation and/or FP&A processes. You will lead key aspects of OneStream implementations, including planning, solution design, configuration, build, testing, training, change management, go-live and post-go-live support. This position may require you to work directly with clients from an offshore location and at client sites.


Responsibilities Include
Knowledge Preferred: The candidate is expected to have strong knowledge of OneStream and functional expertise in FP&A, Financial Close and Consolidation, or both.
•  Strong knowledge of OneStream and functional expertise in FP&A, Financial Close and Consolidation, or both.
•  Strong understanding of OneStream application design, metadata, workflows, security, business rules, reporting and integrations.
•  Experience implementing planning, budgeting, forecasting, financial close, consolidation and management reporting solutions.
•  Good knowledge of Multi-GAAP, multi-entity and multi-currency applications.
•  For consolidation-focused candidates, good understanding of intercompany eliminations, consolidation adjustments, ownership accounting, currency translation and group reporting.
•  For FP&A-focused candidates, good understanding of integrated planning, driver-based forecasting, allocations, scenario modelling and management reporting.
•  Experience developing Cube Views, dashboards, reports and Excel Add-In solutions, and using/configuring relevant OneStream Marketplace Solutions.
•  Good understanding of data integration, data validation, reconciliation and financial reporting processes.
•  Ability to lead requirement-gathering and solution-design activities, support testing and deployment, establish best practices, guide team members and client stakeholders, and build prototypes or proof-of-concept applications.


Job Requirements
The candidate should be able to demonstrate abilities and proven success in end-to-end implementation of OneStream CPM/EPM projects:
•  8+ years of overall experience in CPM/EPM, finance transformation, financial systems or related consulting roles.
•  Minimum 6 years of hands-on OneStream experience, with at least two end-to-end implementation projects.
•  Strong functional expertise in FP&A or Financial Close and Consolidation; experience across at least one or both areas is preferred.
•  Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable and sustainable OneStream solutions.
•  Experience designing and configuring metadata, workflows, security, business rules, integrations, reports and dashboards, including relevant OneStream Marketplace Solutions.
•  Ability to identify process-improvement opportunities and recommend standardized, automated and scalable solutions.
•  Experience managing system integration testing, user acceptance testing, data validation, cutover, deployment and hypercare activities.
•  Ability to manage multiple workstreams and coordinate activities across business, functional, technical and integration teams.
•  Experience managing project deliverables, timelines, dependencies, risks, issues and stakeholder communication.
•  Ability to lead teams involving multiple territories in Onshore-Offshore Model
•  Demonstrated people-management skills, including leading and mentoring team members, allocating work effectively, providing regular coaching and performance feedback, and fostering a collaborative and inclusive team environment.
•  Ability to review solution designs and project deliverables for quality, consistency and alignment with OneStream best practices.
•  Ability to guide business users during planning, forecasting, month-end, quarter-end or year-end reporting cycles, based on the candidate's area of expertise.
•  Experience leading and mentoring project team members, with strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, presentation and documentation skills.
•  OneStream certification and prior consulting experience are preferred.
Additional Job DescriptionAdditional Job DescriptionThe Opportunity

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.

As a Manager in OneStream Implementation for Finance Solutions, you will lead the design and delivery of efficient financial processes, focusing on Financial Close, Consolidation, and FP&A. Within our Management Consulting practice, you will leverage your skills to enhance financial operations, streamline processes, and implement solutions that improve decision-making and financial performance for our clients.

As a Manager, you will guide and develop teams, manage client accounts, and drive strategic planning. You will be responsible for mentoring junior staff, confirming project success, and maintaining standards. Your role will involve identifying opportunities, embracing technology, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will collaborate with both PwC and client teams to implement OneStream solutions, manage project deliverables, and provide guidance on financial systems and process automation.

Responsibilities

- Leading the design and delivery of efficient Financial Close, Consolidation, and FP&A processes using OneStream
- Managing end-to-end OneStream implementations, including planning, solution design, configuration, and testing
- Guiding teams in change management, training, and post-go-live support for OneStream solutions
- Coordinating with client stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable OneStream solutions
- Overseeing the development of Cube Views, dashboards, reports, and Excel Add-In solutions
- Implementing process improvements and recommending automated solutions to enhance financial operations
- Managing system integration testing, user acceptance testing, and data validation activities
- Leading multiple workstreams and coordinating activities across business, functional, and technical teams
- Providing mentorship and guidance to team members, fostering a collaborative and inclusive environment
- Reviewing solution designs and project deliverables for quality and alignment with OneStream standards
- Supporting business users during planning, forecasting, and reporting cycles based on area of expertise
- Utilizing financial data mining and modeling skills to enhance decision-making and financial strategy development

What You Must Have

- At least a Bachelor's degree

- Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart

- Possessing OneStream certification
