Job DescriptionGrowing as a strategic advisor, you leverage your influence, expertise, and network to deliver quality results. You motivate and coach others, coming together to solve complex problems. As you increase in autonomy, you apply sound judgment, recognising when to take action and when to escalate. You are expected to solve through complexity, ask thoughtful questions, and clearly communicate how things fit together. Your ability to develop and sustain high performing, diverse, and inclusive teams, and your commitment to excellence, contributes to the success of our Firm.


Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to:


Craft and convey clear, impactful and engaging messages that tell a holistic story.
Apply systems thinking to identify underlying problems and/or opportunities.
Validate outcomes with clients, share alternative perspectives, and act on client feedback.
Direct the team through complexity, demonstrating composure through ambiguous, challenging and uncertain situations.
Deepen and evolve your expertise with a focus on staying relevant.
Initiate open and honest coaching conversations at all levels.
Make difficult decisions and take action to resolve issues hindering team effectiveness.
Model and reinforce professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), the Firm's code of conduct, and independence requirements.
Additional Job DescriptionAdditional Job DescriptionThe Opportunity

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.

As a Senior Manager - Treasury Management System Implementation, you will specialize in enhancing financial operations and strategies within our Finance practice. You will assess financial processes, identify areas for improvement, and design solutions to streamline operations, enhance controls, and reduce costs. As a Senior Manager, you will leverage your skills and professional networks to deliver quality results, motivate and coach teams, and solve complex problems. You will apply sound judgment, recognize when to take action, and communicate effectively to drive project success.

In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will focus on implementing financial systems, process automation, and financial shared services. You will craft and convey clear, impactful messages, apply systems thinking to identify underlying problems, and validate outcomes with clients. Your ability to lead teams through complexity and demonstrate composure in challenging situations will contribute to the success of our firm. You will initiate open and honest coaching conversations, make difficult decisions, and model professional standards, reinforcing the firm's code of conduct and independence requirements.

Responsibilities


- Lead end-to-end Treasury Management System (Kyriba, FIS Quantum, FIS Integrity, GTreasury) implementations, including design, configuration, testing, and go-live, along with bank/ERP integrations.
- Drive treasury transformation initiatives covering cash management, forecasting, investments, debt, risk (FX/IR/Commodity), in-house bank, and payment factory setup, while optimizing treasury processes.
- Manage client delivery and team performance by providing TMS product support, supporting business development, and coaching/mentoring team members to ensure high-quality outcomes.
- Leading the implementation of treasury management systems to enhance financial operations
- Analyzing client financial processes to identify areas for improvement and cost reduction
- Designing and implementing solutions to streamline financial operations and enhance controls
- Providing strategic guidance on financial systems implementation and process automation
- Coaching and motivating teams to solve complex financial challenges and drive project success
- Applying systems thinking to uncover underlying financial problems and opportunities
- Validating outcomes with clients and incorporating feedback to refine financial strategies
- Directing teams through complex and uncertain situations with composure and clarity
- Developing and sustaining diverse and inclusive high-performing teams
- Crafting and conveying clear, impactful messages that tell a holistic financial story
- Initiating open and honest coaching conversations to foster team development
- Making informed decisions to resolve issues affecting team effectiveness
- Modeling and reinforcing professional and technical standards within financial operations

What You Must Have


- An undergraduate degree from top institutes followed by relevant work experience (Core Consulting experience would be an added bonus), or
- MBA in Finance from a premium B-School / Qualified CA / CPA/ ICWA / CMA with relevant consulting experience
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 12 years of experience
- At least one of the following: Certified Public Accountant
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart


- Advise global clients on treasury transformation by improving process efficiency, conducting stakeholder workshops, and applying strong business acumen across finance, banking, and accounting domains.
- Drive end-to-end Treasury Management System (Kyriba, FIS Quantum, FIS Integrity, GTreasury) implementations, including requirements gathering, design, configuration, testing, data migration, and post-production support, along with proficiency in MS Office and digital tools.
- Independently lead workstreams and cross-functional teams while demonstrating strong analytical thinking, communication, problem-solving, and coaching/mentoring capabilities to deliver high-quality outcomes.
- Excelling in financial forecasting and financial management
- Demonstrating proficiency in financial modeling and financial strategy
- Utilizing analytical thinking to solve complex financial problems
- Leading teams through challenging and uncertain situations
- Applying systems thinking to identify opportunities and problems
- Crafting and conveying clear, impactful messages to stakeholders
- Initiating open and honest coaching conversations at all levels

Job Description
As a WS practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients overcome their transformation challenges by developing their compensation strategies through analysis of industry benchmarks, company policies and culture, and employee performance. As part of the team, you will support in preparing job architecture framework, executive pay packages, Incentives design, equity valuations, compliance and regulatory requirements, and financial planning and reporting.
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to)
Role & responsibilities
As a Senior Associate in Workforce Solutions -5-8 years Rewards, you will engage with clients to analyze their reward and benefits strategies, design competitive compensation structures, and develop attractive benefits packages. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will focus on providing consulting services related to human resources, talent management, and organizational development. You will work closely with clients to optimize their workforce, enhance employee engagement, and drive organizational effectiveness.
As a Senior Associate, you will leverage your skills to analyze complex problems and manage assigned workstreams. You will develop deliverables within client service engagements, using your understanding of the firm's methodologies and technology resources. You will also have the opportunity to build meaningful client relationships and mentor Associates and other junior team members. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will support clients in overcoming transformation challenges by developing compensation strategies through analysis of industry benchmarks, company policies, and employee performance. You will also prepare job architecture frameworks, executive pay packages, and incentives design, while engaging with client leadership to translate workforce insights into actionable business recommendations.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client needs to develop comprehensive compensation strategies and solutions
- Designing competitive and equitable compensation structures and benefits packages
- Interpreting market and organizational data to assess the impact of rewards decisions
- Developing global guidelines and methodologies that align with business strategies
- Engaging with client leadership to translate workforce insights into actionable recommendations
- Leading business data evaluation to draw conclusions and develop insightful rewards strategies
- Identifying and tracking key risks, project KPIs, and opportunities for project planning
- Assisting practice leadership with client proposals and thought leadership initiatives
- Benchmarking client data using market compensation survey databases
- Utilizing analytical tools like Alteryx, Tableau, and PowerBi for data analysis and reporting
- Managing tasks in a fast-paced and flexible environment to support client needs
- Collaborating within a team setting to foster efficient and innovative ways of working

Rewards Specialized certifications preferred
- Excelling in compensation plan design and analysis
- Experience in Global Compensation/Total Rewards Managemen
- Working knowledge of analytical tools like Alteryx, Tableau, PowerBi
- Demonstrating strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities
- Supporting engagement manager in delivering client needs
- Demonstrating capability to work independently and collaboratively
- Fostering efficient and innovative ways of working
- Possessing Rewards Specialized certifications
- Managing tasks in a fast-paced, flexible environment

Description:
Job Overview
In this role, you will work with PwC and client team members in designing an efficient Financial Close and
FP&A process. You will be responsible for all aspects of OneStream implementation, including planning,
configuration, design, build, testing, training, and change management, go-live and post go-live support. This
position may require you to work directly with the client from offshore location and at the client site:
Responsibilities Include
Knowledge Preferred: The candidate is expected to have good knowledge of OneStream, Regulatory
reporting and Financial Close Process.
Good knowledge in OneStream
Good implementation experience on Multi GAAP and Multi currency applications Responsible
for building best practices within planning, forecasting and reporting processes and implementing
new performance reporting, planning and forecasting processes within the OneStream Good
understanding of intercompany elimination, consolidation adjustments, ownership accounting
Ability to design metadata, configure security and write business rules Good understanding of
Smart View and Reporting
Good to know other tools like Data Integration, Reconciliation, etc.
Job Requirements
The candidate should be able to demonstrate abilities and proven success in end-to-end implementation
of OneStream CPM/EPM projects:
Proficiency in understanding business requirements and translating them into OneStream solution
Responsible for building best practices within financial close and consolidation, FP&A processes and
reporting 2-4 years of experience in OneStream with at-least 1-2 end-to-end project experience. Good
understanding of the entire Financial Close Process at standalone and group level Functional knowledge of
Consolidation and FP&A in order to guide business users and help them during the financial close process.
Develop various reports (One Stream Cube Views and Excel Add-in) and dashboards as needed. Ability to
build prototype proof of concept” applications within the OneStream platform Transforming FP&A
(Financial Planning & Analysis) from excel based to technology supported (OneStream) integrated planning
Good communication and detailing skills

As a Databricks + Agentic AI Manager you will lead client support work within our Data and Analytics Engineering practice, focused on data engineering solutions that turn raw data into usable insights and support data pipelines, integration, and transformation efforts. As a Manager you will lead teams, coach junior professionals, manage performance, and guide delivery across multiple workstreams while bringing judgment, business knowledge, and a practical approach to technology and innovation. In this role at PwC, you will help shape work around Databricks and agentic AI, coordinate deliverables, support client needs, and contribute to solutions that strengthen data infrastructure and analytics capabilities within PwC Acceleration Center Bangalore.
Responsibilities
- Leading data engineering workstreams that design and build Databricks and Azure-based data pipelines for client solutions
- Managing project planning, prioritization, and delivery across data integration, transformation, and validation efforts
- Guiding teams through development of data lake, data warehouse, and lakehouse architectures that support analytics use cases
- Reviewing solution designs for data modeling, performance tuning, query optimization, and database reliability
- Coaching team members on Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, and Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform implementation methods
- Translating business requirements into scalable data infrastructure and pipeline designs that support AI-enabled workflows
- Coordinating delivery across technical stakeholders to address data quality, security, and operational issues
- Applying analytical thinking to identify dependencies, risks, and opportunities across complex data environments
- Supporting client-facing engagements by communicating technical progress, design choices, and delivery milestones
- Promoting responsible use of agentic AI, automation, and cloud data tooling in modern data engineering solutions
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 8 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Management Information Systems, Computer and Information Science, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Mathematical Statistics
- Demonstrating Databricks platform delivery across data modernization initiatives
- Applying Agentic AI concepts to client-facing data engineering solutions
- Managing project planning, budgeting, execution, and delivery
- Mentoring teams through complex data architecture decisions
- Translating business needs into scalable analytics design
- Navigating ambiguity while advancing quality and timelines

Description:
Position: Senior Engineer Advanced Flight Management System (FMS) Aerospace
Role Summary:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our Advanced Flight Management System (FMS) team. The ideal candidate will have strong avionics software development experience, mandatory hands-on experience in Flight Management Systems, and expertise in developing safety-critical software in a DevOps environment. The role requires ownership of product quality, collaboration with multidisciplinary teams, and a mindset focused on delivering optimized and efficient solutions.

Key Responsibilities:
- DO178 Level A verification experience
- Very good knowledge on C++.
- Display products experience will be plus
- Design, develop, integrate, and verify safety-critical FMS software.
- Work in a DevOps environment, contributing to CI/CD and continuous improvement.
- Own product quality and ensure compliance with DO-178B/C standards.
- Collaborate with Systems, Certification, and other cross-functional teams.
- Works on software design, coding, integration, and verification
- Drive software optimization, automation, and engineering best practices.
- Mentor team members and contribute to technical excellence.

Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor s or master s degree in aerospace, Electronics, Computer Science, or a related engineering discipline.
- 3 to 10 years of experience in avionics software development.
- Mandatory experience in Flight Management System (FMS) software development. User Interface skills are recommended
- Strong knowledge of DO-178B/C and software design, development, integration, and verification.
- Experience working in a DevOps environment with CI/CD practices.
- Strong programming skills in C/C++, scripting languages, and embedded real-time software development.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Desired Competencies:
- Strong ownership and accountability for product quality.
- Ability to identify and implement optimized, scalable, and efficient solutions.
- Self-driven team player with a passion for developing high-quality, safety-critical avionics software.
Location: IN-KA-Bangalore, India (eInfochips)
Time Type: Full time
Job Category: Engineering Services

Description:
Job Profile: Payer Modernization Healthcare Transformation & Analytics
Role Overview
We are looking for professionals with experience in healthcare payer operations, transformation, technology, and analytics to support payer modernization initiatives. The role will focus on improving operational effectiveness, redesigning workflows and operating models, leveraging data and analytics, and supporting technology-enabled transformation across payer functions.
Candidates may specialize in one or more of the following capability areas:
Healthcare Back Office Transformation
Healthcare Middle Office Transformation
Payer Analytics & Data Strategy
Key Responsibilities
Support strategic, operational, and technology-led transformation initiatives across healthcare payer organizations.
Assess existing processes and develop process maps, workflow assessments, operating models, and improvement recommendations.
Conduct benchmarking, workforce assessments, research, and cost-benefit analyses to identify improvement opportunities.
Support transformation across payer functions such as claims, enrollment, eligibility, billing, provider data, care management, utilization management, pharmacy/PBM, network management, payment integrity, and risk adjustment.
Analyze large and complex healthcare datasets to identify trends, operational issues, and actionable business insights.
Support technology-enabled operating model transformation, including workflow redesign, system implementation, platform optimization, and process automation.
Contribute to analytics initiatives addressing risk adjustment, quality, utilization, care management, pharmacy performance, and payment integrity.
Support data governance and effective communication of analytical insights to business and operational stakeholders.
Use GenAI to support research, insight development, and storyboarding where appropriate.
Evaluate opportunities to leverage automation, AI/ML, NLP, interoperability, and data exchange to improve payer processes.
Essential Knowledge & Experience
Understanding of healthcare payer operations and core functions.
Experience supporting operational, strategic, technology, analytics, or transformation initiatives.
Understanding of payer workflows such as claims, enrollment, eligibility, billing, provider data, benefits, care management, and utilization management.
Familiarity with process mapping, workflow assessment, operating models, project management, or benchmarking.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to conduct independent research and translate findings into actionable insights.
Experience working with complex datasets.
Understanding of payer technology platforms and system-enabled process improvement.
Ability to communicate analytical and technical insights clearly to business stakeholders.
Preferred Knowledge & Experience
Understanding of Medicare Advantage, Medicare Part D, Medicaid, and commercial payer models.
Familiarity with risk adjustment, HCCs, Stars, HEDIS, CAHPS, and compliance-driven payer activities.
Understanding of Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) concepts such as formulary design, utilization management, rebates, pharmacy networks, and drug-spend analytics.
Awareness of CMS oversight, payer regulatory requirements, audits, and compliance processes.
Understanding of value-based care and payment models.
Experience with payer analytics use cases involving risk adjustment, quality, care management, utilization, pharmacy, or payment integrity.
Exposure to predictive modeling, forecasting, risk scoring, or anomaly detection.
Familiarity with healthcare interoperability, data exchange, provider data platforms, and automation concepts.
Exposure to digital transformation and analytics programs.
Technical Skills
Essential
Experience analyzing large and complex datasets.
Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills.
Ability to perform benchmarking and basic cost-benefit analysis.
Basic proficiency in GenAI-enabled research and insight development.
Preferred
SQL
Python or R
Automation tools
AI/ML and NLP concepts
Predictive modeling and forecasting
Healthcare analytics and data visualization
GenAI-based research and storyboarding

Description:
Organizational Design - Senior Associate
Job description
4-8 years Organizational Design team you will help clients address workforce and organizational challenges through innovative solutions. As an Associate you will support client delivery across key Organization & Talent priorities while developing your analytical and communication skills. This position provides an exciting opportunity to engage with diverse stakeholders and contribute to impactful transformation initiatives.
Human Development, Human Resources Management, Organizational Behavior Studies, Organizational Management, Sociology, Psychology
Role & responsibilities
Assist clients in addressing organizational and workforce challenges
Support the delivery of key initiatives in Organization & Talent
Engage with diverse stakeholders to gather insights and feedback
Develop analytical skills to inform decision-making processes
Contribute to the design of creative solutions for clients
Collaborate with team members to enhance communication strategies
Participate in impactful transformation initiatives
Uphold professional standards and industry practices in consulting
Those in organisational design at PwC, you will focus on optimising the structure and processes for businesses to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. You will help clients align their organisational structure with their strategic goals for long-term success.
Driven by curiosity, you are a reliable, contributing member of a team. In our fast-paced environment, you are expected to adapt to working with a variety of clients and team members, each presenting varying challenges and scope. Every experience is an opportunity to learn and grow. You are expected to take ownership and consistently deliver quality work that drives value for our clients and success as a team. As you navigate through the Firm, you build a brand for yourself, opening doors to more opportunities.
Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to:
Apply a learning mindset and take ownership for your own development.
Appreciate diverse perspectives, needs, and feelings of others.
Adopt habits to sustain high performance and develop your potential.
Actively listen, ask questions to check understanding, and clearly express ideas.
Seek, reflect, act on, and give feedback.
Gather information from a range of sources to analyse facts and discern patterns.
Commit to understanding how the business works and building commercial awareness.
Learn and apply professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), uphold the Firm's code of conduct and independence requirements.

Strong leadership and communication skills; decisive under pressure.

As an AES Guidewire ClaimCenter Business Analyst Senior Associate you will help shape and support Guidewire ClaimCenter work within our Advisory practice, focusing on business analysis, client support, and the delivery of enhancements that improve insurance operations and user experience. As a Senior Associate you will analyze complex problems, manage assigned workstreams, build meaningful client relationships, mentor junior team members, and apply critical thinking to navigate ambiguity while strengthening your personal brand and technical skills. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will contribute to Application Evolution Services for Guidewire by gathering requirements, interpreting feedback, evaluating process impacts, and supporting solution development for deployed ClaimCenter environments.
Responsibilities
Demonstrates expert abilities managing ITIL Processes; Tracking SLAs, and contracting;
- Demonstrates advanced abilities providing solution strategy and Application Evolution Services (AES, formerly AMS) delivery as a Guidewire Functional Lead. Employees in the Functional Lead position should think of themselves and be regarded by the client as a trusted advisor and think strategically about how to create value using the Guidewire Suite of products;
- Demonstrates expert abilities with ITIL Incident and Problem management for the Guidewire Suite of applications as it will be critical that Senior Business Analyst in this position are capable of navigating both business processes as well as enterprise solution perspectives at high level and holistic view;

- Reviewing user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria to clarify scope and identify implementation impacts
- Interpreting business feedback and data points to recommend process improvements and application adjustments
- Mentoring junior team members on Guidewire concepts, delivery methods, and issue resolution approaches

- Applying problem-solving skills to diagnose system issues, evaluate options, and support timely resolution of incidents and enhancements
- Contributing to continuous improvement efforts by identifying automation, tooling, and process opportunities within application support

- User story creation/updation, developing process flows, UI mock ups, and developing data mapping in the standard Guidewire recommended user stories;
- Familiarity with Use case, SWOT analysis, Mindmapping, PESTLE analysis; Product Designer
- Usage of Tools JIRA, Confluence, ServiceNow, Splunk and familiarity with SQL
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 4-9 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

Description:
Job description
Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

Job Description: Data Engineer / Data Warehouse Developer
Experience: 4 to 7 Years

Core Technologies: Google BigQuery (GBQ), dbt, Python, Informatica IICS, SQL
Role Overview
We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer / Data Warehouse Developer with 47 years of experience in building, optimizing, and maintaining scalable data engineering and data warehousing solutions. The ideal candidate must have strong hands-on expertise in SQL, Python, Google BigQuery, dbt, and Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services (IICS), along with a solid understanding of data warehousing concepts and ETL/ELT development.
The candidate will develop robust data pipelines, implement complex transformations, automate data engineering processes using Python, optimize BigQuery workloads, and deliver high-quality, analytics-ready datasets to support business intelligence and analytical use cases.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and transformation workflows using BigQuery, dbt, Informatica IICS, Python, and SQL.
Develop complex SQL queries and reusable transformation logic to process large volumes of data efficiently.
Build and maintain dbt models, including incremental models, data tests, documentation, and dependency management.
Develop Python scripts and utilities for data processing, pipeline automation, validation, reconciliation, and operational monitoring.
Use Python libraries and APIs to integrate data sources, automate repetitive tasks, and streamline data engineering workflows.
Develop and support ETL/ELT integrations using Informatica IICS, including mappings, mapping tasks, taskflows, scheduling, and error handling.
Apply data warehousing principles to design dimensional models, fact and dimension tables, star/snowflake schemas, and slowly changing dimensions.
Optimize BigQuery query performance and cost through efficient SQL, partitioning, clustering, and execution-plan analysis.
Implement data quality checks, automated validations, reconciliation processes, and exception handling.
Troubleshoot pipeline failures, investigate data discrepancies, and resolve production issues.
Use Git and established CI/CD practices for source control, code reviews, testing, and deployments.
Collaborate with business analysts, BI developers, architects, and other engineering teams to deliver reliable, business-ready data products.
Maintain technical documentation and follow engineering standards for code quality, testing, security, and maintainability.
Required Technical Skills
1. Python
Strong hands-on programming experience with Python for data engineering and automation.
Proficiency in writing reusable, modular, and maintainable Python code, including functions, classes, exception handling, and logging.
Experience with data manipulation and processing using libraries such as Pandas and NumPy.
Ability to develop scripts for data validation, reconciliation, file processing, automation, and operational support.
Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, CSV, and other common data formats.
Understanding of Python package management, virtual environments, dependency management, and debugging.
Ability to write efficient code, handle large datasets, and implement robust error handling and logging.
2. Google BigQuery (GBQ)
Hands-on experience developing and optimizing complex SQL queries in BigQuery.
Strong understanding of datasets, tables, views, materialized views, and BigQuery architecture.
Experience with partitioning, clustering, query execution analysis, and cost optimization.
Ability to design scalable data models and efficiently process large datasets.
Familiarity with integrating BigQuery workloads with Python-based applications or automation.
3. dbt (Data Build Tool)
Hands-on experience developing and maintaining dbt models using SQL and Jinja.
Understanding of dbt project structure, model dependencies, materializations, and incremental models.
Experience implementing dbt tests, source definitions, documentation, and lineage.
Familiarity with Git integration, automated testing, and CI/CD-based deployments.
4. Informatica IICS
Hands-on experience with Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services for data integration and transformation.
Experience developing mappings, mapping tasks, taskflows, and data integration workflows.
Understanding of source-to-target mapping, scheduling, error handling, and operational monitoring.
Ability to troubleshoot and optimize ETL workflows.
5. Data Warehousing and SQL
Strong understanding of data warehouse architecture and ETL/ELT design patterns.
Expertise in dimensional modeling, star and snowflake schemas, fact and dimension tables, and SCD Types 1 and 2.
Strong SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, subqueries, and query optimization.
Understanding of staging, curated, and business-ready data layers, incremental loading, CDC concepts, and data quality management.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Google Cloud Platform services such as Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer, and Cloud Functions.
Experience automating cloud operations and data workflows using Python and APIs.
Familiarity with shell scripting and Linux/Unix environments.
Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation.
Familiarity with BI tools such as Looker or Power BI.
Exposure to Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and reusable data products.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and using Jira.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
4–7 years of relevant experience in data engineering, data warehousing, or ETL/ELT development.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Experience: 5-10 Years
Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad
Work Mode: Hybrid
Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced Service Transition Lead / Service Management professional with strong hands-on experience in managing end-to-end service transitions and ITSM processes.
The ideal candidate should come from a process and service management background, with expertise across Incident, Problem, Change, Release, SLA/OLA, RCA, PIR, CAB, CMDB, SIAM, ServiceNow reporting, and process improvement.
Service Transition experience is mandatory. This is not a technical development/infrastructure role. We are looking for candidates who specialize in ITSM processes, transition governance, service management, and multi-vendor coordination.
Key Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end Service Transition activities for new or changed services moving into BAU/application support.
Create, define, implement, and improve ITSM / IMS processes, procedures, governance models, and operating frameworks.
Own and govern Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management processes.
Develop and maintain transition plans, readiness assessments, checklists, governance mechanisms, and service acceptance criteria.
Ensure successful handover of applications/services from project or development teams into operational support.
Manage Change and Release processes, including planning, risk assessment, approvals, scheduling, governance, and implementation tracking.
Facilitate and coordinate CAB (Change Advisory Board) activities.
Drive RCA (Root Cause Analysis) and PIR (Post-Incident Review) processes for major/critical incidents.
Define, monitor, calculate, and report SLAs, OLAs, KPIs, and other service management metrics.
Create and maintain ServiceNow reports and dashboards for SLA compliance, incidents, changes, problems, and overall service performance.
Use Microsoft Excel for service reporting, analysis, SLA tracking, process metrics, and management reporting.
Work effectively within a SIAM / multi-vendor model, coordinating across multiple internal and external service providers.
Support appropriate CMDB governance and ensure configuration/service information supports ITSM processes.
Identify process gaps and drive continuous service/process improvement initiatives.
Coordinate with application support teams and other stakeholders to ensure operational readiness and service stability.
Provide service management updates, risks, SLA performance, transition status, and improvement plans to stakeholders.
Mandatory Skills & Experience
510 years of relevant experience in IT Service Management / Service Management.
Hands-on Service Transition experience is mandatory.
Strong experience in creating, implementing, or improving ITSM / IMS processes.
Strong process knowledge across:
Incident Management
Problem Management
Change Management
Release Management
Service Transition
Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, particularly reporting and service-management tracking.
Experience with SLA calculation, SLA reporting, KPI tracking, and service-performance reporting.
Strong knowledge of RCA, PIR, SLA, OLA, CAB, and CMDB processes.
Experience working within a SIAM / multi-vendor service management environment.
Strong Microsoft Excel skills for reporting, analysis, tracking, and management dashboards.
Experience working with or supporting Application Support / Application Management Services.
Demonstrated experience in process improvement and service optimization.
Strong stakeholder, governance, coordination, and vendor-management skills.
Preferred Skills
ITIL Foundation / ITIL 4 certification.
Experience managing complex service transitions involving multiple vendors/service providers.
Experience with Major Incident Management and service improvement initiatives.
Exposure to transition governance, operational readiness, service acceptance, and knowledge-transfer processes.
Strong reporting, presentation, and stakeholder communication skills.

Description:
PwC US CONSULTING SOLUTIONS - MANAGEMENT CONSULTING Our Management Consulting team works with our global clients to design and implement growth, operational and customer focused strategies for sustainable competitive advantage. Our thought leadership and unparalleled experience help clients turn formidable challenges into market advantage across the value chain and around the globe. Additionally, our extensive expertise in various industries allows us to serve clients with consulting services with a focus on the most profitable elements of the value chain to create scalable businesses that will deliver increased sustainable profits.  Our Management Consultants work with the client and project teams to support global engagements from India through activities that are driven toward delivering results - conduct analyses and develop insights, prepare excel models, analyze large sets of data, capture as-is processes, prepare work plans, design to-be processes. In addition, consultants also support project lead, work directly with client teams, and facilitate meetings to enable decision making, organize and prepare recommendations on client issues, and participate actively in new business development, thought leadership and firm building activities. PRACTICE OVERVIEW: WORKFORCE SOLUTIONS
At PwC, this team of consultants works with their US counterparts to develop both short and long-term Workforce Solutions for our clients. Our practitioners facilitate transformation by conducting strategic change initiatives, assisting transformative leadership initiatives, designing HR processes, developing, and implementing learning interventions that align with the clients business strategy. Some of our key capabilities include: 
HR Strategy & Operations 
NextGen Change  
Organization & Talent  
Rewards & Benefits 
Workforce Technology – Enabling Apps 
POSITION REQUIREMENTS: Key Responsibilities: As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growthAs such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to): Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies: 
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Bloom’s taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery – spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training. 
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 1–3 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements: 
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.
What skill does it take? Must-have
An interest in upskilling for a digital world and technology trends, an openness to learning new tools and adapting how you work. 
Will to work in a fast-paced environment with sometimes unpredictable circumstances or changes, comfortable working in ambiguity. 
Self-motivated with a passion for client work and teamwork. 
Strong project management skills. 
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with stakeholders at all levels. 
Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs. 
Ability to develop and present new, innovative ideas and conceptualize new approaches and solutions. 
Will to learn, adopt and lead new ways of doing things (e.g., personas, journey mapping, gamification, etc.). 
Proficiency in leveraging GenAI tools to enhance productivity, analysis, and delivery quality. 
Ability to work with data to transform information into actionable insights. 
Foster an efficient, innovative, and team-oriented work environment.  
Strong work ethics, proactive, and professional behavior. 
Good-to-have
Effective storytelling and communication skills to various audiences (written and verbal). 
Strategic, creative thinker and problem solver. 
Analytical mindset, with the ability to use data and metrics to assess training effectiveness. 
Supports engagement managers in delivering engagements by identifying and addressing client needs. 
Exhibits strong ability to work independently as well as in a highly collaborative team environment. 
Demonstrated experience supporting client-facing consulting engagements and mentoring junior team members. 
Hands-on experience utilizing AI tools and capabilities such as prompt engineering, AI-assisted analysis, and creating workforce-specific solutions.

At PwC, we connect people with diverse backgrounds and skill sets to solve important

with PwC.
Acceleration Centers (ACs) are PwCs diverse, global talent hubs focused on enabling

specic solutions.
PwC's high-performance culture is based on passion for excellence with focus on diversity
and inclusion. You will collaborate with and receive support from a network of people to

career coaching and learning & development makes our rm one of the best places to work,
learn and excel.
Apply to us if you believe PwC is the place to be. Now and in the future!

Description:
We're Hiring | Multiple Openings Partner Enablement & Operations

Hyderabad/Bangalore/Pune

Exciting career opportunities across Customer Support, Technical Support, Quality Assurance, Training, SME and Team Leadership.

6 Positions Open & Salary:

Subject Matter Expert - Technical Lead (Salary upto 8 LPA)
Quality Analyst - Quality Coach (Salary upto 10 LPA)
Trainer - Partner Enablement (Salary upto 10 LPA)
Team Lead / AM Partner Enablement (Salary upto 12 LPA)

Immediate Joiners
Industry: IT Services / B2B Technology Support

Hr Iqra 9103718248

1. Partner Advocate Frontline Agent
Job Description
We are hiring Partner Advocates to support global technology partners with program membership, product-related queries and marketplace offers. The role involves delivering excellent customer support, resolving queries and managing cases through appropriate channels.
Key Responsibilities
Handle partner queries through phone, chat and online submissions.
Provide guidance on partner programs, membership and marketplace offers.
Troubleshoot issues and manage cases through resolution.
Maintain accurate case documentation and ensure timely follow-ups.
Escalate complex issues to appropriate support teams.
Maintain customer satisfaction, confidentiality and compliance.
Qualification & Experience
Graduate in any discipline.
Minimum 6 months of experience in Customer Support, Technical Support or Sales.
Good knowledge of Windows, Microsoft 365 and basic IT terminology.
Excellent English communication and problem-solving skills.
Willingness to complete required product training and certifications.

2. Subject Matter Expert (SME) Technical Lead
Job Description
Looking for an experienced SME to provide advanced technical and process support to frontline teams handling global technology partner queries. The role involves resolving complex cases, guiding agents, managing escalations and strengthening overall process knowledge.
Key Responsibilities
Provide real-time technical and process guidance to frontline agents.
Troubleshoot complex partner issues and manage critical escalations.
Support partner calls and coordinate with specialist support teams.
Mentor agents through case reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions.
Develop and maintain SOPs, troubleshooting guides and knowledge articles.
Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
Qualification & Experience
Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
Minimum 1 year of experience in Technical Support, Customer Support or a comparable role.
Prior SME, escalation handling or advanced troubleshooting experience preferred.
Knowledge of Windows, Microsoft 365, Azure and partner support platforms.
Strong analytical, communication and mentoring skills.

3. Quality Analyst Quality Coach
Job Description
We are looking for a Quality Analyst / Quality Coach to monitor and improve the performance of frontline support teams. The role focuses on interaction audits, quality assessments, feedback, coaching and improving customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Monitor and evaluate customer interactions across calls, chats and case records.
Conduct quality audits based on defined standards and scorecards.
Provide individual and group coaching to improve agent performance.
Analyse CSAT, DSAT and recurring quality defects.
Conduct root cause analysis and recommend corrective actions.
Participate in internal and client calibration sessions.
Prepare quality reports, dashboards and performance improvement plans.
Qualification & Experience
Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
Prior experience in Quality Assurance, Customer Support or Technical Support.
Experience in interaction monitoring, case audits and coaching.
Knowledge of CSAT, DSAT, RCA and quality reporting.
Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint.
Strong analytical and communication skills.

4. Trainer Partner Enablement
Job Description
Seeking an experienced Process / Technical Trainer to design and deliver training programs for partner support teams. The role involves onboarding new employees, developing technical knowledge, conducting assessments and improving overall team readiness.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct new-hire onboarding and process training.
Develop training materials, presentations, assessments and learning guides.
Deliver classroom, virtual and practical training sessions.
Train employees on partner support platforms, products and processes.
Conduct knowledge assessments and identify learning gaps.
Provide coaching during training and nesting periods.
Track training effectiveness and maintain learning records.
Qualification & Experience
Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
Prior experience as a Process Trainer, Technical Trainer or Training Specialist.
Experience in training-needs analysis and instructional design.
Knowledge of Windows, Microsoft 365, Azure and partner support processes preferred.
Proficiency in PowerPoint, Word, Excel and Teams.
Excellent presentation, facilitation and communication skills.

5. Team Lead / Assistant Manager Partner Enablement
Job Description
We are hiring an experienced Team Lead to manage frontline operations supporting global technology partners. The role involves leading a team of Partner Advocates, driving operational performance, ensuring service quality and managing customer escalations.
Key Responsibilities
Manage daily operations and allocate work across the team.
Monitor productivity, quality, CSAT and service-level performance.
Conduct regular one-on-one sessions, team meetings and coaching.
Handle complex partner escalations and ensure timely resolution.
Identify performance gaps and coordinate training interventions.
Drive process improvements and ensure compliance with policies.
Prepare operational reports and share performance updates with management.
Qualification & Experience
Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
Prior experience leading Customer Support, Technical Support or Contact Centre teams.
Experience in performance management, coaching and escalation handling.
Knowledge of Windows, Microsoft 365, Azure and partner support platforms preferred.
Strong leadership, communication and stakeholder-management skills.

6. Quality Manager Partner Enablement
Job Description
Looking for an experienced Quality Manager to lead the Quality Assurance function for partner enablement operations. The role involves managing quality teams, developing audit frameworks, driving customer experience improvements and ensuring consistent quality standards across support operations.
Key Responsibilities
Define and implement quality frameworks, scorecards and audit methodologies.
Lead, coach and develop the Quality Analyst team.
Monitor quality performance across calls, chats and case management.
Conduct calibration sessions with Operations, Training and stakeholders.
Analyse CSAT, DSAT, escalations and recurring quality issues.
Drive RCA, corrective and preventive action plans.
Prepare quality dashboards, reports and management presentations.
Ensure compliance with privacy, security and contractual requirements.
Qualification & Experience
Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
Significant experience in Quality Assurance and Customer Support operations.
Prior experience managing Quality Analysts or a quality team.
Strong knowledge of quality frameworks, RCA, coaching and continuous improvement.
Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and quality reporting tools.
Six Sigma, COPC or relevant quality certification preferred.
Excellent leadership and stakeholder-management skills.

Description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way youd like, where youll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where youll be able to reimagine whats possible. Join us and help the worlds leading organizations
Your Profile

We are looking for experienced PLSQL Developers with strong expertise in Oracle Database technologies to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing, optimizing, and maintaining database objects, supporting enterprise applications, and ensuring high-performance database operations.
Design, develop, test, and maintain complex PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, triggers, and database objects.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical database solutions.
Develop and optimize SQL queries for high-performance applications.
Perform data analysis, data migration, and database enhancement activities.
Troubleshoot and resolve database-related issues in development, testing, and production environments.
Create and maintain database schema objects, views, indexes, sequences, and materialized views.
Perform performance tuning of SQL queries, PL/SQL code, and database objects.
Support application development teams during integrations, releases, and deployments.
Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.



Your Profile

Prepare technical documentation and provide production support as needed.
6 to 14 years of IT experience with strong expertise in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL development.
Hands-on experience in:
PL/SQL Packages, Procedures, Functions, and Triggers, Complex SQL Queries, Performance Tuning, Query Optimization, Data Modelling Concepts, Stored Procedures Development, Materialized View, Database Indexing Strategies, Exception Handling, Bulk Collect FORALL
Strong understanding of Oracle Database architecture.
Experience with Oracle 11g, 12c, 19c, or higher versions.
Ability to analyze and resolve performance bottlenecks.
Experience in database design, development, and support activities.



What you''ll love about working with us

We value flexibility and support a healthy work-life balance through remote and hybrid work options.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
Career development programs and certifications in cloud technologies.
A diverse and inclusive workplace that fosters innovation and collaboration.
We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise andstrong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of 22.5 billion.
Capgemini in India comprises nearly 235,000 team members working across 13 locations: Bangalore, Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Coimbatore, Gandhinagar, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Noida, Pune, Salem, and Tiruchirappalli.

Description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you'd like, where you'll be supported and inspired bya collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you'll be able to reimagine whats possible. Join us and help the worlds leading organizations

Your Role

We are looking for experienced Guidewire professionals with strong hands-on expertise across ClaimCenter and Guidewire Integrations to design, configure, customize, and support scalable solutions for Property Casualty insurance clients. The role involves working across the Guidewire Insurance Suite ecosystem to enable seamless policy administration, claims management, billing operations, and system integrations.
Design, develop, configure, and maintain Guidewire applications across ClaimCenter and claims Integration modules.
Customize Guidewire components using Gosu, Java, Guidewire Studio, and configuration tools.
Develop and support ClaimCenter solutions including claim workflows, rules, plugins, batch processes, web services, and integrations with internal and external systems.
Design and build integrations using the Guidewire Integration Framework, including plugins, messaging, web services, batch processes, event triggers, and data exchange pipelines.
Develop and maintain SOAP/REST APIs, XML/XSD-based data exchanges, JSON structures, messaging components, and integration interfaces.
Collaborate with business analysts, architects, QA teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.


Your Profile
6+years of experience in software development, with strong hands-on exposure to Guidewire InsuranceSuite applications.
Strong experience in Guidewire module: ClaimCenter
Proficiency in Gosu, Java, XML, JSON, XSD, SQL, SOAP/REST Web Services, and Guidewire configuration tools.
Good understanding of Property Casualty insurance domain processes across Claims and integration landscapes.
Hands-on experience with Guidewire data models, workflows, rules engine, plugins, messaging, batch processes, and web services.
Experience integrating Guidewire applications with ClaimCenter,comp raters, payment gateways, document systems, accounting platforms, customer portals, and other external systems.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools such as JIRA and Confluence. [Job Descri...C CC Integ | Word]
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, DevOps tools, Git, Jenkins, Maven, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Guidewire Cloud is preferred.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
Guidewire certification in ClaimCenter is preferred.


What you will love about working here

Opportunity to work on large-scale Guidewire InsuranceSuite transformation programs for global PC insurance clients.
Exposure to end-to-end insurance technology delivery across policy, claims, billing, and integration platforms.
Hands-on experience with modern engineering practices including Agile delivery, CI/CD, DevOps, cloud, and integration-led architecture.
Structured learning, certifications, and continuous upskilling opportunities in insurance platforms and emerging technologies.
A collaborative and inclusive culture focused on innovation, delivery excellence, and client value.


We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of 22.5 billion.
Capgemini in India comprises nearly 235,000 team members working across 13 locations: Bangalore, Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Coimbatore, Gandhinagar, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Noida, Pune, Salem, and Tiruchirappalli.

Manage incidents, service requests, and change requests through ticketing tools.
Monitor AWS infrastructure and application services.
Create and maintain support documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles.
Participate in on-call support and production release activities.

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Description:
Designation : Business Analyst
Location : Bangalore & Navi Mumbai Location

Responsibilities :
Business Analyst would be responsible for working closely with the Business Teams and helping them in making data driven decisions. This would require cross-communication between the Business Team, Product Team & Data Engineering as well. Apart from solving the business problem at hand, a Business Analyst would also be responsible for sharing insights and learning basis the data exploration/mining and convert these into clear action points and ensure that the same are being worked upon
Getting business requirements from the respective Business Teams, identifying the
underlying business case and building a generalized solution
Extracting & Exploring the data from database and other sources that may exist,
cleaning the data for any issues/missing values also needs to be owned upon
Converting the cleaned data into actionable insights and sharing the same with relevant
Audience
Automation of data problems/solutions that occur recursively
Flagging to Data Engineering in case of data sanity issues are to be seen
Ensure that the action insights shared with the business teams are worked upon

Job Purpose

The Client Manager is responsible to understand the business and most important be a bearer of relationship with Enterprise Customer, with Ownership of Entire Customer Life Cycle for the assigned Enterprise Customers. Single & Most important bearer of Relationship with Enterprise Customer with Ownership of Entire Customer Life Cycle for all assigned Enterprise Customers.

Collaborative aproach within the team and organisation
Account Engagement and Account Mapping across multi levels /verticals
End to end operational responsibility leading to CXX

Competencies
Experience in managing global and a track record of global accounts/ enterprise solution selling
Experience in complex change management and operating in a matrix, fast moving and technical environment.
Experience in working in multi-cultural environment ability to manage an international and distributed team.
Team player, strong influence and relationship management skills, customer centric.
Strong communication and decision making skills– ability to balance conflicting interests and ability to lead in a high-growth, high-uncertainty environments
Learning
To learn new products and services so as to be updated with the Customer needs and market trends
Apply the learning in own Customer scenario
Must have technical/ professional qualifications
Experience handling Strategic Accounts and C-level engagement
Education: MBA and Engineering background preferred
5+ years of experience
Should have preferably worked with Telecom, Technology Companies

Area Sales Manager (ASM) NoBroker Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

Job Locations: Mumbai | Bangalore | Noida | Pune
Experience: 3–6 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time

Industry: Real Estate / Sales / Business Development

Job Description:
NoBroker is looking for dynamic and result-oriented Area Sales Managers to drive territory-level sales operations, achieve revenue targets and manage sales teams.
The candidate will be responsible for driving business growth, managing sales executives, closing customer leads and expanding the company's customer base.

Key Responsibilities:
Drive territory-wise sales and revenue targets.
Handle and close leads provided by the company.
Recruit, train, mentor and manage Sales Executives.
Develop effective sales strategies to achieve business targets.
Build strong customer relationships and resolve escalations.
Promote premium plans and value-added services.
Identify new business opportunities and local partnerships.
Monitor team performance, KPIs, CRM updates and MIS reports.

Candidate Requirements:
Bachelor's degree is required.
3–6 years of experience in Sales / Business Development.
Real estate knowledge and experience preferred.
Basic understanding of property transactions and the real estate market.
Regional language proficiency is mandatory, along with good communication skills.
Must own a two-wheeler and possess a valid driving licence.
Strong leadership, negotiation and team management skills.
Comfortable working in a target-driven sales environment.

Preferred Industry: Real Estate, PropTech, BFSI, Telecom, FMCG and B2C Sales.

Salary & Benefits:
Attractive Fixed Salary Package.
Fixed Monthly Incentives.
Uncapped Performance-Based Incentives.
Career Growth Opportunities.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Lead SAP PM functional consulting activities across requirement gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.
Conduct workshops with business stakeholders to understand maintenance processes, asset management requirements, and operational challenges.
Configure and implement SAP Plant Maintenance functionalities including Technical Objects, Functional Locations, Equipment Masters, Work Centers, Maintenance Notifications, Maintenance Orders, Task Lists, Maintenance Plans, and Measuring Points/Counters.
Design and optimize preventive, predictive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance processes aligned with business objectives.
Analyze business requirements and prepare functional specifications for custom developments, reports, forms, enhancements, interfaces, and workflows.
Perform fit-gap analysis and recommend SAP best practices to improve maintenance efficiency and asset reliability.
Work closely with ABAP, Basis, Data Migration, and Integration teams to implement business requirements.
Configure and support calibration management, refurbishment processes, warranty tracking, and maintenance costing processes.
Manage SAP PM integration with MM, QM, PP, SD, PS, and FICO modules to support end-to-end business processes.
Support inventory and spare parts management through PM-MM integration.
Define authorization requirements and assist in security role testing related to maintenance functions.
Participate in data migration activities involving equipment masters, functional locations, maintenance plans, task lists, and historical maintenance data.
Develop and execute unit testing, system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), and regression testing scenarios.
Prepare configuration documents, functional design documents (FDD), business process documents (BPD), test scripts, and end-user training materials.
Support cutover planning, go-live activities, hypercare support, and production stabilization.
Analyze and resolve production issues, ensuring adherence to SLAs and business continuity requirements.
Collaborate with business users to drive continuous process improvements and system optimization initiatives.
Provide guidance on SAP S/4HANA PM functionalities and Fiori applications related to maintenance operations.
Support implementation of asset management strategies focused on equipment reliability, maintenance compliance, and cost optimization.
Participate in project estimation, effort planning, risk assessment, and change request management.
Mentor junior consultants and provide functional expertise during project execution.
Work directly with client leadership, plant maintenance teams, operations teams, and external stakeholders in a customer-facing consulting role.
Ensure solutions comply with industry standards and maintenance best practices across Manufacturing, Automotive, Pharma, Chemicals, Utilities, Oil & Gas, and Engineering sectors.
Must have hands-on experience in at least one complete end-to-end SAP PM implementation lifecycle covering Blueprint, Realization, Testing, Go-Live, and Hypercare phases.

Preferred candidate profile

Minimum 6+ years of strong SAP PM functional consulting experience.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, or related discipline.
Completed at least one full-cycle end-to-end SAP PM implementation project with active involvement across all project phases.
Strong hands-on expertise in SAP PM configuration and business process design.
Experience working on SAP S/4HANA PM implementations, migrations, or transformation projects.
Good understanding of Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) and maintenance management best practices.
Proven experience in maintenance planning, preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, shutdown management, and asset lifecycle management.
Strong integration knowledge with SAP MM, QM, PP, PS, and FICO modules.
Experience in preparing functional specifications and coordinating with technical teams for developments and enhancements.
Exposure to Fiori applications and SAP S/4HANA innovations in Plant Maintenance.
Ability to independently interact with business stakeholders and translate business requirements into SAP solutions.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities.
Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience in client-facing consulting environments and global delivery models.
SAP PM or SAP S/4HANA Asset Management certification will be an added advantage.
Prior experience in Manufacturing, Pharmaceutical, Automotive, Utilities, Chemicals, EPC, or Oil & Gas industries preferred.
Ability to work from Mumbai, Pune, or Bangalore and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Candidates with implementation plus support/rollout experience will be highly preferred.
Immediate joiners or candidates with short notice periods are preferred.

About the Role
Capgemini is seeking highly skilled SAP Central Finance (CFIN) Consultants to join our growing SAP Finance Transformation practice. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SAP Central Finance, SAP S/4HANA Finance, financial process transformation, data migration, and system integration. You will play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise-wide Central Finance solutions for global clients.
Key Responsibilities
SAP Central Finance Implementation & Solution Design
Lead and participate in end-to-end SAP Central Finance (CFIN) implementation projects.
Gather business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP Central Finance solutions.
Configure and support SAP CFIN functionalities including:
Initial Load & Replication
Central Payment
Central Reconciliation
Application Interface Framework (AIF)
Source System Mapping
Key & Value Mapping
Design and implement real-time financial data replication using SAP LT Replication Server (SLT).
Collaborate with business teams to harmonize finance processes across multiple ERP landscapes.
Integration & Data Migration
Integrate SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, and non-SAP systems into the SAP Central Finance environment.
Manage data migration activities, including data cleansing, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation.
Support financial master data governance and integration with SAP MDG.
Ensure data consistency, completeness, and accuracy throughout migration and replication processes.
Troubleshoot replication and interface issues to ensure business continuity.
Finance Transformation & Process Optimization
Drive finance transformation initiatives leveraging SAP S/4HANA Central Finance capabilities.
Analyze existing business processes and recommend improvements based on SAP best practices.
Enable process standardization and harmonization across global business units.
Support business stakeholders in defining future-state finance operating models.
Financial Reporting & Support
Support financial reporting, analytics, and consolidation requirements.
Develop and enhance reporting solutions using SAP Fiori, Embedded Analytics, SAC, and BW.
Support month-end and year-end closing activities.
Provide post-go-live support and resolve issues related to:
Data Replication
Financial Postings
AIF Monitoring
Mapping Errors
Reconciliation Discrepancies
Financial Reporting
Required Skills & Qualifications
Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience in SAP Central Finance (CFIN).
Expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance and SAP FI/CO.
Experience with:
SLT Replication
AIF Framework
MDG Integration
Data Migration & Reconciliation
Financial Master Data Management
SAP Fiori Applications
Understanding of SAP integration methodologies and architecture.
Functional Expertise
Strong knowledge of:
General Ledger (GL)
Accounts Payable (AP)
Accounts Receivable (AR)
Asset Accounting (AA)
Cost Center Accounting
Profit Center Accounting
Internal Orders
Bank Accounting
Financial Closing & Reporting
Preferred Experience
6 to 15 years of SAP consulting experience.
Minimum 4+ years of hands-on SAP Central Finance experience.
At least one full lifecycle SAP Central Finance implementation is preferred.
Experience working on global SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
Exposure to Treasury, Group Reporting, and Cash Management would be an advantage.
Experience in Agile and SAP Activate methodologies.

Job Description: Assistant Manager MIS & Business Analytics (Finance)

Role Objective:
We are looking for a highly analytical and result-oriented professional to lead MIS reporting, financial data analysis, dashboard development, and business performance tracking. Identify the reasons behind revenue fluctuations, cost increases, margin changes, and deviations from targets.

Develop Power BI dashboards and automated reporting solutions wherever applicable.
Improve data collection, validation, reporting formats, and analytical processes.
Establish standardised KPI definitions and reporting practices across departments.
Ensure data integrity, confidentiality, and reliability of management information.
