Description:
Level 6: GN - SC&E - PRH - Process Excellence - Senior Manager
Management Consulting Senior Manager - Industry & Workflow Advisor / Value Architect
Accenture Strategy and Consulting
Business Unit: Strategy & Consulting, Global Network | Areas of Work: Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) | Level: Senior Manager | Location: Delhi, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai | Overall Relevant Exp: 10+ years
As part of Accenture's Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) organization within Strategy & Consulting, you will work in a collocated pod that turns AI ambition into measurable business value - taking solutions from problem definition to a live, scalable outcome.
You are a senior, process-driven, industry-embedded advisor. You redesign how businesses get work done by combining AI, automation, and human expertise into smarter, more efficient processes - working at the intersection of business strategy and technology. You govern end-to-end enterprise workflows, create detailed blueprints (architectural plans, system connections, and workflow designs), define where people stay in control and where AI takes over, and translate complex business processes into AI-ready, executable designs for engineering and platform teams. The work demands hands-on design judgment that goes beyond high-level recommendations - turning strategy into concrete plans implementation teams can execute, with an agent-first mindset.
Roles & Responsibilities
Owns end-to-end workflows across functions, systems, and data, reflecting how the business truly operates.
Identifies where AI, automation, and orchestration can augment or replace human steps - and where human judgment must stay in the loop.
Defines workflow logic, states, handoffs, and exception paths so each design is unambiguous and ready to build.
Applies industry and regulatory knowledge to keep workflows compliant, realistic, and aligned to domain operating models.
Translates client processes into clear, structured requirements that engineers and architects can build against.
Owns enterprise value realization - defines the value story, value metrics, KPIs, and success metrics, governs the business case, and drives benefits realization at portfolio level.
Defines and governs the agentic solution design and AI adoption strategy across engagements - agent roles, prompt logic, RAG grounding, multi-agent orchestration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop.
Leads business development and pre-sales for AI-led reinvention pursuits - shapes proposals and RFP responses that convey the solution and its quantified business impact.

Must-have skills
Deep process design and architecture expertise - Business Process Strategy, Business Process Modeling (BPM / BPMN), Business Process Design, End-to-End Process Architecture, Enterprise Process Mapping, Workflow Analysis & Design, Workflow Integration, Cross-Functional Process Integration, and AI-Ready / Automation-Ready Process Design.
Hands-on Process Transformation and Digital Transformation experience across complex enterprise environments.
Command of core Business Architecture techniques - Operating Model Design, Value Chain Analysis, Customer Journey Mapping, and Business Capability Modelling.
Industry & Functional Process Expertise, Domain-Specific Operating Models, and Industry Value Stream Knowledge - including end-to-end workflows such as Order to Cash, Record to Report, Hire to Retire, and Source to Pay.
Strong native AI fluency - NLP, LLMs, RAG, Machine Learning, and Human-Machine Interaction (HMI), including agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration.
Hands-on experience working with LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) to build working prototypes, dashboards, and solutions that address real enterprise problems, with attention to token cost and performance.
Proven experience leading large-scale enterprise transformation programs end to end.
Experience leading and aligning cross-functional teams - engineering, data, and business - to deliver outcomes.
Strong communication, interpersonal, presentation, and storytelling-with-data skills, combined with analytical thinking, cross-cultural competence, and the ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.


Qualification
Desirable skills
Experience with enterprise and AI platforms such as SAP, Oracle, PEGA, Salesforce, Workday, IBM, leading AI model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic), and the major cloud AI stacks (Microsoft Azure AI, AWS, or Google Vertex AI).
Industry domain depth in one or more sectors such as Banking, Insurance, Health, Utilities, Manufacturing, Retail, or Telco.
Familiarity with AI & Data Solution Architecture and AI-enabled operating models.
Experience implementing workflow automation and robotic process automation (RPA) solutions using tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Microsoft Power Automate.
Comfort with "vibe coding" - rapidly prototyping working software using AI coding assistants.
Product management experience spanning discovery, scoping, and delivery.
Process discovery and analysis using process-mining tools such as Celonis or Signavio to uncover inefficiencies and automation opportunities; Lean Six Sigma certification a plus.
Agile / Scrum / hybrid delivery with sound SDLC governance; a relevant AI or Agentic AI certification is a plus.
Educational Qualification
MBA or Master's degree from a Tier 1 college is preferred.

Description:
Level 6: GN - SC&E - PRH - Process Excellence - Senior Manager
Management Consulting Senior Manager - Industry & Workflow Advisor / Value Architect
Accenture Strategy and Consulting
Business Unit: Strategy & Consulting, Global Network | Areas of Work: Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) | Level: Senior Manager | Location: Delhi, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai | Overall Relevant Exp: 10+ years
As part of Accenture's Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) organization within Strategy & Consulting, you will work in a collocated pod that turns AI ambition into measurable business value - taking solutions from problem definition to a live, scalable outcome.
You are a senior, process-driven, industry-embedded advisor. You redesign how businesses get work done by combining AI, automation, and human expertise into smarter, more efficient processes - working at the intersection of business strategy and technology. You govern end-to-end enterprise workflows, create detailed blueprints (architectural plans, system connections, and workflow designs), define where people stay in control and where AI takes over, and translate complex business processes into AI-ready, executable designs for engineering and platform teams. The work demands hands-on design judgment that goes beyond high-level recommendations - turning strategy into concrete plans implementation teams can execute, with an agent-first mindset.
Roles & Responsibilities
Owns end-to-end workflows across functions, systems, and data, reflecting how the business truly operates.
Identifies where AI, automation, and orchestration can augment or replace human steps - and where human judgment must stay in the loop.
Defines workflow logic, states, handoffs, and exception paths so each design is unambiguous and ready to build.
Applies industry and regulatory knowledge to keep workflows compliant, realistic, and aligned to domain operating models.
Translates client processes into clear, structured requirements that engineers and architects can build against.
Owns enterprise value realization - defines the value story, value metrics, KPIs, and success metrics, governs the business case, and drives benefits realization at portfolio level.
Defines and governs the agentic solution design and AI adoption strategy across engagements - agent roles, prompt logic, RAG grounding, multi-agent orchestration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop.
Leads business development and pre-sales for AI-led reinvention pursuits - shapes proposals and RFP responses that convey the solution and its quantified business impact.

Must-have skills
Deep process design and architecture expertise - Business Process Strategy, Business Process Modeling (BPM / BPMN), Business Process Design, End-to-End Process Architecture, Enterprise Process Mapping, Workflow Analysis & Design, Workflow Integration, Cross-Functional Process Integration, and AI-Ready / Automation-Ready Process Design.
Hands-on Process Transformation and Digital Transformation experience across complex enterprise environments.
Command of core Business Architecture techniques - Operating Model Design, Value Chain Analysis, Customer Journey Mapping, and Business Capability Modelling.
Industry & Functional Process Expertise, Domain-Specific Operating Models, and Industry Value Stream Knowledge - including end-to-end workflows such as Order to Cash, Record to Report, Hire to Retire, and Source to Pay.
Strong native AI fluency - NLP, LLMs, RAG, Machine Learning, and Human-Machine Interaction (HMI), including agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration.
Hands-on experience working with LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) to build working prototypes, dashboards, and solutions that address real enterprise problems, with attention to token cost and performance.
Proven experience leading large-scale enterprise transformation programs end to end.
Experience leading and aligning cross-functional teams - engineering, data, and business - to deliver outcomes.
Strong communication, interpersonal, presentation, and storytelling-with-data skills, combined with analytical thinking, cross-cultural competence, and the ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.


Qualification
Desirable skills
Experience with enterprise and AI platforms such as SAP, Oracle, PEGA, Salesforce, Workday, IBM, leading AI model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic), and the major cloud AI stacks (Microsoft Azure AI, AWS, or Google Vertex AI).
Industry domain depth in one or more sectors such as Banking, Insurance, Health, Utilities, Manufacturing, Retail, or Telco.
Familiarity with AI & Data Solution Architecture and AI-enabled operating models.
Experience implementing workflow automation and robotic process automation (RPA) solutions using tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Microsoft Power Automate.
Comfort with "vibe coding" - rapidly prototyping working software using AI coding assistants.
Product management experience spanning discovery, scoping, and delivery.
Process discovery and analysis using process-mining tools such as Celonis or Signavio to uncover inefficiencies and automation opportunities; Lean Six Sigma certification a plus.
Agile / Scrum / hybrid delivery with sound SDLC governance; a relevant AI or Agentic AI certification is a plus.
Educational Qualification
MBA or Master's degree from a Tier 1 college is preferred.
AboutCompany:

Your Role

Warehouse Processes Knowledge: Good understanding of EWM core processes-Inbound (goods receipt, putaway), Outbound (picking, packing, loading), Internal movements, Replenishment, and Physical Inventory.
RF Device Integration: Experience with RF Framework, ITSmobile, barcode scanning, and mobile data entry setup.
Problem Solving: Strong analytical, debugging, and performance optimization skills.

Description:
Business Unit: Strategy & Consulting, Global Network | Areas of Work: Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) | Level: Manager | Location: Bangalore, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Pune | Overall Relevant Exp: 7+ years
As part of Accenture's Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) organization within Strategy & Consulting, you will work in a collocated pod that turns AI ambition into measurable business value - taking solutions from problem definition to a live, scalable outcome.
You are a process-driven, industry-embedded advisor. You redesign how businesses get work done by combining AI, automation, and human expertise into smarter, more efficient processes - working at the intersection of business strategy and technology. You govern end-to-end enterprise workflows, create detailed blueprints (architectural plans, system connections, and workflow designs), define where people stay in control and where AI takes over, and translate complex business processes into AI-ready, executable designs for engineering and platform teams. The work demands hands-on design judgment that goes beyond high-level recommendations - turning strategy into concrete plans implementation teams can execute, with an agent-first mindset.
Roles & Responsibilities
Owns end-to-end workflows across functions, systems, and data, reflecting how the business truly operates.
Identifies where AI, automation, and orchestration can augment or replace human steps - and where human judgment must stay in the loop.
Defines workflow logic, states, handoffs, and exception paths so each design is unambiguous and ready to build.
Applies industry and regulatory knowledge to keep workflows compliant, realistic, and aligned to domain operating models.
Translates client processes into clear, structured requirements that engineers and architects can build against.
Owns the value story for the engagement - defines value metrics and KPIs, establishes the baseline, builds the business case, and tracks value realization.
Defines the agentic solution design - agent roles, prompt logic, RAG grounding, multi-agent orchestration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop.
Drives business development and pre-sales - shapes proposals and RFP responses that convey the solution and its quantified business impact


Qualification
Must-have skills
Deep process design and architecture expertise - Business Process Strategy, Business Process Modeling (BPM / BPMN), Business Process Design, End-to-End Process Architecture, Enterprise Process Mapping, Workflow Analysis & Design, Workflow Integration, Cross-Functional Process Integration, and AI-Ready / Automation-Ready Process Design.
Hands-on Process Transformation and Digital Transformation experience across complex enterprise environments.
Command of core Business Architecture techniques - Operating Model Design, Value Chain Analysis, Customer Journey Mapping, and Business Capability Modelling.
Industry & Functional Process Expertise, Domain-Specific Operating Models, and Industry Value Stream Knowledge - including end-to-end workflows such as Order to Cash, Record to Report, Hire to Retire, and Source to Pay.
Strong native AI fluency - NLP, LLMs, RAG, Machine Learning, and Human-Machine Interaction (HMI), including agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration.
Hands-on experience working with LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) to build working prototypes, dashboards, and solutions that address real enterprise problems, with attention to token cost and performance.
Strong communication, interpersonal, presentation, and storytelling-with-data skills, combined with analytical thinking, cross-cultural competence, and the ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.
Desirable skills
Experience with enterprise and AI platforms such as SAP, Oracle, PEGA, Salesforce, Workday, IBM, leading AI model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic), and the major cloud AI stacks (Microsoft Azure AI, AWS, or Google Vertex AI).
Industry domain depth in one or more sectors such as Banking, Insurance, Health, Utilities, Manufacturing, Retail, or Telco.
Familiarity with AI & Data Solution Architecture and AI-enabled operating models.
Experience implementing workflow automation and robotic process automation (RPA) solutions using tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Microsoft Power Automate.
Comfort with "vibe coding" - rapidly prototyping working software using AI coding assistants.
Product management experience spanning discovery, scoping, and delivery.
Process discovery and analysis using process-mining tools such as Celonis or Signavio to uncover inefficiencies and automation opportunities; Lean Six Sigma certification a plus.
Agile / Scrum / hybrid delivery with sound SDLC governance; a relevant AI or Agentic AI certification is a plus.
Educational Qualification
MBA or Master's degree from a Tier 1 college is preferred.

Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work: Enterprise AI Value Strategy
Level: Consultant
Location: Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad
Years of Exp: 5+ years
Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you believe software engineering is entering a new AI-native era? Are you a problem solver who enjoys helping CIOs, CTOs, CDOs and engineering leaders rethink how software is imagined, designed, built, tested, secured and delivered using AI? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation practice and work with global clients to shape the next frontier of enterprise software delivery using AI. Working with C-suite stakeholders, you will help enterprises adopt AI-native software delivery at scale and turn transformation ambition into measurable outcomes. You will help enterprises define AI-powered software delivery transformation strategies and translate them into executable approaches, define target state SDLC, create platform and tooling strategy and architecture, engineering productivity measures, delivery operating model change and measurable value realization.
The Practice - A Brief Sketch
Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of and focuses on our clients' most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through engineering transformation initiatives, aimed at making software delivery powered by AI to bring productivity and quality uplift, resulting in larger enterprise value delivery.
You are:
A workstream owner. You take a defined part of an engagement end-to-end - the agent hierarchy for a process, or use-case and data-product definition for a domain - and are its day-to-day client contact.


Qualification
The work
Basic Requirements
Basic Requirements
* Assist in discovery workshops to identify business opportunities and translate them into AI use cases, business cases, and solution requirements.
* Design end-to-end agent-driven business process flows and define agent hierarchies, help define AI solution blueprints, and high-level reference architectures.
* Develop functional specifications and collaborate with architecture and engineering teams to deliver implementation-ready solution designs.
* Apply foundational knowledge of enterprise data, data management, and analytics to shape AI solution design and business outcomes.
* Evaluate AI platforms, tools, and industry best practices to support solution recommendations and client engagements.
Good to Have
* Experience defining data products, enterprise data models, and AI-ready data foundations.
* Exposure to knowledge graphs, knowledge layers, prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Experience developing AI capability roadmaps, AI platform assessments, and value realization plans.
* Strong consulting, problem-solving, stakeholder communication, and presentation skills with experience working in cross-functional teams
Tech fluency
Hands-on depth in at least one platform (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake), or foundation models (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI)., plus conversant across the categories. Can weigh trade-offs (fit, cost, risk) within an engagement.
Industry Lens:
Working knowledge of one priority industry's processes and value drivers; applies it to use-case and roadmap work..

Min. 5 yrs overall, incl. AI & data projects
High-value consulting or relevant industry/functional experience
Engages senior stakeholders
Structured problem-solving; program management
Strong communication

Bachelor's degree (relevant discipline); MBA preferred

An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everything-from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Job Title: Data Analyst
Location: Bangalore / Mumbai / Pune
Department: Customer & Retail Analytics
Employment Type: Full-time
About FedEx: FedEx provides customers and businesses worldwide with a broad portfolio of transportation, e-commerce, and business services and also serves our customers through our retail presence. We foster an environment of growth and learning, where innovative ideas are encouraged, and diverse teams are valued for their contributions. As part of our commitment to excellence, were seeking a highly skilled Data Analyst to join our analytics team.
Job Summary: As a Data Analyst, you will play a key role in gathering, processing, and analyzing data to drive informed decision-making and actionable insights for FedEx. Your quantitative expertise and business acumen will help develop analytical solutions to improve operations, customer experience, and business outcomes. This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to develop meaningful data analysis, insights summarizations/ visualizations and communicate findings that guide strategy and operational decisions.
Key Responsibilities:
Collect, analyze, and interpret complex data sets using Python and SQL to support business objectives.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs, formulate analytic solutions, and provide actionable insights.
Develop and maintain data models and reports to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and business metrics.
Create meaningful data visualizations to communicate findings, trends, and actionable insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Conduct exploratory data analysis and identify patterns, trends, and opportunities for business improvement.
Support data quality initiatives, ensuring accuracy and consistency across data sources.
Utilize statistical and quantitative techniques to support problem-solving and business optimization efforts.
Mandatory Skills:
Python: Proficiency in data manipulation, data analysis libraries (Pandas, NumPy), and data visualization libraries (Matplotlib, Seaborn).
SQL: Strong command of SQL for data extraction, transformation, and complex queries.
Business Acumen: Ability to understand business context and objectives, aligning analytics with organizational goals.
Quantitative Aptitude: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.
Data Visualization: Basic skills in data visualization to effectively communicate insights.
Statistical Analysis: Foundational understanding of statistical methods (e.g., regression, hypothesis testing).
Communication Skills: Ability to distill complex data insights into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders.
Good-to-Have Skills:
Power BI: Experience with Power BI for data visualization and report development.
Machine Learning Fundamentals: Basic knowledge of machine learning concepts for deeper pattern analysis.
Advanced Excel: Skills in advanced Excel functions, pivot tables, and data cleaning for quick analyses.
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field. Master’s degree is a plus.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably within the logistics, supply chain, or transportation industry.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex data insights to stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills and a collaborative mindset.
Join Our Team: If you are passionate about Data analytics to drive business impact and enhance the customer experience, we invite you to join our team at FedEx. Apply now to be part of a dynamic, innovative environment where your skills and expertise will make a difference.
Application Process: To apply for this position, please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and qualifications. Qualified candidates will be contacted for further evaluation.

Description:
Job Title: Relationship Manager - CAT - Elite
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance


As a Relationship Manager in the CAT - Elite team, you will be responsible for managing and nurturing relationships with our high-value clients, ensuring that their financial needs are met effectively. Your main focus will be on developing comprehensive financial strategies that align with clients objectives, providing personalized service, and maximizing client satisfaction. You will collaborate closely with various internal teams to deliver exceptional service and drive business growth.

Key Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain strong relationships with high-value clients, understanding their financial goals and needs.
- Provide tailored financial advice and solutions to meet client requirements, including insurance products and investment opportunities.
- Conduct regular client meetings to review portfolios, discuss market trends, and assess client satisfaction.
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure timely and effective service delivery.
- Identify new business opportunities and drive customer acquisition through referrals and networking.
- Monitor client portfolios and recommend adjustments to align with changing financial situations or goals.
- Stay updated on industry trends, product offerings, and regulatory changes to provide informed advice to clients.

Skills and Qualifications:
- Bachelors degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
- Proven experience in relationship management, preferably in the insurance or financial services sector.
- Strong understanding of insurance products, investment strategies, and financial planning.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and rapport with clients.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Proficiency in using CRM systems and MS Office Suite.
- Ability to work independently as well as part of a collaborative team.
- Initiative and proactive approach to managing client relationships and identifying opportunities.

Tools Required:
- Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software
- Financial modeling tools
- MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
- Market analysis tools and platforms
- Communication tools (email, video conferencing, etc.)

This position offers a unique opportunity for individuals who are passionate about building strong client relationships and helping clients achieve their financial objectives while being part of a dynamic team at Axis Max Life Insurance.

Description:
We at Tech Mahindra are currently looking for an experienced IT Recruiter with 5-9 years of experience to join our team.
Based on your background, I believe this opportunity could be a good fit.
Please find the attached JD for your consideration and share your interest along with your updated profile.
Position: Senior IT Recruiter / Technical Recruiter
Experience: 5-9 Years
Location: Pune/Bangalore
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated IT Recruiter with 5-9 years of experience in technical hiring. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle for IT positions across various technology stacks and business units. The role requires expertise in sourcing niche talent, stakeholder management, market intelligence, offer negotiations, and driving hiring closures within defined timelines.
Key Responsibilities
Manage end-to-end recruitment for IT and technology positions across multiple skill sets and seniority levels.
Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring requirements, define candidate profiles, and develop recruitment strategies.
Source candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, employee referrals, social media channels, and talent networks.
Conduct candidate screening and preliminary assessments to evaluate technical competencies, communication skills, and cultural fit.
Coordinate interviews, gather feedback, and drive hiring decisions with stakeholders.
Negotiate compensation packages and facilitate offer rollouts to ensure successful closures.
Build and maintain talent pipelines for critical and future hiring needs.
Drive recruitment for niche technologies and support large-scale hiring initiatives.
Ensure excellent candidate experience throughout the hiring lifecycle.
Required Skills & Competencies
End-to-end IT Recruitment
Technical Screening
Talent Mapping & Market Research
Stakeholder & Hiring Manager Management
Offer Negotiation
Candidate Relationship Management
Recruitment Metrics & Reporting
Vendor/Subcontractor Management
Preferred Experience
Experience in hiring for niche and critical skills.
Exposure to subcontractor/vendor hiring models.
Experience supporting large-scale hiring and lateral recruitment initiatives.
Knowledge of workforce planning and resource management processes.
Experience working with global or enterprise clients.
Ideal Candidate Profile
Proven track record of successfully closing complex and niche IT requirements.
Strong sourcing capability and passive candidate engagement skills.

Do you believe in creating an impact? Are you a problem solver who enjoys working on transformative strategies for global clients? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
Then, this is the right place for you! Welcome to a host of exciting global opportunities in Accenture Technology Strategy & Advisory.
The Practice- A Brief Sketch:
The Technology Strategy & Advisory Practice is a part of and focuses on the clients most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative R&D transformation, aimed at redefining business models using agile methodologies.
We provide you with a great learning ground, deep-rooted in , where you will get an opportunity to advice and work with our key global clients, driving end-to-end transformative strategic value and business growth. Manage budgeting and forecasting activities and build financial proposals

MBA from a tier 1 institute

3+ years of experience in financial modeling, valuation analysis, scenario testing and writing business cases (quantitative and qualitative) to support strategic business initiatives, process improvement initiatives, or IT transformation
2+ years of experience leading or managing large teams effectively including planning/structuring analytical work, facilitating team workshops, and developing technology strategy recommendations
Good knowledge of technology and enterprise architecture concepts through practical experience and knowledge of technology trends e.g. Mobility, Cloud, Digital, Collaboration

Description:
Manager/Senior - People Advisory Services
People Advisory Services shapes and delivers the part of business strategy that depends on people. As a PAS professional, you will have the opportunity to work with global clients to understand and address some of their largest and most complex people related challenges, and ultimately improve and drive sustainable business results. We focus on engagements that relate to performance, talent, systems, reward, mobility and analytics.
In joining PAS - a global network, youll also gain valuable experiences and a wealth of knowledge by working across capabilities, service offerings, sectors and geographies. So whenever you join, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.
The opportunity: Manager/Scon - PAS Wkfa - National - CNS - PC - Workforce Advisory - Mumbai/Bangalore
As a member of the PAS team focused on HR and business performance, you will join a talented group of professionals that help support the design and implementation of HR operating models and organizational structures, improve HR process efficiency, manage people risks, support change efforts to help organizations to successfully transition to a future state, and advise organizations on a range of challenges that are associated with a merger, acquisition, divestiture and/or carve-out.
Your key capabilities
Talent Transformation
Leadership Development
Succesion Planning
Organizational Design
Performance Management and career mapping
HR Operating & Delivery Model
HR Process Efficiency & Policy
Organizational Change Management
Your key responsibilities
As a Manager/Senior Consultant, you will be a key resource on business transformation projects. In this role, you should be able to deliver quality client service, deliver insightful solutions and balance multiple priorities. You will also be expected to have excellent communication skills, integrate into and lead new teams, and rapidly establish relationships.
Demonstrate technical competence in our capabilities (Organizational Change Management, Organizational Design, HR Operating & Delivery Model, HR Process Efficiency & Policy and Transactions) and take a practical/business driven approach to solving complex client challenges
Contribute to generating profitable revenue through identifying follow-on engagement opportunities and developing lasting relationships with clients
Lead project work streams from planning through to implementation - managing project resources and budgets effectively
Be able to influence and persuade clients and stakeholders to gain support for any major change initiatives and/or decisions
Take a practical approach to solving issues and gaining client agreement
Encourage and facilitate collaboration amongst team members, and promote an inclusive working environment
Identify and effectively manage and mitigate any risks and issues
Contribute to business development and client pursuit activities by preparing proposals and delivering presentations for potential clients
Provide coaching and development opportunities for junior resources and peers, and act as a visible role model for our people
Skills and attributes for success
Excellent managerial, organizational, analytical and communication skills
Experience in Organizational Change Management, Organizational Design, HR Operating & Delivery Model, HR Process Efficiency & Policy and Transactions
To qualify for the role you must have
Post graduate degree or equivalent with a specialization in Human Resources (India or abroad) from a Tier 1 Institute.
3-5 years of experience for Senior Consultant in HR role (recruitment, organization structuring, manpower planning, compensation and benefits, learning and development, performance management etc.)
5-8 years of experience for Senior Consultant in HR role (recruitment, organization structuring, manpower planning, compensation and benefits, learning and development, performance management etc.)
Relevant professional experience, including for example previous work with a global management consultancy firm, niche consultancy or performed an in-house role in which you gained exposure to a large-scale project(s)
Ideally you\'ll also have
Strong communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)
Strong leadership skills and supervisory responsibility.
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative way to provide services across multiple client departments while adhering to commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions.

Design integration solutions using SAP Integration Suite.

Support solutioning, estimations, RFPs, delivery governance, and stakeholder engagement.
Mentor architects, developers, and integration consultants.

Manufacturing | Consumer Goods | Energy Utilities | Retail | Automotive | Pharmaceuticals | Banking Financial Services | Telecommunications

Job Title: Risk Senior Specialist
Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President
Location: Mumbai, India
Role Description
Market and Valuation Risk Management (MVRM) provides an independent view of market risks and valuation to Deutsche Bank s senior management. Market risk team manages Deutsche Bank s Market Risk position in an independent and neutral way.
You will be a part of the Market Risk Analysis and Control (MRAC) function within MVRM and will be responsible for the provision of all official market risk metrics and core analysis in support of risk management decision making for Rates asset class. The team operates a business/asset class and risk metric aligned organizational matrix supported by central functions. The team has a global presence with staff located in London, New York, Berlin, Singapore, Mumbai and Bangalore.
You will be exposed to risk management techniques viz. analysis/computation of VaR, SVaR, IRC, Backtesting, FRTB for a diverse range of derivative products. The team is also proficient in combining this risk knowledge with best in class automation and visualization skills including python/VBA/Tableau to provide value added analytical outputs to its stakeholders
You will be expected to be proficient in automation tools (python essentially) with sufficient knowledge of risk to enhance the output of the team.
Your key responsibilities
This role is within the Rates Asset class team. The primary responsibilities are:
Risk validation and ensure appropriate controls in place
Review and understand the historical simulation VaR, FRTB and Backtesting(outlier analysis), including staying abreast of the development of this metric and related drivers
Facilitating better risk analysis and automated reporting infrastructure to stakeholders using required programming tools(python/Tableau etc.) is a critical part of profile
Perform deep dive analysis into concentrations of risk or emerging items of interest, providing high quality and accurate information at a level for senior management consumption
Perform analytical analysis of our limit to generate proposals for limit changes and for new limits
Support the analysis and communication of business portfolio level topics to senior management and their committees
Your skills and experience
Experience in working with commodities especially Energy asset class is a must.
Experience in working with python and tableau is a must.
University degree in Economics, Mathematics or other quantitative subject.
5+ years experience in Market Risk within the Financial Market / Investment Banking industry (other relevant backgrounds e.g. Trading, Product Control, IPV will also be considered)
Proficiency in Python/VBA, Tableau, MS Office tools is essential for the role
Good understanding of other Market Risk measurement techniques e.g. VaR, RNIV, Economic Capital, IRC.
Excellent communication skills; ability to articulate technical and financial topics with global stakeholders
A reliable team player with the motivation to work in a dynamic, international and diverse environment
Able to multi-task and deliver under tight deadlines
A committed and motivated individual for self-development and growth
Hands on coding skills(Python specifically) and Tableau skills will be a significant plus
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

Job

Summary :As a Digital Marketing Platform Consultant, you will be responsible for designing, building, and implementing strategies to enhance business performance using Customer Data Platforms and other digital marketing tools. Your typical day will involve working with clients to solve customer-facing challenges in sales, service, and marketing, and developing solutions to meet those requirements.

Roles & Responsibilities


Conduct assessment of client's current data management and Customer Data Platform (CDP) capabilities. Provide recommendations on optimizing the current stack and develop use cases to improve utilization .


Gather business requirements and strategize and build client's digital marketing data management program that delivers high-performance profiles for segmentation, personalization & activation across digital channels.


Identify different data sources, approaches to enrich customer profiles/segments in CDP and define use cases across multiple channels/destinations. Design data cleaning, transformation, and integration approach from various data sources into CDP.


Evaluate and recommend new ways of data management through CDP and how it connects into the broader marketing technology landscape (campaign management and insight generation).


Work as a BA or a functional consultant as part of CDP implementation. Plan, design, implement & integrate CDP solutions such as Adobe Experience Platform – RT CDP and work with partners to leverage various data management capabilities offered by these solutions.


Understand and convey the impact of regulations like CCPA, GDPR and client's own internal or industry regulation on data gathering and management. Guide towards privacy by design, consent management for customer profile activation across digital marketing channels.


Understand and design integrations (including API-based/file-based integrations) between tools/platforms of different vendors/ MarTech /AdTech components/data sources.


Stay abreast of MarTech landscape & engage ecosystem players/vendors to ensure best-in-class digital audience management capabilities for clients. Propose and conduct pilots as needed.


 Qualification 

Professional & Technical Skills


Must Have

Skills:

NoBrokerHood, a part of NoBroker Technologies Pvt.Ltd. Our founders understood the need to have a tech-enabled
visitor and community management system, that aims to make life convenient, hassle-free, and secure for the
residents of a gated community. Thus, NoBrokerHood was launched. NoBrokerHood is a smart visitor, society and

under its hood. From catering to all the society needs like complaint management, gate entry, maintenance bill
payments, digital notice board, it also has features like Marketplace, home services and more. NoBrokerHood goes

and management committees with digital convenience, revenue growth, and future-ready innovation.
To know more about NoBrokerHood, visit our website - https://www.nobrokerhood.com/
About the role:
We are currently looking to hire an energetic, highly motivated, can-do attitude individual who is willing to join our
team as a Territory Sales Manager. In this role, you will be responsible for acquiring leads and generating revenue
by onboarding new apartment complexes and societies into NoBrokerHood by meeting with prospective clients in
person and explaining the product.
Job Description:-



Minimum 1-5 years of proven sales track record and ability to meet targets.
Lead generation through prospecting referral and web researches
Should have an interest in Business Development (B2C/ B2B) for Software Application Products
/solutions.

Meet prospective clients, execute effective product demonstrations, and emphasize product features and
benefits with a focus on the value of the solution.


Capabilities of selling Hardware IOT devices
Meet with Committee Members of Apartments and Societies,accounting services partners and builders to
understand the scope of business and their expectations.




Prospect, educate, qualify, and generate interest for Sales Opportunities and lead conversions.
Ability to do product demonstrations to higher level authorities
Onboarding new apartments on the NoBrokerHood platform will be a major KRA.
Researching potential leads from the open market, web searches, or digital resources.
Mandatory requirements for this position





Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Should be proficient in English and Regional language (knowing the regional language of the job location
will be a plus).






Should be comfortable working on weekends(Sat & Sun compulsory working), with a week off on Monday.
Effective presentation and negotiation skills.
Hands-on MS Office Excel, Word & PPT, etc.
Ability to handle CRM softwares
A valid drivers license(DL) with a two-wheeler/four-wheeler as this role requires you to be on the field.
Geographical knowledge of the job location is an added advantage.

Enterprise AI Value Strategy- Senior Manager
Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to help our most strategic clients realize exceptional value from AI in software delivery, a boardroom priority for organizations globally and be at the forefront of shaping how enterprises adopt AI-native software engineering
Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work: Enterprise AI Value Strategy
Level: Senior Manager

Location: Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad

Years of Exp: 14+ years

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you believe software engineering is entering a new AI-native era Are you a problem solver who enjoys helping CIOs, CTOs, CDOs and engineering leaders rethink how software is imagined, designed, built, tested, secured and delivered using AI Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture
If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation practice and work with global clients to shape the next frontier of enterprise software delivery using AI. Working with C-suite stakeholders, you will help enterprises adopt AI-native software delivery at scale and turn transformation ambition into measurable outcomes. You will help enterprises define AI-powered software delivery transformation strategies and translate them into executable approaches, define target state SDLC, create platform and tooling strategy and architecture, engineering productivity measures, delivery operating model change and measurable value realization.
The Practice - A Brief Sketch
Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on our clients- most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through engineering transformation initiatives, aimed at making software delivery powered by AI to bring productivity and quality uplift, resulting in larger enterprise value delivery.
You are:
A portfolio owner and enterprise advisor for reinvention. You set the process-reinvention agenda across accounts, shape enterprise agentic architecture and operating-model change, build the practice, and own the book of business.


Qualification
The work
Basic Requirements
Shape enterprise AI strategy and advise C-suite stakeholders on AI-led business, technology, and functional transformation.
Lead executive discovery sessions to identify enterprise AI opportunities and define AI transformation roadmaps, investment priorities, and value realization strategies.
Define enterprise AI and data architecture, including AI platform strategy, agentic architectures, enterprise data strategy, data products, semantic layer, and target-state AI capabilities. (with technical depth and agentic system build experience in 1 platform or functional area - GCP, AWS, Snowflake, DataBricks, Azure, Anthropic)
Develop executive business cases, AI maturity assessments, value frameworks, and AI & data roadmaps to accelerate enterprise AI adoption.
Lead multidisciplinary consulting teams across strategy, architecture, data, engineering, and change management while owning executive relationships and client outcomes.
Drive practice growth through GTM development, solution innovation, proposal leadership, and AI opportunity origination.
Good to Have
Experience designing enterprise operating models, organization redesign, and workforce transformation strategies for AI-native enterprises.
Experience defining AI governance, Responsible AI, AI risk, and compliance frameworks.
Experience shaping large AI transformation deals, strategic partnerships, and technology ecosystem alliances.
Strong executive communication, thought leadership, and consulting skills with experience influencing CxO decision-making and leading enterprise-scale AI transformation initiatives.
Tech fluency
Deep in at least one platform (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake), or foundation models (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI) and able to shape
Industry Lens:
Deep expertise across one or more priority industries (Consumer Goods, Retail, Life Sciences, Banking); sets the reinvention agenda for their core processes and is seen externally as a voice in it.
Role Summary
Min. 14 yrs overall, incl. AI & data projects (solutioning, designing, or delivering)
High-value consulting; large-scale delivery with minimal oversight
C-suite advisory experience on operating-model and process change
Working knowledge of AI governance and regulation
Structured problem-solving; program management; strong communication
Qualifications & Certifications
Bachelor's degree (relevant discipline); MBA preferred
What's in it for you
An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients
Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed responsible business into everything-from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Role & responsibilities :
Module Configuration & Support: Configure, maintain, and support JDE EnterpriseOne Manufacturing modules (Versions 9.0, 9.1, 9.2)
Core Functional Areas: Manage and configure Bill of Materials (BOM), Routings, Work Orders, Shop Floor Management, Product Data Management (PDM), Product Costing, and Manufacturing Accounting.
Planning & Integration: Support Material Requirements Planning (MRP), Master Production Scheduling (MPS), Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP), and integration with Inventory Management and Procurement.
Requirement Gathering & Design: Conduct workshops with business stakeholders, gather functional requirements, and author Functional Design Documents (FDDs) and specifications for custom developments or reports.
Integrations: Work on JDE inbound/outbound interfaces and custom integrations with Shop Floor / MES (Manufacturing Execution Systems) or external warehousing tools.
Testing & Deployment: Lead/participate in system configuration testing, Integrated Testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and prepare end-user training materials.

Description:
About the Job:

As an L3 Care Engineer, you will be responsible for the performance, availability and reliability of our cloud-based services and underlying infrastructure, acting as a critical technical subject matter expert. You will lead the resolution of complex, high-severity customer issues across Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift and OpenStack platforms, and serve as a final escalation point for our customers.

Our team operates on a follow-the-sun model, ensuring 24/7 coverage and rapid response times. While this may occasionally require shifts outside typical local business hours, total work hours remain consistent with a standard work week. A rotational on-call schedule is a mandatory part of this role: on-call experts provide immediate support for urgent cases, including direct customer contact (call/Teams) and prompt engagement in designated war rooms. All interventions are performed in live environments and must strictly follow the Standard Network Touch Policy.

What you will do:

Manage, troubleshoot and optimize containerized applications and infrastructure deployed on Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift and OpenStack platforms.
Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for core cloud infrastructure technologies, including advanced Linux (CentOS) system administration, Docker/containers and complex networking configurations.
Lead the investigation and resolution of complex, high-severity customer issues, quickly diagnosing problems across the entire cloud stack.
Identify root causes and implement effective, durable solutions for customer incidents.
Prepare and conduct rigorous Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical incidents to identify systemic issues and prevent recurrence.
Develop, test and maintain robust automation using Python and Ansible to streamline daily operations and reduce manual effort in maintenance and deployment activities.
Provide end-to-end Escalation, Monitoring and Emergency (EME) support as a final escalation point, ensuring service availability and meeting SLAs.
Participate in the rotational on-call schedule, joining customer calls and war rooms for urgent cases.
Liaise directly with customer and internal teams to understand requirements and deliver tailored technical solutions.
Stay current with industry best practices and emerging technologies in cloud and containerization.


What you will bring:

10+ years of hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Linux, and OpenStack.
Linux expertise: strong knowledge and proven hands-on experience with Linux administration.
Networking foundations: strong knowledge of core networking principles (TCP/IP, routing, load balancing, firewalls) in a cloud environment.
Containerization virtualization: strong knowledge of Kubernetes orchestration, OpenStack platforms and Docker/containers.
Problem-solving mindset: sharp troubleshooting skills and an analytical approach to complex challenges.
Scripting automation: solid Python scripting skills for task automation and system management.
Configuration management: hands-on experience with Ansible.
Root Cause Analysis: expertise in preparing and implementing RCAs.
Escalation monitoring: proven experience with EME (Escalation, Monitoring and Emergency) management processes.
Communication: excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to articulate complex issues clearly.
Customer focus: ability to handle customer pressure and manage expectations with a positive, professional attitude.
Teamwork: a strong team player, self-motivated and able to excel in a high-pressure, dynamic support environment.
Willingness to work in shifts: comfortable with a follow-the-sun model and a mandatory rotational on-call schedule.


Considered a plus: one or more of the following certifications - Red Hat Certified Specialist in Cloud Infrastructure (EX210), RHCE in Red Hat OpenStack (EX310), RHCSA, RHCE, CKA, Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration (EX280), Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Automation and API Management (EX380).

FI-CA

Strong debugging and issue resolution skills.

Job Title: SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant

Location: Bangalore / Pune / Mumbai / Gandhinagar
Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and passionate SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant to join our growing SAP practice. As an SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant at Capgemini, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and supporting SAP Business Workflow solutions to automate business processes and enhance operational efficiency. You will collaborate closely with functional consultants, business users, and technical teams to deliver innovative workflow-based solutions across SAP landscapes.
As an SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant, you will:
Design, develop, and implement SAP Business Workflow solutions to automate end-to-end business processes.
Configure and develop workflow components including Tasks, Standard Tasks, Workflows, Events, Methods, Rule Resolution, and Agents.
Create and enhance Business Objects (BOR) and ABAP OO-based workflow objects.
Develop custom workflow functionalities using ABAP programming techniques, User Exits, BAdIs, Enhancements, and Function Modules.
Configure event management and workflow triggering mechanisms using change documents, business transactions, and custom events.
Develop and troubleshoot workflow notifications, work items, inbox configurations, and approval processes.
Integrate workflows with SAP modules such as MM, SD, FI, CO, HCM, and SRM based on business requirements.
Perform workflow administration activities including monitoring, debugging, error handling, and performance optimization.
Work with functional consultants and stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical workflow solutions.
Ensure adherence to SAP development standards, best practices, and quality processes throughout the project lifecycle.

Required Skills

Strong hands-on experience in SAP ABAP Workflow Development.
Expertise in SAP Business Workflow configuration and development.
Experience with BOR (Business Object Repository) and ABAP OO Workflow.
Good knowledge of Workflow Administration, Event Management, Agent Determination, and Rule Resolution.
Strong ABAP development skills including Reports, Enhancements, BAdIs, User Exits, Function Modules, and Object-Oriented ABAP.
Experience in workflow debugging, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA workflow framework will be an added advantage.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.Role & responsibilities

Description:
Job Description
Job Title: Product Lifecycle Risk Manager, AVP
Location: Mumbai, India
Alternative Locations: Pune, India / Bangalore, India


Role Description:
Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.
Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.
We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow. That’s why we are ‘Investors for a new now’.
As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.

About DWS Investment Risk:
The Chief Risk Office within DWS is an independent function responsible for protecting the business as well as being a trusted adviser and partner for supporting sustainable business growth.
As part of the Chief Risk Office, Investment Risk provides independent oversight and challenge of risks arising from DWS fiduciary activities, including the governance of investment products throughout their lifecycle.
The Product Life Cycle Risk Team is responsible for the New Product Approval framework, related policies, procedures, controls and governance tooling. The team works closely with Business, Investment, Product Management and control functions to support robust, transparent and regulatory-compliant product decisions.

What we’ll offer you
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
Best in class leave policy
Gender neutral parental leaves
100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities
Manage and further develop Product Risk processes, policies, controls and governance frameworks across the product lifecycle, ensuring consistent, scalable and effective standards.
Manage and continuously enhance the New Product Approval (NPA) framework, including transparent prioritization of initiatives and effective management of dependencies across the product pipeline.
Perform independent 2LoD reviews of NPA submissions and support the relevant Risk Type Heads in assessing and signing off product initiatives, including the identification, challenge and escalation of material risks and control gaps.
Own and further develop the NPA platform and related governance tooling, driving system enhancements, process automation and scalable workflow solutions.
Coordinate Product Governance activities across Business, Investment, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations and other control functions to ensure initiatives are complete, decision-ready and progressed effectively through the governance process.
Support governance committees and contribute to global Product Lifecycle initiatives through management information, decision materials, governance records, regulatory implementation and process transformation.

Your skills and experience
University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience, with at least five years of relevant experience in Asset Management, Product Governance, Product Management, Risk Management, Compliance, Operations, Regulatory Change or a related governance or control function.
Strong understanding of investment products, asset management operating models, product lifecycle management and Product Governance frameworks within a regulated financial services environment.
Knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements, with the ability to assess regulatory developments and translate their impact into appropriate governance processes, policies and controls.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proven ability to independently review and challenge complex product initiatives, identify material risks and control gaps, and formulate clear, practical recommendations.
Experience managing or enhancing governance processes, workflows and control frameworks, including translating governance requirements into system enhancements and supporting tool implementation, testing, migration or automation initiatives.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management and organizational skills, with the ability to prepare concise materials for senior stakeholders and committees, constructively influence cross-functional teams and deliver high-quality outcomes across competing priorities.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word; experience with data analytics, reporting tools or process automation solutions is advantageous.

How we’ll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
About us and our teams
Please visit our company website for further information:
https://www.db.com/company/company.html

Implementation and Configuration: Design, configure, and implement SAP TM solutions to meet client requirements.

Job Description of Lady Security Guard
Job Introduction / Roles Responsibilities
As a professionally trained Lady Security Guard for G4S, you could be a member of the security team responsible for securing premises, such as building sites, courts, shops, warehouses, banks and factories. You would be conducting foot or vehicle patrols, controlling access at points of entry, securing equipment and people, responding to emergency situations, monitoring CCTV, surveillance operative and helping to identify and prevent criminal activity.

Ensuring all Policies and Procedures are adhered to at all times

Control the entry and exit of individuals, materials, and vehicles
Patrol on foot searching for any situations or conditions hazardous to the property or safety of a person at a site

Write appropriate reports as required

Career growth

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Job Description
Overview
We are seeking experienced individuals with previous exposure on Aviation schemes to join our land development team to work on diverse projects that deliver coordinated designs for landside and airside schemes. This role expects exposure to hydraulic design, utilities modelling and design, road and pavement design.
Your role
Minimum 12+Years of experience
Strong knowledge of the fundamental concepts, principles, and theories of system integration as applied to multi-disciplinary designs and own discipline of wet utilities (Storm Water, Foul water, Potable water and Treated Sewage Effluent).
Knowledge of international codes for US, Canada, UK, Middle East will be preferred.
Understanding of sustainable solutions, sustainability requirements in the countries mentioned above.
Leading projects from concept design stage through the life cycle of project.
Able to understand a client's requirements and bring the different technical solutions to influence.
Acts as a Project Technical Leader or Technical Reviewer for large/complex projects.
Attending/arranging multi-disciplinary project technical/financial review calls, client presentation meetings, internal lesson learned and strategic/technical workshops.
Must have knowledge in bid proposals and management.
Should be flexible and open to new ideas and ways of delivering the building places projects in a digital way.
Should be proactive to implement digital tools/systems in projects for a more effective way to deliver projects.
Strong understanding of management processes related to technical integration and associated analytical / investigative approaches.
Strong knowledge and understanding of supporting pan design disciplines such as Engineering Safety Management, Human Factors and Sustainability.
High level of accountability for Technical Delivery
Takes a leadership role and trusted to make decisions, typically at group / team level or within a specific area of the business.
Works autonomously within established procedures and practices.
Welcomes those with different or distinct perspectives, seeking to engage and harness disparate views at all levels of the organization.
About you
Detailed knowledge of the fundamental concepts, principles, and theories of system integration as applied to multi-disciplinary designs.
Project Technical Leader on large or complex multi-disciplinary projects.
Consistently produces concept and feasibility solutions.
Works as a Project Technical Leader on large complex projects / Project Technical Reviewer on large complex projects Driving the right behaviours within organization for digital initiatives to improve business performance productivity.
Professional Head of Discipline or possibly leading a subset technology as Technical Authority.
Track record of delivering projects of increasing complexity to time, cost, and quality.
Coordination and development of innovation on a divisional basis.
Comprehensive understanding of management processes related to technical integration and associated analytical/investigative approaches.
Detailed understanding of principles of assurance and compliance as defined and applied within the relevant industry environment.
Comprehensive understanding of supporting pan design disciplines such as Engineering Safety Management, Human Factors and Sustainability.
Other:
High level of accountability. Drives the strategic direction of an aspect of the business to achieve desired business outcomes.

Description:
We are looking for a skilled Plastic Processing Operator to join our team at Cosmo Films Ltd. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in plastic processing and be able to operate various equipment efficiently.

Roles and Responsibility


Operate and maintain plastic processing machines such as extruders, blow molders, and injection molders.

Monitor and control the quality of plastic products during production.

Collaborate with the maintenance team to ensure equipment is properly maintained and repaired.

Implement safety procedures to prevent accidents and injuries.

Work closely with the production team to meet daily targets and deadlines.

Maintain accurate records of production runs and machine performance.


Job Requirements


Minimum 2 years of experience in plastic processing operations or a related field.

Strong knowledge of plastic materials and manufacturing processes.

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and meet deadlines.

Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

Familiarity with quality control measures and safety protocols.

Ability to lift heavy objects and stand for long periods.

Description:
Job Summary
Lead Facilitator - Nagaland - East Hub
Location: Kohima, Nagaland
Responsibilities
Design
Ability to design contextualized training structure with new activities and workshops based on local emerging needs and context.
Improvise contents of the workshop in the moment and be aware of the plan / curriculum being only a guiding document.
Converse, make sense and contextualize content of the workshop based on the group.
Facilitation
Keep the process connected to the program goals.
Hold space for the group and individuals to express themselves deeply.
Invite individual and group creativity.
Improvise and be spontaneous in front of a group.
Hold an attitude of welcome and inclusion.
Develop the culture of appreciation.
Managing Strong Emotions in a group (Manage Triggers).
Be able to track the journey of the group and individuals.
Training
Train other facilitators / stakeholders on the Principles / Practices / Processes of facilitation with a minimum of 10-day TOT workshop.
Provide one-on-one mentoring on principles of facilitation.
Accountability
Accountable for ensuring high-quality implementation of the SEL Teacher s Handbook by strengthening the facilitation capacity of SRGs, identifying emerging learning needs, enabling continuous improvement, and supporting coherence across implementation partners.
Accountable for nurturing a facilitative culture of reflection, appreciation, feedback, and collaborative learning within the team and across stakeholders. Accountable for making thoughtful real-time facilitation and design decisions that respond to emerging group needs while remaining aligned to programme intent.
Accountable for independent designing, facilitating, and adapting sessions based on the context.

Description:
Trainee, Program Implementation
Location: Nagaland, Haryana
About Program Operations and Logistics Sub-vertical
Antarang Foundation runs 2 programs: 1) Career Aware with students of municipal schools and low-income private schools studying in 9th and 10th standard across Mumbai, Pune, Udaipur and Goa. 2) Career Ready with students of low-income private junior colleges studying in 11th and 12th standard across our five geographies. The role of Program Operations and Logistics Sub-vertical is to provide end to end support to the facilitators and partner schools/colleges to be able to deliver the program with the required quality. From orienting the schools/colleges at the start of the year, distributing the books/materials to them, allocation of facilitators, to ensure data comes back on a timely basis and gets scanned and uploaded on to our systems, we do it all.
Position Overview
If you have a knack for management, multi-tasking, problem solving coupled with the traits like consistency, spontaneity and dependability, this is the place you may want to be in.
This position is an opportunity for you to impact the career journeys of more than 60,000 young adults and you will need to do everything to make their experience with us, a smooth and memorable one. You will specifically have a very important role in working with our High-tech OMR scanner to ensure student information gets uploaded on our systems timely and accurately. This is a Full-time position and requires an dependable and committed candidate who has an eye for detail.
Responsibilities
Data Management and Upload (PRIMARY): Ensuring filled OMR sheets come back on a timely basis from facilitators
Checking if the sheets are filled as expected, else getting it rectified with facilitators
Scanning approx 2000 sheets per hour on our high tech scanner and and doing minor troubleshooting if required
Operations and Administration: Sorting and Packaging of student books and getting it couriered to schools
Operations and Administration: Managing the storage of books and scanned OMRs and optimum utilization of office space.
Operations and Administration: Packaging of gifts/momentos if required and couriering it to all the Headmasters
Operations and Administration: Maintaining the inventory of medium wise books and other program Related materials
Vendor Management: Coordinating with the vendors (Courier, Books printing and Scanner) to get the tasks done
Vendor Management: Maintaining the bills/invoices and submitting it to the Finance department
Communication: Coordinating with Headmasters to share the progress and solve for the issues Escalate it on a timely basis to ensure speedy resolution of the same
Communication: Keeping the internal teams looped in to seek their support and inputs
Communication: Writing emails to the stakeholders in reference to the task in hand
Student Support and Tracking: Making student support calls to collect information and tracking their journeys post of our programs
Student Support and Tracking: Maintaining, updating the database with the same and preparing reports
Student Support and Tracking: Interpreting data from dashboards and reporting trends to the team.
Profile Requisites
Minimum 1-year commitment required with 8.5 hrs per day
Ability to multitask and prioritize tasks
Clear verbal and written communication, knowledge of local language
Tech Savvy (comfortable using Microsoft Office; confident of learning to operate scanners, dashboards)
Ability to do a certain task multiple times with focus without getting bored
Readiness to give hand and feet support even at odd hours (if and when required).
