The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Description:
Gen AI | Infosys | 2-5yrs | Pan India

Job Description

Are you passionate about building next-generation AI solutions? Join our team to design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge Generative AI applications that drive real business impact.

We are looking for experienced GenAI professionals with strong expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Agent Frameworks, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and MCP (Model Context Protocol).

If you are an immediate joiner and excited about shaping the future of AI, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop enterprise-grade Generative AI applications.
Build Agentic AI solutions using modern agent frameworks.
Develop and optimize RAG-based architectures for intelligent knowledge retrieval.
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems using MCP and related protocols.
Work closely with business and technology teams to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Evaluate, fine-tune, and deploy AI models for production environments.
Ensure AI solutions are secure, scalable, and performance-optimized.

Required Skills
Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Expertise in RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and prompt engineering.
Experience with Agent Frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LangChain, etc.).
Knowledge of Agentic AI concepts and implementations.
Experience with MCP, API integrations, and AI orchestration.
Proficiency in Python and AI/ML development ecosystem.
Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) is an advantage.
Qualification: BE / BTech / MTech / MCA / BCA

Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.

Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).

Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Entry level management position that focuses on successfully accomplishing the daily objectives in the kitchen. Assists in leading staff while personally assisting in all areas of the kitchen, including food production; purchasing and kitchen sanitation. Position contributes to ensuring guest and employee satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Culinary Arts, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met
- Maintains food handling and sanitation standards.
- Performs all duties of Culinary and related kitchen area employees in high demand times.
- Oversees production and preparation of culinary items.
- Ensures employees keep their work areas clean and sanitary.
- Works with Restaurant and Banquet departments to coordinate service and timing of events and meals.
- Complies with loss prevention policies and procedures.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Communicates areas in need of attention to staff and follows up to ensure follow through.
- Leads shifts while personally preparing food items and executing requests based on required specifications.
- Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.
- Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.
- Checks the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.
- Assists in determining how food should be presented and creates decorative food displays.
Supporting Culinary Team Activities
- Supervises daily shift operations.
- Ensures all employees have proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.
- Ensures completion of assigned duties.
- Participates in the employee performance appraisal process, giving feedback as needed.
- Handles employee questions and concerns.
- Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
- Participates in an on-going employee recognition program.
- Conducts training when appropriate.
- Monitors employees progress towards meeting performance expectations.
Maintaining Culinary Goals
- Participates in department meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the departmental goals to produce desired results.
- Supports and assists with new menus, concepts and promotions for the Restaurant outlets and Banquets.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Handles guest problems and complaints seeking assistance from supervisor as necessary.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service within guidelines.
Additional Responsibilities
- Reports malfunctions in department equipment.
- Purchases appropriate supplies and manages food and supply inventories according to budget.
- Attends and participates in all pertinent meetings.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Exhibits culinary talents by personally performing tasks while assisting in leading the staff and managing all food related functions. Works to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction while maximizing the financial performance in all areas of responsibility. Assists in supervising all kitchen areas to ensure a consistent, high quality product is produced. Responsible for guiding and developing staff including direct reports. Must ensure sanitation and food standards are achieved. Areas of responsibility comprise overseeing all food preparation areas (e.g., banquets, room service, restaurants, bar/lounge and employee cafeteria) and all support areas (e.g., dish room and purchasing) as applicable.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 6 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Culinary Arts, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting in Leading Kitchen Operations for Property
- Provides direction for all day-to-day operations.
- Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence or determine appropriate replacement to fill gaps.
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.
- Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an "open door" policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.
- Demonstrate new cooking techniques and equipment to staff.
Setting and Maintaining Goals for Culinary Function and Activities
- Develops and implements guidelines and control procedures for purchasing and receiving areas.
- Establishes goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.
- Communicates the importance of safety procedures, detailing procedure codes, ensuring employee understanding of safety codes, monitoring processes and procedures related to safety.
- Manages department controllable expenses including food cost, supplies, uniforms and equipment.
- Participates in the budgeting process for areas of responsibility.
- Knows and implements the brands safety standards.
Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met
- Provides direction for menu development.
- Monitors the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.
- Determines how food should be presented, and create decorative food displays.
- Recognizes superior quality products, presentations and flavor.
- Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
- Follows proper handling and right temperature of all food products.
- Ensures employees maintain required food handling and sanitation certifications.
- Maintains purchasing, receiving and food storage standards.
- Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides and supports service behaviors that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service. Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters. Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
- Trains kitchen associates on the fundamentals of good cooking and excellent plate presentations.
- Administers the performance appraisal process for direct report managers.
- Interacts with the Banquet Chef and Catering department on training regarding food knowledge and menu composition.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and or managers.
- Manages employee progressive discipline procedures for areas of responsibility.
- Ensures disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and supports the Peer Review Process.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to executive teams, managers and supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.

Description:
Job Summary
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that its your career and Its yours to build which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
The opportunity : Senior Project Consultant-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh
GOV :
Our Global Government & Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
SaT :
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government & Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EYs Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social & Health care, Education, Urban & Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste & Sanitation, Power & Utilities and Public Finance & Management.
SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory :
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to todays toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.


Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence
Work closely with clients to understand their business challenges and provide practical, data-driven solutions.
Support government, public sector, and private sector projects from planning through implementation.
Conduct market research, policy analysis, stakeholder consultations, surveys, and interviews to generate actionable insights.
Analyze quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends, opportunities, and recommendations.
Develop reports, presentations, concept notes, business cases, strategy documents, and client deliverables.
Prepare financial and operational assessments, forecasts, and impact analyses to support decision-making.

About Us:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the team:

Oil & Gas. This team is directly responsible for growth of Oil and Gas offline transactions & users at Paytm.

About the role:

Team Lead KAM - To work with the business to understand and manage Programs being run for the Clients/Brands. And for accelerating the core growth metrics focusing on sales & distribution. Provides guidance and instruction to a working group about a project or portfolio of projects. These leads are responsible for monitoring the efforts of the team members and getting the work done effectively and efficiently with the proper utilization of resources.

Skills that will help you succeed in this role:

2+ yrs. of experience in Distribution sales in fintech, Banking/ Sales, EDC Sales.
Develop plans and strategies for developing business and achieving the company's sales goals.

Create a culture of success and ongoing business and goal achievement.
Hire and build a new team to support our growing needs and future projects.
Define optimal sales force structure.

Define and coordinate sales training programs that enable staff to achieve their potential and support company sales objectives.

Manage customer expectations and contribute to a high level of customer satisfaction.

Define sales processes that drive desired sales outcomes and identify improvements.

Going to the Merchant and educating him/her about the benefits of the Swipe machine (EDC) converting them and managing their accounts.

Exceptional communication, presentation skills and relationship building skills.

Ability to aggressively manage the successful execution of a sales strategy.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree

Should have a strong understanding of the local language.

Self-motivated and goal-oriented, with a demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Willingness to travel as needed to meet with clients and attend industry events.

Education: Applicants must possess bachelors degree or above

Why join us:

We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that is how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India

Description:
Job Description-

The Associate IT Security Operations will support the IT Security team in day-to-day security
operations, monitoring, alert handling, ticket management, and coordination with IT teams for
security-related activities.
The role requires a basic understanding of EDR/XDR, DLP, vulnerability and patch
management, along with a strong willingness to learn and work with new cybersecurity
technologies.
Experience
13 years of experience in IT Security, Cybersecurity, SOC, IT Operations, or a related field.
Key Responsibilities
Monitor and support day-to-day IT Security Operations activities.
Monitor and perform initial triage of security alerts from EDR/XDR and DLP platforms.
Have a basic understanding of EDR/XDR concepts, endpoint security alerts, malware
detections, and security incidents.
Support DLP alert monitoring, investigation, and incident closure.
Monitor vulnerability and patch management status and coordinate with IT teams for
remediation.
Track security issues and incidents through the organization's ticketing/ITSM tool such
as ServiceNow or equivalent.
Ensure security tickets and alerts are investigated and updated within defined SLAs.
Support endpoint security activities and identify devices with security-agent or
compliance issues.
Assist senior team members with security incident investigations and remediation
activities.
Prepare basic security operations reports and maintain operational trackers.
Follow defined security SOPs, processes, and escalation procedures.
Work closely with IT Infrastructure, Network, Endpoint, IAM, and other teams for
security remediation.
Stay updated with cybersecurity concepts and demonstrate eagerness to learn and work
with new security technologies and tools.
Technical Understanding
The candidate should have a basic understanding of:
EDR/XDR: CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Cortex XDR, Microsoft Defender, or similar
platforms.
DLP: Microsoft Purview, Forcepoint, Symantec/Broadcom, or similar solutions.
Vulnerability Management: Qualys, Tenable/Nessus, Rapid7, or similar tools.
Patch Management: Intune, ManageEngine Endpoint Central, SCCM/MECM, or
equivalent.
Ticketing/ITSM: ServiceNow, Jira, ManageEngine ServiceDesk, or equivalent.
Basic understanding of Windows endpoints, networking, malware, phishing,vulnerabilities, and cybersecurity incidents.

Qualifications & Skills
1–3 years of relevant IT/Security Operations experience.
Basic understanding of cybersecurity and endpoint security concepts.
Good analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Good written and verbal communication.
Ability to follow processes and work within defined SLAs.
Strong willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies.
Ability to work effectively with multiple IT and Security teams.
Key Focus
IT Security Operations | EDR/XDR | DLP | Vulnerability & Patch Management | Security Alert
Monitoring | Ticket Management | Incident Support

Description:
Travel: Willingness to travel to offices, warehouses, and other business locations across India
.
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled and proactive Sr. Associate Network Engineer (L2) to
manage, monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure. The
candidate must have hands-on experience with Fortinet FortiGate firewalls, Cisco
switches, Cisco Meraki wireless access points, and FortiAP wireless solutions.
The role involves handling L2 network incidents, troubleshooting complex connectivity
and performance issues, supporting network deployments, coordinating with ISPs and
OEM vendors, and ensuring network availability across corporate offices and
warehouse locations.
Key Responsibilities
1. Firewall Management – Fortinet
Configure, manage, and troubleshoot FortiGate firewalls.
Manage firewall policies, NAT, routing, VLANs, IPsec VPNs, and SSL VPNs.
Monitor firewall health, traffic logs, security events, and resource utilization.
Troubleshoot connectivity, VPN, and policy-related issues.
Support firmware upgrades, configuration backups, and security patching.
Work with FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer for centralized management and log
analysis, where deployed.
2. Switching and Routing – Cisco
Configure and troubleshoot Cisco Layer 2 and Layer 3 switches.

Manage VLANs, trunk ports, access ports, STP, EtherChannel, and inter-VLAN
routing.
Troubleshoot DHCP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, and network connectivity
issues.
Diagnose switching loops, packet drops, port errors, and network latency.
Support switch installation, configuration, replacement, and firmware upgrades.
Maintain network diagrams, IP address records, and configuration backups.
3. Wireless Network Management – Cisco Meraki and FortiAP
Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot Cisco Meraki wireless access points and
FortiAPs.
Manage SSIDs, VLAN mapping, authentication, RF settings, channel allocation,
and transmit power.
Troubleshoot Wi-Fi connectivity, authentication failures, roaming issues,
interference, and high latency.
Analyze wireless client connectivity, signal strength, channel utilization, and
access point performance.
Manage wireless configurations through the Meraki Dashboard and
FortiGate/FortiAP management interfaces, as applicable.
Support wireless surveys, AP installations, coverage validation, and Wi-Fi
optimization at offices and warehouse sites.
4. Network Monitoring and Incident Management
Monitor network infrastructure using tools such as PRTG, SolarWinds, Nagios, or
equivalent platforms.
Investigate alerts, identify root causes, and resolve L2 network incidents within
defined SLAs.
Perform systematic troubleshooting of LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, firewall, and internet
connectivity issues.
Escalate L3 or OEM-dependent issues with detailed troubleshooting evidence.
Prepare incident reports, root cause analysis (RCA), and preventive action plans.
Participate in change management, maintenance windows, and major incident
resolution.
5. Site Deployment and Vendor Coordination
Travel to corporate offices, warehouses, and other business sites for network
deployment and troubleshooting.

Support installation, commissioning, migration, and replacement of firewalls,
switches, and wireless access points.
Coordinate with ISPs, OEMs, and field support teams for fault resolution and
service restoration.
Validate network connectivity, wireless coverage, and infrastructure readiness at
new sites.

Description:
SASE Network Security Engineer
Secure Access Service Edge (SASE)

Role Overview
We are seeking a skilled SASE Network Security Engineer to design, implement, operate, and continuously improve our enterprise Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) and Security Service Edge (SSE) platform. This role is critical to enabling secure, high-performance connectivity for distributed users, devices, and applications while advancing our Zero Trust security strategy.

The ideal candidate combines deep networking expertise with modern cloud-delivered security capabilities and will play a key role in migrating legacy remote-access and web-proxy solutions to a converged SASE architecture.

Key Responsibilities
Design, deploy, and manage SASE/SSE solutions including Secure Web Gateway (SWG), Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Firewall-as-a-Service (FWaaS), and threat protection.
Configure and optimize traffic steering, SSL/TLS inspection, client deployment, policy enforcement, and high-availability designs.
Lead migration of legacy VPN, web proxy, and remote-access technologies to cloud-delivered SASE services.
Monitor platform performance, analyze logs and telemetry, troubleshoot complex issues, and drive continuous optimization of security posture and user experience.
Develop automation scripts, infrastructure-as-code approaches, and maintain high-quality technical documentation.
Collaborate with Network Engineering, Cybersecurity, Architecture, Identity, and Operations teams to ensure alignment with Zero Trust principles and enterprise standards.

Required Qualifications
2+ years of experience in network engineering, network security, cloud security, or cybersecurity engineering.
Hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating enterprise SASE/SSE platforms (e.g., Zscaler, Netskope,Cisco Secure Access, or equivalent).
Strong understanding of SASE and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) architectures and principles.
Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, Routing and Switching, VPNs (IPsec, SSL/TLS), proxy technologies, and traffic engineering.
Experience with identity federation and authentication (SAML, OIDC, SCIM) and major IdPs (Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD, Okta, etc.).
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and hybrid connectivity patterns.
Excellent troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications
Vendor certifications (e.g., Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Netskope, Cisco) related to SASE/SSE or network security.
Experience with SD-WAN technologies and integration with SASE.
Knowledge of DLP, CASB advanced features, Remote Browser Isolation (RBI), and threat protection capabilities.
Scripting/automation experience (Python, PowerShell, Terraform, Ansible, or similar).
Experience with SIEM platforms and security monitoring workflows.
Prior experience in large-scale enterprise or regulated environments.

Our goal is to make payments so easy, safe and universally accepted that people never feel the need to carry cash or cards again. We believe India is at the cusp of a new mobile revolution, which will change the way we manage our money on the go. We see ourselves facilitating this change, through technology and dogged customer centricity. PhonePe went live in 2016 and crossed 5 bn transactions on its platform in 2019. In 2020, PhonePe forayed into diverse areas with the launch of insurance and super funds. Today we have 440+mm registered users and 35 mm merchants live on our platform.
Description:
Role: Business Development Associate (BDA)
Team: Enterprise Team
Reporting: TBD

Core Responsibilities:
Account Management: Onboarding merchants on the platform is the first stage of a long-term relationship between PhonePe and the account. The strength of these relationships, combined with our technology-based solutions, will eventually determine the success of PhonePe in each market in terms of market share and revenue. BDA's task is to develop a deep understanding and relationship with each account that any competitor finds it an uphill task to onboard the merchant account. The incumbent needs to up sell & cross sell new products and services featured in the org such as Smart speaker, EDC machines & tracks certain other products that are suitable for our merchant base. The BDA is expected to engage with merchants and address their queries or escalations, along with Re KYC tracks in a timely manner referring to products & services.

Map Competition: To be able to take timely action, it is imperative that we monitor the market and be informed of competitions initiatives. This will ensure that appropriate response strategies are being formulated and implemented. The BDA must benchmark competition, share best practices internally and ensure that PhonePe always stays one step ahead in the market. The incumbent is expected to own the market or the geography assigned and ensure the health or the portfolio of the merchants.
Qualifications:
12th + Education Qualification.
0-2 years of experience in sales, business development, or account management (enterprise experience preferred).
Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Understanding of CRM software (e.g., Salesforce) and MS Office (PowerPoint, Excel).
Skills required:
Excellent written/verbal communication.
Strategic thinking and market research skills.
Resilience and ability to handle rejection.
AboutCompany:
About PhonePe Group:
Phonepe is the leader in the UPI based payments in India with a market share of more than 50.1%. Location

Multiple

proactively

influencing on ground business

Indicators

Cx / Gx metrics

Networking ability 
Soft Skills (ERP/APP usage, Excel, Email writing)

Job Title: DataStage Developer
Experience: 2-8 Years
Location: PAN India
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking a talented IBM DataStage Developer with 23 years of experience in ETL development, data integration, and data warehousing projects. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in IBM InfoSphere DataStage, SQL, and database technologies, with the ability to design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL solutions that support business intelligence and analytics initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy ETL jobs using IBM InfoSphere DataStage.
Develop and maintain data integration workflows for loading data from multiple source systems into data warehouses and data marts.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical ETL solutions.
Implement data cleansing, validation, and transformation logic.
Optimize DataStage jobs for performance, scalability, and reliability.
Perform unit testing, integration testing, and support UAT activities.
Troubleshoot ETL job failures and resolve production issues.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

Job description

Senior Executive Relationship Management

Job Title: Senior Executive Relationship Management
Department: Sales
Industry: Interior Design / Home Interiors
Experience: 1-5 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Working Days: 6 Days a Week
Fixed Weekly Off: Tuesday

Job Summary

We are looking for a dynamic and customer-focused Senior Executive Relationship Management to drive sales, build strong customer relationships, and deliver an exceptional customer experience. The ideal candidate should have strong communication and negotiation skills, a customer-centric approach, and the ability to achieve sales targets in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Generate new business opportunities by proactively engaging with prospective customers and building a strong sales pipeline.
Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers to understand their requirements and provide suitable solutions.
Drive sales and achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets in coordination with the interior design team.
Ensure an excellent customer experience throughout the sales journey, from the initial enquiry to deal closure.
Understand customer needs, address concerns, and provide effective solutions to improve customer satisfaction.
Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and proactively resolve customer and business challenges.
Explore alternate sales channels, including residential visits, apartment activities, design consultations, and showroom engagements.
Coordinate with internal teams, including interior designers, to ensure smooth customer interactions and timely follow-ups.
Analyse sales performance and customer feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
Demonstrate flexibility, accountability, and a results-oriented approach in a fast-paced work environment.
Communicate effectively with customers, colleagues, business partners, and other stakeholders.
Take the initiative to implement new ideas and contribute to business growth.

Required Skills and Qualifications

1-5 years of experience in sales, business development, or relationship management.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong customer relationship management and negotiation skills.
Good listening, presentation, and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to multitask, prioritise tasks, and manage time effectively.
Target-oriented mindset with a proven ability to drive sales and achieve business goals.
Strong ownership, initiative, and willingness to work in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Candidates with experience in B2C sales, customer relationship management, real estate, home interiors, or other customer-facing sales roles will be preferred.
Candidates with strong customer-handling skills and a passion for delivering excellent service are encouraged to apply.
Candidates should be comfortable with customer visits, apartment activities, and showroom-based sales engagements.Role & responsibilities

The flagship HomeLane brand has seen strong expansion and market presence in India.

Responsibilities
OE shall be owner of his / her service area in terms of all operations related actions and shall Execute daily service operations with a team of assigned Technicians within a given service areas
Ensure quality of service delivery by effective supervision on technicians - on the job as per company SOPs
Ensure technicians carry out treatment within a given Time on Site (ToS) in a competent manner. (OE to engage technician via route riding, training on the job).
Plan execute 02 TPAs (Technicians Performance Assessment) per assigned technician with 2 development programs per year. Coach train assigned technicians in order to improve the service quality
Convey special instructions, if any, to technicians to execute the job as per Service Docket (liaison with Sales colleagues)
Carry out pest management audits of customer sites as per agreed schedule by i or R auditor.
Complete close customer audit non-conformities (external / internal). Follow up implement CAPA at customer site
On Site Documentation: Implementation of SOP, Compliance and closure of audits non-conformities (Internal / External). Send service dockets of completed services to NKA for invoicing on time.
Handle assigned customer complaints in his / her service areas, within 24 hours resolve complaint at earliest, as per the customers convenience and update the Root Cause in iCABS to ensure proper ticket closure
Identify resolve service delivery issues in coordination with the Branch Manager
Conduct daily 10 min stand up meeting monthly operations meeting
Be conversant with STP (Service Track Pest) and monitor, analyze visit extraction notes for all high infestation related service visits on a daily basis; take action.
Digital Initiative: Be conversant with all in house systems.
Maintain Material consumption, Overtime Hrs. schedule at an agreed targeted level for the assigned service area and for technician
Approval of conveyance amount for assigned technicians
Monitor report to ABM/BM on input costs at all major sites as per gross margin agreed discuss action plans to bring it within limits
Actively drive Service Product Leads for assigned technician group within service area by implementing STA (See, Tell, Ask) and T.I.M.E. (Train, Incentivise, Monitor, Engage) on the job coaching to create density of customers.
Innovation: conduct trials and report findings as per the guidelines, implement new service lines as per the SOPs.
Minimum 18 customer visits per week for Resi SA (Residential Small Accounts segment heavy branch), includes, Customer complaints. For Specific Site based OEs -Number shall not be applicable but Retention of customer/s at site would be main KPI with all scheduled services completed efficiently and effectively.
Inventory: Help ABM/BM to manage Inventory - coordinate with other Ops colleagues
to manage Stock Levels of branches forecasting, Indenting receipt of material for branch (as an assigned function within branch by BM).
Ensure APL (Approved Preparations List) is followed by all assigned technicians all chemical containers have original labels
Ensure proper schedule of maintenance repairs of equipment is established followed (via JOC).
Promote highest grooming standards (uniform, Safety shoes, PPEs)
Encourage technicians to plan their leaves in advance to curb absenteeism
Help Resolve any Grievances IR issues of Technicians bring to the notice of ABM/BM on day today basis
Report any deviation that could impact service quality or productivity of technicians like- over commitments, recommendation regarding night service (if it is not needed), covered area mismatch, etc


Requirements
Minimum B. Sc. (Chemistry / Zoology / Agriculture). Any prior experience in operations of pest management or service industry is desirable.
Proficient in use of computer applications systems with Excel, Word, PowerPoint (or its equivalent)
Should get well versed with various internal company systems such as iCABS, STP, iAuditor, SRA, SQA, SQS, TPA, myRentokilPCI, Service Leads App, U+ etc

Description:
Lead - Business Development
About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving enterprise customer acquisition and expansion across key verticals and geographies. The role demands deep industry insight, strong solutioning capability, and the ability to build executive relationships within large organizations. As a senior leader, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.
Key Responsibilities:
Drive Revenue Growth: Lead and deliver aggressive revenue targets on a monthly and quarterly basis through new customer acquisition and strategic account expansion in the logistics and supply chain domain.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert large B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.
Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-impact BD team; establish scalable processes for lead generation, funnel management, and account growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Product, Pricing, and Finance to develop compelling proposals, pilot programs, and commercial models.
Performance Tracking: Own pipeline forecasting, sales performance metrics, and revenue attribution; regularly report to executive leadership on growth performance and strategic initiatives.
Client Success & Retention: Ensure seamless client onboarding, continuous engagement, and upselling of adjacent logistics services such as reverse logistics, express delivery, or value-added services.
Preferred Background & Skills:
5+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, FTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.

Description:
Job Summary
The opportunity: Senior Project Consultant-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh
GOV: Our Global Government Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
SaT:
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY's Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social Health care, Education, Urban Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste Sanitation, Power Utilities and Public Finance Management.
SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory :
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to todays toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.
Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence
Minimum 5 years of experience in consulting, advisory, strategy, research, analytics, policy, or project management. Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities. Experience in conducting research, stakeholder engagement, interviews, and quantitative and qualitative analysis. Excellent communication, report-writing, and presentation development skills. Proven ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment and manage diverse stakeholders. Strong client management and project coordination skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and other analytical and reporting tools. Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality outcomes. Experience in government advisory, public policy, economic development, institutional strengthening, or transformation projects will be an added advantage. Engage with clients to understand business challenges and deliver practical, evidence-based solutions. Support the planning, execution, and monitoring of consulting and advisory assignments across government, public sector, and private sector engagements. Conduct market assessments, policy research, stakeholder consultations, and data analysis to generate meaningful insights and recommendations. Prepare high-quality reports, presentations, strategy papers, business cases, and other client deliverables. Develop financial, operational, and impact assessments to support informed decision-making. Work closely with project teams, subject matter experts, and stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery. Build and maintain strong client relationships while ensuring high standards of service and professionalism.
Skills and attributes
To qualify for the role you must have
Qualification
Any Post Graduation
Experience
5+ years of overall experience
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
Department: HCD (Projects & Services Division)

Tasks :
1.Facility Development & Project Execution: Review designs, specifications, BOQs and P&IDs; supervise mechanical installation, testing and commissioning; coordinate with EPC contractors, consultants and vendors; monitor progress, quality, cost and timelines.

2.HVAC & Cleanroom Engineering: Review and execute HVAC for classified areas, covering HEPA filtration, air changes, pressure cascades and environmental control; coordinate testing, commissioning and qualification.

3.Process Utilities: Supervise installation, commissioning and maintenance of chillers, cooling towers, AHUs, steam and pure steam, WFI, purified water, compressed air and gases, boilers, ETP, exhaust systems and cold storage.

4.Equipment Integration: Coordinate mechanical and utility requirements for bioreactors, fermenters, purification systems and filling lines; ensure hygienic design and maintainability; support qualification documentation.

5.Maintenance & Facility Operations: Develop preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance programmes; ensure utility availability; maintain equipment records and asset plans; implement AMC/CAMC; coordinate calibration and statutory compliance; support deviations, change control and CAPA.

6.GMP, Qualification & Compliance: Ensure compliance with WHO-GMP, Schedule M, biosafety and contamination control; support DQ, IQ, OQ and PQ; coordinate with QA, QC, Validation and Production; support inspections and audits.

7.Tendering & Contract Management: Prepare specifications, BOQs, DPRs, estimates and tender documents; evaluate bids and vendors; monitor contractor performance and handover of completed facilities.

Requirements
Maximum Age: 40 years as on 01.11.2026 for BE / B.Tech holders;
45 years as on 01.11.2026 for Diploma holders

Basic pay range: Rs. 30,000 - 50,000 per month
Gross Salary: Rs. 61,830.00 (Non-Metro) (approx.) at the minimum of the scale.
Annual CTC: 8.82 Lakhs (Non-Metro) (approx.) at the minimum of the scale.

Qualification:
Essential: BE / B.Tech in Mechanical.
OR
Diploma in Engineering (Mechanical).

Post Qualification Experience:
For Degree holders, minimum 3 years of post-qualification experience in mechanical engineering for the planning, design, development, execution, installation, commissioning, qualification and maintenance of vaccine and biologicals manufacturing facilities, pharmaceutical or biotechnology facilities, similar institutes. Experience in cleanroom HVAC, GMP-compliant utilities and industrial process systems, and in project execution, installation, commissioning and facility maintenance. Knowledge of WHO-GMP, Schedule M, biosafety and contamination control requirements.

For Diploma holders, minimum 10 years of post-qualification experience in mechanical engineering for the planning, design, development, execution, installation, commissioning, qualification and maintenance of vaccine and biologicals manufacturing facilities, pharmaceutical or biotechnology facilities, similar institutes. Experience in cleanroom HVAC, GMP-compliant utilities and industrial process systems, and in project execution, installation, commissioning and facility maintenance. Knowledge of WHO-GMP, Schedule M, biosafety and contamination control requirements.

Essential Technical Competencies
Cleanroom HVAC and controlled environmental systems.
GMP-compliant process utilities.
WFI and Purified Water Systems.
Steam, Pure Steam and Compressed Air Systems.
Chillers, Boilers and Industrial Utility Systems.
Biological manufacturing equipment integration.
Equipment qualification and commissioning.
Preventive and predictive maintenance.
Technical tendering, procurement and project management.
AutoCAD, P&ID and engineering drawing interpretation.

No. of Positions : 1
Posting Location: Chandigarh
AboutCompany: HLL Lifecare Limited (HLL), India's leading manufacturers and marketers of contraceptive, Health Care and Pharma products is a Mini Ratna Central Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. HLL is a global leader in the area of contraceptives, hospital products and healthcare services. With 8 manufacturing units, 3 subsidiary / joint venture companies, 21 regional offices. HLL exports products to over 85 countries. Besides this, HLL is engaged in providing healthcare and diagnostic services, consultancy and contract services for healthcare infrastructure projects and consultancy services for procurement of medical equipment and devices in healthcare sector. Thus, HLL is positioned as a total healthcare solution provider catering to the well-being of society at large.

Description:
Job Summary
Agilent is looking for passionate and motivated young scientists to join our team as Field Application Engineers (FAE) supporting our LCMS (Liquid Chromatography Mass Spectrometry) and GCMS (Gas Chromatography Mass Spectrometry) business. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work closely with leading pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, food, environmental, and research laboratories across India. As a Field Application Engineer, you will serve as a technical expert, helping customers develop analytical workflows, optimize methods, and maximize the value of Agilent's advanced analytical instrumentation. You will collaborate with sales, product specialists, application scientists, and customers to drive technology adoption and business growth.


Responsibilities
Develop and optimize LCMS and GCMS analytical methods and workflows for applications including pharmaceuticals, pesticides, antibiotics, food safety, and other emerging markets

Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems & Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting & MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency & Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Description:
About Us:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the team:
Oil & Gas. This team is directly responsible for growth of Oil and Gas offline transactions & users at Paytm.

About the role:
Team Lead KAM - To work with the business to understand and manage Programs being run for the Clients/Brands. And for accelerating the core growth metrics focusing on sales & distribution. Provides guidance and instruction to a working group about a project or portfolio of projects. These leads are responsible for monitoring the efforts of the team members and getting the work done effectively and efficiently with the proper utilization of resources.

Skills that will help you succeed in this role:

2+ yrs. of experience in Distribution sales in fintech, Banking/ Sales, EDC Sales.
Develop plans and strategies for developing business and achieving the company's sales goals.
Create a culture of success and ongoing business and goal achievement.
Hire and build a new team to support our growing needs and future projects.
Define optimal sales force structure.
Define and coordinate sales training programs that enable staff to achieve their potential and support company sales objectives.
Manage customer expectations and contribute to a high level of customer satisfaction.
Define sales processes that drive desired sales outcomes and identify improvements.
Going to the Merchant and educating him/her about the benefits of the Swipe machine (EDC) converting them and managing their accounts.
Exceptional communication, presentation skills and relationship building skills.
Ability to aggressively manage the successful execution of a sales strategy.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field (MBA preferred).
Should have a strong understanding of the local language.
Self-motivated and goal-oriented, with a demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Willingness to travel as needed to meet with clients and attend industry events.

Education: Applicants must possess bachelor’s degree or above

Why join us: We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that is how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.
Who Will Do Well in This Role?
Someone who is sharp, articulate, proactive, and comfortable speaking to customers every day—someone who enjoys sales and account management, takes ownership, learns quickly, and can turn customer conversations into meaningful business opportunities.
If you are looking to build a career in Inside Sales, Account Management & Customer Success with one of India’s leading logistics companies, we’d love to hear from you.

Description:
Job Summary
The Territory Manager is responsible for driving sales growth, market development, and customer engagement across the assigned territory. The role partners closely with healthcare professionals, distributors, and key stakeholders to expand product adoption, support clinical utilization, and deliver territory-specific growth strategies across the Trauma and CSOT portfolios.
This field-based position is based in North India and requires regular customer engagement across assigned territories, including hospitals, surgeons, distributors, and healthcare institutions. The role requires approximately 50% travel to support sales growth, clinical adoption, customer education, and territory development activities. This position is aligned to the Trauma portfolio across Punjab, Haryana (excluding NCR), and Jammu Kashmir, while also supporting the full Cranial and Spinal Orthopedic Technologies (CSOT) portfolio in Himachal Pradesh.
Responsibilities
Achieve or exceed sales targets across the assigned Trauma and CSOT product portfolios.
Develop and manage relationships with surgeons, healthcare professionals, hospital stakeholders, and channel partners.
Identify new business opportunities and convert prospective accounts into active customers.
Provide product support and clinical assistance during procedures, including operation theater engagements when required.
Conduct product education programs and training sessions for healthcare professionals and distributor teams.
Analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities to develop territory growth plans.
Execute territory-specific sales strategies and business development initiatives to increase market penetration.
Communicate customer feedback, market insights, and product improvement opportunities to internal stakeholders.
Qualifications
High School Diploma (or equivalent) and 6+ years experience
Associate's Degree and 4+ years experience
Bachelor's Degree and 2+ years experience
Physical Job Requirements
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.
Recruitment Fraud Alert
We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:
Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official channels.
Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.
If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments.
If you have any questions or concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us through official channels.

Description:
About Liability Sales
The Liability Sales department focuses on the liability acquisition, assets and retail forex business for the
bank. The department drives business from branches across India and is responsible for sourcing of retail
and corporate deposits, salary and non-salary accounts, trust accounts and forex Business with a view to
increase the retail book of the bank.
About the Role
Officer Sales are a part of the Bank's front-line sales force whose primary responsibility is to get new
customers for the bank and explore new business opportunities. Officer Sales are responsible for selling
banking and investment products and services to customers based on their needs. They are also responsible
for handling customer queries to ensure customer satisfaction. This is a pure sales job and involves daily
customer reach-outs & travelling
Key Responsibilities
• Identify sales opportunities for both the Bank and third-party products by acquiring new customers
and building new relationships.
• Manage business relations with existing customers to increase the depth of existing relationships.
• Achieve sales targets as assigned by the organization monthly as per Grade Matrix (BDE, Officer and
AM Sales)
• Record and track all engagement activities through the CRM system.
• Comply with KYC/SEBI rules, regulations, and legislation governing the financial services industry
Qualifications
Optimal qualification for success on the job is depends on Grade offer to:
• Officer Sales-2 : Graduate with more than 1 year of experience (upto 2 years)
• Officer Sales-1 : Graduate with less than 1 year of experience
Role Proficiencies:
For successful execution of the job, the candidate should possess the following:
• Good communication (both verbal and written) skill in both English and the local language.
• Excellent lead generation and conversion skill
• Ability to handle pressure and meet deadlines.
• Ability to work successfully as a part of a team.
• High sales orientation to meet the sales targets consistently. • Ensure resource should have the recommended Model Device and Android Version- Model 1-OPPO, VIVO, MI, 1+, Samsung and Realme. Android Version- 10/11/12/13.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Client Acquisition & Onboarding: Source new NRI customers through referrals, overseas branches, digital leads, and direct outreach.

Portfolio & Wealth Management: Handle High-Net-Worth (HNI) and affluent NRI portfolios; offer customized financial solutions including Mutual Funds, Portfolio Management Services (PMS), Life/Term Insurance, and RBI/Sovereign Gold Bonds.

Liability & Asset Growth: Increase and track Assets Under Management (AUM), CASA (Current Account Savings Account) balances, and fixed deposits.

Relationship & Service Deepening: Regularly review client portfolios, handle service requests/complaints, track client visits to India, and engage on personal or festive occasions.
AboutCompany:
Jana Small Finance Bank, erstwhile Janalakshmi Financial Services, is headquartered in Bengaluru. It is one of the 10 financial institutions which had received in-principle approval from RBI, in 2015, to set up a Small Finance Bank.
Established in Bengaluru in 2008, it went on to become the largest Micro Finance Institution (MFI) in India, and was recognised globally as one of the world€™s innovative financial institutions working on the problem of financial inclusion.
Jana Bank received the final banking license in April 2017 and started banking operations on March 28, 2018. Under the leadership of its MD & CEO, Ajay Kanwal, Jana Small Finance Bank€™s vision is to become the leading inclusive digitised bank serving all customer segments and communities of an aspirational India.
Currently, post the transition phase, the bank is enabling its existing 45 lakh customers across 19 states in India to access banking services. It has Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) of about 35 percent and a loan book of INR 76 billion as on March 31, 2018. By 2020, the bank aspires to add four million customers.
The bank has deep domain expertise in banking and financial services, with the senior management team having 25+ years of average experience in banking sector. Its current employee strength is of 15,000. By end of 2019, Jana Bank€™s 500 branches will be operational across 19 states, post conversion of majority of its micro finance storefronts into bank branches.
Bengaluru-headquartered Jana Small Finance Bank is regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).

1) Job Position:

Assistant Vice President / Manager-Medical Business Operation-India- Global Digital Health Startup.

2) , Role & Responsibility:

i) To work as an Assistant Vice President / Manager for Medical Business Operation for Pan India & South East Asia based in our Global Delhi HQ, India or for Manager Remotely work from Home-based in Bangalore /Mumbai.

Dealing day to day basis with a big chain of hospitals Group or Direct B2C Consumer Market in Healthcare domain of Public health, Preventive Health, Early Detection, Dr Consultations, R&D Collaborations, Treatments, Surgeries, Disease Management related in Chronic Diseases such as in Oncology, Diabetes, Heart Disease, COPD & Mental Health, working directly dealing in the end to end Patient Management, Patient Case Management( Domestic and or International Patients), Medical Business Operation outside and inside a Hospital environment in Oncology/Diabetes/Heart/Chronic Diseases areas ( Digital Health Products & Solutions) while working with early-stage / established Health Startup.

ii) Mandatory to be an entrepreneur & should have worked/working in a HealthTech / Healthcare organisation of repute in an early-stage/ Growth stage Digital Health / Health Startup / Indian big company / fast-growing MNC in HealthTech / Healthcare.

3) Qualification:
