Department: PSD
Function: Institutional Sales
Designation: Product Sales Executive (PSE)
Reporting To: ABM/ Regional Manager
Experience: 3 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Location - Mumbai, Kolkata, Patna, Bihar


Job Purpose
The Product Sales Executive (PSE) Institutional Sales will be responsible for driving product
sales and business growth through institutional customers. The role involves identifying new
business opportunities, developing relationships with key institutional clients, generating
enquiries, preparing quotations, negotiating commercial terms, and ensuring achievement of assigned sales targets.

Key Responsibilities
- Identify and develop new institutional customers and business opportunities.
- Manage relationships with existing institutional clients and ensure repeat business.
- Conduct regular customer visits and understand product requirements.
- Generate leads through market visits, references, networking and other business development activities.
- Present and demonstrate products to institutional customers as required.
- Prepare and submit quotations, proposals and commercial offers.
- Coordinate with internal teams for pricing, product availability, dispatch and delivery.
- Follow up on enquiries, quotations and orders to ensure timely conversion.
- Negotiate with customers within approved company guidelines.
- Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
- Maintain an updated database of institutional customers, prospects and sales activities.
- Monitor market trends, competitor activities and customer requirements.
- Ensure timely collection of outstanding payments in coordination with the finance team.
- Handle customer queries and coordinate for resolution of complaints.
- Maintain regular sales reports, visit reports and pipeline updates.
- Support the organization in developing new territories, accounts and product opportunities.

Key Accountabilities / KPIs
- Achievement of assigned sales targets.
- New institutional customer acquisition.
- Revenue and product-wise sales growth.
- Enquiry-to-order conversion.
- Number and quality of customer visits.
- Development of active sales pipeline.
- Customer retention and repeat orders.
- Timely payment/collection follow-up.
- Gross margin as per company guidelines.
- Accuracy and timely submission of sales reports.

Target Customer Segments
The candidate may be responsible for developing business from:
- Corporates and large organizations
- Educational institutions
- Hospitals and healthcare institutions
- Government/semi-government institutions
- Hotels and hospitality organizations
- Dealers/distributors and institutional buyers
- NGOs and other bulk purchasers
- Other B2B/institutional customers relevant to the company's product portfolio

Candidate Profile
Qualification:
- Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in Sales & Marketing will be an added advantage.

Experience:
- 3 years of experience in B2B, institutional sales, corporate sales or field sales.
- Freshers with strong communication and sales aptitude may also be considered.
Skills Required:
- Good communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong negotiation and relationship-management skills.
- Ability to generate leads and convert prospects into customers.
- Target-oriented and self-motivated approach.
- Good presentation and convincing skills.
- Basic knowledge of MS Office/Excel and CRM systems.
- Willingness to travel extensively for customer meetings.
- Ability to work independently.

Desired Competencies
- Business development
- Customer relationship management
- Sales planning and execution
- Negotiation skills
- Market intelligence
- Follow-up and closing skills
- Problem-solving ability
- Time management
- Result orientation

Pathologist-Full Time
Patna
Lab Operations
Role summary
Managerial Responsibilities:
Overall Management of the laboratory
Consumption management
Quality management

Technical Responsibilities:
Up gradation of advanced technologies Quality of the results.
What the role entails - Key accountabilities/ responsibilities
1. Provide advice to those requesting information about the choice of tests, the use of the laboratory service and the interpretation of laboratory data.
2. Serve as an active member of the medical staff in main lab, collection center,
3. Relate and function effectively with NABL & other accrediting agencies, Appropriate administrative officials, healthcare community, the patient / clients.
4. Define, implement, and monitor standards of performance and quality improvement of the medical laboratory service orservices.
5. Monitor all processes in the laboratory to determine that reliable data is being generated.
6. Ensure availability of sufficiently qualified personnel with adequate training and experience to meet the needs of the laboratory.
7. Plan, set goals, develop, and allocate resources appropriate to the medical environment.
8. Provide effective and efficient administration of the medical laboratory service, including budget planning and control with responsible financial management, in accordance with institutional assignment of such responsibilities.
9. Provide educational programs for the medical and laboratory staff and participate in educational programs of the institution.
10. Implement a safe laboratory environment in compliance with good practice and applicable regulations.
11. Address any complaint, request, or suggestion from users of laboratory services. Ensure good staff morale.
12. Report authorization of Hematology, Biochemistry, Immunoassay, Clinical Pathology, and serology
13. Routine review of QC for all departments with review of reports including CBC, MP, PS, Reticulocyte count, Fluid routine, ICT/DCT, Blood group before approving
14. Formulate review and recheck policies for all tests and ensure compliance with the help of Lab supervisor and technicians.
15. Verification of critical, unusual, and abnormal test results before release
16. Interpret, Correlate, and generate medically significant laboratory data.
17. Attending all sorts of client queries related to test enquiries and interpretation of test results.
18. Approval of SOPs for use and ensure compliance with respect to accreditation requirements.
19. Ensure review of monthly MIS
20. Ensure results are reported within turnaround time with the help of section head.
21. Review and improvement of reports formats.
22. To identify new equipment, tests, technology, products and standardization of assays.
23. Identify needs for resources (human / equipment / infrastructure) and submit to senior management for approval.
24. Attending conferences/workshops to ensure updated knowledge about recent trends.
25. To spend time reviewing daily pendency status on reports not released as well as sample received cases to avoid patient dissatisfaction.
26. To keep a watchful eye on instrument maintenance and hygiene of lab and practice 0 tolerance in this area. Any instrument failure due to user s should be avoided totally as it affects our patient and business.
27. To ensure sample processing is not stopped due to KIT non availability.
28. To ensure that every PR is approved on time and any gaps are highlighted.
29. COL/ Lab Head should work with BU Heads in forecasting CAMP s and other seasonal activities and order KITs sufficiently.
30. To keep a close watch on technical complaints. Ensure analytical complaints get logged, DE flagging is minimized. For recorded complaints and initiate proper CAPA and must also discuss in weekly calls with the team on learning and preventive actionsand timely escalation of analytical complaints/ Legal threats
31. To spend quality time on understanding patient and customer VOC especially on cases we are not resolving on time. COL/Lab Head should guide the team to resolve issues on time andsupport them wherever technical input is required.
32. To participate in weekly meetings along with BU/SBU Heads to resolve issues as well as seek support wherever needs from nontechnical team.
33. To take responsibility to train the non-technical team for better business and customer engagement.
34. COL/Lab Head must contribute at least 8 hours in a month in training and sharing knowledge to the team through a formal mechanism.
35. To promote MHL test to larger communities of clinician through KOL Connects. They must use our report as a tool to promote test by recommending new test based on diagnosis in the report.
36. To make time at least once a month to meet B2B clients, collection centers, customers to understand the pulse of the market.
37. To follow guidelines objectively as per MHL Policy and ensure a culture of data-based decision making and discussions; hence every month compliance is very important. It is at most importance for to have self-Compliance from every lab and noncompliance is given utmost importance for closure.
38. To give sufficient time to check and review the Lab managers /Technical team on quality, material consumption and technical performance.
39. Ensure that processes needed for the quality management system are established, implemented, and maintained.
40. Reporting to laboratory management, at the level at which decisions are made on laboratory policy, objectives, and resources, on the performance of the quality management system and any need for improvement.
41. Ensuring the promotion of awareness of users needs and requirements throughout the laboratory organization.
What we are looking for in you
Excellent communication and analytical skill.
Working With
Lab Operations Team
Role demands (Travel)
Yes
Stakeholder interfaces
Yes
What we promise to you
A strong growth prospective.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

NALANDA (CD-123)

3. FE need to visit according to time slot and All visit Feedback has to be updated (in MUCH application).

9. He has to follow company process in terms of customer handling etiquettes and dress code while he is on field along with maintaining the Code of conducts and integrity as per company norms.

Description:
About the Role:The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving B2B customer acquisition for PTL vertical. As a sales professional, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.
Key Responsibilities:
New Business Development: Identify and onboard new B2B clients manufacturers, traders, distributors, and retailers who have regular

Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.

Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.

Description:
Responsible for preparing all event documentation and coordinates with Sales, property departments and customer to ensure consistent, high level service throughout pre-event, event and post-event phases of property events.
This position primarily handles events of average complexity.
Ensures their property events have a seamless turnover from sales to service back to sales.
Recognizes opportunities to maximize revenue opportunities by up-selling and offering enhancements to create outstanding events.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; experienced (1 - 2 years of experience) in the event management or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; at least 1 year experience in the event management or related professional area required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Event Logistics and Operations
- Ensures that events progress seamlessly by following established procedures, collaborating with other employees, and ensuring accuracy.
- Greets customer during the event phase and hands-off to the Event Operations team for the execution of details.
- Adheres to all standards, policies, and procedures.
- Ensures billing accuracy and conducts bill reviews with the clients prior to processing the final bill.
- Manages group room blocks and meeting space for average to large-sized assigned groups.
- Identifies operational challenges associated with his/her group and determines how to best work with the property staff and customer to solve these challenges\ and/or develop alternative solutions.
- Uses his/her judgment to integrate current trends in event management and event design.
- Acts as liaison between field salesperson and customer throughout the event process (pre-event, event, post-event).
- Participates in customer site inspections and assists with the sales process as necessary.
- Performs other duties as assigned to meet business needs.
- Solicits feedback from the property departments to identify areas for improvement to enhance the Event Planner s experience.
Ensuring and Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Delivers excellent customer service throughout the customer experience and encourages the same from other employees.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Coordinates and communicates event details both verbally and in writing to the customer and property operations.
- Makes presence known to customer at all times during this process.
- Oversees his/her customer experiences from file turnover through the post event phase until turnover back to sales.
- Follows up with customer post-event.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Uses personal judgment and expertise to enhance the customer experience.
- Stays available to solve problems and/or suggest alternatives to previous arrangements.
- Works to continually improve customer service by integrating obtained feedback and personal judgment into action plans.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Ensures hourly employees understand expectations and parameters for event activities.
Leading Event Management Teams

Description:
Programme Overview
India has the world's highest burden of tuberculosis (TB). The National TB Elimination Program (NTEP), led by the Central TB Division (CTD), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, aims to end TB, and expanding access to rapid molecular testing is central to that goal. WJCF has supported the CTD and state health departments on TB, across case detection, access to diagnostics, preventive therapy, private-sector engagement and technical support to governments.
India built a large network of RT-PCR laboratories during COVID-19, and much of it now sits underused. With ICMR having validated an open RT-PCR kit for TB, this network could substantially expand rapid molecular testing for TB. WJCF has supported the Central TB Division's operational feasibility assessment of open RT-PCR for TB, including at IGIMS Patna and Siwan District Hospital.
Before the feasibility assessment was conducted, sites collocated with open real time PCR and NAAT (currently used under the programme) were identified by the State and CTD. These facilities were individually assessed on site by a team of technical experts using a detailed structured checklist. The non-conformities were addressed; kits and consumables were procured; the lab personnel trained subsequently on laboratory practices by the microbiologist followed by demonstration and hands-on practice facilitated jointly by a microbiologist and the manufacturers technical representative.
Learnings from the feasibility assessment encourage scale up of Open Real Time PCR-based testing for TB.

We are looking for a skilled Project Manager with experience in OHE works to lead our PSI project. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing projects and leading teams, with excellent communication and problem-solving skills.

Roles and Responsibility

Manage and coordinate the activities of cross-functional teams to ensure successful project execution.

Develop and implement project plans, resource allocation, and risk management strategies.

Conduct site visits to monitor progress and identify potential issues or delays.

Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and provide updates on project status.

Ensure compliance with safety protocols and regulations during construction activities.

Analyze project data to identify areas for improvement and optimize processes.


Job Requirements

Proven experience as a Project Manager with a minimum of 5 years of experience.

Strong knowledge of project management principles, practices, and techniques.

Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Familiarity with construction methods, materials, and safety protocols.

Experience working with Blue Star Ltd or similar companies is an added advantage.


The company offers a competitive salary package and opportunities for professional growth and development.

Description:
Job Summary
Job title: Customer Service Assistant. As a Customer Service Associate at Marks and Spencer, your main role is to assist customers, maintain store standards, and learn the basics of store operations. Your key responsibilities include:
Responsibilities
Greet Assist Customers: Welcome customers with a friendly attitude and help them find what they need.
Understand Customer Needs: Listen to customers, understand their preferences, and recommend suitable products.
Support Visual Merchandising: Help maintain the store's appearance by following guidelines for product displays.
Proper Product Handling: Ensure products are handled carefully and organized correctly on the shelves.
Learn Store Procedures: Follow company guidelines for tasks like stocking, housekeeping, and cashiering.
Assist with Cashiering: When needed, help with basic cashier duties to provide smooth service.
On-the-Job Training: Take part in training sessions to improve your skills and grow within the role.
Qualifications
Essential: Minimum 12th Pass
Preferred: Any Graduate

As a Procurement Associate (PA), you will handle all Used Car Dealers in a given area and ask them to take part in car auctions and convince them to give a higher bid.

Park yourself at our office by 10 AM sharp (maximum), with a dash of Punctuality and flexibility for those occasional extra laps around the track. Gear up and join our winning and exciting team at Cars24, where every day is a drive towards success!

Description:
Job Description

Position Title: Paramedics/Senior Paramedics
Reports To: Regional Paramedic/Medical Officer I/Medical Officer II

Location: Airport Locations

Job Purpose
To provide timely and effective medical support to employees through medical assessments, emergency care, and regulatory health compliance activities, while ensuring adherence to DGCA and company requirements. The role is responsible for maintaining operational readiness of the Medical Centre, conducting Breath Alcohol Testing (BAT), supporting audits and investigations, managing medical inventories, and contributing to a safe, compliant, and healthy workplace environment.

Key Accountabilities
To conduct pre-flight/post-flight medical checks and maintain all its documentation and records as per prevailing DGCA and company rules. • Conduct Pre-Duty Breath alcohol tests for ground staff and maintains all its documentation and records as per prevailing DGCA and company rules.
To maintain the upkeep of the Medical Centre and address all discrepancies.
Assist in replenishing and certifying the contents of the First Aid Kit, Medical Kit and Universal Precaution Kit.
• Treat the employees and attend to emergencies in the capacity of a paramedic.
Assist in dealing with the casualties of the accidents/medical incidents in the Airport areas for employees of IndiGo, if needed as a paramedic and administer first aid.
Coordinate with emergency services if necessary.
Assist and submit themselves to DGCA/internal audits and investigations, if required.
Maintaining administrative requirements of medical room like monthly stock taking for PFMC related stationery/eqpt, medicine stock, stationery requirements and initiate process for purchase as and when necessary, etc.

Qualifications Essential
GNM/B.Sc Nursing
Valid Nursing Registration

Skills
First aid basics
Basic computer knowledge

AboutCompany:
SBI Life Insurance (SBI Life / ‘The Company’), one of the most trusted life insurance companies in India, was incorporated in October 2000 and is registered with the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) in March 2001.
Serving millions of families across India, SBI Life’s diverse range of products caters to individuals as well as group customers through Protection, Pension, Savings and Health solutions.
Driven by ‘Customer-First’ approach, SBI Life places great emphasis on maintaining world class operating efficiency and providing hassle-free claim settlement experience to its customers by following high ethical standards of service. Additionally, SBI Life is committed to enhance digital experiences for its customers, distributors and employees alike.
SBI Life strives to make insurance accessible to all, with its extensive presence across the country through its 1,146 offices, 27,040 employees, a large and productive network of about 253,799 agents, 62 corporate agents and 9 bancassurance partners with more than 41,000 partner branches, 150 brokers and other insurance marketing firms.
In addition to doing what’s right for the customers, the company is also committed to provide a healthy and flexible work environment for its employees to excel personally and professionally.
SBI Life strongly encourages a culture of giving back to the society and has made substantial contribution in the areas of child education, healthcare, disaster relief and environmental upgrade. In 2024-25, the Company touched over 53,000 direct beneficiaries through various CSR interventions.
Listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange ('BSE') and the National Stock Exchange ('NSE'), the company has an authorized capital of Rs. 20.0 billion and a paid-up capital of Rs. 10.0 billion. The AuM is Rs. 4,758.1 billion.

Description:
About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving B2B customer acquisition for PTL vertical. As a sales professional, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.

Key Responsibilities:
New Business Development: Identify and onboard new B2B clients manufacturers, traders, distributors, and retailers who have regular
PTL freight movement needs.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Product, Pricing, and Finance to develop compelling proposals, pilot programs, and commercial models.
Performance Tracking: Own pipeline forecasting, sales performance metrics, and revenue attribution; regularly report to executive leadership on growth performance and strategic initiatives.
Client Success & Retention: Ensure seamless client onboarding, continuous engagement, and upselling of adjacent logistics services such as reverse logistics, express delivery, or value-added services.

Preferred Background & Skills:
1+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.

Description:
Job Purpose

To manage and drive sales through distribution in order to attain market leadership in the given territory, through growth in gross numbers and revenues
Key Result Areas/Accountabilities

Sales
Establish a Best-in-Class distribution footprint and a strong promoter channel where the TSM is supervising promoters
Deliver sales target for all products (voice-prepaid / post-paid, data etc.) by executing the distribution strategy
Help zone and circle achieve Revenue targets by driving secondaries through Mass Retail distribution and by pushing unlimited products penetration
Monitor quality of acquisition through the distribution channel
Competition Tracking & reporting schemes & programs
Ensure availability of stock at retail while adhering to the norms
Execute promotional activities for channel partners to drive sales and build market credibility
Revenue
Achieve zonal revenue target for the distribution channel across all products
Distribution expansion and extraction
Achieve retail (MBO) expansion targets through increase in number of outlets in existing and new geographies
People
DSE Management
Target Setting DSE
DSE Beat Plan adherence
Systems/formats at DSE end
Drive Distribution KPIs delivery
MD/AD/SD Management
DSE Availability monitoring
Monitor Stock holding
Day to day Performance Review & discussions
Problem Solving
Load Out monitoring
Systems/formats at MD point
HSW compliance
Core Competencies, Knowledge, Experience

Good communication skills
Sales Planning & Forecasting
Products Services & Technology Knowledge - Consumer
Leads Decision Making & Delivering Results
Analytical Thinking
Building Team Commitment
Must have technical / professional qualifications

Essential : Graduation - Regular
Desired : post - graduation in business management/MBA
work ex: 1 - 4 years
Experience with distribution planning and channel implementation.

Description:
Job Description: Associate / Senior Associate Used Commercial Vehicle
Finance (Ahmedabad, Baroda, Mumbai (all areas), Pune)
Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our
Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a
minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local
network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting
monthly disbursement targets.
Key Responsibilities & KRAs
• Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement
targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by
the company.
• Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities
through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
• Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used
vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
• Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of
customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
• End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document
collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
• Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in
monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired
portfolios.
Required Qualifications & Skills
• Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used
CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
• Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
• Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle
market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
• Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-
building skills.
• Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for
extensive field travel.

What We Offer
• Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive
structure.
• Travel allowances.
• Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial
institution.

Designation: Senior Interior Designer
Location: Mumbai, Bangalore, Vadodara
Experience: 3 to 6 Years


About Livspace

Livspace is a leading technology-driven home interiors and renovation platform, providing end-to-end interior solutions for homeowners. We combine design, technology, project execution, and customer experience to deliver beautiful and functional homes.
Job Overview
We are looking for an experienced and creative Senior Interior Designer who can independently manage residential interior design projects from concept to final design closure.
The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in space planning, modular interiors, design concepts, client management, and design software, along with the ability to deliver high-quality designs within defined timelines.

Required Skills

Strong knowledge of residential interior design and space planning.
Excellent understanding of modular kitchens, wardrobes, living rooms, bedrooms, and complete home interiors.
Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, 3ds Max/3D visualization tools, and MS Office.
Strong knowledge of materials, finishes, hardware, lighting, and furniture.
Excellent presentation and client-handling skills.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to understand client needs and convert them into practical design solutions.
Strong attention to detail and design aesthetics.
Ability to manage multiple projects and work within deadlines.
Good understanding of design feasibility, execution requirements, and site constraints.
Experience & Qualification

3 to 6 years of relevant experience in residential interior design.
Bachelor's/Diploma degree in Interior Design, Architecture, or a related field.
Candidates with experience in home interiors, modular interiors, design studios, or interior design companies will be preferred.
Strong portfolio demonstrating residential interior design projects is preferred.
AboutCompany: Livspace is Asia's largest and fastest-growing home interiors and renovation platform. Leveraging its proprietary technology, the company delivers end-to-end home interior and renovation solutions, encompassing modular solutions, furniture, false ceilings, soft furnishings, dcor, civil works, and more. The company serves homeowners across diverse market segments in India and Singapore.

Job Location: Bangalore, Vadodara, Chennai

Job Requirements
This position is a mechanical integrity technical position for fixed equipment in support of petrochemical facility
This position provides technical support to the client with a focus on managing the risk based inspection program, troubleshooting, asset improvement, and technology selection
Provide strong technical leadership in Inspection/Corrosion Management for Oil & Gas upstream/downstream assets
Provide technical solution in upstream/downstream Asset Integrity
Has ability to create innovative solutions /automations/ methodologies to build a differentiation for Quest Global
Integrity assessment/assurance activities like FFS, Corrosion Evaluations and Remaining Life Studies
Drive and manage Integrity Engineers to execute the workflows with Quality at scale 
Provide pre-sales support for new business deals and post-sales support for the new projects assigned
Drive core team members to recruit skilled resources or train internal resources to achieve the targets
Act as a bridge between customer, sales organization and global technical teams
Lead Develop, nurture and manage global customer relationships and drive strategic partnering initiatives to address unique business situations and complex technology needs
Review technical scoping, estimation, fitment and feasibility studies, mapping customer expectations and solution design, prepared by Program Managers and Project Leader
Degradation evaluations related to pressure equipment, heat exchangers, piping circuits, fired equipment, flares, above ground storage tanks, and/or pressure relief devices.
Monitoring and surveillance of integrity parameters to ensure reliable operations.
Troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and integrity recommendation stewardship.
Bad actor identification and analysis to reduce equipment downtime.
Data analytics, digital tools/ technologies and operationalize upgraded work practices through digital transformation.
Overall integrity effectiveness and management which includes, criticality assessments, consequence/ complexity rating of fixed equipment, development of fit-for-purpose risk based strategies, setting optimum task intervals including considerations to local regulations/ statutory requirements, timely review of inspection findings, and ever-greening of strategies.
Regional oversight and stewardship of integrity work product metrics for quality, effectiveness, and efficiency in achieving business unit/ manufacturing site objectives.
Work Experience
Engineering degree (Mechanical/Materials or Chemical) 3 to 8 years of oil gas experience in related industry (refining/petrochemical/LNG/oil & gas) 
Should have sound knowledge on Oil & Gas upstream and downstream business in the following areas 
- Risk Based Inspection methodologies 
- Fixed equipment inspection tasks/ procedures 
- Inspection Optimization
- Piping Circutization/TML development 
- API Damage Mechanisms of Refinery/Chemicals 
- In-service inspection of all types of fixed equipment 
- Knowledge of materials and standards 
- Knowledge of corrosion & welding
- Knowledge of NDTs
-Thickness inspection management and analysis
- Corrosion management and analysis
- Inspection plan development/ optimization.
- Knowledge of software (APM Meridium/Pestra/Credo, etc.) 
- Ability to lead teams 
- Excellent communication 
Should have working knowledge of oil and gas plant operations 
Should have exposure to Operating condition Safety, SHE risks, spill/ safety incident and equipment failure opportunities 
Should have Knowledge of various roles and responsibilities of engineers working in the oil and gas field/site 
Should have knowledge of corrective and preventative maintenance strategy 
Should have knowledge of International standards in design, quality, and procedures for approved equipment
Working knowledge in key sections of ASME Sec Div. 1/2, ASME Sec V, ASME Sec IX, ASME Sec Il, ASME B31.3/ B31.1/ B31.4/ B31.8, ASME PCC-2
Field in-service inspection and repair of pressure equipment, heat exchangers, piping systems, pressure relief devices and above ground storage tanks in operating unit
Good to have skills:
Certification and in-depth working knowledge in API 580, API 510, API 570, API 571 , API 653, NACE Senior Corrosion Technologist, BSI ISO/ ENI AS Standards, AWS/ CSWIP/ ASNT NDT Techniques
Experience with Meridium/Credo/Pestra and SAP

Job Description

Are you passionate about building next-generation AI solutions? Join our team to design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge Generative AI applications that drive real business impact.

We are looking for experienced GenAI professionals with strong expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Agent Frameworks, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and MCP (Model Context Protocol).

If you are an immediate joiner and excited about shaping the future of AI, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop enterprise-grade Generative AI applications.
Build Agentic AI solutions using modern agent frameworks.
Develop and optimize RAG-based architectures for intelligent knowledge retrieval.
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems using MCP and related protocols.
Work closely with business and technology teams to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Evaluate, fine-tune, and deploy AI models for production environments.
Ensure AI solutions are secure, scalable, and performance-optimized.

Required Skills
Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Expertise in RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and prompt engineering.
Experience with Agent Frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LangChain, etc.).
Knowledge of Agentic AI concepts and implementations.
Experience with MCP, API integrations, and AI orchestration.
Proficiency in Python and AI/ML development ecosystem.
Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) is an advantage.
Qualification: BE / BTech / MTech / MCA / BCA

Position: Salesforce - Senior SQA Engineer
Position: Salesforce Senior SQA Engineer
Experience: 5+ years
Employment Type: Full-time
Job Summary:
We are seeking a Salesforce Senior SQA Engineer with 5+ years of software testing experience and strong hands-on expertise in Salesforce testing. The candidate will be responsible for validating Salesforce applications, integrations, data flows, and end-to-end business processes while ensuring high-quality releases.
Key Responsibilities:
Design and execute functional, integration, regression, smoke, sanity, and end-to-end test cases.
Test Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Lightning Experience, custom objects, workflows, flows, validation rules, and approval processes.
Perform API, integration, data migration, and database validation testing.
Validate Salesforce roles, profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, and business process configurations.
Log and track defects using Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tools.
Participate in Agile ceremonies, release testing, UAT support, and production validation.
Maintain test documentation, execution reports, and quality metrics.
Required Skills:
5+ years of software QA experience, including strong Salesforce testing experience.
Hands-on experience with Salesforce functional and end-to-end testing.
Knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Lightning, workflows, flows, validation rules, and approval processes.
Experience with API testing tools such as Postman or SoapUI.
Knowledge of SQL, SOQL, data validation, and integration testing.
Experience with test management and defect tracking tools.
Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and CI/CD practices.
Preferred Qualifications:
Salesforce Administrator or Platform Developer certification.
Knowledge of Apex, triggers, Salesforce security, and deployment processes.
Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Time Type: Full time

Description:
Business Function
Corporate and Investment Banking provides corporate customers with a full range of commercial banking products and services, including cash management services, current accounts, time deposits, trade finance, working capital finance, term loans and foreign exchange. Through our continued commitment, DBS has cultivated long-standing relationships with its customers in the region that are based on account relationship management, service differentiation, product development and rigorous credit standards.
Responsibilities
Conduct comprehensive credit analysis of IBG2 clients to assess their creditworthiness and financial standing
Interact with clients to gather relevant information and documentation required for credit assessment
Prepare detailed credit proposals and recommendations for new and existing clients. Collaborate with the Credit team to obtain timely approvals for credit facilities
Support Relationship Managers in achieving their business targets by assisting with annual supervision reviews and arranging credit approvals for new-to-bank clients or new deals
Coordinate with the Trade & Operations team and other stakeholders to ensure timely completion of KYC, documentation requirements etc.
Requirements
Relevant experience in credit analysis or a similar role within the banking industry.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret financial statements and assess credit risk
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact effectively with clients and internal stakeholders
Proficient in using financial analysis tools and software
Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
Education / Preferred Qualifications
An MBA or CA with relevant number of years of experience in Corporate Banking
Core Competencies
Good written and verbal communication skills
Good Analytical skills.
Self-driven and highly ambitious
Results-orientated & the ability to handle pressure
Relationship building & management skills
Understanding of competitor products
Comfortable with tight deadlines
Technical Competencies
Sound understanding of asset products and associated technology platforms and operational procedures
Understanding of regulatory guidelines on banking policies issued by MAS/ RBI/SEBI (local regulations in India) and local laws and regulations that impact businesses in general. Understanding of KYC requirements & Anti-money Laundering Policies are critical.
Knowledge of financial markets, products & competitor offerings to assist in meaningful dialogue with clients
Work Relationship
Close interaction with RMs / Branch Manager to ensure consistent on boarding of good quality customers and thereby assisting in delivery of Sales targets.
Close interaction with various stakeholders to ensure consistent and reliable service delivery to the customer.
DBS India - Culture & Behaviors
DBS is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and their opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working, and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Expected value driven behaviors are:
Demonstrate Business Performance through PRIDE 2.0 Value Based Propositions
Ensure Customer Focus by Delighting Customers & Reduce Complaints
Build Pride and Passion to Protect, Maintain and Enhance DBS Reputation
Enhance Self Knowledge, Skills and develop Competencies aimed at continuous improvement
Maintain the Highest Standards of Honesty and Integrity

Description:
Position: Product Security- Embedded / IoT
Product Security Engineer, Embedded / IoT

Experience: 2 to 10 years

Role Overview
We are looking for product security professionals with hands-on experience in assessing and securing embedded systems and IoT products.
The role involves performing product security assessments, conducting VAPT, developing threat models and security requirements, reviewing security controls, and supporting SSDLC activities. The selected candidate will work closely with hardware, firmware, software, and product engineering teams to identify vulnerabilities, recommend practical mitigations, and validate remediation.
Key Skills
Understanding of embedded product architecture, microcontrollers, processors, bootloaders, memory, storage, and embedded Linux and/or RTOS environments. Ability to interpret hardware block diagrams, relevant schematic sections, and firmware architecture.
Hands-on experience assessing debug, programming, or communication interfaces such as UART, JTAG/SWD, SPI, I C, and USB. Familiarity with device debugging, flash access, firmware acquisition, and evaluation of debug and readout protections.
Experience with firmware extraction or acquisition, unpacking, filesystem analysis, configuration review, and static and/or dynamic analysis. Ability to identify hardcoded credentials, exposed secrets, insecure services, weak permissions, vulnerable components, and weaknesses in firmware update mechanisms.
Experience conducting manual and tool-assisted security testing of physical devices, firmware, and exposed interfaces. Ability to validate vulnerabilities, distinguish false positives, demonstrate impact safely, and recommend relevant remediation.
Working knowledge of threat modeling, attack-surface analysis, security risk assessment, product security requirements, secure design review, and security validation. Understanding of assets, data flows, trust boundaries, attack scenarios, and requirement-to-test traceability.
Understanding of secure boot, firmware signing, secure OTA updates, rollback protection, authentication, authorization, cryptographic key storage, certificate management, secure communications, and production security configuration.
Knowledge of TCP/IP and relevant embedded or IoT interfaces and protocols, such as Ethernet, Wi-Fi, BLE, CAN, MQTT, HTTP(S), and TLS. Experience capturing and analyzing traffic and assessing communication security.
Ability to understand C/C++ code and develop or modify Python or shell scripts.
Experience with relevant tools such as Ghidra or IDA, Binwalk, GDB, OpenOCD, Wireshark, Nmap, flash programmers, debug probes, and logic analyzers.
Familiarity with SAST, SCA, and Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) analysis.
Job Responsibilities
Review product architecture, hardware and firmware designs, interfaces, deployment environments, and use cases to identify assets, attack surfaces, trust boundaries, and security risks.
Plan and execute hardware and firmware VAPT using black-box, grey-box, or white-box approaches, as applicable. Assess physical access, debug interfaces, firmware, operating-system configuration, services, communication interfaces, and device management interfaces.
Perform firmware analysis, binary analysis, reverse engineering, and security-focused source code reviews where applicable. Investigate vulnerabilities and document reproducible evidence, root causes, and product impact.
Develop and maintain threat models, security risk assessments, product security requirements, security test plans, test cases, and traceability records throughout the product lifecycle.
Review and validate security controls, including secure boot, signed firmware updates, rollback protection, credential handling, access control, secure communications, and debug restrictions.
Execute or review SAST, SCA, and firmware/binary scanning results. Analyze SBOMs, assess vulnerability applicability, eliminate false positives, and prioritize findings based on exploitability, exposure, and product impact.
Prepare technical reports with findings, evidence, risk ratings, and actionable remediation recommendations. Collaborate with engineering teams, verify fixes, and document residual risks.
Develop reusable testing scripts, procedures, and checklists. Support security activities within development and release workflows and assess newly disclosed vulnerabilities affecting supported products.
Location: IN-GJ-Ahmedabad, India-Ognaj (eInfochips)
Time Type: Full time
Job Category: Engineering Services

Description:
Position: Senior DevOps Engineer - Azure
Key Responsibilities
Work closely with Cloud Architects, Solution Architects, Developers, SRE, and Engineering teams to design and implement Azure infrastructure solutions for products and services.
Design, deploy, and maintain Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure, ensuring scalability, security, reliability, performance, and operational supportability.
Create and maintain infrastructure architecture diagrams, technical documentation, deployment guides, and operational runbooks for Azure environments.
Develop, automate, and test end-to-end cloud infrastructure provisioning and deployment using Infrastructure as Code and configuration-management tools.
Implement infrastructure automation using Terraform, PowerShell, Bash, and Python, including automated provisioning, configuration, scaling, and operational tasks.
Design and optimize Azure networking and cloud connectivity, including VNets, Subnets, NSGs, Route Tables, Load Balancers, Application Gateway, Private Endpoints, VPN, DNS, and Firewall.
Deploy and manage Kubernetes/AKS and containerized workloads, including cluster configuration, application deployment, scaling, networking, and troubleshooting.
Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated application and infrastructure deployments using Azure DevOps or equivalent tools.
Develop and enhance infrastructure architecture, performance optimization, capacity planning, high availability, and disaster recovery solutions to support 99.9%+ uptime.
Implement monitoring and observability using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Prometheus, and Grafana to proactively identify infrastructure and application issues.
Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to develop new technology initiatives focused on availability, scalability, security, performance, automation, and supportability.
Troubleshoot complex Azure, Kubernetes, networking, Linux, Windows, and CI/CD issues and participate in root-cause analysis and production support.
Establish and enforce cloud, DevOps, security, infrastructure, and automation best practices across environments.
Stay current with emerging Azure, DevOps, Kubernetes, automation, security, and cloud-native technologies and continuously improve technical capabilities.
Establish and maintain effective working relationships across Architecture, Engineering, Development, Security, QA, Operations, and Product teams.
Prepare and deliver weekly technical updates and presentations on completed work, infrastructure improvements, automation initiatives, and technical solutions to senior team members and team leads.
YOU MUST HAVE
Bachelors degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
4+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, testing, and supporting Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure.
Strong hands-on experience with Azure services, networking, compute, storage, identity, security, and monitoring.
Proficiency in Terraform, PowerShell, Bash, and Python for infrastructure automation and scripting.
Strong understanding of Azure networking and cloud connectivity, including VNet, Subnets, NSGs, Routing, VPN, DNS, Load Balancer, Firewall, and Private Endpoints.
Strong experience with Linux and Windows system administration, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and best practices.
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and preferably Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
Strong experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, preferably using Azure DevOps.
Experience with Docker and containerized application deployments.
Understanding of cloud security, RBAC, Managed Identity, Key Vault, secrets management, and secure infrastructure practices.
Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent monitoring/observability platforms.
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
Location: IN-GJ-Ahmedabad, India-Ognaj (eInfochips)
Time Type: Full time
Job Category: Engineering Services

Description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting monthly disbursement targets.

Key Responsibilities & KRAs

Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by the company.
Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired portfolios.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-building skills.
Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for extensive field travel.

What We Offer
Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive structure.
Travel allowances.
Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial institution.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

AWS DevOps Engineer - Mobile CI/CD
o Design, implementation, and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines for mobile application build automation using Jenkins and Bitrise.

o Troubleshoot and optimize CI/CD pipelines, build environments, dependencies, and release processes to improve reliability and build performance.
o Provide technical leadership, establish DevOps/DevSecOps best practices, and collaborate with development, QA, security, and architecture teams to continuously improve the mobile software delivery process.

Description:
Dear Candidate,
Looking to build something meaningful for Indias MSMEs? Join Tata nexarc, a digital-first B2B platform from the house of Tata, as our Cluster Sales Manager Steel.

Role - Cluster Sales Manager Steel
Experience: 5+ years | Location: Ahmedabad and Bangalore

About the role:
Tata nexarc serves MSMEs with raw material procurement, credit and logistics solutions. We are looking for a self-driven Steel expert to generate demand and build our procurement business from the ground up in a defined cluster.
Key Responsibilities:
Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets (number of clients and GMV) for your cluster.
Drive the sales funnel, acquire new SMB customers, and represent Tata nexarc at industry forums.
Work with cross-functional teams to keep operations smooth for acquired customers and to retain them.
Track steel pricing and market conditions, and share pricing and product availability with customers.
Handle lead pickup, negotiations and payment follow-ups.

Desired Candidate Profile:
Graduate or BE (Civil/Mechanical); MBA preferred.
5+ years in B2B business development, sales or account management, with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets.
Experience selling steel (fabricated structures, TMT bars, coils or related products).
Experience with CRM, data analytics and BI tools; MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Strong communication skills and full professional proficiency in the regional language.
An entrepreneurial mindset, ideally with startup experience.

Why Join Us:
Join a start-up from the house of Tata. Build the India Stack with a nation-first vision of uplifting SMEs, in a fast-paced culture built on Integrity, Pioneering, Unity, Responsibility and Excellence. You get high autonomy through agile cross-functional teams, and you will work on SME-focused products. Benefits include need-based health, wellness and childcare leaves, Tata group employee benefits, and medical, term life and personal accident insurance.

Skills: Steel Sales, B2B Sales, Business Development, Account Management, TMT Bars, MSME, CRM, Negotiation

If this sounds like you, apply now and be part of the Tata nexarc journey.

Description:
Walk-In Drive for Freshers - Supply Chain Apprenticeship Program on 21st November 2026 @ Ahmedabad

Launch Your Career with Zydus. Zydus Lifesciences is inviting applications from dynamic and enthusiastic fresh graduates for its 1-Year Supply Chain Apprenticeship Program within the Global Demand & Supply Organization (GDSO) at the Corporate Office, Ahmedabad.

Walk-In Interview Details
Date: Saturday, 21 November 2026
Location: Zydus Corporate Office, Ahmedabad
Time: 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM

This apprenticeship program offers an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on corporate experience and exposure to various Supply Chain functions while working with experienced professionals in a leading global pharmaceutical organization. Candidates will be assigned to different areas within the Supply Chain function based on business requirements and organizational needs.

Key Responsibilities
Support day-to-day Supply Chain and business operations.
Assist in data analysis, reporting, and process coordination activities.
Work on projects related to planning, inventory management, demand forecasting, logistics, and operational excellence.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support business objectives.
Participate in process improvement and continuous improvement initiatives.
Develop professional and business acumen through practical corporate exposure.


Eligibility & Stipend
B.Pharm (Freshers)
Apprenticeship Stipend: 17,000 per month
B.Tech - Industrial Engineering (Freshers)
Apprenticeship Stipend: 23,000 per month
B.Tech - Mechanical Engineering (Freshers)
Apprenticeship Stipend: 23,000 per month

About the Program
The Supply Chain Apprenticeship Program is designed to provide fresh graduates with practical industry exposure and a strong foundation in Supply Chain Management. Apprentices will have the opportunity to work on real business challenges, understand corporate processes, and contribute to various strategic and operational initiatives within the organization.
This program provides an environment that encourages learning, professional development, and exposure to best practices followed in a global business setting.

Note:
Fresh graduates from the 2024, 2025, and 2026 pass-out batches are eligible to apply.
Candidates from Ahmedabad and nearby locations will be preferred considering the work location and ease of participation in the apprenticeship program.
AboutCompany:
Zydus MedTech is the WOS of Zydus Lifesciences, focused on transforming healthcare through innovative medical technologies. With a legacy of over 70 years, Zydus group has established its presence in more than 85 countries.
At Zydus MedTech, our manufacturing is built on precision, quality, and sustainability. Our state-of-the-art facilities, ISO 13485-certified and equipped with advanced automation, ensure seamless production of next-generation medical technologies. Within our clean rooms where the highest sterility standards prevail-every product is forged with integrity, safeguarding patient safety and redefining reliability.
Zydus Lifesciences Limited (Formerly known as Cadila Healthcare Limited), a leading Indian Pharmaceutical company is a fully integrated, global healthcare provider. With in-depth domain expertise in the field of healthcare, it has strong capabilities across the spectrum of the pharmaceutical value chain. From formulations to active pharmaceutical ingredients and animal healthcare products to wellness products, Zydus has earned a reputation amongst Indian pharmaceutical companies for providing comprehensive and complete healthcare solutions.
One of the salient features of Zydus is its rich history and lineage. The origin of the company dates all the way back to the 1950s. The company was founded in the year 1952 by Mr. Ramanbhai B. Patel (late), a first-generation entrepreneur and a doyen in the field of Indian Pharmaceuticals.
In 1995, the group was restructured and thus was formed Cadila Healthcare under the aegis of the Zydus group. From a humble turnover Rs. 250 crores in 1995 the group witnessed a significant financial growth and registered a turnover of over Rs. 17,000 crores in FY-21.
Adhering to its brand promise of being dedicated to life in all its dimensions, Zydus continues to innovate with an unswerving focus to address the unmet healthcare needs. Simultaneously it rededicates itself to its mission of creating healthier, happier communities across the globe.

Description:
Job Summary
The opportunity: Consultant-AMI-Business Consulting Risk-CNS - Risk - Process & Controls - Ahmedabad
The Advanced Manufacturing, Mobility & Infrastructure (AMI) Industry Market contains the following industries: Aerospace and Defence, Chemicals, Infrastructure, Industrial Products, Automotive, and Transportation that includes Mobility-as-a-Service. We help our clients to address the rapidly changing needs of our business world on not only how goods and services are bought and sold, but also on how they are designed and created. AMI builds and shares resources across sectors facing common challenges and aims to drive more effective cross-sector collaboration while enabling greater resource-pooling and developing more cohesive market responses. AMI also presents an opportunity to connect regional sector communities with a more robust, global priority sector infrastructure.
CNS - Risk - Process & Controls :
EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls
Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.
Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.
Your key responsibilities
Demonstrated expertise in planning and executing internal audits and process reviews independently, with a clear understanding of audit methodology and documentation standards. Strong working knowledge of internal controls design, testing, and evaluation to identify control gaps and recommend effective remediation. Proficient in risk management frameworks and techniques for assessing process and operational risks within business environments. Skilled in using Microsoft Office tools such as Excel for audit data analysis, workpaper preparation, and reporting. Proven ability to deliver clear presentations and monitor the execution quality of team members' audit and process review deliverables.
Skills and qualifications To qualify for the role you must have
Master of Business Administration
Chartered Accountant
Experience
2 to 4 years
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it's your career and it's yours to build which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
The opportunity
Consultant-National-Tax-Tax - ITTS - Advisory - Ahmedabad
National comprises of sector agnostic teams working across industries for a well rounded experience.
TAX - ITTS - Advisory :
Our globally coordinated tax professionals offer connected services across all tax disciplines to help the clients thrive in an era of rapid change. We combine our exceptional knowledge and experience with the people and technology platforms to equip clients in making better business decisions by bringing insights to the forefront. We help companies understand the tax policies and tax laws of governments around the world to plan and comply accordingly. Our teams leverage transformative technologies to deliver strategy and execution, from tax and regulatory obligations to operations and workforce management, to reduce risk and drive sustainable value.
We have competencies in Business Tax Services, Global Compliance and Reporting, Global Law, Indirect Tax, International Tax and Transaction Services.
Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence
Demonstrated expertise in advising on transaction tax matters across domestic and cross-border deal structures. Strong working knowledge of M&A tax considerations, including structuring, due diligence, and post-deal tax integration. Proficient in analyzing tax implications of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and restructuring transactions. Experienced in preparing tax analyses, memoranda, and advisory deliverables that support transaction decision-making. Proven ability to apply general consulting methodologies to translate complex tax regulations into practical, client-ready recommendations.
To qualify for the role you must have
CA
Experience
1+ Years
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
Job Summary
The objective of our advisory risk services is to provide clients with a candid and reliable overview of their risk landscape. Our solutions can be used by our clients to build confidence and trust with their customers, the overall market and when required by regulation or contract. You will be responsible for executing client related engagements in the areas of governance, risk & compliance (GRC), internal audits, process reviews, standard operating procedures, enterprise risk management, revenue assurance.
Your responsibilities
Execution on client engagement. Ensure quality delivery as per client requirements.
Review of working papers and client folders. Suggest ideas on improving engagement productivity and identify opportunities for improving client service.
Understand business & industry issues / trends. Identify areas requiring improvement in the client's business processes to enable preparation of recommendations.
Handling data analytics - Access, ACL etc.
Ensure compliance with engagement plans and internal quality & risk management procedures.
Awareness of internal auditing standards issued by IIA and ICAI.
Demonstrate an application & solution-based approach to problem solving technique.
Manage the engagement budgets and support superiors in developing marketing collaterals, business proposals and new solution / methodology development.
Develop strong working relationships with client (process owner/functional heads).
Attention to detail and mentor young interns and analysts within the practice.
Contribute to knowledge management sessions within the practice.
Skills and attributes for success
Determine that the work delivered is of high quality.
Anticipate and identify engagement related risks and escalate issues as appropriate.
Actively establish client (process owner/functional heads) and internal relationships.
Assist and share knowledge with team members, seniors and managers in developing new methodologies and internal initiatives and participate in performing procedures especially focusing on complex, judgmental and/or specialized issues.
Work with the team and the client to create plans for accomplishing engagement objectives and a strategy that complies with professional standards and advise clients to understand and manage their business risks and verify the validity of their business information.
Brief the engagement team on the client's IA environment and industry IA trends. Maintain relationships with client management to manage expectations of service, including work products, timing, and deliverables. Demonstrate a thorough understanding of compliance, financial, and operational risks along with performing internal control testing, develop internal audit plans, and provide internal audit services on an outsourcing basis. Assess internal controls and SOX framework in order to mitigate risk and apply it to client situations.
Bring and utilize extensive knowledge of the client's business/industry to identify technological developments and evaluate impacts on the client's business. Demonstrate excellent project management skills, inspire teamwork and responsibility with engagement team members, and use current technology/tools to enhance the effectiveness of deliverables and services.
Understand EY and its service lines and actively assess what the firm can deliver to serve clients.
Qualifications / Requirements
Chartered Accountant / Certified Internal Auditor or have a Masters degree in Business Administration.
0-1 year of post-qualification experience in risk advisory, related internal audit experience or external audit experience.
Available to travel outside of the assigned office location at least 50% of the time.

Description:
Job Title: Team Leader - HNI Dealing - Branch Broking

Company Name: Bajaj Broking

Job Description
As a Team Leader - Branch Broking, you will be responsible for driving individual business performance as well as leading the branch dealing team to achieve overall business objectives. The role involves managing your own HNI client portfolio, generating revenue through client acquisition and trading activities, and simultaneously guiding the team to achieve their respective targets.

You will be accountable for individual revenue generation, team productivity, client acquisition, retention, and overall business growth while ensuring superior client servicing, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities
Lead, motivate, and manage the team to achieve overall business and revenue targets.
Drive team-level revenue generation, client acquisition, activation, and retention.
Monitor individual team members' performance and ensure achievement of assigned targets.
Support team members in acquiring new clients, increasing client engagement, and improving revenue productivity.
Oversee trading activities across equity, derivatives, Nifty, and stock options.
Ensure timely sharing of stock, sector, and market updates with clients.
Handle key HNI relationships and resolve escalated client queries.
Conduct regular performance reviews, provide coaching, and develop team capabilities.
Coordinate with research and internal teams to provide relevant investment insights and strategies.
Ensure accurate trade execution, documentation, and adherence to regulatory and internal compliance requirements.
Track individual and team performance through regular business reviews and reporting.
Identify opportunities to improve revenue, operational efficiency, and overall client experience.
Coordinate with Branch and Regional leadership to achieve business objectives.
Achieve assigned individual revenue targets through HNI client acquisition, relationship management, and trading activities.

Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA will be an added advantage.
Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in dealing, sales, or business development within the financial services industry, preferably with exposure to HNI clients.
Prior experience in team handling or a supervisory role will be preferred.
Strong knowledge of financial markets, equity, derivatives, and investment products.
Strong leadership, communication, relationship management, and people-management skills.
NISM Series VIII Certification is mandatory.
