Solutions (GPS) | Buying Desk - Global Technology Category Location Band Role Type Shift Kraft Heinz India GCC - Ahmedabad or Bangalore B13 Individual Contributor North America-aligned / night shift support required CRITICAL EXPERIENCE 10+ years in procurement, including 5-7 years specifically in IT Procurement Role Summary The Strategic Buyer - Global Technology (Indirect) leads complex, end-to-end strategic sourcing initiatives of up to USD 15 million across global technology categories within the Global Procurement Solutions organization. The role requires strong commercial acumen, deep expertise in technology sourcing, and the ability to structure and negotiate complex, multi-year agreements that deliver measurable business value. Operating as a senior individual contributor, this role partners with Director and VP-level stakeholders across North America, Europe, and APAC to shape demand, influence sourcing strategies, and drive optimal commercial outcomes. The role is accountable for sourcing excellence, procurement governance, contract compliance, and continuous improvement across the source-to-pay lifecycle. The successful candidate must bring hands-on expertise in SaaS agreements, supplier redlines, and complex IT services negotiations, working closely with Legal and cross-functional stakeholders to achieve successful contracting outcomes. Page 1 Kraft Heinz India GCC | Global Procurement Solutions Key Responsibilities 1. Strategic Sourcing & Project Delivery Lead end-to-end sourcing projects of up to USD 15 million across SaaS, enterprise software, cloud, telecom, managed services, and IT services. Develop sourcing strategies covering supplier segmentation, RFx design, commercial structures, TCO and cost models, negotiation plans, communications, and award recommendations. Conduct market analysis, benchmarking, and cost modelling to identify value levers, savings, and cost-avoidance opportunities. Own complex sourcing initiatives aligned with business priorities, procurement KPIs, and committed outcomes. 2. Contract Negotiation & Commercial Management Lead complex negotiations for SaaS subscriptions, software licensing, cloud services, managed services, telecom, and IT professional services. Review supplier contractual redlines and collaborate with Legal, Information Security, Finance, IT, and business stakeholders to resolve issues and drive agreements to closure. Structure agreements to optimize pricing, service levels, contractual protections, risk allocation, and long-term value. Manage contract lifecycle activities including drafting, negotiation, validation, execution, renewals, amendments, Statements of Work, and Change Requests. Clearly articulate negotiation strategy, tactics deployed, stakeholder alignment, and measurable commercial outcomes. 3. Procurement Compliance & Governance Own and enforce compliance with sourcing policies, approval thresholds, controls, and governance frameworks. Ensure correct usage of procurement tools, approved workflows, and standardized processes, including SAP Ariba and ServiceNow. Act as an escalation point for contract compliance and ensure contracts accurately reflect approved commercial and legal positions. Perform compliance checks across SOW, CR, Purchase Request, and Sourcing Request processes and maintain audit-ready documentation. Partner with Finance, Accounting, Legal, Security, IT, and Audit teams to protect governance integrity and mitigate risk. Page 2 Kraft Heinz India GCC | Global Procurement Solutions 4. Supplier & Contract Management Lead supplier evaluation, selection, onboarding, and performance management based on category strategy and defined criteria. Drive supplier consolidation, innovation, performance improvement, cost efficiency, and long-term value creation. Manage supplier risks using structured governance, KPIs, scorecards, and quarterly business reviews. Build strategic partnerships with global suppliers across North America, Europe, and other relevant geographies. 5. Value Creation & Continuous Improvement Identify and implement improvements across sourcing and procurement operations. Drive demand optimization, supplier rationalization, AI-enabled sourcing, RFx optimization, and intake workflow automation. Develop reusable sourcing frameworks, templates, playbooks, and best practices. Support procurement transformation and maturity-building initiatives within the GCC. 6. Stakeholder Management Advise and influence global stakeholders and category leads to shape sourcing strategies and optimize outcomes. Collaborate with Category Managers, Finance, Legal, IT Directors and VPs, Information Security, and business teams across geographies. Align sourcing activity with broader category, regional, and enterprise objectives. Operate effectively across time zones, particularly with North American and European stakeholders. 7. Mentorship & Team Support Act as a senior mentor and knowledge leader within the Buying Desk. Guide junior team members on complex sourcing events, negotiations, contracting challenges, and problem-solving. Drive knowledge sharing, capability development, and procurement upskilling initiatives. Page 4 Kraft Heinz India GCC | Global Procurement Solutions Qualifications & Experience 10+ years of experience in procurement and strategic sourcing. 5-7 years of direct IT Procurement experience across SaaS, software, cloud, telecom, managed services, or IT professional services. SAP ABAP S/4 HANA Consultant/Developer

Location:
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli (Hybrid)

Experience:
JL4: 2-5 Years
JL5: 5-9 Years


About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP ABAP S/4HANA Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, enhancing, and supporting SAP ABAP applications in S/4HANA environments.
The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in ABAP Development, RICEF Objects, Adobe Forms, Smart Forms, BAPI, BADI, Enhancements, Reports, Interfaces, and S/4HANA development frameworks. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, upgrade, and support projects is highly preferred.

Roles & Responsibilities
Develop and enhance SAP ABAP programs based on business requirements.
Design and build RICEF objects including Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, and Forms.
Develop Adobe Forms, Smart Forms, SAP Scripts, and Interactive Forms.
Create and enhance BAPIs, BADIs, User Exits, Customer Exits, and Enhancement Framework objects.
Design and develop ALV Reports, Classical Reports, and Interactive Reports.
Work with Functional Consultants to understand and translate business requirements.
Analyze and optimize existing ABAP programs for performance improvement.
Develop inbound and outbound interfaces using IDoc, RFC, Web Services, and APIs.
Support S/4HANA migration and custom code remediation activities.
Prepare Technical Specifications and Design Documents.
Conduct Unit Testing, SIT, UAT, and Production Support activities.
Resolve production incidents within SLA timelines.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support projects.
Collaborate with cross-functional SAP teams during project delivery.
Ensure adherence to development standards and best practices.

Qualifications

B.E / B.Tech / MCA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP ABAP and S/4 Hana experience for JL4.
Minimum 5 years of SAP ABAP experience for JL5.
Strong understanding of SAP technical architecture and development lifecycle.

SAP ABAP

Your Job Profile

Lead SAP AD (Mainly new world SAP S/4) deals with global scope (5 to 15 M Euros), take end to end responsibility of entire SAP Solutioning, bid response by putting together and working with a solution team/SMEs.
Appropriately position and promote Capgeminis SAP offers/assets in the opportunity context, by working closely with customer.
Drive the solution strategy by working with account team/sales/partners and shape the deals in tune with the competitive scenario, client priorities, technology suitability/viability with Support from subject matter experts
Deep expertise in Planning and Estimating different types of SAP Business Transformation solutions
Drive pre-sales activities, including bid responses, RFPs, and client presentations.
Leading the S/4HANA RISE adoption initiatives in the context of Digital Transformation in the customersjourney, clearly demonstrating the business value.
Drive next-generation SAP innovations on BTP, including GenAI, Joule, Signavio, and Line-of-Business solutions, to accelerate digital transformation
Drive innovation/transformation agenda in large existing accounts, provide delivery and solution assurance
Drive SAP competency agenda and ideate new innovative solutions/PoCs/PoV''s
Provide expert support to various projects and delivery engagements
Guide, develop, mentor a team of architects and continuously drive Solutioning capability enhancement /improvement /industrialization /reusability /automation



Your Role

Should have 10+ years of SAP exp, deep routed knowledge in area of expertise at least one R2R, O2C, P2P, SCM etc. and good SAP Solution Integration knowledge, should have worked in pre-sales.
Pre-sales solution architect having experience in leading large strategic deals (>10ME) centered around SAP. Understanding business requirements and designing solutions along with estimation, costing and commercial offers to global customers.
Strong hands-on experience in any one of the SAP core modules e.g FICO, P2P, O2C, SCM, Technical streams (5 to 7 yrs), Delivery Management experience in SAP AD implementation projects (5 to 7 yrs.) in customer-facing roles with good industry insight.
Experience in leading SAP projects in the AD side 5 M to 15 M Euros,
Expert understanding of overall process of implementation, migration, upgrade including sizing, architecture, configuration, management and day to day operation of SAP S/4HANA environment.
Broad understanding across functional areas / in-depth process knowledge in one area. Industry knowledge/sector knowhow in Manufacturing/Retail/CPG/Life sciences/Automotive/Utilities
Understands how business works, can articulate in business language and can translate solution/technology propositions into business value
Experience in integrating SAP ERP solutions across other ERPs/SAP solutions
Experienced in a multi-cultural, multi-location distributed global delivery setup.
Excellent communication skill in English and being articulative is a must
Experienced in client interactions at Senior Level CIO, Program managers and Business process owners
Very good capabilities and experience in people management and stake holder management.
Experience in representing the practice/organization in industry events/forums
Ability and willingness to travel extensively for client workshops and deal shaping

Excellent communication skills and attention to detail.

jaro education
Job Description & Candidate Preparation Guide
Career Development Ocer (CDO)
1. About Jaro Education
Jaro Education is India's most trusted online higher education company and a pioneer in the executive
and online education industry. Founded in 2009 by Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe, the company has been self-
funded and protable since inception. Jaro Education has been honored with the EdTech Leadership
Award and recognized as a National Best Employer by the World HRD Congress.
Jaro Education bridges the gap between top-tier global academic institutions and ambitious
professionals. The organization nurtures entrepreneurs and working executives across entry-level to C-
Suite roles through strategic aliations with globally renowned universities and business schools,
including:
IIMs: IIM Ahmedabad, IIM Indore, IIM Kozhikode, IIM Mumbai, IIM Nagpur, IIM Tiruchirappalli,
IIM Visakhapatnam
IITs and IIT-linked institutions: IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Jammu, IIT Palakkad, IIT Roorkee,
E&ICT Academy IIT Kanpur, E&ICT Academy IIT Guwahati, IITM Pravartak IIT Madras
Technology Innovation Hub
Other premier Indian institutions: IISc, XLRI, IMT Ghaziabad, Loyola Institute of Business
Administration (LIBA), IFEEL Institute for Future Education, Entrepreneurship and Leadership,
MIT Institute of Design / MIT IDSS, Niranjan Hiranandani School of Real Estate & HSNC University
Indian Universities and Higher Education Partners: Adani Institute of Digital Technology
Management, Amity University, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Bharati Vidyapeeth / BVDU,
Chandigarh University, Dayananda Sagar University (Bengaluru), Dr. D. Y. Patil Vidyapeeth
Centre for Online Learning (DPU-COL, Pune), Dr. M.G.R. Educational and Research Institute, JAIN
Online, MAHE Manipal Academy of Higher Education, Manipal University, Manipal University
Jaipur, Parul University, Sikkim Manipal University, Symbiosis International (Deemed University) /
SSODL
Global Academic and Executive Education Partners: Deakin University (Australia) & KPMG
in India, Harvard Business Impact, Imperial College Business School Executive Education, Rotman
School of Management (University of Toronto) & IITM Pravartak, Wharton Interactive
Company Vision: To be globally recognized for providing a seamless learning platform for professionals
around the world.
Page 1 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
Company Mission: To make high-quality, outcome-oriented executive education accessible to every
student and professional at all stages of their career.
2. Role Overview & Snapshot
The Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist plays a critical role in driving
business growth by engaging with working executives, assessing their career goals, and counseling them
on higher education options. This is an end-to-end sales and counseling role that combines lead
generation, relationship building, and consultative program matching.
Designation
Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist
Admissions & Executive Education Sales
Department
Target Audience
Working Days
Working Professionals, Corporate Executives & Freshers
Monday to Saturday (Sunday Weekly-O)
10:00 AM to 7:00 PM (Note: Shift may stretch basis business
requirements)
Working Hours
Dress Code
Mon Fri: Business Formals | Saturday: Smart Casuals
Primary CRM Tool
LeadSquared
3. Key Responsibilities & Performance Expectations
High-Volume Lead Outreach & Prospecting
¢ Connect daily with a minimum of 80 working professionals sourced from the LeadSquared CRM
database to build a healthy sales pipeline.
¢ Initiate conversations using cold-calling and warm lead nurture strategies, establishing rapid rapport
with high-potential prospects.
Consultative Counseling & Needs Analysis
¢ Analyze candidate professional backgrounds, current skills, domain expertise, and future career
aspirations.
¢ Identify skill gaps and recommend optimal executive programs, degree courses, diplomas, or
certications from Jaros university partners.
¢ Conduct structured telephonic, virtual, or in-person counseling sessions detailing curriculum
highlights, faculty credentials, learning methodologies, and career outcomes.
Page 2 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
End-to-End Sales Execution & Enrolment
¢ Guide prospects through the complete sales funnelfrom cold calling to lead nurturing, objection
handling, fee negotiation, and nal enrolment closures.
¢ Maintain consistent, personalized follow-up schedules with high-intent leads to maximize conversion
rates.
¢ Meet or exceed assigned daily activity deliverables, weekly conversion targets, and monthly revenue
metrics.
Operations & Data Management
¢ Maintain accurate, real-time records of lead statuses, meeting notes, follow-up dates, and payment
stages in LeadSquared.
¢ Coordinate closely with internal Admissions, Student Support, and Operations teams to ensure a
seamless onboarding experience for enrolled learners.
¢ Stay up-to-date with evolving EdTech trends, institutional accreditation updates, and competitor
oerings.
4. Candidate Prole & Prerequisites
¢ Education & Experience: Bachelors degree in any discipline. Freshers with exceptional
communication skills or candidates with prior sales/EdTech outreach experience are preferred.
¢ Communication Skills: Fluency in English with strong verbal, written, and persuasive articulation
capabilities.
¢ Sales Mindset: High competitive drive, negotiation skills, objection-handling capability, and comfort
working in target-driven environments.
¢ Interpersonal Skills: Empathy, active listening, and the ability to build immediate rapport with mid-to-
senior working professionals.
¢ Technical Savvy: Basic familiarity with Microsoft Oce (Excel, Word) and CRM applications like
LeadSquared.
5. Career Growth Pathway
¢ Structured Career Path: Opportunities to transition from CDO to Senior CDO, Team Leader,
Assistant Manager, and Business Manager based on performance and target achievements.
Page 3 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
Interview Preparation Kit
Please review the following instructions and preparation guidelines before attending your interview with
Jaro Education.
A. General Interview Hygiene & Rules
1. Professional Appearance: Dress in business formals (MonFri style) to demonstrate
professionalism.
2. Technical Setup: Ensure a stable high-speed internet connection, functional camera/microphone,
and a silent, distraction-free environment for virtual meetings.
3. Communication Delivery: Keep answers crisp, structured, and focused. Avoid lengthy anecdotes
or o-topic details.
4. Energy & Condence: Demonstrate high energy, enthusiasm, and articulate speech throughout
the conversation.
5. Past Employer Etiquette: Maintain a strictly positive, objective, and factual approach when
discussing previous employers. Do not speak negatively about former companies or colleagues.
B. Fundamental Concepts to Master
1. What is EdTech?
Denition: EdTech (Educational Technology) refers to the integration of technology, software, and
hardware tools into educational processes to enhance learning accessibility, engagement, and
eectiveness.
Industry Context: Explain why online higher executive education is essential todayallowing
working professionals to upskill without pausing their full-time careers.
2. What is Consultative Selling?
Denition: A sales approach focused on prioritizing the buyer's needs, challenges, and goals rather
than aggressively pushing a product.
Application at Jaro Education: As a CDO, you do not simply "sell a course." You rst identify a
professionals career bottlenecks, understand their skill gaps, and then recommend the specic
executive program that aligns with their career growth.
Page 4 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
C. Sample Interview Questions & Preparation Strategies
Important Note: Interview questions may change from person to person depending on individual
candidate proles and interviewer evaluation. The questions below are representative FAQ example
types to aid your preparation.
¢ "Walk me through your resume and key achievements."
Tip: Focus on your outreach metrics, target achievements, past sales/counseling experience, and
everyday responsibilities.
¢ "Why do you want to build a career in the EdTech industry?"
Tip: Highlight the rapid growth of the online education sector, your passion for career counseling, and
the impact of upskilling working professionals.
¢ "How do you handle a candidate who says the program fee is too high?"
Tip: Demonstrate consultative sellingreframe the fee as a long-term career investment, highlight the
prestige of partner institutes (e.g., IIMs, IITs, Wharton Interactive, Harvard Business Impact), and
discuss nancial exibility (EMIs, loan support).
¢ "What is your reason for leaving your current/previous role?"
Tip: Provide an honest, professional, and growth-oriented answer (e.g., seeking better exposure,
career progression, or entry into the EdTech industry).
¢ "How do you explain gaps in your career (if applicable)?"
Tip: Be transparent, condent, and concise. Explain how you utilized the gap period productively
(certications, skill-building, personal responsibilities).
D. Quick Checklist Before Joining the Interview
Researched Jaro Educations company background, leadership (Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe), vision, and
mission.

Memorized key partner institutions across categories (e.g., IIMs, IITs, IISc, XLRI, Wharton Interactive,
Harvard Business Impact).

Prepared to explain past key performance indicators (KPIs), call targets, and sales achievements.

Reviewed the core denition of Consultative Selling and EdTech.

Dressed in crisp business formal attire.

All the best for your interview!

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a talented Java Full Stack Developer with strong experience in Java, Angular, and React to design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications. The ideal candidate will have expertise in both backend and frontend technologies, a strong understanding of software development best practices, and experience working in Agile environments.
Key Responsibilities
Backend Development
Design, develop, and maintain scalable RESTful APIs and microservices using Java.
Build enterprise-grade applications using Spring Boot and Spring Framework.
Develop secure and high-performance backend services.
Integrate applications with databases, third-party APIs, and cloud services.
Perform unit testing, code reviews, and performance optimization.
Frontend Development
Develop responsive and user-friendly web applications using Angular and React.
Build reusable UI components and implement modern frontend architectures.
Collaborate with UX/UI designers to deliver seamless user experiences.
Ensure cross-browser compatibility and responsive design principles.
Full Stack Responsibilities
Participate in requirement analysis, design discussions, and technical estimations.
Develop end-to-end solutions across frontend and backend layers.
Troubleshoot production issues and implement fixes.
Collaborate with DevOps teams for deployment and release management.
Follow coding standards, security guidelines, and best practices.
Required Technical Skills
Backend
Java 8/11/17+
Spring Boot
Spring MVC
Spring Security
Hibernate / JPA
REST APIs
Microservices Architecture
Frontend
Angular (8+)
React.js
TypeScript
JavaScript (ES6+)
HTML5
CSS3
Bootstrap / Material UI
Database
SQL
PostgreSQL
MySQL
Oracle Database
MongoDB (Good to Have)
Cloud & DevOps
AWS / Azure
Docker
Kubernetes
Jenkins
CI/CD Pipelines
Git/GitHub/GitLab
Other Skills
Agile/Scrum Methodology
Design Patterns
Performance Optimization
Unit Testing (JUnit, Mockito)
SonarQube
Maven/Gradle
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
4+ years of experience in Java Full Stack Development.
Strong expertise in Angular and/or React.
Experience in developing scalable enterprise applications.
Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with cloud-native development.
Knowledge of event-driven architecture (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
Experience with GraphQL.
Knowledge of Security and Authentication frameworks (OAuth2, JWT).
Exposure to AI/ML integrations and modern web technologies.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
Stakeholder management and communication.
Leadership and mentoring capabilities.
Ownership and accountability.

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced Java Spring Boot Microservices Developer with 9-15 years of experience in designing, developing, and delivering scalable enterprise applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices Architecture, Cloud Technologies, and System Design.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop scalable, high-performance applications using Java and Spring Boot.
Build and maintain Microservices-based applications.
Design and implement RESTful APIs and integration services.
Participate in High-Level Design (HLD) and Low-Level Design (LLD) discussions.
Drive architecture decisions and technical solutions.
Optimize application performance and ensure security best practices.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams in Agile/Scrum environments.
Mentor junior developers and conduct code reviews.
Troubleshoot production issues and provide root cause analysis.
Implement CI/CD pipelines and DevOps best practices.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Java 8/11/17/21.
Expertise in Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA.

Job Summary
We are looking for a highly skilled Java Spring Boot Developer with 6-8 years of experience in designing and developing scalable enterprise applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, cloud technologies, and modern DevOps practices. The candidate should be capable of contributing across the software development lifecycle, from design and development to deployment and production support.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications using Java and Spring Boot.
Develop scalable Microservices and RESTful APIs.
Build and consume APIs for internal and external integrations.
Implement event-driven architecture using Kafka or messaging systems.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver solutions.
Participate in application architecture, code reviews, and technical design discussions.
Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability.
Develop database schemas, queries, stored procedures, and data integrations.
Implement CI/CD pipelines and support cloud deployments.
Perform unit, integration, and performance testing.
Troubleshoot production issues and provide timely resolutions.

Mandatory Requirements
6-8 years of hands-on Java development experience.
Minimum 4.5 + years of Spring Boot development experience.
Strong experience with Microservices architecture.
Hands-on experience with Kafka/Event Streaming.
Experience in REST API development and integration.
Strong SQL and database design skills.
Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS/Azure).
Experience with Agile/Scrum methodology.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Spring Cloud components.
Experience with containerization using Docker and Kubernetes.
Exposure to NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, Cassandra, or Redis.
Knowledge of application monitoring and logging tools.
Experience mentoring junior developers and participating in code reviews.
Education
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related field.

Description:
About the Company:
NoBroker is the world's largest no-brokerage property platform, offering end-to-end services in real estate. As India's first Prop-Tech unicorn with a billion-dollar valuation, we provide a seamless experience to future homeowners. We operate in six major cities: Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, NCR, and Chennai. About the Role: As an Area Sales Manager (ASM), you will play a crucial role in bridging demand and supply in the real estate market. You will guide, consult, and support potential homebuyers throughout their purchase journey, helping them find the right property while maximizing sales for NoBroker.

Key Responsibilities:
Engage potential customers via phone, virtual meetings, and on-site visits to explain available properties and convert them into buyers.
Attend qualified leads through virtual or in-person meetings, present tailored property options, and encourage on-site visits.
Negotiate deals between clients, ensuring a win-win agreement.
Build and maintain client relationships, ensuring satisfaction and generating referral business.
Cross-sell additional NoBroker services to offer a complete home-buying experience.
Nurture leads to build a strong sales pipeline and meet daily, weekly, and monthly targets.
Stay updated on market trends, property prices, inventory, and buyer demand.

Requirements:
Bachelors degree or equivalent qualification.
Proven track record in sales, preferably in real estate or a similar domain.
Strong communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills.
Ability to handle objections and close deals effectively.
Good local market knowledge.
Target-driven mindset with a customer-first approach.
Own a vehicle (two-wheeler/four-wheeler preferred).
Fluency in English, Hindi, and a local language.
Availability to work 6 days a week (including weekends).

Key Competencies:
Real Estate Knowledge
Communication, Questioning, and Listening Skills
Networking & Relationship Building
Problem-Solving & Negotiation
Rapport Building
Persuasion & Convincing Skills
Customer-Centric Approach

Description:
About the Role:
Hurix Digital is looking for an accomplished business and operations leader to lead the next phase of growth across our Content, Technology and AI Data Services businesses. This is a senior enterprise leadership role with responsibility for business operations, delivery, revenue realization, profitability, customer success, people leadership and organizational capability. The EVP will work closely with the CEO and the leadership team to build a predictable,profitable and scalable operating organizationone that delivers consistently for customers,develops strong leaders and enables sustainable business growth.

Key Responsibilities:

Business & P&L Leadership
Own operational performance across Content, Technology and AI Data Services.
Drive revenue realization, gross margin, EBITDA, productivity, utilization and cost optimization.
Lead annual operating plans, forecasting, capacity planning and business reviews.
Partner closely with Finance, Sales and business leaders to make informed decisions on growth, investments, costs and profitability.
Ensure that signed business translates into successful, profitable and sustainable delivery. The role should carry genuine business accountability; the earlier EVP framework similarly linked the position directly to growth, profitability, revenue and margin outcomes.

Delivery & Operational Excellence
Build a strong operating rhythm through dashboards, metrics, forecasting, reviews and early-warning mechanisms.
Strengthen delivery governance and establish a high-performing PMO Excellence capability.
Improve predictability across quality, timelines, capacity, productivity and margins.
Build systems and processes that reduce dependence on firefighting and individual heroics.
Drive continuous improvement through technology, automation and AI-enabled workflows.

Customer Leadership
Act as a senior executive sponsor for strategic customers.
Build strong relationships with customer leadership teams and participate actively in QBRs, reviews and critical engagements.
Lead major escalations and ensure strong recovery and closure.
Partner with Sales and Pre-Sales on solutioning, commercials, feasibility and transition of new opportunities.
Identify opportunities for account expansion and deeper customer partnerships.

People & Leadership
Build and develop a strong second line of leaders across operations and delivery.
Assess leadership capability, identify talent risks early and take decisive action where the organization needs stronger talent.
Coach high-potential leaders and create clear succession and development plans.
Build a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration and high performance.
Be a visible and accessible leader, especially during critical business and delivery situations.
Ensure that business growth is achieved without compromising team health,leadership quality or organizational sustainability.
People and customer outcomes were already explicit components of the prior EVP incentive framework through Client Happiness, Team Happiness and People/Customer/Revenue Impact.

AI Data Services & Technology
Play a key role in scaling Hurixs emerging AI Data Services business.
Bring strong business understanding of data operations, human-in-the-loop models,expert talent ecosystems, quality, throughput, productivity and margin.
Strengthen the Technology business by connecting technology capability with customer needs, solutions and profitable delivery.
Drive practical adoption of AI and automation across operations to improve speed,quality and business economics.

Enterprise Leadership
Operate as a trusted partner to the CEO and leadership team.
Provide clear visibility into business performance, risks, customer concerns and people issues.
Surface problems early, bring data-backed recommendations and take ownership for execution.
Work effectively across Sales, Finance, HR, Solutions and other functions to drive enterprise outcomes.
Act as a strong leadership presence on the ground and help translate strategy into execution.

Experience & Background:
We are looking for a leader with approximately 20+ years of experience, including significant responsibility for large-scale operations, delivery or business-unit leadership.
The ideal candidate will demonstrate:
Meaningful P&L and business ownership, beyond project or delivery management.
Experience leading large, complex and multi-disciplinary teams.
Strong track record of driving revenue realization, profitability, productivity and operational predictability.
Executive-level customer management and experience handling strategic accounts.
Demonstrated ability to build strong leadership teams and second-line capability.
Strong numerical and analytical orientation with experience using dashboards,forecasting and operating metrics.
Experience in solutioning, pre-sales, commercials and transition from Sales to Delivery.
Exposure to AI/Data Services, technology services, digital services, learning/content services or adjacent knowledge-intensive businesses.
Strong partnership experience with Finance on business planning, revenue, cost and profitability.
Experience working with global customers and distributed teams.
Prior experience in digital learning or content services is valuable but not mandatory.
We are equally interested in leaders from technology, data and digital services who bring the right combination of business, customer, people and operating leadership.

Leadership Traits We Value
We are looking for someone who can combine:
Structure without bureaucracy.
Speed without chaos.
Customer obsession without organizational burnout.
Commercial ambition with delivery discipline.
High standards with strong people leadership.
Data-driven thinking with sound judgement.


Values:
Get stuff done
Move fast with purpose
Win with ideas
Sweat the details
Deliver great customer experiences
Make your teammate successful


Perks:
Health Insurance
Kwench Library (Klib)
Employee Assistance Program (Free Counseling Service)
Hybrid Work Model
Flexi Reimbursement Basket
Paid Time off
Level up your skills with company-based sponsorship.
Tech reimbursement.

Why Join Hurix Digital?
Hurix Digital is building on its established strength in global content and digital learning while expanding its Technology and AI Data Services businesses. This role offers the opportunity to influence not just how work is delivered, but how businesses scale, how leaders are built, how customers experience Hurix and how the operating model evolves in an AI-first environment. For the right leader, this is a high-impact enterprise role with significant autonomy, visibility and the opportunity to shape Hurixs next phase of growth.

ƒ˜ Interactive eBook platform
ƒ˜ Mobile app development
ƒ˜ Mobile QA & QC services
ƒ˜ Learning Management System
ƒ˜ Flash to HTML5 conversion
ƒ˜ E-Learning solutions

Description:
Job Description Senior DevSecOps Engineer
Company: Hurix Digital
Employment Type: Full-Time
Location: Mumbai , Pune, Chennai (Hybrid)
Experience: 4-6 Years

Role Overview
Hurix Digital is seeking an experienced Senior DevSecOps Engineer to strengthen security across AWS cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and production environments. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on expertise in cloud security, security automation, vulnerability management, and incident response, ensuring secure and efficient software delivery.

Key Responsibilities
Design and implement AWS security controls, including IAM, SCPs, KMS, VPC, and multi-account governance.
Integrate security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA, and secret scanning) into CI/CD pipelines.
Manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) security using Terraform and policy-as-code tools.
Secure containerized environments using Docker, ECS, and Kubernetes security practices.
Implement secrets management, identity federation, and access controls.
Lead vulnerability assessments, risk-based remediation, security monitoring, and incident response.
Automate security compliance processes aligned with SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR.
Conduct threat modeling, strengthen software supply chain security, and mentor engineering teams.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Strong hands-on experience in AWS cloud security, including IAM, Organizations, Control Tower, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Config, and CloudTrail.
Expertise in CI/CD security, preferably GitHub Actions, with tools such as Semgrep, CodeQL, Snyk, and Dependabot.
Proficiency in Terraform and security tools such as Checkov, tfsec, OPA, or Sentinel.
Experience securing ECS/Kubernetes environments, container images, and runtime workloads.
Knowledge of AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault, OIDC, and SSO.
Strong scripting and automation skills using Python and Bash.
Experience in vulnerability management, SIEM integration, threat modeling, and incident response.
Understanding of security compliance frameworks and software supply chain security, including SBOMs and artifact signing.

Preferred Skills
Experience implementing automated compliance and security governance.
Familiarity with STRIDE, SLSA, and Sigstore.
Strong security architecture, risk assessment, and stakeholder communication skills.
Ability to mentor developers and drive security best practices across engineering teams.

Ideal Candidate
A hands-on DevSecOps professional who can independently manage cloud security initiatives, automate security controls, collaborate with engineering teams, and balance security requirements with business and delivery priorities.

Values:
Get stuff done
Move fast with purpose
Win with ideas
Sweat the details
Deliver great customer experiences
Make your teammate successful

Perks:
Health Insurance
Kwench Library (Klib)
Employee Assistance Program (Free Counseling Service)
Hybrid Work Model
Flexi Reimbursement Basket
Paid Time off
Level up your skills with company-based sponsorship.
Tech reimbursement.

Why Join Hurix Digital?
Hurix is scaling its AI Data Services vertical, and this role is at the center of that growth engine. Youll be backed by strong delivery capabilities, a motivated leadership team, and the autonomy to shape your own market strategy. We reward results with generous commissions and long-term growth opportunities.

Description:
Data Engineer
Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Gurgaon, Chennai
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Building the machine learning production System(or MLOps) is the biggest challenge most large companies currently have in making the transition to becoming an AI-driven organization. This position is an opportunity for an experienced, server-side developer to build expertise in this exciting new frontier. You will be part of a team deploying state-of-the-art AI solutions for Fractal clients.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
As MLOps Engineer, you will work collaboratively with Data Scientists and Data engineers to deploy and operate advanced analytics machine learning models. You ll help automate and streamline Model development and Model operations. You ll build and maintain tools for deployment, monitoring, and operations. You ll also troubleshoot and resolve issues in development, testing, and production environments.
Enable Model tracking, model experimentation, Model automation Develop scalable ML pipelines
Develop MLOps components in Machine learning development life cycle using Model Repository (either of): MLFlow, Kubeflow Model Registry
Machine Learning Services (either of): Kubeflow, DataRobot, HopsWorks, Dataiku or any relevant ML E2E PaaS/SaaS
Work across all phases of Model development life cycle to build MLOPS components
Build the knowledge base required to deliver increasingly complex MLOPS projects on the Cloud(AWS, Azure, GCP)/On Prem Be an integral part of client business development and delivery engagements across multiple domains.
QUALIFICATIONS: REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
3-12 years experience building production-quality software
Strong experience in System Integration, Application Development or DataWarehouse projects across technologies used in the enterprise space
Basic Knowledge of MLOps, machine learning and docker
Object-oriented languages (e.g. Python, PySpark, Java, C#, C++ )
Experience developing CI/CD components for production ready ML pipeline.
Database programming using any flavors of SQL
Knowledge of Git for Source code management
Ability to collaborate effectively with highly technical resources in a fast-paced environment
Ability to solve complex challenges/problems and rapidly deliver innovative solutions
Team handling, problem solving, project management and communication skills & creative thinking
Foundational Knowledge of Cloud Computing either one AWS, Azure or GCP
Hunger and passion for learning new skills
Recommended (not mandatory): completion of Fractal Data Science Professional Certificate" with this - https: / / www.coursera.org / professional-certificates / fractal-data-science
EDUCATION:
B.E/B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or related technical degree OR Equivalent.

Description:
Job Title: Intern
Department: Operations
About Business line/Function: The Operations team includes different business units such as Securities Services, Wealth Management, Global Banking Operations, Markets Operations (back office & middle office) and Client engagement & Financial Securities.
These business units provides services to global clients across Asia, Europe & US region offering a wide range of services, which include custody operations, fund accounting, middle-office operations, static data management, trade clearing and settlement operations, securities lending, corporate action, Tax Operations, AML / KYC and other transversal services.
Position Purpose: The purpose of the roles is to provide service to Clients and their Portfolios related activities pertaining to different markets across the globe. 
The incumbent will be managing the daily operations/workflow within the business group and helps the Leads in achieving the process deliverables. 
Responsibilities
Processing of transactions within the agreed timelines
Ensure all the transactions are completed and approved in the system within the TAT /SLA
Ensure all the transactions are processed with at most care without errors/mistakes.
Prioritize the work and conduct investigation with due diligence on all the discrepancies.
Taking corrective measures/action in consultation with the Leads
Escalate unresolved open items to the Leads
Maintain Communication Channels with internal peer groups.
Participate in Cross Training and ensure the Knowledge transfer between the team and processes is happening on periodic basis.
Participate in Brainstorming Sessions and share the best practices and ideas with the peer groups and team members.
Consistently evaluate and update documented procedures to ensure they are complete, accurate and current
The position interfaces with other Process Associates, Mid Office Staff, Relationship Managers and Clients
The position interfaces with International Team Members of BNP Group and its Clients or Vendors or Sub-Custodians
Compliance and Risk Management: Ensure adherence to compliance and risk management policies and procedures. Identify and report any potential risks or compliance issues.
Quality Assurance: Conduct regular self-checks to ensure that all processes and transactions meet the required standards and guidelines.
Technical & Behavioral Competencies
The candidate should be able to read, write and speak in French language
Strong analytical skills, detail orientation, service commitment, solid organizational and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work in shifts as required.
Specific Qualifications:
Graduation in any discipline
DELF B1 and above certification in French language
Location: Mumbai/ Chennai/ Bangalore
About BNP Paribas Group:
BNP Paribas is the European Unions leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Groups commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
About BNP Paribas India Solutions:
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.
Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, color, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. Description:
Role: Workday Compensation Consultant
Exp: 4 to 10 years
Locations: Bang/Hyd/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certifications: Workday Certified (Mandatory)

Certification(s) Preferred:
Active Workday certification (HCM/Compensation)

Required Skills:
Active Workday Core HCM and Advanced Compensation certification.
At least 4 years of relevant Workday HCM experience and ability to work on multiple projects.
Hand on experience on setting up compensation elements like grades, grade profiles, sticks plans, bonus plans, merit plans etc.
Subject Matter Expertise in configuring compensation grid, managing new and existing plans while identifying opportunities for automation and process improvements.
Expertise on stock grants and updates, Processing Bonus Events, One-time payments, Future payments, consolidated Merits.
Functional experience in multiple HR processes like Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Recruiting, Talent.
Perform HRIS operational duties for Workday HCM and Compensation modules.
Ability to work with the client and drive design sessions for various HCM/Compensation areas and hands-on experience in business process configuration and building validation/condition rules.
Understanding of HR programs and policies along with a commitment to HR principles of confidentiality required data analysis and report building skills is essential.
Hands-on experience creating and troubleshooting EIBs (Enterprise Interface Builder).
Ability to help customers resolve functional issues requiring in depth expertise in the Workday solutions.
In-depth knowledge of Workday security framework, calculated fields, custom reports like Advanced/Matrix/Composite and setting up notifications.
In-depth knowledge of various data sources available and how to use them.
Analyze Workday release updates to understand impacts of feature changes, in relation to clients existing configuration.
Ability to maintain the highest regulatory and compliance standards in handling employee records.
Ensure effective engagement and collaboration with cross functional teams (HRIS & Digital, P&C, People Analytics).
Preferred Skills:
Good to have additional certifications like: Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Talent, Recruiting, Reporting.
Knowledge on using object transporter, Customer Central for configuration and migration.

Description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the worlds mostinnovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as theyprovide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days arethe same.
Job Description
Your Role
Creation, modification, and revision of AMM (Aircraft Maintenance Manual) content for Airbus aircraft programs.
Develop and update maintenance procedures in accordance with Airbus documentation standards and guidelines.
Airbus tool experience is mandatory.
Good understanding of Airbus standards, tools, processes, and technical publication guidelines.
Analyze engineering source data, drawings, specifications, and change requests to develop accurate AMM content.
Perform impact analysis and incorporate technical changes into the relevant maintenance procedures.
Ensure technical content meets quality, accuracy, consistency, and compliance requirements.
Coordinate with engineering teams, illustrators, reviewers, and other stakeholders for technical clarifications.
Guide and mentor Junior Authors/Preparators/Proofreaders when required.
Your Profile
6+ Years of experience in AMM Authoring for Airbus aircraft programs.
Strong knowledge of Aircraft Maintenance Manual structure, maintenance procedures, and technical documentation.
Hands-on experience working with Airbus technical publication processes and authoring environment.
Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, source data, and other engineering documents.
Experience in source data analysis, technical analysis, and impact analysis.
Good understanding of engineering changes and their impact on technical publications.
Experience in XML/SGML-based technical documentation and authoring tools will be an advantage.
Strong attention to detail with good analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to work independently while maintaining high levels of accuracy and quality.
Experience mentoring team members and supporting process improvement initiatives will be an added advantage.
What You'll Love About Working Here
We value flexibility and support our employees with hybrid work options and adaptable schedules to maintain a healthy work-life balance.
Our inclusive culture brings together diverse professionals committed to growth, innovation, and excellence.
At Capgemini, you can work on cutting-edge projects in technology and engineering with industry leaders or create solutions to overcome societal and environmental challenges.

Role & responsibilities
Experience: 3+ Years
Location: Bangalore / Coimbatore
Qualification: BE / B.Tech Mechanical Engineering
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled NX Sheet Metal Design Engineer with 3+ years of experience in mechanical design and development. The candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Unigraphics, sheet metal component design, 3D modelling, 2D detailing and manufacturing drawings.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and modify 3D sheet metal components and assemblies using PTC Creo.
Create sheet metal parts, bends, flanges, hems, louvers, cut-outs and other sheet metal features.
Develop flat patterns and manufacturing-ready 2D drawings.
Perform design modifications based on customer requirements and engineering specifications.
Apply GD&T, dimensional tolerances and engineering standards.
Ensure designs are suitable for manufacturing (DFM).
Coordinate with manufacturing, production and quality teams to resolve design-related issues.
Review engineering drawings and ensure design accuracy.
Support prototype development and production-related engineering changes.

Description:
Senior Software Engineer (C# .NET Azure)
With a global team of around 5600+ IT professionals, DHL IT Services connects people and keeps the global economy running by continuously innovating and creating sustainable digital solutions. We work beyond global borders and push boundaries across all dimensions of logistics. You can leave your mark shaping the technology backbone of the biggest logistics company of the world. All our locations have earned #GreatPlaceToWork certification, reflecting our commitment to exceptional employee experiences.

Digitalization. Simply delivered.
Were very excited to see the positive impact of our work but also recognize the potential is much larger. This is why we need you!
#DHL #DHLITServices #GreatPlace #JobLocations #Indore #Chennai # Bangalore

Grow together.
We operate in an agile/DevSecOps manner, with product-oriented teams holding end-to-end responsibility for product success. Our work follows Scrum practices, including stand-ups, reviews, and iterative deployment. While not strictly by the book, we embrace agile principles, learning from failures and getting better every day.

About the IoT team
We are a supportive, quality-driven group of tech enthusiasts who strive to improve daily and are eager to assist you on your journey with us! Our global team includes members from India and Germany, collaborating via Microsoft Teams, Jira, and Confluence. We are aiming to provide a platform that accelerates IoT adoption for operational excellence, customer experience, and employee safety. We built a global platform that processes data from millions of connected devices across DHL and are developing modular use cases for real-time shipment monitoring (e.g. for life science and healthcare shipments) and actionable insights.

Tech stack
Our IoT platform is built on Microsoft Azure, featuring a micro-services architecture and Azure DevOps for continuous integration and delivery, utilizing Docker and Kubernetes. We primarily use .NET Core, C#, and Angular for coding.

Ready to embark on the journey? Heres what we are looking for:
Were looking for a Software Engineer in our IoT team who does both product development (we also do something with AI) where you will have an opportunity to directly impact customer experience in DHL as well as support existing IoT use case implementations.

What do we expect from you?
Proven experience as a Software Engineer with a strong portfolio of projects
Excellent problem-solving skills
Individual with positive energy and can-do attitude
A desire to grow and continuously improve in a fast-paced environment
Strong knowledge in .NET Core and C#
Strong code-reading skills and knack for writing clean, testable, easily maintainable code
Experience with Microsoft Azure Cloud PaaS services
Extensive knowledge in Entity Framework Core
Experience in MS SQL Server
Very good written and spoken English
Willingness to work in the UK shift

Good to have:
Experience with Azure DevOps and Azure Kubernetes Service
Thorough understanding of the responsibilities of the platform, database, API, caching layer, proxies, and other web services used in the syste
Job Locations: Bangalore, Chennai and Indore
An array of benefits for you:
Hybrid work arrangements to balance in-office collaboration and home flexibility.
Annual Leave: 42 days off apart from Public / National Holidays.
Medical Insurance: Self + Spouse + 2 children. An option to opt for Voluntary Parental Insurance (Parents / Parent -in-laws) at a nominal premium covering pre existing disease.
In House training programs: professional and technical training certifications.

Job description
Interview mode-Face to face
Locations-Chennai, Bangalore

Role Overview
The role involves assisting shareholders with buying and selling shares in accordance with established procedures and service standards. The candidate will also handle customer queries and provide operational support under appropriate guidance and supervision.

Key Responsibilities
Handle inbound calls and emails from shareholders, addressing their queries within agreed service standards.
Assist shareholders with share purchase and sale transactions over inbound calls.
Resolve basic customer queries and escalate complex issues to senior team members when necessary.
Support the team in completing daily workloads and meeting operational targets.
Continuously develop operational knowledge and skills while identifying opportunities to improve processes and service quality.
Perform additional duties of a similar nature as required.
Follow company policies, procedures, quality standards, and reporting requirements, ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory and statutory obligations.
Carry out all responsibilities in accordance with the requirements of the company's regulators.
Adhere to established physical and information security procedures to protect company and customer information.
Ensure all activities comply with the applicable quality management system.
Follow scheduled break timings to maintain operational efficiency and meet Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Work according to the designated US business holiday calendar.

Required Skills, Experience, and Competencies
Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and telephone communication skills, with strong active listening abilities.
Shift Flexibility: Willingness and ability to work in US shifts.
Customer Support Experience: Previous experience in a customer service or customer support role
Target Achievement: Ability to meet targets related to accuracy, quality, productivity, and agreed service levels.
CRM Knowledge: Familiarity with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems and practices.
Data Protection and AML: Basic understanding of data protection principles and Anti-Money Laundering (AML).
Customer Focus: Ability to understand customer needs and adapt communication styles to different personalities.
Time Management: Ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and manage time effectively.
Compliance and Process Adherence: Ability to follow established procedures, policies, and regulatory requirements.
Teamwork: Willingness to support team members and contribute beyond assigned responsibilities.

Role: Workday Finance Consultant
Exp: 4 to 10 Years
Location: Bang/Hyd/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certification: Workday Finance certified (Mandatory - P2P/R2R)

Certification(s) Preferred:
Active Workday Finance certification (P2P/R2R)
Required Skills:
Active Workday Financials Record to Report/Contracts to Cash certification.
At least 3 year or full implementation of Financial Accounting, Common Financial Management, Banking and Settlement and/or Customer Accounts.
At least 3 years of relevant Workday experience and ability to work on multiple projects.
Subject Matter Expertise on Financial Processes and reports while identifying opportunities for automation and process improvements.
Functional experience in several Workday Finance modules like Financial Accounting, Common Financial Management, Customers, Customer Accounts, Banking and Settlement, Business Assets, Projects.
Ability to work with the client and drive design sessions for various Finance modules and hands on experience configuring FDM structure and business process configuration and building validation/condition rules.
Hands-on experience creating and troubleshooting EIBs (Enterprise Interface Builder).
Ability to help customers resolve functional issues requiring in depth expertise in the Workday solutions.
In-depth knowledge of Workday security framework, calculated fields, custom reports like Advanced/Matrix/Composite and setting up notifications.
In-depth knowledge of various data sources available and how to use them.
Analyze Workday release updates to understand impacts of feature changes, in relation to clients existing configuration.

Preferred Skills:
Good to have Reporting, FDM and other certifications related to Record to Report OR P2P OR Order to Cash functional areas.
Knowledge on using Customer Central for configuration and migration.

We are looking for a skilled Frontend Developer with expertise in React and Typescript to join our team in Chennai or Bangalore, India. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in frontend development and excellent problem-solving skills.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize project requirements.

Description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you'd like, where you'll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you'll be able to reimagine what's possible. Join us and help the worlds leading organizations


Your Role

We are looking for experienced Guidewire professionals with strong hands-on expertise across Policy Center and Guidewire Integrations to design, configure, customize, and support scalable solutions for Property Casualty insurance clients. The role involves working across the Guidewire Insurance Suite ecosystem to enable seamless policy administration, claims management, billing operations, and system integrations.
Design, develop, configure, and maintain Guidewire applications across Policy Center.
Customize Guidewire components using Gosu, Java, Guidewire Studio, and configuration tools.
Work on Guidewire Policy Center capabilities including policy administration, product configuration, underwriting rules, rating, pricing, renewals, endorsements, cancellations, and reinstatements.
Design and build integrations using the Guidewire Integration Framework, including plugins, messaging, web services, batch processes, event triggers, and data exchange pipelines.
Develop and maintain SOAP/REST APIs, XML/XSD-based data exchanges, JSON structures, messaging components, and integration interfaces.
Collaborate with business analysts, architects, QA teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.




Your Profile

6+ years of experience in software development, with strong hands-on exposure to Guidewire Policy Center applications.
Strong experience in one or more Guidewire modules: PolicyCenter
Proficiency in Gosu, Java, XML, JSON, XSD, SQL, SOAP/REST Web Services, and Guidewire configuration tools.
Good understanding of Property Casualty insurance domain processes across policy and policy integration landscapes.
Hands-on experience with Guidewire data models, workflows, rules engine, plugins, messaging, batch processes, and web services.
Experience integrating Guidewire applications with PolicyCenter, comp raters, payment gateways, document systems, accounting platforms, customer portals, and other external systems.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, DevOps tools, Git, Jenkins, Maven, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Guidewire Cloud is preferred.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
Guidewire certification in PolicyCenter is preferred.




What you will love about working here

Opportunity to work on large-scale Guidewire Insurance Suite transformation programs for global PC insurance clients.
Exposure to end-to-end insurance technology delivery across policy, claims, billing, and integration platforms.
Hands-on experience with modern engineering practices including Agile delivery, CI/CD, DevOps, cloud, and integration-led architecture.
Structured learning, certifications, and continuous upskilling opportunities in insurance platforms and emerging technologies.
A collaborative and inclusive culture focused on innovation, delivery excellence, and client value.


We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of 22.5 billion.
Capgemini in India comprises nearly 235,000 team members working across 13 locations: Bangalore, Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Coimbatore, Gandhinagar, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Noida, Pune, Salem, and Tiruchirappalli.

Description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you like, where youll be supported and inspired bya collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you'll be able to reimagine whats possible. Join us and help the worlds leading organizations


Your Role

We are looking for experienced Guidewire professionals with strong hands-on expertise across Billing Center and Guidewire Integrations to design, configure, customize, and support scalable solutions for Property Casualty insurance clients. The role involves working across the Guidewire Insurance Suite ecosystem to enable seamless policy administration, claims management, billing operations, and system integrations.
Design, develop, configure, and maintain Guidewire applications across Billing Center, and Integration modules.
Customize Guidewire components using Gosu, Java, Guidewire Studio, and configuration tools.
Configure and enhance Billing Center workflows such as invoices, payments, write-offs, adjustments, refunds, delinquency processes, commissions, payment allocation, and GL postings.
Design and build integrations using the Guidewire Integration Framework, including plugins, messaging, web services, batch processes, event triggers, and data exchange pipelines.
Develop and maintain SOAP/REST APIs, XML/XSD-based data exchanges, JSON structures, messaging components, and integration interfaces.
Collaborate with business analysts, architects, QA teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Perform unit testing, support QA/UAT phases, troubleshoot application and integration issues, and assist in production deployments.
Participate in code reviews, Agile ceremonies, documentation, and development best practices to ensure quality and delivery excellence.

Your Profile
6+ years of experience in software development, with strong hands-on exposure to Guidewire Insurance Suite applications.
Strong experience in one or more Guidewire module:Billing Center and Billing guidewire Integrations.
Proficiency in Gosu, Java, XML, JSON, XSD, SQL, SOAP/REST Web Services, and Guidewire configuration tools.
Good understanding of Property Casualty insurance domain processes across billing and integration landscapes.
Hands-on experience with Guidewire data models, workflows, rules engine, plugins, messaging, batch processes, and web services.
Experience integrating Guidewire applications with Billing Center, comp raters, payment gateways, document systems, accounting platforms, customer portals, and other external systems.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
[Job Descri...C CC Integ | Word]
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, DevOps tools, Git, Jenkins, Maven, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Guidewire Cloud is preferred.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
Guidewire certification in BillingCenter is preferred.

What you will love about working here
Opportunity to work on large-scale Guidewire InsuranceSuite transformation programs for global PC insurance clients.
Exposure to end-to-end insurance technology delivery across policy, claims, billing, and integration platforms.
Hands-on experience with modern engineering practices including Agile delivery, CI/CD, DevOps, cloud, and integration-led architecture.
Structured learning, certifications, and continuous upskilling opportunities in insurance platforms and emerging technologies.
A collaborative and inclusive culture focused on innovation, delivery excellence, and client value.

We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of 22.5 billion.
Capgemini in India comprises nearly 235,000 team members working across 13 locations: Bangalore, Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Coimbatore, Gandhinagar, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Noida, Pune, Salem, and Tiruchirappalli.

Description:
Company Profile
Hitachi Energy is a pioneering technology leader that is helping to increase access to affordable, reliable, sustainable, and modern energy for all. We help to power your home, keep the factories running, and our hospitals and schools open. Come as you are and prepare to get better as you learn from others. Bring your passion, bring your energy, and plug into a team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity + Collaboration = Great Innovation.
Visit us -
Business Information:
Hitachi Energy India Development Centre (IDC) is a research and development facility with around 500 RD engineers, specialists, and experts, who focus on creating and sustaining digital solutions, new products and technology. This includes product integration, testing, cybersecurity, and certification. The India Development Centre is situated in Chennai and Bangalore.

IDC collaborates with the RD and Research centres of Hitachi Energy, which are spread across more than 15 locations throughout 12 countries.
In the past 20 years, IDC has secured more than 200 international papers and 150+ patents.
Mission Statement:
We are looking for a skilled and motivated engineer to join our team of RD Engineers.
A person interested in the field of power electronic converters and contribute towards global RD projects.

How you'll make impact:
You bring broad knowledge in the field of controls design, power electronics as an experienced control engineer for power electronics.
Development of control/Protection software in MACH control platform and MATLAB Simulink.
Documentations for control software like concept documents, test reports and other supporting documents part of development.
Eagerness for learning and innovation, the readiness of mind for the use of various new tools for developments tasks but also for collaborating with the team efficiently.
Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.
Your Background:

Phd or Master's degree in electrical engineering with an emphasis on Power Electronics control and control system.
Industry experience with power converters, control systems design and real-time control software.
Control software design experience in MACH control platform, MATLAB/Simulink, or other control platforms.
Proficiency in the use of simulation tools such as MATLAB/Simulink, PSCAD would be an advantage.
Python programming would be an advantage.
Team spirit with the capacity to work independently, complemented by a quick intellect and well-developed analytical skills.
Experience working in an Agile development team would be an advantage.
You like to work in multicultural/international environment.
Proficiency in both spoken written English language is required.

Ensure effective engagement and collaboration with cross functional teams (HRIS & Digital, P&C, People Analytics).

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Requirement - Business Analyst
Hexagram FinTech, a products company in the Investment Management space is looking for young and energetic Functional Specialists to supplement the current product team. The product is deployed in several of the top mutual fund and insurance companies in India and South East Asia and will expose you to the capital markets in these regions.
Finance professional with 2+ years of experience in any Financial Services Industry viz; Asset Management / Portfolio Management / Wealth Management / Mutual Fund / Treasury and other related industry are preferred.
Exposure / Understanding of the following areas is a pre-requisite:
• Understanding of all asset classes (Equities, Bonds, Derivatives, Fixed Income, Mutual Funds , Forex etc.) and examples of each type
• Attributes of each of these asset classes.
• Investment Accounting (General Ledger)
• Understanding of various types of corporate actions
• Understanding of NFO, IPO, Primary Market, Secondary Market etc
• NAV Calculation
• Various types of fees associated with a trade and basic understanding of each fees
• Basic understanding of how accounting is done for each type of transaction.
• Knowledge of Pricing, Valuation, Gain / Loss computation, Interest computation, Amortization, Reconciliation and Reporting
• Knowledge of SQL / Microsoft Excel / Microsoft PowerPoint / Microsoft Word.
Role and Responsibilities:
• Part of the Functional team at Hexagram and will be responsible for Implementation of Hexagrams software products at its client sites
• Assisting the product development team in Testing and validation of functionality
• Providing support to existing clients on the products
• As part of Implementation, will be responsible for supporting the users in user acceptance tests, conducting user training, coordinating with Technical teams, documenting user requirements, assisting in data reconciliation and reporting
• Manage releases from the product team to the client installations, conduct detailed tests, contributing to continuous enrichment of user guides / manuals
• Ability to work as per clients working hours.
Educational Background: Graduate / Post Graduate in Finance
Should be either from BA background or accounting background.
Experience in Front/ Mid /Back end roles on Investment System is a plus.

Mail your resume to rizwan.basha@kfintech.com
AboutCompany: KFintech serves the mission-critical needs of asset managers with clients spanning mutual funds, AIFs (alternative investments), pension, wealth managers and corporates in India and abroad. The company provides SaaS based end-to-end transaction management, channel management, compliance solutions, data analytics and various other digital services to asset managers across segments, as well as outsourcing services for global players.

We are looking for a talented GCP Data Engineer with 2-5 years of experience in designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The ideal candidate should have expertise in BigQuery, Dataflow, ETL/ELT processes, and cloud-based data warehousing solutions.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop scalable data pipelines using GCP services.
Build and maintain ETL/ELT processes for structured and unstructured data.
Develop and optimize data models and data warehouse solutions using BigQuery.
Ingest data from various sources into GCP environments.
Work with large-scale datasets and ensure data quality, integrity, and performance.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data processing workflows.
Collaborate with data analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders.
Implement data governance, security, and compliance best practices.
Automate data workflows and deployments using CI/CD practices.
Required Skills

2-5 years of experience in Data Engineering.
Strong experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Hands-on experience with:
BigQuery
Dataflow
Cloud Composer (Airflow)
Pub/Sub
Cloud Storage
Dataproc
Strong SQL skills and query optimization experience.
Experience with Python, PySpark, or Java.
Knowledge of ETL/ELT frameworks and data warehousing concepts.
Experience working with batch and real-time data processing.
Familiarity with Git and CI/CD tools.

A day in the life of an Infoscion
