Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced API Automation Tester with 5-10 years of experience in API Testing, Automation Testing, and Selenium Automation. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in designing and implementing automation frameworks, validating REST/SOAP APIs, and ensuring end-to-end quality of web applications through robust test automation solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain API automation test frameworks and scripts.
Perform functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
Validate RESTful and SOAP APIs using automation tools and frameworks.
Develop and execute automated test scripts using Selenium for web applications.
Create test plans, test cases, and test data for API and UI testing.
Analyze automation test results, identify defects, and track issues through resolution.
Collaborate closely with developers, business analysts, and product teams.
Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines.
Ensure automation coverage and improve testing efficiency.
Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous quality improvement.
Required Skills
API Testing
Strong hands-on experience in API Testing.
Experience testing REST and SOAP APIs.
API validation using Postman, Swagger, and automation frameworks.
Knowledge of JSON, XML, and API authentication mechanisms (OAuth, JWT, Basic Auth).
Experience with API automation using Java/Python frameworks.
Automation Testing
Experience in designing and developing automation frameworks.
Strong understanding of Data-Driven, Hybrid, and Keyword-Driven Frameworks.
Experience with TestNG, JUnit, PyTest, or similar frameworks.
Test execution, reporting, and defect management expertise.
Selenium Automation
Hands-on experience with Selenium WebDriver.
Page Object Model (POM) Framework implementation.
Cross-browser automation testing.
Handling dynamic web elements and synchronization techniques.
Programming Skills
Java or Python programming experience.
Strong OOP concepts.
Collections, Exception Handling, and Multithreading knowledge.
CI/CD & Version Control
Jenkins / Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions.
Git, GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket.
Continuous Integration and Continuous Testing practices.
Database Testing
SQL Queries.
Database validation and backend testing.
Experience with Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
Preferred Skills
Rest Assured.
Karate Framework.
Playwright automation.
Docker and Kubernetes basics.
Performance testing exposure using JMeter.
Cloud exposure (AWS, Azure).
Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
5-10 years of experience in Software Testing and Test Automation.
Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Description:
NOBROKER
India's leading brokerage-free real estate
SELLER BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT ASSOCIATE (BDA)
Job Description | Field Sales
CompanyNoBroker Technologies Pvt. Ltd.LocationBangalore, Chennai, Mumbai, PuneExperienceMinimum 1 year and smart freshersWork ModeFull-time | Field-basedLanguagesEnglish / Kannada English / Telugu English / Tamil English / Hindi ¢ English / MarathiCore Focus: Field Sales
ROLE SUMMARY
The Seller Business Development Associate (BDA) is responsible for acquiring and engaging property owners, conducting field visits, showcasing properties, assisting buyers, and driving successful property transactions. The company provides qualified leads.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Meet property owners and customers to facilitate property sales, rentals, and leases.
Conduct property visits and accompany buyers during site visits.
Explain property features, pricing, and NoBroker services.
Coordinate property photoshoots and ensure accurate property information.
Negotiate pricing between buyers and sellers to close deals.
Onboard property owners and encourage premium service subscriptions where applicable.
Visit commercial properties to collect owner details and explain NoBroker services.
Upload property details through the NoBroker App or Google Forms.
Maintain customer interactions and sales updates in CRM.
Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets while ensuring excellent customer experience.

Job Title: Senior Salesforce Developer
Experience: 6+ Years
Job Locations: Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad
Notice Period: Immediate joiners preferred

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with 6+ years of hands-on experience in Salesforce development, customization, and implementation. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Apex, Visualforce, and Aura Components.
The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, customizing, and maintaining scalable Salesforce applications while collaborating with business stakeholders, architects, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
Roles and Responsibilities
Design, develop, customize, and maintain Salesforce applications based on business requirements.
Work extensively with Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud implementations and enhancements.
Develop reusable and responsive user interfaces using Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Aura Components.
Write, test, and maintain Apex classes, triggers, batch Apex, and asynchronous processes.
Develop and maintain Visualforce pages and controllers as required.
Implement Salesforce workflows, validation rules, flows, and process automation.
Integrate Salesforce with external systems using REST and SOAP APIs.
Follow Salesforce development best practices, including bulkification, governor limit management, and secure coding standards.
Participate in requirement analysis, technical design, code reviews, unit testing, and deployment activities.
Troubleshoot issues, debug code, and optimize application performance.
Manage deployments using Salesforce change sets, Salesforce CLI, or CI/CD tools.
Collaborate with business analysts, QA teams, architects, and other developers to deliver reliable solutions.
Maintain technical documentation and ensure adherence to Salesforce coding standards.

Required Technical Skills
6+ years of hands-on experience in Salesforce development.
Strong expertise in Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud.
Proficiency in Lightning Web Components (LWC) and JavaScript.
Strong programming experience in Apex Classes, Apex Triggers, Batch Apex, and asynchronous Apex.
Hands-on experience with Visualforce Pages and Controllers.
Experience developing and maintaining Aura Components.
Good understanding of Salesforce data modeling, objects, relationships, security, profiles, permission sets, and sharing rules.
Experience with Salesforce APIs and third-party integrations using REST/SOAP.
Knowledge of SOQL, SOSL, governor limits, and Salesforce platform best practices.
Experience with Salesforce deployment tools and version control systems such as Git.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and the software development lifecycle.

Description:
JOB OVERVIEW


We are seeking an experienced Billing Platform Senior Manager Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) Solution Architect to lead the end-to-end solution architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise Billing Platform implementations across the entire Quote-to-Cash lifecycle. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in both Billing and Revenue capabilities, with extensive experience in subscription billing, usage-based billing, pricing, invoicing, payments, collections, revenue recognition, financial integrations, and enterprise application architecture.
As a trusted advisor to clients, the Senior Manager will drive business transformation initiatives by translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing Billing Platform solutions aligned with industry best practices. The role requires a strong blend of functional, technical, and consulting expertise, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams, engage with executive stakeholders, and deliver large-scale digital transformation programs.
The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end solution ownership, including solutioning, architecture, business process design, functional and technical design, application configuration, integrations, data migration, development oversight, proof of concepts, testing strategy, deployment planning, user enablement, and post-go-live support. The role also requires strong leadership in project management, delivery governance, team management, quality assurance, risk management, and stakeholder communication while driving successful project milestones.
Additionally, the Senior Manager will play a key role in practice development by contributing to solution accelerators, AI-enabled delivery, capability building, pre-sales, client workshops, and thought leadership initiatives. The individual will work closely with client executives, business stakeholders, product teams, architects, functional consultants, and technical teams to deliver end-to-end Q2C solutions that optimize revenue operations, improve business outcomes, and support enterprise growth.


Years of Experience: 12 - 18 Years
Position Requirements:
Own the solution architecture and design for enterprise Quote-to-Cash transformations across Billing and Revenue, including subscription management, pricing, usage-based billing, invoicing, payments, collections, revenue recognition, and financial integrations. Lead end-to-end Billing Platform solution architecture for large-scale implementation programs.
Manage end-to-end implementation programs by overseeing project planning, solution design, configuration, development, integrations, data migration, testing, deployment, and hypercare while leading multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality outcomes on time and within budget. Define enterprise architecture, solution blueprints, and implementation roadmap.
Partner with client executives, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to understand business objectives, facilitate workshops, perform fit-gap analysis, develop scalable solution designs, and provide strategic recommendations aligned with industry best practices. Excellent client-facing skills and communication (written/verbal) skills
Establish delivery governance, manage project risks and dependencies, review solution quality, ensure compliance with architectural standards, and drive successful milestone execution through proactive stakeholder communication and issue resolution.
Contribute to practice development through pre-sales, estimations, proposals, AI-enabled delivery accelerators, capability building, mentoring, solution assets, thought leadership, and the development of reusable frameworks that enhance delivery efficiency and support business growth.
Build and maintain billing workflows, rating rules, invoicing, taxation, payments, collections, and revenue-related processes.
Design and develop integrations between Billing Platform and enterprise applications such as Salesforce, SAP, Oracle ERP, NetSuite, CRM systems, Payment gateways, Tax engines and Data warehouses
Strong hands-on experience with billing platform and experience with APIs, integrations, and data reconciliation.
Understand customer business processes/functional specifications and independently drive technical solutioning to delivery
Ability to lead business discussions with customers, discover requirements, frame a problem statement, lead solution workshops and deliver a Technical solution
Must ensure teams follow the correct procedures, best practices and documentation requirements across project phases
Drive solution quality throughout the implementation lifecycle.
Technical Skills:
API, SQL, CSS, HTML, Java Script, JSON and XML
Certifications:
BillingPlatform Partner Essential Certification (L1)
BillingPlatform Partner Pro Certification (L2)
BillingPlatform Partner Elite Certification (L3)

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.

As a Senior Manager - Billing Platform - Finance Solutions, you will lead the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise Billing Platform implementations across the Quote-to-Cash lifecycle. Within our Management Consulting practice, you will leverage your skills to drive business transformation initiatives, translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions. You will engage with executive stakeholders, delivering large-scale digital transformation programs that optimize revenue operations and support enterprise growth.

As a Senior Manager, you will guide cross-functional teams, applying sound judgment and strategic advising to solve complex problems. You will motivate and coach teams, fostering a diverse and inclusive environment that contributes to the firm's success. Your role involves crafting impactful messages, validating outcomes with clients, and navigating challenging situations with composure. You will also contribute to practice development through thought leadership initiatives and capability building.

In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will focus on implementing Oracle lead management and customer experience solutions, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. Your leadership in project management, delivery governance, and stakeholder communication will drive successful project milestones and enhance delivery efficiency.

Responsibilities

- Leading the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise Billing Platform implementations across the Quote-to-Cash lifecycle
- Translating complex business requirements into scalable and secure Billing Platform solutions aligned with industry practices
- Managing end-to-end implementation programs, including project planning, solution design, configuration, development, and deployment
- Engaging with executive stakeholders and cross-functional teams to understand business objectives and provide strategic recommendations
- Overseeing the development of integrations between Billing Platform and enterprise applications such as Salesforce, SAP, and Oracle ERP
- Driving business transformation initiatives by leveraging functional, technical, and consulting skills
- Facilitating workshops and performing fit-gap analysis to develop scalable solution designs
- Contributing to practice development through pre-sales, capability building, and thought leadership initiatives
- Building and maintaining billing workflows, rating rules, invoicing, and revenue-related processes
- Validating solution quality throughout the implementation lifecycle and managing project risks and dependencies
- Leading business discussions with customers to discover requirements and deliver technical solutions
- Confirming compliance with architectural standards and driving successful milestone execution through proactive communication

What You Must Have

- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 12 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart

- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Business Administration/Management, Marketing, Commerce, Finance, Management Information Systems, Computer and Information Science
- At least one of the following: Oracle Cloud certification in Lead-to-Revenue or related Oracle Customer Experience (CX) Revenue Cloud applications
- Possessing BillingPlatform Partner Elite Certification (L3)
- Demonstrating proficiency in API, SQL, CSS, HTML, JavaScript, JSON, and XML
- Leading large-scale digital transformation programs in finance operations
- Excelling in client-facing communication and stakeholder engagement
- Developing scalable solution designs aligned with industry best practices

Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Kolkata,Pune, Chennai, Gurugram (PwC Acceleration Center India)

About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced Oracle Cloud HCM Functional Consultant with strong expertise in multiple HCM modules and proven experience in end-to-end implementations. You will work closely with clients and internal teams to design, configure, and implement Oracle Cloud HCM solutions, driving HR transformation and process optimization.

Key Responsibilities:
Lead requirements gathering workshops and collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into Oracle Cloud HCM functional specifications
Design and configure Oracle Cloud HCM modules (Core HR, Payroll, Benefits, Absence, T&L, Compensation, Talent Management, Recruitment & Onboarding, Learning, Workforce Modelling) aligned with best practices
Manage multiple end-to-end Oracle Cloud HCM implementations ensuring quality delivery within budget and timelines
Develop and execute test scripts; lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate system functionality
Provide post-implementation support and training to users for smooth adoption of Oracle Cloud HCM solutions
Prepare detailed functional design documents, configuration guides, and user manuals
Integrate Oracle Fusion HCM with third-party systems using Oracle Integration Cloud, FBDI, APIs, etc.
Use Oracle HCM Cloud tools and analytics to provide insights and contribute to HR strategy and workforce planning
Manage stakeholder relations, collaborating across project managers, technical teams, and business users to ensure success

What You Must Have:

Bachelors degree any stream
Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in Oracle Cloud HCM, with at least 2 complete implementations
Expertise in 2+ Oracle Cloud HCM modules: Core HR, Payroll, Benefits, Absence, Time & Labor, Compensation, Talent Management, Recruitment & Onboarding, Learning, Workforce Modeling
Strong understanding and experience in Oracle Integration technologies (Oracle Integration Cloud, FBDI, APIs)
Excellent communication skills in English (oral and written)

Additional Job Description
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a Senior Associate in Treasury Management System Implementation within our Finance practice, you will play a pivotal role in delivering finance solutions that enhance operational efficiency and client satisfaction. You will be at the forefront of client engagements, utilizing your skills to analyze complex financial operations and develop tailored solutions that meet the unique needs of each client.
As a Senior Associate, you will leverage your professional skills to build meaningful client relationships and navigate complex situations. You will be responsible for mentoring junior team members, guiding them through the intricacies of financial operations, and fostering a collaborative environment that encourages growth and innovation. Your ability to anticipate client needs and deliver quality solutions will be crucial in maintaining professional standards and driving success within the team.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will have the opportunity to work within our Finance practice, focusing on finance operations and digital core modernization. Your contributions will be instrumental in shaping the future of financial consulting, providing you with a platform to grow your personal brand and deepen your technical skills.
Responsibilities
- Implementing treasury management systems to optimize financial operations
- Analyzing financial statements and preparing comprehensive reports for stakeholders
- Developing financial strategies and forecasting models to support business objectives
- Conducting financial statement reviews and confirming compliance with internal controls
- Utilizing financial accounting practices to maintain accurate financial records
- Collaborating with clients to address financial management challenges and provide solutions
- Applying analytical thinking to enhance financial reporting and decision-making processes
- Planning, budgeting, and forecasting to align with organizational financial goals
- Reviewing financial statements to identify areas for improvement and efficiency
- Supporting client engagements by providing insights into financial operations and strategies
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 4 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Demonstrating proficiency in financial modeling and forecasting
- Excelling in financial statement analysis and preparation
- Utilizing advanced financial management and reporting skills
- Applying analytical thinking to complex financial operations
- Leveraging financial strategy to optimize client solutions
- Navigating financial internal controls with precision
- Communicating effectively in finance consulting environments

Description:
Dear Candidate,


This is with reference for AWS Data Engineer Professionals

PFB the Job Description

Key responsibilities
Inventory and baseline current Lambda functions, Dagster pipelines, dbt models, MySQL ODS flows and Kafka feeds, document lineage, schedules, SLAs and failure paths.
Design and build Gluebased ingestion, transformation, and cataloguing patterns (Glue jobs, Glue Catalog, Crawlers) with Lambda/Step Functions/Event Bridge orchestration.
Implement S3 Bronze landing with lifecycle/archive policies, Redshift Silver conformance and Gold canonical data products (Customer, Loan, Collections, Risk).
Build automated dataquality gates, reconciliation checks, and sourcetoreport lineage; support the enterprise data dictionary and certification of businesscritical reports
Implement IAM, AWSnative encryption, Secrets Manager and Goldlayer RBAC/leastprivilege access.
Establish Dev/Test environments, Gitbased CI/CD, schema version control (Liquibase) and controlled release promotion; monitoring and recovery via CloudWatch.
Migrate and reconcile workloads wave by wave against baselines; decommission ODS dependencies and replace reverse flows with governed interfaces.
Optimise Redshift performance and cost (WLM, sort/Dist keys, materialised views).
Mentor engineers, own technical quality assurance of deliverables, and work with Data Owners/Champions and Atos architects in an Agile setup.

Mandatory skills
10+ years in data engineering with 5+ Experience in AWS data platforms.
Amazon Redshift (deep): data modelling, performance tuning, WLM, RBAC, external schemas/Spectrum.
AWS Glue (jobs, Glue Catalog, Crawlers) and handson medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) implementation on S3 + Redshift.
AWS Lambda, Step Functions, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager.
Advanced SQL, dimensional/canonical data modelling, ETL/ELT frameworks.
Python (primary) PySpark for Glue jobs.
MySQL (operational data store) and CDC/batch extraction patterns.
dbt must be able to read, reverseengineer, and migrate existing dbt models.
Dataquality frameworks, reconciliation, and lineage/metadata practices.
Git,CI/CD pipelines, database schema version control (Liquibase or equivalent), Dev/Test/Prod promotion.
Leadership, mentoring, stakeholder management; ability to work independently in Agile.

Nice to have
Dagster orchestration for ASIS discovery and migration.
Kafka / eventdriven streaming ingestion.
Apache Iceberg on S3, Apache Spark/EMR
Tableau, Metabase servinglayer knowledge.
Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation).
Datagovernance tooling (Glue Data Quality, Data Zone, Lake Formation).

Total Overall Experience-10-15years
Skill AWS Data Engineer
Location Mumbai, Chennai, and Bangalore

Atos SE (Societas europaea) is an international information technology services company with annual 2012 revenue of EUR 8.8 billion and 77,000 employees in 47 countries. Serving a global client base, it delivers Consulting & Technology Services, Systems Integration and Managed Services.
With its deep technology expertise and industry knowledge, it works with clients across the following market sectors: Manufacturing, Retail & Services; Public sector, Healthcare & Transport; Financial Services; Telecoms, Media & Technology; Energy & Utilities.
Atos is focused on business technology that powers progress and helps organizations to create their firm of the future.
It is the Worldwide Information Technology Partner for the Olympic and Paralympic Games and is quoted on the NYSE Euronext Paris market

Description:
Dear Candidate,

Looking to build something meaningful for Indias MSMEs? Join Tata nexarc, a digital-first B2B platform from the house of Tata, as our Sr. Associate Operations.

About the role:
Own the end-to-end order journey for steel and bitumen raw material orders, from order verification to delivery and proof of delivery. You will be the face of Tata nexarc Operations for customers.

Key Responsibilities:
Manage the full supply chain lifecycle of assigned orders: order verification, documentation checks and seller dispatch coordination.
Monitor deliveries, collect Proof of Delivery (POD), and ensure quality and compliance requirements are met.
Track payments and customer credit limits as per SOPs and payment terms.
Maintain OTIF (On-Time In-Full) delivery performance of 85% or higher, and escalate exceptions early.
Validate documents: customer and seller POs, proforma and tax invoices, e-way bills, Mill Test Certificates (MTC) and delivery proofs.
Coordinate with transporters, fleet owners and drivers, and visit seller locations and transporter hubs when needed.

Desired Candidate Profile:
Graduate or postgraduate in Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics or Engineering.
2–6 years in operations, supply chain, logistics or customer operations; steel experience preferred, bitumen or commodity exposure a plus.
Working knowledge of ERP, CRM and AI-enabled productivity tools.
Strong English and Hindi communication, stakeholder management, attention to detail and a bias for action.

Why Join Us:
Join a start-up from the house of Tata. Build the India Stack with a nation-first vision of uplifting SMEs, in a fast-paced culture built on Integrity, Pioneering, Unity, Responsibility and Excellence. You get high autonomy through agile cross-functional teams, and you will work on SME-focused products. Benefits include a hybrid work model, need-based health, wellness and childcare leaves, Tata group employee benefits, and medical, term life and personal accident insurance.


Skills: Order Management, Supply Chain, Logistics, OTIF, E-way Bill, MTC, Steel, Bitumen, ERP, Stakeholder Management .

If this sounds like you, apply now and be part of the Tata nexarc journey.

Description:
SUMMARY
Summary
We are seeking dynamic and result-oriented Sales & Application Engineers to join our team, offering an exciting career path for Diploma and Engineering graduates. This pivotal role combines technical expertise with business development to drive revenue growth and foster strong client partnerships. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving territory-specific sales targets, identifying new market opportunities, and delivering tailored technical solutions that meet customer needs while maintaining a deep understanding of market trends and competitor activities.

Responsibilities
Achieve assigned sales targets specific to the designated territory.
Identify and cultivate new business relationships with customers, OEMs, and industrial accounts.
Generate business opportunities through strategic market visits and proactive lead generation.
Conduct regular on-site customer visits and facilitate detailed technical discussions.
Promote product offerings and provide appropriate technical solutions to client challenges.
Manage the sales cycle from generating enquiries to following up on quotations and converting opportunities into confirmed orders.
Maintain robust customer relationships to encourage repeat business and long-term loyalty.
Monitor market trends, track competitor activities, and identify emerging business opportunities.
Accurately maintain CRM records and sales reports to ensure data integrity.



Requirements
A Diploma or Engineering degree in a relevant technical field.
Strong passion for technical sales, business development, and customer relationship management.
Proven ability to build and maintain effective relationships with diverse clients.
Excellent communication and presentation skills for technical and commercial discussions.
Capability to analyze market trends and competitor actions to drive strategic growth.
Proficiency with CRM tools and sales documentation management.
Willingness to travel and work across assigned locations including Sambalpur, Cuttack, Kolkata, Jamshedpur, and Bhilai.
Educational Qualification
B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.

Experience
Freshers are welcome.
1 3 years of relevant experience in field sales, industrial sales, technical sales or business development preferred.


Benefits
Salary Structure
Freshers:
15,000 20,000 per month.
Experienced Candidates (1 3 Years):
25,000 40,000 per month, depending on current salary and relevant experience.

Travel Allowance:
Fixed travel allowance of 8,000 per month for local travel within an approximate 40 km radius.
Travel beyond this radius may be reimbursed subject to Reporting Manager approval.
For senior-level employees, customer visit expenses will be reviewed internally on a case-by-case basis.

Description:
Back to Jobs
Pathologist-Full Time
Raipur
Lab Operations
Role summary
Managerial Responsibilities:
Overall Management of the laboratory
Consumption management
Quality management

Technical Responsibilities:
Up gradation of advanced technologies Quality of the results.
What the role entails - Key accountabilities/ responsibilities
1. Provide advice to those requesting information about the choice of tests, the use of the laboratory service and the interpretation of laboratory data.
2. Serve as an active member of the medical staff in main lab, collection center,
3. Relate and function effectively with NABL & other accrediting agencies, Appropriate administrative officials, healthcare community, the patient / clients.
4. Define, implement, and monitor standards of performance and quality improvement of the medical laboratory service orservices.
5. Monitor all processes in the laboratory to determine that reliable data is being generated.
6. Ensure availability of sufficiently qualified personnel with adequate training and experience to meet the needs of the laboratory.
7. Plan, set goals, develop, and allocate resources appropriate to the medical environment.
8. Provide effective and efficient administration of the medical laboratory service, including budget planning and control with responsible financial management, in accordance with institutional assignment of such responsibilities.
9. Provide educational programs for the medical and laboratory staff and participate in educational programs of the institution.
10. Implement a safe laboratory environment in compliance with good practice and applicable regulations.
11. Address any complaint, request, or suggestion from users of laboratory services. Ensure good staff morale.
12. Report authorization of Hematology, Biochemistry, Immunoassay, Clinical Pathology, and serology
13. Routine review of QC for all departments with review of reports including CBC, MP, PS, Reticulocyte count, Fluid routine, ICT/DCT, Blood group before approving
14. Formulate review and recheck policies for all tests and ensure compliance with the help of Lab supervisor and technicians.
15. Verification of critical, unusual, and abnormal test results before release
16. Interpret, Correlate, and generate medically significant laboratory data.
17. Attending all sorts of client queries related to test enquiries and interpretation of test results.
18. Approval of SOPs for use and ensure compliance with respect to accreditation requirements.
19. Ensure review of monthly MIS
20. Ensure results are reported within turnaround time with the help of section head.
21. Review and improvement of reports formats.
22. To identify new equipment, tests, technology, products and standardization of assays.
23. Identify needs for resources (human / equipment / infrastructure) and submit to senior management for approval.
24. Attending conferences/workshops to ensure updated knowledge about recent trends.
25. To spend time reviewing daily pendency status on reports not released as well as sample received cases to avoid patient dissatisfaction.
26. To keep a watchful eye on instrument maintenance and hygiene of lab and practice 0 tolerance in this area. Any instrument failure due to user s should be avoided totally as it affects our patient and business.
27. To ensure sample processing is not stopped due to KIT non availability.
28. To ensure that every PR is approved on time and any gaps are highlighted.
29. COL/ Lab Head should work with BU Heads in forecasting CAMP s and other seasonal activities and order KITs sufficiently.
30. To keep a close watch on technical complaints. Ensure analytical complaints get logged, DE flagging is minimized. For recorded complaints and initiate proper CAPA and must also discuss in weekly calls with the team on learning and preventive actionsand timely escalation of analytical complaints/ Legal threats
31. To spend quality time on understanding patient and customer VOC especially on cases we are not resolving on time. COL/Lab Head should guide the team to resolve issues on time andsupport them wherever technical input is required.
32. To participate in weekly meetings along with BU/SBU Heads to resolve issues as well as seek support wherever needs from nontechnical team.
33. To take responsibility to train the non-technical team for better business and customer engagement.
34. COL/Lab Head must contribute at least 8 hours in a month in training and sharing knowledge to the team through a formal mechanism.
35. To promote MHL test to larger communities of clinician through KOL Connects. They must use our report as a tool to promote test by recommending new test based on diagnosis in the report.
36. To make time at least once a month to meet B2B clients, collection centers, customers to understand the pulse of the market.
37. To follow guidelines objectively as per MHL Policy and ensure a culture of data-based decision making and discussions; hence every month compliance is very important. It is at most importance for to have self-Compliance from every lab and noncompliance is given utmost importance for closure.
38. To give sufficient time to check and review the Lab managers /Technical team on quality, material consumption and technical performance.
39. Ensure that processes needed for the quality management system are established, implemented, and maintained.
40. Reporting to laboratory management, at the level at which decisions are made on laboratory policy, objectives, and resources, on the performance of the quality management system and any need for improvement.
41. Ensuring the promotion of awareness of users needs and requirements throughout the laboratory organization.
What we are looking for in you
Excellent communication and analytical skill.
Working With
Lab Operations Team
Role demands (Travel)
Yes
Stakeholder interfaces
Yes
What we promise to you
A strong growth prospective.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
Purpose of the role

The face of the D2C platform in the physical market. Visit mechanics, roadside garages, small workshops, and truck operators in an assigned territory. Demonstrate the platform, register new buyers, facilitate the first purchase, and ensure the buyer can use the app independently. This role converts an unorganized market buyer into a digital platform user.

Key Responsibility
Cover assigned pin codes daily visit mechanics, garages, and small fleet operators to introduce the D2C platform
Register new buyers on the platform (app install + profile creation) target 15+ new registrations per day
Demonstrate app search (by vehicle model and part name), part selection, payment, and delivery tracking
Facilitate the buyer's first online spare parts purchase stay with them through the transaction
Follow up within 7 days of first purchase to ensure delivery satisfaction and resolve any issues
Capture buyer feedback on platform gaps: parts not found, confusing UX, delivery complaints report weekly
Maintain a daily activity log: shops visited, registrations done, first purchases facilitated
Attend weekly territory review with Category Manager / Lead BD
Participate in platform training sessions when new features or categories are launched

Qualification & Experience

13 years in field sales, FMCG distribution, insurance agency, or fintech outreach roles
Knowledge of commercial vehicles or spare parts market strongly preferred
Smartphone proficiency; able to demonstrate app fluently in local language
High energy and comfort with ground-level market work workshops, roadside interactions
Local language fluency essential; Hindi and regional language preferred
Diploma Holder from Mechanical Background

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Prepare ingredients for cooking, including portioning, chopping, and storing food. Wash and peel fresh fruits and vegetables. Weigh, measure, and mix ingredients. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklist. Prepare cold foods. Operate ovens, stoves, grills, microwaves, and fryers. Test foods to determine if they have been cooked sufficiently. Monitor food quality while preparing food. Set-up and break down work station. Serve food in proper portions onto proper receptacles. Wash and disinfect kitchen area, tables, tools, knives, and equipment. Check and ensure the correctness of the temperature of appliances and food.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATION
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

JOB SUMMARY
Areas of responsibility include Restaurants/Bars and Room Service, if applicable. Assists in the daily supervision restaurant operations and assists with menu planning, maintains sanitation standards and assists servers and hosts on the floor during peak meal periods. Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction. Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then implements plan.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting in Management of Restaurant Team
- Handles employee questions and concerns.
- Monitors employees to ensure performance expectations are met.
- Provides feedback to employees based on observation of service behaviors.
- Assists in supervising daily shift operations.
- Supervises restaurant and all related areas in the absence of the Director of Restaurants or Restaurant Manager.
- Participates in department meetings by communicating a clear and consistent message regarding the departmental goals to produce desired results.
Conducting Day-to-Day Restaurant Operations
- Ensures all employees have proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.
- Communicates to Chef and Restaurant Manager any issues regarding food quality and service levels.
- Ensures compliance with all restaurant policies, standards and procedures.
- Monitors alcohol beverage service in compliance with local laws.
- Manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Performs all duties of restaurant employees and related departments as necessary.
- Opens and closes restaurant shifts.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.
- Encourages employees to provide excellent customer service within guidelines.
- Handles guest problems and complaints, seeking assistance from supervisor as necessary.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Assists in the review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Meets and greets guests.
Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Supervises on-going training initiatives.
- Uses all available on the job training tools for employees.
- Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
- Coaches and counsels employees regarding performance on an on-going basis.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Assists servers and hosts on the floor during meal periods and high demand times.
- Recognizes good quality products and presentations.
- Supervises daily shift operations in absence of Restaurant Manager.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Develop short-term and long-term mine plans, bench sequencing, and overburden (OB) stripping strategy using mine planning software (e.g., Minex, AutoCAD, Deswik).
Execute surface miner deployment planning, bench height/width dimensions, and haul road gradient design suited to local geo-mining conditions.
Plan infrastructure layouts including sumps, drainage diversions, check dams, haul roads, and monsoon preparedness measures.
2. Statutory Clearances & Regulatory Compliance
Prepare documentation and support technical liaisoning for stage-wise Forest Clearance (FC-1 & FC-2), Environmental Clearance (EC), and Mining Lease execution.
Assist in obtaining statutory permissions from the Directorate General of Mines Safety (DGMS), Coal Controllers Organisation (CCO), State Pollution Control Board (SPCB), and Central Ground Water Authority (CGWA).
Coordinate pre-mining geotechnical studies, baseline monitoring, and public hearing procedures for project approval.
3. Land Acquisition & Pre-Mining Infrastructure Support
Collaborate with the Land, Liaison & External Affairs teams on DGPS boundary demarcation, surface feature surveys, and cadastral mapping.
Assist in identifying Compensatory Afforestation (CA) land, preparing land schedules, and conducting sample tree enumeration for statutory clearances.
Coordinate boundary pillaring and NOC clearances for infrastructure/utility diversions (powerlines, roads, water channels).
4. Operational Oversight & Safety Management
Supervise drilling, blasting design, and surface excavation, maintaining fragmentation control, powder factor efficiency, and vibration mitigation within statutory limits.
Implement the mine Safety Management System (SMS) in strict compliance with the Mines Act 1952, Coal Mines Regulations (CMR), and DGMS directives.
Conduct risk assessments, job safety analyses, toolbox talks, and regular safety audits across the project area.
5. Quality Control & Contractor Management
Monitor coal seam correlation, sampling, and coal quality grade assurance (GCV & Proximate analysis) to meet captive requirements.
Scrutinize technical tender specifications, monitor Mine Developer-cum-Operator (MDO) / OB contractor performance, and verify volume measurements.

SUMMARY
Summary
We are seeking dynamic and result-oriented Sales & Application Engineers to join our team, offering an exciting career path for Diploma and Engineering graduates. This pivotal role combines technical expertise with business development to drive revenue growth and foster strong client partnerships. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving territory-specific sales targets, identifying new market opportunities, and delivering tailored technical solutions that meet customer needs while maintaining a deep understanding of market trends and competitor activities.

Responsibilities
Achieve assigned sales targets specific to the designated territory.
Identify and cultivate new business relationships with customers, OEMs, and industrial accounts.
Generate business opportunities through strategic market visits and proactive lead generation.
Conduct regular on-site customer visits and facilitate detailed technical discussions.
Promote product offerings and provide appropriate technical solutions to client challenges.
Manage the sales cycle from generating enquiries to following up on quotations and converting opportunities into confirmed orders.
Maintain robust customer relationships to encourage repeat business and long-term loyalty.
Monitor market trends, track competitor activities, and identify emerging business opportunities.
Accurately maintain CRM records and sales reports to ensure data integrity.


Requirements
A Diploma or Engineering degree in a relevant technical field.
Strong passion for technical sales, business development, and customer relationship management.
Proven ability to build and maintain effective relationships with diverse clients.
Excellent communication and presentation skills for technical and commercial discussions.
Capability to analyze market trends and competitor actions to drive strategic growth.
Proficiency with CRM tools and sales documentation management.
Willingness to travel and work across assigned locations, including Sambalpur, Cuttack, Kolkata, Jamshedpur, and Bhilai.
Educational Qualification
B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.

Experience
Freshers are welcome.
1 3 years of relevant experience in field sales, industrial sales, technical sales or business development preferred.


Benefits
Salary Structure
Freshers:
15,000 20,000 per month.
Experienced Candidates (1 3 Years):
25,000 40,000 per month, depending on current salary and relevant experience.

Travel Allowance:
Fixed travel allowance of 8,000 per month for local travel within an approximate 40 km radius.
Travel beyond this radius may be reimbursed subject to Reporting Manager approval.
For senior-level employees, customer visit expenses will be reviewed internally on a case-by-case basis.

Swiggy is Indias leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. * Supervise daily maintenance and repair activities of ambulances and support vehicles
* Ensure maximum ambulance uptime and immediate response to breakdowns

* Leadership and team management skills
* Problem-solving and quick decision-making ability
* Basic computer skills (MS Excel / fleet maintenance software)
* Good communication and coordination skills
* 24/7 operational environment
* On-call duty for emergencies
* Workshop and field-based work
Candidate should be willing to work anywhere in Chhattisgarh.

Key Responsibilities

1. IT Support & Troubleshooting

Provide first-level technical support for hospital staff on IT-related issues.
Troubleshoot hardware, software, printer, and system problems.
Install and configure desktops, laptops, and peripheral devices.

2. Network & Infrastructure Support

Support LAN/WAN connectivity across hospital departments.
Monitor network performance and report issues to the IT team.

Support database backups and routine system maintenance tasks.
Monitor system performance and report irregularities.

4. IT Security & Data Protection

Follow hospital IT security policies and procedures.
Assist in antivirus management, system updates, and patching.
Support implementation of data security practices.

5. Documentation & Reporting

Maintain records of IT assets, incidents, and support requests.
Assist in documenting IT procedures and troubleshooting guides.

Roles and Responsibilities
Responsible for efficiency of Operations of 108/112 Ambulances in the assigned Cluster, comprising 3-4 districts.
Ensure effective utilization & engagement of human resources in the Region and provide leadership to the team of EMEs and 100-120 ambulance staff in the various districts of the region.
Develop and Implement plans for strengthening interface with the Partners in the region & play a key role in expansions and major business plans for the Region besides facilitating periodical meetings with stakeholders.

Effectively manage and motivate Field manpower for smooth operations.
Ensure cordial relations with the Media, conduct Press meets periodically and ensure optimal media coverage about 108 services in the assigned area of operations.
Develop comprehensive plans to conduct EM training programs in the assigned territory
Responsible for conducting brand awareness campaigns/activities/public engagement activities Presentations, Events, co- branding etc.

Description:
Job Title: Emergency Management Executive
Organization: EMRI Green Health Services (Formerly Known as GVK EMRI)
Project: Prestigious 108 Emergency Response Project

Job Description:

1. Manage ambulance operations including duty rosters, attendance, leave coordination, and fleet maintenance to ensure 247 emergency readiness.
2. Coordinate with District Managers, AOs, EMTs, hospitals, and government stakeholders for smooth emergency service delivery.
3. Lead volunteer induction programs, awareness demos, and community outreach initiatives.
4. Ensure compliance through record maintenance, audit closure, disciplinary actions, and quality monitoring of pre-hospital care.
5. Drive reporting, inventory/indent management, and performance tracking to strengthen the life-saving 108 emergency response system.

Candidate should be qualified in B.E/B.tech - Automobile/Mechanical stream
Candidates should be willing to work anywhere in Chhattisgarh state.
AboutCompany: EMRI handles medical, police and fire emergencies through the ' 108 Emergency service'. This is a free service delivered through state- of -art emergency call response centres. Operating in the Public Private Partnership (PPP) mode.

Description:
Process Executive
You will run defined operational processes to a written standard: working through batches of data, documents or records, checking them against a rule set, logging what does not fit, and reviewing completed work before it goes back to a client. It is detailed, structured work with a clear definition of correct.
Currently hiring On-site, Risali Monday to Saturday No experience required
What you will do
Process batches of data, documents or records against a written procedure
Verify information against named, reliable sources
Log exceptions and flag anything the procedure does not cover
Run review passes on completed work before it is released
Keep simple records of volume, turnaround and errors
Suggest improvements to the procedure when you find a better way
What we look for
A graduate in any discipline
Accuracy and patience with detailed work
Clear written English
Comfort with a computer and basic Excel
Willingness to follow a documented process exactly
The confidence to say when that process is wrong
What we do not require
Prior BPO or office experience
Spoken English fluency or telephone confidence
Any technical or coding background
A specific degree subject or percentage
Willingness to work nights we will not ask

Description:
Roles Responsibilities:
Develop, implement, and monitor site project safety policies, audits, and risk assessments
Ensure compliance with EHS regulations, statutory requirements, and safety standards.
Conduct safety training, orientations, and toolbox talks for all personnel.
Investigate incidents and near misses and implement corrective actions.
Track safety performance, maintain records, and report to management.
Coordinate with contractors, project teams, and authorities on audits and approvals.
Promote a proactive safety culture across the site.
Experience Qualification:
Bachelors Degree in Safety Engineering, Mechanical, Electrical, or any relevant engineering discipline.
Minimum 10-12 Yrs site level experience is required
Knowledge of industrial safety standards, EHS regulations, and statutory compliance.
Preferred: Postgraduate diploma/degree in Occupational Health Safety or Industrial Safety.
Preferred Certification: NEBOSH, IOSH, or equivalent safety management qualification.
Experience in power plants project, heavy industry, or large project sites is desirable.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Promote awareness of brand image internally and externally. Use sales techniques that maximize revenue while maintaining existing guest loyalty to Marriott. Communicate with potential owners via telephone to set up preview package sales/tours. Encourage guests or callers to purchase or schedule preview package sales/tours. Explain details and requirements related to attending a sales presentation to potential owners. Verify that individuals meet eligibility requirements for preview package sales/tours prior to scheduling a tour for a Marriott vacation club property. Determine and give complimentaries to guests as gifts for their patronage (e.g., rewards points, show tickets). Perform general office duties to support Sales Marketing (e.g., filing, sending emails, typing, faxing). Receive, record, and relay messages accurately, completely, and legibly.
Assist management in training, evaluating, counseling, and motivating and coaching employees; serve as a role model and first point of contact of the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process. Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect the privacy and security of guests and coworkers. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

1. Conduct regular field audits of ambulances, crews, and operations across assigned areas.
2. Evaluate adherence to clinical protocols and operational guidelines.
3. Perform surprise inspections to assess real-time service quality.
4. Monitor ambulance readiness, hygiene standards, and equipment availability.
5. Review patient care records, case sheets, and treatment documentation.
6. Conduct call audits and evaluate quality of patient care delivery.
7. Ensure compliance with 108 operational SOPs, statutory, and regulatory requirements.
8. Verify infection control practices, vehicle documentation, and license validity.

Description:
Job Title: Business Development Manager
APC Channel

Company: Axis Max life Insurance

Job Description

Axis Max Life insurance is looking for experienced and result Oriented professionals for its Agency partner Channel (APC).
The Candidates will be responsible for developing business through Agency Partners, Partners Recruitment, Relationship Management, and Achieving assigned business targets,

Key Responsibilities

Recruit and onboard new Agency partners.
Develop and manage relationships with existing partners.
Drive life insurance business through the partner network.
support partners in advisor recruitment and activations
Achieve assigned business and sales targets
Monitors partner productivity and business performance
Conduct regular partner meetings and business reviews
Provide product knowledge and sales supports to partners
Ensure compliance with company policies and regulatory guidelines

Experience

Graduate in any discipline
3-6 years of experience in Life insurance sales
Experience in APC / Agency Channel / Agency partner channel preferred
Relationship management skills
Good knowledge of life insurance product
Target Oriented with strong business development skills

Interested candidates share CV

Divya Singh
Email;divya.11@axismaxlife.com
Mobile : 8287549551
CompanyAddress: Plot No. 90-C,Sector-18,Urban Estate, GURGAON, Haryana, India

Description:
Job Purpose
"This position is open with Bajaj Finance ltd."
Engage with channel partners to build and strengthen relationship. Build distribution for Rural consumer Product Finance and distribution mapping for Rural consumer Product Finance. Duties and Responsibilities
Achieving exceeding Business goals and targets for Consumer Durables -Creating a strong compliant sales culture to drive acquisitions, profitability and employee development-Manage the Distribution through Dealer relations and servicing the Dealers, and their concerns in an appropriate manner.-Managing the Delinquency of the business sourced to ensure health of portfolio
-Effectively engage Operations Risk teams to understand and contribute to overall processes profitability across locations
-Identifying the need of sales training, analyzing changing market trends, channel deployment etc. Also giving feedback suggestions to the RSM/NSM -Ensure implementation of promotional plans contests and suggesting new and innovating promotion plan for the area of work.-Recruiting and Retaining high performers. -Ensuring highest levels of employee relationship, motivation engagement to drive results high levels of employee satisfaction.-Supporting collections team in ensuring 100% collections MAJOR CHALLENGES:
-struggling to find and keep talented employees. -Customer always seeking the latest technology, most efficient service, instant gratification, and a customized experience. -Retaining employees as they have banking sector as an option available.
-Online Market as well effected / impacted in filed. DECISIONS ; - Implement a sales management process that guides the team's decision on how to effectively manage this time and decide who to spend with. -Connect with field Teams Spending the Maximum time to Our Team. Link performance with rewards and recognition as par their achievement. -Design and Develop a Customer (Dealer and Business Partner's) Visit frequency plan for their field. INTERACTIONS: Internal Clients:Roles you need to interact with inside the organization to enable success in your day to day work - Provide market and product related feedback to HO (Managers / Senior hierarchy )-Credit Team for high ticket approvals -Operation for customer services and file disbursement -Risk team for approval declined cases due to specific reasons e.g. policy-FCU Team for fraud cases validation -Collections for bucket cases and FEMI cases or problematic cases External Clients: Roles you need to interact with outside the organization to enable success in your day to day work :External Clients include dealer and business Partners. Identify New key dealer outlets New Business Partners to support sales External Clients include dealer and business Partners. Identify New key dealer outlets New Business Partners to support sales by Achieving Origination Targets. ASSC (Authorized Sales Service Center), Serving the existing external walk in customers at dealers and Increasing business opportunities.
a) Qualifications :
- Graduation / Post graduation
- Strong analytical skills to drive channel performance and drive profitability
- People Relationship Management skills
- Excellent Communication and Negotiation Skill
b) Work Experience:
- Graduation / Post graduation with 4 to 6 years and MBA with 3-4 years of relevant experience in sales
DIMENSIONS
(Key numerical data which will reflect the scope and scale of activities concerning this job)

Financial Dimensions
(These should be quantifiable numerical amounts)
As a manager, you'll need to define Business scope. Defining what is needed is the first step. setting Business goals and allocating to Team. the Business scope should have a tangible objective for the organization
- In Festive seasons minimum 15k cases in a quarter
- Normal days minimum 9K cases in a quarter
- Cross sell targets 650 IPC to be maintained



Other Dimensions
(Significant volume dimensions associated with the job)
Total Team Size: 29
Number of Direct Reports: 6
Number of Indirect Reports: 23 (off role)
Number of Outsourced employees: 18 (ASCC)
Number of locations: in the range 5 to 7
Number of products: 2

Greetings for Capgemini!

We are hiring for SAP TM Functional Consultant kindly go through with below JD and details.

if JD is matching to your profile kindly share updated resume and details on
chaduvula-vinay.a.kumar@capgemini.com

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced SAP TM Functional Consultant with 6 to 15 years of experience in Transportation Management to design, implement, and support SAP TM solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong business process knowledge in logistics and supply chain, along with hands-on experience in end-to-end implementations and system integration.
Locations: Pune / Mumbai / Bangalore / Gandhinagar
Notice Period: Immediate to 30 days
Total Exp
Relevant Exp SAP TM/ SAP S/4HANA TM / Embedded TM
End to End implementation projects -
Notice Period
Current CTC
Expected CTC
Current Company
Current Location
Preferred Location -
Having all previous companies documents Offer Letter/Reliving letter/PF/Experience letter – Y/N
If Ex Employee of Capgemini Kindly share reliving letter and emp id –

Key Responsibilities
1. Implementation & Configuration
Lead and participate in end-to-end SAP TM implementations
Configure SAP TM modules based on business requirements
Design scalable and efficient transportation management solutions
2. Business Process Expertise
Analyze client business processes and identify improvement areas
Provide functional expertise in transportation planning and execution
Translate business needs into functional specifications
3. Integration
Ensure seamless integration with:
SAP SD (Sales & Distribution)
SAP MM (Materials Management)
SAP EWM or other logistics systems (preferred)
Work with technical teams on interfaces (CIF, middleware integration)
4. Transportation & Freight Management
Configure and manage:
Transportation networks
Freight Units and Freight Orders
Carrier selection and tendering
Charge and cost management
Handle freight settlement, invoicing, and cost distribution
5. Order & Planning Management
Implement:
Order integration with SAP TM
Planning profiles and optimizer configuration
Scheduling and execution processes
6. Master Data Management
Maintain master data including:
Business Partners
Products
Transportation resources
Dangerous goods
7. Testing & Support
Prepare functional specifications and test cases
Support SIT, UAT, and production deployment
Track and resolve defects in collaboration with technical teams

Description:
About the Role
Were building and growing our hyperlocal (on-demand) logistics business within Delhivery, and are for someone who can take ownership from day zero acquiring customers, shaping the GTM motion, and building a repeatable revenue engine.
You will operate as a full-stack sales owner — from identifying opportunities within SMEs and enterprises to closing deals and ensuring long-term account success. The role requires a mix of hunting (acquisition) and farming (growth & retention), with a strong bias toward building from scratch.

What You’ll Do
Own the end-to-end sales cycle: prospecting pitching closing account growth for leads with monthly wallet potential of 5L to 10L
Acquire and onboard SMEs and enterprise customers onto Delhivery’s hyperlocal logistics platform
Build a strong pipeline through outbound efforts, partnerships, and market mapping
Work closely with operations to ensure a seamless fulfillment experience for customers while providing top-notch customer assistance
Drive account expansion and retention, identifying upsell/cross-sell opportunities
Develop a deep understanding of customer supply chains and last-mile needs
Contribute to GTM strategy, pricing inputs, and product feedback as an early member of the business
Lay the foundation for scaling this business line and becoming a trusted + reliable logistics partner for our customers
Who We’re Looking For
2–5 years of experience in B2B sales, with a strong focus on acquisition-led roles
Prior experience in logistics, on-demand delivery, or supply chain platforms
Strong exposure to both SME and enterprise sales
Hands-on experience with solution selling (not just transactional sales)
High ownership mindset — comfortable operating in 0-1 environments
Strong understanding of last-mile logistics, fulfillment challenges, and operational nuances

What Makes This Role Different
You’re not inheriting a book of business — you’re building it
Direct impact on shaping a new vertical within Delhivery
Opportunity to scale into a larger role as the business grows
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.

Job description

SAP MDG Consultant
Location:
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli (Hybrid)
Experience:
JL5: 5-9 Years
JL6: 9-18 Years
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP MDG, Data Governance, Data Quality, Replication, Validation, Data Modeling, Workflow Configuration, Business Rules, and Master Data Management. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, and support engagements is highly preferred.
Roles & Responsibilities
Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.
Design, configure, and maintain MDG data models for Customer, Vendor, Material, Business Partner, and Financial master data.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to master data governance.
Configure MDG workflows, validations, derivations, and business rules.
Establish data governance processes, standards, and approval workflows.
Configure replication frameworks and integration with SAP and non-SAP systems.
Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.
Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP MDG experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP MDG experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP MDG experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of Master Data Management and Data Governance processes.

Data Migration Projects
Data Warehousing Concepts
Governance Risk & Compliance (GRC)
Additional Information
Do not apply if:
End User Profiles
Only Training/Certification Profiles
Non-SAP MDG Profiles
Candidates without hands-on SAP MDG implementation/support experience
Generic Data Analyst or Data Steward profiles without SAP MDG experience

Overview
Our team within the Canada Business is dedicated to delivering cutting-edge engineering solutions for water infrastructure projects. We specialize in designing and managing complex systems that ensure sustainable water supply, treatment, and distribution. Our focus is on creating resilient, efficient, and environmentally responsible solutions that support communities and industries worldwide.
We leverage Building Information Modelling (BIM) to enhance collaboration, improve design accuracy, and optimize project delivery across the entire lifecyclefrom concept and planning through construction and operation. BIM enables us to integrate civil, structural, and mechanical elements seamlessly, ensuring cost efficiency and reducing risks.
Atkins Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking a Civil 3D Designer to join our Water BIM team. This role will be based at our Bangalore & Gurugram office, contributing to world-class projects by creating detailed 3D models, coordinating multidisciplinary designs, and ensuring compliance with international standards.

Your Role

Excellent in 3D Modelling of Pipe networks (Dry and Wet), Grading, Corridors, Cut and Fill using Civil 3D.
Excellent in Multidisciplinary 3D model coordination using Navisworks
Check model for Stage Completeness, Dimensional accuracy against modelling standards.
Ensure Level of Quality control for Completeness and adherence to company standards of all Drawings produced.
Stay informed the best practices & methodologies in BIM implementation.
Able to perform and coordinate on multi-disciplinary projects and effective implementation of BEP and BIM workflows.
Ability to determine appropriate record/As-built, test pit, drawings and point cloud data.
Identify and solve drawing/ modelling problems and troubleshooting Civil 3D issues.
Identify new logical ideas for automation to improve efficiency.
In depth knowledge of engineering drawings and specifications. Ability to work using engineers calculations and design in producing drawings / 3D modelling.
Ensures accuracy and adapts a detail-conscious approach; carefully checks details at each stage to avoid errors.
Ensure timely planning and delivery by proactively managing assumptions, dependencies, and risk.
Follow GTC BMS processes to projects
Use of Vehicle tracking

Microsoft Office (Excel, Word)

Strong understanding of: Civil engineering drawings and construction methods
Ability to work with Survey data, point clouds
Good communication and coordination skills
Attention to detail and quality-focused approach
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
