Identify account whitespace and create proactive propositions for priority clients and prospects.
Partner with Sales and Account teams to originate, qualify and convert large BPS and transformation opportunities.
Build senior client relationships across Customer Experience, Sales, Customer Success, Support and Operations.

Solutioning & Presales
Lead solution strategy for complex BPS/BPO, managed services and operations-transformation deals.
Design global operating models spanning people, process, technology, AI, locations, governance and commercials.
Lead discovery, proposals, due diligence, solution presentations and deal defence.
Develop business cases focused on productivity, customer experience, revenue enablement and cost-to-serve.

Technology BPS Domain Leadership
Contact Centre/CX: omnichannel service, customer acquisition and onboarding, customer success, retention, self-service, quality and workforce optimisation.
Sales Operations: sales and presales support, CRM operations, deal desk, lead and pipeline operations, partner operations, renewals and RevOps.
Technical/Product Support: helpdesk, L0-L2 support, case management, knowledge management, troubleshooting, self-service and engineering escalation.\

AI-led BPS Transformation
Define the GenAI and Agentic AI agenda across CX, Sales Operations and Technical Support.
Apply process redesign, intelligent automation, analytics and AI to transform end-to-end workflows.
Develop use cases including intelligent triage, agent assist, knowledge discovery, quality automation, case summarisation, next-best action and workflow orchestration.

Offering & Practice Leadership
Build industry-specific BPS offerings, solution playbooks and go-to-market propositions.
Develop differentiated propositions with relevant technology and ecosystem partners.
Create market-facing thought leadership, client propositions and case studies.
Build and mentor Technology domain consultants, solution architects and presales specialists.

Desired Candidate Profile
18+ years overall experience with 10+ years in Solutioning, Presales, Consulting, BPS/BPO or Transformation.
Strong Technology/Hi-Tech industry experience across areas such as Consumer Technology, Semiconductor, Software, Platforms or digital businesses.
Proven experience shaping and winning large BPS/BPO, outsourcing, managed-services or transformation engagements.
Strong expertise across CX/Contact Centre, Sales Operations and Technical Support.
Good understanding of GenAI, Agentic AI, intelligent automation and analytics applied to business operations.
Proven track record of pipeline creation, account expansion and large-deal wins.
Strong executive presence and ability to influence senior client stakeholders.
Bachelors degree in Engineering, Technology, Business or a related discipline; MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification preferred.

Description:
Role Overview
We are hiring a Sales Closing Head to lead the end-to-end customer conversion and deal closure charter for a marquee ultra-luxury residential asset based out of our Gurugram office. This role will own the closing engine for the project, including lead-to-nett. conversion, customer engagement, site sales performance, negotiations, commercial structuring, booking closures, and transition into collections / post-sales teams. The mandate is to maximize booking conversion and realization by combining premium client handling with rigorous sales discipline, strong negotiation capability, and flawless execution.
Key Responsibilities
Own overall site sales closures, booking conversion, realization, and revenue delivery for the asset.
Lead the closing charter across digital, tele calling, referrals, channel-led opportunities, and relationship-driven premium buyers.
Manage and drive the lead-to-VC-to-booking funnel, ensuring strong conversion at every stage.
Personally lead high-value negotiations and closures for marquee inventory with HNIs, UHNIs, entrepreneurs, CXOs, NRIs, and family-office type buyers.
Partner with Asset head and Sales Strategy on commercial closure strategy, including negotiation guardrails, product fitment, offer structuring, and premium inventory monetization.
Partner closely with sourcing, channel sales, and marketing teams to ensure high-quality pipeline flow and strong closure productivity.
Build and lead a high-performance closing team with strong process discipline, premium customer engagement, and consistent follow-through.
Ensure a best-in-class customer experience including project presentation, objection handling, commercial discussions, and booking confidence.
Maintain strong governance on documentation, booking forms, legal-commercial coordination, CRM hygiene, and collections handover.
Provide leadership with clear visibility on pipeline quality, booking forecasts, conversion ratios, sales objections, and negotiation trends.
Ideal Candidate Profile
1215 years of total experience in sales, with strong exposure to luxury / premium residential real estate.
At least 58 years in leadership roles managing site sales, direct closures, customer conversion, and premium deal-making.
Proven experience in handling high-ticket residential inventory and converting affluent customer segments.
Strong understanding of Gurugram / NCR luxury residential market dynamics and buyer behaviour.
Demonstrated track record of driving site sales conversion, direct customer closures, and strong realization outcomes.
Strong commercial judgment across negotiation, pricing fitment, inventory movement, objection handling, and closure structuring.
High personal polish, maturity, and ability to engage credibly with premium clientele and senior stakeholders. Source
Preferred Background / Pedigree
Candidates from leading or premium residential developers will be strongly preferred, especially from organizations such as DLF, Oberoi Realty, Total Environment, SOBHA, or similar high-end residential / branded residential platforms.
Relevant profiles from luxury sales, wealth advisory, hospitality-led residential sales, or premium client engagement environments may also be considered, provided they bring strong real estate closure capability.
Education: MBA / PGDM preferred for senior commercial leadership roles.
Pedigree: Candidates from reputed Tier 1 / Tier 2 institutions preferred.
Weightage: Proven success in luxury residential sales, direct customer closure, negotiation maturity, and premium relationship handling will matter more than academic brand alone.
What Success Looks Like
Strong lead-to -booking conversion
High-quality marquee closures and negotiation outcomes
Healthy realization versus plan
Smooth booking-to-collections handover
Premium customer experience through the point of closure
Strong market positioning and commercially disciplined sell-through

Core Finance Change Delivery
Key Responsibilities
Avaloq - Monthly Goca Maintenance

Analyse demands regarding Grca, FTP and Goca changes, and provide clear guidance and conclusion in the usage of these figures for each Private Bank entities using the Avaloq Core Banking System.
Avaloq Changes

=>Testing Balancing Rules lifecycle for each Product
=>Testing Booking rules lifecycle for each Product - analysing the usage of the Bookind in Avaloq

Data Controls
Organize and perform controls on important amount of data, highlight the inconsistencies that might appear, understand the reasons of these, and liaise with concerned stakeholders to implement needed changes.

Product Owner Administration
Follow up on Product Owner subjects (jiras).

Customers / Stakeholders

Be accountable to present clear solutions within changes and implementation for new requirements

Leadership & Teamwork
Collaborative behaviours, actively share ideas / approaches with the rest of the GPB Finance teams
Utilise fully the onshore / offshore operating model

Operational Effectiveness & Control
Ensure all work is completed in accordance with appropriate Group Standard and practices
Provide assurance that any process risks identified are highlighted and managed as appropriate
Support all regulatory and compliance matters and the management of operational risk

Major Challenges
Be able to cover a wide range of financial matters and products from accounting perspective
Partner with the Finance teams to achieve a strong and accurate maintenance of the Avaloq Chart of Account

Management of Risk
Ensure all actions take account of the likelihood of operational risk occurring
Addressing any areas of concern in conjunction with line management and/or the appropriate department

Observation of Internal Controls
Maintains internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators
Understands, follows and demonstrates compliance with all relevant internal and external rules, regulations and procedures that apply to the conduct of the business in which the jobholder is involved, specifically Internal Controls and any Compliance policy including, inter alia, the Group Compliance policy

Requirements
Knowledge of IFRSs and awareness of banking/finance concepts
Strong working knowledge in MS Office tools
Being able to handle simple source systems with no guidance and complex source systems with limited guidance
Proven evidence of strong communication skills used to successfully lead, coordinate and conclude business discussion sessions
Ability to initiate and drive discussions with key stakeholders to effective conclusion
Capable of organizing and managing day to day activities/initiatives for self & team independently
Good team player with proven ability of working with colleagues within & outside of own functional area/team
Ability to multi-task on activities within & outside of the immediate functional area/team
Demonstrate capability to learn and improve self & team's performance on an on-going basis
Proven team working and change management skills
Mind set of continuous improvement and aiming for excellence
Consistently demonstrate integrity, fairness and professional conduct

What additional skills will be good to have?
Knowledge of FTP Chart of Account, GRCA and FTP Global mappings

Description:
Role Overview
We are hiring a Channel Sourcing Head to lead the end-to-end channel-led demand generation and sourcing charter for a marquee ultra-luxury residential asset based out of our office in Gurugram. This role will own the full sourcing engine for the project, including channel partner strategy, broker network development, key account activation, lead generation through CPs, site visit funnel creation, and pipeline quality management. The mandate is to build a high-productivity sourcing ecosystem that consistently drives qualified opportunities into the project while maintaining strong market visibility, premium brand alignment, and disciplined channel governance.
Key Responsibilities
Own overall channel-led lead generation, sourcing volumes, site visit creation, and qualified pipeline delivery for the asset.
Design and drive the channel sourcing strategy across brokers, CPs, strategic intermediaries, wealth networks, and relationship-led ecosystem partners.
Build, activate, and manage a high-quality channel partner ecosystem with strong productivity, engagement, and conversion discipline.
Identify and onboard high-potential channel partners aligned to the ultra-luxury / premium buyer segment in Gurugram and NCR.
Drive regular broker activations, relationship programs, project previews, micro-market engagement, and partner communication to improve visibility and sourcing share.
Ensure strong alignment between inventory positioning, buyer profile, and partner-led sourcing opportunities to improve lead quality.
Work closely with closing, direct sales, and marketing teams to ensure smooth handoff of sourced leads into site visits, negotiations, and closures.
Track and improve channel productivity metrics, including lead quality, visit conversion, booking contribution, repeat business, and partner effectiveness.
Maintain strong governance around partner onboarding, commercial terms, payout discipline, documentation, compliance, and CRM hygiene.
Provide leadership with clear visibility on channel pipeline, partner performance, sourcing trends, market intelligence, and competitor channel activity.
Ideal Candidate Profile
1215 years of total experience in sales, with strong exposure to luxury / premium residential real estate.
At least 58 years in leadership roles managing channel sales, sourcing-led business, partner ecosystems, and premium residential demand generation.
Proven experience in building and scaling high-quality broker / CP networks for premium or luxury projects.
Strong understanding of Gurugram / NCR luxury residential market dynamics, intermediary landscape, and buyer sourcing routes.
Demonstrated track record of driving channel-led site visits, premium lead generation, and commercially relevant pipeline creation.
Strong commercial judgment across partner selection, sourcing productivity, yield orientation, micro-market targeting, and channel incentive discipline.
High personal polish, relationship maturity, and ability to engage credibly with senior channel partners, developers, and premium external stakeholders.
What Success Looks Like
Strong channel-led lead generation and premium pipeline creation
High-quality site visit funnel generated through CPs / brokers
Productive and credible channel partner network
Strong lead quality and sourcing-to-booking contribution
Healthy alignment between partner mix, buyer profile, and inventory movement
Disciplined partner governance, CRM hygiene, and payout compliance
Strong market visibility and commercially effective channel penetration
AboutCompany:
Founded with a vision to democratise land ownership and redefine land as an investible asset in India, The House of Abhinandan Lodha (HoABL) has emerged as one of Indias fastest-growing real estate brands, known for creating aspirational, future-ready developments across marquee destinations. Driven by innovation, customer-centricity, and design excellence, HoABL has consistently offered landmark plotted developments and premium lifestyle ecosystems that combine luxury, transparency, and long-term value creation.
As part of its next phase of growth, HoABL is now expanding into the ultra-luxury residential segment with iconic new launches designed to set new benchmarks in sophistication, exclusivity, and elevated living experiences. This business represents an opportunity to help shape a category-defining luxury brand, and we are looking for exceptional talent who embody refinement, relationship excellence, commercial sharpness, and a deep understanding of affluent and HNI customer engagement.

Description:
Job Description
This role is part of the Marketing function and is responsible for driving strategy, market development, commercialization, and lifecycle management across assigned products and therapeutic areas. The Marketing team partners closely with Sales, Research & Development, Clinical, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Finance, Operations, and regional stakeholders to identify growth opportunities, accelerate adoption, and deliver sustainable business results through customer-focused strategies.
This position is based in Gurgaon, India and operates in a Flex work model, combining on-site and remote work based on business needs. Travel of approximately 35-40% is expected to support customer engagement, market development activities, internal collaboration, and business initiatives across regions.
The Marketing Manager is responsible for developing and executing product, portfolio, and market strategies that drive commercial growth and customer impact. This individual will translate customer, market, and competitive insights into actionable strategies, lead commercialization initiatives, and influence cross-functional teams to deliver measurable business outcomes. The role requires strong strategic thinking, analytical rigor, and accountability from opportunity identification through execution.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.
Develop and execute product, portfolio, and market strategies aligned with commercial and business objectives.
Analyse customer, market, competitive, and business data to identify growth opportunities, unmet needs, and emerging market trends.
Lead product planning, commercialization, launch execution, market development, and lifecycle management 
initiatives.
Define customer segmentation, product positioning, value propositions, and go-to-market strategies to improve market performance.
Partner with Sales, Research & Development, Clinical, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Finance, Operations, and regional teams to deliver strategic priorities.
Monitor business performance, evaluate return on investment, and optimise marketing programmes, resource allocation, and investments.
Influence stakeholders across functions and geographies to build alignment, support decision-making, and drive execution of key initiatives.
Manage project timelines, budgets, risks, and resources to ensure successful delivery of high-impact programmes.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline and 10+ years of experience in marketing, product management, commercial strategy, market development, or related commercial roles; MBA from a premier business school required.
Demonstrated experience developing and executing product, portfolio, or commercial strategies that delivered measurable business results.
Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and business functions.
Strong analytical capability with experience translating market, customer, competitive, and business insights into strategic recommendations.
Experience managing commercialization, product launch, market development, or lifecycle management activities.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience within MedTech, healthcare, medical devices, diagnostics, biotechnology, or life sciences industries.
Experience leading regional or multi-country marketing initiatives and influencing stakeholders across geographies.
People leadership experience, including coaching, mentoring, or managing marketing professionals.
Experience with portfolio optimisation, market access strategies, and customer engagement planning.
Advanced proficiency in business analytics, forecasting, market assessment, and strategic planning methodologies.

Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

Description:
Lead - Business Development

About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving enterprise customer acquisition and expansion across key verticals and geographies. The role demands deep industry insight, strong solutioning capability, and the ability to build executive relationships within large organizations. As a senior leader, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.

Key Responsibilities:
Drive Revenue Growth: Lead and deliver aggressive revenue targets on a monthly and quarterly basis through new customer acquisition and strategic account expansion in the logistics and supply chain domain.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert large B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.
Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-impact BD team; establish scalable processes for lead generation, funnel management, and account growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Product, Pricing, and Finance to develop compelling proposals, pilot programs, and commercial models.
Performance Tracking: Own pipeline forecasting, sales performance metrics, and revenue attribution; regularly report to executive leadership on growth performance and strategic initiatives.
Client Success & Retention: Ensure seamless client onboarding, continuous engagement, and upselling of adjacent logistics services such as reverse logistics, express delivery, or value-added services.

Preferred Background & Skills:
5+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.

Description:
Senior Manager - Risk, Fraud and Audit
Location: Mumbai/Gurgaon/Bangalore
Experience: 8-12 years
Industry: Payments (Mandatory)

About EnKash
EnKash is a full stack payments company offering a unified platform for payables, receivables, corporate cards, and expense management. Backed by key RBI licenses including PA-O & PA-P and PPI, EnKash enables merchants to automate financial operations with compliance and control.

About the Role
We are looking for a seasoned Risk & Compliance professional with strong expertise in payments for managing our PA & PPI license This role will play a critical part in strengthening risk governance, ensuring regulatory compliance, and managing fraud across payment flows, card systems, and merchant transactions. You will work at the intersection of risk, compliance, and operations, driving robust controls across both issuance and acquiring environments in a highly regulated fintech landscape. The person is expected to coordinate internally & externally with banks, regulators, FIUs, LEAs etc and help manage risk in the ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities
Fraud Risk Management & Monitoring: Design and implement end-to-end fraud prevention and detection strategies across payment gateway/acquiring flows/ issuing flows, including real-time monitoring and risk mitigation.
Fraud Investigations & Incident Response: Lead investigations, manage chargebacks/disputes, and handle fraud incidents across card transactions, merchant payments, and gateway flows, ensuring timely resolution and escalation.
Regulatory Compliance & Reporting: Ensure adherence to RBI guidelines across PAPG, PPI, including KYC/KYB, AML transaction monitoring, FIU-IND STR reporting, and regulatory submissions.
Risk Assessment & Control Framework: Conduct comprehensive risk assessments across acquiring ecosystems, identifying vulnerabilities in transaction flows, integrations, settlements, and merchant onboarding. Audit & Governance: Drive internal and external audits, strengthen governance frameworks, and ensure robust internal controls, documentation, and audit readiness.
Policy Development & Process Excellence: Develop and enhance risk, compliance, and fraud management policies/SOPs aligned with regulatory requirements and industry best practices across both ecosystems.
Stakeholder Management & Training: Collaborate with product, tech, business, and compliance teams; present risk insights and drive organization-wide awareness on fraud prevention and regulatory compliance.

What Were Looking For
8-12 years of experience in Audit, Risk, Fraud, or Compliance roles within fintech
Strong exposure to PAPG (Payment Aggregator/Payment Gateway) ecosystems and/or Prepaid Payment Instruments ecosystems.
Solid understanding of RBI regulations, including KYC/KYB, AML transaction monitoring, fraud management, and digital payments compliance
Hands-on experience in fraud risk management, transaction monitoring, and chargeback handling across cards and/or payment gateway environments
Proven experience managing internal/external audits and regulatory interactions
Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills
Managing and closing LEA/FIU queries.

Why Join EnKash?
Opportunity to work across both acquiring (PAPG) and issuance (PPI) ecosystems
Exposure to complex, high-scale payment and regulatory frameworks
High ownership role with direct impact on risk strategy and governance

Description:
Senior Associate Workforce Solutions (Dayforce)
Job description
is responsible for independently managing assigned workstreams and supporting end-to-end Dayforce HCM implementation projects across functional areas, including Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, and Talent Management, as well as technical areas such as Data Conversion, Integrations, and Reporting. The role requires strong expertise in one or more Dayforce modules, with a working understanding of related modules and cross-functional dependencies. Key responsibilities include requirements gathering, business process design, solution design, system configuration, data migration and validation, integrations, reporting, testing, cutover, and post-go-live activities. The position involves collaborating closely with clients, project managers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into effective HCM solutions, resolve implementation challenges, and ensure timely, high-quality project delivery. Additionally, the role supports regulatory compliance, process optimization, and transition to managed services while ensuring solution quality and alignment with client business objectives.
Essential Responsibilities
Support the end-to-end implementation and transformation of Dayforce HCM solutions for external clients, covering discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support, within your primary module and in coordination with other module workstreams.
Own assigned Dayforce functional workstreams, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of project milestones, deliverables, and client requirements.
Facilitate client discovery workshops and working sessions to gather requirements, document current-state HR and payroll processes, business rules, organizational structures, and data flows, validate design decisions, resolve open items, and align client needs with Dayforce capabilities.
Translate business and functional requirements into Dayforce configurations, solution design documents, configuration workbooks, and test scenarios.
Support data migration activities, including coordination of legacy data extraction, data mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and issue resolution to ensure accurate conversion into Dayforce.
Collaborate with technical and integration teams on inbound and outbound integrations between Dayforce and third-party systems, including data mapping, integration testing, error resolution, and data flow validation.
Plan and execute testing activities, including functional, system integration (SIT), user acceptance (UAT), regression, and end-to-end business process testing; support payroll parallel testing where applicable by validating calculations, analyzing variances, and reconciling results; and manage defects through resolution.
Advise clients on Dayforce capabilities, HCM business processes, regulatory compliance considerations, and leading practices, and identify opportunities for standardization, automation, and optimization by assessing manual workarounds, control gaps, and system capabilities.


Requirements
48 years of relevant experience in HCM implementation, HR technology consulting, HR transformation, or enterprise HRIS projects, including hands-on Dayforce HCM implementation experience.
Hands-on experience configuring Dayforce in at least one primary module (Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, or Talent Management), with working knowledge of cross-module dependencies.
Experience across the end-to-end Dayforce implementation lifecycle, including discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, data migration, integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover, go-live, and post-production support.
Experience independently managing a functional workstream, facilitating client workshops, translating business requirements into system solutions, troubleshooting configuration issues, and delivering documentation and project milestones.
Solid knowledge of HCM data migration, mapping, validation, reconciliation, integration testing, and defect management.

Work closely with functional teams, architects, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.

Mandatory Skills:
Strong hands-on experience in BMC Remedy AR System / BMC Helix ITSM development.
Strong knowledge of Remedy workflow customization and automation.
Experience with Forms, Active Links, Filters, Escalations, Menus, Guides, and workflow objects.

Description:
Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

Description:
Roles and Responsibilities :
We are seeking a Senior Consultant for Traffic & Revenue Forecasting to assess, develop and review traffic demand and toll revenue forecasts for greenfield and brownfield transport infrastructure projects, including those with closed tolling systems.
The role requires advanced Excel proficiency for building and auditing forecasting models, analyzing traffic counts and toll data, and conducting scenario, impact and sensitivity analyses. Responsibilities include preparing reports and presentations, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, and supporting client engagements across bid processes, due diligence, and operational reviews. 
Candidates should have 4+ years of relevant experience, a background in transport planning, engineering, economics, or related fields, and strong quantitative and communication skills. 
Experience in traffic and revenue analysis, data science, and network modelling is preferred, and the position values attention to detail, structured thinking, and the ability to work effectively under deadlines.

Description:
About The Role


Job Title -

Instructional Design - Associate

- T&O- (S&C GN)

Management Level:12 - Associate

Location:Gurugram, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Kolkata and Chennai

Must have skills:

Instructional Design OR Storyboarding OR Articulate Storyline


Good to have skills:Whatfix, walk me, ADDIE model

Experience:Minimum 0-3 year(s) of experience is required


Educational Qualification:Any Bachelors Fulltime

Job

Summary:

As a Talent & Organization (T&O) professional in the S&C Global Network, youll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. Youll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. Youll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process. Essentially, youll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!

Roles & Responsibilities:



Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as an Instructional Designer Analyst in our T&O practice, a typical day might include:
Support team/ project through various phases of learning design and development based on the identified business problem, audience profile, and evaluation methodology.
Help develop standards and templates for the proposed learning solution.
Create effective training materials mapping the clients needs using learning modalities such as Instructor-led training, Web-based training, virtual Instructor-led training, simulations, videos, interactive learning nuggets, and performance support materials.
Collaborate with stakeholders such as Subject Matter Experts, team leads, media and technology teams to support iterations to the learning material for improved business outcomes.
Creatively visualize the content and work with the visual design team to convey the course content/key messages impactfully.
Write impactful storyboards by understanding the raw content and repurposing it based on audience, content, modality, and other considerations.
Perform quality checks on the training deliverables to meet the standard quality benchmarks.
Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
Proficiency in content development and instructional design, research and information gathering, content analysis, knowledge of latest trends in the learning industry.
Understanding of industry standard design/rapid authoring tools such as Articulate/Captivate/ Lectora/ Camtasia/ SAP Enable Now/WalkMe and be comfortable with client proprietary authoring tools. An ideal candidate should be well-versed with the technical functionalities and limitations of these tools.
Work in a problem-solving global environment with Cross cultural competence.
Possess excellent interpersonal and writing skills with a strong business acumen.


Qualification

Professional & Technical

Skills:

Graduate/Post Graduate in any specialization, preferably Journalism / Mass Communication / English Literature /Advertising / Public Relations
Desired work experience:-0-3 years in instructional design and content development with an understanding of training and design strategy
Adept at gathering and understanding source content to create engaging courses based on the target audience
Experience in applying proven learning methodologies and emerging technologies for adult learning



Additional Information:
A transparent career path designed for rapid career progression
A supportive culture that is serious about training, coaching and continuous learning
A global network where only state-of-the-art tools and technologies will do
A bighearted environment with opportunities to give back to our local communities
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
ROLE SUMMARY
The Service Level Manager is responsible for tracking, measuring, analyzing, and reporting on service level performance across PwC's in-scope infrastructure managed services. You ensure SLA commitments are accurately measured against defined methodologies, reported transparently to governance forums, and that breach risks and trends are identified and escalated before they affect Client confidence.
Experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
58 years of IT operations or managed services experience, with at least 3 years in a Service Level Management or operational reporting role.
Demonstrated experience producing governance-ready SLA performance reports for senior client and leadership stakeholders.
Experience working across multi-tower infrastructure environments with multiple SLA domains.
Track record of identifying SLA breach risks and driving timely remediation through cross-functional coordination.
Technical & Process Skills
Strong working knowledge of ITIL-aligned service level management practices.
Hands-on experience with enterprise ITSM platforms, particularly ServiceNow, for SLA configuration, tracking, and reporting.
Strong proficiency in reporting and visualization tools: Power BI, ServiceNow Performance Analytics, or equivalent.
Excellent analytical and communication skills for translating performance data into actionable governance insights.
ITIL Foundation certification

Description:
SUMMARY
Summary:
We are seeking dynamic and customer-focused professionals to join our Greenlight Hub team in Gurgaon as Customer Support Specialists. This role is central to empowering new driver partners by delivering exceptional in-person support, guiding them through onboarding, and equipping them with the tools and knowledge needed to succeed. As a key member of our operations team, you will play a vital role in shaping the driver experience, ensuring smooth onboarding, resolving issues efficiently, and fostering a positive brand presence. The ideal candidate is a self-driven communicator with a passion for helping others, strong problem-solving abilities, and a proactive mindset. This is a temporary, contract position with potential for extension, offering a unique opportunity to be part of a fast-growing, mission-driven organization.

Responsibilities:
Deliver high-quality, in-person support to driver partners during onboarding and ongoing operations.
Guide new drivers through the onboarding process and introduce them to essential tools and resources.
Troubleshoot and resolve driver-related issues promptly and effectively.
Serve as a brand ambassador by promoting the company’s values and building enthusiasm among drivers.
Stay updated on company processes, tools, and policies to ensure accurate and consistent support.
Collaborate with the Driver Operations team to identify and implement process improvements.


Requirements
Any graduation degree.
Freshers or up to 1 year of experience in voice-based customer support.
Proven ability to handle in-person interactions with empathy, patience, and professionalism.
Excellent problem-solving skills and a resourceful mindset when addressing challenges.
Highly organized, self-motivated, and team-oriented with a passion for empowering others.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Strong verbal communication skills in both English and Nepali. 

Location: Gurgaon Sec 39, Pune baner, Mumbai Kurla West, Bangalore - electronic city


Benefits

NTH: 17k
+
Incentives- Upto 6k depending on performance.

Description:
Job Description


Overview
The BIM Designer/Lead Designer role at AtkinsRalis GDC Transportation focuses on delivering advanced BIM and CAD designs for major global rail and bridge infrastructure projects. Based in Bangalore or Gurgaon, the position involves creating and managing 3D models, producing detailed 2D drawings, coordinating multidisciplinary BIM workflows, and ensuring compliance with AtkinsRalis standards and international BIM practices. The role requires strong modelling expertise, understanding of BIM standards, experience with tools like MicroStation, OpenBuildings, ProjectWise/ACC, and the ability to collaborate within large engineering teams. It offers excellent growth opportunities within a world-leading infrastructure consultancy.


Your role
Should be able to develop CAD/BIM 3D Models / 2D Drawings to the standards codes
Should be able to produce medium to complex 3D modelling for bridges Rail structures
Competent in producing GA and RC detailing drawings for bridges and Rail structures.
Work with the Information Manager and project teams to assist in the development and implementation of BIM strategies, BIM Execution Plans, workflows and processes on projects in accordance with AtkinsRalis Corporate Standards, Client requirements and industry best practice.
Should be able to produce 3D models and extract information directly from models to create 2D drawings, schedules, setting out, quantities and other deliverables.
Should be able to develop models and technical content including clash detection and compliance with BEP.
Should be able to follow OCRA process in EDMS workflow
Should have strong written verbal communication in English
Experience of working in Common Data Environment (CDE) like ProjectWise / ACC
Apply AtkinsRalis Quality, Safety Environmental (QSE) standards and Business Management System (BMS).


About You
Requirements
Must have Civil Engineering background with preferable Rail domain experience.
Experience of Bridge Detailing, reinforcement detailing, structural steel detailing and schedules.

Description:
Gen AI Architect - Lead Data Scientist

Architect end-to-end enterprise GenAI solutions focusing on agentic system designs, including multi-agent orchestration, autonomous task execution, tool-use chains, LLM integration, and RAG pipelines.
- Define and enforce agentic design standards across teams covering agent communication protocols, intelligent task routing, lifecycle management, shared tool registries, and orchestration framework selection (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel Agents, cloud-based frameworks).
- Align technology choices with clients preferred cloud platforms and infrastructure, ensuring compliance, cost efficiency, portability, and seamless integration with existing governance policies and services.
- Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate objectives into agentic AI requirements, defining agent capabilities, success metrics, and MVP scope for iterative delivery.
- Establish robust observability, testing, and operational standards for agentic AI solutions including telemetry, monitoring, automated regression tests, simulation environments, and production SLAs to ensure reliability.
- Lead and mentor GenAI/Agentic AI engineering teams through architecture reviews, code-level guidance, sprint planning, and quality assurance to ensure high-quality solution delivery.
- Evaluate, select, and implement agentic AI technology stacks encompassing vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Azure AI Search), orchestration frameworks, observability tools (LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize AI), and AI-powered development tools, complemented by strong expertise in DevOps, LLMOps, containerized architectures, and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's & Master's Degree
- At least 8 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Over4years of experience in developing and scaling Generative AI projects from prototypes to enterprise production, managing throughput, latency, cost, and multi-region deployments.
- Proven expertise implementing AI interoperability protocols like MCP (Model Context Protocol) and A2A (Agent-to-Agent) at scale for seamless system integration.
- Skilled in using enterprise cloud AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, and Google Vertex AI to build and deploy production-grade agentic AI solutions.
- Advanced Python programming skills and hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks including LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and AutoGen for building robust generative AI applications.
-Deep understanding of advanced Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures (Graph RAG, Vectorless RAG, Hybrid RAG) and traditional AI/ML fundamentals like model building, fine-tuning, and evaluation.
- Strong knowledge of LLM security risksprompt injection, jailbreaking, data exfiltration, tool misuseand experience designing defense-in-depth safeguards within agentic system architectures.
- Expertise in containerization and cloud-native orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker, serverless) and event-driven architectures for scalable deployment of agentic AI workloads; holds relevant AI or solution architecture certifications.

Description:
Gen AI Data Science lead (Architect)

Architect end-to-end enterprise GenAI solutions focusing on agentic system designs, including multi-agent orchestration, autonomous task execution, tool-use chains, LLM integration, and RAG pipelines.
- Define and enforce agentic design standards across teams covering agent communication protocols, intelligent task routing, lifecycle management, shared tool registries, and orchestration framework selection (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel Agents, cloud-based frameworks).
- Align technology choices with clients preferred cloud platforms and infrastructure, ensuring compliance, cost efficiency, portability, and seamless integration with existing governance policies and services.
- Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate objectives into agentic AI requirements, defining agent capabilities, success metrics, and MVP scope for iterative delivery.
- Establish robust observability, testing, and operational standards for agentic AI solutions including telemetry, monitoring, automated regression tests, simulation environments, and production SLAs to ensure reliability.
- Lead and mentor GenAI/Agentic AI engineering teams through architecture reviews, code-level guidance, sprint planning, and quality assurance to ensure high-quality solution delivery.
- Evaluate, select, and implement agentic AI technology stacks encompassing vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Azure AI Search), orchestration frameworks, observability tools (LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize AI), and AI-powered development tools, complemented by strong expertise in DevOps, LLMOps, containerized architectures, and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's & Master's Degree
- At least 8+ years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Over4years of experience in developing and scaling Generative AI projects from prototypes to enterprise production, managing throughput, latency, cost, and multi-region deployments.
- Proven expertise implementing AI interoperability protocols like MCP (Model Context Protocol) and A2A (Agent-to-Agent) at scale for seamless system integration.
- Skilled in using enterprise cloud AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, and Google Vertex AI to build and deploy production-grade agentic AI solutions.
- Advanced Python programming skills and hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks including LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and AutoGen for building robust generative AI applications.
-Deep understanding of advanced Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures (Graph RAG, Vectorless RAG, Hybrid RAG) and traditional AI/ML fundamentals like model building, fine-tuning, and evaluation.
- Strong knowledge of LLM security risksprompt injection, jailbreaking, data exfiltration, tool misuseand experience designing defense-in-depth safeguards within agentic system architectures.
- Expertise in containerization and cloud-native orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker, serverless) and event-driven architectures for scalable deployment of agentic AI workloads; holds relevant AI or solution architecture certifications.

Job Description
Overview
You are a well-qualified principal geotechnical engineer with the drive and enthusiasm to embrace new challenges, here's an opportunity to play a prominent role in the further growth of one of the leading ground engineering groups in the world. With more than 400 ground engineering professionals world-wide, AtkinsRalis Geotechnical reputation is built on the skills, excellence and commitment of our people in all aspects of geotechnical engineering. We see a bright future as we adapt and strengthen our technical expertise in growth areas, such as Tunnelling, Mass Transit, Major Infrastructure and Energy.
Your role
have a great opportunity in our Bangalore office for an ambitious Principal Geotechnical Engineer to join our experienced and dynamic team to help deliver a range of projects primarily in the infrastructure sector (roads, rail, water and commercial / industrial development)
This is a fantastic opportunity to take a leading role as a technical reviewer in the ground engineering input to some of our most challenging projects.
About you
have a great opportunity in our Bangalore office for an ambitious Principal Geotechnical Engineer to join our experienced and dynamic team to help deliver a range of projects primarily in the infrastructure sector (roads, rail, water and commercial / industrial development).
This is a fantastic opportunity to take a leading role as a technical reviewer in the ground engineering input to some of our most challenging projects.
The successful applicant will be a Principal Geotechnical Engineer with a proven technical and project management track record.
inimum of 20+ years industrial experience in a similar organisation.
A strong academic background with a relevant degree (ideally MSc/Meng/MTech or equivalent).
Chartered status (C.Eng, P.Eng,P.E, or equivalent).
Proven experience of acting as a Principal Geotechnical Engineer in a fast-moving engineering consultancy environment.
Highly experienced with geotechnical analysis software like PLAXIS (2D3D) SLOPE/W, WALLAP, PDISP, VDISP REPUTE.
Proven Geotechnical design experience.
Excellent interpersonal and technical skills and the ability to develop and lead Geotechnical design teams.
Excellent communication skills and confidence to liaise with clients.
Good commercial track record in negotiating and running successful jobs.
Excellent report writing skills with the ability to self-check and produce accurate work.
A willingness to travel on short assignments both to the UK and overseas.
Reward benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.
About AtkinsRalis
We're AtkinsRalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
Find out more.

Prepare ingredients for cooking, including portioning, chopping, and storing food. Wash and peel fresh fruits and vegetables. Weigh, measure, and mix ingredients. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklist. Prepare cold foods. Operate ovens, stoves, grills, microwaves, and fryers. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

All About You
• Lead UI architecture and design activities for key product capabilities and user experiences.
Drive adoption of reusable component frameworks, design system standards, and modern frontend
engineering practices.
•
Partner closely with Product, UX, and Engineering teams to translate business requirements into
intuitive and scalable user experiences.
•
• Contribute to application architecture decisions across frontend and backend services.
• Promote accessibility, responsiveness, performance, and security best practices.
• Working knowledge of Agile and SAFe frameworks.
• Lead development of modern web applications using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS.
• Design and implement reusable components, shared libraries, and frontend design patterns.
• Collaborate with backend engineers to design and integrate REST APIs and microservices.
Drive adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices and tools to improve developer productivity, code
quality, testing, and documentation.
•
Drive adoption of DevOps tooling and practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and
release engineering.
•
Lead implementation of non-functional requirements (NFRs), including performance, accessibility,
reliability, and scalability.
•
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across frontend and backend systems.
Guide and coach engineers on frontend architecture, engineering principles, and technology best
practices.
•
• Promote engineering excellence through code reviews, design reviews, and technical mentoring.
• Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Your Skills
Extensive experience building enterprise-scale web applications using React and modern frontend
technologies.
•
Strong hands-on experience with React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Redux, React Query, or
similar frontend frameworks and state management libraries.
•
• Experience designing reusable UI components, frontend frameworks, and design systems.
Strong understanding of responsive design, accessibility (WCAG), cross-browser compatibility, and web
performance optimization.
•
• Experience integrating frontend applications with REST APIs and microservices.

Title : SAP Consultant
Skills: SAP BW (BW on HANA / BW4HANA), Native HANA & S/4HANA CDS Views
Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore/ Indore
Total Exp: 03-08 Years
Notice Period: Joining in 1 to 2 months, FTE only
Position Overview
We are seeking a skilled SAP Technical Consultant with strong expertise in SAP BW (BW on HANA / BW4HANA), Native HANA development, and S/4HANA CDS Views to support enterprise-wide analytics, reporting, and data integration initiatives. The ideal candidate will have 3-8 years of progressive SAP experience with hands-on exposure to data modeling, performance optimization, and cross-functional collaboration in modern SAP data landscapes.
Core Responsibilities
Technical Development & Implementation
Collaborate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and end-users to analyze requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions
Design, develop, and implement technical solutions across SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Support migration and upgrade activities from legacy systems while maintaining data consistency, quality, and integrity
Participate in technical workshops with business users to gather requirements and contribute to SAP solution design
SAP BW Development & Data Modeling
Design and develop SAP BW/BW4HANA data models using InfoObjects, Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and Open ODS Views
Build and maintain transformations, DTPs, and process chains for efficient data loading and delta management
Develop and optimize BEx queries and analytical reports to support operational and management reporting needs
Implement extraction using standard and custom ODP-based data sources, including SAP ERP/S4HANA extractors
Apply LSA++ modeling principles to design layered, scalable, and maintainable BW data architectures
S/4HANA CDS Views Development
Design and develop ABAP CDS (Core Data Services) views and entities with associations, annotations, and calculations
Implement data models using ABAP CDS views for operational reporting, embedded analytics, and real-time insights
Create and enhance customer-specific CDS views and analytical queries to meet business requirements
Optimize existing CDS views for improved performance and data modeling efficiency
Develop solutions using SAP BTP/BAS and S/4HANA Private Cloud/On-premise environments
Integrate CDS views with Fiori applications and other analytics platforms
Native HANA Development & Performance Optimization
Design and develop Native HANA solutions (HANA 1.0 and HANA 2.0 XSA) using Calculation Views, Attribute Views, and Analytic Views
Create SQL script solutions, stored procedures, and mixed modeling scenarios for analytics use cases
Support BWoH and BW4HANA modeling activities, including Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and ODP extractors
Perform optimization and troubleshooting of Calculation Views and SQL queries using standard performance tuning techniques
Assist with ABAP to HANA SQL conversions and AMDP script implementations
Support HANA security models, transport management, and lifecycle management activities
SAP Functional Knowledge
Good understanding of core S/4HANA/ECC modules including SD, MM, FI/CO, HR, WM, PP, and supply chain processes
Basic knowledge of master data management and data governance practices
Education and Experience:
Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science, IT, or related field, with a University degree (Master/Diploma/PhD) in IT, and strong independent, team-oriented, and accountable work ethic.
3-8 years of SAP development experience, focusing on SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Hands-on experience in at least one full-cycle SAP BW/BW4HANA implementation
Working knowledge of ABAP CDS view development and Native HANA modeling
Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently as well as in a team
This role is ideal for a motivated SAP professional who is passionate about leveraging SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS technologies to deliver reliable, enterprise-scale data and analytics solutions as part of a collaborative technical team.
Application Process
Qualified candidates should submit:
Detailed resume highlighting project experience
Cover letter describing relevant technical achievements
Portfolio of completed data analytics projects (if available)
Professional references from previous SAP implementations
We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace.
Working at HGS
At HGS, our employees get an open and collaborative environment and gain experience working for customers in various industries while solving complex business problems. They get support to learn new technologies as well as to enhance existing skills to further their career growth.
Interested candidates please share your profile to ___________@teamhgs.com

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

POSITION SUMMARY
Check figures, postings, and documents for correct entry, mathematical accuracy, and proper codes. Organize, secure, and maintain all files, records, cash and cash equivalents in accordance with policies and procedures. Record, store, access, and/or analyze computerized financial information. Maintain accurate electronic spreadsheets for financial and accounting data. Prepare, maintain, and distribute statistical, financial, accounting, auditing, or payroll reports and tables. Complete period-end closing procedures and reports as specified. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Description:
Job Description Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Engineer
Experience: 3 Years
Job Title: GCP Data Engineer
Work Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore / Indore
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled GCP Cloud Engineer with 3 years of hands-on experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services, cloud infrastructure, deployment, monitoring, and automation. The ideal candidate should have experience in managing cloud environments and supporting scalable, secure, and reliable cloud solutions.
Required Skills & Responsibilities
3 years of hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Good knowledge of GCP services such as:
Compute Engine (GCE)
Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)
Cloud Storage (GCS)
BigQuery
Cloud Functions / Cloud Run
Cloud SQL
Experience with IAM, service accounts, roles, and permissions.
Good understanding of VPC, subnets, firewall rules, and networking.
Experience in deploying and managing applications on GCP.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab, or Cloud Build.
Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
Knowledge of cloud monitoring and logging using Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging.
Understanding of cloud security, backup, and disaster recovery concepts.
Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Good to Have
Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer certification.
Knowledge of Python or Shell scripting.
Exposure to DevOps practices and automation.
Understanding of AWS or Azure cloud platforms.
Candidate Expectations
Strong communication and analytical skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
Immediate joiners or candidates with a short notice period preferred.

Description:
We are hiring at multiple level for our Admin team in multiple locations - Mumbai, Indore and Pune

Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced Manager / Senior Manager Administration to oversee end-to-end administration, facilities management, infrastructure development, real estate, vendor management, and workplace operations across multiple locations. The role requires strong expertise in operational efficiency, property management, resource utilization, and administrative cost optimization.
Key Responsibilities:
Facilities & Infrastructure Management: Oversee the setup, maintenance, and management of corporate offices, branch offices, and project locations.
Real Estate & Property Management: Handle property scouting, site identification, property evaluation, lease coordination, rental negotiations, and ongoing property management.
Utilities & Building Systems: Manage generators, HVAC/AC systems, UPS, elevators, fire safety, security systems, pest control, and other essential utilities.
Asset & Premises Management: Ensure proper maintenance and optimal utilization of company-owned and leased properties, equipment, furniture, vehicles, and other assets.
Vendor Management & Procurement: Manage vendors and service providers, negotiate commercial terms, prepare bills of materials, process purchase orders, and coordinate delivery, installation, and commissioning.
Office Administration: Ensure smooth day-to-day operations, timely availability of office supplies, consumables, and other administrative requirements.
Repairs & Maintenance: Oversee repairs, maintenance, and replacement of office equipment, furniture, appliances, and infrastructure.
Utility & Cost Management: Monitor electricity, water, and other utility bills, ensure timely payments, and identify opportunities for administrative cost optimization.
Service Provider Coordination: Maintain effective relationships with vendors, contractors, landlords, and service providers to ensure quality and timely service delivery.
Compliance & Documentation: Maintain administrative records, vendor documents, property records, asset registers, and compliance documentation in line with company policies.

Required Skills & Competencies:
Strong knowledge of real estate, property scouting, property evaluation, lease negotiations, and property management, preferably from the same industry - Supply chain/Logistics
Excellent vendor management, commercial negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Familiarity with ERP systems, procurement workflows, database management, and administrative reporting.
Strong organizational, multitasking, time-management, and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to manage multiple locations, vendors, properties, and administrative priorities efficiently.
Focus on cost control, service quality, resource optimization, and operational excellence.
Educational Qualification: Any Graduate.
Experience Requirements:
5-15 years of relevant experience in administration, facilities management, infrastructure management, real estate, or corporate office operations.
Proven experience in vendor management, procurement, office setup, property scouting, property management, maintenance, and administrative cost optimization will be preferred.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Supports all property operations, ensuring that the highest levels of hospitality and service are provided. Manages the flow of questions and directs guests within the lobby. Supports the tracking and resolution of service issues.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 1 year experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Guest Services and Front Desk Operations
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Supervises and manages employees. Understanding employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Supports handling complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Assists with energy conservation efforts by monitoring compliance during property tours.
Supporting Projects and Policies Related to Guest Experience and Safety
- Supports implementation of the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
- Supports regular inspection tours of the entire facility for appearance, safety, staffing, security, and maintenance.
- Sends copy of MOD report to all departments on a daily basis.
- Ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
- Understands and can implement all emergency plans including accident, death, elevator, thefts, vicious crimes, bombs, fire, etc.
- Understands and complies with loss prevention policies and procedures.
Ensuring and Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Intervenes in any guest/employee situation as needed to insure the integrity of the property is maintained, guest satisfaction is achieved, and employee well being is preserved.
- Serves as a leader in displaying outstanding hospitality skills.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
- Maintains high visibility in public areas during peak times.
- Provides immediate assistance to guests as requested.
- Interacts with customers on a regular basis throughout the property to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Records guest issues in the guest response tracking system.
- Reviews comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updating the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Maintains a strong working relationship with all departments to support property operations and goals and to expedite the resolution of any problems that may arise through the general operation of the property.
- Communicates any variations to the established norms to the appropriate department in a timely manner.
- Participates as needed in the investigation of employee and guest accidents.
- Performs Front Desk duties in high demand times.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY - F&B and Event Service Expert
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table or serving guests during a banquet or event. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side. Our F&B Service Experts is skilled in a wide range of event functions and able to take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests experience is well taken care of from start to finish. Whether setting tables and event materials communicating with the kitchen, interacting, and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the F&B Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
Position: Senior Azure Data Engineer (MS fabric)
Location: Hyderabad/Indore- India
Duration: Full time

Job Description :

Summary
We are looking for dynamic and result oriented cloud data engineers to join our fast-growing Cloud Analytics practice.

Position Summary
Candidate should be self-starters with a passion for business analytics and Data and use their excellent problem solving and analytical skills along with superb written and oral communication skills to develop solutions that delight our customers.
Keep reading if you have a strong desire to excel and are keen to work on end-to-end cloud analytics projects while further developing your career.
Key Responsibilities:
Understand existing landscape and business objectives of the customers.
Translate their explicit and implicit requirements into optimal, scalable, high performance Azure Analytics solution.
Modify existing solutions to enhance, optimize, or to incorporate new functionality.
Ensure high quality of deliverables from self and team.
Provide candid, meaningful feedback and regular progress updates to the team and customer.
Explore how the world of data has evolved and how the advent of cloud technologies is providing new opportunities for businesses to explore.
Learn the various data platform technologies that are available, and how to take advantage of the available technologies for organizational benefit.
Contribute to presales activities including proposals, POC and Demos.
Requirements / Qualifications:
Education:
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
Experience & Requirements:
5-8 years of professional work experience with at least 3 years as cloud data engineer preferably in Microsoft Azure.
Well versed with relational databases, nonrelational databases, data streams, and file stores
Should be able to perform data-related tasks in Microsoft Azure cloud analytics platform.
Well versed with Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Databricks, and Azure Analysis Services (AAS)
Must possess excellent programming skills with SQL, and Python.
Having experience working on spark platform
Should be able to use services and tools to ingest, egress, and transform data from multiple sources, including SAP, within Microsoft Azure.
Ability to collaborate with business stakeholders to identify and meet data requirements.
Ability to Design and implement Azure analytics solutions.
Manage, monitor, and ensure the security and privacy of data to satisfy business needs.
Having Azure data engineer associate certification is preferred.
Good to have experience in reporting tools like PowerBI.
Having experience with Snowflake and Snowpro certification is a bonus.
Excellent communication skills
Demonstrated knowledge of a formal system implementation methodology – requirements gathering, design, build/test and deploy (Agile methodology preferable).
