Description:
Required Skills
Strong hands-on experience in VAPT, API Security and Cloud Security Testing
Good knowledge of OWASP, CVSS, authentication/authorization, IAM and network security
Experience testing Kubernetes, Docker/containers, Linux and REST APIs
Understanding of OpenStack, virtualization, cloud networking and multi-tenant security is highly desirable.
Ability to automate security tests using Python, Bash or similar scripting
Experience: 5+ years in application, cloud or infrastructure security testing.
Roles & Responsibilities
Perform Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT) across Private Cloud services including IaaS, PaaS, Kubernetes, containers, storage, network and IAM.
Conduct security testing of REST APIs, web services and microservices aligned with OWASP Top 10 / OWASP API Security Top 10.
Test authentication, authorization, RBAC, session management, input validation, tenant isolation and business-logic security. These are established testing areas in the current security program.
Assess Kubernetes, container, Linux and cloud infrastructure configurations for vulnerabilities and security weaknesses.
Perform dependency, image and container vulnerability assessments using tools such as Burp Suite, Nmap, Trivy, SonarQube and OWASP Dependency-Check. Trivy, Sonar and OWASP Dependency-Check are already represented in the current security-testing workflow.
Document vulnerabilities with severity, impact, evidence and remediation guidance, and validate fixes through retesting.
Work closely with Engineering and DevSecOps teams to integrate security testing into CI/CD and release security gates.

AboutCompany:
Jana Small Finance Bank, erstwhile Janalakshmi Financial Services, is headquartered in Bengaluru. It is one of the 10 financial institutions which had received in-principle approval from RBI, in 2015, to set up a Small Finance Bank.
Established in Bengaluru in 2008, it went on to become the largest Micro Finance Institution (MFI) in India, and was recognised globally as one of the world€™s innovative financial institutions working on the problem of financial inclusion.
Jana Bank received the final banking license in April 2017 and started banking operations on March 28, 2018. Under the leadership of its MD & CEO, Ajay Kanwal, Jana Small Finance Bank€™s vision is to become the leading inclusive digitised bank serving all customer segments and communities of an aspirational India.
Currently, post the transition phase, the bank is enabling its existing 45 lakh customers across 19 states in India to access banking services. It has Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) of about 35 percent and a loan book of INR 76 billion as on March 31, 2018. By 2020, the bank aspires to add four million customers.
The bank has deep domain expertise in banking and financial services, with the senior management team having 25+ years of average experience in banking sector. Its current employee strength is of 15,000. By end of 2019, Jana Bank€™s 500 branches will be operational across 19 states, post conversion of majority of its micro finance storefronts into bank branches.
Bengaluru-headquartered Jana Small Finance Bank is regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).

Description:
What does an Operations Manager really do? Think of yourself as a leader and the master of your department, so not just anyone is qualified for this role! Here at TaskUs we make sure we get the best of the best, after all, we are a ridiculously good company so we make sure our employees are top notch.
Come on now, we need your full attention because its time to imagine what its like being an Operations Manager.

Imagine yourself going to work with one thing on your mind: that in most companies, its all about the KPIs but in TaskUs its all about solving business problems through innovation. As you tackle your new tasks for the day, you know that it will all lead to one thing that your department believes in: to provide the best possible customer experience to your clients.

As Operations Manager, you are also responsible for making sure that KPIs are being met consistently. You need to come up with ways in which to effectively make each employee reach their best potential. With this, you must also be creative because you need to devise effective plans on how to make each employee reach their target.
As a leader, you must also gain the trust and respect of your employees because lets face it -- how can you lead when people don't believe you? You need to be able to reach out to them, drop by their workstations, have short chit-chats, and make them feel important. You need to be able to identify their strengths and weaknesses, take advantage of them and assign them tasks that will help them work on their weaknesses and showcase their talents. This way, you are able to manage relationships better and develop people at the same time.

Requirements:

So, what is it were looking for?

Since this is an Operations Manager post, wed need someone who already has the skills to even call themselves a Manager. Were looking for someone who has strong interpersonal skills, verbal and written communication skills and most importantly empathy. Someone who has a high affinity and cultural awareness of political and social situations regarding the relevant market and region that will be supported.
Someone who has at least three years of related working experience, preferably someone who already knows how the system works -- specializing in a customer experience operations and management.
We need someone who is responsible and has a good track record of meeting and delivering targets. Someone who can articulate him/herself well enough with others, like teammates and clients. We need someone who can multitask and work in a fast-paced environment. Someone who can lead and is great in analyzing situations and data.

Description:
Being a Team Leader, you will manage the day-to-day planning and operations of your team. This includes making sure that each of your Teammates delivers on their Service Level Agreement (SLA) and achieve their Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

As Team Leader, you are in charge of managing the team and making sure everyone adheres to their schedules. You must be organized and be able to handle responsibility. A critical part of the role is to be able to train and help in the development of your team, by conducting team huddles, coaching sessions, and recognizing weaknesses - so you
can offer solutions to help them improve and grow. Through that, your team will be able to deliver a superior customer experience - which is the main thrust of your department.

You must be adept at creating reports of your teams performance and documenting feedback from your client. You must be able to effectively manage issues that might arise (including HR related ones); not to mention, being creative in terms of thinking of solutions; and acting as the liaison between management and your team.

So, what are we looking for?

We need someone who has the skills to call themselves a Leader.
Someone with college or vocational school graduation as a qualification and has at least one (1) year of relevant Team Leader experience managing at least 15+ teammates while working in a customer support role within an outsourcing or similar company.
We need someone with excellent verbal and written communication skills along with above-average technical know-how.

Description:
Dear Candidate,

We are hiring for HL in Indore location, please find the details.

Prefer 1+ years of experience in HL products.

Responsible for achievement of business Targets in the assigned Branch, Develop and maintain business relationships with other support teams
Leverage the existing JC/Branch relationships to promote and source the Housing loans/LAP business
Maintain customer relationship post the disbursement to ensure customer satisfaction and long relationship with the Bank.
Maintain 100% non-delinquency in assigned branch, Support the collections team on any delinquencies on the branch portfolio. Demonstrate initiative and creativity.
Liaison with DSA/Connectors/Vendors for enhanced business Support. Developing & implementing Marketing/Sales strategies by analysing Market & competitors to grow Bank customer base.
Training our Polies & products to DSA/Connectors to bring Quality proposals which Fits as per Bank Policy.
Achieving Cross sell Targets assigned.

Perks and benefits CTC + Mediclaim + Insurance + Allowance

Interested candidates can share your resume to meenal.devde@jana.bank.in
AboutCompany:
Jana Small Finance Bank, erstwhile Janalakshmi Financial Services, is headquartered in Bengaluru. It is one of the 10 financial institutions which had received in-principle approval from RBI, in 2015, to set up a Small Finance Bank.
Established in Bengaluru in 2008, it went on to become the largest Micro Finance Institution (MFI) in India, and was recognised globally as one of the world€™s innovative financial institutions working on the problem of financial inclusion.
Jana Bank received the final banking license in April 2017 and started banking operations on March 28, 2018. Under the leadership of its MD & CEO, Ajay Kanwal, Jana Small Finance Bank€™s vision is to become the leading inclusive digitised bank serving all customer segments and communities of an aspirational India.
Currently, post the transition phase, the bank is enabling its existing 45 lakh customers across 19 states in India to access banking services. It has Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) of about 35 percent and a loan book of INR 76 billion as on March 31, 2018. By 2020, the bank aspires to add four million customers.
The bank has deep domain expertise in banking and financial services, with the senior management team having 25+ years of average experience in banking sector. Its current employee strength is of 15,000. By end of 2019, Jana Bank€™s 500 branches will be operational across 19 states, post conversion of majority of its micro finance storefronts into bank branches.
Bengaluru-headquartered Jana Small Finance Bank is regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).

Job description Sales (LAP) Sales Manager
Job Type: Full-time
About IIFL Finance: IIFL Finance is a leading financial services provider in India, known for its comprehensive range of solutions including loans, insurance, and investment products. We are expanding our footprint and are excited to offer opportunities in the LAP (Loan Against Property) segment in the LAP region.
Position Overview: We are looking for a dynamic and motivated Sales Representative to join our LAP team at IIFL Finance. This role involves promoting our Loan Against Property products, building relationships with clients, and achieving sales targets in the LAP region. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in financial sales and a deep understanding of the local property market.
Key Responsibilities:
DSA Network for Sales Maximization: Maximize sales through a network of DSA by effectively managing connector and builder relationships to ensure strong business
Disbursement Target Management and Achievement: Drive Disbursement Target vs Achievement for LAP product - as per expected business growth plan.
Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams such as underwriting and customer service to ensure smooth customer service.
Market Research: Stay informed about local real estate trends, property values, and competitive offerings. Use market insights to refine sales strategies and identify new opportunities.
Desired Candidate Profile:
3+ years of experience strong understanding handling LAP Product
Problem Solving ability
Bachelors degree in finance or any other field - Graduation is a must

About IIFL Finance: IIFL Finance is a leading financial services provider in India, known for its comprehensive range of solutions including loans, insurance, and investment products. We are expanding our footprint and are excited to offer opportunities in the LAP (Loan Against Property) segment in the LAP region.
Position Overview: We are looking for a dynamic and motivated Sales Representative to join our LAP team at IIFL Finance. This role involves promoting our Loan Against Property products, building relationships with clients, and achieving sales targets in the LAP region. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in financial sales and a deep understanding of the local property market.
Key Responsibilities:
DSA Network for Sales Maximization: Maximize sales through a network of DSA by effectively managing connector and builder relationships to ensure strong business
Disbursement Target Management and Achievement: Drive Disbursement Target vs Achievement for LAP product - as per expected business growth plan.
Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams such as underwriting and customer service to ensure smooth customer service.
Market Research: Stay informed about local real estate trends, property values, and competitive offerings. Use market insights to refine sales strategies and identify new opportunities.
Desired Candidate Profile:
3+ years of experience strong understanding handling LAP Product
Problem Solving ability
Bachelors degree in finance or any other field - Graduation is a must

Description:
Short Text :-

Process Engineer is responsible for review process design, conducting technical studies and analysis, problem solving and troubleshooting, plant performance optimizing, implement best practices. Ensure safety and regulatory compliance, sharing knowledge and expertise with team members.
Job Accountabilities:-

1. Conducting technical studies and analysis to optimize plant performance
2. Developing and implementing process designs and improvements
3. Technical studies, technical report preparation for ongoing projects
4. MOC proposal technical evaluation & field verification to ensure risk mitigation
5. Participating in PSSR field activity to capture observations related to process
6. Assistance in basic / detail engineering/pre-commissioning / commissioning for upcoming projects.
7. Ensuring compliance with safety & regulatory standards
8. Use of different tools of Risk assessment-HITRA, Whatif, HAZOP
9. Software competency in process & data analysis tools-Aspen, Hysis, Pipesim, Olga
10. Root cause analysis for failure review, use of failure analysis tools e.g. Why-why
11. Prepare SOP, SMP, KPI and periodic review with job cycle check
12. Providing training to team members for competency building
13. Operating experience of alarm management, alarm rationalization.
14. Carrying out Pre-start-up safety review of new projects and equipment
15. Interpretation of cause & effect, SOC, Alarm & trip register, design conditions.
16. Knowledge of SCADA system and its operating features
17. Working experience as Technical Service with good interpretation of technical data
18. Ensuring deliverable as per Operating management system.

Skills Required (Knowledge and Skills)

Expertise in process engineering fundamentals, process principals including mass & energy balance, thermodynamics and chemical reactions.
Knowledge of different national & international standards, regulations and their applicability.
Experience in process simulation and modelling such as Aspen plus, Hysys, Bow tie, PHAST or similar tools.

Key Attributes (Experience and Qualification)

BE -Chemical Engineering
Minimum 3 years in working experience in upstream (E&P) Oil/Gas/ Project design.

Job Title: Academic Counsellor
Offline Learning Centres
Location: Thane/ Andheri/ Marol/Mumbai
Working Days: 6 (Monday Saturday)
About upGrad
Founded in 2015, upGrad is Asias largest integrated Learning, Skilling, Workforce Development, and Placement company. Its offerings include online and hybrid degrees, study abroad programs, certifications, bootcamps, and doctorates for working professionals. Through its B2B arm, upGrad also provides enterprise training, recruitment, and staffing services. With 10M+ learners across 100+ countries, 300+ global university partners, 2500+ pathway connections, and 20,000+ recruitment partners, upGrad continues to empower careers worldwide.
Learn more: www.upgrad.com/offline-centres
About the Role
As an Academic Counsellor, you will play a key role in guiding potential learners, helping them identify the right career path, and showcasing how upGrads programs can accelerate their journey. You will be responsible for driving enrollments and revenue by nurturing leads, providing consultative counselling, and closing sales in a highly competitive environment.
5 Reasons to Join upGrad Offline Learning Centres
1. Performance Incentives: Target monthly incentive of INR 30,000, with potential to earn 1.5X/2X of that based on performance.
2. Career Growth: Promotion opportunities in 1 year or lateral movement across other Business Units at upGrad.
3. Continuous Upskilling: Access 100% free upGrad programs for yourself and a 50% discount for your family.
4. Comprehensive Health & Wellbeing: Benefit from INR 5L medical insurance for yourself and your family, plus a 24x7 mental health helpline for all-round support.
5. Employee Referral Bonus: Receive INR 15,000 for every successful employee referral bring great talent to upGrad and get rewarded.
Key Responsibilities
Engage with potential learners through calls, video sessions, and in-centre meetings to understand their career goals and recommend suitable programs.
Drive weekly & monthly enrollment and revenue targets by effectively converting leads into admissions.
Manage the complete sales lifecycle from first interaction to enrollment and post-sales support.
Track and improve key performance metrics such as counselling sessions, conversion rates, and revenue.
Maintain accurate learner records on CRM and share feedback with the Marketing team to improve lead quality.
Work closely with centre teams to ensure a smooth learner journey and high satisfaction levels.
Skills & Experience
Graduate with 1–6 years of experience in consultative or B2C sales (education industry exposure preferred).
Strong communication, persuasion and relationship-building skills.
Organized, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities under pressure.
Empathetic listener with ability to build trust and focus on learner success.
Comfortable with CRM tools and basic MS Office proficiency.
Equal Opportunity
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business needRole & responsibilities

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Assists in carrying out the daily activities of the Human Resource Office including recruitment, total compensation, and training and development. Additionally, he/she assists in delivering HR services that meet or exceed the needs of employees and enable business success; as well as ensuring compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and operating procedures.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting in Managing Recruitment and Hiring Process
- Assists in the interviewing and hiring of Human Resource employee team members with the appropriate skills, as needed.
- Assists in establishing and maintains contact with external recruitment sources.
- Attends job fairs and ensures documentation of outreach efforts in accordance with Human Resource Standard Operating Procedures.
- Networks with local organizations (e.g., Hotel Association and peers) to source candidates for current or future openings.
- Assists in monitoring candidate identification and selection process.
- Performs quality control on candidate identification/selection.
Assisting in Administering and Educating Employee Benefits
- Works with the unemployment services provider to respond to unemployment claims; reviews provider reports for accuracy and corrects errors.
- Assists with unemployment claim activity reports.
- Attends unemployment hearings and ensures property is properly represented, as needed.
Assisting in Managing Employee Development
- Assists with departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
- Ensures employees are cross-trained to support successful daily operations.
- Assists with coordination and facilitation of new hire orientation program to generate a positive first impression for employees and emphasize the importance of guest service in company culture.
- Ensures attendance by all new hires and participation of the leadership team in training programs
- Assists with ensuring departmental orientation processes are in place and employees receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
Assisting in Maintaining Employee Relations
- Assists in maintaining effective employee communication channels in the property (e.g., develops daily communications and assists with regularly scheduled property-wide meetings).
- Reviews progressive discipline documentation for accuracy and consistency, and checks for supportive documentation and is accountable for determining appropriate action.
- Utilizes an open door policy to acknowledge employee problems or concerns in a timely manner
- Ensures employee issues are referred to the Department Manager for resolution or escalated to the Director of Human Resources/Multi-Property Director of Human Resources.
- Partners with Loss Prevention to conduct employee accident investigations, as necessary.
- Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
Assisting in Managing Legal and Compliance Practices
- Assists with ensuring employee files contain required employment paperwork, proper performance management and compensation documentation, are properly maintained and secured for the required length of time.
- Assists with ensuring compliance with procedure for accessing, reviewing, and auditing employee files and ensure compliance with the Privacy Act.
- Assists with ensuring medical records are maintained in a separate, secure and confidential medical file.
- Facilitates random, reasonable belief and post accident drug testing process (in properties where applicable).
- Communicates property rules and regulations via the employee handbook.
- Assists with ensuring all safety and security policies (e.g., property removal, lost and found items, blood borne pathogens, accident reporting, and hygiene) are communicated to employees on a regular basis through orientation, property meetings, bulletin boards, etc.
- Assists with periodic claims reviews with Regional Claims office to ensure claims are closed in a timely manner and reserve levels are appropriate for open claims.
- Assists with managing Workers Compensation claims to ensure appropriate employee care and manage costs.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Location: Indore, Madhya Pradesh
Department: Operations
Experience: 7-10 Years (3-5 Years in People Management)
Work Schedule: India Night Shift
Employment Type: Full-Time/In Office
About the Role
We are looking for a proactive, responsible, and experienced Night Shift Operations & Floor Manager to oversee and manage our Indore office operations during the night shift.
The individual will be responsible for ensuring smooth floor operations, employee discipline, employee support, and effective coordination with the Process Managers and Operations Leadership team based in Mumbai.
The person will act as the primary point of contact at the Indore office during India night hours, taking ownership of day-to-day operational activities, addressing employee concerns, managing emergencies, and ensuring that all critical updates and challenges are communicated to the appropriate stakeholders in Mumbai.
We are looking for someone with a strong leadership mindset who can manage the floor, motivate employees, proactively identify challenges, and ensure complete operational visibility for management.
Key Responsibilities
1. Floor & Operations Management
Take complete ownership of the Indore office floor during the night shift.
Ensure smooth day-to-day operations and maintain discipline across the floor.
Monitor employee attendance, punctuality, engagement, and productivity.
Ensure employees remain focused on their assigned responsibilities and avoid unnecessary idle time, excessive personal mobile usage, or unproductive activities.
Identify operational gaps and proactively address floor-related challenges.
Ensure a professional, productive, and well-managed working environment.
2. Coordination with Mumbai Management
Act as the primary point of contact between the Indore night shift team and Mumbai-based Process Managers and Operations Managers.
Immediately escalate production, accuracy, employee performance, and operational challenges to the respective managers.
Maintain regular communication with the Mumbai night shift management team.
Schedule meetings and discussions whenever required to address process-related concerns.
Ensure all escalated issues are followed up until closure.
3. Employee Management & Team Motivation
Motivate, guide, and support employees working during the night shift.
Maintain positive employee morale and encourage teamwork and accountability.
Address employee concerns and workplace challenges.
Monitor employee behaviour, discipline, and overall floor engagement.
Identify employees requiring additional support and coordinate with the respective managers.
4. Medical & Emergency Support
Ensure medical assistance is arranged whenever employees require medical attention.
Act as the first point of contact for emergencies at the Indore office during the night shift.
Immediately communicate critical incidents and emergency situations to the appropriate management.
Ensure timely coordination and support until the situation is resolved.
5. Productivity & Performance Monitoring
Monitor team productivity, production levels, and accuracy.
Identify performance-related challenges and coordinate with the respective Process Managers.
Proactively flag employees or teams facing productivity or accuracy issues.
Arrange discussions with the relevant stakeholders to address performance gaps.
Ensure corrective actions are implemented and monitored.
6. Daily Reporting & Management Updates
Share regular updates with management regarding all important night shift activities.
Provide visibility into employee attendance, productivity, floor discipline, and operational performance.
Report internet connectivity issues, system failures, infrastructure challenges, and other floor-related disruptions.
Maintain records of escalations, incidents, action items, and pending concerns.
Ensure management is immediately informed of any critical issue rather than waiting until the end of the shift.
Prepare and share structured daily shift reports.
Required Qualifications & Skills
Overall 7-10 years of experience with minimum 3-5 years of experience in people management, preferably in BPO, KPO, back-office operations, or similar service environments.
Experience managing teams and handling day-to-day operational activities.
Previous experience in night shift operations will be preferred.
Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
Strong email drafting and professional communication abilities.
Good working knowledge of MS Excel and PowerPoint.
Strong leadership, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to handle employee concerns, operational escalations, and emergencies.
Strong organizational and time management abilities.
Ability to manage responsibilities and take ownership of situations.

Description:
Job Summary
Assistant HR Manager - HR Operations Employee Experience. Organization: Chapter 247 Infotech. Location: Indore. Working Days: 5 days a week. Reports To: Leadership Team of HR. Experience Required: 5+ years. Function: Human Resources.
Chapter 247 is looking for an enthusiastic, experienced HR professional who is keen to take ownership of HR operations and employee experience across the complete employee lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities
Contribute to HR strategy in partnership with the leadership team; own the manpower plan, headcount tracking and HR budget; and provide regular HR reports on headcount, attrition, hiring, payroll cost and compliance.
Employee lifecycle and HR operations: Manage employee records, attendance, leave and HR documentation; administer Keka HRMS across modules and drive automation.
Payroll: Coordinate and support payroll team monthly payroll : inputs, attendance and LOP reconciliation, validation, payslips, tax and statutory compliance.
Onboarding and induction: Handle offers, appointment letters, joining formalities, background checks and system access; run a structured induction and track probation confirmations.
Compensation Benefits : maintain pay structures, benefits and increment proposals for appraisal cycles.
Performance Management and Employee engagement: Run the performance cycle (goals, reviews, feedback) and act as a support system engagement activities, recognition and surveys.
Employee relations: Resolve grievances fairly and confidentially; manage disciplinary processes (show-cause, inquiry, warnings); ensure POSH compliance, including the Internal Committee and awareness.
Policies, SOPs and documentation: Draft and update HR policies, SOPs, employee handbook, letters and templates; keep records audit-ready.
Exit management: Manage resignations, notice period, handover and clearance; conduct exit interviews and report attrition insights; process


Key Requirements
5-7 years of HR experience with a strong HR operations background; graduate or postgraduate in HR or Management (MBA/PGDM in HR preferred).
Good knowledge of the complete employee lifecycle.
Hands-on experience with Keka HRMS; knowledge of all modules is a big plus.
Understanding of statutory compliance, labour laws and HR policies.
Experience in employee engagement, performance management, onboarding and exit formalities.
Ability to manage attendance, payroll coordination, employee records and HR documentation.
Strong communication, interpersonal and problem-solving skills, with discretion on confidential matters.


What We Look For
Ownership: you take initiative and close loops without being chased.
Attention to detail and the ability to work to deadlines.
Confidence working with the HR leadership team and senior management.
Integrity and strict confidentiality.

POSITION SUMMARY
Inspect guest rooms, public areas, pool, etc. after being cleaned by Housekeeper to ensure quality standards. Run sold room reports, verify room status, determine discrepant rooms, prioritize room cleaning, and update status of departing guest rooms. Assist Housekeeping management in managing daily activities. Act as a liaison to coordinate the efforts of Housekeeping, Engineering, Front Office, and Laundry. Ability to push and pull a loaded housekeeping cart and other work-related machinery over sloping and uneven surfaces. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Stand, sit, kneel, or walk for an extended period across an entire work shift. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Prepare special meals or substitute items. Regulate temperature of ovens, broilers, grills, and roasters. Pull food from freezer storage to thaw in the refrigerator. Ensure proper portion, arrangement, and food garnish. Maintain food logs. Monitor the quality and quantity of food that is prepared. Communicate assistance needed during busy periods. Inform Chef of excess food items for use in daily specials. Inform Food Beverage service staff of menu specials and out of stock menu items. Ensure the quality of the food items. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklist. Prepare cold foods.
Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees; serve as a role model. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Anticipate and address guests service needs. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATION
Education: Technical, Trade, or Vocational School Degree.
Related Work Experience: At least 3 years of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
1. Customer Delight & Experience Excellence Deliver a seamless, personalized experience for every pet parent and pet, ensuring high NPS and repeat visits through proactive engagement, swift service delivery, and empathetic interactions.

2. Operational & Booking Efficiency Achieve 100% accuracy and timeliness in appointment booking, grooming and vet service scheduling, and follow-ups to maximize resource utilization and service turnaround time (TAT).

3. Client Relationship Management Build lasting relationships with customers by maintaining regular touchpoints, resolving concerns promptly, and leveraging CRM tools to track preferences, special occasions, and feedback.

4. Team Engagement, Training & Capability Building – Hire, train, and retain a passionate, customer-first team; conduct regular skill-building programs for grooming, retail, and vet support staff; foster high engagement through recognition and career development.

5. Retail & Service Profitability – Drive revenue growth through optimized product mix, upselling & cross-selling between product, grooming, and vet services, and effective cost control.

6. Shrinkage & Stock Loss Control – Maintain shrinkage at or below 1.5% of total net sales through FIFO compliance, robust inward/outward stock control, regular CCTV review, and theft prevention measures.

7. Regulatory Compliance & Inspection Readiness – Ensure all operational licenses (e.g., Shops & Establishment, Trade, Bio Medical Waste Management, PNDT, X-Ray/AERB) are valid and renewed on time; manage official visits/inspections in liaison with Area Manager, Legal, and HR.

8. Community & Brand Building – Position the Experience Centre as a local hub for pet care by hosting events, workshops, and collaborations, strengthening brand loyalty and visibility.

9. Compliance & Process Adherence – Ensure 100% adherence to SOPs, safety protocols, and hygiene standards across retail, grooming, and vet care services.
AboutCompany:
Overview
Established in 1981, Cosmo First Limited is a four-decade-old global business conglomerate with entities-- Cosmo Films, Cosmo Speciality Chemicals, Zigly, and Cosmo Foundation. Cosmo Films is one of the most preferred global brands offering value-added BOPP films for packaging, labels, lamination, and industrial applications. With innovation, development, and research embedded in its core values, Cosmo First has ventured into successful businesses like Cosmo Speciality Chemicals and Zigly, a D2C Omni channel pet care business under its entity. The company has been at the forefront of developing customer-centric solutions to deliver the finest product and service experience, backed by innovation, people, and processes. Cosmo First has a strong focus on sustainability and invests in promoting innovative practices toward ensuring a safer planet for future generations.

Description:
About Us: Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.
About the Role: Paytm is looking for an experienced sales professional & people manager to be a part of the QR & Sound Box vertical.
Expectations/ Requirements:
1.Growth of distribution and market share in the assigned area of operations.
2.Visibility & accountability through extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product .
3.Identify and recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4.Plan the market size, span and geographies for ASMs .
5.Devise best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
6.Monitor the quality parameters as suggested by the management.
7.Validate and conduct audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
8. People manage a large team of 5-10 ASMs & 200+ indirect employees.
Must Have: Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application the new learnt ideas and concepts.
Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. Self-starters, who can take ownership and are comfortable navigating ambiguity, will be an ideal fit. 8-12 years experience in sales - business development, B2C markets
2. Passionate about working in a fast growing firms and large team handling.
3. Articulate complex solutions to novice customers.
4. Good sales and negotiation skills. Experience in quota driven sales is a must.
5. Experience in payments and finance is a plus - though not mandatory
AboutCompany: Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

Description:
So what does a Senior Operations Manager really do? Think of yourself as one of the leaders
of your department, so not just anyone is qualified for this role! Here at TaskUs, we make sure
we get the best of the best, after all, we are a ridiculously good company so we make sure our
employees are top notch. Come on now, we need your full attention because its time to imagine
what its like being a Senior Operations Manager.
TaskUs is the fastest growing tech-enabled business services company in the world. We exist to
provide ridiculously innovative customer support, AI operations, and content security to the
worlds most disruptive companies
We believe our Frontline employees come first, always. At TaskUs, leaders eat lastin other
words, we expect you to put your line of direct reports before yourself. We think in terms of
#FrontlineFirst because we know good ideas can come from anyone at anytime. Thats probably
why were ranked 40th on Glassdoors 2019 100 Best Places to Work list.
A special place requires special people. Qualified candidates have a sense of humility, an
adventurous spirit, and a relentless work ethic. If you are looking for more than the standard 9 to
5, youve found it.
We exist to make the worlds best companies better. We aim to have fun while doing it.
So what does a Senior Operations Manager really do? Think of yourself as one of the leaders
of your department, so not just anyone is qualified for this role! Here at TaskUs, we make sure
we get the best of the best, after all, we are a ridiculously good company so we make sure our
employees are top notch. Come on now, we need your full attention because its time to imagine
what its like being a Senior Operations Manager.
Imagine yourself going to work with one thing on your mind: in a company like TaskUs, its
more than just the KPIs if you want to solve business problems through innovation. As
you tackle your new tasks for the day, you know that it will all lead to one thing that your
department believes in: to provide the best possible customer experience to your clients.
As a Senior Operations Manager, you will oversee and direct the activities of a number of
campaigns along with all Operations Managers, Team Leaders and Staff assigned to his
campaigns. You will also be responsible for a wide spectrum of responsibilities and must be able
to multitask with ease and proficiency. Along with this, you are also responsible for the regular
and often daily interactions with all the company departments/ campaign team leaders and the
whole management team. Maintain an open line of communication between staff and senior
management. You will manage and staff the operations assigned. You will also be responsible
for all aspects of operations which include but not limited to monitoring operations staffing,
provide temporary coverage and training; provision of excellent clientele service, problem
resolution and the like. What else? Well, you will also develop individual & team goals and
implement a plan to carry out objectives. You will guide Operations Managers in a meeting of all
team & individual goals. Along with this, you must ensure compliance with all established



policies and procedures. You also need to also Assist the Operations Director in crafting
operations procedures.
So, do you have what it takes to become a Senior Operations Manager?
Requirements:
So, what is it were looking for? Well, since this is a Senior Operations Manager post, we need
someone who already has the skills to even call themselves a Senior Operations Manager! In
other words, someone who has at least 3 years of related working experience, preferably
someone who has experience in being a Senior Manager/Director specializing in BPO
Operations and Management or equivalent.
We need someone who has handled at least 600 FTEs. Someone with strong computer
skills, especially in using MS Office applications and Google applications. We need someone
whos responsible and has a good track record of meeting and delivering targets. Someone
who can articulate him/herself well enough with others, like teammates and clients. So
definitely someone with excellent verbal and written communication and customer service
skills.
We need someone who can multitask and work in a fast-paced high-stress environment.
Someone who can lead and is great in analyzing situations and data. Someone who has the
ability to build productive business relationships with clients. Someone who has strong
organizational, analytical and managerial skills. Lastly, we need someone who possesses a
professional, courteous, and resilient attitude.
TaskUs is the fastest growing tech-enabled business services company in the world, delivering
the customer support, AI operations and content security services that power the worlds most
innovative companies. Listed as one of Glassdoors 100 Best Places to Work, USA Todays
Best Company Cultures and Best Companies for Women by Comparably, TaskUs is a
Frontline-First company that puts its people at the heart of everything they do.
TaskUs has been recognized as one of the Inc. 500 Fastest Growing Private Companies in
America for the past seven years consecutively. Founded in 2008 by Bryce Maddock and
Jaspar Weir, the company raised over $250mm in 2018 from the worlds largest private equity
firm, Blackstone.
TaskUs currently has over 15,000 employees and offices across the U.S., Philippines, India,
Taiwan, and Mexico.
TaskUs, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer.

AboutCompany:
Jana Small Finance Bank, erstwhile Janalakshmi Financial Services, is headquartered in Bengaluru. It is one of the 10 financial institutions which had received in-principle approval from RBI, in 2015, to set up a Small Finance Bank.
Established in Bengaluru in 2008, it went on to become the largest Micro Finance Institution (MFI) in India, and was recognised globally as one of the world€™s innovative financial institutions working on the problem of financial inclusion.
Jana Bank received the final banking license in April 2017 and started banking operations on March 28, 2018. Under the leadership of its MD & CEO, Ajay Kanwal, Jana Small Finance Bank€™s vision is to become the leading inclusive digitised bank serving all customer segments and communities of an aspirational India.
Currently, post the transition phase, the bank is enabling its existing 45 lakh customers across 19 states in India to access banking services. It has Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) of about 35 percent and a loan book of INR 76 billion as on March 31, 2018. By 2020, the bank aspires to add four million customers.
The bank has deep domain expertise in banking and financial services, with the senior management team having 25+ years of average experience in banking sector. Its current employee strength is of 15,000. By end of 2019, Jana Bank€™s 500 branches will be operational across 19 states, post conversion of majority of its micro finance storefronts into bank branches.
Bengaluru-headquartered Jana Small Finance Bank is regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).

About us:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants’ business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About the team: EDC Retail – EDC is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of EDC machines through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.
Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Create an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture
2. Need to drive swiping device sales in the assigned area.
3. Resolving merchant queries
4. Drive overall engage merchant base
5. Capable of hiring and building team
6. Set clear team goals
7. Delegate tasks and set deadlines
8. Oversee day-to-day operation
9. Monitor team performance and report on metrics
10 .Motivate team members
11. Discover training needs and provide coaching
12 .Listen to team members feedback and resolve any issues or conflicts
13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments
14. Encourage creativity and risk-taking
15. Suggest and organize team building activities

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Qualification:- Graduate/Post Graduate.

Description:
Here is a professional Job Description for an Assistant Restaurant Manager WOW! momo, suitable for recruitment portals, LinkedIn, and internal hiring.
JOB DESCRIPTION
Assistant Restaurant Manager WOW! momo
Department: Operations
Designation: Assistant Restaurant Manager (ARM)
Industry: Quick Service Restaurant (QSR) / Food & Beverage
Reports To: Restaurant Manager / Area Operations Manager
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Location: As per business requirement
About WOW! momo
WOW! momo is one of India’s leading homegrown QSR brands, known for its innovative food offerings, customer-centric approach, and fast-growing restaurant network. We are looking for energetic, customer-focused, and result-oriented professionals to join our restaurant operations team.
Job Purpose
To support the Restaurant Manager in managing day-to-day restaurant operations, ensuring excellent customer experience, maintaining food quality and safety standards, driving sales and profitability, and developing a motivated team that consistently delivers WOW! service.
Key Responsibilities
1. Restaurant Operations
Manage daily restaurant operations and ensure smooth functioning across all shifts.
Ensure adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational checklists, and company policies.
Monitor opening and closing activities, equipment functionality, cleanliness, and overall restaurant readiness.
Ensure timely order preparation, accurate billing, and efficient order delivery.
2. Sales & Business Performance
Drive daily sales and achieve assigned sales targets.
Monitor key performance indicators such as average order value, customer footfall, order accuracy, and sales growth.
Identify opportunities to improve upselling, cross-selling, and customer conversions.
Support cost control initiatives and improve restaurant profitability.
3. People Management & Development
Lead, coach, and motivate Team Members and Shift Managers.
Ensure adequate manpower availability and effective shift scheduling.
Drive employee engagement, attendance, discipline, and retention.
Train team members on product knowledge, customer service, food preparation, and operational standards.
Identify high-potential employees and support their career growth through on-the-job training and development.
4. Customer Experience
Ensure exceptional customer service and a positive dining experience.
Handle customer complaints and resolve service issues promptly.
Maintain service speed, product consistency, and order accuracy.
Build customer loyalty through friendly, efficient, and professional service.
5. Food Safety & Quality
Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and food handling standards.
Monitor product quality, portion control, freshness, and adherence to recipes.
Ensure proper storage, stock rotation, and expiry-date monitoring.
Maintain a clean, safe, and hygienic restaurant environment.
6. Inventory & Cost Management
Monitor inventory levels and ensure timely stock replenishment.
Minimize food wastage, pilferage, and operational losses.
Conduct stock counts and support inventory reconciliation.
Monitor consumption, food cost, packaging cost, and other controllable expenses.
7. Cash Management & Compliance
Ensure accurate cash handling, billing, POS operations, and end-of-day reconciliation.
Maintain operational records, registers, and reports as required.
Follow company policies and applicable statutory requirements.
Ensure proper handling of cash, inventory, and other company assets.
Eligibility Criteria
Education: Graduate preferred; candidates with relevant qualifications and QSR experience may also be considered.
Experience: 2–4 years of experience in restaurant operations, preferably in QSR, food service, or retail operations.
Prior experience in team handling, shift management, customer service, and sales performance is preferred.
Required Skills & Competencies
Strong leadership and team management skills.
Customer-first attitude and problem-solving ability.
Sales orientation and business acumen.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment.

Role & responsibilities


Job Description:
Objective: The purpose of the role is to execute all channel related activities for the designated area through vendor which includes eating and drinking, modern trade, mom and pop retailers, grocery and non traditional channels or point of sale and vendor management
Title: Team Leader Channel
Function: Commercial
Work Location: Indore, Pune
Job Responsibilities:
Channel Programs
1. Execution of unit specific initiatives in E&D, Grocery, and Convenience channel as per plan shared
2. Ensure outlet activation execution as per RED standards
3. Ensure support development and implementation of unit activation plans, using approved national/regional channel standards.
4. Planning of standard approved activation elements & other marketing collaterals
5. Execution and portfolio management as per the plan shared
Across depots & distributors
1. Execution of local initiatives
2. Tracking of systems and evaluation process
3. Local Initiatives to scale up the national/regional program
Analysis and Reporting
1. Activation as per RED / DEEP RED to do list.
2. Identify gaps & growth opportunities in various channels as per PITA model
3. Tracking of competition activities
4. Ensure activation in market through analysis RSA data
Supervises: None
Direct Reports: None
Geographical Scope:
Reports To: Area Channel Manager/Channel Manager
Key Customers:
Internal Customers: Sales Team at the Unit, Finance, RTM
External Customers: Vendors, Suppliers, Distributors, Key Accounts, Agencies, Customers
Job Requirements:
Qualifications: Graduation/M.B.A.
Experience: 4-8 Years
Functional Skills:
Customer Management (a)-Competent
Financial Knowledge / Application and Appreciation (a)- Working Knowledge
Market Execution (a)-Competent
Planning and Analytics (b)-Working Knowledge
Sales Management (b)-Working Knowledge
Travel: Above 75%
AboutCompany:
Our operations started in 1997 with the simple aim of making beverages for the India of the 21st century. Two decades later, we are one of Indias top FMCG companies. Only because fellow Indians, who have faith in the quality and purity of our products, pick our beverages, 439 times per second. Our 15 factories, spread across India, manufacture the beverages that India wants. And if it is about India, we better make the best. With stringent processes, world-class machines, state-of-the-art equipment, and the best packaging materials, we make 68 different beverage products in multiple categories. In doing so, we strive to leave things better than we first inherited. Be it by skewing our energy sourcing towards renewable and clean energy, or collaborating with the local communities, to make their lives better.
We are HCCB, we are Inspired by India.
To read more about us on www.hccb.in or follow our social media handles.

Description:
Role: Senior Data Engineer
Years of Experience: 5-8 Years
Location: Ahmedabad, Pune, Indore
Notice Period: Immediate to 30 Days Max
Must Skill: Python, SQL, Azure Databricks, ADF, ETL, Pyspark,

Role Summary
Build and operate scalable, reliable data pipelines on Azure. Develop batch and streaming ingestion, transform data using Databricks (PySpark/SQL), enforce data quality, and publish curated datasets for analytics and ML.

Key Responsibilities
Design, build, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines in Azure Data Factory and Databricks across Bronze Silver Gold layers.
Implement Delta Lake best practices (ACID, schema evolution, MERGE/upsert, time travel, Z-ORDER).
Write performant PySpark and SQL; tune jobs (partitioning, caching, join strategies).
Create reusable components; manage code in Git; contribute to CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions/Jenkins).
Apply data quality checks (Great Expectations or custom validations), monitoring, drift detection, and alerting.
Model data for analytics (star/dimensional); publish to Synapse/Snowflake/SQL Server.
Uphold governance and security (Purview/Unity Catalog lineage, RBAC, tagging, encryption, PII handling).
Author documentation/runbooks; support production incidents and root-cause analysis; suggest cost/performance improvements.

Must-Have (Mandatory)
Data Engineering & Pipelines
Hands-on experience building production pipelines with Azure Data Factory and Databricks (PySpark/SQL).
Working knowledge of Medallion Architecture and Delta Lake (schema evolution, ACID).
Programming & Automation
Strong Python (pandas/PySpark) and SQL.
Practical Git workflow; experience integrating pipelines into CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions/Jenkins).
Familiarity with packaging reusable code (e.g., Python wheels) and configuration-driven jobs.
Data Modeling & Warehousing
Solid grasp of dimensional modeling/star schemas; experience with Synapse, Snowflake, or SQL Server.
Data Quality & Monitoring
Implemented validation checks and alerts; exposure to drift detection and pipeline observability.
Cloud Platforms (Azure preferred)
ADLS Gen2, Key Vault, Databricks, ADF basics (linked services, datasets, triggers), environment promotion.
Data Governance & Security
Experience with metadata/lineage (Purview/Unity Catalog), RBAC, secrets management, and secure data sharing.
Understanding of PII/PHI handling and encryption at rest/in transit.
Collaboration
Clear communication, documentation discipline, Agile ways of working, and code reviews.

Good-to-Have
Databricks Asset Bundles (DAB) for environment promotion/infra-as-code style deployments.
Streaming/real-time: Kafka/Event Hubs; CDC tools (e.g., Debezium, ADF/Synapse CDC).
MLOps touchpoints: MLflow tracking/registry, feature tables, basic model-inference pipelines.
Power BI exposure for publishing curated tables and building operational KPIs.
DataOps practices: automated testing, data contracts, lineage-aware deployments, cost optimization on Azure.
Certifications: Microsoft Certified Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) or equivalent.

Qualifications
46 years of professional experience in data engineering (or equivalent project depth).
Bachelor’s/Master’s in CS/IT/Engineering or related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Role Name: SAP S/4HANA SD / Vistex / CS Consultant
Experience: 4 to 10 Years
Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli
Work Mode: Hybrid
Roles & Responsibilities
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to Sales & Distribution and Customer Service processes.
Configure and implement SAP S/4HANA SD solutions based on business needs.
Design and support Vistex solutions for rebates, chargebacks, incentives, claims, and pricing programs.
Work on Customer Service (CS) processes including service orders, warranty management, and service contracts.
Participate in end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementation, rollout, and enhancement projects.
Perform system configuration, testing, defect resolution, and user acceptance testing support.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including MM, FI, PP, and technical teams.
Prepare functional specifications and support developments, integrations, and interfaces.
Conduct client workshops, provide solution recommendations, and support go-live activities.
Ensure adherence to SAP best practices and project standards.
Mandatory Skills
Strong hands-on experience in SAP S/4HANA Sales & Distribution (SD).
Mandatory experience in Vistex.
Mandatory experience in SAP Customer Service (CS).
Strong knowledge of:
Order-to-Cash (O2C)
Pricing
Sales Orders
Deliveries
Billing
Credit Management
Returns Process
Experience in Vistex modules such as:
Rebates
Chargebacks
Incentives
Claims Management
Pricing Programs
Minimum one end-to-end SAP S/4HANA Implementation project.
Experience in requirement gathering, configuration, testing, and deployment.
Integration knowledge with MM, FI, and other SAP modules.
Strong client-facing and stakeholder management skills.

Job Information
Job Title

Business Development Partner (Commission Based)

Role Association:
This is a commission-based model only and the association shall be a commission earning structure where the partner earns once the client releases the payout.
Location(s):

Inviting Business Development Partners from the following locations, (However not constrained):-
Mumbai

Target Businesses:
Hospitals / Clinics / Doctors
Pharmacy Outlets
Restaurants and Hotels.
Tour and Travel Agencies
Retail Outlets and Shops
Automobile Agencies / Showrooms / Garage
Salon / Beauticians / Boutique
Theme Parks / Theatres / Public Entertainment set ups
Professional Services Astrologers / Doctors / Veterinarians / Chartered Accountants / etc.
And other businesses within your city / nearby locations.
Job Purpose
Business Development and “New Market” & “Emerging Market” Business Development and Client Acquisition.
Generate Business through networking with Business Heads / Business Owners.
This is strictly a “Commission Based” association only and not a fixed salaried job. Please do study the key terms of association below.
Anyone who can contribute parallely with his current assignment or through part time or is a Home Based Entrepreneur.
Desired Exposure: Should have a strong network / association with local businesses.
Main Accountabilities
Role Requisites
Business Development

Generating business by coordinating with local business connects.
Cross selling services offered by “Udbhabana Business Solutions”, focus shall be on Business development of “Udbhabana Digytech Solutions”, though.
Brand Positioning

Position brand “Udbhabana Digytech Solutions” in the domain of expertise and generate brand awareness within the local and adjoining cities / territories.
Brand Value Preposition through customized Digytech solutions and position “Udbhabana Digytech Solutions” as one of the prominent business partners.
Key Points of Association
Rule of Association

This is a “Commission Based Assignment”.
Incumbent shall be responsible for Business Development and Client Acquisition with Udbhabana Business Solutions.
Incumbent shall receive a 100 percent payout within 72 banking hours upon receipt of 100 percent payment from the client, after statutory deductions if any, through bank transfer only.
Recurring Commissions

Recurring commissions are projects where Udbhabana Business Solutions are associated on a monthly delivery model and here the incumbent shall receive the said recurring commission every month, post payment by the client.
Statutes shall be applicable as per law.
One-Time Commissions

One time projects are projects where Udbhabana Business Solutions are associated for one specific project or task, and here the incumbent shall receive the said recurring commission every month, post payment by the client.
Statutes shall be applicable as per law.
Payout Timelines

Payouts shall be through bank transfers only, or as discussed during joining, and shall attract TDS or any form of mandatory local statutes.
Payout shall be released within 72 banking hours after the receipt of 100 percent payment from the client.
Desired Professional Attributes:
Incumbents with atleast one year of Business Development of any IT based service, however not a compulsion though.
Must have a great networking connect with local businesses.
Should be smart to understand the local businesses challenges and advise Digital Marketing and Tech solutions, as appropriate.
Udbhabana Business Solutions Offerings:
Please note that this commission-based role is for Digital Marketing Services from Udbhabana Business Solutions, however incumbents must be aware of the bouquet of services offered by Udbhabana Business Solutions, and if the incumbent makes a cross selling for any of the following services, besides Digital Marketing, then the incumbent has the potential to earn commissions as per the table mentioned below:
Job Information
Domains

Services

Payouts
Tech Solutions

Digital Marketing.
E Commerce Platforms.
Create and Manage Websites.
Web & Mobile based App development & management.

One-Time Assignments: 6 Percent of Gross Billing.
(TDS / Taxes or compliance as applicable during disbursement shall be deducted, as per statutes)
Human Resource

Recruitments.
Labour Law / Compliance Projects.
Talent Management
Organizational Development.
Performance Management Projects
Salary Outsourcing / Payroll Outsourcing

(TDS / Taxes or compliance as applicable during disbursement shall be deducted, as per statutes)
Note:-
Payouts mentioned above are on Gross Payout for Udbhabana Business Solutions only and excludes any sub-outsourced fee for the said project, if applied.
Potential good performers will be given an option / invitation, to associate with us, with the same Variable Commissions and a fixed monthly salary component, after six months of successful and good performing association.
This opportunity is valid for Business Development association and related commissions within India only, if an incumbent generates overseas or international business, for which commissions will be discussed and finalized, case-to-case.

Description:
Position: Cluster Human Resource

Eligibility Parameters:
3-4 years of experience in Human Resource generalist role.

Education Qualification
Minimum : MBA/ PGBDA (HR) (regular course)

Position Reports to : AHR /Zonal HR
Reportees : HR Intern (Wherever applicable)

Required Competencies
Technical Expertise
Communication & Presentation skills
Planning & Organising
Counselling & Coaching
Teamwork & networking
Problem Solving

Key Accountabilities/Responsibilities
The most important end-results for which an incumbent would be held responsible at the end of the year.

Manpower Budgeting
Involved in proposing the manpower budgets after taking into account various projections & projected manpower numbers for the coming year.
Allocates the staff in various sub-departments considering various factors like Strengths & weaknesses of each member, GMROL, level of intervention required with the customer (A/B/C), MPA along with DMs & UM
Ensures availability of that manpower as per budgets and checks that budgets are not exceeded beyond permissible limits.
Does availability study periodically, gives feedback to DMs & Supervisors and arrives at solutions for problem areas.

Recruitment, Selection & Induction
Ties up with consultants to meet manpower requirements. Negotiate with them for least possible service fees.
Follows up with consultants for filling up vacancy as soon as possible
Maintains database of applications, rejects
Liases with institutes and colleges for CCA applications
Prepares for and conducts assessment centre for selection
Conducts interviews with UH for selection for all store level positions upto Department Managers.
Evaluates need for placing of advertisements & gets required approvals
Ensures induction schedule is prepared for new joinees, induction goes as per plan, adequate inputs are given and employees are equipped enough before they are on the job.

Training & Development
Prepares training calendar after collating data from PA forms & discussions with concerned Supervisors & DMs.
Does module development on certain training areas
Ensures all infrastructure is in place for internal training programs
Liases with external consultants for specific training needs which cannot be catered to internally & negotiates for best quality at best rate and gets necessary approvals for external trainings.
Ensures smooth execution of trainings.
Ensures training evaluation is done for each program conducted
Liases with Brands/ SO for product/ brand training
Delivers training programs

Payroll Activities
Ensure error-free & timely updation of employee data on system.
Ensures all payroll inputs to be closed as per given timelines with the central payroll team.

Employee Communication & Policy implementation
Communicates employee related policies and ensures adherence to the same
Clarifies queries related to policies and gives feedback on the same to the SO

Welfare Activities
Handles employee grievances at all levels by coaching & counselling
Ensures tie-ups for employees with other institutions like computer institutes, libraries etc.
Ensures execution of employee engagement activities as per annual calaneder.
Activates unit led awards to keep motivation levels high

Statutory Compliances
Liases with consultants to ensure statutory compliances & timely filing of returns.
Ensures statutory compliances are met wrt brand staff, concessionaires etc.

Performance Appraisal
Communicates to the staff the appraisal schedules & process to be followed which are sent be SO
Conducts PA workshops for assessors to throw light on process & common appraisal errors
Ensures regular follow ups to ensure appraisals are done as per time lines
Goes through appraisal forms to oversee the quality of the feedback & comments & evaluate objectivity
Does the normalisation for each supervisor team and communicate ratings as per normal curve back to the supervisors. Make changes, discuss with concerned HODs and arrive at final ratings
Sends collated data to SO
Counsels employees if dissatisfaction arises post increments showing them the organization perspective & the way ahead

Description:
About TaskUs: TaskUs is a provider of outsourced digital services and next-generation customer experience to fast-growing technology companies, helping its clients represent, protect and grow their brands. Leveraging a cloud-based infrastructure, TaskUs serves clients in the fastest-growing sectors, including social media, e-commerce, gaming, streaming media, food delivery, ride-sharing, HiTech, FinTech, and HealthTech.

The People First culture at TaskUs has enabled the company to expand its workforce to approximately 45,000 employees globally. Presently, we have a presence in twenty-three locations across twelve countries, which include the Philippines, India, and the United States.

It started with one ridiculously good idea to create a different breed of Business Processing Outsourcing (BPO)! We at TaskUs understand that achieving growth for our partners requires a culture of constant motion, exploring new technologies, being ready to handle any challenge at a moments notice, and mastering consistency in an ever-changing world.

What We Offer: At TaskUs, we prioritize our employees' well-being by offering competitive industry salaries and comprehensive benefits packages. Our commitment to a People First culture is reflected in the various departments we have established, including Total Rewards, Wellness, HR, and Diversity. We take pride in our inclusive environment and positive impact on the community. Moreover, we actively encourage internal mobility and professional growth at all stages of an employee's career within TaskUs. Join our team today and experience firsthand our dedication to supporting People First.

Think of yourself as one of the leaders of your department and not just anyone is qualified for this role. We make sure we get the best of the best, after all, we are a ridiculously good company so we make sure our employees are top notch. We need your full concentration because its time to imagine what it’s like being a Team Leader.Imagine yourself going to work with one thing on your mind: to provide the best customer experience to your clients. As you look at your tasks for the day, you should be able to drive the performance of teammates in order for them to continuously hit their goals. You must be able to coach and manage the teammates under your supervision and act as a bridge between your teammates and the other departments.Being a Team Leader, you will manage the day-to-day planning and operations of your team. This includes making sure that each of your Teammates delivers on their Service Level Agreement (SLA) and achieve their Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). As Team Leader, you are in charge of managing the team and making sure everyone adheres to their schedules. You must be organized and be able to handle responsibility. A critical part of the role is to be able to train and help in the development of your team, by conducting team huddles, coaching sessions, and recognizing weaknesses - so you can offer solutions to help them improve and grow. Through that, your team will be able to deliver a superior customer experience - which is the main thrust of your department. If you have previous experience working on the phone, email and live chat customer support roles, then that’s a plus in your favor. If you’re familiar with E-Commerce, ZenDesk, or any other CRM tools; flexible and willing to work different shifts - then we definitely want to talk to you.

How We Partner To Protect You: TaskUs will neither solicit money from you during your application process nor require any form of payment in order to proceed with your application. Kindly ensure that you are always in communication with only authorized recruiters of TaskUs
