Description:
The Front Office Executive is responsible for managing reception operations and ensuring a smooth and professional first impression for patients, visitors, and vendors.
The role includes greeting and assisting individuals upon arrival, handling inquiries both in person and over the phone, and maintaining a welcoming environment at all times.
The executive manages appointment scheduling, coordinates with doctors and healthcare professionals, and informs patients about any delays or changes in their appointments.
They assist patients with registration and admission forms, accurately enter patient details into the hospital management system, and verify important documents such as ID proofs and insurance papers.
The role also involves coordinating with the billing department for payments, handling various payment modes including cash and card, and issuing accurate bills and receipts.
Additionally, the executive ensures the front office area remains organized, maintains necessary records and reports, supports interdepartmental coordination for smooth operations, addresses patient concerns courteously, provides information about hospital services and doctor availability, answers and routes phone calls appropriately, responds to emails and messages promptly, and facilitates effective communication between patients and hospital departments.

Role & responsibilities
We are seeking a Network Implementation Engineer to perform the staging, configuration, migration, and cutover of enterprise and data center network environments. This role is responsible for turning Low-Level Designs (LLDs) and High-Level Designs (HLDs) into production reality across Cisco routing, switching, wireless, and security ecosystems. The ideal candidate has deep Cisco CLI expertise, hands-on experience executing maintenance windows, and familiarity with Cisco's controller-led architectures (Catalyst Center).
Key Roles and Responsibilities
Implement and configure Router and Switches in enterprise environment.
Replacement and migration of EOL router and Switches in enterprise setup.
Understating and experience on ACL and Qos configuration.

Onboard devices into Cisco Catalyst Center (formerly DNA Spaces/DNAC) for automated template deployment.
Lead scheduled, off-hours maintenance windows to perform core/distribution cutovers, legacy hardware decommissioning, and software upgrades (IOS-XE / NX-OS).

Wireless- Hands on experience on cisco air OS and catalyst controllers (8500,5520,9800), Access point, RF fundamentals, WLAN fundamentals.
Experience & Certifications
Experience: 6 months of hands-on deployment and migration experience specifically within production networks.
Education Graduate from any stream (Engineering graduates preferred) or equivalent practical field experience.
Certifications (Required or Strongly Preferred):
Cisco CCNA (minimum prerequisite if accompanied by deep field experience),CCNP preferred.
Cisco CCNA Wireless is a strong plus.

Role & responsibilities

Job Title: Business Development Manager
Company: G4S Secure Solutions India
Location: Multiple Locations / Pan-India Hubs
Experience: 2 8 Years
Role Type: Full-Time, Individual Contributor

About the Role
We are looking for high-energy, target-driven Business Development Managers to drive our Mid-Market corporate sales across Pan-India hubs. In this role, you will focus on acquiring new mid-sized corporate clients and expanding business within existing accounts.
You will manage mid-sized commercial deals (ranging from 20 Lakhs to 85 Lakhs+ / 25K–100K in annual contract value), allowing you to focus purely on high-impact corporate accounts while smaller transactional inquiries are handled by our operations team.

What’s in It for You? (Compensation & Growth)
Monthly Payouts: Fast-paced monthly performance tracking with monthly commission payouts.
Multi-Year Earning Potential: Earn trailing commissions in Years 2 and 3 for multi-year contracts you close, plus an Annual Target Bonus.
Clear Career Path: High performers hitting targets for 2 consecutive years qualify for fast-track promotion to Enterprise Sales roles.
Key Responsibilities
1. New Business Acquisition (50% of your time)
Identify and pitch to potential corporate clients across industrial corridors, manufacturing plants, logistics hubs, and commercial buildings through cold calling, field visits, and networking.
Follow up on and convert inbound leads from digital marketing, website inquiries, and branch referrals.
Prepare accurate pricing proposals/cost sheets using company tools and respond to commercial RFQs while maintaining healthy profit margins.
Close multi-year security service contracts within the mid-market segment.
2. Account Expansion & Retention (35% of your time)
Build strong relationships with existing mid-market clients to expand manpower deployments across new sites.
Cross-sell electronic security solutions (CCTV, access control, and intrusion detection packages) to existing customers.
Manage timely contract renewals (targeting 90%+ retention) and execute annual price revisions aligned with statutory minimum wage updates.
3. Sales Operations & Smooth Handover (15% of your time)
Maintain up-to-date pipeline data, meeting notes, and deal stages in Salesforce (CRM).
Coordinate closely with Branch Operations and Finance teams after contract signing to ensure smooth deployment and timely billing.
Who We Are Looking For

Experience & Education:
Education: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (MBA in Sales/Marketing is a plus).
Manager: 2–5 years of proven experience in high-volume B2B / field sales.
Senior Manager: 5–8 years of proven B2B / commercial services sales experience.
Skills & Competencies:
Sales Hustle: Strong track record in B2B field sales, cold calling, lead qualification, and closing deals quickly.
Client Relationship Management: Ability to engage and negotiate with Business Owners, Plant Heads, Facility Managers, and Purchase Officers.
Commercial Acumen: Comfortable working with pricing/costing sheets, profit margins, and basic labour compliance/minimum wage structures.
Tech-Savvy: Hands-on experience using CRM tools (like Salesforce) and MS Excel.
(Preferred) Basic understanding of manned guarding or electronic security systems (CCTV, access control).

Role Summary

Own endtoend onboarding of vendors, dealers and other counterparties under anchorled Supply Chain Finance programs. Ensure fast, compliant onboarding, smooth activation and strong earlystage engagement to drive utilization and portfolio hygiene.

Key Responsibilities

Engage with vendors/dealers to explain SCF products, benefits and onboarding process.
Manage complete onboarding workflow: KYC, documentation, risk checks, approvals and limit setup.
Coordinate with Credit, Risk, Ops, Legal and Tech for frictionless onboarding and compliance.

Monitor counterparty-level ageing/overdue, flag early warning indicators, follow-up for payments, support Collections on early bucket resolution, and ensure anchor alignment on disputes.
Resolve operational issues, documentation gaps and onboarding bottlenecks.
Maintain MIS, funnel trackers and adherence to onboarding TATs.
Support Anchor Relationship Managers with utilization, reactivation and earlycycle portfolio hygiene.

Counterparties onboarded
Onboarding TAT (Pre-sanction documentation Approval post-sanction documentation Golive)
Documentation quality / monitor deferrals.
Firstdrawdown % and utilization support

Experience: 4 to 10 years in SCF, Working Capital, Trade Finance, MSME lending or onboarding roles.
Skills: Strong communication, KYC/AML understanding, documentation accuracy, process discipline, Excel/CRM familiarity.
Traits: High ownership, speed, detailorientation, customer empathy.

Education
Graduate/MBA preferred.
Certifications in KYC/Compliance/SCF are advantageous.

Description:
COMPANY PROFILE
Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world s most ambitious changemakers define the future.
Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefining industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.
WHAT MAKES US GREAT PLACE TO WORK
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the worlds best places to work. We are currently the #1 ranked consulting firm on Glassdoors Best Places to Work list and have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoors list since its founding in 2009.
Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these dont happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
WHO YOULL WORK WITH
Youll join our Data Science & Machine Learning Engineering experts within the Applied Technology & AI team. This team is part of Bains digital capabilities practice, which includes experts in analytics, engineering, product management, and design. In this multidisciplinary environment, youll leverage deep technical expertise with business acumen to help clients tackle their most transformative challenges. Youll work on integrated teams alongside our general consultants and clients to develop data-driven strategies and innovative solutions. Together, we create human-centric solutions that harness the power of data and artificial intelligence to drive competitive advantage for our clients. Our collaborative and supportive work environment fosters creativity and continuous learning, enabling us to consistently deliver exceptional results.
The Role
As a Lead, Full-Stack Data Scientist, you will leverage your experience to design, implement and refine algorithms to extract and use actionable information from multi-modal data across a wide range of industries and business problems. You bring a strong generalist foundation across core data science methods (e.g., statistics, forecasting, optimization, and machine learning) that lets you move fluidly across problem types rather than specializing narrowly in one. [CP1] You ll develop and deploy analytical and machine learning models that power production systems such as dynamic personalization and pricing engines, predictive maintenance and always-on forecasting and optimization capabilities.
You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.
Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn by doing, with support from experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.
WHAT YOU LL DO
Develop data, technology and AI solutions, leveraging a spectrum of techniques including data science, machine learning, AI algorithms to address large-scale enterprise challenges and enable production systems
Develop and maintain long-lasting models, algorithms, and tools that support internal or client needs
Collaborate closely with and influence general consulting teams to identify analytics solutions for client business problems and to execute those solutions
Leverage AI tools with guardrails to accelerate and amplify design, development and implementation phases across the life cycle
Evaluate where generative AI offers a better path to a client solution, and apply techniques such as prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and model fine-tuning where appropriate
Collaborate with technology leaders to develop and advocate for cutting-edge data science concepts to both technical audiences and business stakeholders
Collaborate with data engineers to ensure data pipelines and platforms support modeling, experimentation, and analytics use cases
Support data transformations at scale, including cleaning, enriching, de-duping, joining, and correlating structured, semi-structured, or unstructured data for modeling and analysis
Define and implement new and innovative modeling techniques, experimentation strategies, and analytics workflows within Bains full model development life cycle, including documentation, unit/integration testing, and reviews
Support model deployment and operationalization in collaboration with engineering teams, ensuring scalable data science solutions
Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders; lead working sessions, present recommendations, and write crisp technical documentation
Collaborate with client data engineering and analytics teams and, when needed, contribute to data acquisition, extraction, and preparation to ensure data is fit for modeling and analysis
Establish and promote best practices for model development, documentation, and reuse, enabling scalable and repeatable approaches across industries and use cases
Help prioritize and scope data science initiatives by translating complex client business problems into actionable projects with clear execution paths
Provide technical guidance to external clients and internal stakeholders at Bain
Contribute to industry-leading innovations that translate into meaningful impact for clients in casework
Stay current with emerging trends and technologies in data science, and proactively identify opportunities to enhance the capabilities of the analytics platform
ABOUT YOU
Required:
A strong generalist background with proficiency across core data science methods, including forecasting, statistical modeling, optimization modeling and machine learning
An interest in applying your expertise across a wide array of industries and problems
Strong experience working in common data science query and programming languages (Python required, at least working knowledge of SQL)
Hands-on experience with at least two of the following problem types, with breadth of experience across associated tools and techniques
Marketing mix modeling (Bayesian regression, causal inference, adstock/saturation modeling)
Price elasticity and optimization (econometrics, causal inference, optimization)
Segmentation and personalization (clustering, recommendation systems, experimentation, bandits)
Supply chain / OR (optimization, simulation)
Demand forecasting (time series, hierarchical forecasting, ML)
Predictive maintenance (survival analysis, anomaly detection, sensor time series)
Experience building and evaluating LLM-based applications, including prompt optimization
Experience in AI-native delivery, such as using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate modeling work, generate and test hypotheses, and prototype analytical approaches
Hands-on experience collaborating with engineering teams to take models into production
Experience working in agile, cross-functional team environments
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to discuss technicalities of solutions, algorithms, and techniques with colleagues and clients
Curiosity, proactivity, and critical thinking
Ability to collaborate with people at all levels and with multi-office/region teams
Strong stakeholder management skills, with both internal leadership and with clients
Proven ability to operate in ambiguity and complexity, manage priorities, and deliver outcomes independently or with a collaborative team
Advanced degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Econometrics, Statistics or Information Sciences
3+ years of experience in advanced analytics or related field
Preferred (non-requisite)
Working knowledge of Bayesian methods
Experience deploying ML models using containerization (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform) and MLOps tooling such as MLflow and GitHub Actions
Experience managing data workflows and pipelines for modeling
Working knowledge of SQL or NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Snowflake, or similar)
Experience scaling model training and inference on large datasets, and optimizing pipelines for performance in production environments
Experience with building complete web apps using coding assistants
Experience building agentic harnesses and orchestration of agentic processes
This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

Description:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.
Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
WHO YOU LL WORK WITH
Vector is Bain s integrated digital and analytics capability, bringing together Enterprise Technology and AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) to deliver cutting-edge innovation. AIS, formed through the merger of Bains Advanced Analytics and Innovation & Design teams, is a diverse group of experts in analytics, engineering, product management, and design. Together, we create human-centric solutions that leverage the power of data and artificial intelligence to drive competitive advantage for our clients.

WHAT YOU LL DO
As an Expert Manager, Platform Engineering, you will lead the design and build of cloud-based distributed systems that solve complex business challenges for some of the world s largest companies. You will draw on your deep software engineering, cloud engineering, and DevOps expertise to design and build technology stacks and platform components that enable cross-functional AI Engineering teams to create robust, observable, and scalable solutions. You will guide a diverse engineering team through the entire engineering life cycle.

Lead cloud solution and distributed systems architecture for full stack AI software and data solutions
Collaborate closely with and influence general consulting teams to identify analytic solutions to client business problems, and to appropriately scope, prioritize and execute those solutions
A technical leader responsible for defining and implementing scalable, observable, manageable, and self-healing cloud-based solutions across AWS, Google Cloud and Azure
Lead key parts of implementation, testing and management of Infrastructure as Code (IAC) of cloud-based solutions that may include CI/CD, data integrations, APIs, web and mobile apps, and AI solutions
Participate in code reviews and contribute to the establishment and enforcement of coding standards and best practices to ensure high-quality, maintainable code
Lead implementation of robust security measures to protect sensitive data and ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and organizational policies.
Collaborate on (or lead) the development and maintenance of APIs and microservices to expose analytics functionality to internal and external consumers, adhering to best practices for API design and documentation
Work with the team and other senior leaders to create a great working environment that attracts other great engineers
Coach engineering teams at our clients and partners to raise their capabilities and ensure that our work is successfully deployed to the highest standards
Drive best demonstrated practices in platform engineering, and share learnings with team members in AAG about theoretical and technical developments in platform engineering
Drive industry-leading innovations that translate into great impact for our clients in case work
Act as PD Advisor as needed
Participate in recruiting and onboarding for other team members

ABOUT YOU
Required
7+ years minimum experience and 4+ years at Lead or Staff level, or equivalent
Master s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
Proven experience as a cloud engineer and software engineer within either product engineering or professional services organizations
Commercial acumen and understanding of business models

Technical Skills and Knowledge:
Track record designing and delivering cloud-based distributed solutions GCP, AWS, or Azure
Experience building infrastructure as code with tools such as Terraform (preferred), Cloud Formation, Pulumi, AWS CDK, CDKTF, etc.
Experience building backend APIs, services and/or integrations with Python
Deep familiarity with nuances of software development lifecycle
One or more configuration management tools: Ansible, Salt, Puppet, or Chef
One or more monitoring and analytics platforms: Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, SumoLogic, NewRelic, DataDog, CloudWatch, Nagios/Icinga
CI/CD deployment pipelines (e.g. Github Actions, Jenkins, Travis CI, Gitlab CI, Circle CI)
Practitioner experience with Kubernetes through services like GKE, EKS or AKS is a benefit
Experience implementation of large-scale structured or unstructured databases, orchestration and container technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes or Terraform
Experience with workflow orchestration such as dbt, Beam, Airflow, Luigy, Metaflow, Kubeflow, or any other
Use Git as your main tool for versioning and collaborating
Exposure to LLMs, Prompt engineering, Langchain a plus
Experience designing API interfaces
Strong computer science fundaments in data structures, algorithms, automated testing, object-oriented programming, performance complexity, and implications of computer architecture on software performance
Experience in data architecture, database schema design, database scalability
Experience working according to agile principles
Travel frequency and destinations will vary based on project needs.
Hybrid role

Interpersonal Skills:
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to explain and discuss technicalities of solutions, algorithms and techniques with colleagues and clients from other disciplines
Curiosity, proactivity and critical thinking
Ability to collaborate with people at all levels and with multi-office/region teams
Ability to work independently and juggle priorities to thrive in a fast paced and ambiguous environment, while also collaborating as part of a team in complex situations

Customer Engagement

Deliver proactive engagement at key milestones and moments of truth” to build trust and loyalty.

Revenue Ownership

Service Excellence

Collaborate with internal teams to resolve issues, track complaints, and escalate systemic blockers.

AboutCompany:
The House of Abhinandan Lodha (HoABL), founded in 2020, is Indias largest branded land developer and one of the fastest-growing premium real estate brands in the country. Description:
Role Summary / Purpose

The Manager Workforce Solutions (ADP WorkForce Software Configuration) leads the design and delivery of client workforce management transformation and implementation engagements. The role owns ADP WorkForce Software (WFS) solution design and configuration governance, guides integration and testing strategy, manages delivery teams and senior client stakeholders, and ensures workforce policies and payroll requirements are translated into sustainable, controlled solutions.
Essential Responsibilities
Lead ADP WorkForce Software implementation and optimization workstreams from discovery and solution design through configuration, testing, cutover and stabilization.
Own solution design for time and attendance, workforce scheduling, leave/accruals, approval workflows and workforce-to-payroll integration within the contracted scope.
Facilitate senior client design workshops and translate complex workforce policies, collective bargaining rules and pay practices into scalable configuration standards.
Provide expert oversight of rule configuration for overtime, premiums, shifts, breaks, rounding, holidays, exception management and pay code mappings.
Guide the design of organizational structures, security roles, manager workflows, reporting and control frameworks, balancing standard functionality with business needs.
Oversee HR and payroll integration design, interface specifications, end-to-end data flows, reconciliations and defect resolution with technical teams and vendors.
Approve configuration workbooks, design decisions, testing strategy, traceability and deployment readiness; manage scope changes and design trade-offs.
Direct system integration testing, user acceptance testing and parallel validation where relevant; ensure critical defects and payroll-impacting issues are resolved.
Manage project plans, resourcing, budgets, risks, dependencies, quality and client communications for assigned engagements.
Scheduling Go-Live Review Board and presenting configuration, audits and cutover plan to ADP WorkForce Software Enablement Services
Advise client leadership on workforce management operating models, controls, compliance considerations and opportunities for automation and standardization.
Lead, coach and review the work of Senior Associates and Associates; develop reusable accelerators and strengthen the WFS configuration capability.
Support proposals, estimates, statements of work, solution demonstrations and practice development activities as required.
Partner with HR, payroll, finance, operations and technology stakeholders to map workforce management processes, policies, controls and integration dependencies.
Assess workforce management and payroll impacts of time capture, attendance exceptions, scheduling, leave, overtime and premium pay rules.
Maintain configuration decisions, requirements traceability, process flows, test evidence and handover documentation in line with project governance.
Identify opportunities to streamline manual processes, improve data quality and strengthen workforce-to-payroll controls.

Qualifications / Requirements
Bachelors degree in Human Resources, Business, Information Systems, Engineering, Finance or related discipline; relevant advanced degree is an advantage.
ADP WorkForce Suite Certifications (configuration required)
WorkForce Time Configuration through Time201
WorkForce Reports
WorkForce Time Integrations
Approximately 8-12+ years of experience in workforce management, HR technology or payroll transformation, including leadership of implementation workstreams.
Demonstrated experience leading ADP WorkForce Software (WFS) solution design and configuration, ideally across multiple client implementations.
Deep knowledge of complex time and attendance rules, workforce scheduling, accruals, labor policies and downstream payroll impacts.
Experience overseeing integrations, configuration governance, test strategy, cutover and production stabilization.
Proven ability to manage client executives, cross-functional delivery teams, project risks, quality and commercial expectations.
Desired Skills
Experience delivering enterprise-scale, multi-location or multi-jurisdiction WFS implementations and optimization programs.
Ability to define standard design patterns, configuration governance, reusable assets and quality review checkpoints.
Knowledge of workforce compliance, payroll controls, data privacy, role-based access and audit requirements.
Experience with complex HR/payroll ecosystems and vendor-led integrations.
Strong consulting, stakeholder management, team leadership, commercial and problem-solving skills.
Grade / Level
Manager

Description:
Role Summary / Purpose
The Senior Associate Workforce Solutions (ADP WorkForce Software Configuration) supports client workforce management and payroll transformation engagements, with a focus on hands-on configuration of ADP Workforce Software (WFS), including time and attendance, scheduling, leave and workforce-to-payroll interfaces. The role supports requirements, solution configuration, testing, deployment and stabilization while collaborating with client stakeholders, vendors and PwC delivery teams.

Essential Responsibilities
Configure and maintain ADP WorkForce Software modules and settings based on approved business requirements, including time capture, attendance, schedules, pay rules, accruals and absence policies, as applicable to the client deployment.
Translate labor agreements, workforce policies and payroll requirements into configuration specifications for overtime, shifts, premiums, breaks, rounding, holidays and exception handling.
Support requirements workshops and document current-state and future-state processes, configuration workbooks, rule matrices and design decisions.
Set up and validate employee groups, organizational structures, calendars, approval workflows, roles and security permissions within the agreed solution scope.
Support configuration of time collection methods, timesheet approvals, manager self-service, alerts and reporting where enabled.
Work with integration teams to define and test inbound HR master data and outbound approved time/pay data interfaces to payroll and other downstream systems.
Execute unit, system integration, regression and user acceptance testing; prepare scenarios, reconcile results and investigate configuration defects.
Support data conversion, deployment readiness, cutover activities, production validation and hypercare troubleshooting.
Prepare client-facing status updates, defect logs, issue trackers and configuration documentation; escalate design or delivery risks promptly.
Support junior team members through knowledge sharing, review of work products and consistent testing and documentation practices.
Partner with HR, payroll, finance, operations and technology stakeholders to map workforce management processes, policies, controls and integration dependencies.
Assess workforce management and payroll impacts of time capture, attendance exceptions, scheduling, leave, overtime and premium pay rules.
Maintain configuration decisions, requirements traceability, process flows, test evidence and handover documentation in line with project governance.
Identify opportunities to streamline manual processes, improve data quality and strengthen workforce-to-payroll controls.

Qualifications / Requirements
Approximately 4-8 years of experience in workforce management, time and attendance, HRIS or payroll implementation and support.
ADP WorkForce Suite Certifications (configuration and integrations required)
WorkForce Time Configuration through Time500
WorkForce Reports
WorkForce Time Integrations
Practical hands-on configuration experience in ADP WorkForce Software (WFS); direct WFS experience required.
Understanding of timekeeping, scheduling, leave/accrual rules, overtime calculations, pay code mapping and payroll interfaces.
Experience across discovery, configuration, test execution, defect resolution, cutover and post-go-live support.
Ability to engage client stakeholders, analyze complex rule scenarios and document clear configuration decisions.
Desired Skills
Experience with ADP WorkForce Software time and attendance and scheduling configuration in multi-site or complex policy environments.
Exposure to API, file-based or middleware integrations with payroll and HR platforms.
Understanding of wage-and-hour, labor agreement and jurisdiction-specific workforce rules as they affect configuration.
Experience with configuration migration, security roles, reporting, reconciliation and production support.
Strong analytical, communication, documentation and stakeholder coordination skills.
Grade / Level
Senior Associate

Client Advisor Job Description
About NoBroker
NoBroker is a technology-led real estate platform focused on simplifying the property buying, selling, and renting experience through technology. We operate in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where ownership, customer experience, and business outcomes are highly valued.
About the Role
We are looking for Client Advisors to join our sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving sales, understanding customer requirements, guiding customers through NoBroker’s products and services, and converting leads into successful customers.
The role requires strong communication, relationship-building, follow-up, and negotiation skills, along with a target-oriented mindset.
Key Responsibilities
Drive sales and revenue targets within the assigned territory.
Identify and connect with potential customers to understand their property requirements.
Guide customers on NoBroker’s plans, products, and value-added services.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships throughout the sales journey.
Generate leads through calls, referrals, follow-ups, and local market opportunities.
Conduct product/service demonstrations and clearly explain pricing and benefits.
Handle customer queries, objections, and escalations effectively.
Convert leads into customers and consistently achieve individual sales targets.
Follow up with prospective customers to maximize conversions.
Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities for premium plans and additional services.
Maintain accurate customer information, follow-ups, and sales activities in the CRM.
Track daily sales performance, pipeline status, and achievement against targets.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding and service delivery.
Stay updated on local market trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities.
Prepare regular sales reports and share performance updates with the reporting manager.
Candidate Requirements
Experience: Freshers can apply.
Education: Any Graduation.
Age: Up to 30 years.
Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Good customer-handling and relationship-management abilities.
Strong persuasion, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills.
Comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
Self-motivated, persistent, and result-oriented.
Willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced sales environment.
Hiring Details

Why Join NoBroker?
Opportunity to build a career in a fast-paced PropTech environment.
Performance-driven growth opportunities.
Exposure to sales, customer management, negotiation, and business development.

Description:
Job Title: Network Provisioning Lead
Location: Bangalore/Noida
Qualification: Any Graduation
Level: P4-I
Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM / based on business requirements
Job Summary
The Network Provisioning Lead will provide day-to-day operational leadership for telecom provisioning activities covering Order Entry, Circuit Design, ASR, and circuit implementation. The role will ensure workload is effectively managed, provisioning milestones are achieved, quality standards are maintained, and operational issues are resolved or escalated appropriately.
Key Responsibilities
Lead day-to-day activities across the assigned provisioning workstream.
Manage work allocation, priorities, aging orders and critical due dates.
Monitor productivity, quality, SLA/TAT and delivery performance.
Support team members with telecom, provisioning, process and tool-related questions.
Review complex provisioning issues and guide the team toward resolution.
Coordinate with Planning, Order Management, ASR, Design, Operations and other internal teams.
Work with carriers/vendors where support or follow-up is required.
Identify delivery risks and take appropriate action before committed dates are impacted.
Ensure process adherence, documentation and inventory updates are completed correctly.
Support knowledge transfer and readiness as activities transition to the India team.
Coach team members and identify skill or knowledge gaps.
Drive process improvement and automation opportunities across the workstream.
Provide regular operational updates to management and stakeholders.
Required Skills
Strong understanding of telecom/network provisioning.

Job Summary
The Network Provisioning Escalation & Insights Specialist will provide operational visibility across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Hot Cut and related provisioning activities. The role will focus on data validation, identifying aging orders and operational risks, analyzing trends and ensuring the right issues are escalated to the right teams at the right time.
The role will work across provisioning teams, Operations, internal stakeholders and external carriers/vendors to drive issues through resolution.
Key Responsibilities
Monitor operational data across network provisioning activities.
Validate order, milestone and provisioning information for accuracy and completeness.
Identify aging orders, missed milestones, jeopardies, recurring issues and delivery risks.
Analyze operational trends and highlight areas requiring attention.
Identify data discrepancies and work with the responsible team to correct them.
Determine which issues require escalation based on aging, customer impact, due date and operational risk.
Drive the right escalation to the right team at the right time.
Track escalated issues through closure rather than only raising the escalation.
Coordinate with Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Provisioning, Operations and other internal teams.
Coordinate with carriers/vendors regarding provisioning delays and unresolved dependencies.
Provide clear operational insights and status reporting to stakeholders and leadership.
Support root-cause analysis for repeat issues.
Identify process gaps based on data and operational trends.
Recommend improvements to reduce aging, exceptions and repeated escalations.
Support reporting and dashboard automation to improve operational visibility.
Required Skills
Good understanding of telecom/network provisioning.
Experience working with operational data, reports or dashboards.
Strong analytical and data-validation capability.
Ability to identify trends, exceptions and operational risks.
Experience managing or coordinating provisioning/order escalations.
Good understanding of aging, due dates, milestones, jeopardies and dependencies.
Strong problem-solving and root-cause-analysis skills.
Ability to coordinate across multiple teams and vendors.
Strong written and verbal communication.
Confidence to raise risks and communicate issues to stakeholders.
Strong ownership and follow-through.
Good to Have
Experience across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design or Network Provisioning.
Carrier/LEC/vendor coordination experience.
Experience with Granite/XNG or similar telecom systems.
Advanced Excel skills including PivotTables, lookups and formulas.
Power BI/dashboard development experience.
SQL knowledge for validation and analysis.
Power Automate, VBA or Python experience.
Experience automating operational reporting or exception identification.

Description:
Job Summary
The Builder - Logistics is a high-agency, 0-to-1 role embedded within Ca's GS Retail Logistics function in the South. Based out of Bengaluru and working closely with the Regional Head - South, you will build new programs, ship new tools, and run controlled experiments across Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, and Kerala. This is not a steady-state ops role - you'll spend most of your time defining problems, prototyping solutions, and turning what works into repeatable playbooks that city teams can run at scale. You'll operate at the intersection of ops, data, product, and AI.
Key Responsibilities
New Program Design - Identify gaps across pilot supply, CSP adherence, auto-allocation, and fulfilment. Design new programs from scratch, run pilots, and hand off winning plays to city teams.
Ops Diagnostics Deep Dives - Own regional data - cut it by city, cohort, and process step to surface what's broken and where the fastest wins sit. Convert findings into structured action plans.
Product Specs Tool Building - Write clear specs for internal tools and dashboards. Partner with Product and Tech to ship what the region needs; use no-code and AI where full builds are overkill.
Automation of Manual Workflows - Map the region's sheet-heavy workflows and lead their transition to automated systems. Ship quick wins with Apps Script, Zapier, or AI copilots before scoping full products.
City-Level Experimentation - Run controlled A/B tests across cities to validate whether a new process, script, or intervention actually moves the KPI. Kill what doesn't work, scale what does.
Cross-functional Execution - Work directly with city heads, Category Managers, Product, and Tech to unblock progress. Translate ground-team pain-points into shipped fixes fast.
Qualifications Experience
2-4 years in high-agency roles - startup ops, strategy consulting, category management, or founders office.
Track record of shipping something end-to-end - a program, a tool, a dashboard, a new city launch - that survived after you moved on.
Comfortable in ambiguity - can walk into a messy problem and leave with a structured plan.
Strong first-principles thinking; happy to visit yards and talk to pilots before writing a single line of a proposal.
Bengaluru-based or willing to relocate; comfortable travelling across Hyderabad, Chennai, and Kerala.
Data AI Skills
Advanced Excel / Google Sheets - pivots, lookups, and formula-based analysis at scale.
SQL fluency for querying large operational datasets; Python or R for deeper analysis is a strong plus.
Comfort building dashboards (Looker, Data Studio, Tableau) that drive city-level decisions.
Hands-on with AI copilots (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or similar) to accelerate analysis, drafting, and prototyping.
Familiar with no-code automation (Apps Script, Zapier, Retool) to ship quick wins without engineering support.

Description:
Job Title: Business Clients Credit Advisor
Corporate Title: Associate
Location: Bangalore, India


Role Description
Business Banking is the liability business for Deutsche Bank present in 17 locations across India . This carters to a wide variety of population through its distinct channels like Personal banking, Private Banking and Business Banking.
The primary objective is to enhance the value of the savings account portfolio through cross-sell, leading to increase in fee income, to add to that ensure acquisition of new clientele.


Responsibilities
Advising on credit-related client solutions and assessing loans from an income and risk perspective, within the existing credit processes
Be responsible for preparing credit submissions for approval, and the independent application for credit authority or approvals, whilst also monitoring credit exposures and/or any credit material deterioration over the life cycle of the client relationship
Identifying business clients credit needs and proposing suitable products, services and/or solutions
Supporting efforts to gain new business and grow earnings potential from existing clients, e. g. at client conferences
Advising and guiding teams in the development of bespoke products/solutions/platforms
Working with functional and cross-functional colleagues to ensure that products/solutions/platforms meet the needs of the bank/clients. May also participate in the negotiation and execution of mandated transactions with clients
Optimal utilization of resources, and compliance with defined performance targets keeping in line with relevant internal guidelines/controls and regulatory requirements
Maintaining and growing business contacts and leads in the lending business
Compliance with internal and credit-related regulations, e. g. , QS audit results, KWG 18 etc.
Implementing regulatory KYC requirements, and maintaining compliance with other applicable regulatory requirements and guidelines


Your skills and experience
Candidate should have excellent communication in English and well groomed.
Minimum qualification required is Graduation.
Minimum Experience should be 8 - 12 Years in relevant field.
This is an individual contributor role. Need a Senior Banker, with good knowledge about investments, Wealth Management, Mutual Funds, PMS, Insurance. Acquisition of New to Bank clients.
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

Job Title Client Account Lead Senior Manager
Management Level: 06 Senior Manager
Location: Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore
Must have skills: Proven track record in sales origination and deal structuring within Communication, Media Technology industries, Consultative selling expertise
Good to have skills: Stakeholder management with PL responsibility, Domestic consulting experience is mandatory
Job SUMMARY
As a Client Account Lead, you will be responsible for driving sales growth, revenue expansion, and client value creation in the domestic India market. This role demands a strong ability to originate and structure deals, build long-term trust with C-suite executives, and position Accenture as a strategic partner for transformation and innovation. You will identify and pursue new opportunities, originate deals, and expand relationships with existing clients in telecom, media, and technology sectors.
Key responsibilities
Originate and pursue new business opportunities with existing and potential clients in telecom, media, and Software Platforms, Hi Tech \ semiconductor sectors.

Develop compelling proposals and sales presentations, clearly articulating Accentures value proposition and ROI for client operations. Candidate should be able to own clients, drive revenue, and deliver engagements

Build and sustain C-suite relationships, positioning Accenture as a trusted advisor for transformation and innovation agendas.
Drive account growth and profitability, with full ownership of sales targets.
Construct innovative deal solutions, leveraging Accentures consulting and technology capabilities to differentiate in the market.
Ensure robust delivery and consulting for seamless execution of client engagements and maximize client satisfaction.
Professional Technical Skills:
Proven track record in sales and account management (10+ years), with demonstrated success in revenue growth and deal origination.
Strong C-suite relationship management, with ability to influence executive decision-making and drive strategic partnerships.
Consulting and IT services sales expertise, preferably with domestic consulting experience in the India market across any Telecom, Media, Hi Tech, Software Platforms organisation.
Commercial acumen with experience in PL management, deal structuring, and innovative commercial pathways.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, enabling persuasive client engagement and closing complex deals.
Leadership and team management skills, with ability to inspire, guide, and deliver results through high-performing teams.
Whats in-store for you
Learn and grow continuously: Build new skills, grow existing skills, develop new areas of expertise within functional, technical or industry areas of the business with Accentures unmatched 24/7 expert-curated learning boards, webinars and classroom-style training programs
Innovate: Get access to resources that will allow you to leverage the latest technologies and bring innovation to life with the worlds most recognizable companies - Thrive and advance: Grow your career as far as your ambitions take you.
Truly human: Bring your whole self to a company that aims to be the most diverse in the world and delivers real-time performance feedback based on your strengths, not stats


Qualification
Experience: Minimum 12-14 years of sales experience for Communication, Media, software and platforms, Hi Tech focused companies as clients.
Educational Qualification: Masters degree in business administration (MBA) or post graduate degree in management (PGDM)

We are looking for a skilled Senior Software Developer - BMC Helix to join our team and take ownership of the development, integration deployment of BMC Remedy/Helix ITSM applications in enterprise environments. Description:
Location: Bangalore, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
Thales India Engineering Competency Center in Bangalore is seeking a HW Test bench Lead- maintenance role.
In this role, you will manage Test Bench/ Automated Test Equipments maintenance and sustenance activities, which includes conducting scheduled maintenance procedure, inspecting, and troubleshooting test bench equipment.
These test benches primarily support various Thales defense applications and its products.

Essential skills:
Test Bench Hardware systems knowledge such as COTS Test and measurement instruments from different OEMs including NI Hardware including PXI systems, Industrial PC (PICMG SBC ) and VME systems.
5 +yrs Experience in handling various interface form factors such as PCI, PCIE, PCIe, CPCI, PXI, PXIe, VME etc.
Experience in Test Bench development or maintenance using COTS test measurement equipment, custom designed interface test adapters, PCBAs
Experience of testing avionics communication interfaces/buses such as MIL-STD-1553B, ARINC 429 , Serial RS 485 / 422, CAN etc is desirable.
Experience on interface cards such as Discrete IO, Analog, serial (RS232/422/482), synchro etc on various form factors listed above.
Problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
Experience in testing and knowledge of test equipment for measurement and control.
Hands on experience in handing various measuring tools such as Digital Oscilloscope, Function / wave generators up to 18GHz, Spectrum Analyzers, RF power meters etc.
Experience in analyzing / understanding electrical schematics, Cable Harness drawings and block diagrams.

Responsibilities:
As a maintenance engineer you will be responsible for undertaking periodic maintenance procedure and ensure the test system / bench are reliable.
Identify faults, efficiency and safety issues.
Respond to equipment breakdowns, provide first line diagnostic and arrange repairs or replacements.
Execute functional tests and validate the results against established standards
Perform quality inspections to ensure compliance with safety regulations.
Should work closely with multi discipline teams and organize to fix the issues.
Preparation of the associated report and log maintenance to keep track of tasks
Collaborative work applying quality standards and internal processes
Should be able to estimate and monitor costs of maintenance.

Overview
As Wastewater Modeller, you will be working on diverse range of sewerage related projects that deliver sustainable benefits to communities and the environment through a range of public and private sector clients.

Your role
Perform a role bringing together hydraulic modelling (1D-2D) and engineering aspects of the project. You will have to understand the engineering constraints and opportunities associated with modelling solutions to drainage problems to ensure model outputs are realistic.
Undertake technical work including hydraulic modelling like model build (1D - 2D), model verification, evaluation, feasibility, optioneering and outline design of solutions.
Understand the client requirements and deliver the work in smarter way by developing some automation tools along with high quality.
Demonstrate high standards deliverables by adopting various self-check methods and documentations.
Assist with project management and take a proactive approach to managing client relationships, clarifying expectations and outcome measures in order to meet their requirements and deliver successful projects.
Support wider business lines and develop and strengthen internal team.

About you
Has a Bachelor or Master's degree in Civil Engineering or Water Resources or Environmental engineering or Geology or Geography.
3 to 8 years of experience in hydraulic design or modelling.
Working towards achieving chartership with appropriate institution (i.e. ICE, CIWEM).
Good working knowledge or experience of Infowork ICM, Mapinfo, QGIS, Sewer Gems, HEC-RAS, MicroDrainage or similar.
A strong, self-motivated and assertive person capable of working under pressure.
Good communication writing skills.
Flexible to adopt new work /challenge work as per business requirement.

Reward benefits

Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Description:
Job Description


Overview


Water Management Consultancy (WMC) is a key part of the Infrastructure division within AtkinsRalis' Water and Environment Business. Serving both UK and international clients, our projects span flood defence, hydraulic structures, ports, and maritime engineering. The WMC team brings together a diverse range of expertise, including river and coastal engineering, hydrology, hydraulics, dam engineering, hydraulic gates, and maritime engineering.
In this role, you'll be instrumental in delivering a variety of projects, with a particular emphasis on integrated water management. This includes hydrodynamic catchment modelling, sustainable drainage, water-sensitive urban design, river restoration, software development, research, and client and stakeholder engagement. This opportunity is ideal for those seeking technical challenges and looking to contribute to advanced, industry-leading projects.




Your role
Be highly motivated, proactive, and possess a "can-do" attitude.
Be skilled in collaborative working, with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Demonstrate strong organizational and time management abilities.
Be flexible and open to new challenges.
International experience.
Chartered Engineer status or actively working towards Chartership.
Proficiency in coding/programming (R, VBA, Python) is a plus.


About you
A strong academic background with a degree in Civil Engineering and/or a master's degree in Water Management/Hydrology, with 8 to 15 years of experience in the water industry.
Experience in 2D modelling using TUFLOW.
Significant experience with 1D-2D modelling using FMP-TUFLOW, ESTRY-TUFLOW, Infoworks ICM, especially with UK clients.
Build, refine and analyse hydraulic models (1D, 2D, and 1D2D) to represent river channels, floodplains, and potentially pipe networks.
Experience in leading flood modelling projects and managing a small team.
Provide modelling inputs and analysis to support the production of Flood Risk Assessments (FRAs) for planning applications.
Perform sensitivity testing to quantify uncertainty in model parameters and components.
Proficiency in GIS, including QGIS, MapInfo, ArcGIS, and open-source GIS tools.
An understanding of the overall fluvial model development process.
Experience in undertaking Flood Risk Assessments and developing drainage strategies.
Familiarity with FEH (Flood Estimation Handbook) methods.
Working towards achieving Chartered status.
Ability to produce clear and concise technical reports in English.
Effective communication skills for collaborating with colleagues and clients via video conferencing.
Adherence to quality procedures and maintaining high standards in your work.
Enthusiasm for learning new skills and work procedures.


Reward benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.


About AtkinsRalis
We're , a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Job Type Regular
At AtkinsRalis , we seek to hire individuals with diverse characteristics, backgrounds and perspectives. We strongly believe that world-class talent makes no distinctions based on gender, ethnic or national origin, sexual identity and orientation, age, religion or disability, but enriches itself through these differences.

Role MDM Architect
Locations – Pune | Bangalore | NCR | Hyderabad
Your Responsibilities includes, but not limited to:
Understand the technical landscape current as well as desired future state Assess the current state architecture & understand current business processes for managing Master Data Management solutions.
Assess the functional and non-functional requirements of desired future state MDM solution Prepare the to-be architecture including data ingestion, data quality rules, data model, match/merge, workflows, UI, batch integration and real-time services.
Extensive hands-on experience in installation and configuration of core Informatica MDM Hub components such as Hub console, Hub Store, Hub Server, Cleanse/Match Server and Cleanse Adaptor.
Ability to deliver full lifecycle MDM projects for clients including Data modeling, Metadata management, design and configuration of matching and merging rules, design and configuration of standardizing, cleansing and deduplication rules.
Create Design Document and data models addressing business needs for the client MDM environment - Contribute to creating reusable assets and accelerators for MDM platforms.
Will also be involved in integration/transfer of data across multiple systems, streamlining data processes and providing access to MDM data across the enterprise.
Make technology decisions related to the Client MDM environment & Interpret requirements and architect MDM solutions.
Provide subject matter expertise on data architecture and data integration implementations across various downstream system.
Coordinate with Project Managers and participate in project planning and recurring meetings.
Collaborate with other team members to review prototypes and develop iterative revisions.
Must have Skills:
12+ years of experience & should have hands on experience of working in MDM Projects and hands on experience in one or more MDM tools like Informatica or Reltio and has expertise in defining matching/ merging & survivor-ship rules.
Should have strong commercial knowledge of key business processes & compliance requirements within Pharma Industry across multiple master data domains like Physician & Product
Hands on experience in industry data quality tools like Informatica IDQ, IBM Data Quality.
Must be proficient reading and understanding data models and experience working with data and databases.
Strong technical experience in the areas of Master Data Management, Meta data management, Data Quality, Data Governance, Data Integration (ETL) and Data Security
Experience with (all stages of MDM SDLC) planning, designing, building, deploying and maintaining scalable, highly available, mission critical enterprise-wide applications for large enterprises
Should have experience in integrating MDM with Data Warehouses and Data Lakes
Excellent query writing skills with Working knowledge of Oracle, SQL server, and other major databases
Good knowledge of SOA/Real-time integration, Pub-Sub Model and Data Integration with Various CRM systems like Veeva, Siebel.
Expertise in engaging with business users to understand the business requirements and articulate the value proposition.
Should have experience working with 3rd Party Data Providers like IQVIA, SHS, Veeva etc
Solid experience in configuring 3rd Party Address standardization tools Like or Tools Similar to Address Doctor, Loqate
Provide subject matter expertise on data architecture and data integration implementations across various downstream systems
Possesses excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, innovative presentation skills
Experience with RFP/RFI and pre-sales

Description:
SQL DBA Azure
Pune / Bangalore / Noida:
5 Days – Work from Office
What does a successful SQL DBA – Azure do at Fiserv?
We are looking for a skilled SQL DBA with hands-on Azure experience to join our team and support the administration, performance, availability and security of critical database environments. In this role, you will manage SQL Server databases across on-premises and cloud environments, support production systems and help ensure reliable, scalable, and high-performing database operations.
A successful candidate brings strong SQL Server database administration experience, practical knowledge of Azure services and the ability to work across infrastructure, application, and development teams. This role is important to maintaining database stability, supporting cloud initiatives and driving operational excellence.
What you will do
Administer, monitor and maintain SQL Server database environments across development, test and production systems
Manage databases in Azure environments, including support for cloud-hosted database services and related platform operations
Perform database installation, configuration, upgrades, patching and migration activities across on-premises and Azure platforms
Monitor database health, performance, storage and availability and take proactive action to prevent issues
Perform backup, recovery, restoration and disaster recovery support for business-critical databases
Troubleshoot database issues and optimize performance through tuning, indexing, query analysis and configuration improvements
Support high availability and disaster recovery solutions for SQL Server environments
Ensure database security, user access management and compliance with operational and security standards
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, cloud and application support teams to resolve issues and support new initiatives
Automate routine database administration tasks where appropriate
Support production releases, environment readiness and operational transitions
Maintain technical documentation, standards, support procedures and runbooks
Participate in incident management, root cause analysis and continuous improvement efforts
What you will need to have
4 to 10 years of experience in SQL Server database administration
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server in production environments
Hands-on experience with Azure, including Azure SQL Database, Azure virtual machines or other Azure data services
Experience in database backup and recovery, performance tuning, security and monitoring
Strong knowledge of SQL Server installation, configuration, patching and upgrade processes
Experience supporting high availability and disaster recovery configurations
Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills
Experience working in cross-functional support and delivery environments
Good verbal and written communication skills
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, work and military experience
What would be great to have
Experience with Snowflake
Familiarity with Azure automation, scripting or infrastructure support
Experience with PowerShell or other scripting tools
Knowledge of CI/CD, DevOps or infrastructure-as-code practices
Experience in financial services, payments or other regulated environments
Familiarity with enterprise monitoring and alerting tools

Analyze business requirements, source-to-target mappings, and data models.
Design and execute ETL test cases, test plans, and test strategies.

Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and data engineers to resolve data-related issues.

Experience in validating ETL workflows, mappings, transformations, and data pipelines.
Knowledge of Data Warehouse concepts, Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Fact and Dimension tables.
Experience with databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Teradata, or Snowflake.
Strong understanding of Data Migration and Data Validation techniques.
Hands-on experience with defect tracking tools like JIRA or Azure DevOps.
Understanding of SDLC, STLC, and Agile methodologies.
Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Preferred Skills

Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Experience in testing data lakes and modern data platforms.
Knowledge of automation tools for ETL validation.
Familiarity with BI reporting tools like Power BI, Tableau, Cognos, or Business Objects.
Experience with Python or Shell scripting for data validation.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
As Wastewater Modeller, you will be working on diverse range of sewerage related projects that deliver sustainable benefits to communities and the environment through a range of public and private sector clients.
Your role
Perform a role bringing together hydraulic modelling (1D-2D) and engineering aspects of the project. You will have to understand the engineering constraints and opportunities associated with modelling solutions to drainage problems to ensure model outputs are realistic.
Undertake technical work including hydraulic modelling like model build (1D - 2D), model verification, evaluation, feasibility, optioneering and outline design of solutions.
Understand the client requirements and deliver the work in smarter way by developing some automation tools along with high quality.
Demonstrate high standards deliverables by adopting various self-check methods and documentations.
Assist with project management and take a proactive approach to managing client relationships, clarifying expectations and outcome measures in order to meet their requirements and deliver successful projects.
Support wider business lines and develop and strengthen internal team.
About you
Has a Bachelor or Master's degree in Civil Engineering or Water Resources or Environmental engineering or Geology or Geography.
10+ years of experience in hydraulic design or modelling.
Working towards achieving chartership with appropriate institution (i.e. ICE, CIWEM).
Good working knowledge or experience of Infowork ICM, Mapinfo, QGIS, Sewer Gems, HEC-RAS, MicroDrainage or similar.
A strong, self-motivated and assertive person capable of working under pressure.
Good communication writing skills.
Flexible to adopt new work /challenge work as per business requirement.
Reward benefits
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.
About AtkinsRalis

Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Description:
MS Dynamics Developer/Consultant
Location: Pune, India
Experience: 4 to 10 years

What does a successful MS Dynamics Developer do at Fiserv?

In this role, you will design, develop and support Microsoft Dynamics solutions that help drive operational efficiency, improve user experience and support business growth. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to understand business needs, configure and customize solutions, and deliver scalable, high-quality applications that align with enterprise standards.
What you will do:
Design, develop, customize and support Microsoft Dynamics solutions based on business and technical requirements
Work with stakeholders to gather, analyze and translate business needs into functional and technical specifications
Configure and customize Dynamics modules, workflows, forms, dashboards and integrations
Develop plugins, custom workflows, reports and enhancements within the Microsoft Dynamics environment
Integrate MS Dynamics with other enterprise applications and third-party platforms
Support data migration, system upgrades, deployments and environment management activities
Troubleshoot application issues, identify root causes and provide timely resolution
Perform unit testing, system testing and support user acceptance testing
Create and maintain technical documentation, process documents and support materials
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, QA and business teams to deliver reliable solutions
Ensure solutions follow security, compliance and coding best practices
Provide ongoing production support and continuous improvement recommendations

What you will need to have:

4 to 10 years of overall IT experience
Hands-on experience working with Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Microsoft Dynamics CRM
Strong experience in customization, configuration and development within MS Dynamics
Create and manage copilot agents
Experience with C#, .NET, JavaScript, plugins, workflows and web services
Experience in integrating Dynamics with external systems using APIs or middleware
Good understanding of Power Platform, including Power Automate and Power Apps
Experience with SQL Server and data migration activities
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Good verbal and written communication skills
Bachelors degree in computer science, Information Technology or related field

What would be great to have:
Experience with Dynamics 365 CE, CRM or ERP modules based on business need
Knowledge of Azure services and cloud-based integrations
Experience in DevOps, CI/CD pipelines and release management
Familiarity with reporting tools and dashboards
Microsoft Dynamics certifications
Experience working in an enterprise environment with global teams
Understanding of Agile delivery methodologies

Description:
Senior Network Test Engineer
Experience: 5 to 10 Years
Work location: Bangalore/ Pune/ Noida

Feature & Protocol Testing: Test network routing features to ensure they work exactly as designed.
Regression Testing: Re test existing features across different software versions to find new bugs or performance drops.
L2 & L3 VPN Testing: Set up and test virtual private networks, ensuring traffic flows correctly and safely between virtual routers.

Troubleshooting: Find network bugs, analyze packet captures (Wireshark), and work with developers to fix them.
Network automation: Python, Ansible, REST APIs

MPLS Basics: Good understanding of how MPLS works, including LDP and RSVP TE.

Testing Tools: Experience using hardware traffic tools like Ixia (IxNetwork) or Spirent, along with Wireshark.

Description:
Job Title: Embedded UI Software Engineer
Experience: 4-9 Years
Location: Bangalore / Noida
Job Description
We are looking for an experienced Embedded UI Software Engineer to design and develop graphical user interfaces for embedded products. The candidate should have strong expertise in Embedded C/C++, LVGL, TouchGFX, or similar embedded GUI frameworks, along with hands-on experience in ARM-based embedded systems.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop embedded graphical user interfaces using LVGL, TouchGFX, Embedded Wizard, Qt for MCU, or similar frameworks.
Develop UI applications for LCD/TFT touch displays on embedded platforms.
Integrate UI software with embedded platform services and device drivers.
Work on ARM Cortex-M based microcontrollers (STM32, NXP, ESP32, etc.).
Develop and debug embedded firmware using C/C++.
Support display, touch, communication, and peripheral interfaces.
Collaborate with hardware, firmware, validation, and product teams.
Participate in software testing, debugging, and product releases.
Mandatory Skills
4-6 years of Embedded Software Development experience.
Strong programming skills in Embedded C/C++.
Experience with LVGL (mandatory preferred).
Hands-on experience with TouchGFX, GUIX, emWin, Embedded Wizard, Qt/QML, or similar Embedded GUI frameworks.
Experience with ARM Cortex-M platforms (STM32/NXP).
Experience in RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, QNX, VxWorks, or Embedded Linux).
Knowledge of Display Technologies, LCD/TFT Touchscreens, HMI Development.
Experience with UART, SPI, I2C, CAN communication protocols.
Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.

Job Title: Circuit Design Engineer
Location: Bangalore/Noida
Qualification: Any Graduation
Level: P3-I
Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM
Job Summary
The Circuit Design Engineer will be responsible for designing and augmenting network circuits to support existing and new voice network connectivity. The role requires a good understanding of telecom network architecture, DS0/DS1/Ethernet circuits, POI connectivity, Network product requirements, and circuit inventory.
Key Responsibilities
Proficient in basic telecom and transmission concepts.
Good understanding of Transmission architecture and Network connectivity.
Design and augment DS0/DS1/Ethernet/IP circuitry for existing and new Customer /Network connectivity.
Translate network and transport requirements into appropriate circuit designs.
Review engineering requirements and validate circuit design information.
Coordinate with Planning, ASR, Implementation, Operations, and vendor teams for circuit provisioning.
Support new circuit installation, augmentation, migration, and disconnect activities.
Maintain accurate circuit and network inventory in Granite/XNG/PRO or applicable inventory systems.
Analyze network design issues and provide timely recommendations or solutions.
Maintain engineering documentation and update order/design status.
Support Customer Sales and network optimization activities when required.
Required Skills
Experience or good understanding of telecom circuit design.(SDH/SONET/WAVE)
Knowledge of DS0, DS1/T1,IP/Ethernet transport circuits, and Network architecture.
Understanding Network connectivity and circuit configurations.
Ability to interpret network diagrams, circuit information, and engineering requirements.
Good analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Good verbal and written communication.
Microsoft Excel knowledge including PivotTables, formulas, and lookups.
Good to Have
Experience with Granite/XNG or similar telecom inventory systems.
Understanding of Access Service Requests (ASR) and carrier provisioning.
Experience supporting network migrations, grooming, optimization, or decommissioning.
Power BI, VBA, Power Automate, Python, or other automation skills.

Job Title: ASR Engineer
Location: Bangalore/Noida
Qualification: Any Graduation
Level: P3-I
Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM
Job Summary
The ASR Engineer will be responsible for creating, submitting, tracking, and completing Access Service Requests with telecom carriers/LECs to support network provisioning requirements. The role requires good knowledge of carrier ordering processes, circuit configurations, and end-to-end ASR lifecycle management.
Key Responsibilities
Create and submit Access Service Requests (ASRs) using carrier/LEC web portals.
Translate engineering and transport requirements into accurate ASR submissions.
Understand ASR ordering requirements for DS0, DS1/T1,Ethernet and Customer Circuits and associated access services.
Validate ASR information before submission to minimize carrier clarifications and rejections.
Track submitted ASRs and follow up with carriers/LECs through completion.
Review and process carrier responses, including FOCs and DLRs.
Coordinate with Design, Planning, Implementation, Operations, and carrier teams to resolve ASR-related issues.
Monitor order milestones, due dates, jeopardies, and exceptions.
Maintain accurate order status and documentation throughout the ASR lifecycle.
Escalate carrier delays and provisioning issues as required.
Support circuit installs, changes, migrations, and disconnect requirements.
Maintain appropriate circuit/order information in Granite/XNG or applicable systems.
Required Skills
Hands-on Access Service Request experience.
Knowledge of ASR ordering requirements and carrier/LEC processes.
Experience using LEC/carrier web ordering tools.(VFO)
Ability to translate network/transport requests into ASR submissions.
Knowledge of TDM and IP network circuit configurations.
Understanding of FOC, DLR, due dates, and carrier provisioning milestones.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good verbal and written communication.
Microsoft Excel knowledge, including PivotTables and formulas.
Good to Have
Experience with PRO/Flightdeck or similar telecom provisioning/inventory tools.
Knowledge of Telecom network architecture and planning.
Experience in carrier/vendor coordination.
Power BI, VBA, Power Automate, Python, or other automation skills.
