Description:
Job Title: Network Provisioning Escalation & Insights Specialist
Location: Bangalore/Noida
Qualification: Any Graduation
Level: P3-2/P4-1
Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM / based on business requirements
Job Summary
The Network Provisioning Escalation & Insights Specialist will provide operational visibility across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Hot Cut and related provisioning activities. The role will focus on data validation, identifying aging orders and operational risks, analyzing trends and ensuring the right issues are escalated to the right teams at the right time.
The role will work across provisioning teams, Operations, internal stakeholders and external carriers/vendors to drive issues through resolution.
Key Responsibilities
Monitor operational data across network provisioning activities.
Validate order, milestone and provisioning information for accuracy and completeness.
Identify aging orders, missed milestones, jeopardies, recurring issues and delivery risks.
Analyze operational trends and highlight areas requiring attention.
Identify data discrepancies and work with the responsible team to correct them.
Determine which issues require escalation based on aging, customer impact, due date and operational risk.
Drive the right escalation to the right team at the right time.
Track escalated issues through closure rather than only raising the escalation.
Coordinate with Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Provisioning, Operations and other internal teams.
Coordinate with carriers/vendors regarding provisioning delays and unresolved dependencies.
Provide clear operational insights and status reporting to stakeholders and leadership.
Support root-cause analysis for repeat issues.
Identify process gaps based on data and operational trends.
Recommend improvements to reduce aging, exceptions and repeated escalations.
Support reporting and dashboard automation to improve operational visibility.
Required Skills
Good understanding of telecom/network provisioning.
Experience working with operational data, reports or dashboards.
Strong analytical and data-validation capability.
Ability to identify trends, exceptions and operational risks.
Experience managing or coordinating provisioning/order escalations.
Good understanding of aging, due dates, milestones, jeopardies and dependencies.
Strong problem-solving and root-cause-analysis skills.
Ability to coordinate across multiple teams and vendors.
Strong written and verbal communication.
Confidence to raise risks and communicate issues to stakeholders.
Strong ownership and follow-through.
  Good to Have
Experience across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design or Network Provisioning.
Carrier/LEC/vendor coordination experience.
Experience with Granite/XNG or similar telecom systems.
Advanced Excel skills including PivotTables, lookups and formulas.
 Power BI/dashboard development experience.
SQL knowledge for validation and analysis.
Power Automate, VBA or Python experience.
 Experience automating operational reporting or exception identification.

Location: Bangalore/Noida
Qualification: Any Graduation

Job Summary
The Network Provisioning Lead will provide day-to-day operational leadership for telecom provisioning activities covering Order Entry, Circuit Design, ASR, and circuit implementation. The role will ensure workload is effectively managed, provisioning milestones are achieved, quality standards are maintained, and operational issues are resolved or escalated appropriately.

Lead day-to-day activities across the assigned provisioning workstream.

Ensure process adherence, documentation and inventory updates are completed correctly.
Support knowledge transfer and readiness as activities transition to the India team.
Coach team members and identify skill or knowledge gaps.
Drive process improvement and automation opportunities across the workstream.
Provide regular operational updates to management and stakeholders.

Good understanding of telecom circuits, carrier provisioning and network operations.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and critical deliverables.
Strong stakeholder/vendor coordination.
Good communication and confidence in leading operational discussions.
Positive attitude, ownership and adaptability.

Experience as a Team Lead, SME or senior provisioning engineer.
Exposure to Granite/XNG, carrier portals or telecom OSS/BSS systems.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will manage the daily operations of the front office and guest services teams, ensuring that all guests receive outstanding service. You will manage check-in and check-out processes, resolve guest concerns, and lead a team of front desk agents and guest service representatives to meet the hotel s service standards. As a Front Office Front Office Executive, you re not just managing daily front office operations - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Proven experience in a front office or guest service management role within the hospitality industry.
Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate staff.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a guest-centric approach.
Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail, with the ability to handle high-pressure situations.
Proficiency in hotel property management systems (PMS) and front office operations.
Proficiency in English; additional languages are a plus.
Ability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Oversee daily front office operations: Overseeing Front Office activities, including guest service, registration, room inventory, and adherence to policies and standards
Monitor and elevate service: Assist in tracking guest satisfaction, addressing service issues, and guiding the team to implement improvements that enhance the guest experience
Support revenue initiatives: Assist in promoting hotel services and executing up-selling tactics to drive room occupancy and revenue growth
Facilitate team knowledge: Provide regular updates and training to ensure the team is well-informed of hotel offerings, services, and local attractions
Delight our guests: Welcome guests, respond to inquiries, and resolve concerns promptly to uphold service standards
Oversee VIP guest experience: Review VIP reservations and ensure an elevated and seamless check-in and check-out experience
Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support front office team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will oversee the daily operations of the front office and guest services teams, ensuring that all guests receive outstanding service. You will manage check-in and check-out processes, resolve guest concerns, and lead a team of front desk agents and guest service representatives to meet the hotel s service standards. As a Assistant Manager Front Desk, you re not just overseeing daily front office operations - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Proven experience in a front office or guest service management role within the hospitality industry.
Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate staff.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a guest-centric approach.
Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail, with the ability to handle high-pressure situations.
Proficiency in hotel property management systems (PMS) and front office operations.
Proficiency in English; additional languages are a plus.
Ability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Lead daily front office operations: Overseeing Front Office activities, including guest service, registration, room inventory, and adherence to policies and standards
Monitor and elevate service: Assist in tracking guest satisfaction, addressing service issues, and guiding the team to implement improvements that enhance the guest experience
Support revenue initiatives: Assist in promoting hotel services and executing up-selling tactics to drive room occupancy and revenue growth
Facilitate team knowledge: Provide regular updates and training to ensure the team is well-informed of hotel offerings, services, and local attractions
Delight our guests: Welcome guests, respond to inquiries, and resolve concerns promptly to uphold service standards
Oversee VIP guest experience: Review VIP reservations and ensure an elevated and seamless check-in and check-out experience
Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support front office team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Prepare ingredients for cooking, including portioning, chopping, and storing food. Wash and peel fresh fruits and vegetables. Weigh, measure, and mix ingredients. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklist. Prepare cold foods. Operate ovens, stoves, grills, microwaves, and fryers. Test foods to determine if they have been cooked sufficiently. Monitor food quality while preparing food. Set-up and break down work station. Serve food in proper portions onto proper receptacles. Wash and disinfect kitchen area, tables, tools, knives, and equipment. Check and ensure the correctness of the temperature of appliances and food.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATION
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY- Assurance - Senior Associate
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
The opportunity
We re looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.
Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement team s work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on one s own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across one s aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead one s GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.
Skills and attributes for success
Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.
Ideally, you ll also have
Proficiency in MS - Excel, MS - Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What we Offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Diagnoses and treats diseases and injuries using medical imaging techniques like X-rays, CT scans, MRIs, and ultrasounds.
Job Responsibilities
Image Interpretation: Review and analyze diagnostic images (X-rays, MRIs, CT scans, ultrasounds, and PET scans) to identify abnormalities and establish accurate diagnoses.
Report Generation: Prepare detailed, comprehensive written reports of findings and document procedural outcomes for referring physicians.
Image-Guided Procedures: Perform or direct minimally invasive, image-guided procedures such as biopsies, aspirations, and vascular interventions.
Patient Safety & History Evaluation: Review patient medical histories to check for risk factors (such as contrast allergies) and ensure safe procedural execution.
Radiation Safety Management: Enforce strict safety protocols, control radiation exposure levels, and maintain quality control standards for imaging equipment.
Multidisciplinary Collaboration: Consult with primary care doctors, surgeons, and specialists to discuss diagnoses and help shape patient treatment plans.
Supervision: Guide, oversee, and train radiology technicians and staff to ensure optimal image capture and workflow efficiency

Preferred candidate profile
Analytical & Observation Skills: Exceptional attention to detail to detect minute, subtle abnormalities within complex imaging scans without oversight.
Medical & Anatomical Knowledge: Deep understanding of human anatomy, pathology, radiation physics, and the physiological effects of various diseases.
Communication Skills: Clear verbal and written proficiency to explain critical findings concisely to fellow medical staff and counsel patients when necessary.
Technical Proficiency: Hands-on ability to operate and navigate advanced hospital imaging hardware and Picture Archiving and Communication Systems (PACS).
Problem-Solving & Decision Making: Capacity to evaluate ambiguous or complex emergency cases and make rapid, accurate clinical judgments under pressure.
Manual Dexterity: Steady hand-eye coordination required for performing delicate image-guided interventions and biopsies.

Job Summary
At our Video Game Art Institute, we are committed to nurturing creativity and guiding students toward successful careers in the gaming and creative industries. We are seeking a Counseling Operations Executive who will play a key role in supporting prospective students through their admission journey while ensuring smooth operational support within the institute. This is a student-facing role that requires excellent communication skills, organizational ability, and a passion for education in the creative arts.


Responsibilities
Engage with prospective students and their parents to provide detailed information about the institute, its programs,and our creative learning environment.
Guide applicants through the entire admission process, from initial inquiry to enrollment.
Highlight the unique benefits of our curriculum, faculty, and campus culture.
Follow up with leads, maintain admission records, and support outreach efforts.
Collaborate with the marketing team on open houses, events,and school tours.


Requirements
Excellent verbal and written communication skills (a must!).
Prior experience in counseling, admissions, or customer service is a plus.
Interest or background in creative fields like design, arts, or media is advantageous.
Strong organizational and interpersonal skills.
Basic knowledge of computer and MS Office.

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! Your meticulous attention to detail and commitment to excellence will help create an unforgettable experience for our guests. As a Housekeeping Associate, you re not just ensuring the cleanliness of guest rooms - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Minimum of 1 year of experience in the Housekeeping department
Prior housekeeping or room attendant experience preferred, especially in hospitality.
Ability to maintain high cleanliness and presentation standards.
Capable of performing physically demanding tasks (e.g., lifting, bending, standing for long periods).
Courteous and professional when interacting with guests.
Efficient in completing tasks within set timeframes.
Works well with housekeeping and other hotel departments.
Available to work shifts, including weekends and holidays.
Basic proficiency in English; additional languages are a plus.
Knowledge of cleaning chemicals and safety procedures.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Keep guest rooms spotless: Clean and tidy assigned rooms, including making beds, cleaning bathrooms, dusting, vacuuming, and performing deep cleaning tasks as needed
Replenish linens and amenities: Replace bed linens, towels, and guest essentials as needed
Manage supplies: Stock, maintain, and transport the housekeeping supply cart daily
Delight our guests: Respond to guest requests promptly and courteously
Manage waste disposal: Dispose of trash and recyclables in designated areas

Description:
Job Summary
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that its your career and Its yours to build which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
Role overview
The opportunity: Project Analyst-National-Forensics-ASU - Forensics - Discovery - Noida
National comprises of sector agnostic teams working across industries for a well rounded experience.
ASU - Forensics - Discovery :
Successful organizations depend on their reputation for keeping promises, respecting laws and behaving ethically to maintain stakeholder trust. EY Forensic & Integrity Services professionals help organizations protect and restore enterprise and financial reputation. We assist companies and their legal counsel to investigate facts, resolve disputes and manage regulatory challenges. We put integrity at the heart of compliance programs to help better manage ethical and reputational risks.
Our integrated approach ranges from enhancements in areas of perceived weakness or issues including governance, controls, culture and data insights to full organizational design and structural implementation. We want to help companies safeguard and restore financial and brand reputations. The insights and quality services we deliver help build trust and confidence in the capital markets and in economies the world over.
Your key responsibilities
Review documents, emails, and datasets as part of data breach review projects. Identify and classify Personally Identifiable Information (PII), Protected Health Information (PHI), financial information, and other sensitive data. Conduct quality control and quality assurance checks to ensure review accuracy, consistency, and completeness. Validate review decisions against established project protocols and client guidelines. Escalate exceptions, inconsistencies, and complex findings to project leads. Maintain strict confidentiality and comply with applicable data security requirements. Meet defined productivity, quality, and turnaround expectations.
Qualifications
LL.B.
Experience
Document Review (MDR) and Data Breach (DBR)
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Job Description Job Title Relationship Associate Location Branch Name (as per requirement) Department Bancassurance Function Bancassurance YBL - Sales Reporting to Center Manager Band 5
Function Summary
The Bancassurance Department within Axis Max Life Insurance plays a critical role in driving the distribution of life insurance products through our strategic partnership with Yes Bank. This department leverages Yes Bank s existing customer base and infrastructure to offer insurance solutions.
Bancassurance Department serves as a bridge between Axis Max Life Insurance Company and Yes Bank, ensuring that insurance products are effectively marketed and sold to a wide customer base, while maintaining high standards of customer service, compliance, and performance.
Below is a summary of the key functions typically performed by the Bancassurance Department:
Sales and Distribution Management
Customer Relationship Management
Compliance and Regulatory Oversight
Job Summary
This role involves establishing and strengthening relationships with branch managers and staff to generate leads, the candidate will actively participate in branch activities. The incumbent will be responsible for closing sales and ensuring follow-up on issuance.
A key aspect of the role is to increase the bank s customer awareness about life insurance solutions and achieve targeted penetration of cross-sell within the branch s customer base. The candidate will effectively drive reward and recognition programs for bank staff and regularly train them on life insurance concepts and new product introductions.
Key Responsibilities
Establishing strengthening relationship with branch manager staff to gain leads from them.
Involvement in work site activities (putting up stalls and making presentations in corporate.
Closing sale and following up on issuance.
Increasing bank s customer awareness about Life Insurance solutions and achieve the targeted penetration on cross sell within the branch s customer base.
Drive effectively the Reward and recognition programs launched for the bank staff.
Train the bank staff regularly on concepts in life insurance and new product introductions.
Key skills required
Communication skills
Strategic thinking
Product Knowledge
Problem solving
Time management
Customer relationship management
Deal closing skills
Goal oriented
Customer centricity.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Prepare ingredients for cooking, including portioning, chopping, and storing food. Wash and peel fresh fruits and vegetables. Weigh, measure, and mix ingredients. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklist. Prepare cold foods. Operate ovens, stoves, grills, microwaves, and fryers. Test foods to determine if they have been cooked sufficiently. Monitor food quality while preparing food. Set-up and break down work station. Serve food in proper portions onto proper receptacles. Wash and disinfect kitchen area, tables, tools, knives, and equipment. Check and ensure the correctness of the temperature of appliances and food.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATION
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Description:
At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY- Assurance Senior Associate
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
The opportunity
Were looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.
Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement teams work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for ones team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on ones own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across ones aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead ones GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.
Skills and attributes for success
Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.
Ideally, youll also have
Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What we Offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. Well introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: Youll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: Well provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: Well give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: Youll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world


EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY- Assurance Senior Associate
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
The opportunity
Were looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.
Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement teams work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for ones team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on ones own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across ones aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead ones GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.
Skills and attributes for success
Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.
Ideally, youll also have
Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What we Offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. Well introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: Youll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: Well provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: Well give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: Youll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world


EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

POSITION SUMMARY
Complete closing duties, including storing all reusable goods, breaking down goods, cleaning all equipment and areas, returning equipment to proper locations, locking refrigerators, restocking items, turning off lights, locking doors, and completing daily cleaning checklist. Set up, stock, and maintain work areas. Inspect the cleanliness and presentation of all china, glass, and silver prior to use. Maintain cleanliness of work areas throughout the day, practicing clean-as-you-go procedures.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards. Speak with others using clear and professional language, and answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! Sales Revenue Support: Drive upselling initiatives, monitor sales performance, and support revenue targets.
Compliance Hygiene: Ensure adherence to health, safety, and hygiene regulations across all outlet areas.
Coordination Communication: Collaborate with kitchen, housekeeping, and other departments for seamless service delivery.

Description:
Were Hiring | Assistant Housekeeping Manager | Cronwe Plaza New Delhi Mayur Vihar
At Crowne Plaza, we believe exceptional hospitality begins with exceptional attention to detail! We re looking for a passionate, guest-focused, and dynamic Assistant Housekeeping Manager to join our team and ensure the highest standards of cleanliness, comfort, and service excellence across the hotel.
If you have a passion for hospitality, strong leadership skills, and the ability to create a welcoming environment for our guests, we d love to hear from you!
A little taste of your day-to-day:
Operational Excellence - Overseeing daily housekeeping operations and ensuring guest rooms, public areas, and back-of-house areas meet IHG brand standards.
Guest Experience - Ensuring guest satisfaction through prompt attention to requests, feedback, and housekeeping-related concerns.
Team Leadership - Supervising, motivating, and developing the housekeeping team to deliver consistent service excellence.
Quality Standards - Conducting regular room inspections and ensuring adherence to cleanliness, presentation, and hygiene standards.
Interdepartmental Coordination - Working closely with Front Office, Engineering, and other departments to ensure smooth operations and timely room readiness.
Inventory Management - Monitoring linen, guest amenities, cleaning supplies, and departmental inventory to ensure effective utilisation and cost control.
Training Development - Coaching team members, conducting on-the-job training, and promoting a culture of continuous improvement.
Safety Compliance - Ensuring compliance with health, safety, hygiene, and hotel operating procedures.
What we re looking for:
Relevant experience in the Housekeeping department, preferably in a 4-star or 5-star hotel.
Previous supervisory or managerial experience in hotel housekeeping operations.
Strong knowledge of room operations, public area cleaning, and housekeeping standards.
Excellent leadership, communication, and team management skills.
Strong organisational abilities with an eye for detail.
A guest-oriented approach with the ability to handle operational challenges effectively.
Candidates based in Delhi/NCR will be preferred.
What you can expect from us:
At IHG Hotels Resorts, we offer a supportive work environment, opportunities to learn and grow, competitive rewards, hotel room discounts, a full uniform, and access to industry-leading training.
We celebrate individuality, embrace diversity, and create an inclusive workplace where everyone can belong and thrive.
Ready to bring your leadership and hospitality expertise to our Winning Team
Join Crowne Plaza New Delhi Mayur Vihar and be part of a global family committed to True Hospitality for Good.

Description:
Key Responsibilities & NABH Compliance Duties1. Pre-Anesthesia Evaluation (PAE) & Planning:
Patient Assessment: Conduct and document a thorough pre-anaesthesia evaluation of the patient's medical history, physical examination, airway status, and relevant lab/radiology investigations prior to any procedure.
Risk Stratification: Evaluate ASA (American Society of Anesthesiologists) physical status grading and formulate a customized anesthesia plan (general, regional, spinal, epidural, or monitored anesthesia care).
Informed Consent: Obtain a separate, dedicated bilingual/informed consent for anesthesia (distinct from the surgical consent), clearly explaining the technique, associated risks, benefits, and alternatives to the patient or legal guardian.
Starvation & Medication Protocols: Verify adherence to pre-operative fasting/starvation guidelines and manage pre-medication orders.
2. Intra-Operative Management & Monitoring
Anesthesia Delivery: Safely induce, maintain, and reverse general, regional, or local anesthesia/sedation.
Continuous Monitoring: Maintain continuous, documented intra-operative monitoring of vital parameters as per NABH minimum standardsincluding heart rate, ECG rhythm, non-invasive/invasive blood pressure, respiratory rate, oxygen saturation (SpO), body temperature, and End-Tidal CO (EtCO).
Hemodynamic & Organ Support: Manage fluid balance, blood/blood-product transfusions, ventilation, and intra-operative medical emergencies.
Presence: Ensure the qualified anesthesiologist remains physically present and attentive throughout the course of the anesthesia.
3. Post-Anesthesia Care Unit (PACU) & Recovery
Handover & Recovery Tracking: Supervise the safe transfer of the patient to the recovery room or Intensive Care Unit (ICU) with verbal and written handovers.
Discharge Criteria: Evaluate and document recovery status using objective scoring systems (e.g., Aldrete Score) before authorizing discharge from the PACU back to the ward or step-down unit.
Post-Operative Pain Management: Implement acute pain management protocols (e.g., patient-controlled analgesia, epidural infusions, or multi-modal analgesia regimens).
4. Critical Care, Trauma & Non-OR Anesthesia (NORA)
Provide airway management, resuscitation, and critical care support in emergency departments, labor/delivery suites (obstetric analgesia), cath labs, radiology suites, and the ICU.
Participate actively in hospital code blue (cardiopulmonary resuscitation) teams and disaster/trauma response protocols.
5. Quality Assurance, Infection Control & NABH Documentation
Mandatory Documentation: Ensure real-time, signed, and dated entries in the medical record for pre-anesthesia notes, intra-operative chart logs, drug dosages, and post-anaesthesia evaluations.
Adverse Event Reporting: Immediately record, report, analyze, and review any intra-operative or post-operative adverse anesthesia events, near-misses, or complications through the hospitals quality improvement framework.
Infection Control & Equipment Checks: Verify daily safety checks of anesthesia work-stations, crash carts, and defibrillators, adhering strictly to sterile and infection-control guidelines (e.g., circuit changes, proper CSSD sterilization).

Key Competencies & Skills Required
Clinical Mastery: Advanced airway management (intubation, LMA placement, difficult airway cart utilization).
Emergency Response: Proficiency in ACLS (Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support) and PALS (Pediatric Advanced Life Support).
Compliance Mindset: Strict adherence to hospital Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) required for NABH accreditation audits.
Communication: Clear, empathetic interaction with patients/families during consent and multi-disciplinary coordination with surgeons and nursing staff.

Qualification Requirement: MD / DNB / DA in Anesthesiology with valid State Medical Council registration and hospital credentialing/privileging per NABH guidelines.

Description:
Job Description


Overview

Our team within the Canada Business is dedicated to delivering cutting-edge engineering solutions for water infrastructure projects. We specialize in designing and managing complex systems that ensure sustainable water supply, treatment, and distribution. Our focus is on creating resilient, efficient, and environmentally responsible solutions that support communities and industries worldwide.
We leverage Building Information Modelling (BIM) to enhance collaboration, improve design accuracy, and optimize project delivery across the entire lifecycle-from concept and planning through construction and operation. BIM enables us to integrate civil, structural, and mechanical elements seamlessly, ensuring cost efficiency and reducing risks.
Atkins Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking a Civil 3D Designer to join our Water BIM team. This role will be based at our Bangalore Gurugram office, contributing to world-class projects by creating detailed 3D models, coordinating multidisciplinary designs, and ensuring compliance with international standards.



Your Role

Roles Responsibilities
Excellent in 3D Modelling of Pipe networks (Dry and Wet), Grading, Corridors, Cut and Fill using Civil 3D.
Excellent in Multidisciplinary 3D model coordination using Navisworks
Check model for Stage Completeness, Dimensional accuracy against modelling standards.
Ensure Level of Quality control for Completeness and adherence to company standards of all Drawings produced.
Stay informed the best practices methodologies in BIM implementation.
Able to perform and coordinate on multi-disciplinary projects and effective implementation of BEP and BIM workflows.
Ability to determine appropriate record/As-built, test pit, drawings and point cloud data.
Identify and solve drawing/ modelling problems and troubleshooting Civil 3D issues.
Identify new logical ideas for automation to improve efficiency.
In depth knowledge of engineering drawings and specifications. Ability to work using engineers' calculations and design in producing drawings / 3D modelling.
Ensures accuracy and adapts a detail-conscious approach; carefully checks details at each stage to avoid errors.
Ensure timely planning and delivery by proactively managing assumptions, dependencies, and risk.
Follow GTC BMS processes to projects
Use of Vehicle tracking
Software Skills
Autodesk Civil 3D
AutoCAD
Navisworks
MicroStation, ORD (Preferred )
ProjectWise / Forma
Microsoft Office (Excel, Word)

Required Skills Competencies
Strong understanding of: Civil engineering drawings and construction methods
Ability to work with Survey data, point clouds
Good communication and coordination skills
Attention to detail and quality-focused approach
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision



About You

Qualifications Skills
Graduate Engineers (bachelor's degree) with 3 to 5 years or Diploma in Engineering with up to 7-10 years of relevant experience in the BIM domain or duly qualified having exceptional work experience track record.
Desirable Experience
Canada / UK infrastructure or consultancy project experience
Experience working within ISO 19650 BIM environment
Awareness of Common Data Environment (CDE) workflows



Rewards Benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

We're , a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

We strongly believe that world-class talent makes no distinctions based on gender, ethnic or national origin, sexual identity and orientation, age, religion or disability, but enriches itself through these differences.

Description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
We are seeking a talented and motivated Backend Developer with 3-5 years of experience to join our engineering team. You will play a key role in building and maintaining robust backend services that power our applications. This position requires a developer with strong experience in Golang and Python , along with hands-on knowledge of cloud infrastructure , containerization , and databases .

Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Go (Golang) and Python .
Build and manage RESTful APIs and microservices.
Work with PostgreSQL and Redis for efficient data storage and caching.
Develop and deploy applications in Docker containers using Kubernetes for orchestration.
Collaborate with DevOps to deploy and monitor applications on AWS cloud infrastructure.
Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging to ensure high code quality and system reliability.
Contribute to architectural decisions and help shape backend system design.
Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines for backend services.
Troubleshoot and resolve performance and scalability issues.
undefined

Qualifications:
3-5 years of backend development experience.
Proficiency in Golang and Python .
Strong understanding of PostgreSQL and Redis .
Experience with Docker and containerized applications.
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes for orchestration.
Proficiency with AWS services (e.g., EC2, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, IAM).
Understanding of RESTful API design principles.
Familiarity with CI/CD tools and practices.
Good problem-solving skills and ability to work in an agile team environment.

Preferred Qualifications
B.E/BTech. degree in Computer Science, similar technical discipline or equivalent practical experience

Summary:
We are seeking a dynamic and motivated individual to join our team as a Premium Retail Sales Executive in Bangalore

As a Premium Retail Sales Executive, you will be responsible for delivering exceptional customer service, meeting sales objectives, and maintaining the overall visual appeal of the store

This is an excellent opportunity for both fresher and experienced individuals who are passionate about sales and customer satisfaction

Ensure the delivery of products and services to customers meets the highest standards

Create an interactive and engaging store experience to build customer confidence

Follow the selling process and adhere to standard operating procedures and organizational policies

Maintain the cleanliness and visual appeal of the store at all times

Utilize time effectively, including periods without customer interactions, to upgrade communication skills, gain knowledge of SOPs, and manage stock

Job Title: Semi Technical Customer Support Associate

Locations: Pune / Noida

Experience: 6 Months – 5 Years
Process: Semi Technical Voice Customer Support
Work Model: 100% Work from Office
Process Type: US Process
Shift: Night Shifts Only
Working Days: 5 Days Working | 2 Rotational Offs
Training: No leaves allowed during training

Job Summary

We are hiring Semi Technical Customer Support Associates for our US Voice Process in Pune and Noida.

The ideal candidate should have excellent English communication skills, strong customer service abilities, and basic technical troubleshooting knowledge. The candidate should be comfortable working in a high-volume customer support environment and willing to work in night shifts.

Key Responsibilities

* Handle inbound and outbound customer interactions through voice support.
* Resolve customer queries, complaints, and basic technical issues effectively.
* Troubleshoot basic to intermediate technical issues using available knowledge bases.
* Provide accurate information and appropriate resolutions to customers.
* Handle approximately 40–50 calls per shift while maintaining service quality.
* Document customer interactions, resolutions, and follow-up actions in CRM/ticketing tools.
* Escalate unresolved issues to the appropriate teams as per process guidelines.
* Coordinate with internal teams for timely issue resolution.
* Maintain professionalism, empathy, and a customer-focused approach.
* Follow company policies, compliance requirements, and operational procedures.
* Maintain required productivity, quality, attendance, and schedule adherence.
* Candidates must be comfortable working on Indian holidays.

Key Performance Metrics

Candidates will be measured on:

* AHT – Average Handle Time
* CSAT / CCR – Customer Satisfaction
* FCR – First Call Resolution
* Quality Score
* Schedule Adherence
* Attendance & Productivity

Salary

* 6–12 Months Experience: Up to 4.5 LPA
* 12–18 Months Experience: Up to 5 LPA
* 18+ Months Experience: Up to 6 LPA

Important: Salary will be offered with a maximum 25% hike on the candidate’s last drawn salary, subject to eligibility and company norms.

Required Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong customer service and problem-solving skills.
* Basic technical troubleshooting knowledge.
* Good listening and analytical abilities.
* Basic computer knowledge.
* Experience with CRM/ticketing tools is preferred.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfortable handling high-volume calls.
* Basic typing skills.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
* Willingness to work in night shifts.

Eligibility

* Graduate / Undergraduate candidates can apply.
* Minimum 6 months of relevant experience in Customer Care, Customer Support, Contact Center, Voice Process, or Technical Support.
* Overall experience considered: 6 months to 5 years.
* Candidates should have a proven ability to meet productivity and SLA targets.
* Strong customer-centric approach.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Candidates with experience in international voice customer support / technical support.
* Experience handling US customers will be an added advantage.
* Comfortable working in a high-pressure, target-driven environment.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.
* Team player with a professional and customer-focused approach.

Important Information

Location: Pune / Noida Sector 62
Work Mode: Work from Office – 100%
Shift: Night Shift – US Process
Working: 5 Days Working | 2 Rotational Offs

Description:
Role & responsibilities :
OCM Lead Consultant
Location: EMEA / USA / India
Job Summary
The OCM (Organizational Change Management) Lead Consultant is responsible for leading change management, training, and communication activities associated with enterprise-wide transformation programs, including ERP/HRIS implementations and organizational transitions.
This role focuses on the people side of change, helping organizations successfully adopt new processes, technologies, job roles, and organizational structures. The objective is to minimize resistance, maximize engagement, and drive successful adoption of transformational initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Change Management & Stakeholder Engagement
Develop and execute structured change management strategies, communication plans, and training programs to support organizational transformation.
Conduct change impact assessments and identify stakeholder groups affected by change.
Develop stakeholder maps and engagement plans to effectively manage client audiences.
Identify potential sources of resistance and implement mitigation strategies to encourage positive acceptance of change.
Build, mobilize, and manage change champion/change agent networks to accelerate adoption.
Training & Adoption
Design and implement role-based training strategies and learning programs.
Create employee orientation and onboarding plans related to new business processes and technologies.
Collaborate with client teams and Learning & Development stakeholders to create detailed training schedules and participant plans.
Work closely with Training/Learning Leads to ensure successful training delivery and adoption.
Program Execution & Leadership
Monitor change management and training activities and provide regular status updates.
Adapt change strategies as organizational needs evolve.
Lead and manage large-scale OCM teams consisting of junior, mid-level, and senior consultants.
Ensure alignment of change, communication, and training activities for a seamless end-user experience.
Best Practices & Methodology
Apply industry-leading change management methodologies and frameworks.
Integrate communication, training, and change interventions into a unified adoption strategy.
Recommend and implement best practices to improve transformation outcomes.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Experience
5-10 years of experience in Organizational Change Management (OCM).
Experience supporting large-scale organizational transformation programs.
Digital Transformation implementation experience is highly desirable.
Experience working with global teams, offshore (India) teams, and international client stakeholders.
Change Management Expertise
Strong understanding of organizational change principles and change adoption processes.
Experience with ADKAR methodology.
PROSCI Certification preferred.
CCMP (Certified Change Management Professional) certification is a plus.
Project & Delivery Knowledge
Understanding of software implementation lifecycles and project management methodologies, including:
SDLC
Waterfall
Agile
Core Competencies
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
Strong decision-making skills.
Ability to work effectively with employees and leaders at all organizational levels.
Ability to drive alignment toward a common vision and business goal.
Preferred Candidate Profile
OCM Lead / Change Management Consultant with experience in ERP, HRIS, or Digital Transformation programs.
Experience leading large change initiatives in global organizations.

Description:
SAP BASIS Consultant

Location:
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli (Hybrid)

Experience:
JL4: 2-5 Years
JL5: 5-9 Years
JL6: 9-18 Years

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP BASIS Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for managing, administering, monitoring, and optimizing SAP landscapes across enterprise environments.

The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP BASIS Administration, SAP S/4HANA, SAP NetWeaver, SAP HANA Database Administration, System Installation, Upgrades, Migrations, Kernel Upgrades, Performance Tuning, and Production Support. Experience in implementation, migration, upgrade, and support engagements is highly preferred.

Roles & Responsibilities
Install, configure, administer, and monitor SAP systems across landscapes.
Perform SAP system installations, upgrades, refreshes, migrations, and patching activities.
Manage SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP NetWeaver, and SAP HANA environments.
Execute client copies, system copies, kernel upgrades, and transport management activities.
Monitor system performance and optimize SAP application and database performance.
Perform regular health checks and system monitoring activities.
Manage SAP user administration, authorizations, and security-related activities.
Handle SAP Backup, Recovery, High Availability (HA), and Disaster Recovery (DR) configurations.
Support incident management, problem management, and root cause analysis (RCA).
Troubleshoot SAP application, database, and operating system-related issues.
Coordinate with infrastructure, cloud, functional, and development teams.
Support implementation, rollout, upgrade, migration, and maintenance projects.
Manage SAP Transport Management System (TMS) across landscapes.
Prepare technical documentation and operational procedures.
Ensure system availability, reliability, compliance, and operational excellence.
Provide production support and resolve critical incidents within SLA timelines.

Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP BASIS experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP BASIS experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP BASIS experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of SAP landscape architecture and administration.

Mandatory Skills
SAP BASIS Administration
SAP S/4HANA
SAP NetWeaver
SAP HANA Administration
SAP Installation
SAP Upgrades

Good to Have
SAP Solution Manager
SAP Landscape Management (LaMa)
SAP Cloud ALM
SAP BTP Administration
AWS / Azure / GCP Exposure
HANA Database Migration
Automation & Scripting
SAP Fiori Administration
SAP Router Administration
ITIL Process Knowledge

Additional Information
Do not apply if:
End User Profiles
Only Training/Certification Profiles
Non-SAP BASIS Profiles
Candidates without hands-on SAP Administration experience

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Grwoth Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Dear Candidate,

We are looking for a dedicated and experienced Site Engineer to manage waterproofing, retrofit, repairs application projects across. The candidate will be responsible for site execution, billing, coordination with applicator manpower, and client interaction to ensure timely and quality project completion.

Please go through the Job Profile. Interested candidate are required to share their profile at shraddha.bhosle@jsw.in

Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Execution & Supervision
Supervise waterproofing application works at site.
Ensure work is executed as per technical specifications and quality standards.
Conduct site inspections and resolve technical issues.
Maintain daily progress reports.
2. Billing & Documentation
Prepare client RA bills and subcontractor/applicator bills.
Measure work quantities and maintain proper billing records.
Coordinate with accounts for timely submission and approvals.
Maintain material reconciliation statements.
3. Manpower Coordination
Coordinate with applicator teams and subcontractors.
Ensure availability of required manpower and materials.
Monitor productivity and discipline at site.
Provide technical guidance to applicators.
4. Client Coordination
Act as the primary point of contact at site.
Attend client meetings and provide project updates.
Handle site-related queries and ensure client satisfaction.
Coordinate for approvals, inspections, and certifications.
5. Planning & Material Management
Plan daily and weekly work schedules.
Ensure proper storage and usage of waterproofing materials.
Monitor material consumption and reduce wastage.
Preferred Candidate Profile:
Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering.
25 years of experience in waterproofing or construction site execution.
Good knowledge of waterproofing systems (PU coating, APP membrane, injection grouting, etc.).
Strong billing and measurement skills.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel and billing software.

Description:
SUMMARY
Summary
We are seeking dynamic, results-oriented Sales & Application Engineers to join our team, offering an exciting career path for Diploma and Engineering graduates. This pivotal role combines technical expertise with business development to drive revenue growth and foster strong client partnerships. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving territory-specific sales targets, identifying new market opportunities, and delivering tailored technical solutions that meet customer needs while maintaining a deep understanding of market trends and competitor activities.

Responsibilities
Achieve assigned sales targets specific to the designated territory.
Identify and cultivate new business relationships with customers, OEMs, and industrial accounts.
Generate business opportunities through strategic market visits and proactive lead generation.
Conduct regular on-site customer visits and facilitate detailed technical discussions.
Promote product offerings and provide appropriate technical solutions to client challenges.
Manage the sales cycle from generating enquiries to following up on quotations and converting opportunities into confirmed orders.
Maintain robust customer relationships to encourage repeat business and long-term loyalty.
Monitor market trends, track competitor activities, and identify emerging business opportunities.
Accurately maintain CRM records and sales reports to ensure data integrity.



Requirements
A Diploma or Engineering degree in a relevant technical field.
Strong passion for technical sales, business development, and customer relationship management.
Proven ability to build and maintain effective relationships with diverse clients.
Excellent communication and presentation skills for technical and commercial discussions.
Capability to analyze market trends and competitor actions to drive strategic growth.
Proficiency with CRM tools and sales documentation management.
Willingness to travel and work across assigned locations, including Sambalpur, Cuttack, Kolkata, Jamshedpur, and Bhilai.
Educational Qualification
B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.

Experience
Freshers are welcome.
1 3 years of relevant experience in field sales, industrial sales, technical sales or business development preferred.


Benefits
Salary Structure
Freshers:
15,000 20,000 per month.
Experienced Candidates (1 3 Years):
25,000 40,000 per month, depending on current salary and relevant experience.

Travel Allowance:
Fixed travel allowance of 8,000 per month for local travel within an approximate 40 km radius.
Travel beyond this radius may be reimbursed subject to Reporting Manager approval.
For senior-level employees, customer visit expenses will be reviewed internally on a case-by-case basis.

SUMMARY
Network Expert
Summary
Our organization is looking for a seasoned Network Expert possessing deep proficiency in IBM Cloud to design and deploy resilient Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) architectures. This critical position focuses on the strategic implementation of subnets, routing configurations, and security firewalls. The successful candidate will bring advanced knowledge of core networking principles, including Transit Gateways, TCP/IP protocols, DNS administration, BGP dynamic routing, prefix filtering, Site-to-Site IPSec VPNs, VPC routing tables, and load balancing mechanisms. Furthermore, the role demands strong operating system administration skills to guarantee uninterrupted network functionality.

Location: Jamshedpur

Experience: 10-15 years
Responsibilities
Architect and establish intricate VPC ecosystems, encompassing subnet structures and routing protocols.
Set up and oversee firewall configurations to fortify network boundaries.
Continuously track network performance metrics to detect bottlenecks and enhance throughput efficiency.
Troubleshoot and resolve connectivity challenges across diverse environments, including multiple VPCs, on-premises data centers, Power Virtual Server (PowerVS) instances, and third-party cloud platforms.
Ensure system reliability by effectively managing the underlying operating systems.

Requirements
Documented expertise in TCP/IP and BGP routing protocols.
Proven track record of working specifically with IBM Cloud solutions.
A minimum of 10 to 15 years of professional experience within the field of network engineering.
Extensive technical understanding of Transit Gateways, DNS services, prefix filtering, and Site-to-Site IPSec VPNs.
Skill in administering VPC routing tables and executing load balancing strategies.
Proficiency in performing essential operating system administration duties.

SUMMARY
Linux Administrator

Summary
We are looking for an experienced Linux System Administrator to manage, support, and maintain our Linux server infrastructure deployed on the IBM Cloud. In this vital position, the ideal candidate will design and oversee local and network storage solutions, with a specialized emphasis on Logical Volume Manager (LVM) setups. The role also involves creating and implementing thorough system-level backup plans and managing automated snapshot schedules to guarantee data reliability and accessibility. The position is based in Jamshedpur and requires a candidate with 5 to 10 years of relevant experience.

Location: Jamshedpur

Experience: 5-10 years
Responsibilities
Manage and maintain the Linux server environment within the IBM Cloud ecosystem.
Architect and administer storage frameworks, focusing on the deployment and optimization of Logical Volume Manager (LVM) systems.
Formulate and carry out strong backup procedures while establishing routine snapshot scheduling.
Continuously track system performance, with a focus on optimizing CPU usage, memory allocation, and disk I/O scheduler efficiency.
Adjust operating system kernel parameters, including sysctl settings, to improve overall system stability and data throughput.


Requirements
Documented professional history as a Linux Administrator.
Proven proficiency in working with IBM Cloud infrastructure.
A career background of 5 to 10 years in system administration positions.
