Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow thebusiness and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities

Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team ( reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition


Desired Skills

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.
AboutCompany: Swiggy is an Indian online food ordering and delivery company. Founded in 2014, Swiggy is headquartered in Bangalore and operates in more than 580 Indian cities, as of July 2023.[4] Besides food delivery, the platform also provides quick commerce services under the name Swiggy Instamart, and same-day package deliveries with Swiggy Genie.

Description:
Job Description (JD)
Consultant / Assistant Manager Internal Audit
Location: Mumbai, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Chennai & Bangalore
Function: Governance, Risk and Compliance Services (GRCS) Department: Risk Consulting
Role Overview
Consultant / Assistant Manager Internal Audit will be responsible for managing and executing internal audit, risk consulting and process improvement engagements across multiple industries. The role involves leading project teams, managing client relationships, ensuring quality deliverables, supporting business development activities and contributing to the growth of the GRCS practice
Key Responsibilities
A. Internal Audit & Risk Advisory
Lead risk-based internal audits, process audits and risk consulting engagements.
Conduct Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and risk assessments.
Evaluate business processes, identify operational risks and assess internal controls.
Perform SOX 404, Internal Financial Controls (IFC) and regulatory compliance reviews.
Identify control gaps and recommend process improvements and risk mitigation measures.
Execute control self-assessments, revenue assurance and continuous monitoring activities.
B. Project Management & Execution
Manage multiple internal audit and risk consulting projects simultaneously.
Lead project teams and oversee project planning, execution and delivery.
Ensure project quality, profitability and adherence to timelines and budgets.
Report project progress and key risks to the Director / Partner.
Act as the primary client contact throughout project execution.
C. Client & Stakeholder Management
Manage client relationships and understand business requirements.
Conduct stakeholder discussions and management presentations.
Communicate audit findings, control gaps and recommendations.
Support clients in implementing corrective actions and process improvements.
D. Team Management & Leadership
Supervise, coach and mentor junior team members.
Review team deliverables and ensure quality standards.
Conduct training and support team capability development.
Manage team performance and promote effective collaboration.
E. Business Development & Practice Growth
Identify business opportunities and contribute to lead generation and deal closure.
Support proposals, pre-sales activities and RFP responses.
Identify cross-selling opportunities across KPMG service lines.
Contribute to revenue growth and client relationship development.
F. Thought Leadership
Contribute to developing new solutions and service offerings.
Participate in knowledge management and practice development initiatives.
Stay updated on industry trends, regulatory developments and emerging risks.
3. Key Service Offerings
Risk-Based Internal Audit
Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and Risk Assessment
Business Process Consulting
SOX 404 and Internal Financial Controls (IFC)
Regulatory and Contractual Compliance
Corporate Governance Advisory
Revenue Assurance and Control Self-Assessment
Continuous Auditing / Monitoring
Accounting Manuals Development
Capital Projects Audits
Project-Focused Control Assessment
Setting Up Internal Audit Functions
4. Educational Qualifications
- MBA / Chartered Accountant (CA)
Preferred Certifications:
CIA Certified Internal Auditor
CISA Certified Information Systems Auditor
CPA Certified Public Accountant
CMA Certified Management Accountant
ACCA Association of Chartered Certified Accountants

We are seeking a passionate and knowledgeable Veterinary professional to join our team as a Veterinary Trainer, Researcher, and Content Creator. You will be responsible for developing and delivering high-quality veterinary training programs, conducting applied research, and creating engaging educational content for diverse audiences including veterinary professionals, students, and animal health stakeholders.

Training:
Design, develop, and deliver interactive training modules, workshops, and webinars for veterinary professionals.
Evaluate learning outcomes and continuously improve training methodologies.
Research & Development:
Conduct veterinary research, literature reviews, or case studies in areas such as clinical care, animal welfare, diagnostics, or public health.
Analyze data and publish findings in internal reports, academic journals, or professional presentations.
Collaborate with universities, NGOs, or industry partners on joint research projects
Content Creation :

Ensure all content is scientifically accurate, audience-appropriate, and aligned with organizational goals.

Skills:
Strong foundation in veterinary medicine and current practices.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Experience with instructional design tools, LMS platforms, and multimedia content creation.
Data analysis skills and familiarity with research methodologies.
Comfortable presenting to live or virtual audiences.


Preferred candidate profile

Passion for animal health education and science communication.
Ability to translate complex veterinary concepts into accessible information.
Collaborative and proactive mindset.
Attention to detail with a commitment to high-quality output.

Description:
Job Purpose


This position is open with Bajaj Finance ltd.





General Admin (Facility Management RM)
1. Control branch OPEX expenses within set budget.
2. Maintain regular Maintenance Hygiene of branches.
3. Timely closer on Issues including RM activity.
4. Timely Payment of branch expense bills.
5. Expense control of general expenses of branches.
6. Branch Feedback of employees seniors visiting branches.
7. Maintain proper data / records of all expenses of all locations managers supervised.
8.Monthly branch visits .
Infrastructure (NEW Projects under BASE)
1. Identification of new premises as per company requirement (Location rate).
2. Close on documentation legal clearance.
3. Having the civil work (as required) completed.
4. Installation of furniture fixtures.
5. Coordination with infra vendors.
6. Ensuring the branch is complete handed over to business well in TAT
Statutory Compliances
1. Ensuring the LOI is signed well within the TAT. (within 5 working days from receiving the legal clearance stability
2. Ensuring the lease agreement is signed well within the TAT. (within 10 working days from signing the LOI
3. Ensuring the lease agreement is registered well within the TAT. (within 20 working days of receiving the approval from H.O)
4.the shops establishments application is applied the certificate is received well within the TAT. (within 10 days of branch completion)
5.security related equipments are up to date under AMC renewals are done prior to expiry of contract.
6. Renewals of all Lease agreements AMC contract done prior to the expiry date.
7. Ensuring all statutory documents / certificates are displayed at the common area (reception) in line to compliance.





1. Graduate in any discipline with experience of working in Administration preferred
2. Inclination to have knowledge/ exposure on legal/ compliance matters.
3. Exposure in handling govt. / legal Issues
4. Team management interpersonal Skills
5. Good on negotiations and Vendor development Management
6. Well versed with MS Word, Excel, Power Point
7. Willing to Travel

Job Purpose


This position is open with Bajaj Finance ltd.
Engage with channel partners to build and strengthen relationship. Build distribution for Rural consumer Product Finance and distribution mapping for Rural consumer Product Finance.




Achieving exceeding Business goals and targets for Consumer Durables -Creating a strong compliant sales culture to drive acquisitions, profitability and employee development-Manage the Distribution through Dealer relations and servicing the Dealers, and their concerns in an appropriate manner.-Managing the Delinquency of the business sourced to ensure health of portfolio
-Effectively engage Operations Risk teams to understand and contribute to overall processes profitability across locations
-Identifying the need of sales training, analyzing changing market trends, channel deployment etc. Also giving feedback suggestions to the RSM/NSM -Ensure implementation of promotional plans contests and suggesting new and innovating promotion plan for the area of work.-Recruiting and Retaining high performers. -Ensuring highest levels of employee relationship, motivation engagement to drive results high levels of employee satisfaction.-Supporting collections team in ensuring 100% collections MAJOR CHALLENGES:
-struggling to find and keep talented employees. -Customer always seeking the latest technology, most efficient service, instant gratification, and a customized experience. -Retaining employees as they have banking sector as an option available.
-Online Market as well effected / impacted in filed. DECISIONS ; -Implement a sales management process that guides the teams decision on how to effectively manage this time and decide who to spend with. -Connect with field Teams Spending the Maximum time to Our Team. Link performance with rewards and recognition as par their achievement. -Design and Develop a Customer (Dealer and Business Partners) Visit frequency plan for their field. INTERACTIONS: Internal Clients:Roles you need to interact with inside the organization to enable success in your day to day work -Provide market and product related feedback to HO (Managers / Senior hierarchy )-Credit Team for high ticket approvals -Operation for customer services and file disbursement -Risk team for approval declined cases due to specific reasons e.g. policy-FCU Team for fraud cases validation -Collections for bucket cases and FEMI cases or problematic cases External Clients: Roles you need to interact with outside the organization to enable success in your day to day work:External Clients include dealer and business Partners. Identify New key dealer outlets New Business Partners to support sales External Clients include dealer and business Partners. Identify New key dealer outlets New Business Partners to support sales by Achieving Origination Targets. ASSC (Authorized Sales Service Center), Serving the existing external walk in customers at dealers and Increasing business opportunities.




a)Qualifications :
-Graduation / Post graduation
-Strong analytical skills to drive channel performance and drive profitability
-People Relationship Management skills
-Excellent Communication and Negotiation Skill
b)Work Experience:
-Graduation / Post graduation with 4 to 6 years and MBA with 3-4 years of relevant experience in sales
DIMENSIONS

Financial Dimensions
(These should be quantifiable numerical amounts)
As a manager, you''ll need to define Business scope. Defining what is needed is the first step. setting Business goals and allocating to Team. the Business scope should have a tangible objective for the organization
-In Festive seasons minimum 15k cases in a quarter
-Normal days minimum 9K cases in a quarter
-Cross sell targets 650 IPC to be maintained



Other Dimensions
(Significant volume dimensions associated with the job)
Total Team Size: 29
Number of Direct Reports: 6
Number of Indirect Reports: 23 (off role)
Number of Outsourced employees: 18 (ASCC)
Number of locations: in the range 5 to 7
Number of products: 2

Description:
Position Summary

The IT Assistant will provide operational and technical IT support to approximately field staff across districts, ensuring the availability, functionality, security, and effective use of IT equipment and digital tools required for program implementation.

The position will serve as the first point of contact for field-level IT issues, providing timely troubleshooting, coordinating repairs and replacements, supporting new employee onboarding, supporting procurements and maintaining accurate records of IT assets. The role will also facilitate coordination between district teams and the Country Office/State IT/Admin function to ensure consistent IT service delivery across geographically dispersed locations.

Travel: Regular inter-district travel will be required, with frequency determined by support requests and field requirements.

2. Key Roles and Responsibilities

A. Field-Level IT Support and Troubleshooting

Provide first-level technical support to field staff for laptop, desktop, printer, scanner, and other IT-related issues.
Diagnose and resolve common hardware, software, operating system, and application-related problems.
Support staff with email configuration, account access, password resets, software installation, system updates, and basic device configuration, subject to access permissions.
Troubleshoot internet connectivity, Wi-Fi, mobile hotspots, and network-related issues at district offices and field locations.
Provide remote support wherever feasible and undertake field visits for issues that cannot be resolved remotely.
Escalate complex technical issues to the designated IT team at Country Office or authorised service provider, as the case may be, and track them through resolution.

B. IT Equipment Deployment and Employee Onboarding

Configure and deploy laptops and other IT equipment for new joiners and replacement requirements.
Coordinate with HR, Administration, and district teams to ensure timely IT readiness before employees join.
Support device allocation, user account setup, installation of approved applications, and access to required systems.
Facilitate the collection, reconfiguration, and reassignment of IT equipment during employee transfers, exits, or role changes.
Ensure that devices are configured in accordance with organisational IT standards and security requirements.

C. IT Asset Management and Inventory Control

Maintain an updated inventory of IT assets across all districts, including laptops, desktops, printers, accessories, and other assigned equipment.
Record asset allocation, serial numbers, asset tags, user details, location, warranty status, and movement history.
Conduct periodic physical verification of IT assets in coordination with the relevant district and state teams.
Track damaged, non-functional, obsolete, lost, or unutilised equipment and recommend appropriate action.
Monitor equipment under repair, warranty claims, and replacement requirements.
Ensure timely collection and return of IT assets during employee separation and maintain supporting documentation.
Update the designated asset management system or tracker and report discrepancies for resolution.

D. Internet Connectivity and Field Infrastructure

Assess internet connectivity requirements at district offices and other designated programme locations.
Troubleshoot connectivity issues affecting access to programme systems, virtual meetings, email, and online reporting tools.
Coordinate with internet service providers and authorised vendors for installation, maintenance, and fault resolution.
Maintain records of connectivity-related complaints, downtime, recurring issues, and resolution timelines.
Identify locations with recurring connectivity challenges and recommend practical solutions, such as alternative connectivity options, where approved.
Support the basic setup and troubleshooting of routers, Wi-Fi devices, and other approved networking equipment.

E. Software, Applications, and Digital Tools

Assist field staff in installing, configuring, and using organisation-approved software and programme-related digital tools.
Support basic troubleshooting of productivity applications, video-conferencing tools, browsers, printers, and document-sharing platforms.
Assist staff in accessing organisational systems and applications, coordinating with the relevant system administrator where required.
Support the rollout of software updates, security patches, and approved IT tools.
Help field staff understand basic IT procedures and the appropriate use of organisational devices and systems.

F. IT Security and Data Protection

Ensure that organisational IT equipment is used in accordance with approved IT guidelines.
Support implementation of device security requirements, including antivirus protection, system updates, screen locks, and approved security configurations.
Guide staff on password security, phishing awareness, safe internet use, and secure handling of organisational information.
Immediately report suspected malware, unauthorised access, lost or stolen devices, and potential data breaches to the designated IT/security team.
Support secure device handover, data backup where authorised, and device sanitisation or wiping in accordance with approved procedures.
Ensure that confidential data is not transferred, accessed, or shared through unauthorised applications or storage devices.

G. IT Support for Programme Activities and Meetings

Provide technical support for virtual meetings, online trainings, workshops, and programme review meetings.
Assist with the setup and troubleshooting of audio-visual equipment, projectors, displays, webcams, microphones, and speakers where available.
Support connectivity and device readiness for field-level digital data collection, online assessments, reporting, and other programme activities.
Help district teams prepare equipment and test connectivity before important programme events.
Provide on-site IT support for designated programme activities when required.

H. IT Helpdesk, Reporting, and Service Monitoring

Maintain a centralised log of IT requests, complaints, and incidents received from the nine districts.
Categorise issues by urgency, impact, and type, and prioritise critical issues affecting programme delivery.
Track issue resolution, pending requests, vendor interventions, and recurring technical problems.
Provide periodic reports on IT support requests, resolution timelines, equipment downtime, asset status, and recurring challenges.
Maintain a district-wise tracker of IT assets, equipment under repair, connectivity issues, and pending requirements.
Identify recurring issues and recommend preventive measures to reduce service interruptions.

I. Staff Orientation and Basic IT Capacity Building

Conduct basic orientation sessions for new and existing staff on the appropriate use of laptops, email, approved applications, and IT security practices.
Develop or share simple user guides and troubleshooting instructions for frequently reported issues.
Help staff adopt standard procedures for raising IT requests and reporting technical incidents.
Identify common IT skill gaps among field staff and recommend targeted support or refresher sessions.

4. Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Applications, or a related discipline.
Approximately 23 years of relevant experience in IT support, desktop support, helpdesk operations, or field-level IT service delivery.
Experience providing technical support across multiple offices or geographically dispersed locations would be an advantage.
Practical knowledge of laptop and desktop troubleshooting, Windows operating systems, printers, basic networking, Wi-Fi, and internet connectivity.
Familiarity with Microsoft 365 or similar productivity applications, email systems, video-conferencing tools, and basic endpoint security.
Experience maintaining IT asset registers, service request trackers, and equipment repair records.
Ability to communicate technical information in simple language to non-technical users.

5. Core Competencies

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills - a responsive approach to staff support.
Ability to prioritise requests and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
Good communication and coordination skills.
Strong documentation and record-keeping skills.
Ability to work independently across multiple districts.
Willingness to travel regularly to district offices and field locations.
Commitment to confidentiality, data protection, and organisational IT policies.

Description:
*Role: Business Development / Expansion Role – OYO (Field Profile)*
*What is this role about?*
This role is about **expanding OYO’s hotel network in new and upcoming markets*
You will identify hotels, meet property owners, explain OYO’s vision, and help them partner with OYO. From the first discussion to the hotel going live, you will manage the full journey.
This is a *field-based role* and requires regular travel.
*What will you do in this role?*
• Find hotels and properties that can partner with OYO
• Generate leads through market visits, brokers, and referrals
• Visit properties and meet hotel owners face to face
• Explain how partnering with OYO can grow their business
• Negotiate commercials and close property signings
• Build a joint business plan with property owners for long-term profitability
• Coordinate with internal teams to launch the property on OYO
• Review agreements and service levels with property owners
• Resolve issues between property owners and internal OYO teams
*How is your performance measured?*
• Number of sellable rooms signed every month
• Number of rooms made live and available for booking
• Gross margin generated from signed properties
*Education:*
• Graduation mandatory
• MBA preferred
**Experience & Skills:**
• 1–5 years of relevant experience
• Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills
• Comfortable reading and understanding legal agreements
• Analytical and data-driven mindset
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
• Basic working knowledge of ERP or mobile apps
• Good Excel skills and professional email writing
*Stakeholders you will work with:*
*Internal:*
• Business Development Head
• Hub Head
• Central Team
• Operations Team
• Transformation Team
• Legal Team
*External:*
• Property Owners
• Real Estate Brokers
*In simple words:*
Your role is to *find hotels, sign them, launch them on OYO, and ensure the partnership is profitable*.

Ensure accurate tracking, reconciliation, and security of all cash deposit and electronic payments received during regular operation in hospital
Strict internal controls to prevent fraud, coordinates with banking partners, and ensures all related actions to be completed as per compliance

Train hospital staff on proper cash handling, point-of-collection patient billing

Establish team as well as individual goals and deliver against the same as per defined service delivery framework and quality processes
Ensuring Regular Governance in place (Internal & External Governance Meeting with teams and Business)
Need to have functional proficiency and specialized knowledge for own areas of responsibility, fair understanding of end-to-end process and IT systems supporting the same

Functional Knowledge of Skills (Must Have)
Proficiency in data management and treasury operation, Good interpersonal skills, Flexible with Job duties, Cash/Collection management and resolve settlement issue

Risk Taking, Accountability, Collaboration

To sell products or services for a company and represent their brand. Also, to manage relationships with customers, serving as the key point of contact, from initial lead outreach to when a purchase is ultimately made.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Areas of responsibility include Restaurants/Bars and Room Service, if applicable. Supervises daily restaurant operations and assists with menu planning, maintains sanitation standards and assists servers and hosts on the floor during peak meal periods. Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction and maximize the financial performance in areas of responsibility. Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then implements plan.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Day-to-Day Operations
- Supervises and manages employees. Manages all day-to-day operations. Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Maintains service and sanitation standards in restaurant, bar/lounge and room service areas.
- Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.
Leading Food and Beverage Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaches, mentors, or otherwise helps others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Ensures and maintains the productivity level of employees.
- Provides the leadership, vision and direction to bring together and prioritize the departmental goals in a way that will be efficient and effective.
- Ensures compliance with all food & beverage policies, standards and procedures by training, supervising, follow-up and hands on management.
- Ensures compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
- Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
- Ensures staff understands local, state and Federal liquor laws.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Monitors alcohol beverage service in compliance with local laws.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensures the quality, standards and meets the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Acts as the guest service role model for the restaurants, sets a good example of excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Handles guest problems and complaints.
- Meets with guests on an informal basis during meals or upon departure to obtain feedback on quality of food and beverage, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Ensures corrective action is taken to continuously improve service results.
- Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.
- Manages service delivery in outlets to ensure excellent service from point of entry to departure (e.g., greeting from hostess, speed of order taking and food and beverage delivery, fulfillment of special requests, collection of payment & invitation to return).
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Identifies the educational needs of others, develops formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaches or instructs others.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably. Strives to improve employee retention.
- Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an "open door" policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Ensures recognition is taking place across areas of responsibility.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Assists servers and hosts on the floor during meal periods and high demand times.
- Recognizes good quality products and presentations.
- Supervises daily shift operations in absence of Assistant Restaurant Manager.
- Oversees the financial aspects of the department including purchasing and payment of invoices.

Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)

Description:
MEGA HIRING DRIVE | TELEPERFORMANCE
International Customer Support Executive Voice | Chat | Email

Company: Teleperformance
Job Role: International Customer Support Executive
Job Location: Jaipur, Rajasthan
Work Mode: Work From Office
Process: International Voice / Chat / Email
Hiring: Freshers & Experienced Candidates
Working Days: 5 Days Working
Shifts: Rotational Shifts
Week Offs: Rotational Week Offs
Joining: Immediate Joiners Preferred

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY
Looking for an exciting career opportunity in the International BPO industry? Teleperformance is hiring enthusiastic and customer-focused candidates for International Customer Support operations.
We are inviting applications from candidates across PAN India who are interested in working in Jaipur. Whether you are a fresher looking to start your professional journey or an experienced candidate looking for career growth, this is an excellent opportunity to develop your skills and work with international customers.

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES
Handle international customer queries through Voice, Chat and Email support channels, depending on the assigned process.
Assist customers with service-related queries, complaints, account concerns and general support requirements.
Manage inbound customer calls professionally and provide accurate information and effective resolutions.
Respond to customer queries through live chat and email while maintaining professional communication.
Ensure excellent customer experience through active listening, empathy and a customer-centric approach.
Handle customer complaints, escalations and follow-ups within defined turnaround times.
Maintain customer records, update internal systems and follow process guidelines.
Demonstrate strong problem-solving, multitasking and customer-handling skills.
Maintain quality standards and contribute towards customer satisfaction and customer delight.

PREFERRED CANDIDATE PROFILE
Excellent English communication skills are mandatory.
Freshers with strong English communication skills can apply.
Undergraduate candidates with a minimum of 6 months of documented BPO / Customer Support experience can apply.
Graduates and postgraduates from any stream are eligible.
Candidates with International BPO, Voice Process, Chat Support, Email Support and Customer Service experience will be preferred.
Basic computer knowledge and good typing skills.
Strong interpersonal skills, problem-solving abilities and a customer-focused attitude.
Comfortable working in rotational shifts and rotational week-offs.
Must be willing to relocate to Jaipur and work from the office.

EXCITING RELOCATION BENEFITS & FACILITIES
710 Days Complimentary Hotel Accommodation for eligible outstation candidates.
10,000 Relocation Bonus as per company policy.
Travel Ticket Assistance for eligible candidates relocating to Jaipur.
Free Cab Facility as per process and shift eligibility.
Five Days Working.
Professional training and development opportunities.
Career growth opportunities in Quality Analyst, SME, Team Leader and Operations roles, subject to performance and eligibility.
Applicable employee benefits and performance-based incentives as per company policy.

PAN-INDIA HIRING – JAIPUR LOCATION
Candidates from all over India are welcome to apply!
We are sourcing candidates from Delhi NCR, Gurgaon, Noida, Mumbai, Pune, Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Surat, Jaipur, Jodhpur, Udaipur, Kota, Ajmer, Lucknow, Kanpur, Indore, Bhopal, Chandigarh, Ludhiana, Dehradun, Patna, Ranchi, Kolkata, Bhubaneswar, Guwahati, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Kochi and other cities across India.

Important: Candidates must be willing to relocate to Jaipur. This is a Work From Office opportunity.
APPLY NOW!
An excellent opportunity to begin or advance your career in the International Customer Support industry with Teleperformance.

Description:
We work in collaboration with State Education Departments to bring reform by implementing large-scale system-led projects, with the goal of improving foundational learning (FLN) outcomes in students. Our team supports the State in designing and implementing an integrated program that encompasses multiple aspects of a reform process - ranging from designing effective classroom pedagogy to building salience and state capacity to deliver FLN at scale, while also strengthening governance and other critical enablers. Room to Read has partnered with the Education Department of Jharkhand on a long-term engagement for system reform and a demonstration program in selected districts.


Responsibilities
The Program Associate will be responsible for the intervention in his / her district and will have the following specific key roles and responsibilities:


Program Understanding
Develop a thorough understanding of Room to Read s Literacy program design and Project Deliverables
S/he has good awareness of Foundational Literacy and Numeracy programs, their design and strategies operating in project region.
Develop a strong understanding of Govt s education policies NEP, NCF, FLN, SIQE, Mission Ankur etc.


On-ground Implementation and Monitoring
Support the quality implementation of the project in the district and blocks, ensuring timely, efficient, and well-coordinated implementation, adhering to the program and budget guidelines.
Complete higher frequency of regular visits to program schools, observe classroom transactions, speak to teachers and head masters and make suggestions for improving quality and utilization of these materials.
Support District Lead collating collated from the field to further communicate the same to SO and CO for necessary changes in the pedagogy and material.
Support in analyzing various data and information emanating from the field, develop programmatic co- relations and flag off issues for a larger discussion.
Participate in any other activities which may be required to be undertaken to fulfil the objectives of the organization.
Support effective utilization of program budget through proper planning and tracking of planned activities. Ensure that financial and procurement norms are adhered to, and efforts are made to reduce cost to the extent possible, without compromising on the quality.
Track program progress on key indicators according to the ME framework during monthly meetings and throughout the project timeline.
Participate actively on social media in all Room to Read (RtR) campaigns.
Stay updated and share this knowledge with the District Lead regarding new programs/interventions of the like-minded organizations in district.
Identify operational bottlenecks and weaknesses, wherever applicable and come up with solutions for the same in consultation with District Lead.
Support the District Lead in the execution of the Project by leading all technical tasks in the district focused on capacity building of stakeholders across all levels (District, Block, Cluster and Schools), support uptake of materials, and establish coordination with various stakeholders at the district level to sustain the impact and interventions from the program.


Government Liaison and Technical Support
Support District Lead in participation of technical assistance discussions at the district level.
Attend government meetings, discussions and committees on foundational literacy as well as Numeracy and use those forums to advocate for enabling policies and government orders in support of RtR literacy program.
Interact with key stakeholders (government departments and officials such as CDEO/ADPC/DEEO/RPs/DIET etc.) as recommended by the District Lead to ensure delivery of program objectives and explore opportunities for systemic integration.
Conduct discussions with stakeholders at multiple levels across the districts reflecting on the insights collated via field visits, monitoring data and interactions to formulate the way forward for the month.


Participation in Meetings/Workshops at State and INCO Level
Participate in IDTS workshops on material development, training module development and training of trainers.
Attend review meetings at the state/national level and provide reflective feedback on program implementation and design issues. At the same time acts as the conduit for transferring innovative ideas and practices from the national level (or from other states) on to the field.


Planning, Reporting and Documentation
Support District Lead for preparing regular (monthly, quarterly, and yearly basis, including program data) qualitative reports and documenting event reports, case studies and best practices.
Support and ensure all data entry and compilation on monthly, quarterly and yearly basis, including GSD, Dashboard data, maintaining high levels of data quality.
Develop actionable insights through analyses of data collected via monitoring visits to further inform the project implementation.
Assist for preparing Implementation calendar, cash forecast, PRs budget outlook, APB and regular tracking of budget management.


Qualifications

Required
Master s degree in education / social sciences or equivalent preferred.
Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in the education sector.
In-depth knowledge on foundational literacy, language and reading practices and approaches.
Strong written and oral communication skills.
Critical thinking and analytical skills.
Proven track record of achieving results.
Proven ability to work effectively with schools and communities.
Ability to travel regularly to project sites in remote locations.


Preferred
Able to design google forms, sheets, sites, dashboard etc.
Data analysis through advance excel, SPSS etc.
Development of short videos
Able to design workshops session plan.
Able to lead facilitation in workshop for internal team, teachers and officers etc.
Able to design modules, feedback forms, questionnaire, etc.

Description:
Important: All applicants must be legally eligible to work in the country where the position is located. Room to Read is not able to provide sponsorship.


Job Summary
Position Overview: The Associate will supports technology adoption, EdTech pilots, and on-ground program delivery for the Prevail Fund Jharkhand Foundational Literacy Program (SFLP) in Jharkhand. The role also feeds into the wider Jharkhand State Project Management Unit (SPMU) technology agenda. The role sits close to field cadres and program teams. It will be a cross functional role involving you moving between a training hall, a school, and a spreadsheet in the same week. This role turns technology into action on the ground: configuring the LMS, running pilots, listening to users, and closing the gap between what a tool promises and what a CRP or teacher actually experiences in the field. This position requires frequent travel and will report to District Lead.
About the Edtech Function in Prevail-Jharkhand: Room to Read uses a blended training framework (Online + Offline) to train and certify field cadres (Program Field Coordinator, Program Associate, Program Officer, District Lead) across multiple districts. The program also testing new EdTech and AI tools to support teacher training, coaching, and classroom practice.


Responsibilities
LMS Management: Manage day-to-day use of the Jharkhand LMS instance for field cadre training and certification.
Set up courses, quiz banks, and completion tracking for each training module.
Coordinate with the Room to Read India LMS administrator for platform changes and upgrades.
Troubleshoot access and login issues for learners and facilitators.
EdTech Pilots and AI App Testing: Coordinate the testing of AI applications and EdTech tools proposed for the Jharkhand program.
Plan and run field pilots from setup through review: install the tool, train the users, observe use, and record results.
Flag technical issues and usability problems to the EdTech Lead and the tool developer.
User Research and Feedback: Plan and conduct user interviews with teachers, CRPs, Master Trainers, and other field cadres.
Collect feedback on the Moodle platform, training content, and EdTech pilots.
Turn raw feedback into clear, short insights the Edtech team can act on.
Use Case Landscaping: Map where technology is already used, and where it could help, across the Prevail Jharkhand project: training, coaching, monitoring, and libraries.
Keep a shared, up-to-date use-case map for the project team.
Flag priority use cases for the EdTech Lead to take forward.
Creation of mockups and prototypes using AI and other design tools
Field and Program Support: Give on-ground support to program staff and government cadres in multiple districts.
Join field visits with the District Lead, CRPs, and Master Trainers as needed.
Support the rollout of training sessions, TLM (Teaching and Learning Material) distribution, and monitoring tools at the school and cluster level.
Technology Facilitation: Act as the first point of contact for field staff questions about LMS, apps, and other digital tools.
Run short orientation sessions on new tools for field cadres.
Write simple, step-by-step guides for tools and workflows.
Reporting and Documentation: Keep clear records of pilot activities, interview notes, and platform issues.
Contribute EdTech updates to monthly and quarterly program reports.
Keep the projects knowledge base current on EdTech status and open issues.


Qualifications
Graduate degree in education, social sciences, computer applications, or a related field.
2-4 years of relevant experience in EdTech, LMS administration, or field program support.
Comfort with frequent field travel as needed across multiple districts.
Basic troubleshooting skills with mobile apps and digital tools.
Experience with qualitative research methods, such as user interviews and feedback collection.
Strong oral and written communication skills in English and Hindi.


Preferred
Working knowledge of Moodle or another LMS platform.
Prior experience in the education or development sector.
Exposure to AI tools used in education or training delivery.
Experience working with government education cadres (CRPs, BRPs, Master Trainers) or community-level stakeholders.

Description:
SUMMARY
Summary
We are seeking dynamic and result-oriented Sales & Application Engineers to join our team, offering an exciting career path for Diploma and Engineering graduates. This pivotal role combines technical expertise with business development to drive revenue growth and foster strong client partnerships. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving territory-specific sales targets, identifying new market opportunities, and delivering tailored technical solutions that meet customer needs while maintaining a deep understanding of market trends and competitor activities.

Responsibilities
Achieve assigned sales targets specific to the designated territory.
Identify and cultivate new business relationships with customers, OEMs, and industrial accounts.
Generate business opportunities through strategic market visits and proactive lead generation.
Conduct regular on-site customer visits and facilitate detailed technical discussions.
Promote product offerings and provide appropriate technical solutions to client challenges.
Manage the sales cycle from generating enquiries to following up on quotations and converting opportunities into confirmed orders.
Maintain robust customer relationships to encourage repeat business and long-term loyalty.
Monitor market trends, track competitor activities, and identify emerging business opportunities.
Accurately maintain CRM records and sales reports to ensure data integrity.



Requirements
A Diploma or Engineering degree in a relevant technical field.
Strong passion for technical sales, business development, and customer relationship management.
Proven ability to build and maintain effective relationships with diverse clients.
Excellent communication and presentation skills for technical and commercial discussions.
Capability to analyze market trends and competitor actions to drive strategic growth.
Proficiency with CRM tools and sales documentation management.
Willingness to travel and work across assigned locations including Sambalpur, Cuttack, Kolkata, Jamshedpur, and Bhilai.
Educational Qualification
B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.

Experience
Freshers are welcome.
1 3 years of relevant experience in field sales, industrial sales, technical sales or business development preferred.

Location: Sambalpur and Cuttack

Benefits
Salary Structure
Freshers:
15,000 20,000 per month.
Experienced Candidates (1 3 Years):
25,000 40,000 per month, depending on current salary and relevant experience.

Travel Allowance:
Fixed travel allowance of 8,000 per month for local travel within an approximate 40 km radius.
Travel beyond this radius may be reimbursed subject to Reporting Manager approval.
For senior-level employees, customer visit expenses will be reviewed internally on a case-by-case basis.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
Project Role : Data Engineer

Project Role Description : Design, develop and maintain data solutions for data generation, collection, and processing. Create data pipelines, ensure data quality, and implement ETL (extract, transform and load) processes to migrate and deploy data across systems.

Must have skills :Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform

Good to have skills:NA
Minimum 3 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification:15 years full time education

Summary:
As a Data Engineer, your typical day involves designing, developing, and maintaining comprehensive data solutions that support the generation, collection, and processing of data. You will be responsible for creating efficient data pipelines that facilitate smooth data flow and ensure the integrity and quality of data throughout its lifecycle. Your role includes implementing processes to extract, transform, and load data, enabling seamless migration and deployment across various systems. Collaboration with different teams to understand data requirements and optimize data architecture is an integral part of your daily activities, ensuring that data solutions align with organizational goals and support business intelligence needs.

Roles & Responsibilities:

- Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
- Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
- Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and analyze data requirements, ensuring alignment with project objectives.
- Continuously monitor and optimize data pipelines for performance, scalability, and reliability.
- Document data processes and workflows to maintain clarity and support knowledge sharing within the team.
- Assist junior team members by providing guidance and support to foster their professional growth.

Professional & Technical Skills:
Must To Have Skills:
Proficiency in Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform.
- Experience in building and managing scalable data pipelines and workflows.
- Strong knowledge of data integration techniques and ETL processes.
- Familiarity with cloud-based data storage and processing solutions.
- Ability to troubleshoot and resolve data-related issues efficiently.
- Understanding of data governance and data quality best practices.

Additional Information:

- The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform.
- This position is based at our Pune office.
- A 15 years full time education is required.



Qualification
15 years full time education

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Handling Industrial Canteens / Hostel Mess with capacity of 500 - 1000 meals per day. Experience of Club House operation as well as parties (Outdoor catering / Banquet services) & events on day-to-day basis. Menu Planning, Food costing, Store management, Staff organizing. Prepare menu and food within guidelines of catering services handling special events, parties & dietary needs. Daily tracking of meal taken by guest & their accounting. Handling of VVIP Guest House management. Knowledge on food safety & hygiene. The checking and recording of all food received, quantities of ingredients used, and the number of meals produced and served. To ensure that all documentation concerning Guest & Client Bill, Vendors Payments, Store Issue, Cleaning Checklist is up to date and monitored. Shall maintain daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual records as necessary, pertaining to his resources/men/materials deployed.
Key Deliverables:-
Manage canteen operations, ensuring quality food service, hygiene, and guest satisfaction.
Oversee canteen operations, including meal planning, food preparation, service delivery, food costing, inventory control, and billing.
Manage Catering Services for corporate events, parties, and special functions.
Plan menus considering nutritional requirements, budget, seasonal availability, and special dietary needs.
Supervise kitchen, catering, housekeeping, and service staff, ensuring efficient manpower deployment and service excellence.
Handle VVIP Guest House operations, hospitality arrangements, accommodation, and catering services.
Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and statutory regulations.
Monitor receipt of food materials, stock consumption, meal production, wastage control, and store management.
Maintain records related to guest/client billing, vendor payments, store issues, cleaning checklists, and service documentation.
Coordinate with vendors and procurement teams to ensure uninterrupted supply of quality materials and services.
Maintain daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual MIS reports on manpower, materials, meal statistics, and operational performance.
Drive cost optimization, process improvement, and high standards of hospitality and customer service across all facilities.

Min. Qualification: Diploma in Hotel Management/Hospitality from a recognized university/institute.

Preferred candidate profile :-
Min 3 - 5 Years of relevant experience in Hospitality Industry / Industrial Catering.
Computer & Account Knowledge would be an added advantage.

Description:
Job Summary:
As part of a formal apprenticeship or regional training program, assists with facilities changes and improvements; assists with maintaining relationships with various suppliers and vendors of services provided to the facility; communicates changes and improvements to affected facility occupants. Performs activities under direct supervision.
Key Responsibilities:
Supports coordination with facilities management to schedule work and special projects for the assigned facility. Assists with planning for changes and improvements; assist with schedules and implements plan. Helps with developing, documenting, and reporting budgets for approval process; creates and writes purchase orders; approves payment of invoices. Assists to update, edit and print CAD layouts and master plans; assist with managing floor space and office space all locations within master plan. Assists with organizing installation of communications equipment with internal and external suppliers and customers. Participates in improvement processes; actively participates in self-and team audits and resulting process improvements. Works under close supervision according to defined facility procedures/processes. Attends classes and on/off site training programs (travel if required) and makes appropriate progress necessary to build basic skills and knowledge required to pass local certification.
Key Responsibilities
Manage shift schedules, manpower deployment, and overtime planning.
Coordinate employee transport services and site vehicle management.
Oversee housekeeping, gardening, pest control, and drinking water facilities.
Manage daily canteen forecasting, manpower availability, and service quality.
Support front desk operations, courier services, and employee administration activities.
Coordinate leadership, global leadership, customer visits, and hospitality arrangements.
Organize employee engagement activities such as birthday celebrations and events.
Support medical health check-up drives and employee welfare programs.
Manage uniform measurement and distribution activities.
Coordinate induction and training schedules for new joiners.
Drive plant 5S initiatives and workplace organization standards.
Manage admin service vendors and ensure compliance with service-level agreements.
Ensure plant readiness, cleanliness, and a positive employee experience.
Key Skills
Administration Facility Management
Vendor Management
Visitor Event Coordination
Transport Canteen Management
Communication Stakeholder Management
Planning Resource Management
5S and Workplace Management
Problem Solving and Customer Service Orientation
Competencies:
Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Emergency Preparedness - Plans, manages and supports the site s emergency preparedness program; identifies risks and develops a risk management plan to address incidents such as power outage, flood, and fire; manages the maintenance of emergency systems for fire and flood protection; reports any system impairments.

Facilities Maintenance - Assesses the condition of the facility including its systems, structure, interiors, exteriors and grounds; manages facility operations and maintenance activities; develops and operates asset management systems for Preventative Maintenances that uses criticality analysis, predictive tools and prioritization.

Facilities Operation - Manages occupant services (parking, janitorial services, food services, concierge, facility helpdesk, security and safety); manages the maintenance contracting process; develops and manages the facility s operational planning requirements (temperature control, lighting, equipment replacement, water treatment and so forth).

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.

Experience:
Minimal or no work experience required.

Position description: Join Jindal Ferrous Limited's Central QA - Blast Furnace department as an entry-level engineering professional dedicated to supporting quality assurance processes within the mining and metals sector. This role involves assisting in the monitoring and optimization of blast furnace operations to ensure compliance with industry standards and company quality benchmarks. The position offers a unique opportunity to develop technical expertise in metallurgical processes, data analysis, and quality control methodologies while contributing to the continuous improvement of production efficiency and product quality in a dynamic industrial environment.

Primary Responsibilities:
Assist in the implementation and monitoring of quality assurance protocols specific to blast furnace operations.
Conduct routine inspections and data collection to evaluate the performance and condition of blast furnace equipment.
Support senior engineers in analyzing metallurgical data to identify process deviations and recommend corrective actions.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure adherence to safety and environmental regulations during furnace operations.
Maintain accurate documentation of quality control tests, inspection reports, and process parameters.
Participate in troubleshooting and resolving operational issues under the guidance of experienced engineers.
Contribute to the development and refinement of standard operating procedures (SOPs) for blast furnace quality assurance.
Assist in the preparation of technical reports and presentations for management review and decision-making.
Engage in continuous learning to stay updated on industry best practices, emerging technologies, and regulatory requirements.
Skills:
Metallurgical Process Knowledge
Quality Assurance and Control
Data Analysis and Interpretation
Statistical Process Control (SPC)
Technical Report Writing
Root Cause Analysis
Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) Development
Safety and Environmental Compliance
Equipment Inspection and Maintenance
Team Collaboration and Communication

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Growth Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
About Organisation
Tata Power runs four electricity distribution companies (Discoms) in Odisha through a public-private partnership with the state government. Formed as 51:49 joint ventures between Tata Power and the Government of Odisha, these utilities supply reliable power to nearly 10 million consumers across the state.

The Four Odisha Discoms
TPCODL (TP Central Odisha Distribution Limited)
TPNODL (TP Northern Odisha Distribution Limited)
TPSODL (TP Southern Odisha Distribution Limited)
TPWODL (TP Western Odisha Distribution Limited)

This Position will be based at TP Central Odisha Distribution Limited, Bhubaneswar, Odisha

Job Purpose
To develop and implement the organization's industrial relations strategy, fostering a positive and harmonious relationship between management and employees, ensuring compliance with labor laws, and effectively managing industrial disputes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE ROLE

Industrial Relations Strategy Development:
Develop and implement a comprehensive industrial relations strategy aligned with the organization's goals and values.
Establish and maintain effective communication channels with employee representatives, unions (if applicable), and the workforce.
Proactively identify potential industrial relations issues and develop preventive strategies.

Negotiation and Collective Bargaining:
Lead and manage negotiations with unions or employee representatives on matters related to wages, working conditions, and other terms of employment.
Develop and implement collective bargaining agreements.
Ensure compliance with the terms of collective bargaining agreements.
Grievance Handling and Dispute Resolution:
Establish and manage effective grievance handling mechanisms.
Investigate and resolve employee grievances and industrial disputes in a fair and timely manner.
Mediate and facilitate discussions to reach amicable settlements.

Compliance with Labor Laws:
Ensure the organization's compliance with all applicable labor laws, regulations, and statutory requirements in India (including but not limited to the Industrial Disputes Act, Trade Unions Act, etc.).
Stay updated on changes in labor legislation and advise management on their implications.

Experience - 20+ years of Experience.

Knowledge & Skills

In-depth knowledge of Indian labor laws and industrial relations practices.
Proven negotiation and collective bargaining skills.
Strong conflict resolution and mediation abilities.
Excellent communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.
Ability to build and maintain effective relationships with employees, unions, and external authorities.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ethical and fair approach to handling employee and industrial relations issues.
AboutCompany:
Tata Power- An Equal Opportunity Employer.

Led by a powerful vision, Tata Power pioneered the generation of electricity in India. It has now successfully served the Mumbai consumers for over ninety years and has spread its footprints across the nation. Today, it is the countrys largest private player in the sector. Apart from Mumbai and Delhi, the company has generation capacities in Jojobera, Jharkhand and Karnataka.As a growth strategy , Tata Power has ventured into several greenfield projects in Generation. The 4000 megawatt imported Coal-based generating station at Mundra , Gujarat , 1000 megawatt Thermal Power plant at Maithon , Jharkhand are some of its recent involvements. It has got several other upcoming capacity additions / greenfield projects in Maharashtra , Jharkhand , Orissa , West Bengal.

Description:
Zonal Human Resources Lead

Role Overview:

Position Summary:
The Zonal Human Resources Lead is responsible for overseeing and leading end-to-end HR service delivery for both direct and indirect employees across branch operations. This role acts as a strategic and operational HR partner focused on talent retention, performance management, employee grievance redressal, statutory labor compliance, and championing occupational health and safety standards in alignment with company values.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities:

1. HR Business Partnering & Operations
HR Strategy & Budgeting: Formulate and execute the annual branch HR plan and operating budget in alignment with business priorities and Hub HR objectives.
Workforce Planning & Talent Acquisition: Collaborate with the central recruitment team to ensure timely hiring, seamless onboarding, induction, and deployment of direct and indirect branch staff.
Employee Lifecycle & Records Management: Maintain accurate employee personal files and partner with the HR Shared Services / Transaction Center to ensure real-time ERP data integrity.
Performance & Talent Development: Drive the timely closure of the Performance Development Review (PDR) process for indirect staff; partner with the training function to identify training needs and ensure compliance with mandatory training programs.
HR Analytics: Compile, analyze, and present branch HR metric dashboards and reports to Hub and Corporate HR stakeholders.

2. Employee Relations, Engagement & Grievance Redressal

Grievance Resolution: Promptly address, manage, and resolve employee queries/grievances escalated beyond the central HR Helpdesk/Wish Center purview.
Employee Voice & Engagement: Conduct structured town halls, listening tours, and communication sessions to gather employee sentiment and implement corrective action plans.
Cross-Functional Escalation: Coordinate closely with Centers of Excellence (CoEs), Employee Relations (ER), and Shared Services for smooth conflict resolution.

3. Statutory & Regulatory Compliance

Compliance Management: Partner with the central ER and Compliance teams to guarantee strict adherence to local labor laws, statutory acts, and client-site audit mandates.
Quality Standards: Drive documentation and procedural compliance for the HR chapter of ISO audits and corporate quality accreditations.
Vendor & Agency Oversight: Liaise with regulatory agencies and third-party staffing vendors as needed for audits and labor compliance.

4. Occupational Health & Safety

Workplace Safety: Promote adherence to corporate Health & Safety policies and safe working protocols across all branch facilities and operational deployments.
Incident Management: Drive safety awareness campaigns, conduct safety drills, report on-site incidents, and facilitate swift incident resolution.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) & Success Metrics
Plan vs. Actual: Adherence to branch HR headcount plan and operational budget.
Operational Execution: % completion of recruitment targets, PDR cycles, and statutory training.
Retention: Branch voluntary attrition rate compared to internal benchmarks.
Service Delivery: Grievance resolution turnaround time (TAT) and employee engagement scores.
Audit & Risk: Zero critical non-compliance observations during statutory or client audits.
Safety: Number of workplace Health & Safety incidents reported/resolved.
Key Relationships & Stakeholders
Internal Stakeholders: Branch Manager & Operations Team, Hub HR Business Partners, Hub ER Team, Corporate/HQ HR, Talent Acquisition Team, Learning & Development Team, HR Shared Services / Wish Center, Payroll & Benefits Team.
External Stakeholders: Statutory & Labor Law Authorities, Government Regulatory Bodies, Third-party Staffing & Logistics Vendors.
Education
Minimum: Bachelors Degree / Diploma in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
Preferred: Masters Degree or MBA with a specialization in Human Resources / Industrial Relations.
Experience
3 to 7 years of solid HR Generalist / HR Business Partnering experience within a structured corporate environment.
Workforce Scale: Demonstrated experience managing HR operations for large distributed/field-force teams (direct and indirect/blue-collar workforce) is strongly preferred.
Competencies & Skills
HR Expertise: Deep functional knowledge of Indian labor laws, statutory compliances (PF, ESI, Gratuity, Bonus, Minimum Wages, Contract Labor Act), performance management, and HR ERP tools.
Operational Agility: Proven capability to navigate complex, fast-paced environments and manage competing operational priorities.
Communication: Strong interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills with the ability to influence branch leaders and front-line workers alike.
Leadership & Ethics: High standard of personal integrity, empathetic grievance handling, and collaborative stakeholder management.
