Description:
Role: Area Sales Manager
Location: Zonal office- Bhubaneswar
Reporting to: Regional Sales Manager
Team name: Sales team
About the Team and the Role:
The Sales team at Ather is responsible for building a network and establishing the blueprint for selling Electric Vehicles in India, driving a historic transformation of the two-wheeler commute through a breakthrough product and an engaged community.
This role is for an Area Sales Manager who will play a key role in the growth story, owning the business in their region and ensuring growth in sales while maintaining high levels of customer experience and operational profits.
Responsibilities:
Drive sales through assigned Channel Partners
Build teams and systems that ensure sustainable sales growth while maintaining exceptionally high customer experience standards.
Foster and manage strong relationships with retail partners to ensure business thriving and alignment with brand vision.
Execute operational excellence at Channel Partners covering local demand generation and sales driving activities.
Analyze the sales funnel to identify problem statements, develop solutions, and motivate teams for implementation.
Deliver against steep ramp-up plans with a focus on scaling the regional business effectively.
Manage multi-stakeholder inputs from internal teams and external partners to maintain design and operational integrity.
Conduct regular performance reviews and site assessments to ensure business health and consistency across locations.
Strategise and strive to improve Ather market share in the assigned territory
Required qualifications
Postgraduate or graduate degree in Business or Engineering from a Tier I/Tier II institute.
4 to 10 years of experience in B2C/Channel sales.
Must Have Competencies
Data-driven analysis of sales funnels to identify bottlenecks and implement strategic solutions for revenue growth.
Strategic channel management to align retail partners with corporate goals while ensuring partner profitability.
Operational excellence in retail management, specifically driving local demand generation and customer experience standards.
Expertise in B2C sales strategies and the ability to execute aggressive market ramp-up plans in competitive environments.
Good to Have Competencies
Deep understanding of technology or automobile retail landscapes and evolving mobility trends in the Indian market.
Advanced negotiation and persuasive communication skills for navigating complex stakeholder relationships and retail partnerships.
Proficiency in organizational planning and resource prioritization to manage multi-location business operations.
Ability to build and empower high-performing teams through structured mentorship and performance management systems.
Want to know more?
At Ather, weve built India’s first intelligent scooter, from scratch. Based on the philosophy of clean design and smart technology, we are transforming the urban commute experience. We are expanding in India, and in the coming years, we look forward to scaling up and launching more products globally. Today, our product offerings include the Ather 450X, 450S, 450 Apex, and Rizta. Beyond the product, we are also setting up an extensive charging network and re-imagining end-to-end ownership experience. To know more, check out our Careers site and our Substack.
Be You, With Us
The Ather story doesn't write itself - our people do. We believe everyone is equal, but not the same. Diversity is our strength, and building an inclusive and equitable workplace begins with acknowledging and embracing our differences. We are an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects a wide range of identities, experiences, and perspectives - all united by a shared passion to shape the Ather journey.

Description:
Job Purpose


This position is open with Bajaj Finance ltd.


Duties and Responsibilities


General Admin (Facility Management RM)
1. Control branch OPEX expenses within set budget.
2. Maintain regular Maintenance Hygiene of branches.
3. Timely closer on Issues including RM activity.
4. Timely Payment of branch expense bills.
5. Expense control of general expenses of branches.
6. Branch Feedback of employees seniors visiting branches.
7. Maintain proper data / records of all expenses of all locations managers supervised.
8.Monthly branch visits .
Infrastructure (NEW Projects under BASE)
1. Identification of new premises as per company requirement (Location rate).
2. Close on documentation legal clearance.
3. Having the civil work (as required) completed.
4. Installation of furniture fixtures.
5. Coordination with infra vendors.
6. Ensuring the branch is complete handed over to business well in TAT
Statutory Compliances
1. Ensuring the LOI is signed well within the TAT. (within 5 working days from receiving the legal clearance stability
2. Ensuring the lease agreement is signed well within the TAT. (within 10 working days from signing the LOI
3. Ensuring the lease agreement is registered well within the TAT. (within 20 working days of receiving the approval from H.O)
4.the shops establishments application is applied the certificate is received well within the TAT. (within 10 days of branch completion)
5.security related equipments are up to date under AMC renewals are done prior to expiry of contract.
6. Renewals of all Lease agreements AMC contract done prior to the expiry date.
7. Ensuring all statutory documents / certificates are displayed at the common area (reception) in line to compliance.





1. Graduate in any discipline with experience of working in Administration preferred
2. Inclination to have knowledge/ exposure on legal/ compliance matters.
3. Exposure in handling govt. / legal Issues
4. Team management interpersonal Skills
5. Good on negotiations and Vendor development Management
6. Well versed with MS Word, Excel, Power Point
7. Willing to Travel

Description:
WE ARE HIRING: Field Sales Engineers (15 Openings Across India)

BT Print & PKG Solutions LLP is expanding! We are looking for dynamic, target-driven Field Sales Engineers to spearhead B2B sales for our advanced industrial coding, marking, and inspection portfolioincluding CIJ/TIJ Printers, Laser Marking Machines, and AI Inspection Systems.

If you thrive in industrial automation or high-velocity B2B sales and want to partner with leading manufacturers across the Food, Pharma, Beverage, Dairy, and Electronics sectors, we want to hear from you!

Locations: Kolkata | Delhi | Pune | Mumbai | Hyderabad | Chennai | Bangalore | Punjab

Openings: 15 Positions

Compensation: Competitive & Negotiable (Based on experience, location & industry standards)

What You’ll Do:
Drive Growth: Develop new business within your assigned territory and crush sales targets.

Pitch & Demonstrate: Conduct on-site client visits, technical presentations, and live product demos.

Nurture Accounts: Build strong, long-term relationships with existing clients to maximize retention.

Collaborate: Work alongside our service engineers to ensure smooth installation and after-sales support.

Represent & Report: Attend industry trade shows/exhibitions, track market intelligence, and share weekly/monthly pipeline reports with management.

What We’re Looking For:
Education: B.E./B.Tech (Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics preferred) OR MBA in Sales & Marketing.

Experience: 3–7 years in B2B field sales across Industrial Machinery, Automation, Packaging Solutions, or Banking/Financial Sales. (Prior experience in coding & marking equipment is a strong advantage!)

Skills: Solid technical aptitude for machinery, strong negotiation skills, and a self-starter attitude.

Mobility: Extensive regional travel is mandatory; owning a 2-wheeler or 4-wheeler is an added advantage.
AboutCompany: BT Print is built upon the philosophy that business is about positively impacting social ecosystem including lives of people and enhancing value of business activities. All aspects of a business should benefit society at large thus every service we offer is not developed with the intent aimlessly increase market share; rather, our focus is on providing a valuable service. We are a highly energetic team passionate about supporting business by providing high quality products and services which helps in reducing overheads and costs.

Description:
At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Position Name-Senior Manager
Position Details
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, the Digital Senior Manager will be responsible for working closely and leading teams with associates, seniors, team leaders, assistant managers, and handling service delivery for an Area/Region/Solution/Sector. The principal objectives will be to ensure that consistent and high-quality service is provided by the team by taking end-to-end project ownership and accomplishing the define goals. The Innovation Manager is responsible for the overall success of implantation of solutions/ideas that can bring more business or can bring efficiencies by digitalize the manual work.
Requirements (including experience, skills and additional qualifications)
Requirement & Qualification
A Bachelor's/ Masters degree (BE/BTech/MCA/MTech & MBA) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems Management, Accounting, Finance or a related field with adequate industry experience.
15-20 years experience (demonstrated competence, depth, and breadth) of operational and project/Program management experience
Strategize and outline goals and objectives of the program
Monitor multiple projects through the entire program cycle, Manage the daytoday detailed aspects of multiple projects, Coordinate and utilize resources for multiple projects in the program
Communicate program objectives, goals, and progress to program directors, executives, upper management, and stakeholders
Experience in independently leading the organization wide Tech Initiatives along with managing the delivery of those initiatives spanning across
Automation Robotics Process Automation, SharePoint/ React, .NET, Web Portal development, Cloud etc.
Transformation Business Process Reengineering, Business Process
Optimization
Data Visualization PowerBI, Spotfire etc.
Knowledge & ability to manage Financial Accounting engagements across domains
Ability to manage tight deadlines and multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously.
Prior experience with agile methodologies and practices
Awareness on cloud technologies is required
The individual will assist the management team in developing and coaching team members as well as ensuring that resources are deployed in the most effective manner
While the individual will be based at our Bangalore office, the role requires the person to travel to other countries on a short or long-term basis for client engagements.
Good to have
PMP Certifications or equivalent certification
Scrum Product Owner or Scrum Master Certifications
Key Responsibilities:
Develop strong relationship with onshore stakeholders (Areas leadership and champion network) and manage their expectations on service delivery
Building Centralized Data storage system
Building Data Strategies for the team
Built good understanding of Sources and Target sources by understanding the GDS Assurance Business.
Responsible for identifying and creating new service offerings/Solutions
Responsible for ensuring high quality consistent and efficient service is provided by the team to the Project teams of different areas/regions
Responsible for managing the operational aspects of Project management such as, resource management, Metrics & Reporting, performance management and elements of risk management
In addition, the Manager will be responsible to build strong relationships with local teams and clients, identifying areas where GDS can improve quality of, and increase the scope of work
Experience in coordinating projects and interdependencies between various projects within the program
Additional skills requirements:
Excellent written, oral, presentation and facilitation skills
Ability to coordinate multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously through effective prioritization, organization, flexibility and self-discipline.
Must have demonstrated project management experience.
Knowledge of firms reporting tools and processes.
Proactive, organized and self-sufficient with ability to priorities and multitask.
Analyses complex or unusual problems and is able to deliver insightful and pragmatic solutions.
Ability to quickly and easily create/ gather/ analyze data from a variety of sources.
A robust and resilient disposition able to encourage discipline in team behaviors
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 7200 + professionals, in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What working at EY offers
At EY, were dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way thats right for you
EY | Building a better working world


EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Role: GIS Performance Tester
Experience: 5-6 years
Staff Level: Senior Associate
Education: BE/BTECH or equivalent
Key responsibilities:
Define GIS performance testing strategy covering web, desktop, and servicelevel workloads (ArcGIS Server, Utility Network, Feature Services).
Identify performancecritical GIS workflows (pan/zoom, tracing, edits, large spatial queries, batch jobs).
Create realistic GIS workload models based on editor, viewer, integration, and batch processing usage patterns.
Design test scenarios for: 
Map rendering and symbology scaling
Feature service queries (attribute + spatial)
Utility Network traces and validations
Web GIS Load Test scenarios
Concurrent editing and versioned data access 
Load and Stress Simulation:Execute load, endurance, and stress tests to determine how GIS (likeArcGIS Server) perform under high user traffic, specifically testing 2D/3D map rendering and data querying.
Bottleneck Analysis: Monitor system KPIssuch as CPU utilization, memory, response times, and throughput—to identify bottlenecks related to spatial analysis or database queries.
Result Reporting: Create detailed performance analysis reports that highlight the system's performance, identifying areas for improvement or potential downtime.
Collaborate with Functional Analysts to map business flows into performance test cases.
Prior experience in GIS Testing assignments will be an advantage.
Collaboration & Optimization:Work with GIS developers and architects to suggest infrastructure changes, database tuning, or code optimizations to resolve issues.
Perform RCA on performance issues and recommend improvement opportunities.
Essential Qualifications:
Minimum of 5 years’ working experience with Esri ArcGIS Software (Enterprise, Desktop, Server, ArcGIS Pro, Online)
Understanding of ArcGIS Enterprise Architecture- ArcGIS Server, Portal, data Store etc.
Understanding of ArcGIS Pro concepts: Maps, Projects, Layout templates, Editing Templates, Tasks etc.
Understanding of Esri geoprocessing tools: model Builder
Understanding of Geodatabases: Versioning and Spatial data Types

Description:
We are the makers of possible
BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities.
Why Join Us?
A career at BD means learning and working alongside inspirational leaders and colleagues who are equally passionate and committed to fostering an inclusive, growth-centered, and rewarding culture. You will have the opportunity to help shape the trajectory of BD while leaving a legacy at the same time.
To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. We welcome people with the imagination and drive to help us reinvent the future of health. At BD, you’ll discover a culture in which you can learn, grow and thrive. And find satisfaction in doing your part to make the world a better place.
Become a maker of possible with us!
Responsibilities:
1. Conduct CME's, seminars , promotional events and In service programs in the respective region In order to improve BD Specimen Management value proposition amongst both clinical and economic buyers towards business outcome and achieve Regional business objectives.
2. Clinical capability building amongst regional Specimen Management direct selling organisation and amongst channel partners ( administering trainings, continuous evaluation) in line with the country clinical objectives In order to enhance their ability to adequately differentiate the brands in the market and thus achieve targeted business outcomes.
3. Creating and implementing the regional calendar of engagements with potential/existing customers In order to create strong brand awareness and creating door openers at the relevant levels
4. Support / assist sales organisation with product evaluations and 'critical to business' technical challenges (including but not limited to troubleshooting and product applications) In order to attain high levels of product penetration, query resolution and trouble free product application.
5. Leading edge key customer relationship management and creation of regional KOL network In order to ensure usage of full array of BD Specimen Management products by leading client organisations and using these customer relationships to drive the conversions.
6. Coordinate timely completion of clinical/economic studies initiated in the region . In order to ensure that the clinical/ economic studies planned for the year are completed with in the stipulated timelines.

Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) Senior Associate (5-9 Years of Experience)
As an OAC Senior Developer, you will work with technical and project teams to design and deliver enterprise-grade data integration solutions for some of our Fortune 1000 clients. Title: Sap Fico Consultant
Skills: Skills highlighted with ‘‘ are preferred keyskills, Controlling, SAP FICOSAP COCopaCost Center AccountingCO-CCAutility, About company, Thanks & Regards,, Mary Florence, PwC Acceleration Center
Description:
Extensive SAP S/4HANA Finance expert with solution design experience across the full FI stack, preferably with an accounts and finance background.
Lead a team of Finance specialists; facilitate and guide the implementation and support teams.
Ability to lead and facilitate design workshops, assessments, and planning sessions, demonstrating leadership experience in project management.
Lead dynamic, interactive requirements-gathering sessions with stakeholders throughout the enterprise.
Strong, hands-on expertise across core SAP FI modules:
FI-GL (General Ledger) New GL, document splitting, parallel ledgers/accounting principles, chart of accounts design, financial statement versions, and period-end closing activities.
FI-AR (Accounts Receivable) — customer master data, credit management, dunning, incoming payments, down payments, and customer-side intercompany processes.
FI-AP (Accounts Payable) — vendor master data, payment runs, payment terms, down payments, automatic/electronic payments, and vendor reconciliation.
Asset Accounting (FI-AA) — asset classes, depreciation areas, parallel valuation, asset acquisitions/retirements/transfers, and integration with GL and CO, including regulated utility plant and FERC asset classification where applicable.
Bank Accounting / Treasury integration — bank master data, electronic bank statement processing, cash management, and bank reconciliation.
Taxation — tax procedures, tax codes, withholding tax, and statutory/compliance reporting requirements.
Basic, working knowledge of Controlling — Cost Center Accounting (CO-CCA), Profit Center Accounting (CO-PCA), and Internal Orders — sufficient to support FI-CO integration points and cross-module postings; deep Product Costing or Material Ledger specialization is not required for this role.
Strong knowledge of FERC (Federal Energy Regulatory Commission) regulatory reporting for the utilities/energy industry, including FERC Form 1/2/6 preparation, regulatory chart of accounts mapping, and FERC account classification within SAP.
Hands-on experience configuring FERC-compliant Asset Accounting structures — Continuing Property Records (CPR), Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC, both debt and equity components), Construction Work in Progress (CWIP) capitalization, retirement units, and regulatory versus book depreciation.
Understanding of the regulatory ledger/parallel ledger approach (New GL document splitting, or FI-SL) to maintain FERC regulatory books alongside US GAAP/IFRS books, including regulatory asset/liability (ASC 980) accounting.
Exposure to Public Utility industry-specific functionality, Work Order management integration (PM/PS) for capital project accounting, and minor/major retirement processing relevant to utility plant.
Experience supporting FERC audits and regulatory filings, including variance analysis between book and regulatory basis of accounting.
Mentor, coach and manage multiple teams and projects.
Proven experience in configuring, testing and supporting SAP Finance solutions across GL, AR, AP, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting and Taxation.
Participate in design discussions, providing expertise on the SAP S/4HANA Finance platform.
Work with business users to understand requirements and propose alternative design solutions across FI processes.
Develop a collaborative and cohesive team, working with a culture of a One Team mindset.
Hands-on experience in Finance and accounts, with the ability to translate accounting requirements into system configuration.
Hands-on experience across S/4HANA Finance features with ability to design, develop and customize solutions, including integration with other modules like MM/SD/PS/PP/PM/IM — particularly how procurement, sales, and production postings flow into FI.
Knowledge of CFIN, and understanding of the elimination of ETL tools to enable transactional-level matching in real time.
Understanding of AIF and field value mapping, centralized transaction processing, payments, intercompany reconciliation, and group consolidation using S/4HANA Group Reporting.
Working familiarity with the S/4HANA Intercompany Matching and Reconciliation (ICMR) tool, as well as a solid accounting and finance background.
Knowledge and experience in implementing SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting is an added advantage.

Position Level

Position Details
EY's GDS Assurance Digital teams mission is to develop, implement and integrate technology solutions that better serve our audit clients and engagement teams. As a member of EY's core Assurance practice, you'll develop a deep Audit related technical knowledge and outstanding database, data analytics and programming skills.
Ever-increasing regulations require audit departments to gather, organize and analyse more data than ever before. Often the data necessary to satisfy these ever-increasing and complex regulations must be collected from a variety of systems and departments throughout an organization. Effectively and efficiently handling the variety and volume of data is often extremely challenging and time consuming for a company.
EY's GDS Assurance Digital team members work side-by-side with the firm's partners, clients and audit technical subject matter experts to develop and incorporate technology solutions that enhance value-add, improve efficiencies and enable our clients with disruptive and market leading tools supporting Assurance.
GDS Assurance Digital provides solution architecture, application development, testing and maintenance support to the global Assurance service line both on a pro-active basis and in response to specific requests.
EY is currently seeking Software Engineer to join the GDS Assurance Digital practice in Bangalore, India, to work on various Microsoft technology based projects for customers across the globe.
Requirements
A Bachelor's degree (BE/BTech/MCA & MBA) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems Management, Accounting, Finance or a related field with adequate industry experience.
Technical skills requirements
BE/BTech/MCA with a sound industry experience of 4.5 to 7 Yrs.
Strong experience in MVC, .Net Core and Entity Framework.
Strong React JS or Angular JS experience.
Solid working knowledge of relational database development: MS SQL/SQL Azure, EF 6, EF Core
Storing experience in ASP .NET, C# and or VB.NET, Windows or Web based development, Web API, Web Services, Application Blocks
Basic knowledge in Azure stack like Logic apps, Azure functions and Web Apps and deployment solutions
Unit testing: NUnit, Moq, jest
Experience using distributed version control systems: Git/SVN
Should have understanding and experience of software development best practices.
Excellent business communication
JSON and Rest API integration
Need to work as a team member to contribute in various technical streams of Microsoft Technologies.
Nice to have skill
Basic knowledge in one of the following technologies: Angular, React
Experience in Azure DevOps
Experience in Agile / Scrum methodology
Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities
An ability to quickly understand complex concepts and use technology to support data modeling, analysis, visualization or process automation
Selects appropriately from applicable standards, methods, tools and applications and uses accordingly
Ability to work within a multi-disciplinary team structure, but also independently
Demonstrates analytical and systematic approach to problem solving
Communicates fluently orally and in writing and can present complex technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences
Able to plan, schedule and monitor work activities in order to meet time and quality targets
Able to absorb rapidly new technical information, business acumen, and apply it effectively
Ability to work in a team environment with strong customer focus, good listening, negotiation and problem-resolution skills
Additional skills requirements
The expectations are that a Senior will be able to maintain long-term client relationships and network and cultivate business development opportunities
Provide high quality client services by directing daily progress of engagement work, informing engagement manager of engagement status, and managing staff performance.
Must have presentation skills - ability to create PowerPoint deck to communicate solution architecture to various stakeholders.
Should have understanding and experience of software development best practices
Excellent business communication, Consulting, Quality process skills
Must be a team player

Description:

Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions underpinned by the worlds largest delivery network Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With 750K people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at

About Global Network:
Accenture Strategy shapes our clientsfuture, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on issues such as digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models as well as the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. Today, every business is a digital business. Digital is changing the way organizations engage with their employees, business partners, customers, and communities how they manufacture and deliver products and services, and how they run their organizations. This is our unique differentiator. We seek people who recognize and understand the impact that digital, and technology have on every industry and every sector, and share our passion to shape unique strategies that allow our clients to succeed in this environment.
To bring this global perspective to our clients, Accenture Strategy''s services include those provided by our
Global
Network a distributed management consulting organization that provides management consulting and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. Approximately 10,000 consultants are part of this rapidly expanding network, providing specialized and strategic industry and functional consulting expertise from key locations around the world. Our Global Network teams complement our in-country teams to deliver cutting-edge expertise and measurable value to clients all around the world. For more information visit .

Why Technology Consulting
The Technology Consulting business within Global Network invents the future for clients by providing them with the right guidance, design thinking and innovative solutions for technological transformation.
As technology rapidly evolves, its more important than ever to have an innovation advisor who can create a new vision or put one into place to solve the clients toughest business problems.
Specialize in management or technology consulting to transform the world''s leading organizations by building innovative business solutions as their trusted advisor by:

Helping Clients: Rethinking IT and Digital ecosystems and innovating to help clients keep pace with fast-changing, customer-driven environments.

Enhancing your Skillset: Building expertise and innovating with leading-edge technologies such as Blockchain, Artificial Intelligence and Cloud.

Transforming Businesses: Developing customized, next-generation products and services that help clients shift to new business models designed for today''s connected landscape of disruptive technologies

Principal Duties

And Responsibilities:
Project environment that offers multiple opportunities for career growth.
The opportunities to make a difference within exciting client initiatives are limitless in this ever-changing business landscape
Here are just a few of your day-to-day responsibilities.
Lead Hybrid Cloud Projects: Guide clients through application modernization and migration initiatives, designing strategies and roadmaps for hybrid environments.
Architect Hybrid Solutions: Develop cloud architectures integrating public cloud services with on-premises and private cloud platforms, using technologies such as OpenShift, Anthos, and VMware.
Application Modernization: Design composable architectures using microservices, event-driven architectures (EDA), and cloud-native technologies across hybrid environments.
Hybrid Cloud Integration: Implement solutions that enable seamless workload portability and management across on-premises, private, and public clouds.
DevOps & Automation: Establish CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform, Deployment Manager, OpenShift templates), and automated operations across hybrid environments.
Data Integration & Analytics: Architect data platforms that span cloud and on-premises, enabling advanced analytics, machine learning, and secure data exchange.
Security & Compliance: Design secure hybrid architectures, ensuring compliance with industry standards and best practices for identity, access, and data protection.
Client Advisory: Serve as a trusted advisor, communicating hybrid cloud architecture, best practices, and transformation strategies to technical and business stakeholders.
Thought Leadership: Develop reusable assets, publish whitepapers, and contribute to the hybrid cloud community.
Business Case & ROI Analysis: Build financial models for cloud adoption, including TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) and ROI. Advise on cost optimization strategies and AWS pricing models.
Operating Model Design: Design cloud operating models for governance, security, and compliance. Recommend organizational changes for cloud adoption (e.g., Cloud Center of Excellence).
Resilience & DR Strategy: Define RTO/RPO tiers, multi-region patterns, backup/restore policies
Design Architecture Review Board charters, NFR baseline templates



Qualification

Qualifications:
Bachelors degree
MBA Degree from Tier-1 College (Preferable)
9-13 years of large-scale consulting experience and/or working with hi tech companies leading Projects on Cloud Strategy, Assessment, Cloud architecture, App Modernization, Containers, information security and information management.
Professional Cloud Architect Certification (GCP or AWS)

Experience:
We are seeking experienced professionals who have led large-scale engagements in application modernization, cloud architecture, and cloud strategy. The ideal candidates will have technical expertise in cloud strategy, assessments, cloud architecture, application modernization, and containers, across all stages of the innovation lifecycle, with a focus on shaping the future in real-time."
The candidate should have practical industry expertise in one of these areas - Financial Services, Retail, consumer goods, Telecommunications, Life Sciences, Transportation, Hospitality, Automotive/Industrial, Mining and Resources.

Key Competencies and Skills:
The right candidate should have competency and skills aligned to one or more of these archetypes
Expertise in hybrid cloud architecture, integration, and cloud-native development.
Strong knowledge of microservices, containers (Kubernetes, OpenShift), and event-driven design.
Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and infrastructure automation across hybrid environments
Other desired skills -
Strong desire to work in technology-driven business transformation
Strong knowledge of technology trends across IT and digital and how they can be applied to companies to address real world problems and opportunities.
Comfort conveying both high-level and detailed information, adjusting the way ideas are presented to better address varying social styles and audiences.
Leading proof of concept and/or pilot implementations and defining the plan to scale implementations across multiple technology domains
Flexibility to accommodate client travel requirements
Published Thought leadership Whitepapers, POVs

About the Role
We are looking for experienced SAP CPI Consultants to join our SAP practice. Develop custom integration logic using Groovy Scripts.
Configure adapters, mappings, content modifiers, routers, and exception handling mechanisms.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize integration interfaces.
Collaborate with functional and technical teams to understand business requirements and integration needs.
Perform unit testing, SIT, UAT support, defect resolution, and production support activities.
Prepare technical specifications and integration documentation.
Participate in implementation, rollout, migration, upgrade, and support projects.
Support SAP S/4HANA integration initiatives.
Ensure adherence to integration best practices, security standards, and governance processes.

Position Name-Senior Manager
Position Details
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, the Digital Senior Manager will be responsible for working closely and leading teams with associates, seniors, team leaders, assistant managers, and handling service delivery for an Area/Region/Solution/Sector. The principal objectives will be to ensure that consistent and high-quality service is provided by the team by taking end-to-end project ownership and accomplishing the define goals. The Innovation Manager is responsible for the overall success of implantation of solutions/ideas that can bring more business or can bring efficiencies by digitalize the manual work.
Requirements (including experience, skills and additional qualifications)
Requirement & Qualification
A Bachelors/ Master s degree (BE/BTech/MCA/MTech & MBA) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems Management, Accounting, Finance or a related field with adequate industry experience.
15-20 years experience (demonstrated competence, depth, and breadth) of operational and project/Program management experience
Strategize and outline goals and objectives of the program
Monitor multiple projects through the entire program cycle, Manage the daytoday detailed aspects of multiple projects, Coordinate and utilize resources for multiple projects in the program
Communicate program objectives, goals, and progress to program directors, executives, upper management, and stakeholders
Experience in independently leading the organization wide Tech Initiatives along with managing the delivery of those initiatives spanning across
Automation - Robotics Process Automation, SharePoint/ React, .NET, Web Portal development, Cloud etc.
Transformation - Business Process Reengineering, Business Process
Optimization
Data Visualization - PowerBI, Spotfire etc.
Knowledge & ability to manage Financial Accounting engagements across domains
Ability to manage tight deadlines and multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously.
Prior experience with agile methodologies and practices
Awareness on cloud technologies is required
The individual will assist the management team in developing and coaching team members as well as ensuring that resources are deployed in the most effective manner
While the individual will be based at our Bangalore office, the role requires the person to travel to other countries on a short or long-term basis for client engagements.
Good to have
PMP Certifications or equivalent certification
Scrum Product Owner or Scrum Master Certifications
Key Responsibilities :
Develop strong relationship with onshore stakeholders (Area s leadership and champion network) and manage their expectations on service delivery
Building Centralized Data storage system
Building Data Strategies for the team
Built good understanding of Sources and Target sources by understanding the GDS Assurance Business.
Responsible for identifying and creating new service offerings/Solutions
Responsible for ensuring high quality consistent and efficient service is provided by the team to the Project teams of different areas/regions
Responsible for managing the operational aspects of Project management such as, resource management, Metrics & Reporting, performance management and elements of risk management
In addition, the Manager will be responsible to build strong relationships with local teams and clients, identifying areas where GDS can improve quality of, and increase the scope of work
Experience in coordinating projects and interdependencies between various projects within the program
Additional skills requirements :
Excellent written, oral, presentation and facilitation skills
Ability to coordinate multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously through effective prioritization, organization, flexibility and self-discipline.
Must have demonstrated project management experience.
Knowledge of firm s reporting tools and processes.
Proactive, organized and self-sufficient with ability to priorities and multitask.
Analyses complex or unusual problems and is able to deliver insightful and pragmatic solutions.
Ability to quickly and easily create/ gather/ analyze data from a variety of sources.
A robust and resilient disposition able to encourage discipline in team behaviors
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 7200 + professionals, in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
At EY, we re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to :
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that s right for you
EY | Building a better working world

Description:
Star Bucks is looking for Store Operations to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.

The Store Operations Specialist is responsible for overseeing and optimizing the daily operations of our retail stores. They play a vital role in ensuring a seamless customer experience, managing inventory, and implementing operational processes to enhance store efficiency. This role requires a detail-oriented individual with strong organizational and communication skills. Key Responsibilities : Customer Service : Provide exceptional customer service by addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring a positive shopping experience. Train and mentor store staff on customer service best practices. Inventory Management : Monitor and manage store inventory levels to prevent stockouts and overstock situations. Coordinate with suppliers for timely replenishment of inventory. Conduct regular stock audits and maintain accurate inventory records. Store Layout and Merchandising : Collaborate with the visual merchandising team to ensure attractive and effective product displays. Optimize store layout for a smooth flow of customers and improved product visibility. Operational Efficiency : Develop and implement operational procedures to streamline store processes and reduce operational costs. Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to store operations. Loss Prevention : Implement loss prevention strategies to minimize theft and ensure the security of store assets. Conduct periodic security audits and recommend improvements as needed. Employee Training and Development : Train and coach store staff on operational procedures, customer service, and product knowledge. Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees. Compliance and Safety : Ensure the store complies with all safety and regulatory requirements. Implement safety protocols and conduct regular safety drills.

UFlex Ltd. is looking for Holography - Technical Trainee - Production to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.

Support the production team in the manufacturing of holographic security elements by operating basic machinery, handling raw materials, and performing routine tasks under supervision. A Geographic Information System (GIS) is a computer system that analyzes and displays geographically referenced information. Geographic information system(s), GIS
GIS is a technology that is used to create, manage, analyze, and map all types of data.

Role Objective
To support front Retail forces via Store operation excellence programs to ensure increasing stores productivity and profitability.

On a typical day you will drive the following
To ensure the delivery of operational KPI, sales and profitability plan across stores and review KPI’s periodically. Effectively manage and review the P&L of all the stores to optimize store profitability.

To identify underperforming stores and develop a business plan to address and manage issues effectively.
Coaching the store manager and staff on performance improvement. Work on individual store – improvement plan.

Seek and continuously develop knowledge and information about competitor’s activity, tactics, offers and utilize the information to maximize business opportunity.

Nykaa sells products which are manufactured in India as well as internationally. In 2015, the company expanded from online-only to an omnichannel model and began selling products apart from beauty. As of 2020, it retails over 2,000 brands and 200,000 products across its platforms.

Description:
Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) Azure, Kubernetes & Terraform
Experience: 48 years
Role Overview
We are seeking experienced and hands-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost-awareness, and delivery quality.
Key Responsibilities
Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
Architect and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform module design, remote state, workspaces, policy-as-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
Build, maintain, and optimize end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
Develop Python-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day-2 operations across cloud platforms.
Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.
Required Skills and Experience
Strong hands-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps);
Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi-environment patterns, and integration with policy-as-code frameworks.
Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply-chain controls.
Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
Qualification and Certifications
B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ-104 / AZ-305 / AZ-400), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security+).
Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.

Locations- Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Kolkata, Noida, Kochi, Coimbatore

Description:
Job Description: iOS Developer

Job Title: iOS Developer


Exp: 5to 8 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled iOS Developer to design, develop, and maintain high-quality iOS applications. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in Swift, iOS SDK, and mobile application development with a focus on performance, scalability, and user experience.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain iOS applications using Swift and UIKit/SwiftUI.
Collaborate with product managers, designers, and backend developers to deliver high-quality mobile solutions.
Integrate RESTful APIs and third-party libraries/services.
Optimize application performance, responsiveness, and security.
Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code following coding standards.
Participate in code reviews, debugging, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
Ensure applications comply with Apple's App Store guidelines.
Work in Agile/Scrum teams and contribute to sprint planning and delivery.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Swift.
Expertise in iOS SDK, UIKit, and/or SwiftUI.
, Interface Builder, and iOS development tools.
Good understanding of MVC, MVVM, VIPER architecture patterns.
Experience integrating REST APIs, JSON parsing, and networking frameworks.
Knowledge of Core Data, SQLite, UserDefaults, and data persistence.
Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and version control systems.
Understanding of mobile security, memory management, and performance optimization.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Firebase services (Analytics, Crashlytics, Push Notifications).
Knowledge of XCTest, Unit Testing, and UI Testing.
Experience with CocoaPods, Swift Package Manager, or Carthage.
Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
Published applications on the Apple App Store.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Nice to Have
Experience working in Agile environments.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Keywords: Swift, Objective-C, iOS SDK, SwiftUI, UIKit, Xcode, REST API, Core Data, Firebase, MVVM, Mobile App Development, Git, XCTest, App Store Deployment.

With over three decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer our clients through their digital journey. We do it by enabling the enterprise with an AI-powered core that helps prioritize the execution of change. We also empower the business with agile digital at scale to deliver unprecedented levels of performance and customer delight. Our always-on learning agenda drives their continuous improvement through building and transferring digital skills, expertise, and ideas from our innovation ecosystem.

To learn more about Infosys and see our ideas in action please visit us at www.Infosys.com

Your Role

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Technical Architect with 15 years of experience in Salesforce development and architecture to design, lead, and deliver scalable, secure, and high-performing Salesforce solutions. You will collaborate with business stakeholders, project managers, and development teams to translate business requirements into robust technical architectures while driving best practices, governance, and innovation across the Salesforce ecosystem.






Your Profile

Strong expertise in Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Aura Components, and Salesforce APIs.
Proven experience in designing and implementing complex enterprise-scale Salesforce solutions.
Strong understanding of Salesforce security model, data architecture, sharing mechanisms, and integration patterns.
Experience integrating Salesforce with external platforms using REST/SOAP APIs and middleware solutions.
Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Certified Application Architect, Salesforce Certified System Architect, or Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA).
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience working within Agile development methodologies.

Shape your career with flexible career paths and internal mobility across the Capgemini Group.
Access comprehensive wellness benefits, including health checks, telemedicine, insurance with top-ups, elder care, partner coverage, and new-parent support.
Work on cutting-edge Salesforce projects with global clients, contributing to solutions that address complex business, societal, and environmental challenges.

Description:
Area

Key Responsibilities
PLC, SCADA & Automation Systems

Ensure smooth operation, maintenance, and reliability of PLC, SCADA, HMI, BMS, EMS, and automation systems across manufacturing and utility areas.
• Troubleshoot automation and control system failures to minimize downtime.
• Support configuration, modification, backup, restoration, and lifecycle management of automation systems.
• Coordinate with OEMs and internal stakeholders for upgrades, maintenance, and resolution of technical issues.
Instrumentation & Control Systems

Ensure proper functioning of field instruments, sensors, transmitters, controllers, and associated control systems.
• Support calibration activities and reliability improvement initiatives.
• Execute preventive and predictive maintenance activities related to instrumentation and automation systems.
• Maintain engineering records, specifications, loop diagrams, and instrument documentation.
Validation, Compliance & Data Integrity

Support validation and qualification activities related to PLC, SCADA, HMI, and computerized systems.
• Ensure systems remain compliant with cGMP, Data Integrity, and computerized system requirements.
• Participate in periodic reviews, audit readiness activities, and regulatory inspections.
• Maintain validated state of computerized systems through effective lifecycle management.
AboutCompany:
Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.
Zydus global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.
Interested candidates can please share their Resumes/ CVs at Karishma.R.Kadu@ZydusLife.com

About the team :
QR and Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role :
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.

Expectations/ Requirements :

2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.

Job description Sales (LAP) Sales Manager
Job Type: Full-time
About IIFL Finance: IIFL Finance is a leading financial services provider in India, known for its comprehensive range of solutions including loans, insurance, and investment products. DSA Network for Sales Maximization: Maximize sales through a network of DSA by effectively managing connector and builder relationships to ensure strong business
Disbursement Target Management and Achievement: Drive Disbursement Target vs Achievement for LAP product - as per expected business growth plan.

Market Research: Stay informed about local real estate trends, property values, and competitive offerings. Use market insights to refine sales strategies and identify new opportunities.
Desired Candidate Profile:
3+ years of experience strong understanding handling LAP Product
Problem Solving ability
Bachelors degree in finance or any other field - Graduation is a must

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Roles and Responsibilities
Job Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented and organized Accounts Executive to manage the companys day-to-day accounting operations, billing, financial entries and documentation. The candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring smooth daily accounting activities.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage daily accounting entries and bookkeeping.
* Prepare sales invoices, purchase bills and quotations.
* Record daily sales and purchase transactions.
* Maintain cash, bank and ledger entries.
* Handle customer and supplier account records.
* Manage purchase invoices, sales bills and debit/credit notes.
* Maintain accounts receivable and payable records.
* Perform bank reconciliation and ledger reconciliation.
* Coordinate with customers and suppliers regarding billing and payment-related queries.
* Maintain proper documentation of all financial transactions.
* Assist in GST-related entries, documentation and reports.
* Prepare daily and monthly accounting reports.

Job Description
Position: Receptionist / Front Office Executive
Department: Front Office
Industry: Hotel / Resort / Hospitality
Reporting To: General Manager
Location: Shimla


Job Purpose
The Hotel Receptionist Is Responsible For Providing A Warm And Professional Welcome To Guests, Managing Check-in And Check-out Procedures, Handling Guest Enquiries, Coordinating With Hotel Departments, And Ensuring A Smooth And Pleasant Guest Experience Throughout The Stay.


Key Responsibilities

A. Guest Reception Welcome
Welcome And Greet Guests Professionally And Courteously.
Create A Positive First Impression Of The Hotel.
Assist Guests With Their Requirements And Provide Accurate Information.
Maintain Professional Communication And Grooming Standards At All Times.


B. Check-In Check-Out
andle Guest Check-in And Check-out Procedures Efficiently.
Verify Guest Identification And Required Documents.
Allocate Rooms According To Reservations And Hotel Policies.
Provide Room Keys/cards And Explain Basic Hotel Facilities And Services.
Process Departures And Coordinate With The Relevant Departments.


C. Reservation Booking Coordination
Handle Room Reservation Enquiries Through Phone, Email, Online Platforms, And Walk-ins.
Verify Room Availability And Booking Details.
Update Reservation Information Accurately In The Hotel System.
Coordinate With The Reservations And Housekeeping Teams Regarding Room Status.


D. Guest Service
Handle Guest Requests, Questions, And Complaints Professionally.
Resolve Routine Guest Issues Or Escalate Them To The Appropriate Manager.
Provide Information About Hotel Facilities, Restaurants, Nearby Attractions, Transportation, And Local Destinations.
Maintain Excellent Guest Relations And Customer Service Standards.


E. Telephone Communication
Answer And Transfer Telephone Calls Professionally.
Respond To Guest Emails And Messages Promptly.
Maintain Proper Communication With Front Office, Housekeeping, FB, Accounts, Maintenance, And Management.
Take And Communicate Guest Messages Accurately.


F. Cash Billing Support
Handle Guest Payments And Basic Billing Procedures As Assigned.
Maintain Proper Records Of Cash And Transactions.
Coordinate With The Accounts Department Regarding Billing Or Payment-related Matters.
Follow Hotel Procedures For Cash Handling And Financial Documentation.


G. Front Office Administration
Maintain Guest Records And Registration Documents.
Maintain Accurate Shift Handover Records.
Prepare Daily Front-office Reports As Required.
Maintain Confidentiality Of Guest And Hotel Information.
Follow All Hotel Policies, SOPs, And Security Procedures.


Required Skills
Excellent Communication And Interpersonal Skills.
Good English And Hindi Communication Skills.
Pleasant Personality And Professional Appearance.
Good Customer-service And Problem-solving Skills.
Ability To Handle Guests Calmly And Professionally.
Basic Computer And MS Office Knowledge.
Knowledge Of Hotel PMS/software Will Be An Advantage.
Good Telephone Etiquette.
Ability To Work Effectively In A Team.


Qualification Experience
Qualification: 10+2 / Graduate / Diploma In Hotel Management, Hospitality, Tourism, Or A Related Field.
Experience: 0-3 Years Of Experience In Hotel, Resort, Hospitality, Front Office, Or Customer Service.
Freshers With Good Communication Skills And A Positive Attitude May Also Be Considered.


Personal Attributes
Well-groomed And Professional.
Polite, Friendly, And Customer-oriented.
Punctual And Disciplined.
Honest And Responsible.
Positive Attitude.
Able To Work Under Pressure.
Strong Attention To Detail.
Willingness To Learn And Improve.


Working Requirements
Willingness To Work In Rotational Shifts.
Willingness To Work On Weekends And Public Holidays As Per Hotel Requirements.
Maintain Proper Uniform And Grooming Standards.
Follow Hotel Attendance, Leave, Safety, Security, And Operational Policies.
Perform Additional Front-office Duties Assigned By Management.


Key Performance Indicators (KPI)
Guest Satisfaction And Feedback.
Accuracy Of Check-in/check-out Procedures.

Role & responsibilities
New Product Development & Introduction: Lead Packaging projects & trials at Factory level with focus on line performance, cost efficiency on time delivery and product quality. Provide packaging input within the AGs proposing and evaluating best packaging alternatives for new products and improvements to existing products. Organise and document factory trials including machinability, shelf-life, storage handling, laboratory and transport tests for validation of new packaging and changes in specifications.
Nestle Continuous Excellence: Conduct value analysis; identify and recommend cost improvements and source reduction opportunities. Initiate (or participate in) DMAIC exercises. Guardian of packaging quality going out of the factory lines.

People & Know How: Ensure development of competencies of packaging assistants & disseminate packaging best practices and knowledge at the shop floor (e.g. "One Point Lessons"). Source & utilise training materials available within the Group (or develop training materials as appropriate) Packaging Material and Packaging Lines Efficiency in line with the goals of NCE Zero waste, Zero loss: Accountable for efficiency in Packaging Lines and Materials usage. Support to Procurement on local & zone level. Consumer Complaints: Analyze consumer complaints related to packaging, propose & implement corrective actions.

Academic Experience:

Problem solving approach.
Project management.
Supplier & converter auditing.

Knowledge
1. Nestl Corporate Business and Nestl Management & Leadership Principles, Nestl on the Move, Nestl Leadership Framework.

2. Competent in Packaging Safety, Quality and Compliance.

3. Basic knowledge in production planning.

4. Aware of customer and consumer understanding.

5. Aware of relevant technology platforms, people management tools & practices in the Nestle context.

6. Good understanding of NPDI process.

7. Good understanding of NCE methodologies in particular TPM & LEAN.

Job Introduction:
Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems & Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting & MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency & Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Description:
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurantslearning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot  issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales
AboutCompany: Swiggy is an Indian online food ordering and delivery company. Founded in 2014, Swiggy is headquartered in Bangalore and operates in more than 580 Indian cities, as of July 2023.[4] Besides food delivery, the platform also provides quick commerce services under the name Swiggy Instamart, and same-day package deliveries with Swiggy Genie.

Description:
1. Preparation and review of the manufacturing and packaging Technical Direction.
2. Preparation of SOPs pertaining to In-Process QA.
3. Line Clearance during all critical process during Dispensing, Manufacturing, Filling & Stoppering and Packing operation.
4. Verify the dispensing of RAW Material and Packing Material.
5. In Process checking during dispensing , manufacturing, filling lyophillization, sealing, optical inspection, labeling and packing operation.
6. Sampling of process Validation Batches.
7. Sampling of In - Process and finished products and validation activities.
8. Collection of swab and rinse sampling after cleaning of equipment's and area.
9. Collection, Storage, Handling, Inspection and destruction of reserve samples.
10. Review Executed Exhibit and commercial Batch Manufacturing Records and packaging Record for release of finished Product.
11. To Monitor and verify any qualification of the process, equipment and system.
12. To Perform role of QA oversight and observe the compliance to SOP and aseptic behavior and indentify the deficiencies, if found any.
13. To Excute the Aseptic Core Monitoring during batch processing activity.
14. To participate in Media fill activities and ensure the review and compliance of the activity as per the Batch Records and protocols.
15. Preparation of PQR data for the product manufactured in year on rolling basis.
16. Collection and evaluation of Batch process parameters(CPP), Quality attributes from batch record and analytical record.
17. To review the Non Viable trends of Production Area.
18. To Perform any other works as and when assigned by HOD.

As a professionally trained Lady Security Guard for G4S, you could be a member of the security team responsible for securing premises, such as building sites, courts, shops, warehouses, banks and factories. Description:
JOB SUMMARY:
Responsible for achieving the targets for Annuity Business through NPS, Superannuation & open market (PSU clients) in the assigned region. Responsible for providing assistance in executing the business plan
Assist in launching Annuity Business in the Region
Presenting products to the targeted audience
Update the Sales process and maintain the database as suggested by Retirement Solutions (Government Annuity) department
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Responsible for implementing the sales plan of the assigned region
- Responsible for achieving sales targets from assigned Region/PSU-Clients
- Assist in launching & driving Government Annuity Business
- Assist PSU clients in evaluating their needs to help select the best solution
- Prepare periodic sales reports
Maintain database on Govt./ PSUs and competitor information
- Update the client s/ call reports accurately and efficiently and any competitor s information as suggested by Goverment Annuity team
Continuously evaluate potential of Annuity Business in the region
- Develop specific analysis parameters
- Conduct analysis on the potential groups/PSUs and prepare reports for the Business Head
- Collect competitor information on the Government Annuity Business
Adhere to all Organization s policies and procedures
Measures of Success:
- Actual sales achieved vs the plan
- Accuracy and timeliness of sales reports
- Actual activity vs targeted activity
- Accuracy of competitor information; up to date data
KEY RELATIONSHIPS:
Internal:
- Business Heads
- MLI HR & Sales Training Team
- MLI Operations Team
External:
- Top Clients
- All Stakeholders
DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE:
Graduate/Master of Business Administration preferably in Sales, Marketing or Finance
1-2 years of experience in Life Insurance
