Description:
Job Summary
Ortho Max Mfg Co. Pvt. Ltd. is seeking a dynamic and result-oriented Sales Manager Domestic to drive sales growth across Punjab, Rajasthan, and Himachal Pradesh. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in the medical devices or orthopaedic implant industry and will be responsible for developing business opportunities, strengthening customer relationships, and achieving regional sales targets across the assigned territories.
Responsibilities
Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve or exceed regional sales targets.
Identify new business opportunities and expand existing customer relationships across Punjab, Rajasthan, and Himachal Pradesh.
Conduct market research to stay updated on industry trends, competitor activities, and customer requirements.
Build strong relationships with key decision-makers in hospitals, clinics, trauma centres, and healthcare institutions.
Schedule product demonstrations, surgeon meetings, training sessions, and provide technical support as required.
Address customer complaints or issues promptly and professionally to ensure customer satisfaction.
Analyse market dynamics to identify potential growth opportunities within the assigned territories.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Marketing, Product Development, and Operations, to align sales strategies with company objectives.
Consistently achieve and exceed assigned sales targets.
Track sales performance, prepare periodic reports, and identify areas for improvement.
Develop and implement strategies to increase market share throughout the assigned region.
Ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory and company requirements related to sales activities.
Drive customer satisfaction and build long-term business relationships.
Manage distributor and dealer networks within the assigned territories, where applicable.
Experience & Qualifications
Bachelor s Degree in Engineering, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related field.
3 4 years of proven sales experience in the Medical Devices or Orthopaedic Implant industry (preferred).
Strong understanding of the healthcare industry, particularly Orthopaedics and Trauma Care.
Demonstrated track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.
Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
Proficiency in Hindi is essential. Knowledge of Punjabi is preferred. Familiarity with regional languages is an added advantage.
Willingness to travel extensively across Punjab, Rajasthan, and Himachal Pradesh.
Strong leadership, planning, and territory management capabilities.
Role Details
AboutCompany:
Ortho Max Manufacturing Company Pvt. Ltd. specializes in the design and production of orthopedic implants and surgical instruments. Their portfolio includes solutions for orthopedics, neurosurgery, veterinary applications, and cranio-maxillofacial procedures. The company emphasizes innovation, precision engineering, and global market outreach.

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Travel Technology
Operations Specialist
The opportunity
The Travel Technology Operations Specialist supports technology and AI initiatives across the Travel, Meetings & Events (TME) portfolio. Acting as the operational representative and communication bridge between Enterprise Technology (ET), business subject matter experts (SMEs) and delivery teams, the role ensures operational realities, business impacts and market-specific considerations are understood throughout the solution lifecycle.
Working across ET, project teams, local Travel Managers and operational stakeholders, the role translates operational expertise into clear, actionable input for technology teams and communicates solution direction, impacts and decisions back to SMEs. This two-way coordination helps ensure travel technology and AI solutions are practical, well-informed, supportable and fit for purpose once live.
Key responsibilities Operational representation
Provide operational insight and business context throughout Travel Technology and AI solution delivery.
Help delivery teams understand travel processes, market variations, user impacts and support considerations.
Coordinate the collection, organisation and validation of operational content from SMEs to support knowledge bases used by AI-enabled travel solutions.
Identify operational risks, dependencies and practical constraints, and raise them with the project team.
Stakeholder and SME coordination
Act as the primary communication bridge between ET, delivery teams and business and operational SMEs.
Identify and engage the appropriate SMEs, coordinating their participation in workshops, walkthroughs and validation activities.
Translate operational knowledge into clear, structured input for technology teams and communicate technical direction, decisions and impacts back to SMEs in accessible business language.
Engage traveler user groups early to validate strategy and proposed deliverables, gathering feedback to inform decision-making, prioritization and delivery planning.
Maintain clear information flows, decisions and follow-ups so ET and project teams can access the operational expertise needed to inform their work.
Operational review and validation
Review proposed solutions from an operational perspective, including process impacts, market considerations and support implications.
Provide clear operational feedback and recommendations without owning requirements, functional design or technical decisions.
Confirm that key operational assumptions are practical and scalable.
Deployment and stabilisation support
Support deployment readiness by confirming that operational impacts have been identified and relevant stakeholders engaged.
Provide local Travel Managers with the operational input needed to support market communications and engagement.
Gather post-go-live feedback, provide business context for issue assessment and identify improvement opportunities.
Scope
In scope: Travel-specific TME tools and automations, non-Concur travel integrations, AI-enabled travel solutions owned by TME Innovation, coordination of operational content for AI knowledge bases, and related travel ecosystem technology.
Out of scope: Concur ownership or support; business analysis; requirements or functional documentation; process or solution design ownership; technical architecture; project budgets, timelines or governance; formal ownership of communications, training or change management; and technical ownership of AI platforms or knowledge-base architecture.
Skills and experience
Experience in corporate travel, travel operations, business operations or a technology-enabled service environment.
Strong communication, stakeholder management, coordination and relationship-building skills, with the ability to bridge technical and operational audiences.
Ability to understand complex operational processes and translate risks, impacts and business knowledge into clear, structured information.
Experience working across functions, markets and cultures in a global environment.
Practical problem-solving skills and the confidence to challenge assumptions constructively.
Experience supporting technology implementation, operational change, knowledge management or continuous improvement is desirable.
Knowledge of corporate travel technology, AI-enabled solutions, Travel Management Companies or the wider supplier ecosystem is desirable.
What success looks like
ET, delivery teams and the right operational stakeholders and SMEs are connected at the right time, with clear two-way communication.
Operational risks, impacts and market considerations are identified early, translated appropriately and communicated clearly.
Operational knowledge is collected, validated and organized to support accurate, maintainable knowledge bases for AI-enabled solutions.
Solutions are practical, supportable and aligned to operational needs.
Local Travel Managers receive accurate operational input to support market engagement.
Post-go-live feedback and lessons learned inform future improvements.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Job Summary
Discipline: GDS Enablement Services Growth & Innovation
Role title: Quantum Senior Associate
The Quantum Senior Associate will play a hands-on delivery role across Quantum Technology initiatives, with stronger ownership for solution design, technical execution, stakeholder communication and delivery quality than an Associate role. The role requires practical experience in quantum-safe security and/or quantum computing, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business and delivery outcomes.
The role is expected to have a primary focus on quantum safety, including post-quantum cryptography readiness, and a secondary focus on quantum computing use cases such as optimization, machine learning and simulation.
Responsibilities
Support the development of quantum safety and quantum computing solutions, prototypes and demonstrations.
Contribute to post-quantum cryptography readiness assessments, including data gathering, analysis and documentation.
Develop and evaluate quantum algorithms and workflows for selected optimization, machine learning and simulation use cases.
Build and maintain software tools, accelerators and proof-of-concept assets using established engineering practices.
Prepare technical documentation, assessment reports and presentation materials for internal and external stakeholders.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including cybersecurity, AI/ML, platform engineering and product teams.
Participate in testing, validation and benchmarking activities to assess solution performance and applicability.
Stay current on developments in quantum computing, post-quantum cryptography and related emerging technologies.
Quantum Specialist Responsibilities
Quantum Cyber / Safety:
Support quantum risk assessments and identify areas that may require future cryptographic modernization.
Assist in prototyping and benchmarking post-quantum cryptography algorithms within applications and services.
Contribute to analysis of quantum-safe and hybrid cryptographic approaches and document findings.
Support development of crypto-inventory and discovery capabilities to identify legacy cryptography dependencies.
Execute testing of hybrid key exchange mechanisms and document performance observations.
Assist with implementation and validation of crypto-agility patterns, certificate updates and key management enhancements.
Contribute to creation and maintenance of migration guides, standards documentation and operational runbooks.
Quantum Compute & Algorithms:
Develop and evaluate quantum algorithms using industry-standard quantum development platforms.
Support experimentation and testing to assess the practicality of quantum use cases.
Build proof-of-concept solutions for optimization, simulation and emerging Quantum + AI use cases.
Perform basic resource estimation and analysis of quantum circuits and algorithm performance.
Compare classical and quantum approaches and document observations and recommendations.
Maintain reproducible experimentation environments using Python, Jupyter notebooks, containers and source control tools.
Knowledge and Skills Requirements
Foundational understanding of quantum computing concepts, including qubits, gates, quantum circuits and current hardware limitations.
Basic understanding of post-quantum cryptography concepts, key encapsulation mechanisms, digital signatures and emerging standards.
Familiarity with cryptographic concepts such as public-key cryptography, certificates and secure communication protocols.
Experience with at least one quantum development platform such as Qiskit, PennyLane, Cirq, Azure Quantum or AWS Braket.
Proficiency in Python programming and familiarity with commonly used scientific and data analysis libraries.
Working knowledge of software development fundamentals, including version control and testing practices.
Ability to design and execute experiments, analyse results and communicate findings effectively.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Effective written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work collaboratively in global, cross-functional teams.
Interest in emerging technologies and willingness to continuously learn new concepts and tools.
Education and Experience
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Cybersecurity, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
25+ years of relevant experience in one or more of the following areas:
Software development or engineering
Applied cryptography or cybersecurity
Data science, machine learning or advanced analytics
Quantum computing research or development
High-performance or scientific computing
Experience developing prototypes, proof-of-concepts or technical solutions using modern programming languages and frameworks.
Familiarity with Python and scientific computing libraries such as NumPy, SciPy, pandas or similar tools.
Exposure to quantum computing concepts, quantum software development kits or post-quantum cryptography is preferred but not mandatory.
Understanding of cybersecurity and cryptography fundamentals is desirable.
Experience working in agile, research or innovation-focused environments is advantageous.
Ability to independently complete assigned deliverables while collaborating effectively with senior team members.
Publications, hackathons, certifications, research projects or open-source contributions related to quantum technologies are beneficial but not required.
Willingness to work with global teams and support overlap with US East Coast hours when needed.

Job Title - Solution Architect - AI - Manager - ACS SONG
Management Level:Level 7 -Manager
Location:Kochi, Coimbatore, Trivandrum, Bangalore
Must have skills:Generative AI,Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, or Agentic AI, , Large Language Models (LLMs)

Good to have skills:Model Context Protocol (MCP)/ Agent2Agent (A2A)
Experience:10 - 15 years of experience is required

Educational Qualification:B.Tech/BE/M.Tech/MCA
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect - AI with 10+ years of overall technology experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on experience designing and architecting AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in enterprise solution architecture and experience designing scalable, secure, resilient, and production-ready AI solutions on at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
The role will be responsible for defining end-to-end AI solution architectures covering application, data, AI/ML, integration, security, infrastructure, and operational components. The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, data teams, AI engineers, software engineers, security teams, and cloud platform teams to translate business requirements into practical and scalable technology solutions.
The candidate should have strong knowledge of modern AI architecture patterns including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, AI agents, vector databases, knowledge retrieval, API/tool integration, model orchestration, observability, security, and responsible AI. Experience in taking AI solutions from initial discovery and proof-of-concept through production deployment and operationalization is essential.


Roles and Responsibilities
Design end-to-end AI and Generative AI solution architectures that address business requirements while meeting enterprise standards for scalability, security, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
Define appropriate architecture patterns for Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, Machine Learning, intelligent automation, conversational AI, and AI-enabled enterprise applications.
Provide architectural leadership across the complete solution lifecycle, from discovery, feasibility assessment, architecture definition, prototyping, implementation, production deployment, and post-production operations.
Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate AI use cases, identify suitable technologies, assess technical feasibility, and define implementation roadmaps.
Lead the architecture and solution design of enterprise AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Agentic AI solutions across cloud and hybrid environments.
Translate business requirements, functional requirements, and non-functional requirements into scalable and secure solution architecture designs, architecture diagrams, integration patterns, and technical specifications.
Design AI solutions using services and technologies available on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including managed AI/ML, data, integration, compute, security, and observability services.
Define architectures for LLM-based applications, including prompt orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings, model routing, grounding, knowledge bases, AI agents, tool/function calling, and multi-agent architectures.
Design enterprise integration patterns connecting AI solutions with APIs, databases, data platforms, SaaS applications, enterprise applications, event-driven systems, and external services.
Evaluate and recommend appropriate foundation models, LLMs, embedding models, AI platforms, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and supporting technologies based on business, technical, security, cost, and performance requirements.
Define architecture approaches for AI security, identity and access management, data privacy, guardrails, content filtering, responsible AI, model governance, and regulatory compliance.
Establish architectural standards for AI observability, monitoring, tracing, logging, evaluation, performance management, reliability, and operational support.
Work closely with AI engineers, data scientists, data engineers, application developers, DevOps/MLOps teams, cloud engineers, and security teams to guide implementation and ensure alignment with the target architecture.
Lead architecture reviews, technical design workshops, proof-of-concepts, technology assessments, and design governance activities while communicating complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and business stakeholders.
Ability to conduct AI use-case discovery, technical feasibility assessments, architecture assessments, technology evaluations, and solution option analysis.
Ability to create and communicate high-level architecture, detailed solution architecture, sequence diagrams, data flows, integration diagrams, deployment architectures, and architecture decision records.
Ability to design appropriate AI guardrails addressing areas such as hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, harmful content, unauthorized tool execution, and inappropriate model responses.
Ability to define reference architectures, reusable architecture patterns, technical standards, and architecture governance frameworks for AI solutions.


Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills
10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, application architecture, cloud architecture, data architecture, solution architecture, or related technology roles.
Minimum 3 years of experience designing or implementing AI-based solutions, including Generative AI, Machine Learning, Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, or Agentic AI.
Demonstrated experience working as a Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Cloud Architect, AI Architect, or equivalent senior architecture role.
Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale, production-grade solutions involving multiple applications, platforms, integrations, and data sources.
Hands-on architecture experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, document retrieval, and enterprise knowledge bases.
Strong hands-on architecture experience with at least one major cloud platform:
AWS - for example Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker,
Microsoft Azure - for example Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search,
Google Cloud Platform (GCP) - for example Vertex AI, Gemini, BigQuery
Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture patterns, including microservices, APIs, serverless architectures, containers, event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and distributed systems.
Strong understanding of REST APIs, API gateways, authentication and authorization, OAuth/OIDC, networking, secrets management, encryption, and enterprise security architecture.
Strong understanding of enterprise data architectures including data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouses, relational databases, NoSQL databases, vector databases, and streaming platforms.
Strong understanding of enterprise security architecture including Identity and Access Management, Role-Based Access Control, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, and secure API design.
Strong ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, scalability, security, maintainability, complexity, and time to market.
Experience integrating AI applications with enterprise data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, Microsoft Fabric, or equivalent technologies.
Experience designing integrations between AI solutions and enterprise systems using APIs, messaging platforms, event buses, queues, workflow engines, and integration platforms.
Experience designing highly available, scalable, fault-tolerant, secure, and cost-effective enterprise solutions.
Experience taking technology solutions through multiple lifecycle stages including discovery, architecture, proof-of-concept, implementation, deployment, and production support.
Experience with prompt engineering, context management, grounding techniques, model selection, model evaluation, hallucination mitigation, and AI guardrails.
Experience defining deployment strategies for AI applications across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
Experience working with enterprise security, risk, compliance, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions meet organizational and regulatory requirements.
Experience estimating solution complexity, cloud infrastructure requirements, implementation effort, technical dependencies, and architecture risks.
Understanding of common AI orchestration and development frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, DSPy, or equivalent technologies.
Understanding of AI production monitoring including model/application performance, latency, token consumption, cost, prompt and response tracing, model failures, retrieval quality, and system availability.
Understanding of Agentic AI concepts, including AI agents, planning and reasoning workflows, tool/function calling, agent orchestration, workflow automation, and multi-agent systems.
Understanding of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, DevOps, MLOps, LLMOps, containerization, Kubernetes, and automated deployment practices.
Understanding of data ingestion, ETL/ELT, data pipelines, data quality, metadata management, data governance, and data security concepts.
Knowledge of Responsible AI principles, AI governance, model risk management, data privacy, prompt security, content moderation, explainability, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Knowledge of emerging AI interoperability patterns and protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication is desirable. Any experience with UCP is also a plus.
Familiarity with observability platforms and technologies such as OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, Datadog, Grafana, or equivalent tools.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage effectively with business leaders, product owners, enterprise architects, engineering teams, security teams, and senior management.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex AI and architecture concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate multiple technical approaches and clearly articulate architectural trade-offs.
Ability to provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to cross-functional engineering teams without necessarily being responsible for direct people management.
Strong consulting mindset with the ability to understand business problems, challenge assumptions, identify technical risks, and recommend pragmatic solutions.
Ability to work across multiple projects and technology domains while maintaining consistency with enterprise architecture principles and standards.

Additional Information
Relevant cloud architecture certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified:Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or equivalent certifications.
AI/ML or Generative AI certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Google, Databricks, NVIDIA, or other recognized technology providers are advantageous.
Experience working in large enterprise environments, consulting organizations, or complex multi-cloud transformation programs.
Experience defining or contributing to organizational AI architecture standards, Generative AI platforms, AI Centers of Excellence, or enterprise AI governance frameworks would be advantageous.

POSITION SUMMARY
Complete closing duties, including storing all reusable goods, breaking down goods, cleaning all equipment and areas, returning equipment to proper locations, locking refrigerators, restocking items, turning off lights, locking doors, and completing daily cleaning checklist. Set up, stock, and maintain work areas. Inspect the cleanliness and presentation of all china, glass, and silver prior to use. Maintain cleanliness of work areas throughout the day, practicing clean-as-you-go procedures.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards. Speak with others using clear and professional language, and answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

INNOV8 | Area Sales Manager Job
Description
About INNOV8
INNOV8 is one of Indias leading coworking and managed office space brands, creating
beautifully designed, premium workspaces that enable people and companies to work,
collaborate, and grow together. With a growing presence across major Indian cities, INNOV8
serves a diverse ecosystem of entrepreneurs, freelancers, startups, and enterprises by offering
flexible workspace solutions tailored to different stages of growth.
Position: Area Sales Manager INNOV8
Reports To: City Head
Employment Type: Full-time
Role Overview
The Area Sales Manager will be responsible for driving revenue growth, occupancy, and
market penetration for INNOV8 centers in the assigned region. The role combines new
business acquisition, account management, and channel development, with a strong focus on
building long-term client and broker relationships.
You will work closely with center teams, marketing, and leadership to ensure sustained seat
sales, timely collections, and best-in-class client experience.
Key Responsibilities
1. Business Development & Growth
• Develop and implement a growth strategy for the region focused on financial gain,
occupancy improvement, and customer satisfaction.
• Identify, build, and expand new markets across relevant customer segments (startups,
SMEs, enterprises, freelancers).



• Generate a strong pipeline of prospects through cold outreach, referrals, ecosystem
connects, and channel partners.
2. Sales, Revenue & Collections
• Achieve monthly and quarterly seat sales and revenue targets for assigned centers.
• Prepare and present formal proposals, quotes, and commercial offers to prospects.
• Negotiate and close deals with key decision-makers, ensuring mutually beneficial
terms.
• Drive monthly collections based on invoices raised; ensure minimal delays and
revenue leakage.
3. Client Relationship Management & Retention
• Build long-term relationships with new and existing customers to drive repeat and
expansion business.
• Regularly engage with clients to understand their evolving needs and identify
upsell/cross-sell opportunities.
• Focus on renewal, expansion, and churn control for key accounts in the region.
• Ensure timely resolution of client complaints within defined TAT and proactively
address service gaps.
4. Channel & Lead Generation Strategy
• Devise and execute strategies for lead generation through:
o Brokers, channel partners, and IPCs
o Online and direct channels
o Startup and ecosystem collaborations

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

We are looking for Executive Assistant who would be required to work in a team environment in delivering the secretarial needs of the global EY office senior management team such as diary management, calendar management, travel management, documentation, tool support and other administrative requirements that may arise on a need basis.
Role Details
Discipline: Executive Assistance CoE
Role Type: Assigned Support / Associate
Responsibilities
The primary role and responsibility of this position will be to work in a team environment and deliver administrative services including, but not limited to
Diary Management - Provide support to the project team members on maintaining and managing key project meetings and the meeting location
Calendar Management - Maintaining project teams calendar to showcase all key events that needs to be planned.

Travel Management - Support the project team members in booking the travel tickets

Administration and organization
Enjoys problem solving
Able to prioritize effectively
Strong project coordination skills
Comfortable using IT systems
Interpersonal skills
Excellent written and oral communication skills
A strong team player who is comfortable working collaboratively with others
Must be able to work virtually, and independently
Able to be diplomatic when dealing with clients
Flexibility

Comfortable working on several activities concurrently

Key attributes
Professional and diplomatic communicator
Quality focused and takes pride in paying attention to detail
Self-starter, who can manage with minimal direction
Able to interact with senior management
Extremely organized and enjoys administration
Able to work in a team arrangement
Demonstrated experience

Qualifications
To qualify for the role, you must have Any graduate or Postgraduate
Ideally, you'll also have
1 to 4 Years
At least a year of experience working in a team environment handling virtual secretarial services is preferred
Good command over English (written & spoken) is mandatory

EYP Staff EYP Financial Restructuring Job Description
Support financial restructuring and turnaround advisory business development activities under the guidance of senior team members. Assist with proposal development support including:
Financial analysis of companies - reviews of historical and forecast performance, profitability, cash flows, working capital and capital structure
Support the team in understanding clients businesses, key financial trends, profitdrivers and potential areas of risk or improvement
Conduct desktop market and industry research, gather relevant data and summarize findings into meaningful insights
Assist with benchmarking analyses, including capital and debt mix, working capital levers, revenue trends and product performance
Prepare clear and well-structured Excel analysis, PowerPoint presentations and supporting reports for business development requirements.
Assist in preparing materials for client discussions, internal reviews and pursuit meetings.
Document the analysis and procedures performed, ensuring that work products are accurate, organized and aligned with project objectives.
Coordinate with team members across different service lines and locations to support data collection and timely project delivery.
Contribute ideas, ask relevant questions and work collaboratively with colleagues in a multicultural and multidisciplinary environment.
Demonstrate attention to detail, adaptability and a willingness to learn while managing assigned responsibilities and deadlines.
This internship provides hands-on exposure to financial restructuring, turnaround, capital advisory and transaction-related projects, supported by structured learning and coaching.
Candidate Profile
Ideal for candidates looking to start their career in finance
Strong academic foundation in finance, accounting and financial statement analysis.
Basic understanding of corporate finance concepts such as cash flow, working capital, debt, capital structure and business performance.
Strong numerical, analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and draw logical conclusions.
Good desktop research skills and the ability to identify, organize and summarize relevant market and company information.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with an interest in developing financial analysis and presentation skills.
Knowledge of how to leverage AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot in a business setting would be an added advantage.
Ability to communicate clearly and professionally, both verbally and in writing.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to produce accurate, well-structured work.
Proactive, curious and willing to learn new concepts, industries and analytical approaches.
Able to work effectively both independently on assigned tasks and collaboratively as part of a project team.
Comfortable working across multiple tasks and adapting to changing project requirements and deadlines.
Prior internship, academic project or coursework in corporate finance, banking, restructuring, transactions or consulting would be an advantage but is not mandatory.
Familiarity with the MENA business environment, banking products or Islamic Finance would be an added advantage.
Fluency in English is required, while knowledge of Arabic would be an added advantage.

Job Summary
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.


EY- Assurance Senior
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.


The opportunity
We're looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.


Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement teams work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for ones team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on ones own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across ones aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead ones GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.


Skills and attributes for success
Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.


To qualify for the role, you must have
Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.


Ideally, you'll also have
Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.


What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

Description:
Job Summary
The Regional Contracts & Supplier Governance Assistant Manager serves as a key enabler of effective contract management, supplier governance, and procurement compliance across the UK&I business. This role is responsible for managing the end-to-end contract lifecycle, supporting supplier onboarding and governance activities, and ensuring adherence to contractual, regulatory, and risk management requirements.
Acting as a central point of coordination between business stakeholders, Procurement, Risk, Finance, and suppliers, the Assistant Manager drives operational excellence through robust governance, process optimization, reporting, and continuous improvement. The role ensures that third-party engagements are managed efficiently, risks are mitigated, and supplier relationships deliver sustainable value and strategic business outcomes.
Your key responsibilities
Manage contract and supplier governance mailboxes, providing guidance and coordinating contract requests through to execution.
Draft, review, negotiate, and administer supplier contracts while ensuring compliance with procurement and governance requirements.
Oversee contract execution processes, including approvals, DocuSign workflows, and maintenance of executed agreements.
Maintain contract repositories, lifecycle trackers, renewals, and audit-ready documentation.
Support supplier onboarding, vendor enablement, and supplier due diligence activities.
Manage supplier governance programs, MSA renewals, performance reviews, and compliance obligations.
Ensure adherence to risk, compliance, and third-party governance frameworks, escalating issues where required.
Support procurement and sourcing activities, including supplier evaluations and governance approvals.
Prepare management reports, dashboards, and analytics on contracts, suppliers, compliance, and performance metrics.
Coordinate audit reviews, remediation activities, invoice governance, and payment-related issue resolution.
Drive process improvements, automation initiatives, stakeholder training, and continuous enhancement of contract management practices.
Ariba supply chain management life cycle
Skills and attributes for success
Demonstrates expertise in leveraging advanced analytics platforms and visualization tools (such as Power BI, ThoughtSpot, or similar) to transform raw data into actionable insights.
Skilled in designing interactive dashboards, reports, and visual narratives that enable stakeholders to quickly interpret trends, patterns, and performance metrics.
Presentation and facilitation skills - Ability to drive meetings, build presentations that interpret the data, creating valuable business insights and delivering the message to the stakeholders
Work under minimal direction/supervision - Be accountable for projects assigned, take complete ownership and drive projects end to end
Business acumen and Adaptability Capable of quickly understanding the needs of the business and be able to align with changing customer expectations
Quick learner - Ability to grasp or quickly understand the process, objectives / intricacies of projects and move to delivery mode in a short span
Attention to detail - Utmost importance to numbers, formatting etc.
Excellent Communication - Listening, reading, writing & speaking skills
MS Office skills: Advanced level experience in Excel reporting & PowerPoint.
Power BI/Other BI tools/ Alteryx - Data Integration and Data Visualization etc.
High degree of professionalism and integrity
To qualify for the role, you must have
Graduate / Post-graduate - (Business Administration, Information and Data Science) with 6 - 8 years work experience in professional services industry.
Strong understanding of data analytics, best practices when developing solutions and experience in solution development, specifically utilizing Microsoft Power Platform.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
Ideally, youll also have
The role demands expertise in Power BI and related Microsoft Power Platform tools, including PowerApps and Power Automate, to design, develop, and maintain robust data solutions. A strong work ethic, meticulous attention to detail, and a commitment to accuracy and timeliness are essential to ensure high-quality deliverables.
What we look for
Self-motivated towards continuous learning and upskilling.
Solution oriented - Ability to focus on solutions in case of ambiguity /uncertainties and not stuck with the problem.
Display a positive attitude, interest in learning new things, capability to work under pressure and thinking out of the box with strategic mindset.
Content management Familiar with maintenance of SharePoint, MS office (Excel and PowerPoint proficiency is a must)

Description:
Job Summary
In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology we are looking for a skilled Infrastructure Data Analyst to support and evolve EY's I&O data analytics and reporting capabilities globally. This is a unique role that bridges deep data analysis with practical infrastructure knowledge, enabling the firm to transform operational data from across its data center, compute, network, storage and observability platforms into actionable intelligence.
A key focus of this role is providing the analytical intelligence layer for the Hyperconverged Service Platform (HCSP) EY's next-generation infrastructure automation platform built on Kubernetes, Temporal and Terraform. The Data Analyst will own the measurement, reporting and continuous improvement analysis of HCSP's provisioning performance, workflow reliability, SLA attainment, drift detection efficacy and operational impact across EY's global data center estate directly enabling the platform team to measure success, identify failure patterns and demonstrate value.
Your key responsibilities
The I&O Platform Infrastructure Data Analyst collects, processes and analyzes operational data from across EY's infrastructure platforms with a particular focus on HCSP platform telemetry transforming raw data from workflow orchestration systems, provisioning engines, log aggregation platforms, ITSM tools and capacity management systems into meaningful insights and visualizations.
The role requires a strong analytical skill set combined with sufficient infrastructure and platform automation awareness to understand the context of the data being analyzed. The analyst will serve as the analytical authority for HCSP KPI reporting tracking metrics such as provisioning SLA attainment, orchestrator failure rates, manual touchpoint reduction, rollback success rates and catalog drift elimination and will partner with the HCSP engineering team, I&O leadership and service management to drive a data-informed culture of continuous platform improvement.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong experience designing and delivering data analytics solutions using Power BI, including complex DAX measures, data models and report publishing.
Proficiency querying and analyzing data from ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) including KQL query development and Kibana dashboard creation.
Experience working with large, multi-source operational datasets and transforming them into executive and operational reporting.
Ability to analyze and report on platform automation data, including:
Workflow execution metrics
OPA policy evaluation outcomes and policy compliance trends
Drift detection signals
ServiceNow order intake volumes, ticket correlation
Good understanding of data center infrastructure technologies including:
Windows Server and Linux operating system fundamentals
Virtualization platforms Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware
Kubernetes cluster concepts pods, namespaces, workloads and resource utilization
Network fundamentals VLANs, DNS, IP management
Storage and compute provisioning concepts
Experience with SQL or KQL for querying structured and semi-structured data sources.
Experience integrating data from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow or equivalent) into analytical reporting.
Familiarity with APM and monitoring tooling (Dynatrace, SolarWinds, Prometheus or equivalent) as data sources.
Experience with ETL/ELT pipelines and data ingestion from multiple infrastructure and platform data sources.
Scripting capability to automate data extraction and transformation tasks:
Python (pandas, NumPy, requests)
PowerShell
Bash
Strong written and verbal communication skills able to present HCSP performance findings and SLA trend analysis to both technical and senior business audiences.
Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks.
Ability to work effectively with global engineering and service management teams across multiple time zones.
To qualify for the role, you must have experience with
Power BI report and dashboard development 57 years.
Power BI data modelling, DAX development and Power Query (M) transformations 57 years.
ELK stack data analysis Elasticsearch queries and Kibana dashboard development 35 years.
SQL data analysis and querying against operational data stores 57 years.
KPI definition, metric design and SLA/OLA reporting for platform or infrastructure services.
Data integration from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, Remedy or equivalent).
Working with infrastructure and platform automation monitoring data metrics, logs, workflow events and traces.
Building capacity planning and trend analysis reports for infrastructure and automation platforms.
Kubernetes and container platform telemetry consumption and analysis.
Workflow orchestration data analysis Temporal, Argo or equivalent execution logs and metrics.
OPA policy evaluation data analysis and compliance reporting.
Drift detection and configuration audit data analysis.
Windows Server and Linux operating system concepts sufficient to contextualize infrastructure data.
Virtualization platform familiarity (Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware vSphere or Azure Stack HCI).
Python scripting for data extraction, transformation and automation 35 years.
PowerShell scripting for Windows infrastructure data collection.
Executive reporting and stakeholder presentation delivery.
Azure Monitor, Log Analytics or equivalent cloud observability data sources (preferred).
Working with CMDB data to enrich infrastructure and platform analytics (preferred).
Ideally, you'll also have
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) certification (desired).
Elastic Certified Analyst certification (desired).
Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900) or Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) (better to have).
ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary).
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics or Databricks (better to have).
Experience with Grafana or similar open-source visualization platforms.
Familiarity with OpenTelemetry (OTel) as a telemetry standard for HCSP platform automation data.
Experience analyzing data from Temporal.io workflow execution APIs or audit logs.

Description:
TechOps - CloudOps - AI/ML Platform Operations Engineer: Senior

Job Summary
We are looking for a seasoned and proactive Senior AI/ML Platform Operations Engineer to operate, support, and continuously improve enterprise machine learning and generative AI platforms. The role will focus on MLOps and LLMOps across model deployment, monitoring, API and endpoint operations, model pipelines, prompt and model configuration, observability, and incident resolution. The engineer will act as a technical escalation point for production AI services and work closely with data scientists, ML engineers, application teams, cloud platform teams, security, DevOps, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, secure, scalable, and cost-effective AI capabilities.


Responsibilities
Provide day-to-day production and operational support for machine learning, generative AI, and large language model platforms across development, test, staging, and production environments.
Deploy, configure, validate, and support machine learning models, foundation models, embedding models, rerankers, and associated inference services using controlled MLOps and LLMOps practices.
Monitor real-time and batch inference workloads, APIs, endpoints, model pipelines, queues, scheduled jobs, and dependent services, and restore failed or degraded services within agreed SLAs.
Troubleshoot endpoint errors, latency, throttling, token limits, authentication failures, networking issues, dependency conflicts, model-loading errors, memory constraints, and scaling problems.
Operate model training, evaluation, registration, approval, deployment, rollback, and retirement pipelines with traceability across model and environment versions.
Support prompt templates, system instructions, model parameters, routing rules, guardrails, content filters, retrieval configuration, tool connections, and environment-specific configuration.
Implement and maintain observability for model quality, response latency, throughput, error rate, availability, token consumption, cost, drift, data quality, hallucination risk, safety events, and user feedback.
Investigate production incidents using application, model, prompt, API gateway, orchestration, cloud service, infrastructure, and security logs, and coordinate service recovery.
Perform root cause analysis for recurring incidents and implement corrective actions, preventive alerts, automated recovery, runbook improvements, and platform engineering enhancements.
Develop and maintain Python utilities, automation scripts, health checks, deployment tooling, test harnesses, evaluation workflows, and operational dashboards.
Support enterprise integrations with OpenAI services, Azure OpenAI where applicable, AWS Bedrock, model gateways, vector stores, API gateways, identity providers, secrets management, and monitoring platforms.
Ensure secure handling of model endpoints, API keys, service identities, secrets, private networking, customer data, prompts, responses, and model artifacts.
Support capacity planning, autoscaling, quota management, rate-limit management, GPU or accelerator utilization, token forecasting, and cost optimization for AI workloads.
Coordinate controlled releases using Git and CI/CD, including testing evidence, model and prompt versioning, approvals, deployment validation, rollback planning, and post-release monitoring.
Manage complex incidents, service requests, problems, and changes, and mentor junior engineers in troubleshooting, platform operations, and operational best practices.
Create and maintain runbooks, SOPs, architecture and dependency records, known-error articles, monitoring standards, escalation paths, and support knowledge bases.
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


Skills and attributes for success
Strong hands-on knowledge of MLOps practices covering experiment tracking, model packaging, model registry, validation, promotion, deployment, monitoring, rollback, and lifecycle governance.
Strong understanding of LLMOps, including foundation model access, prompt and configuration management, evaluation, observability, retrieval-augmented generation, guardrails, endpoint operations, and cost controls.
Experience operating model APIs and endpoints, including authentication, authorization, throttling, load management, autoscaling, latency troubleshooting, retries, timeouts, and high availability.
Strong Python skills for platform automation, API integration, log analysis, operational tooling, testing, and incident diagnosis.

Description:
Talent Development Enablement and Operations Specialist - Supervising Associate

Role Purpose
To provide high-quality operational support to the Talent Development team, with an operational focus on learning deployment, CPD compliance, project execution, and data analytics. The role is pivotal in ensuring process excellence, stakeholder engagement, and data-driven decision-making across the Talent Development function. This role will be supporting a team based in a European Time Zone.


Your key Responsibilities

Operational Excellence
Support the deployment of learning and CPD processes, ensuring compliance and a best-in-class user experience
Manage learner enquiries, exemptions, and feedback loops in collaboration with IBM (DAT), SL Quality teams, and other stakeholders
Maintain and improve documentation, FAQs, and process guidance to reflect evolving ways of working.
Manage the BAU activities around internal and external venue sourcing for the Talent Development Team
Document and standardize processes, templates, and SOPs for repeatable excellence


Project Management
Lead and contribute to operational projects aligned with strategic priorities, including vendor coordination and service quality evaluation
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure timely delivery and continuous improvement of learning operations


Data Analysis Reporting
Collect, organise, and interpret large and varied datasets to produce actionable insights
Perform quality assessments and trend analysis to support CPD compliance and business process improvements
Prepare reports for SL Quality teams and ICAEW inspections, including non-compliance cases and contextual factors (e.g. leave, new joiners)
Support governance activities including audit readiness, data integrity checks, and compliance reporting


Financial Budget Support
Assist in financial planning and control activities, summarising key metrics and trends for leadership review
Maintain up-to-date documentation of finance processes and support the Enablement Finance Lead with holistic financial insights


Stakeholder Engagement Relationship Management
Build strong relationships with the international Talent Development stakeholders, IBM (DAT), and global learning operations
Coach and support team members, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture
Act as the day-to-day contact for third-party vendors (e.g. venue sourcing, print providers), ensuring service quality and process alignment
Query management (CPD, venues, contracting)


Skills Competencies
Advanced Excel skills (including formulae and macros); strong PowerPoint and Word proficiency
Excellent English communication and stakeholder management skills
Strong organisational abilities with attention to detail and deadline discipline
Proactive problem-solving and creative thinking to drive service quality and innovation
Commercial acumen and business awareness
Ability to work independently, adapt quickly, and thrive in ambiguous environments
Commitment to acquiring new knowledge and exploring innovative solutions
Experience in coaching, interpersonal engagement, and working across diverse, international teams


Experience Required
Extensive experience in HR operations and learning deployment within professional services or corporate environments
Proven track record in managing operational processes and large datasets
Familiarity with CPD frameworks and compliance reporting
Experience working in global, virtual teams and managing cross-border relationships
Experience of PowerBI or equivalent is a plus

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY-Consulting - Data and Analytics - Senior Manager - Databricks Architect
EYs Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client s decision-making.
The opportunity
Senior Data & AI Architect with 13+ years of experience in data engineering and data architecture, strong hands-on expertise in Databricks, Hadoop, Spark/PySpark, and cloud data platforms.
This role combines deep technical ownership of enterprise Lakehouse and data platform architecture with hands-on experience building Agentic AI and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions on Databricks. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable designing large-scale, production-grade data pipelines, architecting modern AI-driven solutions, and engaging directly with clients on strategic proposals and solution design.
Your key responsibilities
Architect, design, and deliver scalable Data & AI solutions on the Databricks Lakehouse platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, governance, and consumption layers.
Design and optimize large-scale distributed data processing pipelines using Hadoop, Apache Spark, and PySpark.
Build reusable, production-grade Python frameworks and pipelines for batch and streaming data engineering workloads.
Define and implement cloud data architecture on AWS and/or Azure, covering storage, IAM, networking, security, and monitoring, with native Databricks integration.
Own end-to-end ETL/ELT design, data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and data quality frameworks across the platform.
Design dimensional data models (star/snowflake schemas, fact/dimension tables, SCD) to support analytical and reporting use cases.
Design and build Agentic AI solutions on Databricks, including LLM integration, tool/function calling, agent workflows, guardrails, and enterprise data integration.
Architect and implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solutions using Databricks - document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval, grounding, and evaluation.
Establish and enforce engineering best practices for Git-based version control, code reviews, and CI/CD across development, test, and production environments.
Lead performance optimization and production deployment of Databricks jobs, workflows, and pipelines at scale.
Participate in strategic RFP/RFI responses, technical proposals, solution shaping, effort estimation, and architecture presentations.
Act as a trusted technical advisor in customer workshops, translating business requirements into robust technical architectures.
Mentor engineering teams on Databricks, Spark, cloud architecture, and modern AI/RAG engineering practices.
Skills and attributes for success
13+ years of experience in Data Engineering / Data Architecture, with strong hands-on experience across Databricks, Hadoop, Spark/PySpark, and cloud data platforms.
Databricks
Strong expertise in Databricks Lakehouse, Delta Lake, Databricks SQL, and Unity Catalog.
Hands-on experience with Jobs/Workflows, performance optimization, and production deployments.
Hadoop & Spark
Strong knowledge of the Hadoop ecosystem, HDFS, and Hive.
Strong hands-on experience with Apache Spark and PySpark for large-scale distributed data processi
Python
Strong proficiency in Python for building scalable, reusable, production-grade data pipelines and frameworks.
Cloud
Strong experience with AWS and/or Azure, including cloud storage, IAM, networking, security, and monitoring.
Experience integrating Databricks with cloud-native services.
Data Engineering
Expertise in ETL/ELT, batch and streaming processing, data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and data quality.
Proven ability to design scalable, production-ready pipeline architectures.
SQL & Data Modelling
Strong SQL skills, with experience in dimensional modelling, star/snowflake schemas, fact/dimension models, SCD, and analytical data models.
Agentic AI
Hands-on experience designing and building Agentic AI solutions with Databricks, including LLMs, tool/function calling, agent workflows, guardrails, and enterprise data integration.
RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
Strong experience building RAG solutions using Databricks, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval, grounding, and evaluation.
Git & CI/CD
Strong knowledge of Git, branching strategies, pull requests, and code reviews.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment across multiple environments.
Experience with Databricks Asset Bundles and/or Terraform is a plus.
Strategic RFPs & Solutioning
Ability to participate in strategic RFP/RFI responses, solution shaping, technical proposals, and effort estimations.
Experience delivering architecture presentations and leading customer workshops.
Client Communication
Strong client-facing and communication skills, with the ability to understand business requirements, translate them into scalable technical solutions, and clearly communicate architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ideally, you ll also have
Prior experience in a consulting, systems integrator, or client-facing delivery role.
Relevant cloud or Databricks certifications (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer / Solutions Architect, AWS/Azure certifications).
Exposure to enterprise data governance, MLOps, or LLMOps practices.
At EY, we re dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to :
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that s right for you
EY | Building a better working world

TA Scheduler
We re looking for candidates in the Talent Acquisition/Recruitment Coordination domain with 1-3 year of experience. You will be responsible for supporting interview scheduling and recruitment coordination across service lines within EY GDS , ensuring a seamless experience for candidates, recruiters and interview panels.
The opportunity
We re looking for individuals with strong coordination, communication and organizational skills who can support the recruitment team with end-to-end interview scheduling activities. You will partner closely with recruiters, hiring teams, candidates and interview panels to ensure interviews are scheduled efficiently and within agreed timelines.
You will play an important role in creating a positive candidate and stakeholder experience by ensuring timely communication, accurate scheduling and effective follow-up throughout the interview process.
Your key responsibilities
Coordinate and schedule interviews across service lines within EY GDS (India).
Liaise with candidates, recruiters and interview panels to identify suitable interview slots and ensure timely scheduling.
Manage interview rescheduling and cancellations and communicate changes promptly to all stakeholders.
Track pending interviews and follow up with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely closure.
Maintain accurate candidate and interview information in recruitment systems/tools.
Support candidate communication throughout the interview scheduling process.
Coordinate across multiple stakeholders and manage scheduling requirements effectively.
Ensure recruitment coordination processes are followed consistently and recommend process improvements wherever required.
Work with different recruitment/ERP tools and systems.
Support the recruitment team with operational and coordination activities as required.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Good coordination and organizational skills.
Ability to manage multiple activities and priorities.
Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to communicate professionally with candidates and stakeholders.
Good follow-up and time-management skills.
Ability to work collaboratively in large teams.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Graduate or postgraduate qualification, preferably in HR, or a Diploma in Human Resources.
1-3 year of experience in recruitment coordination, interview scheduling, HR operations or Talent Acquisition.
Basic understanding of recruitment processes.
Good working knowledge of MS Office applications, including Outlook, Excel and Teams.
Ideally, you ll also have
Understanding of recruitment and interview coordination processes.
Exposure to Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) or recruitment tools.
Ability to work with multiple stakeholders and manage competing priorities.
Proficiency in MS Excel.
What we look for
Quick learner with a positive attitude.
A self-starter and problem solver with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
Strong attention to detail and ownership of assigned activities.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
Open to working with cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment.
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Description:
Job Summary
Sitecore Developer - Senior - Consulting
EY GDS Consulting digital is looking out for experienced web content management developer, especially on CMS platforms like Sitecore with experience with .NET, Headless CMS, SEO, Web Search. Resource will be part of Content Management Solutions team delivering to clients across regions.


Your key responsibilities
Should be able to create a complete blueprint to deploy a modernized CMS.
Hands-on expertise in Sitecore CMS with strong competencies in OOPs as a certified Sitecore Developer.
Experience in ASP.NET MVC, React/next.js and related framework is essential.
Integration of Sitecore with CRM and ERP systems.
Should have skills to estimate the work required for developing Sitecore based solutions. Should have experience with determining the solution architecture and infra-architecture for Sitecore based solutions.
Experience in building micro services in .NET core.
Expertise in most of the following -Web API, .Net core, C#, .Net Framework, JSON, SOAP, REST
Experience with SQL Server, NoSQL Databases such as Mongo is an added advantage.
Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery using DEVOPS or similar Tool.
Unit Testing (NUnit, XUnit, MS Tests or similar Testing Framework)
Experience in HTML and JavaScript, jQuery, Web Services, WCF, SQL Server, AJAX, LINQ.
Hands on in Production support activities.


Skills and attributes
4+ years developing Sitecore CMS applications and applications with Web Content Management and content publishing for external facing sites. Experience in working on Digital Marketing projects is a added bonus.
Experience in Search Engine Optimization and implementing custom search.
Must have strong analytical and technical skills using .Net and SQL and using UI tools like Kendo UI, Telerik, etc.
Prior experience in Entity Framework, Caching like Redis, DEVOPS deployment.
Object-Oriented Programming and Design Patterns
Sitecore development estimation. Solution Architecture and Technical architecture experience.
Experience in deploying and configuring Sitecore.
Agile development methodology
Passion for the web, open-source development, and for helping us build meaningful experiences.
Experience consulting strongly preferred.
Strong problem-solving abilities, taking initiative, and the ability to thrive under pressure.
Maintain a positive and constructive outlook, focus on driving results, finding solutions / breakthroughs to solve problems and challenges; has a positive influence on peers.
Interpersonal and communication skills
Respond positively to opportunities to be involved in brainstorming and iterative work. Handle times of change in a way that drives innovation and iteration.
Work in collaborative and supportive manner
Listen carefully to provided information and ask clarifying questions. Actively listen as a learner rather than a passive recipient of information.
Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science or related discipline preferred


Soft Skills
Excellent Communication Skills
Team Player
Self-starter and highly motivated
Ability to handle high pressure and fast paced situations
Excellent presentation skills
Ability to work with globally distributed teams
Ability to work for RFP response.


To qualify for the role, you must have
A bachelors or masters degree
A minimum of 4+ years of experience, preferably background in a professional services firm.
Excellent communication skills with consulting experience preferred


Ideally, you ll also have
Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products.
Can operate independently or with minimum supervision

Description:
Job Overview
Responsible for study build design, edit specifications, system configurations and is accountable for associated study design components. This role will collaborate with various stakeholders- DTL, Programmer, Validation Team, vendors, statisticians, and client representatives. In addition to project deliveries, the role also would be responsible for the project financials from programming shared services perspective.


Essential Functions
Interprets the study protocol.
Design and update the eCRF using third party or in house CDMS tools in alignment with industry standards like SDTM, CDASH as applicable.
Create and update Edit Specification Document.
Generate specifications for EDC build components (e.g., Rights and Roles, System Settings and Home Page)
Complete the Study Authorization Form and Trial Capacity Request Form (InForm)
Attend the Pre-Design Meeting, Online Screen Review Meeting, Unblinded Data review meeting. Attend and present comments at the Internal Design Review Meeting. May lead Online Screen Review Meeting.
Facilitate the internal Edit Specification Review Meeting and leads the discussions regarding the Edit Specification Document.
Design the database to collect LLRR data within the InForm database and ensure Rights and Roles document has appropriate access for Entry and Updates.
Communicate any project risks to the Data Team Lead, including the potential for missing a timeline in the Data Management Project Plan.
Escalate potential quality issues.
Ensure the completion and documentation of all project-specific training, as well as staying current with required Standard Operating Procedures.
Reviews build timelines and provide input as applicable.
Reviews QIP for own projects, identify out of scope activities if any and inform relevant parties.
Responsible for multiple study design projects at the same time.
Might be working on projects across multiple platforms.
Identify areas for process improvements on an ongoing basis. Actively take part and contribute towards process improvement initiatives as assigned besides providing suggestions for continuous improvement of processes.
All responsibilities are essential job functions unless noted as nonessential (N).


Qualifications
Bachelors Degree Bachelor in Science/Computer science/Information Technology or Bachelor in Technology Req
2-4 years of relevant core Technical designer experience and total exp being 7+ yrs. Req
