Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Accountable for overall success of the daily kitchen operations. Exhibits culinary talents by personally performing tasks while leading the staff and managing all food related functions. Works to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget. Supervises all kitchen areas to ensure a consistent, high quality product is produced. Responsible for guiding and developing staff including direct reports. Must ensure sanitation and food standards are achieved.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Culinary Arts, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met
- Manages kitchen shift operations and ensures compliance with all Food & Beverage policies, standards and procedures.
- Estimates daily production needs on a weekly basis and communicates production needs to kitchen personnel daily.
- Assists Executive Chef with all kitchen operations and preparation.
- Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.
- Develops, designs, or creates new applications, ideas, relationships, systems, or products, including artistic contributions.
- Assists in determining how food should be presented and creates decorative food displays.
- Maintains purchasing, receiving and food storage standards.
- Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
- Performs all duties of kitchen managers and employees as necessary.
- Recognizes superior quality products, presentations and flavor.
- Ensures compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
- Follows proper handling and right temperature of all food products.
- Operates and maintains all department equipment and reports malfunctions.
- Checks the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.
Leading Kitchen Operations
- Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.
- Leads shifts while personally preparing food items and executing requests based on required specifications.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Maintains the productivity level of employees.
- Ensures employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.
- Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
- Recognizes success performance and produces desired results.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Handles guest problems and complaints.
Maintaining Culinary Goals
- Achieves and exceeds goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Utilizes the Labor Management System to effectively schedule to business demands and for tracking of employee time and attendance.
- Trains employees in safety procedures.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Participates in the employee performance appraisal process, providing feedback as needed.
- Brings issues to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources as necessary.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Attends and participates in all pertinent meetings.

Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

POSITION SUMMARY
Oversee accuracy of room blocks, reservations, and group market codes. Communicate company values and/or culture to new employees. Review and implement new Reservations procedures. Process all reservation requests, changes, and cancellations received by phone, fax, or mail. Identify guest reservation needs and determine appropriate room type. Verify availability of room type and rate. Explain guarantee, special rate, and cancellation policies to callers. Accommodate and document special requests. Answer questions about property facilities/services and room accommodations. Follow sales techniques to maximize revenue. Input and access data in reservation system. Respond to any challenges found for accommodating rooming requests. Set-up proper billing accounts according to Accounting policies. Troubleshoot, resolve, and document guest issues and concerns or escalate/refer to appropriate individual.
Assist management in training, scheduling, counseling, and motivating and coaching employees; serve as a role model and first point of contact of the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 2 years of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.

Description:
Job Summary
As a Senior within HR Managed Services, you will help organizations transform and optimize HR service delivery through process redesign, HR Shared Services, HR Service Centre set-up and operating model design.
You will work closely with HR and business stakeholders to assess current-state operations, design future-state service delivery models, and implement practical solutions that improve efficiency, governance, employee experience and service quality.
In addition to client delivery, you will play an active role in practice development and business growth by supporting solution development, proposals, market initiatives and reusable assets.


Your Key Responsibilities

Advisory & HR Transformation
Assess current-state HR processes, service delivery structures, organization capabilities and pain points.
Facilitate stakeholder interviews, workshops and requirements-gathering sessions.
Design future-state HR processes, service delivery models, organization structures and governance frameworks.
Develop pragmatic recommendations and implementation roadmaps aligned to client priorities.


HR Shared Services & Service Centre Set-up
Support end-to-end design and set-up of HR Shared Services or HR Service Centres, including scope, location considerations, service catalogue, roles, spans and layers, governance and interaction models.
Develop process maps, SOPs, playbooks, work instructions, service level definitions and RACI frameworks.
Support transition, knowledge transfer, training, testing, operational readiness and stabilization activities.
Define KPIs, reporting requirements and continuous improvement mechanisms for service operations.


Client Delivery & Team Leadership
Own defined workstreams and deliver high-quality outputs within agreed scope, timeline and quality standards.
Build effective working relationships with client stakeholders, EY member firms and cross-functional teams.
Guide junior team members, review deliverables and support their day-to-day development.
Identify risks, dependencies and improvement opportunities, and communicate them proactively.


Practice Development & Business Growth
Contribute to proposals, RFP/RFI responses, solution design, effort estimates and client presentations.
Develop thought leadership, methodologies, accelerators, case studies and reusable assets.
Support market research, account initiatives and internal knowledge-sharing activities.


Skills and attributes for success
Strong understanding of end-to-end HR processes, HR service delivery and HR operating models.
Experience in HR transformation, process redesign, HR Shared Services or HR Service Centre set-up.
Strong consulting, stakeholder management, facilitation and structured problem-solving skills.
Ability to translate business challenges into practical process, organization and governance solutions.
Excellent communication, presentation and client-ready documentation skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively across global and cross-cultural teams.
Open to travel nationally and internationally for approved client projects in line with EY and country-specific travel advisory guidelines.


Ideally, You'll Also Have
6-9 years of experience in HR Transformation, HR operations, HR Shared Services or consulting.
Masters degree in HR or a similar full-time MBA/EMBA.
Hands-on experience in HR operating model design, process mapping, service catalogue design, RACI development and SOP creation.
Experience supporting Shared Services transitions, knowledge transfer, training, operational readiness or stabilization.
Exposure to Lean, Six Sigma or structured continuous improvement methodologies.
Experience supporting proposals, business pursuits and practice development initiatives.

Description:
The Opportunity
We are looking for an SAP OPENTEXT VIM Senior Consultant to join the EY GDS Team. As part of our EY GDS TechOps team, you will be responsible for providing functional support for SAP Vendor Invoice Management (OpenText VIM) across various regions for our global clients. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to address issues, implement enhancements, and optimize invoice management processes to meet business requirements.
This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth as you get to work with a high-quality team to support clients, ensuring seamless invoice processing, automation, and operational excellence through best-in-class solutions, innovation, and continuous improvement.


To qualify for the role
Bachelors degree in engineering/technology (B.E./B Tech) or Commerce/Finance (B Com, M Com), MBA (Finance), CA, ICWA/CMA, or equivalent professional experience.
3-7 years of experience in SAP OPENTEXT VIM/OpenText VIM implementation or AMS support, preferably with global clients.


Your Key Responsibilities
Responsible for providing support for SAP OPENTEXT VIM incidents and service requests, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.
Support incident resolution by analysing issues raised by users and providing effective solutions.
Work closely with customers and support teams to ensure issues and requests are followed up and addressed in a timely manner.
Handle change requests with a clear understanding of business requirements and invoice processing workflows.
Understand business needs and deliver solutions that improve invoice automation, approval workflows, and operational efficiency.
Cross-functional communication skills; experience in offshore/onsite delivery models.
Defect analysis and resolution related to SAP OPENTEXT VIM and integrated SAP modules.
Ability to work with minimal guidance or supervision in a time-critical environment.
Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills within a global support environment.
Flexibility in managing work hours due to the nature of Application Management Services, including shift support and on-call availability for critical business requirements.
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


Skills and attributes for success
Ideally, you'll also have:
Strong knowledge of SAP OpenText VIM components including: Invoice Capture Center (ICC), Document Processing, Approval Workflows, Exception Handling, Duplicate Invoice Checks, Business Rules Framework, Reporting and Analytics.
Experience with SAP FI and MM integration points, including: Accounts Payable, Purchase Orders, Goods Receipts, Vendor Master Data, Payment Processing.
Knowledge of workflow troubleshooting, configuration, and enhancement activities.
Experience with SAP S/4HANA and VIM migration/support projects.
SAP/OpenText VIM Certification is preferred.


What you will do
Provide day-to-day Application Management support for SAP OPENTEXT VIM and related SAP applications across IT Service Management, including service requests, incident management, enhancement requests, change management, and problem management as a Level 2 or Level 3 Application Management Specialist.
Lead and coordinate the resolution of complex VIM process issues, workflow failures, invoice processing exceptions, and system outages, including root cause analysis and corrective actions.

Description:
At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
IAM Secure Access Engineer
Todays world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of professionals who collaborate to support the business by protecting information assets. Our Information Security professionals enable the organization to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and respond to security events as they happen.
Within Information Security, we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions across the security lifecycle. You will join a team of security-focused professionals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative and secure solutions that provide business value.
The opportunity
As EY accelerates the adoption of Frontier AI, Generative AI, AI Agents, and Autonomous Workflows, identity has become a critical security control for protecting enterprise systems, data, and digital assets. AI-powered solutions increasingly access sensitive information, interact with business applications, make decisions, and execute actions on behalf of users, creating new and complex identity security challenges.
The IAM Secure Access Engineer will be responsible for designing, governing, and securing AI identities, agent permissions, and access controls across the organization. This role will help establish mature security frameworks that align with Zero Trust principles, regulatory requirements, and emerging AI governance standards. By providing dedicated expertise in AI-focused identity security, this position will play a key role in reducing organizational risk, strengthening compliance, and enabling the safe, scalable adoption of AI technologies across EY.
The role combines traditional IAM engineering fundamentals with delivery of new Secure Access initiatives across Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, PingID, PingFederate, PingAccess, Okta, PlainID, multifactor authentication, passwordless authentication, workload identities, token protection and secrets or certificate-based authentication.
The engineer will work with Architecture, Product, Operations, application teams and vendors to translate requirements into secure, supportable solutions and move changes through design, build, test, production deployment and operational handover.
Your key responsibilities
AI Identity Governance & Security
Design, implement, and maintain identity governance frameworks for AI agents, machine identities, autonomous workflows, and Generative AI platforms.
Establish lifecycle management processes for AI identities, including provisioning, credential management, authentication, authorization, and deprovisioning.
Define and enforce policies governing AI agent access to enterprise systems, applications, APIs, and sensitive data.
Develop controls to ensure AI systems operate within approved permissions and business boundaries.
Authentication, Federation & Access Engineering
Design, configure and support authentication and federation integrations using SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and related standards.
Implement and maintain MFA, single sign-on, passwordless authentication and risk-based access controls.
Configure and troubleshoot PingID, PingFederate, PingAccess, Okta and Microsoft Entra ID integrations.
Support onboarding and migration of applications to modern authentication patterns.
Analyze authentication failures, policy conflicts, token issues and user access problems across integrated platforms.
Conditional Access & Identity Protection
Implement and enhance Microsoft Entra Conditional Access policies, authentication strengths, authentication contexts and protected actions.
Support Continuous Access Evaluation, token protection, sign-in risk controls and secure administrative access patterns.
Assess policy impact, exclusions, break-glass requirements and deployment risks before production release.
Use logs and platform telemetry to validate control effectiveness and investigate access issues.
Authorization, Workload Identity & Secrets
Implement policy-based authorization using PlainID or comparable authorization platforms.
Support role-based, attribute-based and policy-based access control patterns.
Improve security for service principals, managed identities, application identities and other non-human identities.
Support migration from shared secrets to managed identity, certificates or approved vault-based patterns.
Coordinate certificate, key and secret lifecycle activities with PKI, vault and application teams.
Engineering Delivery & Operations
Create technical designs, implementation plans, test cases, rollback plans and operational documentation.
Raise and manage Change Requests and support production deployments through established controls.
Automate repeatable administration and validation tasks using PowerShell, REST APIs or other approved scripting methods.
Perform unit, integration, regression and security testing and support post-deployment validation.
Participate in incident, problem, vulnerability remediation and continual improvement activities.
Skills and attributes for success
Solid understanding of authentication, authorization, identity federation, MFA, SSO and Zero Trust principles.
Hands-on experience with at least two of the following: Microsoft Entra ID, PingID, PingFederate, PingAccess, Okta or PlainID.
Working knowledge of SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, SCIM, LDAP, Kerberos and RADIUS.
Experience with Conditional Access, Identity Protection, workload identities or modern authentication controls.
PowerShell or comparable scripting experience and the ability to work with REST APIs, JSON and certificates.
Strong troubleshooting, documentation, testing and stakeholder communication skills.
Understanding of secure software delivery, ITSM, Change Management and production support practices.
To qualify for the role you must have
Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
3 to 5 years of experience in IAM, authentication engineering, access management, security engineering or enterprise platform support.
Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI/CD.
Experience creating deployment pipelines and release automation.
Basic containerization knowledge (Docker/Kubernetes preferred).
Experience configuring or supporting enterprise authentication and access management solutions.
Experience delivering controlled changes across development, test and production environments.
Ability to analyze technical issues, document findings and work effectively with distributed teams.
Ideally, youll also have
Experience with Microsoft Entra Conditional Access, Ping Identity products, Okta or PlainID.
Knowledge of passwordless authentication, FIDO2, certificate-based authentication and PKI.
Experience with CyberArk, Azure Key Vault or another enterprise secrets platform.
Cloud platform knowledge in Azure and familiarity with CI/CD or infrastructure automation.
Relevant Microsoft, Ping Identity, Okta, security or ITIL certification.
What we look for
We look for a hands-on engineer who combines sound IAM fundamentals with curiosity about emerging authentication and authorization controls. The successful candidate is structured, security-minded and comfortable collaborating across application, infrastructure, architecture and operations teams.
What we offer
As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The benefits package focuses on physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can explain the benefits available in your country.
Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility so you can make a significant impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Resource Management Advanced Associate
As a Resource Management Advanced Associate, you will be part of an industry leading, high performing and agile team of workforce management professionals providing exceptional client service to our stakeholders and helping our employees gain differential experiences that are aligned to their career aspirations.
We provide learning and growth opportunities to build your ability to analyze, innovate, think and act globally. Youll be part of an organization that is focused on optimization, is solution oriented, innovates and provides best in class services to the client serving teams.
The opportunity
EY Global Delivery Services (EY GDS) is a dynamic and global service delivery network of over 50,000 professionals working across borders, to provide innovative and strategic business solutions to EY member firms and EY clients globally. Resource Management plays a vital role in the firms Next Wave strategy and its purpose of building a better working world.
We offer a great place to work for every person joining EY. At GDS, you will have the opportunity to develop your professional skills in a truly global environment. You will learn and gain experiences from industry leading WFM professionals and a path breaking leadership team.
We invest in your learning and development. Well help you develop the technical and soft skills you need. We support your professional development with a combination of learning, networking, experiences, and coaching. As part of a 300+ member team, supporting 4 unique Service Lines, you will always have opportunities to showcase your skills and contribute to the firms strategic initiatives.
Your key responsibilities
As an Resource Management Advanced Associate, you will work as the staffing point of contact for the assigned region/service/competency team and will be responsible to work with the service delivery managers in capturing staffing demand projections, analyze demand intake patterns, demand supply matching, demand supply gaps, schedule individuals on projects, optimize employee utilization and bench management.
Some of your key responsibilities include:
Capture demand projections, understand demands heuristics and identify actionable demand.
Calculate staffing requirements based on demand projections, delivery deadlines and productivity targets.
Identify suitable staffing options based on matching skills, roles and experiences.
Create staffing schedules to maximize service and minimize cost.
Timely update of employee schedules on the schedule management tool (Retain).
Timely review and resolution of scheduling conflicts.
Proactive review of resource availability/future project demands.
Minimize bench pipeline through proactive deployment on projects.
Minimize open, unfulfilled demand.
Track monitor and report on WFM KPIs such as employee utilization, time to fulfil demand, unfulfilled demand % and bench aging.
Basic reporting and analysis.
Skills and attributes for success
Graduates with 2-3 years of relevant workforce management experience. Understanding of business models, operational and financial aspects of service delivery will be preferred. The suitable candidate should have good analytical skills, can compute staffing demands, validate skills and experiences associated with the demand, identify suitable fulfilment options from the internal pool of professionals available for allocation or on bench and negotiate staffing solutions with the service delivery managers.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Excellent analytical skills.
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel.
Excellent teaming and interpersonal skills.
Positive attitude and ability to excel under tight timelines.
Ideally, youll also have
Experience on workforce management concepts, resource deployment and scheduling.
Working knowledge and subject matter expertise in resource management, demand planning and scheduling in reputed consulting, technology, financial services, accounting and professional services organizations.
What we look for
We are looking for go-getters with a solution oriented and analytical mindset. Someone who is good with numbers and has the willingness to learn. The successful candidate will be one who combines computer skills and mathematical ability with a working knowledge of the business and the negotiation skills of a salesman.
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. Well introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

EY- Process & Controls Risk Consulting Manager -IA Capital Projects
As part of our Risk Consulting, you will be supporting the team in client engagements related to Risk Consulting, Internal Audit, GRC Consulting for various clients across the MENA region. The client base spans across various sectors and includes collaboration with other teams within Consulting services.
The opportunity
Were looking for experienced professionals with experience in the Real Estate and Construction sector and Internal Audit/ Risk to join our Process & Controls Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of our service offering. This position will be based out of our offices (Kochi/ Thiruvananthapuram) in the beautiful state of Kerala.
Working in our practice, you will have the opportunity to work with clients to provide practical risk management, internal audit solutions and gaining valuable experience in a variety of clients.
Your key responsibilities
The current role requires executing internal audit and other risk consulting engagements for Real Estate construction companies. As part of the role, the candidate is expected to:
Responsible for leading and executing client engagements and meeting the expectations of the client and the onsite team within the MENA region.
Ability to interact with all levels of management, including C-Suite executives.
Perform end-to-end internal audits from planning to reporting including process understanding, walkthroughs, preparation of risk and control matrix / audit work program, control testing to assess their design and operating effectiveness, preparation of audit report and agreeing issues/ actions with management.
Have an in-depth understanding of the Real Estate, Capital Projects, and Construction industry risks/issues/trends and end-to-end business processes.
Demonstrate knowledge and experience of the project delivery (EPC) lifecycle, including understanding of governance structures, organizational design, and Delegation of Authority frameworks.
Assess business cases for capital projects, analyzing their structure, assumptions, and feasibility.
Lead audits with engineering, planning, or cost-related components, including review of master planning, engineering phases, stage gate methods, and design maturity.
Understand cost estimating principles, cost estimate classifications, LPM build-up techniques, and perform BoQ analysis and material take-offs.
Evaluate procurement, contract, and commercial practices, and apply project control principles (schedule, cost, risk, reporting).
Analyze integrity, completeness and accuracy of project plans, cost estimates, risk plans, and interpret project documentation such as contracts, reports, and dashboards.
Review and interpret resource plans and schedules to assess alignment with project objectives.
Deliver/manage engagements on time, within budget, and at high quality.
Identify key areas of improvement in the client's business processes and add value through insightful recommendations.
Contribute to business development activities such as proposal preparation and lead identification.
Always comply with the firms quality and risk management policies.
Manage multiple assignments and associated project teams.
Maintain excellent rapport and proactive communication with clients.
Mentor and coach junior team members, enabling them to meet performance goals and grow their careers.
Manage engagement budgets and support superiors in developing marketing collaterals, proposals, and new solutions/methodologies.
Skills and attributes for success
Exceptional command on spoken and written English
Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations at a short notice
Highly analytical, organised and meticulous consulting skills
Demonstrating and applying strong project management skills, inspiring teamwork and responsibility with engagement team members
Ability to multi-task, work well under pressure with commitment to deliver under tight deadline
Strong organizational skills with ability to prioritize effectively
Attention to detail and quality assurance
Proficient in MS-Office Suite, data analysis & validation
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelors or Masters degree in Engineering, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum of 8 years of relevant work experience in Internal Audit / Risk Management, with a focus on the Real Estate, Construction, or Capital Projects sector.
Experience leading or supporting audits involving cost estimation, engineering reviews, procurement, and project controls.
Ability to interpret and assess detailed project documentation, including project charters, schedules, cost plans, and risk assessments.
A valid passport and willingness to travel internationally.
What working at EY offers
At EY, were dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way thats right for you

Description:
At EY, were all in to shape your future with confidence.
Well help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
Associate 66.2 CRM Operations
At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
The opportunity
This opportunity is in the global operations teams of EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) which is rapidly growing. As our efforts towards building a better working world, GDS operations need to create an evolving framework of CRM Operational excellence framework control in all processes, decision making and activities for GDS operations to enable our business teams across locations.
As an Associate Risk Management Analyst, you will take on a more advanced role in supporting the risk management department. Building on the foundational skills developed at the Associate level, you will have increased responsibilities in managing risk management tools, performing more complex tasks related to client and engagement acceptance, and contributing to the continuous improvement of risk management processes. You will also mentor junior team members and provide more in-depth analysis and reporting.
Your key responsibilities
Manage more complex aspects of risk management tools, including advanced troubleshooting and problem resolution.
Lead the implementation of new features or updates in risk management systems, including coordinating with IT and other relevant teams.
Ensure data integrity within risk management tools, performing regular audits and making necessary corrections.
Conduct detailed reviews of client and engagement documentation, identifying and assessing potential risks.
Assist in developing and refining processes for client and engagement acceptance to improve efficiency and compliance.
Liaise with the onshore team and other departments to resolve any issues related to client and engagement acceptance.
Prepare and analyze complex reports on risk management activities, identifying trends and areas for improvement.
Support the development of compliance frameworks and contribute to internal audits by providing necessary documentation and insights.
Act as a point of contact for more complex queries and issues, both from within the team and from other departments.
Contribute to the ongoing improvement of risk management processes, identifying areas for efficiency gains or risk reduction.
Participate in cross-functional projects aimed at enhancing overall risk management capabilities within the organization.
Stay current with industry trends, best practices, and regulatory changes, and share relevant insights with the team.
Qualification, Skills, and attributes for success
Bachelors degree in finance, business, risk management, or a related field.
1-3 years of experience in risk management, finance, or a related area.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Experience with risk management tools and systems is highly desirable.
Excellent communication and leadership skills.

We are seeking a Senior Analyst with 10+ years of experience in professional services, or other leading global organizations, to take a senior role within the Global R&DAs Leadership Reporting Pillar.
The successful candidate will be responsible for delivering accurate, timely, insightful and commercially-focused reporting and analysis to support business decision-making in EYs Global C&I organization.
They will possess strong technical expertise, the ability to understand complex commercial finance concepts, and the confidence to engage effectively with senior stakeholders.
The ideal candidate will:
Demonstrate a strong understanding of commercial financial reporting and analysis.
Be capable of working independently while collaborating effectively within a team environment.
Have excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Be proactive, inquisitive, and focused on continuous improvement.
Thrive in a fast-paced environment managing multiple priorities and competing deadlines simultaneously.

Collaborate effectively within a geographically diverse team environment.

Understand business requirements and provide analytical support for strategic initiatives.

Technical skill set

Interpret and troubleshoot complex SQL queries written by others.
Advanced experience developing reports and dashboards using Power BI.
Advanced Excel skills including complex formulas, data modelling, and automation.
Experience working with large financial and operational datasets.
Understanding of concepts such as Wins, Pipeline, Backlog, Revenue, Margin.

Excellent listening, consultative, influencing and communication skills
Strong curiosity and awareness of emerging business and technology trends.

Description:
Job Summary
The Transformation Delivery practice @ EY provides a rewarding career opportunity, targeted toward becoming a professional in complex business, technology and infrastructure transformation, not simply being a generalist. If you have a passion for rallying together to solve the most complex challenges in todays marketplace, come join our dynamic TD&E team!
The opportunity
Our clients are seeking and hiring a new type of Transformation Delivery expert one who provides strategic guidance but is also deeply embedded in the delivery and success of their programs. Traditional suppliers, such as strategy houses, systems integrators and engineering project management consultants, cannot provide the complete service our clients now demand. Our insights and capabilities across all portfolio levels in planning, analysis and delivery are integrated into our core offerings, and this exemplifies our unique viewpoint over traditional program management. We also offer services that focus on bridging the gap between execution and strategy primarily by designing and implementing frameworks and solutions that allow companies to make data-driven decisions to optimize and manage portfolios and programs/projects. With digital transformations being a focus of EY, we have incorporated technology into our processes, automating manual work and enabling us to provide greater insights and value to our clients.
Your key responsibilities
A successful Transformation Design and Execution Staff will work with our clients to design and establish Transformation Management Office (TMO), Program Management Office (PMO) or Project Portfolio Management business processes and solutions to manage high profile complex programs by applying proven EY frameworks and methodologies based on industry recognized global standards.
You will partner with engagement leadership to design and establish core processes and support a delivery team in planning, controlling, and executing complex programs, PMOs and Transformation Offices. In your role, you will gain valuable insights and help drive strategic conversations with key stakeholders.
You will also work closely with our Technology Solutions team to creatively leverage technology to support processes as part of the overall solution design.
Key deliverables that you will work on are:
Assessments and Process Design
Roadmap Development and Execution
PMO Setup & Run
Sustainable Templates and processes
Dashboards and Automations
Responsibilities, Skills, and Attributes for success
Active listener, passionate learner with a creative and high-performance mindset. Committed and driven towards helping and supporting the team in every aspect possible
Having a successful and proven track record in some or all of below areas:
Business analysis
Transformation Management, Project Management, Change Management
Problem Solving, Design Thinking, root cause assessment
Process improvement, business improvement
Supporting cross-functional teams
Excellent analytical and interpersonal skills as a standard - problem solving, critical thinking, conceptualizing, communication, leadership, presentation, workshop facilitation, storytelling, etc.
Flexible, willing to work in hybrid model and open to support time zones
Strong communication and presentation skills and be able to express yourself effectively, by breaking down complex structures into digestible and relevant points for a diverse set of clients and colleagues, at all levels
Team player that collaborates well in a group setting to quickly and effectively accomplish tasks
Flexibility in embracing and adapting to change
Be able to strive in ambiguous environments and use analytical and creative thinking to find and develop innovative solutions to complex problems.
Be curious and pay attention to detail, exercise active listening and be to anticipate and identify risks and escalate issues as appropriate
Foster an innovative and inclusive team-oriented work environment and demonstrate leadership by playing an active role in counselling and mentoring junior consultants within the organization
Possess good business acumen and remain current on new developments in consulting capabilities and industry trends
Demonstrate in-depth technical capabilities and professional knowledge.
Develop and maintain long-term client relationships and networks
Develop and maintain relationships with team members across EY practices to serve client needs
Cultivate and participate in business development opportunities. Understand EY and its service lines and actively assess/present ways to serve clients.
Support planning activities for large, complex client programs
Own tracking activities for key milestones and deliverables to ensure project stays on track according to plan
Develop key reports and communicate relevant client insights
To qualify for the role, you must have
A bachelors degree (BE - B. Tech / MCA) and a minimum of 0-5 years of related work experience; or a graduate degree and a minimum of 4 years of related work experience
Approximately 6+ years experience on large scale complex programs providing consulting services in at least one of the following areas:
PMO/EPMO design/set up and delivery, program road-mapping design, resource/capacity management, program execution
PMO maturity assessment, PMO Setup & Operations
Transformation Office design/set up and delivery, Value/Benefit realization
End-to End Portfolio Management implementation intake and demand management, portfolio prioritization, portfolio selection, financial management
End-to End ERP implementation
Demonstrated excellent oral and written communication skills
Flexible to work in US and UK time zones
Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
Knowledge of project and portfolio management (PPM) methodologies (Agile, Hybrid, SAFe, DevOps. etc.) and tools (Microsoft based tools such as Azure DevOps, MS Project Online, others such as Jira, Planview, Planisware, Power BI, Tableau, etc.)
PPM certifications such as PMI, Prince2, Scrum Master, Scrum Product Owner, SAFe or equivalent are beneficial
Good to have
MBA or relevant graduate degree is a plus
Understanding of Agile concepts

Discipline: Internal Communications
Role Type: Communications and Engagement Metrics and Channel Reporting
The opportunity
The position is for the team within EY Brand, Marketing and Communications in GDS team and will be aligned to the Communications and Engagement pillar.
This position will work with our stakeholder team to manage communications data, create insightful reports and dashboards to make communications more data driven and manage CE channels.
Your key responsibilities
Timely and accurate addition of all data for delivered communications to the Management Information Application (MIA).
Creation of metrics reports for all communications activities, showcasing function performance in PowerPoint presentations to help stakeholders make informed decisions.
Operational support for communication dissemination on EY channels of communication and SharePoint.
Coordinate the setup of leadership emails for delivery via Broadcast Center (tool specific to EY).
Develop toolkits for the stakeholder on Modern SharePoint.
Assist with the creation of metrics reports for multiple functions using PowerPoint.
Handle logistics and provide operational support for webcasts on platforms like Kaltura and MS Teams.
Create, maintain, and update distribution lists using the One Access tool.
Submit tickets to the BMC ticketing system for updates on the intranet and Broadcast Center.
Interact and collaborate with internal teams on multiple projects.
Skills and attributes for success
Support EY brand, understand, implement, and strictly adhere to the quality standards and procedures established by EY, including verbal and branding guidelines
Pursue and share best practices within the team
Demonstrate eye for detail and ensure all deliverables are of high quality
To qualify for the role, you must have
Overall 8-10 years experience and 7-9 years CE experience
Graduate Bachelors or masters degree preferably in English literature/Mass communication/Journalism
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly PowerPoint and SharePoint.
Familiarity with Broadcast Center, One Access, and other relevant communication tools.
Strong organizational and project management skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Ideally, youll also have
Business acumen to understand the leadership strategy and translate it in the deliverables prepared
Eagerness and be a fast learner who is willing to expand on core skills
Technologies and Tools
MS Office Word, PowerPoint and Excel
Desirable Content CMS, communications analytics, SharePoint, Adobe Analytics
What we look for
Analytics acumen
Research skill
Communication Skills (Comprehend, Verbal & Written)
Listening Skills
Result Oriented
Time Management
Customer Focus
Personal Learning & Development
Planning and organizing
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy.
We are reshaping careers at EY by supporting increasingly diverse career journeys, empowering you to build your career and proactively seek out the experiences that will help you go further.
What you can expect:
Drive your career
Success as defined by you. Your passion amplified by our purpose. Solving the worlds toughest challenges while building a better working world, together.
We provide the scale, teams and the tech. We'll show you whats possible, so youll see opportunities where others see challenges.
With our help, you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
We provide a foundation for you to create and personalize your career, with success defined by you.
Manage your performance
Connect with each other through better conversations,
Find out how we support your career and growth
We recognize your contributions and efforts to team and serve our clients throughout the year.
Varied experience
Challenge the way you experience the world.
Multicultural thinking, teaming and working are at the heart of our shared success.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for Managers with strong experience in global payroll advisory, transformation and implementation to join the PC team. The role will lead complex, multi-country payroll engagements, advise clients on payroll strategy, operating models, technology and service delivery, and manage diverse teams across global locations. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading global professional services organisation while contributing to the growth of the PC payroll practice.
Your Key Responsibilities
Grow the GDS payroll consulting practice through strong collaboration, relationship building and integrated solutioning with EY global offices.
Lead multi-country payroll advisory and transformation engagements from assessment, strategy and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment and stabilisation.
Advise clients on payroll operating models, process harmonisation, governance, controls, compliance, vendor strategy, shared services and outsourcing options.
Lead payroll technology-enabled transformation involving integrations across HCM, payroll, workforce management, finance and third-party systems.
Provide subject matter direction across payroll inputs, gross-to-net processing, statutory deductions, remittances, garnishments, time and attendance, payroll accounting and reporting.
Manage project scope, workplans, resources, budgets, risks, dependencies, quality and engagement economics, ensuring timely delivery and effective escalation management.
Lead requirements workshops, current-state assessments, fit-gap analysis, future-state process design and the preparation of business requirements and solution design documentation.
Oversee data migration, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, payroll parallel runs, reconciliation, cutover, go-live and hypercare.
Establish effective client governance, executive reporting and stakeholder communication across global and country teams, vendors and functional workstreams.
Support business development through solutioning, proposals, effort estimation, client presentations, credentials and development of payroll thought leadership and reusable assets.
Build and coach high-performing teams, set objectives, provide timely feedback and support capability development and career progression.
Implement internal processes to achieve practice objectives relating to quality, productivity, utilisation, headcount growth and market penetration.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong consulting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex payroll challenges into practical recommendations and implementation plans.
Sound understanding of end-to-end payroll processes, controls, statutory compliance, payroll accounting and global delivery models.
Ability to lead complex engagements, manage ambiguity and balance strategic priorities with hands-on delivery.
Strong client-facing, stakeholder management, facilitation, communication and presentation skills.
Commercial awareness, including experience in project planning, effort estimation, budgeting, risk management and engagement economics.
Ability to manage multiple engagements and geographically distributed teams simultaneously.
Strong quality orientation, attention to detail and commitment to meeting delivery timelines.
Cross-cultural awareness and the ability to work effectively with global and country stakeholders.
High integrity, adaptability and willingness to travel nationally and internationally for approved client projects.
Ideally, youll also have
Experience leading payroll strategy, maturity assessment, operating model, vendor assessment, implementation, transformation or managed-services engagements.
Experience designing payroll delivery options, including consolidation, outsourcing, shared services and technology-enabled process improvement.
Practical experience across requirements, process design, data migration, integrations, testing, parallel payroll, reconciliation, cutover and hyper care.
Experience with payroll and HCM technologies such as Workday, SAP HCM, SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll, Dayforce, ADP GlobalView, ADP Celergo, Oracle or PeopleSoft.
Understanding of Workday-to-payroll, SAP-to-payroll, time-to-payroll and payroll-to-finance integration concepts, including data mapping, interface controls and error management.
Experience with workforce management and time-and-attendance platforms such as Dayforce, UKG/Kronos or Workforce Software.
Experience working with global payroll vendors.

EY- Strategy and Transactions (SaT) Valuation, Modelling & Economics (VME) Business Valuations Senior
Role Overview
The Senior Business Valuation role sits within EYs Strategy and Transactions (SaT) Valuation, Modelling & Economics (VME) practice. The role is execution focused, with primary responsibility for hands on valuation of complex financial instruments and portfolio investments, in accordance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS).
The Senior will support financial reporting, portfolio valuation, transaction related, and audit assist engagements, while also contributing to team development, internal reviews, and delivery quality. The role involves technical client interaction and close collaboration with Managers and Senior Managers.
Key Responsibilities
Hands on Valuation Execution
Independently perform fair value measurement of complex financial instruments and portfolio investments, primarily for IFRS financial reporting purposes.
Develop, review, and maintain detailed valuation models using advanced quantitative techniques, including:
Option pricing models (Black Scholes, binomial / lattice models)
Monte Carlo simulation techniques
Discounted cash flow and scenario based models, a pply advanced financial engineering, econometric, and statistical techniques to address complex valuation challenges.
Execute valuations for a broad range of complex securities, including:
Share based payment awards (equity settled and cash settled awards, market and non market vesting conditions) under IFRS 2.
Convertible instruments, SAFEs, and preferred equity with complex rights.
Derivatives (equity, interest rate, commodity, credit), warrants, and embedded derivatives
Contingent consideration, structured and hybrid instruments.
Structured and hybrid instruments with multiple valuation components.
Apply appropriate valuation methodologies in line with IFRS 13 Fair Value Measurement, including assessment of the fair value hierarchy and use of observable and unobservable inputs.
Perform portfolio valuations for private equity, venture capital, and asset management clients, including:
Equity investments across complex capital structures
Private debt and structured credit portfolio
Hybrid instruments and multilayer capital structures
Apply appropriate valuation methodologies including DCF, market approach, OPM, PWERM, and scenario-based models in line with IFRS 13 Fair Value Measurement.
Financial Reporting & IFRS Compliance
Support valuation engagements for statutory and financial reporting purposes, ensuring compliance with relevant IFRS standards (including IFRS 2, IFRS 9 / IAS 32, IFRS 13, and IFRS 3, as applicable).
Prepare clear, well structured valuation reports, working papers, and technical memoranda suitable for audit review.
Ensure valuation assumptions, methodologies, and conclusions are robust, internally consistent, and aligned with EY quality standards and professional valuation practices.
Stay current on updates to IFRS guidance, valuation methodologies, and market practices relevant to complex securities.
Audit Support & Valuation Review
Act as a key audit assist resource, supporting EY Assurance teams and external auditors by explaining valuation methodologies, assumptions, and conclusions.
Respond effectively to audit and internal review comments, updating models or documentation where required.
Participate in internal valuation reviews, assessing work prepared by junior team members to ensure accuracy, robustness, and IFRS compliance.
Support Managers and Senior Managers in ensuring valuation conclusions are defensible and audit ready.
Team Leadership & Development
Supervise, coach, and mentor junior team members, providing guidance on valuation concepts, modelling techniques, and IFRS requirements.
Review work prepared by analysts and seniors in training, providing clear and constructive feedback.
Manage assigned workstreams independently, including planning tasks, monitoring progress, and meeting deadlines.
Contribute to the development and enhancement of internal valuation tools, templates, and technical guidance.
Client Interaction & Collaboration
Participate in limited, technical client interactions, primarily to explain valuation approaches, key assumptions, and outcomes.
Work collaboratively with other SaT / VME teams and adjacent service lines (e.g., Business Valuation, Transaction Accounting, Assurance) on multi disciplinary engagements.
Support engagement delivery by maintaining high technical standards and consistent quality of output.
Qualifications and Experience
Education: CA / ACCA / CFA (or progress toward CFA) or a Masters degree in Finance, Accounting, Financial Engineering, or a related discipline.
Experience : Minimum 8+ years of relevant experience in valuation, transaction advisory, quantitative finance, or complex securities valuation, preferably within a Big 4 or leading advisory firm.
IFRS expertise: Strong practical experience applying IFRS based valuation requirements, particularly IFRS 2 and IFRS 13.
Audit exposure: Experience supporting audits or valuation reviews, including preparation of audit ready documentation and interaction with audit teams.
Technical Skills
Strong understanding of valuation approaches (income, market, and cost) and their application to complex securities.
Advanced Excel based financial modelling skills; VBA skills are an advantage.
Exposure to Python, MATLAB, R, or similar quantitative tools is desirable.
Familiarity with market data sources (e.g., Bloomberg, Capital IQ).
Strong written and presentation skills using Word and PowerPoint.
Core Competencies
Strong analytical and problem solving skills with high attention to detail.
Sound professional judgm

Description:
Job Summary
Join a financial crime technology team building data-driven solutions for global financial services clients. This role combines hands-on Python engineering, advanced SQL development, and practical exposure to Financial Crime Compliance processes. You will work with business, compliance, data, and engineering stakeholders to deliver reliable solutions across KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud.
Role overview
We are seeking a hands-on software engineer with strong Python and advanced SQL skills and relevant Financial Crime Compliance domain experience. The successful candidate will develop and support data-intensive applications, analytical workflows, and rule-based solutions used in customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, fraud detection, investigations, and regulatory reporting.
Key responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain Python applications, services, utilities, and data-processing workflows.
Write complex, optimized SQL for data extraction, transformation, reconciliation, profiling, and investigation use cases.
Work with large financial datasets, including customer, account, transaction, alert, case, and screening data.
Translate Financial Crime Compliance requirements into technical designs, data rules, scenarios, and reusable components.
Support KYC and AML workflows such as customer onboarding, customer risk rating, customer due diligence, enhanced due diligence, and periodic review.
Contribute to Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud solutions, including rule implementation, threshold logic, alert generation, data validation, and issue analysis.
Develop APIs, batch jobs, automation scripts, and integration components using Python.
Perform unit testing, code reviews, debugging, root-cause analysis, and production support.
Collaborate with compliance SMEs, business analysts, data engineers, QA teams, and client stakeholders in Agile delivery teams.
Follow secure coding, version-control, documentation, and deployment practices.
Primary skills must have
Python: Strong hands-on programming experience, including data structures, functions, object-oriented programming, exception handling, modules, logging, testing, and performance-conscious coding.
Advanced SQL: Strong command of complex joins, subqueries, common table expressions, window functions, aggregations, query optimization, stored procedures, and data reconciliation.
Databases: Practical experience with at least one relational database such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, or MySQL.
Data engineering: Experience processing structured data using Python libraries such as pandas and integrating with databases, files, or APIs.
APIs and services: Working knowledge of REST APIs and Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
Engineering practices: Git, unit testing, code review, debugging, documentation, and CI/CD fundamentals.
Cloud: Mandatory hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP. Candidates should have practical experience developing, deploying, or supporting data-driven applications or services in a cloud environment.
Good to have
Experience with PySpark or distributed data processing.
Familiarity with orchestration or ETL tools such as Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent.
Experience with data visualization or reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Understanding of model or rule performance measures, threshold tuning, false-positive reduction, and data lineage.
Exposure to Agile delivery tools and practices, including Jira or Azure DevOps.
Financial Crime domain knowledge
KYC / CDD / EDD: Customer onboarding, identity and document checks, customer risk rating, beneficial ownership, periodic review, and remediation.
AML: Financial crime risk indicators, typologies, alert and case workflows, investigations, escalation, and regulatory reporting concepts.
Transaction Monitoring (TM): Scenario or rule logic, thresholds, segmentation, alert generation, tuning support, back-testing, and data-quality controls.
Sanctions: Customer and payment screening, watchlist concepts, potential-match handling, disposition workflows, and screening data quality.
Fraud: Fraud indicators, rules or models, event and transaction analysis, alert triage, investigations, and case outcomes.
Experience and education
Experience: Strictly 24 years of relevant professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, analytics engineering, or technology delivery.
Eligibility: Freshers and candidates with less than 2 years of relevant experience will not be considered.

Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM and Procurement (PROC) Functional Consultant Senior
Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Cloud Supply Chain Management (SCM) and Procurement (PROC) Functional Consultant at Senior level with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience. The successful candidate will independently support and deliver Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation, transformation, rollout and support engagements across Procurement and related SCM areas, including Self Service Procurement, Purchasing, Sourcing, Supplier Qualification and Management, Procurement Contracts, Inventory Management, Order Management, Product Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain Planning, Cost Management, Maintenance and Logistics. The role requires strong hands-on functional capability, client-facing delivery experience and relevant industry/domain expertise to translate real-world source-to-pay and supply-chain requirements into scalable Oracle Fusion solutions. Knowledge of Oracle Redwood user experience and Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio is also expected.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities:
Deliver Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM and Procurement implementation, transformation, rollout and support activities from requirements gathering through design, configuration, testing, deployment and stabilization.
Manage assigned workstream tasks, plans, risks, issues, dependencies, quality and stakeholder updates under the guidance of the project lead or manager.
Facilitate business workshops, assess current-state industry processes and translate requirements into scalable future-state Oracle Fusion SCM and Procurement solutions aligned with leading practices.
Perform functional fit-gap analysis, configuration, prototyping, conference room pilots, testing, training, cutover and go-live support.
Design integrated source-to-pay, procure-to-pay and supply-chain solutions across Procurement, Inventory Management, Order Management, Cost Management and related SCM modules, coordinating dependencies with Payables, Finance, Projects, reporting, integration, security and data teams.
Prepare high-quality functional designs, configuration workbooks, process flows, test artefacts, user guides and training materials in line with Oracle implementation methodologies.
Assess Oracle Redwood readiness, support business-process redesign for Redwood pages and guided experiences, and execute adoption, testing and change-impact activities.
Identify suitable SCM use cases for Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio and support the definition of agent topics, instructions, tools, data access, human-approval checkpoints and expected outcomes.
Collaborate with technical, security and integration teams to configure, test, publish and monitor AI agents and agentic workflows within Oracle Fusion.
Follow responsible AI controls covering role-based access, data privacy, traceability, testing, monitoring and business-owner approval.
Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, cutover and production support, and drive timely resolution of defects and functional queries.
Contribute to client presentations, solution demonstrations, estimates, proposals, knowledge assets and practice-development initiatives.
Guide junior consultants, review assigned deliverables and maintain delivery quality and internal KPIs.
Experience:
Minimum 5 years of relevant Oracle SCM and Procurement experience, including strong hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud.
At least two end-to-end ERP implementation or transformation engagements, including at least one Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM implementation.
Strong functional expertise in Oracle Fusion Procurementincluding Self Service Procurement, Purchasing, Sourcing, Supplier Qualification and Management, Supplier Portal and Procurement Contractstogether with hands-on knowledge of at least one core SCM area such as Inventory Management, Order Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain Planning, Product Management, Cost Management, Maintenance or Logistics.
Hands-on experience with source-to-pay and procure-to-pay process design, enterprise structures, procurement business units, requisitioning, purchasing, approvals, catalogs, supplier onboarding, sourcing, contracts, receiving, integrations, data migration, reporting and operational controls.
Practical knowledge of Oracle Redwood UX, including Redwood page adoption, process redesign, extension considerations, testing and end-user change management.
Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio, including agent configuration concepts, topics, instructions, tools, workflow orchestration, deployment, security and monitoring.
Ability to support high-value agentic SCM use cases, such as supplier onboarding assistance, procurement policy guidance, order exception management, inventory insights or planning support.
Client-facing delivery experience with sound planning, estimation, risk management, testing and quality assurance capabilities.
Demonstrable industry/domain experience in at least one sectorsuch as retail, government, energy, real estate, oil and gas, manufacturing, utilities, logistics or consumer productswith practical understanding of sector-specific procurement, supplier, inventory, fulfilment, planning and operational-control requirements.
Competencies / Skills:
Strong stakeholder management, consulting, collaboration and junior-team mentoring skills.
Ability to independently manage assigned functional workstreams, priorities and deliverables within agreed timelines.
Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills, with the ability to explain business and functional concepts clearly.
Strong analytical, industry-process design, problem-solving and decision-making capabilities, with the ability to apply domain knowledge to Oracle Fusion SCM and Procurement solutions.
Sound understanding of responsible AI, data privacy, access controls, human oversight and governance for enterprise agentic solutions.
Awareness of Oracle quarterly updates and the ability to assess new SCM, Redwood and embedded-AI capabilities for business adoption.
Proficiency in delivery and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Project, Jira, Azure DevOps or equivalent.
Valid passport and willingness to travel to client sites and work MENA business schedules, including Sunday to Thursday, where required.
Education:
Bachelors degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business Administration, Information Systems or a related discipline; an MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred.
Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM and/or Procurement certification in relevant modules is preferred; credentials or demonstrated training in Oracle Redwood and Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio are an added advantage.

Description:
At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY GDS Data and Analytics (D&A) Data Modeller Developer with Cloud Exposure- Senior
As part of our EY-GDS D&A (Data and Analytics) team, we help our clients solve complex business challenges with the help of data and technology. We dive deep into data to extract the greatest value and discover opportunities in key business and functions like Banking, Insurance, Manufacturing, Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing and Auto, Supply Chain, and Finance.
The opportunity
Role Overview Experienced Data Modeler (5+ years) with strong Private Markets domain expertise to design scalable data models supporting investment management, analytics, reporting, and data governance initiatives.
Key Domain Experience ( 2 minimum )
Private Equity
Private Credit
Fund Accounting
Investment Performance & Analytics
Capital Calls, Distributions, NAV, Valuations, Cash Flows
Technical Skills
Data Modeling (Conceptual, Logical & Physical)
Dimensional Modeling / Data Vault
Data Warehousing, Data Lakes & Lakehouse Architecture
Tools & Platforms
ERwin / ER Studio / similar DM tools
Key Responsibilities
Design and maintain enterprise data models.
Translate business requirements into scalable data solutions.
Create source-to-target mappings and data dictionaries.
Establish data standards, lineage, and governance controls.
Collaborate with Investment Operations, Portfolio Management, Reporting, and Engineering teams.
Perform impact analysis and ensure data quality across platforms.
Preferred Experience
Wealth & Asset Management (WAM)
eFront, Investran, Aladdin, Burgiss or similar Private Markets platforms
Candidate Profile
Overall Eper
Strong blend of Private Markets business knowledge and data architecture/modeling expertise.
Ability to bridge business and technology teams.
Excellent stakeholder management and requirement-gathering skills.
Insurance domain Knowledge
Ideally, youll also have
Client management skills
What we look for
People with technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
What working at EY offers
At EY, were dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way thats right for you
EY | Building a better working world


EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
