Description:
Job Summary
Risk and Compliance Transformation Technical Developer role within EY's Risk and Compliance Transformation team. EY Digital Engineering provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. The Risk and Compliance Transformation practice works with clients to analyse, formulate, design, mobilize and drive digital transformation initiatives. We advise clients on their most pressing digital challenges and opportunities surrounding business strategy, customer, growth, profit optimization, innovation, technology strategy, and digital transformation. Through our unique combination of competencies and solutions, EY helps clients sustain competitive advantage and profitability by developing strategies to stay ahead of the rapid pace of change and disruption and supporting the execution of complex transformations.
We are looking for a Technical Developer in Risk and Compliance Transformation team, with 4-9 years of hands-on development and design experience with preferred prior experience in product-based IT development, involving Full stack engineering (Front-end, Back-end), Machine Learning and AI-driven development and devops. In this role, you will play a dual role a) of creating source code catering to target state functional specifications and b) support the team for overall product or project delivery involving code review, design review, team member technical coaching etc.
EY Digital Engineering is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. The Risk and Compliance Transformation practice works with clients to analyse, formulate, design, mobilize and drive digital transformation initiatives. We advise clients on their most pressing digital challenges and opportunities surround business strategy, customer, growth, profit optimization, innovation, technology strategy, and digital transformation. We also have a unique ability to help our clients translate strategy into actionable technical design, and transformation planning/mobilization. Through our unique combination of competencies and solutions, EY's DE team helps our clients sustain competitive advantage and profitability by developing strategies to stay ahead of the rapid pace of change and disruption and supporting the execution of complex transformations.
Your key responsibilities Design and hands-on Development
Use working experience to amend design (commensurate to functional specifications) and demonstrate hands-on development of product features, with utmost efficiency and optimization of source code
Wherever needed, challenge status quo for tech stacks, API choices to include most efficient industry practices, balancing the time to market for the product at hand
Coach and mentor team members technically as needed (including performing code reviews)
Technical Leadership
Demonstrate the right-ways of development in all facets of software development (Front end, Back end, APIs , Data layers, 3rd party integrations and AI models) (Lead with Walk the Talk mindset)
Map functional specifications to product features to ensure coverage and accuracy of product
Demonstrate critical thinking, strong communication, logical reasoning and technical convincing as needed
Quality Assurance
Perform Techno-functional Testing (QA) for product features getting implemented as per the functional specifications
Automate testing wherever possible using most feasible approaches (Excel/ VBA or Python or any available tool/s)
Collaboration & Support
Partner with architects and application teams for secure solution delivery.
Provide functional support to all phases of delivery (Sprints, Testing, Hypercare etc.)
Ability to guide and coach junior TAs and testers in the team
Skills and attributes for success Required Skills
4-9 years of Technical source code development experience, with right mix of design leadership, hands on development and overall technical leadership
Working experience in Market Risk domain (any 1 or more subject areas of Counterparty Credit Risk, SA-CCR, FRTB, VaR, SVaR, CVA, and Derivative Pricing)
Working experience in
Core Java, OOP, Collections, Multithreading, Concurrency, JVM, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, Kafka, SQL/NoSQL, Design Patterns, JUnit/Mockito, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, AWS/Azure, Performance Tuning
C#, ASP.NET Core
Back end including API creation (Django or Fast API), microservices and data integration, Data Structures and Algorithms
Cloud and Devops: Working knowledge of deploying applications in cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS or GCP) and implement CI/CD pipelines, with version control (Git)
Python driven Machine Learning model implementation (ML Ops) and AI model ops
Databases like SQL (PostgreSQL) and/or NoSQL (MongoDB)
Good to have:
Front end (Either of Angular, or React or similar)
MEAN or MERN stack exposure
Node js Exposure
BI platforms (PowerBI or alike)
Preferred Qualifications
Certifications: Any of Cloud certifications (Azure preferred but AWS, GCP acceptable)
AI or ML Certifications

Description:
Job Summary
EY Risk Consulting Senior Consultant, Regulatory Compliance
As part of Risk Consulting, you will support and deliver regulatory compliance engagements focused on sector-specific regulatory gap reviews, assessments, compliance monitoring and remediation across the MENA region. You will work with clients across banking, sovereign wealth funds, government, infrastructure, energy and other regulated sectors to strengthen compliance processes, systems and controls.
The opportunity
We are looking for a motivated regulatory compliance professional to join our Risk Management team. This is an opportunity to contribute to high-quality regulatory gap assessments, compliance reviews and remediation programmes, strengthen your consulting capabilities and help clients translate regulatory requirements into practical actions. The position will be based in Kochi or Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.
Working in our practice, you will gain experience in regulatory gap assessments, regulatory obligation analysis, risk and control mapping, compliance testing, regulatory change, inspections, remediation and stakeholder advisory across varied industries and operating environments.
Your key responsibilities
As part of the role, you will lead and support responsibilities across the following areas:
Regulatory Gap Assessments
Conduct regulatory gap assessments against applicable MENA and international requirements, including CBUAE, SAMA, Basel, AML/KYC, Consumer Protection, FATCA/CRS and relevant ISO standards.
Assess the design and operating effectiveness of compliance processes, systems and controls, and identify gaps and enhancement opportunities.
Develop clear findings, risk-rated observations, practical recommendations and remediation roadmaps aligned with regulatory expectations and business priorities.
Support regulatory remediation programmes and broader compliance and enterprise risk transformation initiatives.
Monitor key regulatory compliance risks and support the development and tracking of proportionate mitigation actions.
Regulatory Framework Reviews
Analyse new and amended regulations, determine their applicability and business impact, and provide practical guidance on implementation.
Develop regulatory inventories, obligation registers, risk and control matrices, compliance checklists and testing strategies tailored to local regulatory frameworks.
Assist clients in preparing for regulatory inspections, supervisory reviews, information requests and onsite visits.
Draft and communicate regulatory updates, guidance notes, compliance reports and executive presentations.
Support the delivery of compliance training sessions in line with clients compliance training programmes.
Sector-Specific Compliance Assessments
Apply regulatory requirements to the operating context of banking, sovereign wealth funds, government, infrastructure, energy and other regulated sectors.
Present assessment results and recommendations to senior management, CXOs and audit or risk committees.
Assist in managing working relationships with regulatory authorities and, where relevant, law enforcement bodies.
Manage assigned workstreams, coordinate information requests and stakeholder meetings, and deliver high-quality outputs within the agreed scope and timelines.
Review the work of junior team members and support their coaching and development.
Contribute to proposals, credentials, methodologies, thought leadership and other business development initiatives.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong understanding of regulatory compliance frameworks, obligation management, risk and control assessment, compliance monitoring and remediation.
Working knowledge of CBUAE, SAMA, Basel, AML/KYC, Consumer Protection and governance requirements, with the ability to interpret their practical implications.
Ability to analyse regulations, policies, processes and evidence, identify gaps and convert findings into clear, risk-based recommendations.
Strong report writing, presentation, stakeholder interviewing and workshop facilitation skills, including confidence engaging senior stakeholders.
Effective project coordination skills, with the ability to manage assigned workstreams and multiple priorities within tight deadlines.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Attention to detail, professional scepticism and a commitment to quality and regulatory integrity.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with data analytics, Power BI or GRC and compliance platforms would be advantageous.
To qualify for the role, you must have
A bachelors degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Law, Engineering or a related discipline.
Four to eight years of relevant experience in regulatory compliance, internal audit, risk management or conduct review programmes across banking, financial services, government, infrastructure, energy or other regulated sectors.
Experience within a bank, regulator, consulting firm, financial institution or comparable regulated organisation.
Practical experience conducting regulatory gap assessments, developing risk and control matrices or testing strategies, and supporting remediation activities.
Experience working with cross-functional teams and interacting with client, business or regulatory stakeholders.
Ideally, you'll also have
A relevant professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CIA and/or CAMS.
Prior consulting or professional-services experience.
MENA regional experience involving CBUAE, SAMA or other local regulators.
Experience preparing executive-level compliance reports, regulatory updates or audit and risk committee materials.
Arabic language capability, where relevant to client engagements in the MENA region.
Mobility and travel
Willingness and ability to travel to client locations at short notice, with an expected onsite travel requirement of up to 75%.
A valid passport and ability to meet applicable travel requirements.

Position Title: PKI Engineer
Responsibilities
Perform end to end discovery of SSH keys, SSL/TLS certificates, and cryptographic assets across hybrid environments.
Analyze key and certificate usage patterns, identify security gaps, and recommend remediation strategies.
Support secure lifecycle management practices for SSH keys and SSL/TLS certificates, including rotation, revocation, and access controls.
Conduct cryptographic discovery within applications, services, and infrastructure to identify cryptographic primitives and algorithms in use.
Assess cryptographic posture and readiness of systems and applications against emerging quantum computing threats.
Collaborate with architecture and engineering teams to evaluate and implement quantum safe cryptographic solutions.
Contribute to the development of security documentation, standards, and operational procedures.
Skills and attributes for success
Minimum 35 years of experience in Cybersecurity, preferably in cryptography, PKI, or certificate lifecycle management.
Hands on experience with platforms such as Venafi, AppViewX, Thales, Sectigo, MSFT AD CS, or similar.
Experience in discovery, assessment, and management of enterprise cryptographic assets.
Familiarity with Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC), including an understanding of quantum-resistant cryptographic algorithms, emerging standards, migration considerations, and their impact on enterprise PKI and security architectures.
Strong understanding of cryptographic principles, PKI, SSL/TLS, SSH, and trust models.
Familiarity with Linux/Unix/Windows administration, scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell), and automation.
Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and native key/certificate services.
Strong communication, analytical, and collaboration skills.

The Data Insights Executive serves as a strategic enabler of data-driven decision-making and digital transformation across UKI Client & Industries team. Responsibilities

Support digital transformation initiatives by leveraging Microsoft 365, Copilot, and automation to improve operational efficiency.
Work closely with business stakeholders and leaders to align data and digital initiatives with business priorities and regional objectives.
Communicate insights clearly and effectively through well-structured reports, dashboards, presentations, and professional stakeholder communications.
Support leadership decision-making through timely and accurate reporting, trend analysis, and actionable insights.
Design, develop, and maintain business applications using PowerApps (Canvas) to support operational and business requirements.
Integrate Power Platform solutions with Dataverse, SharePoint, Excel Online, and the broader Microsoft 365 ecosystem.
Collaborate closely with MSM, BD, BMC, FMT, Operations, and other relevant teams to develop effective and user-centric solutions.
Support user adoption through training, documentation, knowledge sharing, and ongoing assistance.

Demonstrates good proficiency in analytics platforms and visualisation tools such as Power BI, ThoughtSpot, or similar tools to transform data into meaningful and actionable insights.

Experience working with business stakeholders and senior team members, with the ability to understand requirements and communicate effectively.
MS Office skills: Good to advanced proficiency in Excel reporting and PowerPoint presentations.

Graduate / Post-graduate - (Business Administration, Information and Data Science) with 3 - 6 years work experience in professional services industry having exposure working on applications and automation.

Experience in team management

Role #3 - Rapid Response Reporting Specialist
The Opportunity
To join a high-performing multi-national team within the Global R&DA that provides financial reporting, analytics, and insights support in response to strategic and ad hoc business requests. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with senior stakeholders across a diverse portfolio of customers to design, develop and test reports and dashboards that support strategic initiatives and inform leadership decision-making.
What we look for
We are seeking a Senior Analyst with 10+ years of experience in professional services, or other leading global organizations, to join the Global R&DA Leadership Reporting Pillar.
The successful candidate will play a key role within a small dedicated team working with stakeholders to understand business requirements and advise on the most appropriate reporting solutions.
The role involves producing reporting specifications, designing and developing reports and dashboards, managing user acceptance testing, creating user documentation and delivering demonstrations and training sessions.
The ideal candidate will:
Combine strong technical expertise with excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to translate complex business requirements into impactful reporting solutions.
Demonstrate a strong aptitude for understanding commercial financial reporting and analysis.
Be capable of working independently while collaborating effectively within a geographically diverse team environment.
Be a practical and analytical problem-solver with the ability to clearly articulate approach, findings and recommendations.
Thrive in a fast-paced environment managing multiple priorities and competing deadlines simultaneously.
Take ownership of deliverables ensuring a high standard of quality, accuracy and timeliness.
Key responsibilities
Demonstrate the confidence to ask the right questions to ensure outputs align with business requirements and stakeholder expectations.
Ensuring the timely and accurate delivery of tasks assigned to you, keeping stakeholders and colleagues informed of progress and any potential issues.
Develop a broad understanding of EYs commercial Finance reporting portfolio that can be drawn on for direction and knowledge.
Ensure all reports and dashboards are developed in accordance with established build standards, governance requirements and approved style templates.
Act as a liaison between source data providers and the Global R&DA Leadership Reporting Pillar.
Stakeholder management
Act as a trusted business advisor to finance and business stakeholders.
Develop a thorough understanding of business requirements building stakeholder confidence through insightful questioning and high-quality delivery.
Manage stakeholder expectations and provide regular updates on priorities, timelines, risks, and deliverables.
Challenge requests constructively and in a consultative manner ensuring proposed solutions align with strategic objectives, reporting standards and best practices.
Present findings, insights, and recommendations in a clear, concise, and impactful manner tailored to the audience.
Continuous improvement
Support process improvement initiatives to enhance reporting efficiency, data quality, automation and stakeholder experience.
Document reporting processes and business logic for reporting assigned to you.
Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise and automate processes.
Technical skill set
Demonstrate extensive experience designing, developing and maintaining complex reports and dashboards using Power BI.
Design and develop advanced SQL queries to extract, interrogate, transform and analyse large datasets to help inform on the build of new reports and dashboards.
Advanced Excel skills including complex formulas, data modelling, Power Query, automation and large-scale data analysis.
Interpret, troubleshoot and enhance complex reports and dashboards developed by others.
Demonstrate experience working with large and complex financial datasets.
Understanding of concepts such as Wins, Pipeline, Backlog, Revenue, Margin.
Skills and attributes for success
Excellent listening and communication skills.
Strong curiosity and awareness of emerging business and technology trends.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
A proactive customer-focused approach with a willingness to embrace new ideas and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Job Description
Job Title: Senior Incident & Access Management (IFMS)
Profile Summary
Senior Analyst Incident & Access Management (IFMS) will support IFMS business service continuity through incident coordination and timely, approved access provisioning for Business Operations users. The role monitors tickets and SLAs, drives resolver follow-ups, publishes service reports and identifies Continual Service Improvement (CSI) opportunities across supported engagements.
Roles and Responsibilities
As an Incident Management Analyst, support IFMS Business Operations through the following activities:
Incident monitoring: Review MSO queues daily; validate business impact, priority and assignment, and track ageing, backlog and SLA risks.
Resolution coordination: Follow up with business and technology resolver teams, escalate delays, communicate progress and confirm closure; support major incident coordination and post-incident actions.
Access fulfilment: Handle Business Operations access requests; validate approvals and provision, modify or revoke application access within delegated permissions, following approved role profiles, least privilege and segregation-of-duties controls.
Service reporting: Publish daily ticket updates and periodic reports on demand, SLA attainment, backlog, access fulfilment, risks and outstanding actions.
Operational controls: Maintain accurate MSO records, access approval evidence, SOPs and handovers; support access reviews and track service reviews to closure.
CSI: Identify recurring incidents and process bottlenecks; recommend knowledge articles, self-service and automation, and track improvement outcomes.
Desired Skills
Working knowledge of incident, request, access and SLA management; ITIL Foundation preferred.
Understanding of role-based access, approval workflows, least privilege and segregation of duties.
Proficiency in Excel, ITSM reporting and trend analysis; Power BI familiarity preferred.
Clear stakeholder communication, customer focus and effective business/technology team coordination.
Ability to work independently, prioritize business impact and maintain accurate records and timely follow-ups.
Essential Requirements
Bachelors degree in IT or a related discipline preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.
Typically, 58 years in service delivery/support, including 3+ years in incident coordination, ticket governance, SLA monitoring or reporting.
Hands-on ITSM tool experience; familiarity with MSO and finance managed services environments is an advantage.
Experience in approved user access provisioning, operational reporting and service improvement tracking.

Job Summary
As part of our Risk Consulting, you will be supporting the Team in client engagements related to Risk Management, Internal Audit, GRC solutions for various clients across the MENA region. The client base spans across various sectors and includes collaboration with other teams within Consulting services.
Were looking for experienced professionals with experience in the Risk Consulting and Internal Audit to join our Process & Controls Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of our service offering. This position will be based out of our offices (Kochi/ Thiruvananthapuram) in the beautiful state of Kerala.
Working in our practice, you will have the opportunity to work with clients to provide practical risk management, internal audit solutions and gaining valuable experience in a variety of clients.
Your key responsibilities
Responsible for leading and executing client engagements and meeting the expectations of the client and the onsite team within the MENA region.
Ability to interact with all levels of management, including C-Suite management
Perform end-to-end internal audits from planning to reporting including process understanding, walkthroughs, preparation of risk and control matrix / audit work program, control testing to assess their design and operating effectiveness, preparation of audit report and agreeing issues/ actions with management.
Have an in-depth understanding of the various industry risks/ issues / trends and end-to-end business processes.
Have thorough knowledge and understanding of Internal Audit methodology and IIA requirements.
Deliver / manage engagements to time, cost and high quality.
Identify key areas of improvement in the client's business processes and add value by preparing insightful recommendations.
Contribute to business development activities such as preparing proposals, lead identification
Always comply with the firms quality and risk management policies
Manage multiple assignments and related project teams.
Maintain excellent rapport and proactive communication with the client
Mentor and coach junior team members, enabling them to meet their performance goals and successfully grow their careers
Manage the engagement budgets and support superiors in developing marketing collaterals, business proposals and new solution / methodology development
Skills and attributes for success
Exceptional command on spoken and written English
Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations at a short notice.
Highly analytical, organised and meticulous consulting skills
Demonstrating and applying strong project management skills, inspiring teamwork and responsibility with engagement team members
Ability to multi-task, work well under pressure with commitment to deliver under tight deadline
Strong organizational skills with ability to prioritize effectively
Attention to detail and quality assurance
Proficient in MS-Office Suite, data analysis & validation
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelors degree or relevant professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CIA etc.
Experience in Internal Audit / Risk Management.
A minimum of 8 years of relevant work experience
A valid passport for travel.

At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Clients & Industries: Global C&I Strategic Operations Specialist

About EY
At EY, were all in to shape your future with confidence. Join EY and help build a better working world. Well help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

The Opportunity
The Global Operations Specialist plays a key role in supporting operational excellence across the Clients & Industries (C&I) organization. This role focuses on enabling strategic priorities, optimizing processes, and facilitating collaboration across domains, functions, and pods to deliver agility and impact.
The C&I organization has six Domains, each with individual needs and differing maturity: Insights, Industry, Demand Generation, Client Excellence, Sales & Commercial Excellence, and Enablement & Technology.
This position sits within the Business Enablement Business Management Office and supports the C&I organization through three key functions: Strategic Operations, Core Services, and Performance & Data Insights. Strategic Operations works through pods aligned to each of the six domains, working alongside Core Services and Performance & Data Insights to deliver seamless operational support and strategic execution.
Success in this model depends on agilitythe ability to learn quickly, adapt as priorities change, and drive execution while staying responsive to evolving demands.
The primary stakeholder is the Domain Strategy Execution Leader, although this role will work with the Domain Leader and the rest of the Domain team.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Operations
Partner with leadership to help translate strategic objectives into actionable operational plans within the aligned domain.
Support the design and implementation of short- and long-term initiatives/projects that deliver on strategic priorities, monitoring progress against milestones.
Oversee domain-specific processes, driving clarity, consistency, and timely execution across stakeholders.
Prepare strategic inputs for leadership (e.g., decks), synthesizing content into clear narratives and recommendations to support decision-making.
Collaborate with the Strategic Operations Team Lead and counterparts, plus other Domain teams, to coordinate cross-domain priorities, ensuring operational delivery supports strategic impact.
Support performance monitoring and governance alongside Core Services.
Leverage Performance & Data Insights for analytics and intelligence to guide decisions and monitor impact.


Operational Excellence
Identify and drive efficiencies in relevant areas through automation, standardization, and best practices.
Assess emerging technologies and tools to enhance operational agility and responsiveness.
Promote a culture of continuous improvement within the Strategic Operations team.
Support governance forums and prepare executive-ready updates leveraging data analytics and reporting tools (e.g., Essentials, Dynamics, etc.) in coordination with Performance & Data Insights.
Drive quality and alignment with Core Services and Performance & Data Insights across domain processes, ensuring clarity in roles, handoffs, and workflows.
Assist with additional reporting and analysis requests, help manage stakeholder expectations, and reinforce self-service options.


Stakeholder Engagement
Build strong relationships across domains, functions, and pods to foster collaboration and alignment.
Act as a trusted advisor to leadership, providing recommendations based on operational insights.
Facilitate communication and coordination across domains, functions, and pods for smooth execution of initiatives.


Skills & Attributes for Success
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience in operational process creation, improvement, and handoff.
Proficiency in reporting tools, data visualization, and storyboarding to create impactful prompts for decision-making.
Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities, delivering high-quality outputs under tight timelines.
A client-focused mindset, with the ability to manage expectations and redirect activity as required.
Credible, with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills at Global/Area leadership level.
Resilient, embraces ambiguity, and comfortable working in a global, matrixed environment with evolving priorities.


What we offer you
At EY, well develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. Well empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidenceApply today.

At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY Risk Consulting Manager (Risk Analytics)
As part of our Digital Risk (DR) team within Risk Consulting, we are seeking a Manager with strong business understanding, analytical capability and handson experience in process mining and data analytics to join the DR team and work with our clients on some of the most prestigious projects catering to various sectors across the MENA region. This is an excellent opportunity to join a leading consulting practice and contribute to shaping nextgeneration digital and analyticsdriven risk solutions.
The opportunity
As a Manager, you will engage with clients to strengthen their digital risk posture by bridging business requirements with technical capabilities. You will work on engagements across advanced analytics, data visualization, automation, data governance, process mining, etc. ensuring solutions are aligned with organizational objectives, regulatory expectations and leading practices.
You will work with multidisciplinary teams across data, tech and business functions to design, assess and implement analyticsenabled risk processes and governance structures.
This position will be based out of our offices (Kochi/ Thiruvananthapuram) in the state of Kerala.
Your key responsibilities
Design, develop and oversee the deployment of process mining dashboards using platforms such as Celonis and Power BI to analyze and optimize processes.
Perform and validate deep-dive analysis on core business processes, identifying bottlenecks, root causes and improvement opportunities.
Develop and review root-cause-driven insights and actionable recommendations to improve efficiency, quality and compliance.
Extract, transform and prepare data from ERP and business applications (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, Salesforce, Workday, etc.) to support process mining and analytics initiatives.
Design and develop ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL, Python and data integration tools to create process mining event logs and reporting datasets.
Perform data mapping, data modelling and process event reconstruction to enable end-to-end process visibility.
Support the onboarding of new data sources into process mining platforms such as Celonis, Signavio and ARIS.
Validate process mining datasets through reconciliation, completeness checks and data quality assessments.
Assist in developing process mining use cases, KPIs and dashboards by leveraging transactional and master data from enterprise systems.
Lead a team of Senior Consultants and independently drive client discussions and communications.
Groom junior resources and participate in business development activities.
Provide timely and constructive feedback to junior staff and manage team/individual KPIs and other performance metrices.
Skills and attributes for success
Hands-on experience with:
Process Mining & Analytics
Experience with Celonis, Signavio, ARIS Process Mining or similar platforms preferred.
Candidates with strong SQL, ETL, Data Engineering or Data Analytics experience and willingness to learn Process Mining are encouraged to apply.
Understanding of business process analysis, workflow optimization and operational excellence concepts.
Data Engineering & Integration
Strong SQL skills including complex joins, stored procedures, views and performance optimization.
Experience developing ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL, Python, SSIS, Informatica, Talend, Azure Data Factory, Alteryx or similar tools.
Experience working with large transactional datasets from ERP and enterprise applications.
Understanding of data modelling, data lineage, data transformation and data quality concepts.
Programming & Analytics
Python, SQL, PQL (preferred), R (optional).
Data analysis, automation and scripting experience.
Exposure to machine learning and statistical analysis is advantageous.
Dashboarding & Visualization
Power BI, Tableau, Qlik or similar BI platforms.
Enterprise Platforms
SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, Workday, Azure, AWS, GCP or similar enterprise ecosystems.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelors/Masters degree in computer science, data science or a related field.
8 to 10 years of experience in one or more of the following areas:
Process Mining
Data Analytics
Data Engineering
Business Intelligence
Process Improvement
Experience working with Big4 is a strong advantage.
A valid passport for travel.
Preferred Experience
Experience creating event logs and process datasets from SAP, Oracle, Dynamics 365 or other ERP platforms.
Exposure to process mining concepts such as event logs, case IDs, process variants, conformance checking and root cause analysis.
Knowledge of process mining platforms such as Celonis, SAP Signavio or ARIS is desirable but not mandatory.
Experience with data integration, data warehousing and cloud-based analytics platforms.
Understanding of Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Record-to-Report (R2R), HR or similar business processes.
What working at EY offers
At EY, were dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around.
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career.
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that is right for you.

JOB DESCRIPTION
AVIT Meeting Room
Operations L3 Lead
Role Overview
The role leads a technically skilled Level 3 operations team supporting meeting-room devices and connected peripherals. It combines hands-on technical leadership with service management, work allocation, escalation ownership, operational governance, reporting, and continuous improvement. The Lead works closely with monitoring teams, engineering, project teams, onsite support, service desk, platform teams, vendors and technology stakeholders.
Key Accountabilities
Operational Leadership
Lead daily L3 operations, balancing incidents, service requests, onboarding and offboarding activities, problem investigations, and improvement work.
Allocate work based on priority, impact, technical complexity, regional coverage and resource availability.
Run operational reviews and shift handovers, ensuring ownership, blockers, risks and next actions are clearly documented.
Maintain effective support coverage and act as the primary operational escalation point for the L3 team.
Coach team members, strengthen technical capability, and encourage consistent troubleshooting and documentation practices.
Advanced Incident and Problem Management
Provide technical direction for complex meeting-room incidents that cannot be resolved by L1, L2 or monitoring teams.
Coordinate diagnosis across endpoint, operating system, application, account, network, peripheral and room-integration dependencies.
Own major or recurring issue progression, bringing together internal resolver groups, engineering teams and vendors as required.
Ensure incident records include clear technical findings, actions, evidence, workarounds, resolution details and follow-up requirements.
Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for repeat failures, alert noise and avoidable ticket demand.
Service Reliability and Monitoring
Use operational data and monitoring insights to identify device-health risks, recurring alert patterns, estate-wide issues and service degradation.
Partner with monitoring and engineering teams to improve alert quality, routing, thresholds and actionable diagnostics.
Track device compliance, connectivity, application and operating-system health, and operational readiness across in-scope platforms.
Coordinate recovery campaigns and validate that restored devices remain stable after corrective action.
Device Lifecycle Operations
Oversee operational support for meeting-room device onboarding, configuration validation, readiness testing, BAU handover, replacement and offboarding.
Confirm that prerequisite activities, dependencies, ownership and acceptance criteria are understood before L3 work begins.
Coordinate with project managers, onsite support and dependent platform teams to resolve gaps affecting deployment or decommissioning.
Maintain accurate operational records, handover evidence and supporting documentation for lifecycle activities.
Stakeholder, Vendor and Escalation Management
Provide concise updates on service impact, current status, risks, decisions, dependencies and expected next actions.
Facilitate technical bridges and cross-team troubleshooting for high-impact or multi-domain issues.
Engage OEMs and support partners for advanced diagnostics, defect investigation, warranty and replacement cases.
Ensure escalations are evidence-based, assigned to the appropriate owner and progressed until closure or formal handoff.
Governance, Reporting and Continuous Improvement
Maintain and improve standard operating procedures, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, support boundaries and escalation paths.
Review service performance, ticket ageing, recurring failure themes, backlog, restoration trends and improvement opportunities.
Drive automation, monitoring enhancements, self-heal opportunities and ticket-elimination initiatives with measurable outcomes.
Support operational readiness for new products, platform changes, service transitions and global deployment programmes.
Promote compliance with change, incident, problem, asset, security and data-handling requirements.
Technology and Service Environment
Area Indicative Environment
Meeting-room platforms : Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows and Android, Surface Hub, interactive displays, video-conferencing endpoints, room bars, cameras, microphones, speakers, touch panels and room-signage devices
Operations tooling : ServiceNow, Microsoft Pro Management Portal, monitoring platforms such as Utelogy, Microsoft Intune, reporting dashboards and knowledge repositories
Technical domains : Windows and Android endpoints, Teams Rooms applications, device accounts, identity and access, networking fundamentals, firmware, drivers, peripherals, remote management and AV signal flow
Service practices: Incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, asset, vendor, warranty/RMA, onboarding, offboarding and operational reporting
Candidate Profile
Required Experience and Knowledge
Demonstrable experience leading or coordinating advanced AV, unified communications, meeting-room or endpoint operations in an enterprise environment.
Strong troubleshooting experience across Microsoft Teams Rooms, room peripherals, endpoint operating systems, device management and network dependencies.
Experience managing complex incidents, technical escalations, vendors and cross-functional resolver teams.
Practical understanding of IT service management processes, including incident, problem, change, request and knowledge management.
Experience producing operational reports, trend analysis, executive updates, technical documentation and knowledge content.
Ability to work effectively in a global support model and coordinate across regions, time zones and diverse stakeholder groups.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelors degree or equivalent practical experience in information technology, electronics, telecommunications, AV systems or a related discipline.
Relevant Microsoft, ITIL, vendor or service-management certification.
Experience with ServiceNow, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Pro Management Portal, Power BI, Power Query or comparable monitoring and analytics platforms.
Exposure to device lifecycle programmes, service transition, automation and large-scale operational recovery initiatives.

EY- Risk Consulting Senior Consultant (Sanctions Screening and Transaction Monitoring Model Validation)
As part of our Risk Consulting FS team, we are looking for a Senior Consultant with strong consulting and technical skills to join the FS Risk team and to work with our clients on some of the most prestigious projects within the financial services sector across MENA region. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst contributing to the delivery of Risk Consulting FS domain service offerings and solutions thus creating authentic customer experiences.
The opportunity
As a Senior Consultant, you will engage with clients to support the validation and enhancement of sanctions screening and transaction monitoring models, ensuring they are aligned with regulatory standards and operational requirements. You will work within different sized, multi-disciplinary teams and play a key role in delivering high quality outputs and service to our clients. You will support the validation and fine-tuning of models/tools used for sanctions screening and transaction monitoring. The role involves ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, enhancing model performance, developing subject matter knowledge and supporting the implementation of solutions to meet the ever-changing needs of our clients.
This position will be based out of our offices (Kochi/Thiruvananthapuram) in the state of Kerala.
Your key responsibilities
Support sanctions screening and transaction monitoring model validation engagements including rule-based systems, anomaly detection and machine learning algorithms.
Perform qualitative and quantitative analysis to assess model design, effectiveness, performance and compliance with regulatory expectations.
Execute model testing activities including back-testing, threshold calibration, data analysis and performance assessments.
Analyse large volumes of transactional and customer data to identify trends, gaps and potential model improvements.
Assist in the development and enhancement of validation methodologies, frameworks and performance metrics.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support the integration of model outputs into business processes.
Participate in model implementation reviews, fine-tuning exercises and model performance monitoring activities.
Stay abreast of regulatory changes and advancements in sanctions screening, transaction monitoring and model validation techniques.
Support multiple client engagements and related initiatives while ensuring timely delivery and quality outcomes.
Good to have experience in Risk Management or other Risk Consulting engagements.
The job would require travel (Over 50%) to client locations in Middle East and North Africa such as Dubai, Kuwait, Riyadh, Doha etc.
Skills and attributes for success
Proficient in SQL and Python.
Familiarity with database management and data analysis tools.
Experience in system implementation/fine-tuning, cloud deployment and project delivery.
Familiarity with Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Counter-Terrorist Financing (CTF) regulations and screening tools.
Understanding of sanctions screening systems, transaction monitoring platforms and model validation methodologies.
Exceptional command over spoken and written English.
Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations at a short notice.
Highly analytical, organised, and meticulous consulting skills; attention to detail and quality assurance.
Ability to work collaboratively within engagement teams and contribute effectively to project delivery.
Ability to multi-task, work well under pressure with commitment to deliver under tight deadlines.
Strong organizational skills with ability to prioritize effectively.
Work experience in similar industry (Big 4 preferred).
Strong problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelors degree in engineering, Finance, Statistics, Economics or a related quantitative field; advanced degree preferred.
3 to 5 years of relevant experience working with business consulting firms.
A valid passport for travel.
Preferably, you may also have
AML, CTF Certification (CAMS, CAFP).
Experience / certifications in Cloud Data Architecture, Data Engineering.
What working at EY offers
At EY, were dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around.
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career.
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that is right for you.

EY Risk Consulting Senior (Risk Analytics)
As part of our Digital Risk (DR) team within Risk Consulting, we are seeking a Senior Consultant with strong business understanding, analytical capability and handson experience in process mining and data analytics to join the DR team and work with our clients on some of the most prestigious projects catering to various sectors across the MENA region. This is an excellent opportunity to join a leading consulting practice and contribute to shaping nextgeneration digital and analyticsdriven risk solutions.
The opportunity
As a Senior, you will engage with clients to strengthen their digital risk posture by bridging business requirements with technical capabilities. You will work on engagements across advanced analytics, data visualization, automation, data governance, process mining, etc. ensuring solutions are aligned with organizational objectives, regulatory expectations and leading practices.
You will work with multidisciplinary teams across data, tech and business functions to design, assess and implement analyticsenabled risk processes and governance structures.
This position will be based out of our offices in Kerala.
Your key responsibilities
Design, develop and deploy process mining dashboards using platforms such as Celonis and Power BI to analyze and optimize processes.
Perform deep-dive analysis on core business processes, identifying bottlenecks, root causes and improvement opportunities.
Develop root-cause-driven insights and actionable recommendations to improve efficiency, quality and compliance.
Extract, transform and prepare data from ERP and business applications (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, Salesforce, Workday, etc.) to support process mining and analytics initiatives.
Design and develop ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL, Python and data integration tools to create process mining event logs and reporting datasets.
Perform data mapping, data modelling and process event reconstruction to enable end-to-end process visibility.
Work closely with business and technology teams to understand process flows, source systems and data structures required for process mining analysis.
Support the onboarding of new data sources into process mining platforms such as Celonis, Signavio and ARIS.
Validate process mining datasets through reconciliation, completeness checks and data quality assessments.
Assist in developing process mining use cases, KPIs and dashboards by leveraging transactional and master data from enterprise systems.
Skills and attributes for success
Hands-on experience with
Process Mining & Analytics
Experience with Celonis, Signavio, ARIS Process Mining or similar platforms preferred.
Candidates with strong SQL, ETL, Data Engineering or Data Analytics experience and willingness to learn Process Mining are encouraged to apply.
Understanding of business process analysis, workflow optimization and operational excellence concepts.
Data Engineering & Integration
Strong SQL skills including complex joins, stored procedures, views and performance optimization.
Experience developing ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL, Python, SSIS, Informatica, Talend, Azure Data Factory, Alteryx or similar tools.
Experience working with large transactional datasets from ERP and enterprise applications.
Understanding of data modelling, data lineage, data transformation and data quality concepts.
Programming & Analytics
Python, SQL, PQL (preferred), R (optional).
Data analysis, automation and scripting experience.
Exposure to machine learning and statistical analysis is advantageous.
Dashboarding & Visualization
Power BI, Tableau, Qlik or similar BI platforms.
Enterprise Platforms
SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, Workday, Azure, AWS, GCP or similar enterprise ecosystems.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelors degree in computer science, data science or a related field.
4 to 8 years of experience in one or more of the following areas:
Process Mining
Data Analytics
Data Engineering
Business Intelligence
Process Improvement
Experience working with Big4 is a strong advantage.
A valid passport for travel.
Preferred Experience
Experience creating event logs and process datasets from SAP, Oracle, Dynamics 365 or other ERP platforms.
Exposure to process mining concepts such as event logs, case IDs, process variants, conformance checking and root cause analysis.
Knowledge of process mining platforms such as Celonis, SAP Signavio or ARIS is desirable but not mandatory.
Experience with data integration, data warehousing and cloud-based analytics platforms.
Understanding of Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Record-to-Report (R2R), HR or similar business processes.

Job Summary
The Ops SME is responsible for overseeing vulnerability management activities across the organization's infrastructure, applications, databases, and cloud environments. The role focuses on identifying, assessing, tracking, and remediating security vulnerabilities while ensuring compliance with cybersecurity policies, regulatory requirements, and internal risk management standards.
Essential Functions of the Job
Together with the AMS Lead:
Lead and coordinate end-to-end vulnerability management activities across enterprise systems.
Review and analyse vulnerability scan results.
Prioritize vulnerabilities based on risk, severity, exploitability, and business impact.
Collaborate with application, infrastructure, cloud, database teams and vendors to drive timely remediation.
Monitor remediation progress and ensure adherence to established SLA requirements.
Prepare and present periodic vulnerability metrics, dashboards, and executive reports.
Support internal and external audits by providing evidence related to vulnerability management controls.
Ensure compliance with cybersecurity policies, security standards, and regulatory requirements.
Coordinate exception management processes and document risk acceptance decisions.
Act as an escalation point for critical and high-risk vulnerabilities.
Required 24/7 on-call support (e.g. escalations, vacation, holiday, weekend coverage).
Working in a corporate IT environment with multiple disciplines to deliver projects in line with customer needs.
Working in a corporate IT environment in the Operational / Support Service Management role meeting ITIL framework.
Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities
Ability to prioritize tasks based on criticality.
Must be able to work within a matrix organization balancing the needs of the service line against firm initiatives and goals.
Must make decisions, such as prioritize relationships to develop, negotiate with customers and overcome obstacles.
Analyse trends to identify automation and optimization opportunities.
Identify, manage and resolve complex issues, preventing escalations, where possible.
Manage, negotiate and resolve risks effectively.
Demonstrate, by example, in-depth knowledge of the EY competency principles and practices, including coaching, learning and mentoring.
Create an open, honest, accountable and collaborative team environment.
Knowledge and Skills Requirements
Strong understanding of Vulnerability Management and Cybersecurity principles
High level understanding of service line business processes and application landscape.
Understanding of CVSS scoring, Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE), and risk assessment methodologies
Experience working with .Net Applications, Microsoft Azure, SQL/Oracle Databases
Knowledge on network security, cloud platforms, and application security
Relationship management (internal & external stakeholders)
End to end understanding of IT life cycle (pipeline, resource, demand, project delivery, financial)
7+ years of application services and/or client/supplier relationship management in a technology environment
Good business acumen and ability to negotiate with business partners
Customer centric mindset and able to manage customer expectations
Good executive presence
Ability to develop strategic plans and translate them to actionable roadmaps
Initiates, builds and maintains productive customer relationships
Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity and rapid change
Knowledge of IT Infrastructure Azure, Windows, SQL Server.
Basic project management skills. Demonstrates strong understanding of scope, schedule and planning, time management, resource management and cost management.
Supervision Responsibilities
No direct reports
Establish AMS governance processes, SOPs, and compliance guidelines.
Working relationships (daily) with EY ITSD and AMS Lead
Working relationships (daily) with TCS AMS team and Infosec Team
ET Liaison
Other Requirements
Travel may be required (minimal)
Fluent English speaker
Excellent communication skills in English

Description:
At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
ET Risk & Compliance
ET Risk and Compliance / Risk & Controls Governance Analyst
Supervising Associate
About EY
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build an exceptional experience for yourself and a better working world for all.
Job Summary
Enterprise Technology is a global organization that delivers reliable, secure and resilient technology services and solutions to enable an exceptional technology experience for EY people. As part of the Enterprise Technology Risk & Compliance (ETRC) team, the Risk & Controls Analyst will support the day-to-day execution of RACM governance, control assessment, certification and strategic risk and control initiatives across Enterprise Technology. Reporting to the Risk & Controls Governance Lead, this role will maintain risk and control information, support control impact and gap assessments, coordinate assigned initiatives and provide analysis and governance materials that enable consistent risk and control decisions.
Responsibilities
The Risk & Controls Analyst will support the operational delivery of risk and control governance activities and assigned transformation initiatives under the direction of the Risk & Controls Governance Lead.
Key responsibilities include
Maintain application inventory, control owner and delegate registers, and attestation and certification records that support the ET and Finance control landscape.
Support assessments of applications, processes and technology changes to identify potential requirements for new or updated controls, including IT general controls, SDLC controls and interfaces.
Perform control gap analysis, document findings and contribute practical remediation recommendations for review by Risk & Controls Governance leadership and relevant stakeholders.
Support control rationalization, control impact assessments and analysis of control design or ownership changes.
Support risk and control initiatives
Manage assigned project plans and delivery activities, including milestones, actions, decisions, dependencies, risks, issues, approvals and stakeholder communications.
Prepare governance materials, status packs, ad hoc analysis and trend insights, and identify recurring control issues or themes for escalation and continuous improvement.
Support workflow automation and maintain project and compliance repositories, SharePoint sites, Planner boards and Teams channels where relevant to assigned work.
Share insights and recommendations from control assessments and risk investigations across ETRC teams and collaborate with Finance and Non-Finance RACM stakeholders, Operations & Reporting, Assurance & Compliance and Policy & Standards Enablement.
Analytical / Decision-Making Responsibilities
The role applies analytical and problem-solving skills to evaluate risk and control information, assess changes and reported exceptions, identify potential gaps or recurring themes and develop well-supported recommendations. The individual will organize and synthesize information, manage assigned priorities and dependencies, and escalate significant control, ownership, delivery or data-quality issues appropriately.
Knowledge and Skills Requirements
The role requires a solid understanding of technology risk and controls, RACM concepts, governance processes and project delivery practices. The successful candidate will be able to analyze complex information, maintain accurate governance records and tools, and translate findings into clear documentation and practical actions. Strong organization, collaboration, attention to detail and written communication skills are essential.
Job Requirements
To qualify, candidates must have
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Risk Management, Cybersecurity, Accounting or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
Minimum 5 years of experience in technology risk, internal controls, IT audit, compliance, governance, project delivery or a related field.
Experience supporting RACM maintenance, risk and control assessments, control documentation, certification or remediation activities.
Working knowledge of IT general controls, technology change, access management, SDLC, interfaces and risk management practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and the ability to organize and synthesize complex information.
Strong project coordination skills, including experience tracking milestones, actions, risks, issues, dependencies and stakeholder deliverables.
Ability to work across technology, risk, audit, information security, privacy and business stakeholder groups in a global environment.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear governance materials, analysis and presentation content.
Proficiency with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power BI and collaboration platforms; experience with GRC, workflow or RACM tools is preferred.
Experience supporting AI governance, SAP or ERP transformation, Data Protection, TARP, SDLC or other enterprise technology initiatives is a plus.
Professional certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISM, CIA, PMP or similar are a plus.
What We Offer You
At EY, we will fuel your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
Career development: At EY, your career is yours to shape! We will develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences.
Flexible work arrangements: Our flexible work policies empower you to balance your professional and personal life, fostering a culture of trust and autonomy.
A comprehensive benefits package: need language from Talent/Benefits.
Compensation: A competitive compensation package will be offered, including salary, benefits, and potential for performance-based incentives.
EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Risk Consulting - Senior - Digital Risk - SAP
As part of our Risk Consulting Service Line, you will be part of the team performing reviews and assessment of SAP Application Controls testing for SAP ERP solutions for various clients across the MENA region. An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. Youll also involve in identifying potential business opportunities for EY within existing engagements and escalate these as appropriate. We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced SAP Senior to perform our technical reviews and assessment of complex SAP ERP security design control reviews and assessment projects. The ideal candidate must possess deep technical expertise in SAP ERP solutions including SAP cloud applications etc., strong technical skills, and a proven track record of working and delivering high-quality work for SAP solutions. This role requires excellent communication and client management abilities.
Your key responsibilities
Perform technical review in the SAP security design, implementation of SAP ERP and SAP Cloud solutions.
Review technical specifications and design documents.
Expertise on security configuration standards and best practices for SAP Solutions.
Conduct technical design control review sessions and provide guidance to the team & serve as a technical point of contact for clients and stakeholders
Experience in Implementation of solutions like SAP S4 Hana, SAP ECC, Fiori, Success Factor etc
Strong understanding of SAP security, SoD and related access controls.
Experience with data migration and conversion strategies

Proactively find ways to improve client systems, and processes that improves their technical environment

Contribute to the Risk Consulting team as a key member and assist with facilitating practice wide training (SAP ITGC/ SAP ITAC /SAP Pre & Post Implementation reviews) curriculum.
Work closely with onshore, cross-functional teams and develop strong relationships across the organization, especially with Onsite team.
Skills and attributes for success
Minimum 3 years of experience in SAP Solution security design, review and implementation.
Bachelors or Masters degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Experience in SAP ERP modules across various domains.
Experience in Data Migration, Templates, Knowledge of data models and web services in cloud
Hands-on experience in Documentation, writing Technical Specs, Test Scripts, SIT, UAT, Code Reviews, Deployments, and SDLC Change Management processes.
Experience in performance tuning of SAP Security configurations is highly desirable.
Strong team player, highly motivated, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of SAP S4 Hana, SAP ECC, SAP Cloud services and architecture.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools like JIRA.
Basic Experience with machine learning and AI integration in SAP Cloud applications.
Knowledge of security best practices and compliance standards in cloud environments.

Should have hands on experience and strong knowledge on technical activities performed in S4 Hana and Success factors covering all key modules of Finance, HR and Payroll

Excellent communication, presentation skills and consulting mindset
Client handling experience.
Willing to work in MENA Shift timings (Sunday to Thursday).

SAP certified professional
Ideally, youll also have
A bachelor's or master's degree (B.TECH/B.E/M.TECH/MBA-Finance)
Core experience in SAP Solutions design and implementation functions.
Minimum 3-5 years of relevant experience working in SAP S4 Hana

Experience in major industry sectors like retail, government, energy, real estate, oil & gas, power & utilities.

Description:
Job Description: Account Operations Coordinator Overview
The Account Operations Coordinator will play a critical role in supporting key account operations for nominated accounts within the Account Support centre. This role is designed to ensure high-quality, consistent, and efficient processes across various account management tasks. The coordinator will work closely with account teams and internal business services groups to deliver on day-to-day account operational needs.
Key Responsibilities
Ensure relevant stakeholders receive and understand critical business indicators for the account.
Aggregate account relevant information by leveraging EY tools and external sources.
Develop company research packs by leveraging client websites and external sources and share quarterly financial result summaries with the account team.
Manage content for account databases, websites, and SharePoint sites.
Collaborate with opportunity and data owners to ensure sales, pipeline, and revenue data hygiene.
Prepare Account meeting packs for account team discussions.
Understand organizational hierarchies and support account teams in developing client organization and account team charts.
Help maintain data quality with reference to EY tools such as Account Relationship Database, Global Financial Information System, and Customer Relationship Management.
Review, update, and validate critical links by collaborating with local teams.
Coordinate with account teams to understand the pre-employment screening process as part of compliance checks prior to initiating engagement with the clients.
Understand engagement contract documents for EY employees to precisely interpret with pre-employment screening guidelines.
Facilitate compliance with client mandated procurement requirements.
Identify existing processes for refinement using digital platforms, automation tools, and analytics.
Achieve operational excellence through the standardization of activities and best practice sharing.
Responsible for project management, quality control, review and sharing regular updates on tasks with the involved stakeholders.
Facilitate knowledge sharing.
Skills and Attributes for Success
Succinct and structured oral and written communication skills with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly and concisely, using appropriate analytics and visualization tools.
Experience in Microsoft tools like Excel and PowerPoint.
Stakeholder Management and Project Handling
Understand stakeholder requirements based on business context.
Manage and support initiatives, clarify objectives, priorities, scope changes, and timelines.
Soft Skills
Capability to resolve issues independently and in a team.
Strong needs analysis and stakeholder negotiation skills
Attention to detail and quality
Focus on achieving intended outcomes in a timely manner
Challenge insightfully and propose credible solutions.
Enjoy a team-based environment and respect others' opinions.
Willingness to learn new tools, technology, global developments, and processes.
Create a strong and positive rapport with leadership and team members.
Leadership and People Management
Take ownership and demonstrate self-sufficiency.
Demonstrate strong operational acumen to create impactful relationships with senior leadership.
Work in a dynamic environment with proven ability to multitask and prioritize effectively.
Proven ability to be a team player with exposure to working with multi-cultural teams and collaborating virtually.
Business acumen and commerciality.
Exhibit drive and determination to overcome internal and external barriers and get results from people.
Above average competencies in data analysis, business research, writing and presentation, Microsoft tools, communication, and diction.
Qualifications
To qualify for the role, you must have:
Any graduate degree with relevant experience.
Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.

Description:
The Global Operations Specialist plays a key role in supporting operational excellence across the Clients & Industries (C&I) organization. This role focuses on enabling strategic priorities, optimizing processes, and facilitating collaboration across domains, functions, and pods to deliver agility and impact.
The C&I organization has six Domains, each with individual needs and differing maturity: Insights, Industry, Demand Generation, Client Excellence, Sales & Commercial Excellence, and Enablement & Technology.
This position sits within the Business Enablement Business Management Office and supports the C&I organization through three key functions: Strategic Operations, Core Services, and Performance & Data Insights. Strategic Operations works through pods aligned to each of the six domains, working alongside Core Services and Performance & Data Insights to deliver seamless operational support and strategic execution.
Success in this model depends on agility-the ability to learn quickly, adapt as priorities change, and drive execution while staying responsive to evolving demands.
The primary stakeholder is the Domain Strategy Execution Leader, although this role will work with the Domain Leader and the rest of the Domain team.
Responsibilities Strategic Operations
Partner with leadership to help translate strategic objectives into actionable operational plans within the aligned domain.
Support the design and implementation of short- and long-term initiatives/projects that deliver on strategic priorities, monitoring progress against milestones.
Oversee domain-specific processes, driving clarity, consistency, and timely execution across stakeholders.
Prepare strategic inputs for leadership (e.g., decks), synthesizing content into clear narratives and recommendations to support decision-making.
Collaborate with the Strategic Operations Team Lead and counterparts, plus other Domain teams, to coordinate cross-domain priorities, ensuring operational delivery supports strategic impact.
Support performance monitoring and governance alongside Core Services.
Leverage Performance & Data Insights for analytics and intelligence to guide decisions and monitor impact.
Operational Excellence
Identify and drive efficiencies in relevant areas through automation, standardization, and best practices.
Assess emerging technologies and tools to enhance operational agility and responsiveness.
Promote a culture of continuous improvement within the Strategic Operations team.
Support governance forums and prepare executive-ready updates leveraging data analytics and reporting tools (e.g., Essentials, Dynamics, etc.) in coordination with Performance & Data Insights.
Drive quality and alignment with Core Services and Performance & Data Insights across domain processes, ensuring clarity in roles, handoffs, and workflows.
Assist with additional reporting and analysis requests, help manage stakeholder expectations, and reinforce self-service options.
Stakeholder Engagement
Build strong relationships across domains, functions, and pods to foster collaboration and alignment.
Act as a trusted advisor to leadership, providing recommendations based on operational insights.
Facilitate communication and coordination across domains, functions, and pods for smooth execution of initiatives.
Skills & Attributes for Success
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience in operational process creation, improvement, and handoff.
Proficiency in reporting tools, data visualization, and storyboarding to create impactful prompts for decision-making.
Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities, delivering high-quality outputs under tight timelines.
A client-focused mindset, with the ability to manage expectations and redirect activity as required.
Credible, with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills at Global/Area leadership level.
Resilient, embraces ambiguity, and comfortable working in a global, matrixed environment with evolving priorities.

Facilitate workshops and interviews with stakeholders to understand business requirements, HR processes, and reporting needs.

Direct reports

Fluent English speaker
