Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY - Manager - Cyber Security - OT Cybersecurity
Core Skills: OT Security, ICS/SCADA, Dragos, Nozomi, OT Risk Assessment, Industrial Cyber Resilience
The Opportunity
As part of our Cyber Technology Consulting practice, you will lead and deliver Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity engagements across clients in the MENA region, particularly within Energy, Oil Gas, Utilities, and Smart City ecosystems.
You will work with some of the region s most critical infrastructure operators to assess, design, and enhance their OT security posture, ensuring resilience against evolving cyber threats targeting industrial environments. The role provides the opportunity to operate at the intersection of industrial operations, cybersecurity, and digital transformation, while contributing to the growth of our OT Security competency
Your Key Responsibilities
Client Delivery Engagement Management
Lead and deliver OT cybersecurity engagements , including:
OT risk assessments and maturity assessments
Architecture and network segmentation reviews
Security posture evaluations across SCADA, DCS, PLC, HMI, and ICS environments
Perform OT-focused vulnerability assessments and exposure analysis in coordination with engineering and operations teams.
Implement and operationalize OT monitoring solutions including:
Dragos Platform
Nozomi Networks Guardian / Vantage
Design and validate OT detection and response capabilities , leveraging network traffic analysis, anomaly detection, and threat intelligence.
Conduct industrial threat modeling and risk quantification aligned to operational impact, safety, and business continuity considerations.
Develop OT cybersecurity roadmaps and transformation programs , aligned with frameworks such as:
IEC 62443
NIST SP 800-82
NCA (KSA) / regional regulatory frameworks
Support implementation of:
OT network segmentation (zones conduits)
Secure remote access for vendors and operators
OT-specific incident response and crisis management playbooks
Sector-Specific Advisory
Apply deep understanding of industrial processes and control systems across:
Energy and Power Generation
Oil Gas (Upstream, Midstream, Downstream)
Utilities (Water, Electricity Distribution, Smart Grids)
Smart Cities and Critical Infrastructure ecosystems
Align OT security recommendations with operational priorities such as safety, availability, reliability, and regulatory compliance .
Bridge the gap between engineering, operations, and IT/security teams , ensuring practical and implementable solutions.
Stakeholder Engagement Advisory
Act as a trusted advisor to CISOs, Plant Managers, OT Engineers, and Executive Leadership .
Translate complex technical issues into business, safety, and operational risk impacts .
Deliver executive-level briefings and technical deep-dives , tailored to diverse stakeholder groups.
Facilitate workshops, tabletop exercises, and scenario-based discussions for OT cyber resilience .
Practice Capability Development
Contribute to the growth of the OT Cybersecurity practice , including:
Development of methodologies, playbooks, and accelerators
Standardization of OT assessment frameworks and delivery artifacts
Support business development activities , including:
RFP/RFI responses
Client presentations and solution articulation
Thought leadership in OT cybersecurity and industrial resilience
Stay current with:
Emerging OT threats and attack campaigns
ICS vulnerabilities and adversary tactics
Evolving regulatory requirements across the MENA region
People Leadership Team Development
Lead, mentor, and develop a team of OT security consultants and specialists .
Build cross-functional capability across OT, IT, and cyber domains.
Drive a culture of technical excellence, safety awareness, and delivery quality .
Provide structured feedback, coaching, and career development aligned to firm objectives.
Skills and Attributes for Success
Strong understanding of OT/ICS cybersecurity principles , including security challenges unique to industrial environments.
Hands-on experience with OT security platforms , especially:
Dragos
Nozomi Networks
Deep knowledge of:
Industrial communication protocols ( Modbus, DNP3, OPC-UA, PROFINET, IEC 61850 )
OT asset visibility, anomaly detection, and network monitoring
Experience in installation, commissioning, FAT, and SAT of ICS systems like DCS, PLC, SCADA, and Network Devices in ICS Security related Projects.
Proven capability in conducting OT risk assessments , including:
Threat modeling
Risk quantification
Control gap analysis
Strong understanding of industrial processes and operational workflows across Energy, Oil Gas, Utilities, or Smart City environments.
Familiarity with IT/OT convergence risks , segmentation strategies, and secure architecture design.
Ability to communicate complex technical findings in a clear, business-impact context .
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience in managing large, multi-stream client engagements .
To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have:
Bachelor s or Master s degree in Cyber Security, Engineering (Electrical / Instrumentation / Industrial) , Information Technology , or related discipline.
10-15 years of experience , with at least 5-7 years in OT/ICS cybersecurity .
Proven hands-on experience with:
OT security assessments and architecture reviews
Deployment or use of Dragos and/or Nozomi platforms
OT risk and maturity assessments
Experience working with clients in Energy, Oil Gas, Utilities, or Smart Infrastructure sectors .
Strong consulting, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple engagements and deliver high-quality outcomes.
Willingness to travel across the MENA region , as required.
Ideally, You ll Also Have
Certifications such as:
GICSP (Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional)
ISA/IEC 62443 certifications
SANS ICS (GRID, ICS410, ICS515)
CISSP / CISM (added advantage)
Experience in:
OT incident response and forensic investigations
Industrial SOC / OT SOC design and implementation
Smart City cybersecurity architecture
Integration of OT with enterprise security tools (SIEM, SOAR, XDR)
Exposure to leading OT vendors such as:
Claroty, Dragos, Nozomi, Tenable.ot, Forescout etc.
What We Look For
We seek individuals who:
Have a growth mindset and bring a strong blend of OT domain knowledge and cybersecurity expertise
Can operate effectively across engineering, operations, and cybersecurity stakeholders
Demonstrate client-centricity, problem-solving, and solution-driven thinking
Are passionate about securing critical infrastructure and industrial ecosystems
Contribute to practice growth, innovation, and team development
The ability to balance deep technical expertise with business acumen
A collaborative approach to problem-solving and innovation
A commitment to quality, integrity, and continuous improvement

Job Summary
As a Learning Deployment Specialist within the GDS Talent Services - L&D Hub, you will coordinate the end-to-end deployment of learning programmes and projects for EY teams across regions and time zones. You will manage schedules, learning-system setup, logistics, budgets, compliance and stakeholder engagement, while producing virtual sessions as needed and delivering a consistent, high-quality learner experience in line with agreed service levels.
Responsibilities Learning and project deployment
Build initial course scheduling offering schedule for review
Submit requests to schedule offerings and to publish content in SuccessFactors
Support the end-to-end execution of Learning course deployment plans and budgets, including conference and event management including:
Arranging training material
Monitoring of participant nominations working alongside Deployment Administration Team
Management of learner cancellations, no shows and missed sessions, including coordinating training dates and nominations from different areas of the business
First point of contact for queries from the practice in relation to the courses assigned, in addition to ongoing management of learning mailboxes and referrals from Deployment Administration Team
Prepare facilitators for delivery of Learning courses (logistics) and support in the management of facilitators
Provide oversight of Learning Deployment administration activities, taking responsibility for the detailed review of work performed by the Deployment Administration Team assigned
Manage and maintain SharePoint sites and maintain content relevancy for SL, curriculum, program or course including joining instructions (if required), learner, facilitator information
Support the hosting and production of online modules, webcasts and virtual learning projects. Advise on best practice, for example interactivity during virtual classroom sessions
Virtual Producer role where Virtual Producer team can't support
Realise operational excellence through maintaining thorough understanding of, and adherence to, the Learning Deployment Operating Model
Ideas generation and rollout of networking elements within virtual learning programmes
Venue booking, accommodation booking for residential courses and ongoing management
Ensure CE credits awarded to Learning participants and instructors where applicable
Supporting on projects across the Learning and/or Leadership Development TD team(s) as required
Financial Management
Support the budget, accruals, forecasts, and actual costs of courses/projects you are responsible for.
Support all Finance related activities as per the Deployment model.
Support with monthly/annual finance activities/requests from Enablement/Operations team.
Stakeholder Relationships
Build and maintain close working relationships with onshore and offshore colleagues.
Build and maintain close working relationships with Deployment Administration team (where relevant).
Coach and support the Deployment Administration team to increase their knowledge, skills and competence within their role along with their understanding of the region, by providing transparent and supportive feedback.
Develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders relevant for courses and client groups to enable the successful deployment. Stakeholders may include Deployment Administration Team, Portfolio Managers, Senior Learning Associates, Learning Associates, Enablement team, Service Line Talent Development Teams, Global Deployment Team, Facilitators, external suppliers.
Measure Learning
Access reports on Learning course L1L3 evaluation feedback and analyse feedback from course participants to continually improve course offerings.
Accurate reporting and tracking of course consumption and satisfaction reporting.
Continuous Improvement
Document lessons learned and refine deployment processes.
Stay updated on SuccessFactors features and best practices in learning deployment.
Generate new ideas/suggest improvements/possible solutions.
Team
Contribute to other activities or projects across wider Talent Development functions.
Support the induction of new team members.
Skills and Attributes for Success To qualify for the role you must have:
Strong project management skills to deliver and ensure seamless execution of portfolio tasks.
Proactive problem solver with a solutions mindset, willing to adjust work schedules as necessary to meet peak demands and customer requirements.
Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
Strong IT skills, particularly in the Microsoft Office 365 suite, including Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and SharePoint. There will be a test to determine your knowledge.
Experience in using Power BI, PowerApps, and an openness to learn and use AI will be preferred.
Strong written and oral communication skills and ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels.
Strong team worker, with enthusiastic, can-do approach, with ability to coordinate and work as one team.
Commercial acumen and business awareness.
Commitment to driving and delivering quality services and products to Talent, ensuring high standards are met.
Ability to learn new processes and skills quickly, adapting to changing environments and priorities.
Ability to engage and influence others, demonstrating good change management skills and a desire to drive process improvements.

Description:
EY Cyber Security Manager Data Protection and Privacy Platforms Engineering
Job Listing Detail
At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. Were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
The Opportunity
Were looking for a Manager in our Cyber Security team with a strong focus on Data Protection and Privacy Platforms Engineering. This role is centered on the implementation, engineering, integration, and administration of enterprise scale data protection and privacy technologies, helping organizations protect sensitive data across endpoints, networks, cloud, applications, and AI enabled platforms.
You will work closely with clients to design and operationalize Data Loss Prevention (DLP), data discovery and classification, privacy management platforms, and privacy enhancing technologies (PETs)enabling compliant, secure, and trusted use of data in modern digital and AI driven environments.
Your Key Responsibilities
Lead the design, implementation, and engineering of enterprise data protection and privacy platforms, including DLP, data discovery, classification, and privacy tooling.
Implement and administer Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solutions across endpoint, email, network, cloud, and SaaS environments.
Design and operationalize data discovery and data classification programs, enabling visibility into sensitive data across structured and unstructured sources.
Engineer and integrate privacy platforms supporting consent management, data subject rights (DSR/DSAR), records of processing, and privacy workflows.
Implement and support Privacy Enhancing Technologies (PETs) such as tokenization, pseudonymization, anonymization, encryption, and data masking.
Integrate data protection and privacy platforms with cloud, data, and AI ecosystems, including data lakes, analytics platforms, and AI/ML pipelines.
Manage Microsoft Purview Information Protection (Labeling) for data classification, sensitivity labeling, and policy enforcement
Configure and manage policy driven controls aligned with regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, regional privacy laws) and organizational data governance standards.
Conduct platform configuration reviews, tuning, and optimization to improve effectiveness and reduce false positives.
Support incident response and investigations related to data leakage, privacy breaches, and policy violations.
Collaborate with security architecture, cloud, data, legal, and compliance teams to ensure end to end data protection.
Develop operational runbooks, technical documentation, and standard operating procedures for privacy and data protection platforms.
Mentor and guide junior engineers and consultants, fostering strong engineering and operational discipline.
Engage with client stakeholders to translate privacy and data protection requirements into practical, implementable technical solutions.
Skills and Attributes for Success
Strong hands on experience in data protection and privacy platforms engineering.
Deep understanding of data discovery, data classification, and data lifecycle controls.
Strong knowledge of DLP architectures and policy design across endpoint, cloud, and SaaS.
Experience implementing privacy enhancing technologies (PETs) and data security controls.
Ability to work across cloud, data, and AI environments, supporting secure data usage.
Strong troubleshooting and problem solving skills in complex, enterprise environments.
Ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, privacy officers, and business stakeholders.
Consulting mindset with the ability to manage multiple client engagements and priorities.
To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have
1014 years of experience in Information Security, with strong focus on Data Protection, Privacy Engineering, or Platform Implementation.
Hands on experience implementing and administering DLP solutions (endpoint, email, cloud, network).
Experience with data discovery and classification technologies across structured and unstructured data.
Practical experience with privacy platforms supporting DSAR/DSR, consent, and privacy workflows.
Strong understanding of data protection controls such as encryption, key management, tokenization, and masking.
Experience working in hybrid and cloud environments.
Relevant certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPM, CISSP, or equivalent are an advantage.
Ideally, Youll Also Have
Experience working in a consulting or professional services environment.
Exposure to AI and analytics platforms, with focus on protecting sensitive training and inference data.
Familiarity with global privacy regulations and how they translate into technical controls.
Experience integrating privacy and data protection platforms with SIEM/SOAR or SOC processes.
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trusted client relationships.
A proactive, hands on approach to solving complex data protection challenges.
What We Look For
Professionals with a strong engineering and implementation mindset, not just advisory knowledge.
Ability to lead data protection and privacy platform delivery for complex enterprise clients.
Comfort engaging with CISOs, DPOs, Legal, Data, and Cloud teams.
Experience in RFP responses, solution design, effort estimation, and go to market activities is a plus.
Passion for enabling secure, compliant, and trusted use of data in modern digital and AI driven organizations.

Oracle Fusion - Project Financials Functional - Manager Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Project Financials Functional Manager with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience and strong project accounting and financial management expertise. A qualified Chartered Accountant with relevant post-qualification experience is mandatory. The role requires extensive hands-on implementation and leadership experience across Project Foundation, Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Contracts and Project Control, including budgeting, forecasting, cost collection, burdening, capitalization, intercompany and interproject processing, invoicing, revenue recognition, accounting, period close and reconciliation. The successful candidate will lead functional delivery, solution design, finance stakeholder workshops and project teams while remaining actively involved in configuration, testing, deployment and post-go-live support.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities
Lead end-to-end Oracle Fusion Project Financials implementations, rollouts, upgrades and support engagements, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.
Provide hands-on functional leadership across Project Foundation, Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Contracts and Project Control.
Analyse project accounting and financial management requirements and map them to standard Oracle Fusion Cloud processes and controls.
Design project organizations, project units, templates, classifications, expenditure types, transaction sources, burden schedules, rate schedules, budgets, forecasts, billing plans, revenue methods and accounting options.
Lead cost collection, cost allocation, burdening, capitalization, project asset creation, intercompany and interproject billing, customer invoicing, revenue recognition and project close solution design.
Lead fit-to-standard workshops, requirement gathering, process design, solution walkthroughs and finance stakeholder sign-offs.
Prepare and review functional design documents, configuration workbooks, process flows, test scripts, reconciliation templates, training materials and operating procedures.
Manage integrations with General Ledger, Receivables, Payables, Fixed Assets, Procurement, Expenses, Time and Labor, HCM, EPM and external applications.
Drive CRP, SIT, UAT, data migration, cutover, go-live and hypercare activities, including project cost, revenue, invoice and accounting reconciliation and defect resolution.
Validate subledger accounting, accounting distributions, period close, project-to-ledger reconciliation and project performance reporting.
Manage scope, estimates, plans, risks, issues, dependencies, quality, governance and senior stakeholder communication.
Lead, mentor and review the work of functional consultants while collaborating with finance, technical, integration, data and reporting teams.
Experience
Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in Oracle Projects, Project Accounting or Project Financial Management, including substantial hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Financials.
Qualified Chartered Accountant with relevant post-qualification experience in project accounting, financial control, audit, revenue, costing or management accounting is mandatory.
Strong implementation and support experience across Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Contracts, Project Control and Project Foundation.
Deep knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, cost collection, allocations, burdening, capitalization, project assets, invoicing, revenue recognition, accounting, period close and reconciliation.
Experience in at least three full lifecycle Oracle Projects or Project Financials implementations, including at least two Oracle Fusion Cloud implementations.
Proven experience leading Project Financials workstreams, client workshops, solution design, testing, data migration, cutover, period close, reconciliation and post-go-live support.
Experience with integrations across General Ledger, Receivables, Payables, Fixed Assets, Procurement, Expenses, Time and Labor, HCM and EPM.
Experience in client-facing delivery, project planning, effort estimation, team management and senior stakeholder communication.
Experience in project-centric sectors such as engineering and construction, professional services, energy, real estate, oil and gas, government, or power and utilities is preferred.
Competencies / Skills
Strong Oracle Fusion Project Financials functional, project accounting, financial control and team leadership skills.
Ability to lead Project Financials workstreams independently, work under pressure and meet deadlines.
Sound understanding of accounting standards, project costing, revenue recognition, capitalization, subledger accounting, period close and financial reconciliation.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate finance and business requirements into functional designs.
Excellent organizational, analytical, reconciliation, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Ability to assess financial process and control implications and apply sound professional judgement.
Ability to drive delivery governance, quality reviews, release priorities and team development.
Must have a valid passport for business travel involving work at client sites and be willing to work MENA shift timings (Sunday to Thursday).
Education
Mandatory qualification: Qualified Chartered Accountant from a recognised professional accounting body, with relevant post-qualification experience.
Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Management or Project Financial Management certification is preferred.

Job Summary
We are seeking an initiative-taking and experienced Oracle Fusion Human Capital Management, Talent, Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC) and Benefits, Functional Senior Consultant to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of Oracle Core HCM, Talent, ORC and Benefits modules, extensive functional expertise, and a proven ability to deliver successful implementations and support in a consulting environment.

Manage and support internal KPIs, Oracle Fusion HCM Talent, ORC and Benefits implementation projects, including requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, and deployment, while continuing to support Oracle Core HR implementation priorities.
Should be able to interpret functional requirements and able to deliver and design it from onsite and offshore. If required, ready to travel to onsite
Provide functional expertise in Oracle Fusion HCM modules, with primary focus on Talent Management, Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC) and Benefits, including Core HR, Global Human Resources and know-how in Talent Management
Collaborate with clients to understand their business processes and requirements and provide recommendations for improvements and optimizations. Conduct fit-gap analysis, configuration, functional design documentation, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
Identify and mitigate system risks by evaluating functional and cross-functional dependencies, proactively recommend process improvements based on best practices.
Develop and maintain project documentation using AIM / OUM / TCM / Agile or other prescribed methodologies, including functional specifications, test plans, and user guides.
Drive and assist business users during Prototype/CRPs/SITs/UATs/KUTs and Prepare test scripts and test cases & conduct trainings.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Oracle Core HCM, Talent, ORC, Benefits providing timely and effective support to clients.

Guide junior consultants, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented work environment.

Minimum 5 years of relevant experience working in ERP HR modules (Fusion) in Oracle Core Human Resource, Talent, ORC and Benefits in implementation and support, with focus on functional consulting.

In-depth knowledge of Oracle Fusion HCM suite, and its integration with other Oracle applications suits.
Ready to work either from the onsite and offshore, manage delivery independently.
Experience in costing and integration with Manpower planning or Attendance systems is nice to have
Familiarity with Oracle Reporting Tools (OTBI, BI Publisher) and integrations using HCM Extracts

Experience in any of the major industry sectors like Retail, Government, Energy, Real Estate, Oil & Gas, Power & Utilities and Finance & Banking

Strong customer handling skills and ability to lead & mentor team-members
Ability to drive projects along with the team and independently
Strong communication skills and ability to translate requirements into design documents.
Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines
Excellent organizational and time management skills, strong analytical & problem-solving skills
Ability to acquire, absorb, and apply complex business knowledge to problems quickly
Ability to work as part of a team
Ability to follow well defined release management processes
Ability to multitask and still stay focused on release priorities
Must have valid passport.
Willing to work in MENA Shift timings (Sunday to Thursday).
Client site work / Business Traveling involve
Education
Should be a graduate with an MBA in HRMS/HCM and preferably with Oracle certification and having professional certification (e.g., SHRM, HRCI) is a plus

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Project Portfolio Management (PPM) and Finance Functional Senior with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience and sound project management and project financials domain knowledge. The role requires hands-on implementation and support experience across Project Foundation, Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Control ,Project Contracts and Finance modules, with exposure to Project Execution Management, Project Resource Management, Grants Management and capital projects preferred. The successful candidate will independently deliver assigned functional areas and actively support requirement gathering, configuration, testing, deployment and post-go-live activities.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities
Deliver assigned Oracle Fusion PPM functional areas across implementations, rollouts, upgrades and support engagements.
Configure and support Project Foundation, Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Control and Project Contracts, Finance Modules (Accounts Payables, General Ledger) with exposure to other PPM modules preferred.
Analyse project management and project accounting requirements and map them to standard Oracle Fusion Cloud PPM processes.
Configure project organizations, project units, templates, classifications, expenditure structures, burden schedules, rate schedules, budgets, forecasts, billing plans and revenue methods under solution lead guidance.
Participate in fit-to-standard workshops, requirement gathering, process design and solution walkthroughs.
Prepare functional design documents, configuration workbooks, process flows, test scripts, training materials and operating procedures.
Support PPM integrations with Financials, Procurement, HCM, Time and Labor, Expenses, Supply Chain, EPM, reporting and external applications.
Execute CRP, SIT, UAT, data migration, cutover, go-live and hypercare activities, including project cost reconciliation and defect resolution.
Validate cost collection, capitalization, burdening, budgeting, forecasting, invoicing, revenue recognition and project performance reporting.
Track assigned activities, risks, issues, dependencies and deliverables, and provide timely status updates.
Collaborate with functional, technical, integration, data, finance and reporting teams and support junior consultants as required.
Experience
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Oracle Projects or Project Portfolio Management, including hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud PPM and Oracle FInancils
Strong implementation or support experience in Project Foundation, Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Control and Project Contracts.
Good understanding of project lifecycle and project financial management concepts, including planning, budgeting, forecasting, cost collection, burdening, capitalization, billing, revenue recognition and performance reporting.
Experience in at least two full lifecycle Oracle Projects or PPM implementations, including at least one Oracle Fusion Cloud PPM implementation.
Hands-on experience in requirement analysis, configuration, testing, data migration, cutover and post-go-live support.
Exposure to PPM integrations with Financials, Procurement, HCM, Time and Labor, Expenses, SCM or EPM is preferred.
Experience in client-facing delivery, documentation, issue resolution and stakeholder communication.
Experience in project-centric sectors such as government, engineering and construction, professional services, energy, real estate, oil and gas, or power and utilities is preferred.
Competencies / Skills
Strong Oracle Fusion PPM functional, customer handling and teamwork skills.
Ability to independently manage assigned PPM work areas, work under pressure and meet deadlines.
Good knowledge of project management, project accounting and project financial control processes.
Effective communication skills and ability to translate business requirements into functional documentation.
Strong organizational, time management, analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to learn complex business processes and apply knowledge effectively.
Ability to follow defined delivery and release management processes and remain focused on priorities.
Must have a valid passport for business travel involving work at client sites and be willing to work MENA shift timings (Sunday to Thursday).
Awareness of AI applications in project portfolio management, including automation, predictive analytics and AI-driven project insights.
Education
Mandatory qualification: Bachelors or masters degree in engineering, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Project Management or a related discipline from a recognised institution.
Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Management certification is preferred; PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent project management certification is an advantage.

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation (ARCS) Senior Consultant with strong hands-on expertise in Reconciliation Compliance, high-volume Transaction Matching, reconciliation governance, reporting, integrations and automation. The role will support solution design and independently deliver application configuration, data loads, matching rules, workflow, testing, deployment, documentation and production support under the guidance of project leadership.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities
Participate in end-to-end Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation implementations, rollouts, enhancements and support engagements.
Conduct requirement-gathering and design discussions; document reconciliation, control, compliance and transaction-matching requirements.
Configure Reconciliation Compliance, including periods, calendars, currencies, organisational units, attributes, formats, profiles, reconciliation methods, risk ratings and workflow.
Configure preparer and reviewer assignments, tolerances, variance analysis, auto-reconciliation, ageing, alerts, notifications, attachments, comments, electronic sign-offs and audit evidence.
Design Transaction Matching solutions using multiple data sources, match types, transaction types, one-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-one and many-to-many rules, tolerance logic and date or amount adjustments.
Configure and tune auto-match rules, suggested matches, manual matching, adjustments, unmatched-item ageing, exception handling and reconciliation integration.
Develop balance-sheet, intercompany, bank, cash, subledger-to-ledger, system-to-system and operational reconciliation use cases.
Create and support operational and compliance dashboards, predefined and custom reports, reconciliation-status reporting, ageing analysis, match-rate monitoring and exception reporting.
Develop and support integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, E-Business Suite, SAP, FCCS, banks, subledgers, data warehouses and external systems using Data Integration, EPM Automate, REST APIs and file-based interfaces.
Automate profile imports, balance and transaction loads, currency rates, reconciliation creation, auto-match execution, period-status changes, journal exports, reporting and job monitoring.
Execute CRP, SIT, UAT, data migration, reconciliation-cycle validation, volume and performance testing, cutover, go-live and hypercare; investigate defects and support root-cause resolution.
Prepare configuration workbooks, functional and technical specifications, match-rule designs, test scripts, training materials, operating procedures and deployment documentation.
Support security, segregation of duties, reconciliation policies, audit trails, evidence retention, data lineage, controls and production-support procedures.
Collaborate with finance, controllership, audit and technical teams; guide junior consultants, participate in peer reviews and support demonstrations and estimations.
Experience
Minimum 5+ years of Oracle EPM, finance transformation or account-reconciliation experience, including strong hands-on Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation experience.
At least two full-lifecycle Oracle EPM implementations, including one ARCS implementation covering Reconciliation Compliance and Transaction Matching.
Strong knowledge of balance-sheet reconciliation, account substantiation, reconciliation governance, risk-based workflow, variance analysis and financial-close controls.
Hands-on experience with periods, formats, profiles, rules, currencies, organisational units, workflow, auto-reconciliation, ageing and dashboards.
Hands-on Transaction Matching experience with data sources, match types, matching rules, adjustments, exceptions, auto-match optimisation and high-volume data sets.
Experience integrating ARCS with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP or other source systems and automating processes through Data Integration, EPM Automate and REST APIs.
Experience supporting workshops, configuration, testing, migration, reconciliation-cycle validation, cutover, go-live and post-production support.
Industry experience in government, retail, energy, real estate, oil and gas, financial services, or power and utilities is preferred.
Competencies / Skills
Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation configuration, administration and connected financial-close processes
Reconciliation Compliance, periods, formats, profiles, workflow, risk ratings, ageing, auto-reconciliation and audit evidence
Transaction Matching data sources, match types, rules, tolerances, adjustments, exceptions and match-performance optimisation
Balance-sheet, intercompany, bank, cash, subledger-to-ledger, system-to-system and operational reconciliations
Operational and compliance dashboards, predefined and custom reports, ageing, variance, status and exception analysis
Data Integration, EPM Automate, REST APIs, Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, FCCS and third-party ERP, bank and subledger integrations
Security, segregation of duties, controls, audit trails, evidence retention, data lineage and compliance reporting
Awareness of Predictive AI, Reconciliation Assignment Assistance, Transaction Matching Assistance, confidence scores, anomaly detection and governed human review is desirable
Strong accounting, analytical, problem-solving, requirement analysis, documentation and stakeholder communication skills
Strong teamwork, mentoring and delivery capabilities; willingness to travel and work MENA business timings
Education
CA, CMA, ACCA, MBA Finance or an equivalent finance/business qualification is preferred.
Relevant Oracle Cloud EPM Account Reconciliation certification is preferred; accounting, audit, controls, integration or reporting credentials are advantageous.

Description:
Oracle Fusion - Project Financials Functional - Senior Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Project Financials Functional Senior with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience and strong project accounting and financial management expertise. Chartered Accountant qualification is mandatory. The role requires hands-on implementation and support experience across Project Foundation, Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Contracts and Project Control, including budgeting, forecasting, cost collection, burdening, capitalization, intercompany and interproject processing, invoicing, revenue recognition, accounting and reconciliation. The successful candidate will independently deliver assigned functional areas and support requirement gathering, configuration, testing, deployment and post-go-live activities.
Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities
Deliver assigned Oracle Fusion Project Financials functional areas across implementations, rollouts, upgrades and support engagements.
Configure and support Project Foundation, Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Contracts and Project Control.
Analyse project accounting and financial management requirements and map them to standard Oracle Fusion Cloud processes and controls.
Configure project organizations, project units, templates, classifications, expenditure types, transaction sources, burden schedules, rate schedules, budgets, forecasts, billing plans, revenue methods and accounting options.
Support cost collection, cost allocation, burdening, capitalization, project asset creation, intercompany and interproject billing, customer invoicing, revenue recognition and project close processes.
Participate in fit-to-standard workshops, requirement gathering, process design, solution walkthroughs and finance stakeholder discussions.
Prepare functional design documents, configuration workbooks, process flows, test scripts, reconciliation templates, training materials and operating procedures.
Support integrations with General Ledger, Receivables, Payables, Fixed Assets, Procurement, Expenses, Time and Labor, HCM, EPM and external applications.
Execute CRP, SIT, UAT, data migration, cutover, go-live and hypercare activities, including project cost, revenue, invoice and accounting reconciliation and defect resolution.
Validate subledger accounting, accounting distributions, period close, project-to-ledger reconciliation and project performance reporting.
Collaborate with finance, functional, technical, integration, data and reporting teams and support junior consultants as required.
Experience
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Oracle Projects, Project Accounting or Project Financial Management, including hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Financials.
Chartered Accountant qualification and relevant post-qualification experience in project accounting, financial control, audit, revenue, costing or management accounting are mandatory.
Strong implementation or support experience in Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Contracts, Project Control and Project Foundation.
Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, cost collection, allocations, burdening, capitalization, project assets, invoicing, revenue recognition, accounting and reconciliation.
Experience in at least two full lifecycle Oracle Projects or Project Financials implementations, including at least one Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation.
Hands-on experience in requirement analysis, configuration, testing, data migration, cutover, period close, reconciliation and post-go-live support.
Experience with integrations across General Ledger, Receivables, Payables, Fixed Assets, Procurement, Expenses, Time and Labor, HCM or EPM is preferred.
Experience in project-centric sectors such as engineering and construction, professional services, energy, real estate, oil and gas, government, or power and utilities is preferred.
Competencies / Skills
Strong Oracle Fusion Project Financials functional, project accounting and financial control skills.
Ability to independently manage assigned Project Financials work areas, work under pressure and meet deadlines.
Sound understanding of accounting standards, project costing, revenue recognition, capitalization, subledger accounting, period close and financial reconciliation.
Effective communication skills and ability to translate finance and business requirements into functional documentation.
Strong organizational, analytical, reconciliation, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to assess financial process and control implications and apply sound professional judgement.
Ability to follow defined delivery, governance and release management processes and remain focused on priorities.
Must have a valid passport for business travel involving work at client sites and be willing to work MENA shift timings (Sunday to Thursday).
Education
Mandatory qualification: Qualified Chartered Accountant from a recognised professional accounting body, with relevant post-qualification experience.
Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Management or Project Financial Management certification is preferred.

Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving overall code quality.

Stay updated with industry trends and emerging technologies to enhance front-end development practices.

Job Requirements


Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and related frameworks such as React or Angular.

Experience with PHP, including object-oriented programming concepts and database management systems like MySQL.

Strong understanding of front-end development principles, including responsive design and accessibility guidelines.

Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex issues and provide creative solutions.

Effective communication and teamwork skills, with experience working collaboratively in an agile environment.

Description:
Job Summary
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY GDS Creative Center of Excellence (CoE) is an inhouse agency that helps EY teams build a better working world by delivering high-impact, high-quality and on-brand creative solutions. People in the CoE help create experiences that are not just creatively inspiring, but also strategically precise and deeply human - across multiple media platforms.
As a Senior Associate - Senior Document Specialist, you ideate and deliver best-in-class creatives that intrinsically align with the EY brand and business objectives. You liaise with workflow coordinators, art director, and content teams to render creative concepts strategically and tactically into effective collaterals (MS-based applications). You have an astute understanding of design principles and highly refined sense of aesthetics. So, you comfortably work within the brand specifications, yet push the boundaries to deliver compelling and inspiring creative solutions to customers.


Your key responsibilities
Conceptualize and produce collaterals such as placemats, infographics, presentations, proposals, newsletters, posters, banners, and other marketing collaterals using MS-based applications
Communicate effectively with customers while understanding design briefs and sharing ideas
Provide unique, innovative, and effective solutions/design concepts to customers

Description:
Job Summary
SAP CPI Senior 1,2 TechOps (Application Management) Consultant
We are looking for an SAP CPI Senior to join the EY GDS - SAP TechOps Team. As part of our EY GDS - TechOps team, you will be responsible for the development, maintenance and optimization of our SAP CPI solutions in alignment with our business objectives in a multi-region environment. You will collaborate closely with cross functional teams to address issues, implement enhancements, and optimize applications to deliver seamless global operations support to global clients.


Responsibilities
Provide day to day Application Management support for SAP Applications across IT Service Management including service requests, incident management, enhancement requests as Level 2 Application Management Specialist
Provide level 2 support for SAP CPI/PIPO development activities including customizations, enhancements, and bug fixes across multiple SAP environments troubleshooting and resolving issues related to customer CPI developments and SAP System Performance
Collaborate with functional consultants to gather requirements for incidents, enhancements and problems and translate them into technical solutions
Perform Debugging and Testing to ensure the quality of CPI/PI/PO developments
Support system integration testing, user acceptance testing and production deployment of CPI/PI/PO objects
Document technical specifications, code changes and implementation details for knowledge sharing and future reference
Keep abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies and SAP best practices to contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
Participate in on-call rotation and provide off hours support as needed to ensure the availability and reliability of critical SAP systems.
Available to work on shift hours depending on the requirement of the client
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


Skills and attributes for success
Bachelor's degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences.
Minimum of 5-7 years working experience in SAP CPI/PI/PO development with a focus on level 2 support
Proven experience in designing complex integrations, cloud applications, and security architectures.
Sound experience in Design and implement complex, end-to-end integration scenarios using SAP BTP Integration Suite (CPI, API Management, Event Mesh).
Upto 3 years of SAP PI/PO/CPI experience participation as a lead person responsible for integration design and implementation in at least two full-cycle SAP projects or roll-outs
Strong skills in SAP PI/PO/CPI Design, Configuration, and Administration
Good hands-on knowledge of Java, XSLT Mapping, Java mapping, Groovy Scripts Support integration projects through various phases from gathering business requirements to go-live and post-implementation support
Good Understanding of Business processes and Create and maintain end-to-end functional designs for interfaces
Suggest improvements to current operational procedures within integration environment good knowledge of integration technologies and specific SAP Integration architecture
Strong Knowledge of using IDOC, RFC, JDBC, File, ABAP Proxy, SOAP, HTTP, REST, SFTP, SuccessFactors
Knowledge of SAP BPM/BRM Design, Build, Monitoring and troubleshooting
Strong Knowledge of SAP Cloud Platform services like CPI-DS, SDI, Open Connectors, Persistence
Strong analytical and problem solving skills with good attention to detail
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate

Prepare ingredients for cooking, including portioning, chopping, and storing food. Wash and peel fresh fruits and vegetables. Weigh, measure, and mix ingredients. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklist. Prepare cold foods. Operate ovens, stoves, grills, microwaves, and fryers. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

License or Certification: None

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Role #1 - CI Support, Senior Analyst
The Opportunity
To join a high-performing multi-national team within the Global RDA, providing financial reporting, analytics, and insights support in response to strategic and ad hoc business requests. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with senior stakeholders in the Global Clients Industries (CI) organization, helping drive informed decision-making through the delivery of high-quality information and actionable insights.
What we look for
We are seeking a Senior Analyst with 10+ years of experience in professional services, or other leading global organizations, to take a senior role within the Global RDA s Leadership Reporting Pillar.
The successful candidate will be responsible for delivering accurate, timely, insightful and commercially-focused reporting and analysis to support business decision-making in EY s Global CI organization.
They will possess strong technical expertise, the ability to understand complex commercial finance concepts, and the confidence to engage effectively with senior stakeholders.
The ideal candidate will:
Demonstrate a strong understanding of commercial financial reporting and analysis.
Be capable of working independently while collaborating effectively within a team environment.
Have excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Be proactive, inquisitive, and focused on continuous improvement.
Thrive in a fast-paced environment managing multiple priorities and competing deadlines simultaneously.
Display curiosity and initiative, with a continuous improvement mindset seeking opportunities to enhance processes and report impact.
Take ownership of deliverables ensuring a high standard of quality, accuracy and timeliness.
Collaborate effectively within a geographically diverse team environment.
Key responsibilities
Ensure the timely and accurate delivery of all regular reports they have responsibility for, managing updates and enhancements as required.
Support leadership and business stakeholders with data-driven insights in response to ad hoc requests.
Demonstrate the confidence to ask the right questions of stakeholders and colleagues to ensure outputs align with business requirements and stakeholder expectations.
Develop a deep understanding of the EY reporting portfolio and be able to confidently explain complex technical and business reporting logic to stakeholders.
Communicate findings clearly and concisely both verbally and in writing.
Reconcile data from multiple sources and investigate variances to ensure consistency and accuracy of outputs.
Stakeholder management
Act as a trusted business advisor to finance colleagues and business stakeholders.
Understand business requirements and provide analytical support for strategic initiatives.
Present findings and recommendations in a clear and concise manner.
Manage stakeholder expectations and provide regular updates on priorities, timelines and deliverables.
Continuous improvement
Drive process improvement initiatives to enhance reporting efficiency, data quality, automation and stakeholder experience.
Document reporting processes, methodologies, and business logic.
Lead the development, testing and deployment of new reporting tools and technologies.
Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise and automate processes.
Technical skill set
Design and develop SQL queries to extract, manipulate and analyse large datasets for reporting and analytical purposes.
Interpret and troubleshoot complex SQL queries written by others.
Advanced experience developing reports and dashboards using Power BI.
Advanced Excel skills including complex formulas, data modelling, and automation.
Experience working with large financial and operational datasets.
Understanding of concepts such as Wins, Pipeline, Backlog, Revenue, Margin.
Skills and attributes for success
Excellent listening, consultative, influencing and communication skills
Strong curiosity and awareness of emerging business and technology trends.
Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
Effective prioritization, delegation, multitasking and attention to detail.
Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business language.
A proactive, customer-focused approach with a continuous improvement mindset.
EY | Building a better working world


EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Discipline Design for Technology
Role Type Visual Design
The opportunity
EY GDS Creative Center of Excellence (CoE) is an inhouse agency that helps EY teams build a better working world by delivering high-impact, high-quality and on-brand creative solutions. People in the CoE help create experiences that are not just creatively inspiring, but also strategically precise and deeply human - across multiple media platforms.
As an Associate - Graphic Design, you ideate and deliver best-in-class creatives that intrinsically align with the EY brand and business objectives. You liaise with workflow coordinators, art director, and content teams to render creative concepts strategically and tactically into effective collaterals (MS-based applications, print and interactive collaterals). Your primary work involves creating design solutions for impactful proposals, illustrations, layouts and enhanced user experiences, across multiple streams. You have an astute understanding of design principles and highly refined sense of aesthetics. So, you comfortably work within the brand specifications, yet push the boundaries to deliver compelling and inspiring creative solutions to customers.
Your key responsibilities
Design branding materials, such as brochures, placemats, illustrations, layouts, infographics, on-screen presentations, proposals and social media collaterals
Adhere to EY brand guidelines, meet and exceed defined expectations in terms of aesthetics, quality, turnaround time and efficiency
Stay up to date with latest design trends, socialize the same to peers
Prioritize deadlines and effectively manage multiple creative projects parallelly
Communicate effectively with customers while understanding design briefs and sharing ideas
Provide unique and innovative design solutions to customers and convince them to make the right design choices
Be responsive to customers on calls and emails
Be a part and contribute towards various organizational initiatives
Skills and attributes for success
A user-centric mindset with creative, innovative, and analytical approach
Flawless typography skills and keen sense of balance and intuition when it comes to layout
Excellent communication (comprehension, verbal and written) and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate and persuade
Exceptional attention to detail
Ability to interact effectively and positively in a fast-paced environment
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor s degree or college diploma (preferably in Graphic Design or related discipline)
Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe InDesign and Adobe Document Cloud (Interactive Media)
Strong visual design capability
1-4 years of relevant experience
Ideally, you ll also have
Preferable knowledge of Adobe After effects, Premier Pro and motion graphics skills
Technologies and Tools
Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe InDesign and Adobe Document Cloud (Interactive Media)
What we look for
Passion to tell stories through the power of visuals
Creative problem-solving mindset with a flexible can-do attitude
Self-starter with the ability to understand and translate verbal ideas into impactful, cohesive outputs
Hands-on experience in developing brochures, newsletters, flyers, banners, business presentations, animated presentations, and various types of marketing collaterals
Experience working with global clients
Confidence, maturity, and ability to build strong client relationships
A strong team player who is comfortable working collaboratively with others
What we offer
EY GDS is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies, and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to creative consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Application Vulnerability Compliance SME
Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced Application Compliance SME to drive vulnerability, patching, and lifecycle compliance across enterprise application technologies hosted on Windows and Linux environments.
This is not a hands-on application installation, configuration, or administration role. The SME will focus on identifying compliance risks, coordinating remediation with application and platform owners, driving patch and upgrade programs, improving visibility through automation, and ensuring vulnerabilities and End-of-Life/End-of-Support components are remediated within defined timelines.
Key Responsibilities
Own and coordinate application vulnerability and patch compliance activities across web, middleware, runtime, and application components.
Assess environments to identify technologies such as Microsoft IIS, Apache HTTP Server, Apache Tomcat, NGINX, PHP, Node.js, Java/JDK, .NET/ASP.NET, and related application components.
Review installed versions and inventories to identify:
Security vulnerabilities
Missing patches or security updates
End-of-Life (EOL) and End-of-Support (EOS) components
Unsupported or obsolete software versions
Components requiring upgrade or modernization
Analyze vulnerability findings, vendor advisories, CVEs, severity ratings, product applicability, and available remediation options to determine the appropriate compliance action.
Coordinate remediation with application owners, platform teams, infrastructure teams, and security teams, ensuring clear ownership and tracking through closure.
Drive application owners to assess application compatibility and dependencies before upgrades to PHP, Node.js, Java/JDK, Tomcat, .NET, web servers, and other application components.
Define and maintain remediation plans, priorities, target dates, exceptions, dependencies, and risk tracking for outstanding vulnerabilities.
Coordinate patching and upgrade campaigns for application technologies without directly performing application installation, configuration, or production changes.
Develop and implement automation for vulnerability identification, inventory validation, compliance tracking, reporting, and remediation coordination using technologies such as PowerShell, Bash/Shell, or other automation platforms.
Correlate information from vulnerability management, software inventory, patching, CMDB, and application ownership data sources to improve accuracy and identify compliance gaps.
Track application components against vendor-supported versions and proactively identify technologies approaching EOL/EOS.
Support risk assessment and exception management where remediation cannot be completed within required timelines.
Monitor remediation progress and produce compliance dashboards, metrics, ageing reports, risk summaries, and leadership updates.
Identify recurring compliance gaps and recommend opportunities for automation, standardization, process improvement, and preventive controls.
Maintain application technology inventories, compliance standards, remediation procedures, and supporting documentation.
Support Incident, Change, Problem, Risk, and Vulnerability Management processes where application compliance is impacted.
Act as the SME and coordination point between Security, Infrastructure, Platform, and Application teams for application technology vulnerabilities and lifecycle compliance.
Core Technical Knowledge
The candidate should have strong working knowledge of:
Web and application platforms
Microsoft IIS
Apache HTTP Server
Apache Tomcat
NGINX
Application runtimes and frameworks
PHP
Node.js
Java/JDK
.NET / ASP.NET
Operating environments
Windows Server
Linux / RHEL
Vulnerability and lifecycle management
CVE and CVSS interpretation
Vendor security advisories
Patch and vulnerability assessment
EOL/EOS identification
Application dependency and compatibility assessment
Risk and exception management
Remediation tracking and compliance reporting
Automation and data analysis
PowerShell
Bash/Shell scripting
Automated inventory and compliance validation
Data correlation and reporting
Working knowledge of deployment and application delivery technologies such as Octopus Deploy, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD pipelines from a compliance and vulnerability management perspective, rather than as a deployment administrator.
Role Boundary
This is a governance, coordination, compliance, and automation-focused role. The Application Compliance SME will not be responsible for the routine installation, configuration, administration, or direct production implementation of application components. Remediation changes will be executed by the respective Application, Platform, or Infrastructure teams, while the SME will identify risk, define compliance requirements, coordinate remediation, track progress, automate compliance activities, and validate closure.
Preferred Profile
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Application Compliance, Vulnerability Management, Web Services, Middleware, or Application Platforms, with sufficient technical depth to understand application technology stacks, versions, dependencies, vulnerabilities, and lifecycle risks.
The candidate should be capable of analyzing technical findings and translating them into clear remediation requirements for application and platform owners, while coordinating remediation through completion.
The individual should be comfortable working across Security, Infrastructure, Application, and Platform teams, challenging unresolved risks, tracking remediation commitments, and providing clear compliance status to stakeholders and leadership.
EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY_ Consulting _ RISK Internal Audit - Manager_Healthcare
As part of our Consulting Risk Internal Audit team, our clients look for EY s expertise across the Consulting solutions and specifically for engagements related to Internal Audit, Process compliance and reviews, SOX 404 and, Developing Standard Operating Procedure manuals.
There really is no average day in this role, since every client will have multi-faceted challenges and a distinct business environment. What it means is that you ll have an opportunity to learn and adapt to our clients cultures and contribute towards developing unique solutions that are tailored to individual engagements. Whichever industry or client you re working with, you ll have plenty of opportunities to expand your business network and transform yourself into a truly global professional.
The opportunity
This is client-facing role in a rapidly growing practice, where you ll build client relationships with key stakeholders, including management executives for some of the most globally recognized brands. It makes this the perfect place to gain a deeper understanding of complex businesses transactions, all the while recommending solutions to some of the most pressing business challenges and process inefficiencies. Youll also team with our performance improvement professionals in multidisciplinary engagements, helping major global clients transform and sustain business performance. The team is focused on leveraging emerging technologies like Robotics, AI, Advanced Analytics to enhance various Internal Audit and internal control solutions being provided to the client and actively work in building multiple tools and assets for efficient and effective client delivery. By plugging into our market-leading global network, youll gain the experience you need to become an exceptional Risk Advisor
Your key responsibilities
Market, Leadership and Growth
Executive-level skills in client relationship management and the ability to hold conversations with senior management executives.
Partnering with onshore teams to understand client s business related industry issues / trends and conduct Internal audits and internal control engagements for global clients.
Market Leadership
Participate in key business development efforts
Support the practice in building the Healthcare Sector - Specifically focusing on Healthcare - Providers and Payers (including third party insurance) experience within the Enterprise Risk Team.
Support multiple innovation initiatives to enhance existing solutions leveraging emerging technologies like Robotics, AI, Advanced Analytics
Collaborating with colleagues across multiple service lines, sharing your knowledge and experience to guide business decisions.
Monitoring industry news, tools and trends while suggesting potential risks, as well as opportunities to improve the way we work.
Collaborating with global Sector leads/ teams across the regions to help grow the Healthcare Sector Accounts across solutions
Opportunity of active participation in Healthcare Sector pursuits to bring in/ display the sector skillset within the team/ solutions/ enablers to bring the differentiation to the pursuit.
Support in building strategy around growing EYs and GDS footprint in the Healthcare Sector space, increasing GDS integration on the accounts.
Quality delivery
Independently manage client assignments with minimal supervision
Manage multiple assignments and related project teams.
Meet quality guidelines within the established turnaround time (or allotted budget) for assigned requests.
Constantly monitor project progress, manage risk and verify key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes.
Demonstrate application and solution-based approach to problem solving while executing client engagements and documenting working papers.
Anticipate and identify engagement related risks and escalate issues as appropriate on a timely basis.
Identify process gaps and accordingly provide recommendation in areas requiring improvement based on the clients business process and industry practice.
Operational Excellence
Suggest ideas on improving engagement productivity and identify opportunities for improving client service.
Manage engagement budgets and ensure compliance with engagement plans and internal quality risk management procedures.
Skills and attributes for success
Exceptional command on spoken and written English
Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations
Highly analytical, organized and meticulous consulting skills
Strong academic history (degree in Business, Accounting, or similar work experience in similar industry, Big 4 preferred)
Proficient in MS-Office Suite, data analysis validation
Team player with strong interpersonal skills
Ability to prioritize deliverables effectively in order to achieve optimum results.
To qualify for the role, you must have
More than 8 years of a Big 4 or professional firm or professional industry experience in risk , internal audit, internal controls
Specialization in handling engagements in the Healthcare Sector across the entire value chain.
Should have healthcare experience in
Providers: the ecosystem of providers which include hospitals, physician offices, academic medical centers, specialty care centers, urgent care, community and social care organizations, retail providers, home health care, digital health companies and virtual care platforms.
Payers: The payer for healthcare services may be a government or a health insurance company or a blend.
Experience of building/ implementing sector focused solutions for clients operating in the Healthcare Sector
Strong academic history (degree in Business, Accounting, Engineering or similar).
Strong multi-project management skills.
Skilled at collaborating, motivating and guiding high performance teams.
Cognitive problem solving capabilities, quick decision making skills and ability to handle complex situations with a calm demeanor.
Exceptional command on spoken and written English
Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations
Team player with strong interpersonal skills
Ability to think differently and innovate
Ideally, you ll also have
Responsible for the performance and appraisal of direct reports, including training and developing necessary skill sets to enable them to grow in their careers.
Mentor and coach junior team members, enabling them to meet their performance goals and successfully grow their careers.
Run sector focused upskilling programs to train the team on latest solutions/ technologies in the Healthcare Sector
Support in build new sector focused solutions in collaboration with the Global sector teams/ GDS sector leads to enhance the GDS Play in the Healthcare Sector
Lead delivery of key big sector accounts to ensure display of sector depth and knowledge to onshore, stabilizing the GDS play in the account.
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
Opportunities to work with EY Risk -Internal Audit practices global with leading businesses across a range of industries
What working at EY offers
At EY, we re dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that s right for you
